description:
**Req ID:** 394970
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a AI Engineer Advisor to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
Job Description – AI Engineer
  
  
Position Details
  
  
**Role:** AI Engineer – Agentic AI
  
  
**Grade:** Grade 10/11
  
  
**Experience Required:** 7–10 years overall, with at least 3 years of relevant AI / GenAI experience
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to design, build and deploy AI agents and Generative AI solutions for enterprise applications. The candidate will build agents that plan tasks, call tools and APIs, and complete multi-step workflows, along with the prompts, retrieval (RAG) pipelines and integrations behind them. The role also requires daily use of AI coding assistants to speed up delivery.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be able to work with data scientists, software engineers, product owners and business stakeholders to take AI solutions from idea to production.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Design, develop and deploy AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI or AutoGen.
* Connect agents to enterprise systems and data through REST APIs, SDKs, tool / function calling and MCP servers.
* Write, test and refine prompts so that LLMs give accurate, consistent and safe responses.
* Build RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, embeddings, vector databases and retrieval tuning.
* Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar) for development, testing, code reviews and documentation.
* Package and deploy AI services using Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD pipelines on Azure, AWS or GCP.
* Build user interfaces for human-AI interaction, including human review and approval steps.
* Set up evaluation and monitoring for accuracy, hallucinations, latency and cost, and act on the results.
* Ensure solutions meet security, privacy and responsible AI guidelines, including bias mitigation and prompt-injection safeguards.
* Lead AI projects end to end, ensuring timely delivery and quality.
* Mentor junior engineers, review code and share best practices with the team.
* Present AI opportunities and project updates to senior management and stakeholders.
* Support RFPs, RFIs, solution demos and proofs of concept.
* Document prompt strategies, agent designs and outcomes for reuse across teams.

Must Have Skills Qualifications
  

* 7+ years of overall experience in software engineering, data engineering or ML engineering.
* 3+ years of relevant experience in AI / ML, including hands-on GenAI work.
* Strong hands-on coding in Python (C# acceptable alongside Python).
* Hands-on experience building AI agents with at least one framework such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen or Semantic Kernel.
* Experience with LLMs from OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google (Gemini), Azure OpenAI or open-source models.
* Strong prompt engineering skills for real business use cases.
* Experience with RAG, embeddings and vector databases such as Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector or Azure AI Search.
* Experience integrating AI with applications through REST APIs, SDKs and tool / function calling.
* Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or Cursor.
* Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) and its AI services.
* Experience with Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines.
* Good problem-solving, analytical and communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Front-end skills to build simple agent interfaces (React, Streamlit, Gradio or similar).
* Experience in client-facing delivery, pre-sales or proofs of concept.

Nice to have skills
  

* Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent-to-agent (A2A) protocols.
* Experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools such as LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas or DeepEval.
* Exposure to classic ML using TensorFlow, PyTorch or scikit-learn, and data processing with pandas, NumPy or Spark.
* Knowledge graphs (Neo4j) or graph-based RAG.

Educational Qualification
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science or a related field.

Key Competencies
  

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work in cross-functional teams.

* **Data Store:** Relational Data structures, SQL

title: 10.Senior Product Manager
description:
**About** **PayPay India**
--------------------------

PayPay, a fintech company providing a service enjoyed by over 75 million users since its launch in 2018 in Japan. The company is now home to a very diverse team of members from more than 50 countries. We grew to a team of several thousand employees in Japan but are far from over. We are still in the Day 1. Every day, new members join us from all over the world to create new value and deliver it to society.

**Why India ?**
---------------

To build our Payment services, we got technical cooperation from Paytm (A large payment service company in India). And based on their customer-first technologies , we created and expanded the smartphone payment service in Japan. Therefore, we have decided to establish a development base in India, because it is a major IT country with many talented engineers, as evidenced by the fact that cutting-edge mobile payments can continue to be generated.

**OUR VISION IS UNLIMITED**
---------------------------

We dare to believe that we do not need a clear vision to create a future beyond our imagination. PayPay will always stay true to our roots and realise a vision (future) that no one else can imagine by constantly taking risks and challenging ourselves. With this mindset, you will be presented with new and exciting opportunities on a daily basis and have the opportunity to grow and reach new dimensions that you could never have imagined.

**AI-First Culture at PayPay**
------------------------------

At PayPay, we believe the future of software development is AI-augmented engineering. Every engineer is expected to actively leverage AI tools for code reviews, testing, documentation, debugging, and productivity improvements. AI is not optional — it is a mandatory part of our daily engineering workflow. Candidates must demonstrate both hands-on experience and the right mindset to integrate AI effectively into their workflow, while maintaining the engineering rigor, ownership, and problem-solving skills that only humans can provide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

### **Overview**

PayPay India is seeking an autonomous **Senior Product Manager** to own and drive critical credit and merchant financial products in close collaboration with PayPay group companies.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end product execution, turning business requirements into scalable platform features and seamless end-user experiences. You will work independently on day-to-day execution while collaborating closely with business partners, credit modeling experts, data teams, and engineering to deliver high-impact financial products in Japan.

### **Main Responsibilities**

* **Product Ownership & Execution:** Drive end-to-end product lifecycle for merchant credit and bank integration products from ideation to launch.
* **Cross-Entity Collaboration:** Act as the key product owner working independently with business teams, partner banks, and PayPay group companies in Japan to understand business needs and translate them into actionable product roadmaps.

* **Cross-Functional Alignment with Modeling Teams:** Collaborate with credit modeling, risk, and analytics teams to seamlessly incorporate scoring models, data pipelines, and decision engines into product flows.
* **Data-Driven Optimization:** Analyze product performance, user behavior, and platform metrics using SQL and analytical tools to continuously identify feature gaps and optimize customer experiences.
* **Roadmap Prioritization:** Define product challenges and opportunities, balancing speed of execution with long-term platform scalability.

### **Qualifications :**

#### **Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** Minimum **5+ years** of Product Management experience (7-9 years of overall experience).
* **Technical & Analytical Mindset:** Bachelor’s degree in a technology discipline (or 2+ years in a technical role) with a solid understanding of APIs, technical system architecture, statistical concepts, and data analysis (SQL).
* **Execution Autonomy:** Strong bias for action ("Get Things Done" attitude) with a track record of driving complex initiatives independently.
* **Communication:** Demonstrated success collaborating with cross-functional and international business stakeholders.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* **Domain Versatility:** Prior background across fintech, e-commerce, consumer internet, or high-scale platform products
* Experience collaborating with cross-border business teams
* Experience leveraging AI/LLM tools in daily workflows (e.g., documentation, spec drafting, review, user flow mapping) while maintaining accountability for output.
* **Leverage AI/LLM-based tools in daily workflows (e.g., code development, reviews, testing, debugging, documentation), while ensuring human oversight, judgment, and accountability drive the final product.**

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
Job Description – E-Commerce Marketplace Manager

**Company:** Birju Mahavir Pvt. Ltd. (Brijbooti)  
**Job Title:** E-Commerce Marketplace Manager  
**Department:** E-Commerce / Online Sales  
**Job Location:** Palwal, Haryana  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years in E-Commerce Marketplace Management  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented E-Commerce Marketplace Manager to manage and grow our business on Amazon and Flipkart. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end marketplace operations, sales growth, product listings, advertising campaigns, inventory management, order processing, account health and profitability.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience managing seller accounts on Amazon and Flipkart, with a strong understanding of marketplace policies, sales analytics and performance optimization.

Key Responsibilities1. Marketplace Account Management

* Independently manage and operate Amazon and Flipkart seller accounts.
* Monitor account health, seller performance metrics, policy compliance and marketplace notifications.
* Resolve account-related issues, listing errors, policy violations and operational challenges.
* Ensure timely action on account performance alerts and marketplace requirements.

2. Product Listing & Catalogue Management

* Create, upload and optimise product listings, including titles, descriptions, bullet points, keywords, images and product specifications.
* Manage product catalogue updates, variations, pricing and category mapping.
* Improve product visibility and organic rankings through keyword research and listing optimisation.
* Coordinate with the design team for product images, infographics, A+ Content and enhanced brand content wherever applicable.

3. Sales Growth & Business Development

* Develop and implement strategies to increase sales, conversion rates and market share.
* Identify growth opportunities through product performance analysis, competitor research and market trends.
* Monitor daily, weekly and monthly sales targets.
* Plan and execute promotional campaigns, deals, discounts and seasonal sales.
* Launch new products and improve the performance of existing products.

4. Advertising & Campaign Management

* Plan, execute and optimize Amazon Ads and Flipkart advertising campaigns.
* Manage advertising budgets, keyword targeting, bids and campaign performance.
* Monitor ACOS, ROAS, CTR, CPC and conversion rates.
* Optimize campaigns to improve sales while maintaining advertising efficiency and profitability.
* Prepare regular advertising performance reports and implement corrective actions.

5. Inventory & Order Management

* Monitor inventory levels and ensure product availability across marketplaces.
* Coordinate with the warehouse and dispatch teams to ensure timely order processing and shipping.
* Prevent stock-outs, excess inventory and order cancellations.
* Manage FBA, Easy Ship, Flipkart fulfilment or other applicable fulfilment models.
* Track returns, replacements, damaged products and inventory discrepancies.

6. Pricing & Profitability Management

* Monitor competitor pricing and marketplace price trends.
* Develop pricing strategies based on product cost, marketplace fees, advertising expenses and margins.
* Track SKU-wise sales, revenue, contribution margins and profitability.
* Identify loss-making products and recommend corrective measures.
* Monitor marketplace fees, settlements, reimbursements and claims.

7. Returns, Claims & Customer Issues

* Monitor customer feedback, product ratings, reviews and return reasons.
* Investigate high-return products and recommend corrective action.
* Handle seller support cases, reimbursement claims, order-related issues and payment discrepancies.
* Work towards reducing returns, cancellations and negative customer experiences.

8. Reporting & Performance Analysis

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports covering sales, orders, advertising, inventory and profitability.
* Analyse SKU-wise and marketplace-wise performance.
* Track KPIs and provide actionable recommendations to management.
* Maintain accurate records of sales, expenses, settlements and marketplace performance.

9. Team & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with warehouse, packaging, accounts, design and product teams.
* Ensure timely execution of marketplace activities and new product launches.
* Take ownership of day-to-day marketplace operations and work independently to achieve business targets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing Amazon and Flipkart seller accounts.
* Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Practical experience in product listing, catalogue optimization, sponsored ads and campaign management.
* Good understanding of marketplace fees, pricing, inventory, returns and seller performance metrics.
* Strong analytical skills and proficiency in MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and reporting.
* Ability to analyse data, solve operational problems and improve sales profitability.
* Good communication, coordination and time-management skills.
* Experience in FMCG, food products, herbal products, spices or consumer goods will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly sales and revenue growth.
* Marketplace-wise and SKU-wise profitability.
* Advertising efficiency (ACOS/ROAS).
* Product listing quality and organic ranking improvement.
* Inventory availability and reduction in stock-outs.
* Account health and policy compliance.
* Reduction in returns, cancellations and operational errors.
* Achievement of monthly sales and profit targets.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a proactive professional who can independently manage Amazon and Flipkart operations, take data-driven decisions and contribute directly to the company's online sales and profitability growth.

**How to Apply:** Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with details of the marketplaces they have managed, sales volumes handled, advertising experience and key achievements.

title: Manager, Account Management
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Account ManagementMastercard is seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented professional to join the Financial Institutions (FI) team. This individual contributor role will be responsible for managing and growing strategic relationships with Banks and Financial Institutions while identifying new business opportunities that drive revenue growth and expand Mastercard's presence within the banking ecosystem.  
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted partner to customers, developing deep stakeholder relationships, uncovering opportunities for collaboration, and delivering innovative payment solutions that create mutual value. The role requires a combination of relationship management, business development, strategic thinking, and commercial execution.  
  
Key Responsibilities  

* Own and manage relationships with a portfolio of Banks and Financial Institutions, serving as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans to strengthen existing client relationships, increase customer engagement, and drive sustainable business growth.
* Identify opportunities within existing customer portfolios to expand Mastercard's products, services, and solutions, generating incremental revenue and increasing market share.
* Proactively scout for and secure new business opportunities with existing and prospective banking partners to achieve business development objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision makers, including CXOs, Business Heads, Product Heads, Payments Heads, Cards Leaders, and Digital Banking stakeholders.
* Work closely with customers to understand their strategic priorities and align Mastercard solutions to support their growth ambitions.
* Lead customer engagements and business discussions to identify opportunities across card issuance, digital payments, acceptance, commercial solutions, value-added services, and emerging payment technologies.
* Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new and existing Mastercard products and solutions.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Product, Marketing, Franchise, Customer Solutions, Consulting, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver customer-centric solutions and achieve business objectives.
* Analyse customer portfolios, market trends, competitive dynamics, and industry developments to identify growth opportunities and formulate winning strategies.
* Prepare business cases, commercial proposals, and account growth plans to support customer acquisition and portfolio expansion.
* Lead and support commercial negotiations, partnership discussions, and contract renewals to maximize customer value and business outcomes.
* Track account performance, pipeline opportunities, revenue contribution, and execution against business targets.
* Drive assigned strategic initiatives and projects from concept through implementation, ensuring successful execution and measurable business impact.

  
About You  

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Marketing, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline. MBA preferred.
* Experience in Relationship Management, Account Management, Business Development, Sales, or Product Management within the Banking, Payments, Cards, Fintech, or broader BFSI sector.
* Demonstrated experience managing relationships with Banks and Financial Institutions.
* Proven ability to strengthen existing customer relationships and identify new opportunities that drive incremental revenue growth.
* Strong track record of delivering revenue targets, portfolio growth, and market expansion.
* Deep understanding of the payment’s ecosystem, including cards, digital payments, issuing, acquiring, and banking products.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience developing business cases, commercial proposals, and partnership strategies.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage and influence senior decision makers both internally and externally.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate insights into actionable business opportunities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
* Demonstrated leadership through influence and collaboration across cross-functional teams.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Security Analyst
description:
Location: Bengaluru

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1745370

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Information Security Analyst – Sr. Associate**
------------------------------------------------

Today’s world is fueled by vast amounts of information. Data is more valuable than ever before. Protecting data and information systems is central to doing business, and everyone in EY Information Security has a critical role to play. Join a global team of over 950 people who collaborate to support the business of EY by protecting EY and client information assets! Our Information Security professionals enable EY to work securely and deliver secure products and services, as well as detect and quickly respond to security events as they happen. Together, the efforts of our dedicated team helps protect the EY brand and build client trust.

Within Information Security we blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and technology solutions as we consider the entire security lifecycle. You will join a team of hardworking, security-focused individuals dedicated to supporting, protecting and enabling the business through innovative, secure solutions that provide speed to market and business value.

  

**The opportunity**
-------------------

The Technology Assurance, Risk, and Policy (TARP) function within Information Security strives to create and promote a holistic Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program by creating a robust, resilient, and proactive governance framework, supported by a strategic risk management approach and stringent compliance structures. It aims to integrate and align its GRC initiatives in line with the global firm's objectives and emerging threats within the cybersecurity landscape.

The Technology Assurance team develops provides security assurance on EY’s deployed technology to internal and external stakeholders. The team members act as subject matter experts across a number of information and cyber security disciplines that include, among others, application and network penetrating testing and vulnerabilities identification, information security audits, compliance to cyber security and regulatory frameworks, and conducting or coordinating security audits and assessments. The team develops the overall strategy and for implementing various technical attack and penetration assessment, information security audits like HITRUST, SOC 1 and SOC 2 to provide third-party assurance to EY’s Clients in EY’s senior leadership. The team is responsible of overseeing and leading the technical audit process that includes third-party external assessments of client-facing critical business applications, M365 Teams Apps, Network, cloud configuration reviews, infrastructure reviews, UK Cyber Essentials Plus Certification and UK IT Health Check Certification. The team manages Attack and Penetration testing controls based on Industry Standards and obtain third-party security attestations/certifications to enable EY Business to win in the market. The team also manages and maintains the firm’s ISO 27001 certifications is responsible for the end-end delivery of attestation audits like SOC 1 and SOC2. Technical compliance to regulatory framework like Internation Standard on Quality Management (ISQM) is also a responsibility of the team.

  

An Information Security Analyst will work closely with team leads to assist with one of the security functional areas described above.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Create creating various process documents and assist with the maintenance of the team’s internal procedure and process documents.
* Assist with one or more of the following areas:
  + Develop comprehensive Information Security technical audit plans and schedules based on client demands, regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and organizational objectives.
  + Maintain the firm’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) and participate in the various ISO 27001 activities like risk assessments, maintain monitoring framework for key security metrics and remediation tracking of observations and finding.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including IT teams, compliance teams, ET and CT, to ensure alignment of audit activities with organizational goals and priorities.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation of vulnerabilities, remediation plans, and risk mitigation strategies to share with stakeholders and clients.
* Stay informed about emerging threats, attack vectors, and security vulnerabilities affecting the organization’s technology stack.
* Collaboration with other Information Security groups and external stakeholders across EY is key to this role.

**Skills and attributes for success**
-------------------------------------

* Strong Background in various Information Technology domains
* Working knowledge of Information Security concepts
* Excellent organizational and coordination abilities
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, and analyse information
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt to a fast-moving environment
* Critical thinking skills
* Strong time management skills

  

**To qualify for the role you must have**
-----------------------------------------

* Min 3 years of experience in an information security or technology audit field
* Ability to work collaboratively with various teams to obtain an in-depth understanding of the process and the documentation requirements
* Ability to deliver high quality documentation paying attention to every detail
* Ability to quickly grasp complex technical concepts and make them easily understandable in text and pictures
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills
* Must be a strong multi-tasker and be able to prioritize duties

**Ideally, you’ll also have**
-----------------------------

* Bachelors or above in Information Technology or Cyber Security related Degrees
* Keen interest in pursuing relevant Information Security Certifications like CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 lead auditor, ISO 42001 lead auditor/implementer, CISA, etc.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

As part of this role, you will work in a highly coordinated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:

* **Continuous learning:** You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You will be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: BUK TESCO Bank - Core Banking Infrastructure Engineer - BA4
description:

Area of Expertise: Technology

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000136180

  

As a Service Engineer at Barclays TESCO Bank, where you will play a key role in the supporting applications end-to-end, enhancing capabilities, and delivery continuous improvement of core banking platforms. You will be responsible for ensuring the resilience, performance, and integrity of critical systems while contributing to strategic change and operational excellence within the technology function.

To be successful in this role, you will need experience in:

* **Application Support & Service Delivery**
    
  Leading and Providing end-to-end L2/L3 support for core banking applications, ensuring adherence to service level agreements (SLAs) and operational KPIs. Proactively monitoring system health, managing incidents and service requests, and ensuring high availability of business-critical services.

* **Driving End to End Automation**

Lead the implementation of end-to-end CI/CD automation using Gitlab, Jenkins and Nexus, reducing manual effort while improving deployment consistency, Security and release efficiency.

* **Containerisation, Kubernetes & EKS Engineering**

Hands on proficiency in containerisation, including Docker and Kubernetes/EKS, with the ability to troubleshoot workloads, optimise cluster performance, and design/maintain Helm charts.

* **Maintenance & Continuous Improvement**
    
  Supporting ongoing maintenance activities including defect resolution, patching, and platform upgrades. Driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance application stability, performance, and scalability in line with Barclays’ strategic technology objectives.

* **Change, Release & Environment Management**
    
  Managing application changes through the Barclays change governance framework, ensuring controlled and compliant deployments across environments. Supporting release activities with minimal disruption to production services.

* **Incident, Problem & Root Cause Analysis**
    
  Leading incident triage, performing root cause analysis, and implementing permanent fixes. Contributing to problem management processes to reduce recurring incidents and improve system resilience.

* **Stakeholder Collaboration & Demand Support**
    
  Working closely with business users, development teams, and infrastructure partners to manage demand, prioritise enhancements, and support delivery of the application backlog and strategic initiatives.

* **Operational Excellence & Process Optimisation**
    
  Identifying opportunities to streamline processes, automate repetitive tasks, and implement best practices to improve operational efficiency and user experience.

* **Risk, Compliance & Controls**
    
  Ensuring compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and audit standards. Supporting risk management activities including controls monitoring, incident reporting, and documentation (e.g., RCSAs, records inventory).

* **Environment & Infrastructure Coordination**
    
  Collaborating with infrastructure, database, and middleware teams to manage application environments, capacity planning, and performance tuning.

* **Business Continuity & Resilience**
    
  Supporting disaster recovery planning, failover testing, and continuity processes to ensure minimal disruption to critical banking services.

* **Domain** Banking & Financial Systems

* **Technical Skills** AWS, GitLab, Jenkins, Terraform and Ansible, Kubernetes, Nexus, Python or PowerShell or Any scripting Language Windows/RHEL

* **Good-To-Have:** Datadog , Snyk or SonarQube, ServiceNow/JIRA/Confluence, Java , Safe Agile, Knowledge Fiserv suite of applications

**You may also require the following skills and experience:**

Strong understanding of ITIL practices (Incident, Problem, Change Management)

Experience working within regulated financial services environments.

Ability to manage competing priorities in a high-pressure production support environment.

Effective communication and stakeholder management skills

Continuous learning mindset to adapt to evolving banking technologies and platforms.

  
  

You may be assessed on the key skills needed for success in this role, including application support, incident and problem management, risk and controls, system reliability, and technical expertise in banking platforms.

  
  

This role is based in our Bengaluru office.

**Purpose of the role**

To build and maintain infrastructure platforms and products that support applications and data systems, using hardware, software, networks, and cloud computing platforms as required with the aim of ensuring that the infrastructure is reliable, scalable, and secure. Ensure the reliability, availability, and scalability of the systems, platforms, and technology through the application of software engineering techniques, automation, and best practices in incident response.

**Accountabilities**

* Build Engineering: Development, delivery, and maintenance of high-quality infrastructure solutions to fulfil business requirements ensuring measurable reliability, performance, availability, and ease of use. Including the identification of the appropriate technologies and solutions to meet business, optimisation, and resourcing requirements.
* Incident Management: Monitoring of IT infrastructure and system performance to measure, identify, address, and resolve any potential issues, vulnerabilities, or outages. Use of data to drive down mean time to resolution.
* Automation: Development and implementation of automated tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention, utilising software scripting/coding disciplines.
* Security: Implementation of a secure configuration and measures to protect infrastructure against cyber-attacks, vulnerabilities, and other security threats, including protection of hardware, software, and data from unauthorised access.
* Teamwork: Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, architects, and other engineers to define IT Infrastructure requirements, devise solutions, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives via a data driven approach.
* Learning: Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations, and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.

**Analyst Expectations**

* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.

The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  

* Business acumen, and the ability to communicate to executives, business domain stakeholders and technical staff.
* Strong project management, acumen and familiarity working in agile environments.
* Experience with innovation and ideation methods, such as design thinking and product management.
* Demonstrated influence, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work well with others and exhibit leadership.
* Be an excellent communicator and collaborator, engaging with multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders. Team player with collaborative and inclusive approach.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  

* 10+ years in data governance, model risk, technology risk, compliance or a related analytical role.
* Bachelors degree in field like Computer Science, Information technology, Math, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance (with focus on analysis) etc. and/or relevant proven work experience is required

**Working with Us**

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

  
  

Your Team:

  
  

Enterprise Services provides strategic workplace solutions and robust infrastructure to deliver a consistent employee experience globally. Our team spans real estate strategy, workplace operations and facilities management, risk and resilience, corporate security and executive operations, and workplace experience and insights.

  
  

Your role and impact:

Your role will shape the trusted data foundations and analytical products that support both Enterprise Services and Digital Workplace. Working closely with a pipeline engineer, you will understand workplace data requirements, help translate source data into reliable analytical models and reports, and turn data from our physical workplaces and digital employee environment into actionable insights. You will focus on building effective dashboards, reports and the underlying datasets which can be accessed through self-service and via AI tools. Your efforts will enable dependable reporting, self-service analytics and actionable insight into how we operate globally for nearly 30,000 employees.

  
  

As a Data Engineer, you will:

* Develop and optimize trusted data models and shared semantic models that standardize core entities, dimensions and metrics across physical and digital workplace reporting.

* Create and maintain Power BI datasets, dashboards, reports and analytical tools that enable leaders and operational teams to understand employee experience, technology performance, space utilization and workplace operations.

* Enable secure self-service analytics and responsible data use through reusable datasets, clear documentation and appropriate access controls, aligned with privacy, audit and InfoSec standards.

* Implement data quality, lineage, testing and observability controls, investigating issues and working with source-system owners to resolve root causes.

* Define, develop and maintain automated, monitored and well-documented analytical transformations and reporting processes, partnering with the pipeline engineer on upstream dependencies to improve reliability, refresh performance and time from source data to decision-ready insight.

* Partner with a pipeline engineer to define data ingestion, integration and transformation requirements across digital workplace platforms, workplace technology, occupancy and space systems, facilities and operational sources.

* Partner with product managers, analysts, technology teams and workplace stakeholders to translate business questions into clear technical requirements and reliable data solutions.
  

  

What you'll need:

* 3–6 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics engineering, data engineering or a related discipline, including delivery of production-grade data and reporting solutions.

* Knowledge of data visualization best practices and design principles to create clear, engaging insights that communicate the story, highlight what matters and support decision-making.

* Strong SQL skills and practical experience designing, querying and optimizing relational, dimensional and analytical data models.

* Experience partnering with data or pipeline engineers to specify source, ingestion, transformation and integration needs across APIs, files, databases and cloud platforms, and to validate that resulting datasets meet analytical requirements.

title: Lead Security Engineer (Privileged Access Management )
description:
**Aboud Gartner Information Security:**

Gartner Information Security enables the business to move quickly and confidently by protecting our people, data, and ideas. We are a global team of defenders, investigators, engineers, and lifelong learners who solve complex security challenges together.

You will join an inclusive, security-first culture where expertise is shared, thoughtful challenge is encouraged, and strong ideas can come from anyone. If you are curious, practical, and motivated to strengthen the security posture of a global organization, you will have the opportunity to make a visible impact here.

**About the role:**

We are seeking an experienced Lead Security Engineer specializing in Privileged Access Management (PAM) to join our Identity Management team. In this mission-critical role, you will provide technical leadership for the design, implementation, and operation of enterprise PAM capabilities that secure privileged access across on-premises infrastructure, SaaS platforms, and multi-cloud environments.

You will be responsible for defining technical strategy, driving architectural decisions, and leading the delivery of PAM initiatives that reduce organizational risk while enabling business agility. In addition to hands-on engineering responsibilities, you will mentor team members, establish engineering standards, and drive execution of complex security projects from inception through operationalization.

**What you'll do:**

* Provide technical leadership for the IAM PAM engineering function, driving architecture, engineering standards, and operational excellence across privileged access solutions.
* Engage with technology leaders, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to drive the delivery of secure, scalable, and resilient solutions, ensuring critical systems are protected and aligned with organizational objectives.
* Lead the design, implementation, and operationalization of privileged access management solutions, including enterprise vaults, secrets management, privileged session management, privileged endpoint controls, and Zero Standing Privileges (ZSP) workflows.
* Work within an agile environment to define requirements, prioritize work, manage technical dependencies, and ensure successful delivery of PAM capabilities.
* Develop and oversee automation, integrations, and self-service capabilities that improve security posture and operational efficiency.
* Troubleshoot complex PAM issues and serve as a technical escalation point, providing guidance to engineers, stakeholders, and partner teams.
* Analyze enterprise privileged access use cases and develop detailed technical requirements, governance frameworks, and operational support models.
* Drive adoption of security-by-design principles across cloud, infrastructure, and application platforms.
* Mentor and develop engineers by providing technical coaching, design reviews, knowledge sharing, and guidance on engineering best practices.
* Ensure the reliability and availability of mission-critical IAM systems and participate in the IAM On-Call rotation.
Define, track, and communicate PAM metrics and key performance indicators to demonstrate risk reduction, operational maturity, and program effectiveness.  

**What you'll need:**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 6 to 8 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM) and cybersecurity, including six or more years of experience implementing and operating enterprise PAM platforms such as CyberArk or similar solutions.
* Demonstrated experience leading the design and delivery of enterprise-scale PAM programs and complex security initiatives.
* Experience working with fast-paced operations and development teams; experience with DevOps practices is required.
Knowledge of information security technologies, regulations, controls, and industry standards.  

**Must have:**

* Hands-on experience with enterprise PAM platforms, including credential vaulting, privileged session management, secrets management, and privileged access governance.
* Experience with Zero Standing Privilege (ZSP), Just-in-Time (JIT), and other modern privileged access management controls.
* Strong understanding of cloud IAM and PAM capabilities and familiarity with IaaS and PaaS architectures across AWS, Azure, GCP, and other enterprise cloud platforms.
* Experience developing automation and integrations using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
* Ability to build and deploy automation on cloud platforms, with familiarity in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.
* Working knowledge of IAM services, LDAP, Active Directory, single sign-on (SSO), and federation protocols.
* Working knowledge of PKI fundamentals, certificate lifecycle management, and secrets management best practices.
* Experience defining technical requirements, engineering standards, governance models, and operational support processes.
Proven ability to lead complex technical projects from solution design through implementation and operationalization.  

**Nice to have:**

* Familiarity with AI Agent Identity security concepts, including credential governance, delegated authorization, runtime access controls, and lifecycle management for autonomous and semi-autonomous AI systems.
* Experience securing non-human identities, including service accounts, workloads, APIs, automation platforms, and AI agents within enterprise PAM and Identity Security programs.
* Knowledge of machine identity authentication frameworks and standards, including SPIFFE/SPIRE and Zero Trust concepts.
* Relevant industry certifications such as CyberArk Defender/Sentry, CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, or equivalent credentials.
Experience working in highly regulated environments with stringent compliance, audit, and security requirements.  

**Who you are:**

* A lifelong learner with a desire for continuous personal and professional development.
* Someone with proven communication, collaboration, and critical thinking skills.
* Able to build trusting, meaningful relationships with peers, stakeholders, partners, and suppliers.
* Capable of defining and communicating risk in a business-relevant language to both non-technical and technical audiences, including Leadership teams.
Someone who can apply expert knowledge to solve complex business/technical issues.

The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function manages all aspects of management reporting encompassing budgeting and forecasting, strategic and customer planning. This includes the management and execution of the corporate reporting and planning requirements.  
Business Finance Centre provides FP&A expertise to the organization by compiling and analysing metrics, identifying trends and problems, communicating information to relevant groups, and recommending actions to improve financial performance.  
  
Revenue Assurance (RA) is a function within Finance responsible for strengthening revenue controls, identifying billing opportunities, and minimizing revenue leakage across QMR (Quarterly Mastercard Reported), global billing processes, and billing reviews of revenue streams across core and services.  
The role focuses on ensuring billing accuracy, driving revenue recovery, and partnering with cross-functional teams to enhance revenue integrity and controls.  
  
This position will report to Director, Revenue Assurance, and is responsible for driving data analytics excellence for Global Corporate Revenue assurance team.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities  

* Lead and own revenue assurance review projects to identify billing leakages and ensure billing completeness and accuracy.
* Working with billing on understanding rules, determining if there are any billing issues, working through the back billing, and working through system fixes
* Perform in-depth analysis of data systems and process flows to identify and resolve root causes of revenue leakage. Conduct rigorous data analysis from Mastercard databases to identify, research, and resolve revenue leakage; synthesize findings into actional insights and recommendations
* Understand and validate billing logic by recreating billing from core systems and comparing it with actual billed amounts.
* To work with the pricing teams to see any gaps in pricing or understanding the intent of pricing to determine if we are billing on what we intended to bill on.
* Support risk-based prioritization plans for revenue stream reviews based on materiality, business inputs, and new initiatives
* Perform financial analysis to estimate revenue impact at customer and country levels and support recovery decisions.
* Collaborate with Finance, Product, and GBSC teams to improve billing accuracy, implement fixes, and execute back-billing.
* Communicate identified revenue leakage opportunities, recovery actions/waivers to Regional Finance team and senior stakeholders.
* Act as an active member for all billing related matters and ensure alignment with corporate Revenue Assurance strategies.
* Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders such as Finance, Product, GBSC, etc., to develop analytical toolkit that drives efficiency on issue detection for key initiatives and focuses across corporate and regions
* Partner cross-functionally with internal stakeholders such as Finance, Product, GBSC, etc., to develop analytical toolkit that drives efficiency on issue detection for key initiatives and focuses across corporate and regions

  
All about you:  

* CA/MBA (Finance preferred); CPA/CFA certification is an added advantage.

Strong proficiency in database management, Microsoft Office applications, and data analytics.
  

* Demonstrated success in Revenue Assurance, with the ability to thrive in project-based roles requiring self-initiative and self-motivation.
* Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to simplify and articulate complex issues effectively.
* Knowledge on tools like Alteryx, Tableau , Hyperion etc.
* Structured, proactive problem-solver with a strong focus on process improvement and execution.
* High degree of ownership, business acumen, and entrepreneurial mindset.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across teams and all management levels.
* Proven ability to manage time-sensitive matters, ensuring timely follow-up and closure.
* Capable of handling multiple priorities simultaneously while working effectively with cross-functional partners.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Analyst II - Availability Planning
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**Position:**
Supply Planning Analyst – Availability Planning
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad
  
  
**Overview**
The Supply Planning Analyst – Availability Planning is responsible for ensuring product availability across assigned Business Units (BUs) through proactive supply risk identification, mitigation planning, inventory optimization, and cross-functional collaboration. This role requires strong analytical capabilities to balance customer service, inventory, and supply chain efficiency while supporting business growth objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor short-term and long-term supply risks across assigned Business Units and proactively identify potential service disruptions.
* Perform root cause analysis of supply constraints and develop actionable mitigation plans to minimize business impact.
* Evaluate alternative supply scenarios and recommend the most effective actions to maintain product availability.
* Collaborate closely with Production Planners across manufacturing sites to ensure alignment of supply plans and production schedules.
* Partner with Demand Planning and Customer Service teams to communicate supply risks, service impacts, and mitigation actions.
* Coordinate with Logistics and Control Tower teams to monitor product movements and ensure timely arrival of finished goods at DRP warehouses.
* Review safety stock and cycle stock parameters on a quarterly basis and recommend optimization opportunities.
* Monitor excess, slow-moving, and non-moving inventory and work with Business Units and Production Planning teams to minimize supply chain risks and write-offs.
* Evaluate and approve Additional Volume Requests (AVR) within defined timelines while balancing supply constraints and service commitments.
* Support New Product Launches (NPL), product transitions, and Run-In Run-Out (RIRO) activities through effective cross-functional coordination.
* Participate in daily and weekly supply review meetings with Demand Planning, Customer Service, Production Planning, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure timely escalation of supply constraints and support decision-making through data-driven analysis.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance supply planning processes, service performance, and inventory efficiency.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Case Fill Rate (CFR)
* Days Inventory Outstanding (DIO)
* Reduction in excess and non-moving inventory
* Supply chain risk mitigation effectiveness
* On-time AVR approvals
* Successful execution of product launches and RIRO projects

**Key Interfaces**

* Demand Planning
* Customer Service
* Production Planning
* Logistics and Control Tower
* Business Unit Supply Chain Teams
* Project Management Teams
* Manufacturing Sites

**Requirements**

* 4-6 years of experience in Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, Availability Planning, or related Supply Chain functions.
* Strong understanding of supply planning processes, inventory management, and risk mitigation.
* Experience working with SAP/APO/IBP or equivalent planning systems.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and supply chain analytics.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to perform root cause analysis.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with a customer-focused mindset.
* Fluent in English with strong verbal and written communication skills.

**Apparel Product Development & Merchandising Domain Specialist**
with strong knowledge of garment product development, sourcing, technical merchandising, and brand-side operations.

This is a domain expertise and product development role, not a conventional merchandising execution position. The selected candidate will work closely with our product, AI, and engineering teams to translate real-world apparel industry workflows into intelligent software solutions.

We are looking for someone who understands not only
**what merchandisers do, but why they do it, how decisions are made, and where existing processes can be improved.**

* Work closely with product leaders and AI engineering teams.
* Apply real-world merchandising experience to solve industry-wide operational challenges.

**1. Apparel Industry Domain Expertise**

* Provide practical domain knowledge across product development, merchandising, sourcing, sampling, costing, and pre-production activities.
* Explain end-to-end workflows followed by fashion brands, buying offices, and apparel manufacturers.

* Explain vendor selection, quotation comparison, target costing, and supplier coordination processes.
* Understand how brands coordinate with multiple factories and track product development progress.
* Identify operational challenges in brand-to-manufacturer communication, sample management, and approval tracking.

**3. AI Product Development & Workflow Automation**

* Collaborate with AI engineers and product teams to convert merchandising processes into software requirements.
* **Identify repetitive manual activities suitable for AI-driven automation.**
* Help design AI agents for sampling, costing, technical document processing, approvals, and workflow tracking.
* Validate AI-generated information against actual apparel industry practices.
* Define business rules, workflow exceptions, and scenarios requiring human intervention.
* Provide practical feedback to improve product accuracy, usability, and industry relevance.

**4. Product Testing & Validation**

* Develop realistic merchandising scenarios using tech packs, email conversations, costing sheets, approval documents, and WIP trackers.
* Test AI product features from the perspective of merchandisers, sourcing professionals, and product development teams.
* Identify incorrect interpretations, missing information, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

**5. Customer & Product Collaboration**

* Participate in product discussions, demonstrations, and feedback sessions with apparel manufacturers, buying offices, and brands.
* Understand customer workflows and translate operational requirements into actionable product improvements.
* Work with internal teams to prioritize features based on business value and user needs.
* Support the development of relevant industry use cases and product demonstrations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

What Success Looks Like

title: Staff Architect
description:
We are looking for a Staff Architect to help drive architecture across two connected pillars at organisation: the internal AI engineering platform that accelerates how teams build, and the client-facing product architecture that our customers depend on every day. This is a hands-on, deeply collaborative technical leadership role for someone who has shipped real systems with LLMs and agents, who is comfortable shaping architecture across services, data, security and developer experience, and who is energized by working through other engineers rather than around them.

**The Role**

You will help drive the technical direction of organisation's AI engineering platform and the architecture of our client-facing products. That means partnering with engineering leads, product, security and operations to shape the systems that internal teams build on, the products customers rely on and the AI capabilities that increasingly run through both. You will write code, write design docs, lead reviews, mentor other senior and staff engineers and turn good local decisions into durable enterprise patterns.

This role is intentionally cross-cutting. You will move between platform problems (how engineers and product managers ship faster and more consistently across the company) and product problems (how our client-facing systems scale, integrate, stay secure and incorporate AI in ways that hold up in a regulated industry).

**Key Responsibilities**

**Internal AI Engineering Platform**

* Help drive the architecture of organisation's internal AI scaffolding platform, including agent orchestration, skill and contract design, multi-IDE adapters (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and successors) and the developer experience that ties them together.
* Co-design enterprise-wide standards for building with LLMs and agents: prompt and context patterns, retrieval and grounding, tool integration, evals, guardrails, cost and latency budgets, observability and incident response.
* Partner with engineering leads across product teams to evolve their stacks toward shared scaffolding rather than parallel reinvention, and contribute reusable skills, templates and adapters back to the platform.
* Help shape the evaluation strategy for AI features: how we measure quality, regressions, safety and business impact, and how evals are wired into CI, staging and production telemetry.
* Influence model selection, agent framework choices, vendor versus in-house tradeoffs and where to place the boundaries between platform and product code.

**Client-Facing Product Architecture**

* Partner with product engineering leads to drive the architecture of organisation's client-facing systems across the surfaces customers interact with, including web applications, APIs, integrations and embedded AI features.
* Shape the service architecture: domain boundaries, service decomposition, design platform services, AI services and event-driven patterns.
* Contribute to the data architecture in close collaboration with the Data Architect: how transactional, analytical and regulatory data flows through products, how contracts are defined between systems, how lineage and quality are preserved.
* Help drive the AI in product strategy: where LLMs, RAG, agents and assistive features belong in customer-facing workflows, how they are evaluated, how they fail gracefully and how their behavior is auditable.
* Shape choices around scalability, performance, multi-tenancy and resilience for client workloads, including capacity planning, caching, rate limiting, async processing and graceful degradation.
* Co-design the security and compliance posture for products in a regulated domain: authentication, authorization, tenancy isolation, encryption, secrets handling, audit logging and data residency.
* Influence observability and operability standards: telemetry, logging, tracing, SLOs, on-call ergonomics and incident review.
* Guide integration and interoperability decisions across customer integrations, third-party services, data feeds and partner platforms.

**Technical Leadership Across Both Pillars**

* Lead and contribute to design reviews, architecture decision records and technical writing that sets the bar for the broader engineering organization.
* Mentor staff and senior engineers across teams. Coach them through hard tradeoffs rather than making the calls for them.
* Be the technical voice that helps leadership decide what to build, what to buy and what to retire, and that translates technical reality back to business stakeholders.
* Work with security, compliance and risk to make sure AI-driven workflows and product features meet ORAGANISATION's obligations around data handling, auditability, access control and regulatory exposure.
* Stay close to the broader industry. Bring back practices that are working elsewhere and adapt them to our context.

**Essential Criteria**

* 11+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a clear track record of technical leadership at staff level or equivalent cross-team scope.
* Demonstrated experience designing and shipping production systems built on LLMs or autonomous agents. You can speak in detail to systems you architected, the tradeoffs you made and what you would do differently.
* Strong distributed systems and software architecture background. You can move fluently between service design, API design, data flow, security and developer experience.
* Hands-on experience architecting client-facing SaaS or enterprise products: service boundaries, APIs, integrations, multi-tenancy, performance, resilience and observability.
* Working understanding of data architecture: storage choices (relational, document, analytical, vector), data contracts and how product systems and data platforms meet at the boundary.
* Hands-on fluency with modern AI engineering practice: prompt and context engineering, retrieval augmented generation, agent orchestration, tool use, evals and guardrails.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives through influence in a mid to large engineering organization. You can move a group of senior engineers toward shared decisions without relying on positional authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a one-page design doc that aligns a room of senior people and a five-line summary that aligns an executive.
* A pragmatic, collaborative mindset. You balance rigor with delivery, work inside legacy constraints and still move the architecture forward.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience building developer tooling or internal platforms at enterprise scale, especially scaffolding, code generation, workflow automation or developer productivity systems.
* **Experience integrating AI assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar) into team workflows as a deliberate engineering practice, not just individual use**
  .
* Familiarity with MCP-style tool integration, agent contracts and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
* Experience with eval frameworks (LangSmith or commercial/in-house equivalents) and with observability for LLM and agent systems in production.

title: A.I Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer**

*iRONic Ventures | Kochi Office (No Remote/Hybrid) | Full-Time | 2 Openings*

**The Role**

We're looking for two AI Engineers to build AI features into a production SaaS product used by customers and businesses in Europe. You'll work in TypeScript across the stack, connecting LLMs and generative models to a real application: designing prompts and structured outputs, building evaluations and tests around them, and keeping AI suggestions inside the guard rails of validated business logic. This is a product engineering role, not a research or model-training role. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. The role suits engineers with 2-5 years of experience.

**What You'll Do**

* **AI Features:** Design and build LLM-powered features end to end, from prompt and structured output to API, UI, and tests
* **Generative Media:** Integrate image-generation and image-editing models, and measure output quality, latency, and cost per result
* **Guard Rails:** Treat AI output as a proposal that deterministic, validated code checks before anything reaches the user
* **Evaluation:** Build evaluation sets and automated checks so prompt and model changes are compared on evidence, not guessed
* **Data Integration:** Import, map, and validate structured data from external partners, using AI where it saves manual work
* **Configuration Tooling:** Build tools that let non-technical admins configure business rules safely
* **Production:** Add logging and monitoring around expensive AI calls, and troubleshoot and fix production issues
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) daily, with the test discipline that keeps their output trustworthy

**What We're Looking For**

* **Experience:** 2-5 years of professional software engineering, including at least one LLM-based feature shipped to production
* **Programming:** Strong TypeScript and Node.js; comfortable writing SQL
* **LLM Engineering:** OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, schema validation (e.g. Zod), tool calling
* **Evaluation & Testing:** Automated tests and evals for code that depends on non-deterministic model output
* **Data:** PostgreSQL, data modelling, and working with messy external data
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Daily, hands-on use of coding agents and the judgement to review what they produce
* **Bonus:** Image-generation APIs, vector search (pgvector), job queues (Redis, BullMQ), Next.js and React, three.js, Python for evaluation scripts, German language

**About iRONic Ventures**

iRONic Ventures is a German venture group that builds AI-first companies from the inside. We invest our own capital in AI startups (TAIWA, Nexora AI, Hurraay), build and run our own products, and deliver fixed-fee AI builds for startups across Europe. Having operated in Germany since 2023, we're now opening an office in Berlin and a new office in India, in Kochi, and we're hiring the engineers who will build there.

* **Builders, not just investors:** We're engineers who invest. Product decisions are made by people who read the code
* **AI-native by default:** Coding agents, automated tests, and fast release cycles are how every team works here, not an experiment
* **More than one codebase:** Work across new ventures, our own products, and client builds instead of maintaining one system for years
* **Be early in Kochi:** Join the first engineers in our Kochi office, help shape how it works, and work hand in hand with the team in Berlin
* **A European quality bar:** Build for customers in Germany and across Europe, where privacy, multi-language support, and reliability are expected from day one

**To Apply**

Upload your resume, your LinkedIn profile, and a short note (3-4 sentences) on why you'd be a great fit for the role. Include one thing you built with AI coding tools and how you checked that it worked.

Pay: From ₹380,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

Experience:

* SaaS: 2 years (Required)
* Node.js: 2 years (Required)

Location:

* Kochi, Kerala (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
