title: Product Lifecycle Program Manager
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
The Product Operations team plays a critical role in delivering Cisco’s next-generation hardware products on a scale. Working at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing, the team ensures seamless product lifecycle execution—from new product introduction to high-volume production and customer delivery. With a strong focus on reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence, the team drives impact across global operations and enables successful product outcomes.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
The Cisco Product Operations team is seeking a seasoned Product Lifecycle Program Manager (PLPM) to provide strategic leadership over global cost management and the end-to-end product lifecycle from inception to End-of-Life (EOL). This is a high-visibility, senior-level role that requires the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders—including Manufacturing, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Leadership—to align on strategy and execution for a portfolio of complex product solutions. You will be responsible for defining and implementing the frameworks that ensure operational efficiency and market competitiveness across our global manufacturing footprint.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Strategic Cost Management& Lifecycle Oversight: Serve as the primary architect for end-to-end product lifecycle strategy, driving rigorous cost management protocols from launch through EOL to ensure sustained profitability.
* Engineering Change Governance: Provide authoritative oversight for Engineering Change Management, ensuring seamless technical transitions and minimal operational disruption.
* Product Quality& Financial Stewardship: Maintain stringent control over product quality benchmarks and cost structures, ensuring alignment with organizational financial targets.
* Complex Problem Resolution: Lead the mitigation of critical sustaining issues, including line-stop resolutions, CAP account management, AVL optimization, and continuous manufacturing process improvement.
* EOL Strategy& Orchestration: Direct the development and execution of holistic EOL strategies, partnering with integrated product teams to ensure smooth sunsetting of legacy solutions.
* Enterprise Risk Management: Oversee proactive risk assessment, including multi-source technology evaluation, component-level analysis, cost variance mitigation, and comprehensive supply chain reviews throughout the lifecycle.
* Field Performance& Margin Optimization: Lead strategic action planning for product field performance and spearhead initiatives to drive continuous improvement in gross margins.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or related technical field.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in Supply Chain management within the high-tech sector.
* Proven track record in complex Program Management and executive-level stakeholder management.
* Deep expertise in supply chain dynamics, specifically within high-tech environments, product costing, and sophisticated margin analysis.
* Advanced knowledge of Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and sustaining product support

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Master’s degree in Engineering or Supply Chain Management and/or MBA.
* Knowledge of New Product Introduction (NPI) processes.
* Six Sigma Green or Black Belt certification.
* High proficiency in Agile methodologies and advanced MSFT tools.
* Extensive experience in the high-tech electronics industry and large-scale electronics manufacturing.
* Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Project Lead
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Project and Development Services – India
  
  
Project Lead - High-Rise Greenfield Projects / Commercial projects
  
Position Overview
  
We are seeking an accomplished Project lead to lead the delivery of high-rise greenfield construction projects/Commercial projects from inception through completion. This senior leadership role requires extensive experience managing complex vertical construction while coordinating multiple disciplines, ensuring safety excellence, maintaining quality standards, and delivering projects on schedule and within budget.
  
Core Responsibilities
  
Project Leadership & Execution
  
Lead overall construction management for high-rise greenfield projects encompassing site establishment, foundation works, superstructure construction,Post tensioning works, façade installation, MEP systems and sustainability integration,landscape and interior fit-out through to handover. Develop and implement comprehensive construction execution strategies aligned with project objectives and client requirements. Establish project governance frameworks including PEP,organizational structures, reporting protocols, and decision-making hierarchies. Direct project mobilization activities including site setup, temporary facilities, logistics planning, and resource deployment. Manage critical interfaces between construction phases,trade contractors,stakeholders and coordinate sequencing across multiple work fronts to optimize productivity and schedule performance.
  
Team Management & Leadership
  
Build and lead high-performing project teams including construction managers, engineers, coordinators, and site supervision staff. Provide clear direction, mentorship, and professional development opportunities to team members. Conduct regular performance reviews and implement capability development programs. Foster collaborative team culture focused on safety, quality, and delivery excellence. Interface with senior client representatives, consultants, contractors, and regulatory authorities at executive level. Chair senior project meetings including monthly progress reviews, risk workshops, and stakeholder coordination sessions.
  
Planning, Scheduling & Progress Management
  
Oversee master project scheduling and coordinate detailed construction sequencing across all trades and disciplines. Monitor critical path activities and implement recovery strategies when delays threaten milestone achievements. Direct look-ahead planning processes ensuring material procurement, workforce availability, and equipment resources align with construction requirements. Manage progress measurement systems and verify completed work against payment schedules. Coordinate tower crane operations, hoist schedules, and vertical material logistics specific to high-rise construction. Implement advanced construction methodologies including prefabrication strategies, off-site manufacturing integration, and vertical transportation optimization.
  
Contract & Commercial Management
  
Administer head contracts and manage relationships with principal contractors and major subcontractors. Oversee variation management processes including assessment, pricing negotiation, and approval workflows. Direct claims management and dispute resolution activities, escalating to senior management when required. Monitor commercial performance including cost forecasting, cash flow management, and budget tracking. Review and approve subcontractor payment certificates ensuring accuracy and contractual compliance. Manage extension of time claims and assess contractor entitlements under contract provisions.
  
Quality & Compliance Assurance
  
Ensure construction quality meets design specifications, building codes, and client requirements throughout all phases. Implement inspection and testing protocols specific to high-rise construction including concrete strength verification, structural steel connections, façade performance testing, and MEP systems commissioning. Review and approve method statements, risk assessments, and construction methodologies for high-risk activities including working at height, heavy lifting operations, and façade installation. Coordinate regulatory inspections and building authority approvals at key construction stages. Oversee defects management through punch list compilation, rectification tracking, and practical completion certification.
  
Safety, Health & Environment Leadership
  
Champion safety culture and ensure zero-harm principles are embedded across project operations. Enforce strict compliance with safety regulations, company policies, and industry best practices for high-rise construction. Conduct regular site safety inspections and participate in incident investigations with implementation of corrective actions. Oversee high-risk work activities including tower crane operations, edge protection systems, scaffolding, fall prevention measures, and confined space work. Monitor environmental compliance including dust suppression, noise management, waste disposal, and erosion control. Lead emergency response planning and ensure site preparedness for potential incidents.
  
Risk & Issue Management
  
Identify, assess, and manage project risks across technical, commercial, schedule, safety, and stakeholder dimensions. Develop risk mitigation strategies and contingency plans for high-impact scenarios. Monitor risk registers and implement proactive measures to minimize risk realization. Resolve complex technical and coordination challenges through systematic problem-solving and collaboration with design teams. Manage unforeseen conditions, design changes, and scope variations with minimal impact to project objectives.
  
Stakeholder & Client Relations
  
Serve as primary construction interface with client representatives and senior stakeholders. Prepare and present comprehensive progress reports, financial summaries, and risk assessments for client review meetings. Manage client expectations regarding schedule performance, budget status, and quality deliverables. Coordinate public relations activities and manage community engagement for projects in sensitive urban environments. Facilitate coordination with adjacent property owners, local authorities, and utility providers affected by construction activities.
  
Required Qualifications
  
Essential Experience
  
Minimum 15 to 18 years of progressive construction management experience with at least 8 years focused on high-rise buildings (15+ floors). Demonstrated track record managing greenfield projects from ground-breaking through completion and handover. Proven success delivering multiple high-rise projects on time and within budget. Experience with various contractual delivery methods including Design-Build, Construction Management, and Traditional Lump Sum contracts.
  
Technical Expertise
  
Deep understanding of high-rise construction methodologies including foundation systems (piled foundations, raft slabs,shoring systems(D-wall,micro piling) basement construction), core and outrigger structural systems, post-tensioned concrete construction, structural steel erection and connections, curtain wall and façade systems, and vertical transportation systems. Knowledge of MEP systems integration in high-rise buildings including electrical distribution, HVAC systems, plumbing and drainage, fire protection and life safety systems, and building automation systems. Familiarity with advanced construction technologies including BIM coordination and 4D scheduling, prefabrication and modular construction, crane and hoist logistics optimization, and construction management software platforms.
  
Education & Certifications
  
Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. title: AI Deployment Manager
description:
Why RapidClaims

US healthcare providers are paid only after every visit is turned into billing codes and submitted as a claim. That work is manual, slow and error-prone, and it is getting harder: claim denial rates have nearly doubled in a decade, from 7% to over 13%, while provider margins have fallen from around 10% to just 1% to 2%. Fixing the revenue cycle is now one of the biggest priorities for every health system in the country, and AI is how they are trying to fix it.

RapidClaims is an AI revenue cycle platform. Our autonomous agents code medical records, improve clinical documentation and manage denials, across 25+ specialties, with 98%+ coding accuracy. Clients include Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), specialty physician groups, community health centers and hospital systems. The company has raised $11 million in total funding from top investors, including Accel and Together Fund.

What sets us apart is speed to value. Where incumbents need tens of thousands of records and months of implementation to cover a new specialty, we need a few hundred records and hours. That advantage only counts if every client goes live quickly, stays stable and keeps growing. This role exists to make sure they do.

Why this role exists

In AI for the revenue cycle, the model is no longer the hard part. The hard part is making it work inside a real provider's workflow: their electronic health record (EHR) system, their specialties, their payer mix, their coders and their habits. The companies winning this market are the ones that get clients live fastest and keep them stable at scale. For a client, the deployment is the product.

Every client goes through the same journey with us: a pilot to prove value, a go-live, a period of stabilisation, then expansion into more of their work. Each stage depends on several teams pulling in the same direction, and we are hiring so that one owner holds that together.

The team you will join is responsible for pilots and live clients. You will work with engineering, data science, operations and quality control every day. You will wear multiple hats: problem solving, design thinking, debugging client issues and getting them resolved, and working with operations to manage client volume and bring efficiency.

What you will own

● The deployment. Run pilots, take clients live, stabilise them and lead their expansion. You are accountable for the client's outcome end to end, and you are the

person who knows where every client stands today.

● The translation. Convert client needs into clear, prioritised asks for our teams, and convert our progress into updates the client can act on. Nothing gets lost between the client and the people building for them.

● The resolution. Trace an issue across data, workflow, model and people, route it to the right owner, and drive it to closure. You report problems solved, not problems found.

● The tooling. Prototype agents, prompts and automations that remove manual steps from this job, deploy them, and measure the impact. Where a process is repeated, you are expected to build rather than repeat.

● The product. Turn patterns you see across clients into product features and process changes, so that every client after yours runs on what you learned.

Your first 45 days

● By day 15. You understand how a chart moves through our platform and through a client's revenue cycle. You have shadowed a live account, sat in on client calls, and mapped where work gets stuck and why.

● By day 30. You are running a pilot: discovery, data and integration scoping, workflow setup with data science, and the first quality review with the coding and quality control teams. You have shipped one small tool that saves someone on the team hours every week.

● By day 45. You own a portfolio of clients. One automation you built is in daily use by the team, and one product or process change exists because you saw a pattern across clients and made the case.

How we will measure success

● Time from pilot start to go-live, and from go-live to a stable, predictable weekly volume.

● Volume moving on time for your clients, and how quickly stuck work gets unstuck.

● Accuracy and quality outcomes for your clients, and how quickly issues reach data science when the model is the cause.

● Expansion: more of each client's specialties, sites and workflows moving onto the platform.

● Manual effort removed from the team by what you built.

What you bring

● 2+ years of experience, with shipped AI work. At least one AI-driven solution you built and put in front of real users: an agent, an automation, an internal tool or a product feature. You are hands-on with prompting, agents and evals, and you can

walk us through what you built, how you tested it, and what broke.

● A fast learner. Healthcare billing and medical coding are deep domains. You do not need to know them today, but you need to pick them up quickly and enjoy doing so. We are betting on learning speed over prior domain exposure.

● A structured thinker. You break messy problems down MECE (mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive), so nothing is missed and nothing is counted twice, and you can hold that structure while the details keep changing.

● Comfort with data. SQL, Python or advanced spreadsheets, enough to answer your own questions without waiting on someone else.

● Clear communication, written and spoken. You will talk to clients, engineers, coders and founders in the same day, and each of them needs a different version of the same truth.

● Comfort with context switching. This role moves between a client call, a stuck batch and a prompt that is not working. It is not a role with long quiet blocks, and the people who thrive in it find that energising rather than draining.

● High ownership and a problem-solving nature. You start with "how do I fix this", and you want the zero-to-one journey with the mess that comes with it.

Good to have. Exposure to healthcare, billing or US insurance. A prior client-facing or operations role at a startup. Familiarity with agent frameworks, structured outputs and tool calling, or LLM evaluation tools.

What this role is not

● Not an implementation or project-management role where you run a checklist and hand off. You build, debug and own the outcome.

● Not a pure operations role. If building your own tools does not excite you, this will feel like the wrong job.

● Not a quiet role. Several clients, several teams, many open threads at once.

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* Are you willing to work in Koramangala Bangalore office
* How many years of experience in AI
* How many years of experience in AI deployment
* Have you worked in Health care Industry
* How many No. of end-to-end deployment you have completed
* what is your team leading size
* Do you have managerial experience
* What is your current CTC
* What is your expected CTC
* What is your notice period
* Have you been interviewed by Rapid Claims before?

title: Technical Instructor — Palantir Foundry & AIP | Bengaluru
description:
Ontologize is the sole Palantir Training & Assessment Partner. We help Palantir customers and partners build the in-house expertise they need to develop and operate AI-enabled solutions independently.

We're hiring a Technical Instructor to lead live Foundry & AIP trainings for enterprise teams. This is an instruction-first role where you'll spend most of your time in front of learners — reading the room, adjusting on-the-fly, and making complex platform concepts land for audiences that range from developers to business users. The engineering depth serves the core job (teaching), because it's what makes the instruction credible.

You will be the second person in our Bengaluru office (Whitefield), joining a small, distributed company with teammates across the US, Paris, and Rio de Janeiro. The expectation for this role is 4+ days in office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Deliver multi-day, in-person and virtual Foundry & AIP trainings** for customers and partners, owning the room from preparation through delivery and follow-up
* **Translate complex technical concepts for mixed audiences** — developers, analysts, and executives in the same session adjusting depth and language without losing either group
* **Build and improve curriculum** — develop new training modules, refine existing ones based on what you learn in the room, and keep materials current as the platform evolves
* **Create recorded and written content** as the role matures — tutorials, walkthroughs, and reference material (this is secondary to live delivery and comes later)

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* **You love teaching.** This is non-negotiable. If you're on the fence about whether you want to be in front of learners every week and being a teacher, this role is not for you.
* **You have meaningful Palantir Foundry & AIP experience.** This comes from hands-on Foundry work implementing end-to-end use cases over 3+ years, delivering enterprise outcomes on the platform.
* **You have a strong technical foundation in areas such as Python, Spark, and LLM-enabled workflows**. You are not being hired as a developer, but your technical depth should make your instruction credible.
* **You communicate clearly, both in writing and in speech**. You can explain what matters to non-technical stakeholders in language they can use, whether that is an executive making a decision or a business analyst configuring their first pipeline.
* **You are proactive and autonomous.** You don't wait for work to come to you. You communicate about what you're doing before anyone has to ask.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Full-stack development experience (any stack — we care about the thinking, not the framework)
* Machine learning experience beyond LLM usage
* Foreign language skills (English is a must; anything else is a bonus)

**What Success Looks Like at 90 Days**
--------------------------------------

Independently deliver a full-day training on either our developer-focused or practitioner-focused curriculum, demonstrating:

* Technical correctness under pressure
* Strong Q&A handling
* Pacing control across 5–8 hour sessions
* Whiteboard fluency
* Alignment with Ontologize's standards for instruction quality

**Benefits and Support**
------------------------

We are finalizing our India benefits with local advisors and vendors. Our intent is to build a practical package around ownership, health, learning, and the realities of in-office work. The intended package includes:

* Company-sponsored medical insurance (your choice of plan).
* Learning support for books, tools, courses, certifications and focused skill-building.
* Support for developing as an instructor: practice sessions, delivery feedback, and time to refine your teaching craft between cohorts.
* Company-covered travel for client work, team events, and offsites under our travel policy.
* Lunch reimbursements and commute support for in-office days (within a reasonable monthly cap).

**Travel**
----------

Most trainings are delivered virtually. You will work primarily from our office in Whitefield, Bengaluru, and will occasionally travel to client sites in India for in-person sessions, typically four-day engagements. You should also expect to travel to the US once a year for company events.

**How We Work**
---------------

* Work intensely when you're at work; don't work when you're not at work
* Direct, candid, and respectful feedback
* We flex on scope, not deadlines
* Turn Slack and email notifications off when you're off

**Target start date: July 2026**

Compensation Range: ₹40L - ₹70L

BlackRock Aladdin Data is entrusted with maintaining all data integral to the investment decision process for BlackRock the house and our Aladdin® and eFront® platforms. The Private Markets Data Governance and Master Data Management team, a part of our Private Data Services (PDS) organization, is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and reliability of private markets data for the Aladdin and eFront communities.

We are seeking a Director to lead the Insight Master Data Management (MDM) team, with team members located across Belgrade, Bangalore and Birmingham. This leader will be responsible for the people, processes and operating model supporting master data across the Insight platform and will play a critical role in scaling and evolving our MDM capabilities.

The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership with deep data-management expertise and an operational mindset. They will be responsible for ensuring that master data is accurate, consistent and delivered reliably, while continuously improving how the team operates as the business and platform evolve.

**What you’ll be doing:**

  
  

* Lead the Insight MDM organization
* Lead and develop a globally distributed team of MDM professionals.
* Create a strong, connected team culture with clear accountability, priorities and development opportunities.
* Build MDM expertise within the team and develop leaders who can effectively manage day-to-day delivery.
* Establish clear operating rhythms and ensure effective collaboration across locations.
* Own MDM service delivery
* Provide leadership and oversight for master data onboarding, standardization, maintenance and delivery across eFront Insight.
* Establish effective controls and quality checks across MDM processes and address recurring data-quality or operational issues.
* Ensure the team can effectively support onboarding, business-as-usual operations, integrations and migrations.
* Define and monitor service expectations and use metrics to identify opportunities to improve quality, timeliness and scalability.
* Drive transformation and scale
* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate MDM processes and reduce manual intervention.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Job Title:** AI Platform Engineering Manager

  

**Role Overview:**

EY GDS's Managed Services “AI for AI” team is looking for an **AI Platform Engineering Manager** to own the deployment, scaling, and reliability of our agentic AI solutions across a complex, hybrid infrastructure landscape — multi-cloud, on-prem, and hosted model environments. You'll lead a team of engineers responsible for turning AI prototypes into resilient, enterprise-grade platforms that run globally, securely, and cost-effectively.

This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, MLOps/LLMOps, and agentic systems architecture.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own platform deployment** for agentic AI solutions across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, as well as on-prem and hybrid-hosted model environments (open-source and proprietary LLMs).
* **Design and manage CI/CD and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines** for model deployment, versioning, rollback, and continuous evaluation at scale.
* **Architect for scale and resilience** — ensuring platforms reliably serve 100,000+ concurrent users globally with strong uptime, latency, and cost-efficiency targets.
* **Lead a team of platform/infrastructure engineers**, setting technical direction, mentoring, and managing delivery timelines.
* **Partner cross-functionally** with AI Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Responsible AI leads, and Product Design to translate agentic workflows into production-ready systems.
* **Manage model-hosting strategy**, including trade-offs between hosted APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI), self-hosted open-source models, and on-prem deployments for data residency/compliance needs.
* **Build observability and monitoring** for agentic systems — tracing, logging, cost monitoring, drift detection, and performance dashboards.
* **Drive security, compliance, and governance** of AI infrastructure in collaboration with Responsible AI and InfoSec teams, particularly given enterprise/regulated-client contexts (tax, cybersecurity, supply chain data).
* **Optimize infrastructure cost and performance**, balancing GPU/compute resource allocation across cloud and on-prem environments.
* **Contribute to platform strategy and roadmap**, advising leadership on build-vs-buy decisions, emerging tools, and infrastructure investments.

  

**What We're Looking For**

**Experience**

* 5–8 years in platform engineering, infrastructure/DevOps, SRE, or MLOps roles, with at least 2+ years working on AI/ML or LLM-based systems in production.
* Demonstrated experience deploying and scaling software/AI platforms across multiple cloud providers (AWS,Azure, GCP) and in on-prem/hybrid environments.
* Experience deploying and managing both hosted LLM APIs and self-hosted/open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) in production.
* Experience building or operating agentic AI systems or complex multi-step AI workflows is highly preferred.
* Prior experience managing or leading a team of engineers.

  

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation).
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), and orchestration at scale.
* Experience with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, etc.).

* Working knowledge of enterprise security, data residency, and compliance requirements in regulated industries.
* Proficiency in at least one major programming language (Python strongly preferred; Go or Java a plus)

  

**Soft Skills / Leadership**

* Proven ability to lead engineering teams in fast-paced, ambiguous, build-from-scratch environments.

* Clear communicator who can translate technical trade-offs into business impact for non-technical leadership.

**What We Offer:**

title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  

* Business acumen, and the ability to communicate to executives, business domain stakeholders and technical staff.
* Strong project management, acumen and familiarity working in agile environments.
* Experience with innovation and ideation methods, such as design thinking and product management.
* Demonstrated influence, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work well with others and exhibit leadership.
* Be an excellent communicator and collaborator, engaging with multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders. Team player with collaborative and inclusive approach.

description:

description:

**Job Description**

You will define and implement the end-to-end security architecture for Databricks on a major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This is a hands-on role responsible for the access, governance, and data-protection model across the platform. You have designed and implemented enterprise security controls for Databricks environments, and you will act as a cross-account authority on security guardrails, access governance, and compliance.

What You Will Do

**Own end-to-end security architecture.** Define and implement the security architecture for Databricks across the platform, from identity through data protection.

**Manage identity and access.** Own SSO/MFA integration and RBAC/ABAC access models, and establish access governance processes across accounts and workspaces.

**Secure Unity Catalog.** Design and enforce Unity Catalog security, data classification, and fine-grained access controls (row, column, and attribute level).

**Secure Delta Sharing and open sharing.** Ensure only approved data is exposed across cross-account and open sharing, with reliable, measurable revocation.

**Design least privilege and blast-radius containment.** Establish the lowest practical access boundary, preventing access to adjacent business-unit data and storage.

**Control privileged access and configuration drift.** Govern privileged elevation and break-glass access, and detect unauthorized changes with monitored alert latency and remediation.

**Protect data and secrets.** Establish controls for encryption, secrets management, and network security aligned to relevant regulatory compliance requirements.

**Build guardrails and auditability.** Set up security guardrails, auditability, and access governance so the platform stays compliant and controllable as it scales.

**Provide cross-account technical leadership.** Act as a go-to security reviewer across multiple accounts, contributing to design reviews and resolving access and governance issues that individual delivery teams cannot.

What You Bring (Required)

Hands-on experience designing and implementing security for enterprise Databricks environments.

Deep Unity Catalog security experience: RBAC/ABAC, fine-grained (row/column/attribute) access, data classification, and Delta Sharing / open sharing controls.

Least-privilege and blast-radius design across business units, containing access to adjacent data and storage.

Privileged access management experience: controlled elevation, break-glass, configuration-drift detection, and remediation.

Strong identity and access management background: SSO/MFA integration and access governance.

Expertise in encryption, secrets management, and network security on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements relevant to data platforms.

Ability to design and run proof-of-control tests and quantify outcomes (e.g., revocation time, data exposure, drift-detection and alert latency), not just implement.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

Databricks Cloud Platform Architect accreditation (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or Databricks Platform Administrator.

Recognized cloud security certification (e.g., AWS or Azure security specialty, or CISSP). Note that Databricks has no standalone security certification, so security credentials come from the cloud provider or an industry body.

Multi-cloud experience across two or more of AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Regulated-industry experience (financial services, healthcare, or similar).

What This Role Is Not

This is a Databricks-native security and access architect role. It is not a general enterprise or datacenter security role. The right candidate has genuinely designed and implemented access, governance, and data-protection controls inside Databricks environments, distinct from a generalist security engineer without hands-on Databricks depth.

bp technology is the central organization for all software and platform development. We have a variety of teams depending on your areas of interest, including infrastructure and backend services through to customer-facing web and native applications. The candidate should have broader development experience in programming languages (e.g. Java/.NET/Spring Boot), Integrations, AWS, and AI engineering to design, build, integrate, and support enterprise-grade digital business solutions.
  
The role requires deep expertise in custom application engineering, distributed systems, REST APIs, event-driven integration, enterprise messaging, data architecture, data security and production operations. This is a hands-on technical leadership role, with an expectation to personally contribute to solution design, development, integration engineering, code reviews, production support, and technical delivery.

* Lead the technical design, development, implementation, and operational support of complex enterprise applications, including Java/.NET framework services, Spring Boot microservices, MVC-based web components, REST APIs, event-driven integrations, and cloud databases

* Deploy and manage applications using Kubernetes, and cloud-native workloads on AWS, using services such as EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and IAM.

* Ensure data quality, integrity, and security across all enterprise applications, adhering to protocols and organizational guidelines

* Ensure data protection controls, encryption at rest & transit, data masking, PII/sensitive-data handling aligned to relevant compliance standards

* Collaborate with business customers, and external vendors to gather and analyse requirements, and translate them into technical requirements and solution design

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Strategic Technical Partnership**: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* **Joint Solution Development:** Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* **Customer Deal Support:** Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* **Partner Ecosystem & Events**: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* **Product Feedback:** Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a skilled and motivated **Full-Stack AI Engineer** with hands-on experience in Python-based application development, modern frontend frameworks, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.

The ideal candidate should be capable of developing end-to-end AI-powered applications, building scalable backend services and intuitive user interfaces, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), and implementing AI-driven workflows. The candidate should have a strong foundation in software engineering, problem-solving, and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable, production-ready solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end full-stack applications using Python backend frameworks and modern frontend technologies.
* Build RESTful APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using React.js or other modern frontend frameworks.
* Design and integrate Machine Learning and Deep Learning models into real-world applications.
* Develop Generative AI solutions using LLMs, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Design and implement AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
* Integrate AI models and services through APIs, including cloud-based AI platforms.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases, data processing pipelines, and external service integrations.
* Develop efficient, maintainable, secure, and scalable code following software engineering best practices.
* Perform debugging, testing, performance optimization, and deployment of applications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver AI-driven business solutions.
* Explore emerging AI technologies and contribute to technical innovation and continuous improvement.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **1. Full-Stack Development**

* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Hands-on experience with at least one Python backend framework: FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Experience building REST APIs, integrating third-party services, and implementing backend business logic.
* Working knowledge of React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, or an equivalent modern frontend framework.
* Understanding of frontend-backend integration, authentication, application architecture, and state management.

### **2. Machine Learning and Deep Learning**

* Understanding of core Machine Learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, classification, regression, clustering, and model evaluation.
* Familiarity with Deep Learning concepts and neural network architectures.
* Hands-on experience with libraries such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* Knowledge of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and inference.

### **3. Generative AI and LLM Applications**

* Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or other equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and context management.
* Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Familiarity with embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and document processing.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and response quality optimization.

### **4. Agentic AI and AI Workflows**

* Understanding of AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and state management.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent technologies.
* Knowledge of multi-agent systems, planning, task decomposition, and tool integration.
* Ability to build AI workflows that interact with APIs, databases, and external systems.
* Understanding of agent evaluation, error handling, observability, and reliable execution.

### **5. Databases, Cloud, and Deployment**

* Working knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases and vector databases.
* Understanding of Git, version control, debugging, and testing.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and application deployment.
* Exposure to cloud platform (Microsoft Azure).
* Understanding of application security, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of relevant software engineering or AI application development experience.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, learn new technologies quickly, and collaborate effectively with a team.
* Strong communication skills and a willingness to take ownership of assigned tasks.

title: Post-Doctoral Fellow - Materials Science
description:

This role focuses on bridging the gap between fundamental materials modeling and industrial application. The successful candidate will apply multiscale physics to predict the performance and degradation of high-temperature structural materials, including Ni-based superalloys and Thermal Barrier Coatings (TBCs), as well as various energy-related materials. The role involves integrating simulation insights with experimental validation to drive the development of next-generation materials, including the optimization of existing materials for critical supply chains and the design of novel manufacturing pathways.This is a fixed term position for 9 months.

**Job Description**
===================

**This role focuses on bridging the gap between fundamental materials modeling and industrial application. The successful candidate will apply multiscale physics to predict the performance and degradation of high-temperature structural materials, including Ni-based superalloys and Thermal Barrier Coatings (TBCs), as well as various energy-related materials. The role involves integrating simulation insights with experimental validation to drive the development of next-generation materials, including the optimization of existing materials for critical supply chains and the design of novel manufacturing pathways.**

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Introduction to team:**

Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.

The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.

We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.

  

As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.  

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.

**Job Description**

You will define and implement the end-to-end security architecture for Databricks on a major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This is a hands-on role responsible for the access, governance, and data-protection model across the platform. You have designed and implemented enterprise security controls for Databricks environments, and you will act as a cross-account authority on security guardrails, access governance, and compliance.

What You Will Do

**Own end-to-end security architecture.** Define and implement the security architecture for Databricks across the platform, from identity through data protection.

**Manage identity and access.** Own SSO/MFA integration and RBAC/ABAC access models, and establish access governance processes across accounts and workspaces.

**Secure Unity Catalog.** Design and enforce Unity Catalog security, data classification, and fine-grained access controls (row, column, and attribute level).

**Secure Delta Sharing and open sharing.** Ensure only approved data is exposed across cross-account and open sharing, with reliable, measurable revocation.

**Design least privilege and blast-radius containment.** Establish the lowest practical access boundary, preventing access to adjacent business-unit data and storage.

**Control privileged access and configuration drift.** Govern privileged elevation and break-glass access, and detect unauthorized changes with monitored alert latency and remediation.

**Protect data and secrets.** Establish controls for encryption, secrets management, and network security aligned to relevant regulatory compliance requirements.

**Build guardrails and auditability.** Set up security guardrails, auditability, and access governance so the platform stays compliant and controllable as it scales.

**Provide cross-account technical leadership.** Act as a go-to security reviewer across multiple accounts, contributing to design reviews and resolving access and governance issues that individual delivery teams cannot.

What You Bring (Required)

Hands-on experience designing and implementing security for enterprise Databricks environments.

Deep Unity Catalog security experience: RBAC/ABAC, fine-grained (row/column/attribute) access, data classification, and Delta Sharing / open sharing controls.

Least-privilege and blast-radius design across business units, containing access to adjacent data and storage.

Privileged access management experience: controlled elevation, break-glass, configuration-drift detection, and remediation.

Strong identity and access management background: SSO/MFA integration and access governance.

Expertise in encryption, secrets management, and network security on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements relevant to data platforms.

Ability to design and run proof-of-control tests and quantify outcomes (e.g., revocation time, data exposure, drift-detection and alert latency), not just implement.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

Databricks Cloud Platform Architect accreditation (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or Databricks Platform Administrator.

Recognized cloud security certification (e.g., AWS or Azure security specialty, or CISSP). Note that Databricks has no standalone security certification, so security credentials come from the cloud provider or an industry body.

Multi-cloud experience across two or more of AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Regulated-industry experience (financial services, healthcare, or similar).

What This Role Is Not

This is a Databricks-native security and access architect role. It is not a general enterprise or datacenter security role. The right candidate has genuinely designed and implemented access, governance, and data-protection controls inside Databricks environments, distinct from a generalist security engineer without hands-on Databricks depth.

title: Manager, Quality Assurance
description:
**About Autonomize AI**
=======================

Autonomize AI is on a mission to help organizations make sense of the world's dark data. Unstructured data contains critical insights that, when paired with human context, unlock transformative business outcomes. Our goal is to make that process effortless and accessible.

We are an ambitious, global, remote team committed to human-machine collaboration. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs who have successfully scaled multiple venture-backed companies. We combine expertise in building cutting-edge data products, captivating user experiences, and scaling enterprise AI solutions.

### **The Opportunity**

We are seeking a seasoned, strategic **QA Manager** with **12+ years of experience** to build, scale, and govern our quality engineering and software release ecosystem.

In this dual-impact leadership role, you will define and execute the overall QA strategy while taking end-to-end ownership of delivery schedules, CI/CD release governance, and cross-functional release management. You will manage and mentor a team of high-performing SDETs and QA Engineers, ensuring our enterprise AI products are delivered predictably, securely, and with uncompromised quality.

### **What You’ll Do**

#### **Quality Engineering & Leadership**

* **Strategic QA Leadership:** Define, own, and execute the global QA vision, quality metrics (KPIs/OKRs), and long-term testing roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* **Team Governance & Mentorship:** Lead, mentor, and grow a high-caliber team of SDETs and QA engineers; drive continuous learning and establish engineering best practices.
* **Automation & ML Testing:** Oversee the architectural strategy for scalable, robust test automation frameworks (Web UI, API, Data Pipelines, and Machine Learning/AI model testing).
* **Enterprise Quality Assurance:** Drive shift-left testing methodologies, security/compliance validations, performance/load testing, and overall dark-data pipeline reliability.

#### **Delivery & Release Management**

* **End-to-End Release Management:** Own the release lifecycle for multi-tenant and enterprise AI deployments—managing release cadence, risk assessments, scope stability, and go/no-go decisions.
* **CI/CD Pipeline Governance:** Collaborate closely with DevOps and Engineering to integrate automated quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, enabling smooth, repeatable, zero-downtime deployments.
* **Cross-Functional Delivery Alignment:** Act as the central liaison between Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, and Leadership to ensure delivery timelines are met without compromising quality.
* **Incident & Risk Management:** Establish post-release verification protocols, track production issues, lead root cause analyses (RCA), and implement preventive measures to continuously elevate delivery reliability.

### **You’re a Fit If You Have**

* **Experience:** **12+ years** of progressive experience in Software Quality Engineering, with **5+ years in a manager or leadership capacity**.
* **Release & Delivery Expertise:** Proven track record in release management, release governance, and orchestrating complex deployment cycles for enterprise SaaS/Cloud platforms.
* **Technical & Automation Mastery:** Deep expertise in building/architecting test automation frameworks using Python, Selenium, PyTest, Cypress, or similar tools, along with API testing (Postman, REST Assured).
* **AI/ML & Data Platform Exposure:** Demonstrated experience testing data-intensive applications, unstructured data processing pipelines, or Machine Learning/AI platforms.
* **CI/CD & DevOps Integration:** Hands-on familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* **Process & Agile Leadership:** Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery models, test management systems (Jira, Xray/Zephyr), and tracking key quality metrics (Defect Escape Rate, Test Coverage, Release Cycle Time).
* **Communication & Executive Presence:** Outstanding stakeholder management, problem-solving skills, and the ability to articulate quality/release risks to technical and non-technical leaders alike.

### **What We Offer**

* **Influence & Impact:** Shape the core quality and delivery strategy for enterprise AI implementations.
* **Outsized Opportunity:** Join at an influential level in a rapidly scaling, VC-backed startup.
* **Ownership & Autonomy:** End-to-end ownership of QA and release processes with the freedom to innovate.
* **Learning & Growth:** Constant exposure to serial founders, cutting-edge AI technologies, and a dedicated professional development budget.

title: Manager Engineering
description:
**Career Area**

**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
The Engineering Manager – Data Science is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing multiple pods of data scientists and machine learning engineers while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery of data science products and platforms. This role partners closely with AI product owners, AI architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure data science solutions are technically sound, scalable, and aligned to strategic outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Leadership & Talent Development
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists and ML engineers
* Set clear performance expectations and support career development
* Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture

Technical & Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Provide technical guidance across data science and ML solutions working closely with AI Architects
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards and MLOps practices
* Review model designs and deployment strategies

Delivery & Execution Management
  
  

* Own delivery execution and capacity planning
* Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
* Manage risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with AI Product Owners and business stakeholders
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly

Quality, Governance & Responsible AI
  
  

* Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance standards
* Uphold responsible AI principles

Degree Requirement
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Post Graduate or higher is desired.
  
  
Skill Descriptors
  
  
**Engineering Management**
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high‑performing technical teams delivering complex data science and machine learning solutions. Provides clear direction, sets expectations, and holds teams accountable for outcomes while supporting individual growth and engagement. Balances people leadership, technical oversight, and delivery execution in a fast‑moving environment.
  
  
**Data Science & Machine Learning**
Strong working knowledge of data science, machine learning, GenAI and statistical modeling concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation. Able to guide and review technical approaches, challenge assumptions, and ensure solutions are fit for purpose without requiring hands‑on model development as a primary responsibility.
  
  
**Delivery & Execution**
Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute work in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Manages team capacity, dependencies, and risks to ensure predictable delivery of high‑quality outcomes. Uses data and metrics to assess progress, identify issues early, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Communication & Collaboration**
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. Builds strong partnerships with product owners, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to align expectations, manage trade‑offs, and deliver value.
  
  
Software Development Life Cycle
  
  
Demonstrated knowledge of software and data science development life cycles, including experimentation, prototyping, production deployment, and ongoing operations. Understands the differences between research‑oriented work and production‑grade solutions and guides teams accordingly.
  
  

* Works within formal delivery and governance methodologies
* Understands phases, activities, dependencies, and key decision points across the life cycle
* Identifies common risks and quality considerations at each stage
* Interprets and guides technical documentation, design artifacts, and delivery plans

Artificial Intelligence
  
  
Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, GenAI and machine learning concepts, risks, and opportunities, with the ability to guide teams toward solutions that deliver business outcomes responsibly.
  
  

* Understands AI methodologies, capabilities, and limitations
* Guides teams in applying responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, robustness, and governance
* Keeps informed of emerging AI technologies and evaluates their applicability to business needs
* Supports the adoption of AI practices that balance innovation with risk management

Programming & Technical Literacy
  
  
Strong technical literacy across programming and data science tools sufficient to effectively review code, designs, and technical approaches.
  
  

* Able to assess code quality, maintainability, and architectural alignment
* Collaborates effectively with hands‑on engineers and data scientists
* Understands testing, version control, and deployment concepts
* Hands‑on coding is not a primary responsibility, but technical depth is sufficient to guide and challenge solutions

Technical Troubleshooting
  
  
Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical and operational issues across data, models, and production systems.
  
  

* Guides investigation and resolution of data, model, and system issues
* Reviews logs, metrics, and system behavior to support root cause analysis
* Partners with platform and operations teams to resolve production incidents
* Ensures issues are documented, learnings are captured, and preventative actions are implemented

Note
  
  
This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties, and effort required of employees assigned to this job. description:
