**Description**
At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd
  
  
**ITS Vice Presidency Context**
The Information and Technology Solutions (ITS) Vice Presidential Unit (VPU) enables the World Bank Group to achieve its mission of ending extreme poverty and boost shared prosperity on a livable planet by delivering transformative information and technologies to its staff working in over 150+ locations. For more information on ITS, see this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?reload=9&v=VTFGffa1Y7w
  
  
**Department Context**
The ITS Operations Products unit (ITSOP) enables the Bank's operational business processes through modern, flexible and user-friendly digital products. Its portfolio includes Operations Workspace and related solutions that bring together operational data, documents, workflows, collaboration and decision support for front-line staff.
  
  
ITSOP is seeking an Associate Senior Solutions Architect to provide hands-on architecture and engineering leadership for the Operations Workspace ecosystem. The successful candidate will combine deep Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse expertise with strong .NET and Azure engineering skills, personally implement prototypes and reference solutions, and guide delivery teams from design through production. The role will also help integrate Generative AI and agentic capabilities into operational workflows using a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC). This is not a purely advisory role.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect translates complex operational requirements into secure, scalable and maintainable solutions across Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET, Azure, APIs, data platforms and AI services. The role defines architecture, validates choices through working code, establishes reusable patterns and guardrails, and remains directly engaged in troubleshooting, CI/CD, release readiness and production improvement.
  
  
**Duties And Accountabilities**
The Associate Senior Solutions Architect works across multiple projects in the World Bank Operations portfolio and is accountable for ensuring that technical solutions are successfully designed, delivered and operated for Operations staff.
  
  
From a work-program perspective, the role provides technical leadership, delivery oversight and practical guidance to internal staff and globally distributed vendor teams. The architect helps sequence technical work, resolves delivery constraints and ensures that implementation remains aligned with business priorities, enterprise standards and release commitments.
  
  
From a technical perspective, the role leads application, integration and data architecture; identifies solution components and reusable patterns; validates designs through working prototypes; performs quality and code reviews; and remains accountable for delivery at speed, scale and quality.
  
  
**Role Scope and Distinction**

* Acts as a senior technical subject matter expert for complex, business-critical solutions in the Operations Workspace portfolio.
* Balances strategic architecture with recent, demonstrable hands-on contribution to prototypes, code, integration, deployment and technical problem-solving.
* Leads cross-layer design decisions involving applications, workflows, data, APIs, identity, security, observability and AI-enabled experiences.
* Guides multidisciplinary teams and vendors, mentors architects and engineers, and raises engineering quality through practical standards and reusable implementation assets.
* Works across globally distributed business, product, architecture, security, data, platform and engineering stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture for Operations Workspace and related products, aligning business outcomes, enterprise principles, security requirements and delivery constraints.
* Define target-state and transition architectures, solution options, architecture decision records, integration contracts, non-functional requirements and implementation roadmaps.
* Review designs and code for scalability, resilience, maintainability, interoperability, usability, performance and cost effectiveness.
* Identify systemic risks and technical debt, propose pragmatic remediation, and guide Agile Release Train and product teams through implementation trade-offs.

Lead solution delivery teams through implementation, maintenance, release readiness and operational improvement of business-critical applications supporting Operations Workspace and related Operations product ecosystems.
  
  
Lead application and data architecture modelling, component identification and solution quality reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture principles and approved technology standards.
  
  
**Dynamics 365 and Dataverse Engineering**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse solutions, including data models, security roles, business rules, workflows, plug-ins, custom actions, Power Platform components and environment strategy.
* Design supported extension patterns using C#/.NET, the Dataverse SDK and APIs while minimizing fragile customization and preserving upgradeability.
* Guide integration of Dynamics 365 with SharePoint Online, Microsoft Graph, Azure services, enterprise data products and other operational systems.
* Define application lifecycle management practices for solutions, configuration, environment variables, connection references, test data and controlled promotion across environments.

**Hands-on Prototyping and .NET Engineering**

* Personally design, code, test and demonstrate proofs of concept, technical spikes, reference implementations and minimum viable solutions.
* Develop secure APIs, services, plug-ins and integration components using C#, modern .NET, ASP.NET Core and RESTful patterns.
* Validate architecture choices through executable prototypes, performance tests and failure-mode testing before major delivery investment.
* Troubleshoot complex issues across user experience, application, integration, identity, data and infrastructure layers, and support teams during critical releases.

**Integration, Cloud and Platform Architecture**

* Design API-led, event-driven and workflow-based integrations using appropriate Azure services, API management, messaging, serverless and container patterns.
* Apply identity-first design using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, least privilege, secrets management and auditable authorization patterns, including B2E and approved external-access scenarios.
* Define observability using structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards and actionable alerts across application and integration components.
* Collaborate with data and platform teams to connect operational applications to governed data services, analytics products and structured and unstructured enterprise information.

Design integrations with institutional systems and data platforms, including financing, trust funds, board operations, budgeting, SAP and enterprise data services, using supported APIs, events and workflow patterns.
  
  
Architect document and content-management integrations across Dynamics 365, SharePoint Online and approved cloud services, including secure storage, metadata, retrieval and downstream AI processing.
  
  
**Agentic AI and AI-enabled Operations**

* Design and prototype AI-enabled features and agentic workflows embedded in Operations Workspace, with explicit task boundaries, approved tools, controlled permissions, human review and failure handling.
* Integrate agents with Dynamics 365, enterprise APIs, documents, data platforms and business workflows using secure tool calling, structured outputs and reusable orchestration patterns.
* Apply retrieval-augmented generation, document intelligence and knowledge-grounding approaches where they improve operational workflows and decision support.
* Define evaluation, telemetry and guardrails for groundedness, task success, safety, latency, reliability and cost, and ensure Responsible AI, privacy, records and security requirements are addressed.

Partner with information security teams on architecture reviews, threat modelling, control implementation, security testing and remediation evidence required for production approval.
  
  
**Delivery Lifecycle, CI/CD and Engineering Excellence**

* Establish and improve CI/CD pipelines for Dynamics 365 solutions, .NET services, infrastructure configuration and AI components using Azure DevOps or equivalent enterprise tooling.
* Embed automated unit, integration, contract, security, regression and performance testing into delivery pipelines, with quality gates, approvals, release evidence and rollback approaches.
* Apply both the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and a governed AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC), covering use-case framing, data and grounding readiness, prompt and tool versioning, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and change control.
* Create reusable templates, starter repositories, SDKs, reference pipelines, coding standards and implementation guidance that improve developer productivity and consistency.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Team Leadership**

* Translate operational needs into feasible technical choices and communicate architecture decisions and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Provide practical technical direction to internal teams and vendors, review deliverables against agreed architecture and quality expectations, and intervene hands-on where necessary.
* Mentor architects and engineers through pairing, design reviews, code reviews, demonstrations and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Partner with product leadership to sequence enablers, reduce delivery risk and ensure technical work results in measurable operational value.

Provide work-program oversight for internal and vendor delivery teams across locations, assess deliverable quality, remove technical blockers and hold suppliers accountable for agreed architecture, engineering and documentation standards.
  
  
Selection Criteria
  
  

* Master's degree with at least eight years of relevant experience, or bachelor's degree with at least ten years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related field.
* Substantial recent experience architecting and delivering large-scale enterprise applications using Microsoft Dynamics 365, Dataverse, .NET and Azure.
* Demonstrated hands-on contribution to production solutions, including personal coding, prototyping, integration, troubleshooting and deployment responsibilities.
* Experience leading complex delivery across internal staff, vendors and globally distributed teams in environments with strong governance, security and operational requirements.
* At least seven years of experience developing and maintaining large-scale solutions using C# and the Microsoft .NET ecosystem.
* At least five years of experience architecting Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Dataverse solutions and integrations with SharePoint Online, Azure services and enterprise or on-premises systems.
* Proven experience leading large, complex technical deliverables and globally distributed development teams, including vendor or offshore delivery, in environments with shifting priorities and multi-layered governance.

**Required Technical Capabilities**

* Advanced Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Dataverse architecture, including data modelling, security, workflows, plug-ins, custom APIs, Power Platform extensibility and solution ALM.
* Advanced C# and modern .NET engineering, including ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, automated testing and secure coding.
* Strong Azure application architecture experience, including App Service, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Key Vault, Application Insights, storage and container-based deployment patterns.
* Strong systems integration capability across APIs, events, enterprise applications, Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online and data platforms.
* Hands-on CI/CD and DevSecOps experience, including source control, branching, build and release pipelines, infrastructure/configuration automation, quality gates, secrets handling and rollback.
* Practical experience designing or implementing Generative AI and agentic capabilities, including tool calling, orchestration, retrieval, structured outputs, evaluation, observability and human oversight.
* Ability to apply SDLC and ADLC controls to move prototypes into secure, supportable and production-ready services.
* Strong security architecture knowledge covering identity, authorization, least privilege, data protection, auditability, threat modelling and secure integration.
* Ability to produce clear architecture documentation and to explain decisions, alternatives, risks and trade-offs to varied audiences.
* Hands-on experience extending Dynamics 365 using C#/.NET plug-ins, custom APIs, workflows and supported client-side technologies, with strong knowledge of Dataverse security, data modelling and reporting capabilities.
* Experience implementing authentication and authorization using Microsoft Entra ID, including B2E and approved B2B scenarios.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Operations Workspace, operational process platforms, project or portfolio management solutions, or comparable enterprise CRM/workflow ecosystems.
* Experience with Angular or React and modern web application integration with .NET and Dynamics 365 back ends.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or comparable enterprise agent frameworks.
* Experience with document intelligence, enterprise search, RAG, semantic layers, knowledge graphs or governed access to structured and unstructured information.
* Experience with SAFe, Agile Release Trains, product operating models and architecture governance.
* Experience in international development, financial services or another regulated environment with strong privacy, security and audit requirements.
* Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Azure, DevOps, security or architecture certifications.
* Working knowledge of enterprise data and analytics platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses, Power BI, Azure Data Factory, Databricks or comparable integration and analytics services.

**Recommended Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert or relevant Dynamics 365 certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert.
* SAFe for Architects (ARCH) and/or SAFe DevOps (SDP).
* Relevant Microsoft applied skills or certifications in Azure AI, Azure OpenAI or Copilot Studio.

As the World Bank Group continues to evolve, we value candidates who:
  
  

* Demonstrate the ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, cultures, and institutional boundaries.
* Responsibly leverage digital and AI-enabled tools to enhance productivity, learning, and decision-making.
* Bring experience working in fragile, conflict-affected, and violent (FCV) contexts and are encouraged to highlight relevant experience in their application materials, where applicable.

**WBG Culture Attributes**

* Sense of urgency: Anticipate and quickly respond to the needs of internal and external stakeholders.
* Thoughtful risk-taking: Challenge the status quo and push boundaries to achieve greater impact.
* Empowerment and accountability: Empower yourself and others to act and hold each other accountable for results.

The World Bank Group offers comprehensive benefits, including a retirement plan; medical, life and disability insurance; and paid leave, including parental leave, as well as reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities.

* Create and maintain clear technical documentation for every market, channel, and tracking configuration.

description:

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

### **Role Definition**

The Engineering Manager – Data Science is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing multiple pods of data scientists and machine learning engineers while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery of data science products and platforms. This role partners closely with AI product owners, AI architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure data science solutions are technically sound, scalable, and aligned to strategic outcomes.

People Leadership & Talent Development  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists and ML engineers

* Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture

Technical & Engineering Leadership  

* Provide technical guidance across data science and ML solutions working closely with AI Architects
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards and MLOps practices
* Review model designs and deployment strategies

Delivery & Execution Management  

* Own delivery execution and capacity planning
* Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
* Manage risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Stakeholder Collaboration  

* Partner with AI Product Owners and business stakeholders

Quality, Governance & Responsible AI

### **Degree Requirement**

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Post Graduate or higher is desired.

### **Skill Descriptors**

**Engineering Management**

Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high‑performing technical teams delivering complex data science and machine learning solutions. Provides clear direction, sets expectations, and holds teams accountable for outcomes while supporting individual growth and engagement. Balances people leadership, technical oversight, and delivery execution in a fast‑moving environment.

**Data Science & Machine Learning**

Strong working knowledge of data science, machine learning, GenAI and statistical modeling concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation. Able to guide and review technical approaches, challenge assumptions, and ensure solutions are fit for purpose without requiring hands‑on model development as a primary responsibility.

**Delivery & Execution**

Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute work in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Manages team capacity, dependencies, and risks to ensure predictable delivery of high‑quality outcomes. Uses data and metrics to assess progress, identify issues early, and drive continuous improvement.

**Communication & Collaboration**

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. Builds strong partnerships with product owners, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to align expectations, manage trade‑offs, and deliver value.

### **Software Development Life Cycle**

Demonstrated knowledge of software and data science development life cycles, including experimentation, prototyping, production deployment, and ongoing operations. Understands the differences between research‑oriented work and production‑grade solutions and guides teams accordingly.

* Works within formal delivery and governance methodologies
* Understands phases, activities, dependencies, and key decision points across the life cycle
* Identifies common risks and quality considerations at each stage
* Interprets and guides technical documentation, design artifacts, and delivery plans

### **Artificial Intelligence**

Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, GenAI and machine learning concepts, risks, and opportunities, with the ability to guide teams toward solutions that deliver business outcomes responsibly.

* Understands AI methodologies, capabilities, and limitations
* Guides teams in applying responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, robustness, and governance
* Keeps informed of emerging AI technologies and evaluates their applicability to business needs
* Supports the adoption of AI practices that balance innovation with risk management

### **Programming & Technical Literacy**

Strong technical literacy across programming and data science tools sufficient to effectively review code, designs, and technical approaches.

* Able to assess code quality, maintainability, and architectural alignment
* Collaborates effectively with hands‑on engineers and data scientists
* Understands testing, version control, and deployment concepts
* Hands‑on coding is not a primary responsibility, but technical depth is sufficient to guide and challenge solutions

### **Technical Troubleshooting**

Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical and operational issues across data, models, and production systems.

* Guides investigation and resolution of data, model, and system issues
* Reviews logs, metrics, and system behavior to support root cause analysis
* Partners with platform and operations teams to resolve production incidents
* Ensures issues are documented, learnings are captured, and preventative actions are implemented

title: Tech Architect
description:
**Position Details**

* Department: Engineering / Technology
* Reports to: VP of Engineering / CTO
* Location: Hyderabad, India
* Work arrangement: In-office only
* Employment type: Full-time

**About the Role**

We are seeking a hands-on Tech Architect to define and drive the technical direction of our SaaS platform. You will architect and build scalable backend web services; design analytics pipelines for drone-captured images and videos; enable enterprise-grade single sign-on (SSO) and a secure, extensible integration layer; and turn proofs of concept (POCs) and prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems. You will also champion AI/LLM-powered agentic coding to improve engineering productivity, while setting high standards for security, quality, scalability, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define end-to-end architecture for a multi-tenant SaaS platform, balancing scalability, performance, security, availability, and cost.
* Assess existing POC and prototype code, determine what can be reused versus re-architected, and define a practical path to production and go-live.
* Production-harden prototypes through robust error handling, logging, monitoring, automated testing, security controls, configuration management, and performance tuning.
* Own production-readiness reviews, load and performance testing, CI/CD and deployment strategies (including blue-green and canary releases), rollback plans, and post-launch support.
* Architect scalable analytics pipelines for drone-captured imagery and video, covering live-stream and bulk-field-upload ingestion, processing, model inference, storage, and API-based delivery of results.
* Address drone-data constraints, including large high-resolution media, intermittent or low-bandwidth connectivity, GPS and flight telemetry, altitude, gimbal/camera orientation, timestamps, and mapping data to missions, sites, and assets.
* Make architecture decisions for real-time versus batch processing, GPU/accelerator utilization, edge versus cloud inference, and cost optimization for media-heavy workloads.
* Architect enterprise identity and SSO using SAML 2.0, OIDC, and OAuth 2.0; support per-tenant SSO configuration, integrations with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace, SCIM provisioning, RBAC, and session management.
* Design and own the platform’s extensibility and integration layer, including public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension models for customer, partner, third-party, drone-platform, and fleet-management integrations, with versioning, backward compatibility, and safe sandboxing.
* Own end-to-end security architecture, including API gateway and WAF controls, authentication and authorization, encryption in transit and at rest, secrets and key management, audit logging, and tenant data isolation.
* Drive secure-by-design practices through threat modelling, security reviews of designs and code, dependency and vulnerability management, and penetration-test remediation—including for AI-generated code and third-party extensions/integrations.
* Architect and oversee backend services, including REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and service-to-service communication.
* Remain hands-on: write and review production-grade backend code, build POCs, and demonstrate engineering standards by example.
* Design core SaaS capabilities such as multi-tenancy, subscription and billing integration, tenant data isolation, rate limiting, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead adoption of AI/LLM agentic coding tools such as Claude Code for delivery acceleration, refactoring, and productionizing prototype code.
* Establish workflows and best practices for AI-assisted software development, including code-review standards, guardrails, and quality gates for AI-generated code.

**Tech Architect | Job Description**

* Define technical standards, coding guidelines, and architectural patterns across engineering teams; evaluate and recommend technologies, frameworks, tools, and emerging AI/LLM and computer-vision capabilities.
* Partner with product managers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Review and approve high-level designs (HLDs), guide low-level designs (LLDs), identify technical debt, and lead legacy-system modernization, using AI-assisted tools where beneficial.
* Ensure architecture meets non-functional requirements for scalability, availability, security, tenant isolation, and observability.
* Mentor senior engineers and tech leads on architecture, productionizing prototypes, and effective use of AI coding assistants.
* Lead POCs for new technologies, LLM/agentic workflows, vision models, and major system changes.
* Collaborate with DevOps/SRE teams on infrastructure, deployment, and CI/CD architecture.
* Own architecture documentation and keep it current across the organization.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**

* 10–15 years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in architecture-focused roles.
* Proven experience building and scaling SaaS products end to end, ideally from early-stage development through growth.
* A demonstrated track record of taking POCs/prototypes to production through refactoring, re-architecture, hardening, and successful live launches with measurable reliability and performance.
* Strong backend engineering experience designing, building, and scaling production REST/GraphQL APIs and microservices.
* Experience designing or building systems that ingest and process drone-generated aerial imagery and video at scale, including use cases such as object detection, change detection, classification, tracking, and inspection.
* Understanding of video streaming protocols (RTSP, RTMP, WebRTC, HLS), encoding/transcoding, and large-scale media storage.
* Experience with drone data and metadata, including geo-tagged imagery, flight telemetry, geospatial context, and data flows from device or ground station to cloud.
* Familiarity with production deployment and serving of computer-vision/ML models, including inference optimization, GPU workloads, batching, and model versioning; exposure to OpenCV, FFmpeg, or similar frameworks.
* Hands-on experience implementing enterprise SSO and authentication using SAML, OIDC, OAuth2, and SCIM in multi-tenant SaaS products, including integration with major identity providers.
* Experience designing extensible platforms with public APIs, webhooks, SDKs, and plugin/extension or third-party integration frameworks, including versioning, rate limiting, and safe extension isolation.
* Strong security architecture skills covering API security, encryption, secrets management, tenant isolation, secure SDLC, threat modelling, and OWASP Top 10 risks and mitigations.
* Mandatory hands-on coding capability; this is an active engineering role, not solely an architecture-review position.
* Practical, demonstrable use of AI/LLM-based agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code) in real engineering workflows, beyond casual use.
* Strong expertise in system design, distributed systems, and microservices architecture.
* Experience with multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing systems, and SaaS scalability patterns.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including managed GPU/ML and media services.
* Deep proficiency in at least one major backend language/stack: Java, Python, Node.js, .NET, or Go.
* Deep understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data modelling, caching strategies (Redis or Memcached), and object storage.
* Strong experience with API design, API gateways, messaging/streaming systems such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, and service-integration patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing strategies, and production observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting.
* Understanding of LLM fundamentals—prompting, context management, tool/function calling, RAG, agentic workflows, and multimodal models—sufficient to architect responsible AI integrations.

title: Assoc. Dir. DDIT ISC CSOC Engineering - Cloud
description:
### **Summary**

We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Detection Engineer to help shape the future of cloud security monitoring at Novartis. You will design, build, validate and continuously improve detection capabilities across Azure, AWS and other strategic cloud platforms while being a key partner with incident response and cloud security architect teams. An engineering role that combines cloud telemetry, custom detections, threat research, automation and AI-assisted investigation to create high-signal, scalable outcomes for Cyber Defense.
  
  
Role purpose:
  
  
Build a robust, AI-native cloud detection pipeline that improves correlation and investigation efficiency across multi-cloud environments. Engineer fragmented cloud telemetry into clear, actionable security outcomes with AI embedded throughout the detection engineering lifecycle. A multidimensional engineering role at the intersection of automation, cloud architecture, threat behavior analysis, detection engineering supporting analyst investigation workflows.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and operate an AI-native cloud detection pipeline that aggregates, correlates, enriches, deduplicates and prioritizes signals before analyst investigation
* Build and tune high-fidelity detections that improve coverage across cloud control-plane, data plane and management-plane activity, identity and access, network, container and Kubernetes and security posture.
* Use lower-fidelity and behavioral signals as investigation context, while ensuring known high-confidence detections are consistently escalated for security investigation
* Integrate and correlate telemetry from WIZ, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, AWS GuardDuty, Microsoft Sentinel and other cloud-native or CNAPP sources . Apply hands-on Wiz experience to interpret posture findings, attack paths, identity and exposure context, cloud events, runtime findings and threat detections and improve detection workflows
* Develop behavioral baselines and entity-centric analytics across users, IP addresses, identities and cloud resources . Create reusable dashboards, dynamic lookups and enrichment patterns enabling rapid pivots / drilldowns from an alert to related resource, identity, inventory and historical data
* Own the detection lifecycle from threat hypothesis and telemetry assessment through development, peer review, testing, deployment, tuning, documentation and retirement
* Embed AI across the detection lifecycle to accelerate detection creation and tuning, while ensuring engineering controls and human judgment govern the outcomes
* Finetune detections using historical data, controlled simulations, purple-team exercises, attack emulation and lessons learned from incidents and threat hunts
* Use detection-as-code practices, Git, CI/CD and automated testing to deliver controlled, repeatable and auditable content changes . Partner with Threat Hunting and Response, CSOC analysts, cloud platform teams, data onboarding, threat intelligence and automation teams to close visibility gaps and operationalize detections
Automate enrichment and triage using Python, APIs, SOAR workflows and AI-assisted approaches, with appropriate human oversight for security decisions . Measure and improve detection coverage, precision, false-positive rate, investigation volume, alert latency, data quality and analyst effort  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security, detection engineering, security analytics, threat hunting, incident response or security platform engineering
* Working knowledge of Azure and AWS security architectures, respective cloud domains and workloads
* Understanding of cloud telemetry and logging sources such as Azure Activity and Diagnostic logs, Entra ID logs, AWS CloudTrail, AWS CloudWatch and GuardDuty findings
* Experience in working with CNAPP bundles or developing and tuning detections in Wiz, Vega or cloud-native security platforms
* Proficiency in KQL and at least one scripting or programming language such as Python. CloudShell understanding is expected
* Familiarity with AI/LLM-assisted security investigation, agentic workflows or machine-learning approaches to signal enrichment and triage . Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, threat-informed defense, entity mapping, correlation, enrichment and alert prioritization
* Ability to investigate complex datasets, distinguish true security risk from operational noise and communicate engineering decisions clearly . Experience collaborating across security operations, cloud engineering and platform teams in a global environment.
Experience with detection-as-code, Sigma or YAML-based content, Git, CI/CD, unit/integration testing and safe deployment or rollback practices . Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation or equivalent. Background in threat intelligence, purple teaming, red teaming, incident response or cloud threat research  

**Desirable Requirement:**

  
  

* Relevant certifications such as AZ-500, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, GIAC Cloud Security certifications, CCSP or equivalent practical expertise.
* GIAC Cloud Forensics Responder (GCFR)

Logical thinking and curiosity; desire to understand "why" systems behave the way they do, not just follow steps.

Collaborative and open to feedback; able to receive coaching from Specialists without defensiveness.

Proactive attitude—identify issues before being told, flag ambiguities, suggest improvements based on observations.

Comfort with asynchronous communication and remote collaboration tools (Slack, Confluence, Teams).

Detail-oriented—meticulously follow runbooks, document every step taken, and flag deviations or unexpected findings.

Execute standard troubleshooting steps and runbooks for routine issues (e.g., log file analysis, service restarts, basic connectivity checks).

Exposure to at least one monitoring/alerting tool (Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, PagerDuty).

Familiarity with Jira or similar ticketing systems.

Prior IT or infrastructure support experience (even in a smaller organisation).

Structured onboarding and mentorship from experienced Specialists—accelerated learning path in cloud operations and ITIL incident management.

The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, build, and operate the enabling layer for AI engineering at scale.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

Build platform capabilities that solve recurring problems once, well, for many teams—reducing per-team build and operate toil while ensuring consistency and compliance by default through high-quality, lean designs and implementations.**
* **Serve as the technical advocate for the platform as a product, ensuring capability integrity, feasibility, and alignment with the needs of the engineering teams who consume it. Lead requirement discovery with consuming teams, component design of platform services, frameworks, and the AI control plane, and their development, testing, integration, and support.**

Manage platform dependencies, code design, implementation, the data and policy-as-code enforcement layers, and the OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation substrate—building capabilities that are operable, instrumented, performant, and drift-resistant by design, to the production standards set by SRE. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, codify recurring patterns into reusable components and golden paths, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code to ensure all platform KPIs (adoption, reliability-by-design, and developer experience) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.**
* **Develop lean platform capabilities through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve the real needs of consuming engineering teams. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right capability is delivered at the right time—and adopted, not shelved.**
* **Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering platform capabilities as lean, adoption-validated increments rather than big-bang builds, and keeping them supportable and maintainable.**
* **Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, SRE, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Integrate their constraints into the paved roads so that the secure, compliant, and reliable path is the easy path. Deliver capabilities that are admissible-by-design and submit them for admission, co-defining service-level objectives with SRE, who set production standards and own the admission decision. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.**
* **Possess expertise in platform engineering and modern AI/ML infrastructure—internal developer platforms, MLOps/LLMOps, model serving, retrieval and vector infrastructure, eval and observability tooling, policy-as-code, container orchestration, IaC, and CI/CD at platform scale—including AI and Agentic SSDLC to deliver self-service, governed capabilities with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize platform solutioning and delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.**
* **Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the enterprise data estate and the AI use-case patterns the platform must serve. Translate the needs of engineering teams, reference architectures, and governance requirements into reusable frameworks, the data platform, and governance-as-code enforcement. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.**
* **Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.**
* **Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.**

**The team:** **US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.**

title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
Overview:

**About JAGGAER**  
JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.  
Our 1,300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products—ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  
For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com

**Cyber Security Analyst**

**The Role**  
Reporting to the Manager, IR & Assurance, the Cyber Security Analyst is a core member of the JAGGAER Security Operations Centre (SOC). The analyst shares the day-to-day threat analytics, security event triage, investigation, and incident response that protect JAGGAER's corporate and production environments across on-premise and cloud systems.  
This is a hands-on mid-level operational role. The analyst works as part of a small, close-knit team where everyone shares the core SOC responsibilities. As the analyst develops, they may take ownership of a specialism (for example threat intelligence, threat hunting, or incident response) at approximately 20% of their time, on top of the shared core. This role is based in Hyderabad, India, with hybrid working, and operates within standard working hours.

  
Principal Responsibilities:

**Core Responsibilities (Shared by All Analysts)**  
The core SOC responsibilities are shared across the team. The analyst will:

* Alert triage — Triage and validate security escalations from CrowdStrike Falcon Complete (MDR) and internal sources, prioritising by severity and logging a clear outcome for each.
* Investigation — Investigate confirmed and suspected incidents to establish scope, impact, and root cause, using structured, evidence-based methodology.
* Incident response — Contain, respond to, and document security incidents in line with the Incident Response Procedure — isolating hosts, blocking indicators, and coordinating remediation.
* Correlation & hunting — Correlate activity across CrowdStrike NGSIEM, Observe and the endpoint tooling (CrowdStrike Falcon and Microsoft Defender), using Zscaler VPN data for IP and connection analysis, and hunt for anomalies not surfaced by automated detection (failed logons, privilege escalation, new admin accounts).
* Phishing response — Review and action user-reported phishing (including via PhishER), confirm remediation, and initiate takedowns of malicious domains and leaked credentials.
* Production alignment — Align SOC investigations with security-related production incidents to ensure no coverage gaps between operations and security.
* Detection support — Feed investigation findings, including false positives and coverage gaps, back to the team to inform detection tuning.
* Documentation — Maintain accurate, complete records in Jira and the IR record for all work, and complete daily operational checks and handover.

  
Position Requirements:

**What You Will Bring**  
Essential  

* 3+ years' experience in, or closely related to, the cybersecurity field, with hands-on security operations experience.
* Understanding of Microsoft Windows and Linux/Unix system-level security controls.
* Understanding of common threat-actor techniques, malware behaviour, and persistence mechanisms.
* Hands-on experience with the CrowdStrike Falcon platform, including alert triage, host investigation and response actions such as containment.
* Practical experience with SIEM platforms, including alert triage, event investigation, and documentation. CrowdStrike NGSIEM or comparable technology.
* Practical experience using AI tools to support security work, such as summarizing alerts, drafting queries or analyzing logs, with the judgement to verify output and to keep sensitive data out of unapproved tools in line with company policy.
* Structured, evidence-based investigation approach with clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to work as part of a close-knit team, sharing the core workload and supporting colleagues.

**Desirable**  

* Experience with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and threat intelligence in operational practice.
* Familiarity with CrowdStrike NGSIEM, including CQL query writing, log ingestion concepts and detection rule structure.
* Experience working alongside a managed detection and response (MDR) provider.
* Experience with Microsoft Defender, Mimecast or phishing-response tooling such as KnowBe4 PhishER.
* Scripting (Python or PowerShell) to automate repetitive triage tasks.
* Familiarity with cloud environments (Azure, O365, AWS).
* Interest in developing a specialism (CTI, threat hunting, or IR).
* Relevant industry certifications held or in progress — for example CompTIA Security+, Blue Team Level 1 (BTL1), or ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC). Professional membership (ISC2, ISACA) is welcomed.
* Red/Blue team exposure.

**How You Will Grow**  
The Cyber Security Analyst role sits on a clear progression path: Cyber Security Analyst Senior Cyber Security Analyst Lead Cyber Security Analyst, aligned to the NIST NICE and ENISA ECSF frameworks. Progression is evidence-based. Analysts are encouraged to develop a specialism as they grow, held as additional ownership alongside the shared core.

**What We Offer:**
  
At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.

Our Values - T.E.A.M:  
At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.  

* Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* Accountability – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* Metrics-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

**EEO:**
  
JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and people come first.

---------------

We are looking for a SOC Analyst (L1.5) with hands-on experience in Security Operations, Security Monitoring, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, and SIEM technologies. Candidates with strong experience in Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or ArcSight along with incident response and threat hunting capabilities will also be considered.

### **Security Monitoring & Incident Detection**

* Monitor and analyze security alerts generated from SIEM and integrated security tools.
* Perform real-time alert triage and validate security incidents.
* Investigate incidents related to malware, phishing, ransomware, insider threats, account compromise, privilege misuse, and unauthorized access.
* Escalate incidents to L2/L3 teams as per defined processes.

description:
**Job Description:**

**About Us**

At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.

Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.

We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.

Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.

At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!

**Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

**Process Overview**

Transaction Reporting Control Group are responsible for ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the Bank’s transaction reporting obligations across multiple global regulatory jurisdictions. Completeness, accuracy, and timeliness controls are the primary responsibility of 2 core functions within the Transaction Reporting Control Group team. The Submission Control function is responsible for monitoring and remediating the internal validation failures and the rejects (NACKs) from the regulators, the team must liaise with MO/FO/Tech teams for the root causes of the exceptions. Submission control also monitors the trades which are not getting reported within the compliance time for OTC/ETD/Securities and raise breaches for all timeliness issues that missed the agreed thresholds. The Enhanced Quality Assurance team perform post process testing to validate the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the transaction reports submissions through performing reconciliations and targeted deep dive sample-based QA testing.

  
  

**Job Description**

The current role is for the Enhanced Quality Assurance and below is the description of the role.

* Good understanding of Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) reporting landscape, along with knowledge of other key jurisdictions such as SFTR, EMIR, and HKMA.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Material Terms Reconciliation process, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of reconciliation breaks across regulatory jurisdictions.
* Strong working knowledge on TriOptima and DTCC platforms, with hands-on experience in break analysis, matching logic and resolution.
* Manage daily BAU activities, monitor exception queues, and drive closure of aged and high-risk material terms breaks.
* Provide oversight and guidance to analysts on break investigation, root cause analysis, and remediation strategies.
* Engage with internal stakeholders, technology teams, and counterparties to resolve data quality and reporting discrepancies.
* Track key performance metrics, prepare MI reports, and provide regular updates to management on reconciliation trends, risks, and remediation progress.
* Drive process improvements, automation opportunities, and control enhancements to improve reconciliation accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory reporting requirements and maintain appropriate audit trails and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate issue escalations, prioritize critical breaks, and facilitate timely resolution to minimize regulatory and operational risk.
* Support new regulatory initiatives, system changes, and testing activities impacting the Material Terms Reconciliation process.
* This is a very hands-on role, ideal for someone with drive and willingness to learn and adapt, is proactive and has very good knowledge about the reporting regulation and the reporting system architecture
  

  

**Responsibilities**

* Ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of transaction reporting submissions across multiple regulatory regimes (e.g. CFTC, EMIR, MIFID, SFTR, HKMA etc.)
* Engagement in designing, implementing, and maintaining operation process and controls
* Generate sample from reports and analyze patterns to derive meaningful information
* Management reporting and issue escalation and resolution
* Remaining current on the Regulatory Reporting landscape to ensure the firm’s reporting remains in step with changes in regulatory environment
* Responsible for working closely with GTR and Industry Working Groups (WG)
* Track the progress of the implementation of changes and work closely with various teams in FO/MO/Dev teams and Reporting Dev team
* Document errors as per the guidelines and ensure remediation of the issue. Raise technology requirement JIRAs. Hands-on experience in validating user acceptance test results
* Investigate and identify the root cause for the Transaction Reporting breaks and coordinate with FO/MO/Tech to fix them
* Review controls on regular basis and challenge status quo
* Work with change and initiative team on new changes and provide requirement for controls ahead of going live with new jurisdiction.
  

  

**Requirements**

**Education :** Post-Graduation

**Certifications If any :** NA

  
  

**Experience Range** : 5-8 Years of overall experience

  
  

**Foundational Skills:**

* Solid trade life cycle knowledge; front, middle and back office (FO, MO, BO).
* Familiarity with counter party clearing: LCH (London Clearing House), Chicago Mercantile Exchange, Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), CBOE, OCC highly desirable
* Strong analytical skills and experience working with large data sets in Excel
* Excellent organizational skills to track many concurrent activities
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
* Ability to work independently and assess relative priority among competing issues
  

  

**Desired Skills:**

* Exposure to data mining tool will be added advantage. Opportunity to learn and work on industry leading data mining tools like Tableau, Alteryx, Power BI, AI tools
* Ability to critically appraise the existing process and drive process improvement initiatives.
* Adapts to changes and has a proven track record of working as part of a global team.
* Ability to assess and mitigate risks and dependencies.
* Excellent communication and relationship building skills.
* Proactive and self-starter
  

  

**Work Timings:** 12.30pm - 9.30pm IST

The Senior Change Management Analyst is an experienced individual contributor responsible for supporting ITIL-aligned IT change management. Reporting to the Change Manager, the role reviews and coordinates Requests for Change (RFCs), prepares CAB materials, maintains the change calendar, validates implementation readiness, supports stakeholder communications, monitors outcomes, and recommends continual improvements. The role does not own enterprise change policy, manage people, or serve as final approver for high-risk changes unless formally delegated.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Support consistent, ITIL-aligned execution of the change process under direction of the Change Manager.
* Review RFCs for completeness, risk, impact, approvals, testing evidence, implementation steps, validation criteria, communications, and rollback planning.
* Coordinate with change owners, technical teams, service owners, release teams, incident management, vendors.
* Maintain accurate change records, calendar entries, meeting notes, decision logs, and audit-ready evidence. Escalate scheduling conflicts, readiness gaps, policy exceptions, high-risk changes, and change-related incidents.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Change Governance and RFC Quality**

* Apply approved change policies, procedures, templates, workflows, risk models, and approval paths in daily change activities.
* Review RFCs for business justification, scope, affected services, dependencies, outage needs, approvals, implementation, validation, and backout plans.
* Return incomplete or unclear records to change owners and document required corrections according to process guidelines.
* Verify correct classification and routing for standard, normal, emergency, expedited, major, minor, vendor release-related, infrastructure, application, cloud, security, and vendor-driven changes.

**CAB and Change Meeting Support**

* Prepare CAB agendas, change summaries, risk highlights, schedule views, meeting materials, and decision documentation.
* Assist the Change Manager with facilitation, timekeeping, risk callouts, notes, follow-up tracking, deferrals, approvals, and action items.
* Escalate high-risk, high-impact, conflicting, business-critical, or poorly documented changes before CAB review.

**Risk, Impact, and Readiness Assessment**

* Evaluate readiness based on service impact, technical complexity, outage duration, customer impact, security exposure, data sensitivity, dependencies, and rollback feasibility.
* Constructively challenge weak implementation plans, inadequate testing evidence, incomplete dependency analysis, missing communications, or unrealistic rollback steps.
* Escalate unresolved concerns, policy exceptions, and changes requiring additional review by service owners, cybersecurity, compliance, release management, or business stakeholders.

**Calendar, Scheduling, and Communications**

* Maintain the enterprise change calendar and monitor maintenance windows, blackout periods, and resource constraints.
* Identify collisions, overlapping outages, resource conflicts, and competing implementation windows; coordinate schedule alignment with release, project, application, infrastructure, cloud, security, vendor, and operations teams.
* Draft and distribute approved communications; ensure service desk and support teams understand outage windows, expected symptoms, business impact, workarounds, and escalation contacts.

**Emergency Change, PIR, Metrics, and Tooling**

* Support emergency changes by verifying urgency, risk, approvals, implementation details, validation, communications, and after-the-fact documentation.
* Support post-implementation reviews for failed, backed-out, emergency, high-risk, major, or incident-causing changes; document lessons learned, corrective actions, owners, due dates, and follow-up status.
* Prepare dashboards, trend summaries, audit evidence, and KPI reporting for success rate, failed changes, emergency volume, unauthorized changes, change-related incidents, approval cycle time, standard adoption, and CAB action closure.
* Use ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar ITSM tools to review, route, schedule, document, report, and audit changes; recommend workflow, notification, dashboard, template, and automation improvements.

**YOUR PROFILE**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5 or more years in IT service management, IT operations, infrastructure support, application support, release management, project coordination, or production support.
* 3 or more years of hands-on experience supporting an enterprise IT change management process.
* Current ITIL certification required, preferably ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Experience reviewing RFCs, maintaining change calendars, preparing CAB materials, supporting emergency changes, and documenting post-implementation review outcomes.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or comparable ITSM platforms.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices, including change enablement, incident, problem, service request, configuration, release, service level, and continual improvement.
* Ability to translate technical information into business impact, risk, operational readiness, and stakeholder communication requirements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for meeting notes, status updates, process documentation, and stakeholder communications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL 4 Practitioner: Change Enablement.
* Experience in regulated or audit-driven environments such as Financial Services.
* Experience supporting cloud, hybrid infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, application, database, endpoint, and enterprise platform changes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release automation, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and automated change approval models.
* Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC1, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar control frameworks.
* Experience creating dashboards and analytics using ServiceNow Performance Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting standard change models, risk scoring frameworks, process training materials, and stakeholder communication templates.

**Required Technical Skills and Core Competencies**

* **ITSM and Change**: ITIL-aligned workflows, RFC quality, classifications, approvals, calendars, risk assessment, and closure.
* **Risk Judgment:** Identifies service, business, technical, security, compliance, and scheduling risks before implementation.
* **Service Tools:** Use ITSM tools to review, route, schedule, document, report, and audit change records.
* **Process Discipline:** Applies governance consistently while keeping the process practical and understandable.
* **Technology Ops:** Working knowledge of infrastructure, applications, networks, databases, cloud, cybersecurity, endpoints, and production support.
* **Accountability:** Follows up, maintains accurate records, meets deadlines, and escalates unresolved risks properly.
* **Reporting:** Create and interpret dashboards, KPI summaries, trend reports, data quality checks, and audit evidence.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Builds effective relationships across technical teams, service owners, vendors, audit, and business stakeholders.

* **Communication:** Explains technical change activity clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Collaboration Tools**:Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Visio, or equivalent tools.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Simplifies workflows, standardizes repeatable work, improves templates, and reduces rework.

description:
### **Summary**

We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Detection Engineer to help shape the future of cloud security monitoring at Novartis. You will design, build, validate and continuously improve detection capabilities across Azure, AWS and other strategic cloud platforms while being a key partner with incident response and cloud security architect teams. An engineering role that combines cloud telemetry, custom detections, threat research, automation and AI-assisted investigation to create high-signal, scalable outcomes for Cyber Defense.
  
  
Role purpose:
  
  
Build a robust, AI-native cloud detection pipeline that improves correlation and investigation efficiency across multi-cloud environments. Engineer fragmented cloud telemetry into clear, actionable security outcomes with AI embedded throughout the detection engineering lifecycle. A multidimensional engineering role at the intersection of automation, cloud architecture, threat behavior analysis, detection engineering supporting analyst investigation workflows.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and operate an AI-native cloud detection pipeline that aggregates, correlates, enriches, deduplicates and prioritizes signals before analyst investigation
* Build and tune high-fidelity detections that improve coverage across cloud control-plane, data plane and management-plane activity, identity and access, network, container and Kubernetes and security posture.
* Use lower-fidelity and behavioral signals as investigation context, while ensuring known high-confidence detections are consistently escalated for security investigation
* Integrate and correlate telemetry from WIZ, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, AWS GuardDuty, Microsoft Sentinel and other cloud-native or CNAPP sources . Apply hands-on Wiz experience to interpret posture findings, attack paths, identity and exposure context, cloud events, runtime findings and threat detections and improve detection workflows
* Develop behavioral baselines and entity-centric analytics across users, IP addresses, identities and cloud resources . Create reusable dashboards, dynamic lookups and enrichment patterns enabling rapid pivots / drilldowns from an alert to related resource, identity, inventory and historical data
* Own the detection lifecycle from threat hypothesis and telemetry assessment through development, peer review, testing, deployment, tuning, documentation and retirement
* Embed AI across the detection lifecycle to accelerate detection creation and tuning, while ensuring engineering controls and human judgment govern the outcomes
* Finetune detections using historical data, controlled simulations, purple-team exercises, attack emulation and lessons learned from incidents and threat hunts
* Use detection-as-code practices, Git, CI/CD and automated testing to deliver controlled, repeatable and auditable content changes . Partner with Threat Hunting and Response, CSOC analysts, cloud platform teams, data onboarding, threat intelligence and automation teams to close visibility gaps and operationalize detections
Automate enrichment and triage using Python, APIs, SOAR workflows and AI-assisted approaches, with appropriate human oversight for security decisions . Measure and improve detection coverage, precision, false-positive rate, investigation volume, alert latency, data quality and analyst effort  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security, detection engineering, security analytics, threat hunting, incident response or security platform engineering
* Working knowledge of Azure and AWS security architectures, respective cloud domains and workloads
* Understanding of cloud telemetry and logging sources such as Azure Activity and Diagnostic logs, Entra ID logs, AWS CloudTrail, AWS CloudWatch and GuardDuty findings
* Experience in working with CNAPP bundles or developing and tuning detections in Wiz, Vega or cloud-native security platforms
* Proficiency in KQL and at least one scripting or programming language such as Python. CloudShell understanding is expected
* Familiarity with AI/LLM-assisted security investigation, agentic workflows or machine-learning approaches to signal enrichment and triage . Understanding of MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, threat-informed defense, entity mapping, correlation, enrichment and alert prioritization
* Ability to investigate complex datasets, distinguish true security risk from operational noise and communicate engineering decisions clearly . Experience collaborating across security operations, cloud engineering and platform teams in a global environment.
Experience with detection-as-code, Sigma or YAML-based content, Git, CI/CD, unit/integration testing and safe deployment or rollback practices . Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation or equivalent. Background in threat intelligence, purple teaming, red teaming, incident response or cloud threat research  

**Desirable Requirement:**

  
  

* Relevant certifications such as AZ-500, AWS Certified Security - Specialty, GIAC Cloud Security certifications, CCSP or equivalent practical expertise.
* GIAC Cloud Forensics Responder (GCFR)

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and technically qualified **IT Manager** to lead and manage the organization's IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, ERP systems, networking, and overall technology operations.

The ideal candidate must have a strong technical educational background, hands-on IT infrastructure experience, leadership capabilities, and proven experience managing IT operations across multiple locations (PAN India).

**1. IT Infrastructure Management**

* Manage overall IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, cloud services, hardware, software, and end-user support.

**2. PAN India IT Support & Ticketing Management**

* Manage and monitor the IT ticketing process across all company locations.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues, service requests, and IT-related complaints.
* Establish escalation procedures and monitor ticket closure within defined timelines.
* Supervise the IT support team and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

**3. CCTV Surveillance & Cybersecurity**

* Manage CCTV surveillance systems across corporate offices, factories, and other company locations.
* Ensure proper installation, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of CCTV infrastructure.
* Coordinate with vendors for CCTV upgrades, repairs, and technical support.
* Maintain cybersecurity standards, firewalls, VPNs, data protection, backup, and disaster recovery systems.

**4. ERP & IT Project Management**

* Oversee ERP systems, enterprise applications, and database management.
* Lead IT projects involving system upgrades, ERP implementation, cloud migration, and digital transformation.
* Coordinate with internal departments to identify technology requirements and implement effective solutions.

**5. Vendor Management & IT Procurement**

* Manage IT budgets, vendor relationships, software licensing, and hardware procurement.
* Evaluate IT vendors and negotiate service contracts.
* Monitor AMC agreements, software renewals, and IT infrastructure expenses.

**6. IT Governance & Team Leadership**

* Develop and implement IT policies, SOPs, procedures, and security standards.
* Ensure compliance with IT governance and regulatory requirements.
* Lead, mentor, and supervise the IT team.
* Identify and recommend new technologies to improve operational efficiency.

Required Skills & Technical Expertise

* Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and virtualization.
* Hands-on experience in PAN India IT Asset Management.
* Strong understanding of IT Ticketing Systems and Helpdesk Management.
* Good experience in CCTV Surveillance Management.
* Expertise in networking, LAN/WAN, firewalls, VPNs, and cybersecurity.
* Experience with ERP systems and enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Experience in backup management and disaster recovery.
* Strong vendor management, project management, and team leadership skills.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and decision-making abilities.

Educational Qualification (Mandatory)

Candidates must possess a strong technical educational background with any of the following qualifications:

* B.E. / B.Tech – Computer Science
* B.E. / B.Tech – Information Technology
* B.E. / B.Tech – Computer Engineering
* MCA – Master of Computer Applications

**Important:** Candidates from non-technical educational backgrounds will not be considered for this position.

Preference will be given to candidates with strong hands-on technical expertise rather than purely administrative IT management experience.

Certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCNA/CCNP, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or CISSP will be an added advantage.
