title: Manager - Experiential Marketing
description:
The Manager / Deputy Manager – Marketing (Retail Activation & Campaigning) will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing experiential marketing, retail activation, and consumer engagement initiatives across the West region.  
The role will play a key part in translating brand and marketing strategies into impactful retail campaigns and on-ground consumer experiences that strengthen brand awareness, increase store engagement and support business and sales objectives.  
In addition to managing marketing activation initiatives for the West region, the role will also be responsible for coordinating with and overseeing the deliverables of marketing resources supporting the North region, providing direction, guidance, and mentorship to ensure consistency in execution, timelines, and brand standards.  
The incumbent will work closely with the Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Retail Operations, Sales, Creative, Digital, and external agency teams to ensure seamless planning and execution of campaigns, events, activations, and other consumer-facing initiatives.

**Function:** Marketing  
**Sub-Function:** Experiential Marketing (Retail Activation & Campaigning)  
**Designation:** Manager / Deputy Manager – Marketing  
**Joining Location:** Mumbai – Andheri East  
**Role Type:** Individual Contributor (IC)  
**Regional Responsibility:** West Region, with oversight of North Region resources  
**Reporting To:** Senior Manager – Marketing & VM  
**Experience:** 7+ years, preferably 8–9 years  
**Qualification:** Postgraduate / MBA in Marketing

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Retail Activation & Experiential Marketing Strategy**

* Support the development and execution of regional experiential marketing and retail activation strategies aligned with overall brand and business objectives.
* Translate national marketing campaigns and brand priorities into relevant regional and local market activation plans.
* Identify opportunities to enhance consumer engagement through innovative retail experiences, events, activations, and localized campaigns.
* Develop activation concepts that are relevant to the target consumer and aligned with the brand's positioning.
* Ensure all regional activations maintain consistency with brand guidelines and communication standards.
* Recommend new and innovative activation formats based on market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive activity.

**2. Campaign Planning & Execution**

* Plan, coordinate, and execute integrated marketing campaigns across retail, experiential, events, print, digital and other relevant channels.
* Own regional campaign calendars and ensure timely execution of planned marketing initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external agencies/vendors for campaign planning and execution.
* Prepare detailed campaign briefs, execution plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* Monitor campaign implementation from conceptualization through execution and closure.
* Ensure all campaign assets, branding elements and communication materials are delivered within agreed timelines.
* Conduct post-campaign reviews and identify opportunities for improvement.

**3. Retail Store Activation**

* Partner with Retail Operations and Sales teams to identify opportunities for increasing customer footfall, engagement, and conversion through localized activations.
* Develop and execute store-level promotional activities, consumer engagement programs, and local marketing initiatives.
* Support new store launches, store anniversaries, key retail moments and other business-critical initiatives.
* Develop activation plans for high-priority stores, malls, markets, and catchment areas.
* Ensure activation activities are aligned with store objectives and deliver measurable business impact.
* Gather feedback from stores and regional teams to continuously improve activation effectiveness.

**4. Experiential Events, Partnerships & Sponsorships**

* Plan and execute experiential events, consumer engagement activities, brand experiences, and promotional events.
* Identify and evaluate opportunities for relevant partnerships, sponsorships, collaborations, and local events.
* Coordinate with athletes, influencers, event partners, malls, retailers, and other external stakeholders where applicable.
* Manage event agencies and other external partners to ensure quality and timely execution.
* Ensure event experiences are consistent with brand identity and provide meaningful consumer engagement.
* Track event performance and prepare post-event reports with key learnings and recommendations.

**5. Market & Consumer Research**

* Monitor market trends, consumer behavior, retail trends, and competitor marketing activities.
* Conduct market scans to identify relevant opportunities for regional activations.
* Analyze competitor campaigns, events, promotions, and consumer engagement initiatives.
* Provide insights to the marketing team on regional consumer preferences and market opportunities.
* Use market intelligence to recommend localized marketing initiatives and improve campaign effectiveness.

**6. Brand Management & Compliance**

* Ensure consistent implementation of brand guidelines across all regional activations and consumer touchpoints.
* Work closely with creative and VM teams to ensure all campaign communication and physical branding elements meet brand standards.
* Review marketing collateral, activation concepts, and event branding before execution.
* Ensure agencies, vendors and other partners understand and adhere to brand requirements.
* Identify and address any gaps in brand execution across the region.

**7. Creative & Content Coordination**

* Work with internal creative teams and external agencies to develop campaign and activation communication.
* Prepare clear creative briefs covering campaign objectives, target audience, messaging, deliverables, and timelines.
* Coordinate development of promotional assets, event communication, retail communication, and digital content as required.
* Review creative outputs and provide relevant feedback to ensure alignment with campaign objectives and brand guidelines.
* Coordinate with digital and social media teams to amplify relevant retail activation and experiential initiatives.

**8. Social Media & Digital Integration**

* Coordinate with digital/social media teams to ensure relevant experiential and retail campaigns receive appropriate digital amplification.
* Support the development of content around events, activations, launches, and consumer engagement initiatives.
* Monitor campaign-related digital engagement and consumer response.
* Identify opportunities to integrate offline retail experiences with digital marketing initiatives.
* Ensure regional activation content is aligned with the overall digital communication strategy.

**9. Collaboration with Sales & Retail Operations**

* Work closely with Sales, Retail Operations and VM teams to understand regional business priorities and translate them into marketing activation plans.
* Support sales teams with relevant marketing initiatives that contribute to store traffic, consumer engagement, and sales.
* Participate in regional business reviews and provide marketing recommendations.
* Ensure marketing initiatives are planned based on store requirements, business priorities, and market potential.
* Establish strong relationships with regional stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of campaigns.

**10. West Region Ownership**

* Take end-to-end ownership of retail activation and experiential marketing initiatives for the West region.
* Develop regional activation plans based on business priorities, market potential, and consumer insights.
* Manage the regional marketing calendar and ensure timely execution.
* Coordinate with stores, regional business teams, agencies, and vendors.
* Monitor execution quality and ensure timely resolution of regional activation-related issues.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of regional initiatives and share actionable insights with the senior marketing team.

**11. North Region Resource Oversight & Mentoring**

* Provide functional guidance and mentorship to marketing resources supporting the North region.
* Review and monitor the North team's marketing activation plans, timelines, and deliverables.
* Ensure consistency in campaign execution, brand standards and reporting across West and North regions.
* Support North resources in campaign planning, agency coordination, event execution, and problem-solving.
* Review key deliverables and provide constructive feedback to improve quality and effectiveness.
* Act as a point of coordination between North regional resources and the central Marketing & VM team wherever required.
* Track progress against agreed deliverables and escalate critical gaps or delays to the reporting manager.
* Build capability within the North resources through regular guidance, knowledge sharing and best-practice sharing.

**12. Agency & Vendor Management**

* Identify, coordinate, and manage experiential marketing agencies, event agencies, production partners, and other vendors.
* Brief agencies clearly on campaign objectives, scope, timelines, and expected deliverables.
* Evaluate agency proposals and execution plans based on quality, relevance, feasibility, and cost.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure adherence to agreed timelines and deliverables.
* Ensure proper documentation and closure of marketing activities with external partners.
* Build strong agency/vendor relationships while maintaining commercial discipline.

**13. Budget Management & Cost Optimization**

* Support planning and management of regional marketing and activation budgets.
* Track campaign and activation spend against approved budgets.
* Ensure effective utilization of marketing spends and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Review vendor quotations and proposals in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain appropriate documentation for marketing spends approvals and campaign closures.
* Ensure activities are executed within approved financial parameters.

**14. Campaign Performance & Reporting**

* Establish relevant KPIs for retail activation and experiential marketing initiatives.
* Track campaign performance, consumer engagement, footfall, participation, and other relevant metrics.
* Prepare regular reports on campaign progress, spends, execution status and business impact.
* Conduct post-campaign analysis and identify key learnings.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve future campaigns.
* Maintain a structured repository of campaign plans, reports, photographs, learnings, and performance data.

**15. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with Marketing, VM, Retail Operations, Sales, Digital, Creative, Finance and other internal stakeholders.
* Ensure effective communication of campaign requirements and timelines across functions.
* Coordinate multiple stakeholders simultaneously to ensure seamless campaign execution.
* Proactively identify execution challenges and drive timely resolution.
* Act as a strong bridge between the central marketing team and regional business teams.

**Key Deliverables / KPIs**

The role will be evaluated on:

* Timely execution of regional retail activation and experiential marketing campaigns.
* Quality and consistency of campaign execution across the West region.
* Effectiveness of retail activations in driving consumer engagement and store objectives.
* Successful execution of store launches, events, and key marketing initiatives.
* Adherence to approved marketing budgets and cost optimization.
* Agency and vendor performance management.
* Campaign ROI and performance measurement.
* Quality and timeliness of marketing reports and post-campaign analysis.
* Stakeholder satisfaction across Marketing, Sales, and Retail Operations.
* Effective oversight, mentoring, and delivery tracking of North region resources.
* Consistency of brand standards across regional activations.
* Identification and implementation of innovative experiential marketing opportunities.

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have:

* **7+ years of relevant experience**, preferably 8–9 years, in Marketing, Experiential Marketing, Retail Marketing, Brand Activation, Events or a related field.
* Prior experience in **retail, consumer-facing, lifestyle, footwear, fashion, FMCG, consumer durables or other retail-oriented industries** will be preferred.
* Strong hands-on experience in **experiential marketing, retail activations, events, and campaign execution**.
* Experience in managing multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of retail marketing and consumer engagement.
* Experience working with creative, experiential and event agencies.
* Ability to independently manage regional marketing initiatives from planning to execution and evaluation.
* Experience in mentoring or guiding junior/peer resources will be an advantage.
* Strong commercial understanding and ability to manage marketing budgets effectively.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven retail environment.

**Educational Qualification**

* **Postgraduate / MBA in Marketing** from a recognized institute.
* Additional certification in Digital Marketing, Brand Management, Experiential Marketing or Event Management would be an advantage.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Strong knowledge of **Experiential Marketing and Retail Activation**.
* Campaign planning and execution.
* Event management and consumer engagement.
* Agency and vendor management.
* Market and competitor analysis.
* Budget tracking and cost management.
* Campaign performance measurement and reporting.
* Strong understanding of retail marketing dynamics.
* Proficiency in **Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word**.
* Strong presentation and report-making skills.
* Familiarity with digital marketing and social media platforms.
* Ability to interpret campaign data and derive actionable insights.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* **Strong communication and interpersonal skills**
* Strategic and creative thinking
* Ownership and accountability
* Strong execution orientation
* Stakeholder management
* Collaboration and teamwork
* Problem-solving ability
* Commercial acumen
* Attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple priorities
* Agility and adaptability
* Ability to influence without direct authority
* Mentoring and coaching mindset
* Strong follow-through and commitment to timelines

**Role Summary**

This is an **Individual Contributor role with regional ownership**, responsible for driving **Retail Activation & Experiential Marketing for the West region**, while also providing **functional oversight, mentoring, and deliverable monitoring for North region marketing resources**.

The role requires a candidate who can combine **strategic thinking with strong hands-on execution**, effectively collaborate with Sales, Retail Operations, VM, Creative and Digital teams, and deliver impactful consumer experiences that strengthen the brand and contribute to business growth.

**About Skechers**

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: Sr. Analyst - SC Analytics Demand
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  
  

**OVERVIEW**

  

The purpose of the job is to support Demand planning function by providing Innovative solutions and help implementing it to optimize/Standardize processes which will bring improvement to overall forecasting approach resulting in better accuracy. Explore and take up opportunities which supports the demand planning efforts by creating and executing industry standard approaches. This role requires you to operate on the 1.30pm to 10.30pm shift.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

  

* Basic understanding of new product launches, forecasting techniques, and statistical forecasting models, with the ability to fine-tune model parameters to align forecasts with business needs and market dynamics.
* Analyze forecasting outputs, interpret patterns and trends in complex datasets, and prepare insightful reports to support stakeholder decision-making. Evaluate and monitor key performance metrics, such as forecast accuracy and bias, and publish performance dashboards to keep stakeholders informed.
* Identify improvement opportunities through root cause analysis (RCA) to achieve business targets and enhance reliability, while managing data requirements for new product launch forecasting and prioritizing support requests based on business impact and resource constraints.
* Use tools (like GCP, Python Dash, Tableau, AFO etc.) to extract, transform and manage data from primary and secondary sources using SQL, Excel and Python.
* Collaborate with stakeholders and brand marketing teams to align demand forecasts with launch strategies and promotional plans, lead consensus meetings to incorporate cross-functional feedback, and standardize processes by training stakeholders on tools and methodologies to improve adoption and efficiency.
Coordinate with technical /data science teams to identify process improvement opportunities, validate outputs, propose modification if required.  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* **Education:** Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in Operational research, statistics, supply chain and any other relevant field 3 years of related experience
* **Experience:** 2-3 years of experience in data analysis and high level of analytical skills,
* **Technical Skills:** Working knowledge of data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Looker, along with forecasting techniques, including time-series models (Exponential Smoothing and ARIMA) and machine learning methods.
* Proficiency in statistical analysis and data handling using R, Python, Excel, and SQL to derive meaningful insights from datasets.
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, and Azure, as well as supply chain, CPG, and retail operations **.**
* **Soft Skills:** Demonstrates critical thinking, integrity, teamwork, demand management expertise, a systematic approach to problem-solving, the ability to influence without authority, and strong interpersonal skills.

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* Master’s degree with a major in Operations or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience.
* Professional certifications such as CSCMP or APICS are preferred.
* Proficiency in Excel, knowledge of ERP systems, and familiarity with functional planning tools such as SAP APO.

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

  
  

**Job Overview:**

Finance Technology catalyst for technology and process transformation, enabling Finance teams to replace manual, non-compliant workflows with scalable, automated, and simplified systems across the bank.

Driving Innovation, efficiency and scalability through automation and Integration, these solutions enable Citi to comply with regulatory mandates and empower our businesses to achieve their goals, both current and long-term.

As part of Finance technology, our products and initiatives adhere to Citi’s strategic architecture principles and support the end-to-end integration of multiple global functions within the bank including Finance, Risk, and Controllers.

**About the Role:**

The Technology Product Management Analyst is a strategic professional who owns defining our overarching product strategy, spearheading business engagement and transformation and contributing to directional strategy for AI, integration and automation capabilities.

Key responsibility will be defining Product vision, strategy and roadmap, develop solution proposals, business cases, solution design and tactics in engagement with Business and Technology stakeholders.

This role will be responsible for leading business process redesign, map existing and to-be processes for operational optimization, digital transformation initiative and change management.

With Data at the heart of everything we do, this role will require strong data analytical skills, tracing lineage of data, and developing conceptual and logical data models.

The role is expected to drive cross-functional collaboration and effective communication with business and technology partners, to guide, influence and convince others and lay the direction for Product development.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform analysis and mapping to trace lineage of data and develop conceptual and logical data models.

* Report control issues with transparency and take accountability of deliveries.
* Develop plans and execute functional strategies, requiring coordination and integration across units.
* Help the team prioritize, negotiate, and remove obstacles to achieve business results, and assist in identifying and removing product development blockers.
* Coordinate UAT testing with technology and business users.
* Conduct data analysis to document business requirements at the right level.
  

  

**Must-have skills:**

1.Strong understanding of Finance processes and data flows, record to report, Accounting, reconciliation, regulatory reporting and close process, with ability to interpret financial data. Familiarity with Financial products and asset classes, with an appreciation of how transactions flow from source product systems to financial reporting.

2.Strong working knowledge of AI/ML concepts and their practical applications in business processes across financial services.

3.Ability to critically assess where AI adds value vs, where traditional rule-based automaton / process improvements are more effective ensuring pragmatic and cost-efficient solutions.

**Qualifications:**

2. Strong background in financial domain and data modelling, accounting, ledger, asset classes etc. 5+ years of experience as a business analyst in financial services, driving BPM, digitization and Transformation initiatives in a global set up preferred.

title: Associate Analyst, Analytics & Metrics
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Associate Analyst, Analytics & MetricsOverview  
We are seeking a Data Analyst to transform complex payments, transaction, customer, and operational data into accurate reporting and actionable business insights. The role combines hands-on data management, data quality, SQL and Python analysis, dashboard development, reporting automation, and stakeholder collaboration. The successful candidate will work with business and technology teams to improve performance, identify trends and growth opportunities, and support reliable, data-driven decisions.  
Role  
Data Preparation, Quality and Governance  

* Extract, compile, cleanse, validate, standardize, and organize large datasets from multiple internal and external sources using SQL, Python, Excel, and approved data platforms.
* Review data for completeness, accuracy, consistency, duplication, and compatibility; investigate discrepancies and correct issues where possible or escalate them through defined channels.
* Research and obtain missing information required to complete datasets, records, or supporting documentation.
* Apply defined data extraction, labelling, categorization, mapping, reconciliation, and quality-control procedures.
* Perform internal quality reviews and maintain clear evidence of checks, corrections, assumptions, and data lineage.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with professional maturity and comply with applicable data privacy, security, governance, and retention requirements.

Analysis and Business Insights  

* Analyze payments and transaction data to identify trends, anomalies, customer behavior, operational performance, and potential growth or efficiency opportunities.

Use descriptive statistics, trend analysis, segmentation, model testing, and root-cause analysis
  

* Translate business requirements into structured analytical approaches, datasets, metrics, and reporting solutions.
* Interpret findings with the end user in mind and provide clear, practical recommendations supported by data.
* Collaborate with business, operations, product, risk, and technology stakeholders to clarify requirements and validate analytical outputs.

SQL, Python, Databricks and Automation  

* Write and optimize SQL queries using joins, common table expressions, subqueries, aggregations, and window functions for extraction, validation, reconciliation, and analysis.
* Use Python, particularly pandas and NumPy, to manipulate data, perform quality checks, conduct analysis, and build reusable processing scripts.
* Work with Databricks notebooks and Spark or PySpark for data preparation and distributed processing, with guidance for more complex engineering activities.
* Automate recurring reports, validation routines, and data preparation processes to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Support basic machine-learning activities such as feature preparation, model testing, performance evaluation, classification, clustering, or predictive analysis under established frameworks.
* Document code, logic, dependencies, business rules, and operating procedures so solutions can be reviewed, maintained, and reused.

Reporting and Visualization  

* Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools to track business metrics, KPIs, trends, and exceptions.
* Prepare accurate recurring and ad-hoc reports, presentations, and analytical summaries for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Validate dashboard calculations and reporting outputs against source systems before release.
* Store completed work in designated repositories, maintain appropriate versions, and perform backup activities as instructed.
* Present findings, limitations, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and respond to follow-up questions with supporting evidence.

Delivery and Collaboration  

* Manage multiple assignments or projects simultaneously while meeting agreed quality, productivity, and turnaround expectations.
* Work effectively in a fast-paced environment, prioritize competing requests, and communicate risks or delays early.
* Partner with cross-functional and global teams, participate in reviews, and contribute to process and reporting improvements.
* Operate independently on defined tasks while seeking appropriate guidance for complex, ambiguous, or high-risk issues.
* Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, punctuality, attention to detail, and a goal-oriented approach.

All About You  
Required Qualifications and Experience  

* Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Commerce, or a related discipline.

3-4 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data management, reporting, or a related technical role.  

* Proven experience working with large datasets, performing data validation, resolving quality issues, and delivering accurate analytical outputs.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions, window functions, and complex queries.
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation and analysis, particularly pandas and NumPy.
* Good to have knowledge on Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable data-visualization platform.
* Good Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data analysis, and preferably Power Query.
* Working knowledge of statistics, trend analysis, model testing, and analytical problem-solving.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including report writing, presentations, and stakeholder discussions.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver work accurately within deadlines.
* Experience with web-based applications, internet research, Microsoft Office, and common data-management tools.

Preferred Qualifications  

* Experience in payments, banking, fintech, financial services, or another transaction-intensive environment.
* Familiarity with payment and transaction metrics, customer segmentation, fraud or anomaly analytics, and operational performance reporting.
* Exposure to Databricks, Spark, PySpark, cloud data platforms, Delta tables, or distributed data-processing concepts.
* Exposure to machine-learning modelling, including data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, and interpretation of results.

title: Senior Director, Enterprise AI & IT, India Site Lead
description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

**HackerOne Values**

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is **Customer Obsessed** and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We **Default to Disclosure** by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners **Win Together** by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

**Senior Director, Enterprise AI & IT, India Site Lead**
========================================================

### **Location: Pune, India (working onsite)**

**Position Summary**
--------------------

HackerOne is transforming how we work to become an AI-native enterprise, and the Senior Director, Enterprise AI & IT will lead that transformation. Reporting to the CTO, you will own our Enterprise AI and Enterprise IT functions, shaping how AI changes the systems, workflows, capabilities, and operating models that power HackerOne and ensuring our technology foundation enables the company to move faster and operate more effectively.

This role carries an equally important second mandate: serving as HackerOne’s senior leader on the ground in India and Site Leader for Pune, a strategic technical center for the company. You will be the face and voice of HackerOne in Pune, bringing teams and leaders together across functions, shaping the long-term ambition for the site, and building an environment where Pune takes on increasingly strategic and consequential work.

We opened our new office in Pune, India to welcome team members who value in-person connection, collaboration, and shared purpose. All roles in Pune are hybrid by design – remote options are not available. For the types of challenges we’ll tackle and the work we’ll do together, we believe in-person connection will be essential to building strong relationships, solving problems effectively, and fostering a vibrant community.

As a fully integrated part of HackerOne’s global team, the Pune office will play a meaningful role in advancing our culture and mission. At HackerOne, we Win Together – and our Pune team will help lead the way by shaping a dynamic, in-person culture rooted in purpose and partnership.

**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------

Success in the Senior Director, Enterprise AI role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne.

* Set and execute an **AI Native** strategy for the Enterprise, moving HackerOne beyond incremental AI adoption toward AI-native ways of working. Identify where agents, automation, new capabilities, and redesigned operating models can materially improve how teams work and turn that opportunity into measurable company-wide transformation.
* **Own the Outcome** for Enterprise AI and Enterprise IT, including the systems, platforms, AI enablement, and IT support capabilities employees depend on. Establish clear priorities, operating mechanisms, accountability, and measures of success while ensuring these functions deliver reliable services today and build toward HackerOne’s future.
* Build an AI-native Enterprise IT model, including an increasingly automated **help desk** in which AI agents resolve a growing share of employee needs, human support focuses on what requires judgment and intervention, and deep technical issues reach the appropriate owning teams. Use the resulting data and patterns to continually improve both AI and enterprise systems.
* **Multiply Your Impact** by building, developing, and connecting strong teams and leaders. Create clarity and high standards within Enterprise AI & IT while building a Pune leadership community that shares context, solves problems across organizational boundaries, and collectively owns the success of the site.
* Serve as HackerOne’s senior leader on the ground in India and build one HackerOne in Pune. Establish the connections, operating rhythms, and shared identity that bring teams across functions together as a cohesive, high-performing community; step into cross-functional friction when unclear ownership, competing priorities, or coordination breakdowns impede execution.
* Set the ambition for Pune over the next 2–3 years and practice **Change Agility** as the company and technology landscape evolve. Shape the capabilities, talent, and leadership HackerOne builds in India, translate company strategy into clear local priorities, and enable the site to take on increasingly strategic and consequential work.
* Apply **Data-Driven Decision Making** to Enterprise AI transformation, IT operations, and site leadership. Establish measures that show whether AI is materially improving how HackerOne operates, whether Enterprise IT is delivering effectively, and whether Pune is developing the capabilities and impact expected of a strategic technical center.
* Apply **First Principles Problem Solving** to enterprise-wide opportunities and constraints. Challenge legacy assumptions about how work should be done, reduce unnecessary complexity, and work across organizational boundaries to design simpler, scalable operating models; externally, represent HackerOne in India’s technology and talent ecosystem to strengthen the relationships and employer presence needed to support Pune’s long-term growth.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Significant senior leadership experience owning enterprise technology, AI transformation, enterprise systems, IT, or similarly broad technical functions, with accountability for strategy and execution across multiple capabilities and stakeholders.
* Experience representing a technology company externally and building relationships across India’s engineering, AI, technology, and talent ecosystem.
* Demonstrated experience leading meaningful AI transformation—not simply deploying AI tools—including redesigning workflows or operating models and translating emerging AI capabilities into measurable organizational outcomes.
* Experience operating in a highly technical environment with sufficient depth across enterprise systems, software/automation, AI capabilities, and IT operations to set technical direction, make informed tradeoffs, and build credibility with engineering and business leaders.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience building or leading a strategic technology site or major cross-functional technical organization in India, or comparable experience establishing a strong local leadership community within a global company.
* Experience scaling AI agents, automation, internal developer tooling, or AI-enabled enterprise platforms across a complex organization.
* Experience leading both enterprise IT/systems and transformation-oriented technology functions, including modernizing employee support through self-service and automation.

**Job Benefits:**
-----------------

* Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance\*
* Equity stock options
* Retirement plans
* Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO
* Paid maternity and parental leave
* Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)
* Employee Assistance Program
* **Eligibility may differ by country**

We're committed to building a global team! For certain roles outside the United States, India, the U.K., and the Netherlands, we partner with Remote.com as our Employer of Record (EOR).

Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available.

*Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.*

HackerOne is an Equal Opportunity Employer in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, pregnancy, disability or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*

We are looking for a **Principal AIOps Architect** to spearhead large-scale AIOps, Intelligent Operations, and Agentic AI transformation efforts, shaping architectural direction across cloud, automation, and AI-powered operational intelligence platforms for major enterprise initiatives.

**Responsibilities**

* Direct large-scale AIOps, Intelligent Operations, Agentic AI, and automation transformation programs by establishing target-state architecture, modernization roadmaps, governance frameworks, and reusable solution patterns
* Design observability and operational intelligence solutions spanning metrics, logs, traces, events, topology, service dependencies, incidents, deployments, and configuration changes to support anomaly detection, event correlation, service-impact analysis, and AI-assisted root cause analysis
* Build Agentic AI solutions for IT Operations leveraging Amazon Bedrock/AgentCore, Microsoft Foundry/Azure OpenAI, or Gemini/Vertex AI Agent Engine to support reasoning, knowledge retrieval, tool invocation, multi-step investigation, recommendations, and operational decision-making
* Develop autonomous and semi-autonomous remediation solutions incorporating policy controls, identity and access verification, risk assessment, Human-in-the-Loop approvals, rollback, recovery validation, auditability, and feedback loops
* Connect AIOps platforms with ITSM/CMDB, observability, CI/CD, cloud-management, knowledge, security, automation platforms, and enterprise APIs, including ServiceNow or similar tools
* Oversee enterprise architecture reviews, solution assurance, design authority decisions, non-functional requirements, security, resilience, scalability, operational governance, and technical leadership across Cloud, SRE, DevOps, Platform, Operations, and AI teams
* Head RFP/RFI/RFQ efforts and pre-sales solutioning, covering technical discovery, solution architecture, transformation strategy, estimations, staffing models, implementation roadmaps, assumptions, risks, dependencies, TCO analysis, and technical proposal creation
* Interact with senior customer and executive stakeholders, run architecture workshops and solution defenses, and partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Delivery, Engineering, Practice, and Commercial teams to craft technically sound and competitive solutions

**Requirements**

* 18-25 years of overall IT experience, with substantial background in Enterprise/Solution Architecture, Cloud, SRE, DevOps, Platform Engineering, IT Operations, Automation, or AIOps
* Deep experience building large-scale AIOps and intelligent operations platforms, covering observability, anomaly detection, event correlation, noise reduction, service-impact analysis, AI-assisted RCA, remediation, and operational automation
* Strong command of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud), including enterprise cloud architecture, security, identity, networking, governance, resilience, and scalability
* Direct architecture experience with at least one Agentic AI ecosystem, such as Amazon Bedrock/AgentCore, Microsoft Foundry/Azure OpenAI, or Gemini/Vertex AI Agent Engine/Google ADK
* Solid grasp of Agentic AI architectures, including reasoning, planning, tool/function calling, RAG/knowledge grounding, context and memory, multi-agent orchestration, agent evaluation, Human-in-the-Loop processes, guardrails, and policy enforcement
* Background in designing autonomous/self-healing operations, event-driven remediation, workflow orchestration, ITSM integration, operational governance, and secure interactions between AI agents and enterprise systems
* Strong Python skills for building Agentic AI solutions, APIs, integrations, automation, telemetry processing, orchestration, and rapid prototyping
* Track record in RFP/RFI solutioning, pre-sales architecture, technical proposal development, estimations, solution defense, executive stakeholder engagement, and technical leadership across large enterprise transformation programs

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to multiple major cloud platforms along with familiarity with enterprise observability tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic
* Working knowledge of LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Strands Agents, Google ADK, MCP, A2A, RAG, vector databases, or knowledge graphs
* Experience with SRE, FinOps, cloud economics, capacity optimization, predictive operations, and managed-services solutioning
* Relevant certifications in Cloud Architecture, AI, Enterprise Architecture, SRE, ITIL, or TOGAF

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks & Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
  + Health benefits
  + Retirement benefits
  + Paid time off
  + Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

title: Associate Data Scientist
description:
Metyis is growing! We are looking for an Associate Data Scientist with 3 - 7 years of experience for a full-time position to join our Data and Analytics team in Gurgaon

**Who we are**
--------------

**The next step of your career starts here, where you can bring your own unique mix of skills and perspectives to a fast-growing team.**

Metyis is a global and forward-thinking firm operating across a wide range of industries, developing and delivering AI & Data, Digital Commerce, Marketing & Design solutions and Advisory services. At Metyis, our long-term partnership model brings long-lasting impact and growth to our business partners and clients through extensive execution capabilities.

With our team, you can experience a collaborative environment with highly skilled multidisciplinary experts, where everyone has room to build bigger and bolder ideas. Being part of Metyis means you can speak your mind and be creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you can achieve with a team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.

We are Metyis. Partners for Impact.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Enjoy a high level of responsibility and immediate client interactions under the guidance of senior team members.
* Interact with data team on regular basis to drive innovation and create impact on our clients
* Help our clients to target, measure and improve mission-critical business metrics and generate demonstrable return on investment.
* Become part of a fast-growing international and diverse team

**What you will do**
--------------------

Metyis is growing! We are looking for a data professional to join our Data Science team.

* Own live forecasting and optimization models, keeping them accurate and adapting them as constraints and business rules change.
* Scope and develop new data science projects end to end, from problem framing to deployment.
* Apply machine learning and generative AI to extend solutions where they add value.
* Answer client business questions using data & scenario analyses and provide clear recommendations.
* Present results to client stakeholders, including senior management.
* Work with data and engineering teams on data quality, deployment and cloud performance.
* Guide junior colleagues and review their work.

**What you will bring**
-----------------------

* 3–6 years of professional experience in data science or advanced analytics, delivering projects for business stakeholders.
* **Business acumen:** you can connect data science model outputs and data analysis to business processes (related to functions such as cost, service, inventory, delivery etc.) and communicate insights & recommendations clearly to business stakeholders in English.
* Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn), SQL and Git; you can debug and improve someone else's code.
* **Optimization:** a solid grasp of optimization concepts, such as objectives, constraints and trade-offs, and experience configuring optimization tools and interpreting their results.
* **Supply chain:** working knowledge of demand forecasting, inventory and replenishment, and KPIs such as forecast accuracy and service level.
* **Cloud:** experience running data and ML workloads on Azure, AWS or GCP, ideally with Databricks or Spark.
* **Machine learning:** hands-on experience building and deploying models, such as gradient boosting and time series forecasting, with scikit-learn, XGBoost or LightGBM, including evaluation and drift monitoring.
* **Generative AI:** practical exposure to generative AI and a good sense of where it can add value to business processes.
* A degree in a quantitative field, such as engineering, statistics, computer science or operations research.**Nice to have**
* MLOps tooling, such as MLflow, Docker and CI/CD.
* Orchestration tools, such as Airflow or Azure Data Factory.
* Experience with logistics, pricing or S&OP analytics.
* Consulting or other client-facing experience.

**We are united by our differences**
------------------------------------

At Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow.

**Recruitment Disclaimer**
--------------------------

Metyis only contacts candidates through verified and official channels: LinkedIn (official and verified recruiter profiles), emails ending in @metyis.com, and our Applicant Tracking System (Recruitee). We do not use WhatsApp, social media messaging platforms, or personal accounts for recruitment outreach. If you receive suspicious communication claiming to be from Metyis, please verify the sender and report it through our official website.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

**A PURPOSE DRIVEN COMPANY – 150 YEARS**

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.

Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.

**What you will do:**

As a Platform Engineer on the SaaS BlackLine application team within the Corporate Technology Finance Systems organization, you will report to the Lead, Platform Engineer and serve as a functional subject matter expert supporting enterprise finance systems. In this role, you will help manage the company’s BlackLine platform by providing functional and configuration support for onboarding new affiliated transactions and maintaining existing ones, with a strong focus on financial close automation, intercompany processes, and journal entry governance.

This role offers broad exposure to enterprise finance operations and places them at the forefront of an evolving financial close environment. The responsibilities are closely aligned with BlackLine-related disciplines, including automation, control execution, audit readiness, and process optimization.

**What you can expect:**
------------------------

* Lead the review and analysis of BlackLine incidents, ensuring naming conventions, downstream system requirements, and financial close controls are consistently maintained
* Partner with finance and controllership teams to design and maintain BlackLine configurations that support compliance and the onboarding of new and existing affiliated transactions
* Provide subject matter expertise in BlackLine controls, configurations, and financial close oversight
* Participate in enterprise finance transformation initiatives with an emphasis on BlackLine optimization, including process standardization, automation opportunities, and enhancements that improve efficiency and visibility
* Lead with a product and platform mindset by shaping the vision for BlackLine and related finance platforms, influencing stakeholders, and identifying opportunities to enhance platform capabilities, adoption, and business value
* Contribute to roadmap planning and continuous improvement efforts for BlackLine, supporting intercompany processes and financial close activities

**What you will bring:**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree is required; a degree in Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field is preferred
* 3+ years of practical experience in business analysis, finance systems, financial close, or related accounting and reporting processes is preferred
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess process gaps, control requirements, and dependencies across finance systems
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with accounting, finance, and technology stakeholders
* Exposure to BlackLine modules such as Intercompany Hub, Transaction Matching, or Journal Entry would be highly valuable
* Experience with Oracle ERP (particularly General Ledger) is a plus
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality and audit readiness across finance processes
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities across system enhancements, maintenance activities, and project deliverables while meeting deadlines
* Ability to learn quickly, work independently, and collaborate effectively in a diverse team environment
* Client-focused and results-oriented, with a strong interest in finance transformation, process automation, and scalable accounting operations

**What will set you apart?**

* Experience with BlackLine intercompany Hub is a plus.
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Experience participating in ledger, reconciliation, close automation, or finance transformation initiatives is preferred
* Experience with SQL, Oracle Business Intelligence, or other analytics tools that support financial reporting and reconciliation analysis is a plus
* Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Microsoft Power BI for close reporting, reconciliation monitoring, or operational dashboards is a plus
* An inquisitive mindset and a passion for learning new technologies
* Financial or insurance accounting knowledge is a plus but not required

* **PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

**Skills:** BlackLine , Oracle ERP , Financial close automation

Kody Technolab Limited is seeking a Lead AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, MLOps, and cloud-based AI deployments.

* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models for classification, regression, recommendation, NLP, computer vision, and/or generative AI tasks.

HSBC GIFT IBU (International Financial Service Centre Banking Unit) is based in GIFT, Gandhinagar, Gujarat and serving more than 400+ wholesale banking clients. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the Wholesale Banking Client Service team as Client Service Manager.

Role Purpose

* The Wholesale Client Services (WCS) team is responsible for the management and execution of client related service events through the full life-cycle of a client’s relationship with HSBC
* The Relationship Service Manager (RSM) is responsible for, but not limited to, the proactive management of services for an assigned portfolio of GIFT City branch to ensure a high quality of service is delivered at all times

* Product & Implementation management for customer due diligence

title: AI Evaluation Lead (Part Time Contract, Engagement Based)
description:
**About us**

DATACLAP is an AI data services company based in Coimbatore, working with AI companies across North America and Europe on data annotation, human in the loop workflows, RLHF and MLOps. We're building a dedicated AI evaluation practice covering LLMs, AI agents, computer vision and audio models, and we're looking for experienced practitioners to lead client engagements and mentor our engineering team.

**The role**

This is a part time, engagement based contract role, not full time employment. You'll lead AI evaluation projects for our clients, typically 8 to 15 hours a week per engagement. You'll design the evaluation approach, guide a team of junior engineers who do the hands on execution, review their work, and own the quality of what we deliver. You'll also help us turn every engagement into reusable methods, so the practice gets stronger with each project.

**What you'll do**

* Scope evaluation projects with clients: understand the model, the use case, and what "good" looks like for them
* Design evaluation frameworks, including metrics, test sets, rubrics, and pass/fail criteria
* Build or guide the building of golden datasets and evaluation harnesses
* Design and calibrate LLM as a judge setups, and know when human evaluation is needed instead
* Plan red teaming, safety and robustness testing where relevant
* Lead and mentor 2 to 5 junior engineers per engagement through regular reviews and working sessions
* Review results, catch flawed methodology, and present findings to client stakeholders
* Document each engagement as a playbook, rubric set or template the team can reuse

**What we're looking for**

* 6+ years in machine learning, data science or applied AI, with at least 2 years focused on model evaluation, benchmarking or quality assurance of ML systems
* Hands on experience evaluating LLM applications: RAG systems, chatbots, agents or fine tuned models
* Solid grounding in evaluation fundamentals: metric selection, test set design, statistical significance, inter annotator agreement, and data leakage
* Experience with eval tooling such as DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, Inspect, Langfuse, Braintrust or EleutherAI's evaluation harness (or custom built equivalents)
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers, and comfort reviewing others' work critically
* Clear written and spoken communication; you'll present findings to international clients
* Python proficiency

**Strong plus**

* Computer vision evaluation experience (detection, segmentation, tracking; metrics such as mAP and IoU; tools such as FiftyOne or CVAT)
* Audio or speech model evaluation (word error rate, speaker diarization, MOS style human ratings)
* Experience with AI agent evaluation: task completion, tool use, multi step trajectories
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF
* Prior consulting or client facing delivery experienc
  **e**

**Engagement mode**

* Contract basis, paid per engagement, with a monthly retainer during active projects
* Flexible hours, mostly remote, with occasional in person sessions in Coimbatore
* Start with a short paid pilot project so we can both see if it's a fit
* If you're currently employed, please make sure your employer permits outside consulting work

**How to app**
ly

Send us a short note (not just a CV) describing one model evaluation you designed or led: what you were evaluating, how you decided what to measure, and one thing that surprised you in the results.

title: Applied AI Architect, Partnerships
description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

As a Partners Solutions Architect on the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on cultivating technical relationships with our Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs), and our cloud partners . You will strengthen our relationships with key partners to accelerate indirect revenue, enable their AI practices, and execute on long-term GTM strategy.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* **Strategic Technical Partnership**: Be a technical thought partner to the Anthropic GTM partnerships team, providing technical expertise to better understand the partner landscape, driving key strategic programs, and identifying opportunities to deepen partner technical capabilities. Embed with GSI and cloud partner technical teams to enable their AI practices, support troubleshooting, evangelize Anthropic in their developer communities, and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
* **Joint Solution Development:** Collaborate with partners to identify high value industry-specific GenAI applications, develop joint solutions and codify reference architectures / best practices to accelerate time to deployment
* **Customer Deal Support:** Intervene directly to unblock strategic customer deals where partners are the primary delivery vehicle, providing deep technical expertise and solution architecture guidance.
* **Partner Ecosystem & Events**: Represent Anthropic at partner events such as GSI customer workshops, summits, and industry conferences. Lead or support partner-specific developer events, hackathons, and technical enablement sessions, especially for technically native communities.
* **Product Feedback:** Validate and gather feedback on Anthropic's products and offerings, especially as they relate to partner use cases and deployment patterns, and deliver this feedback to relevant Anthropic teams to inform product roadmap and partner strategy.

**You may be a good fit if you have:**
--------------------------------------

* 10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing/partner-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Partner Sales Engineer
* Track record of successfully partnering with GSIs and/or cloud providers to solve complex technical challenges, from initial solution design through customer delivery
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more
* Strong presentation & technical communication skills with the ability to translate requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

**How we're different**
-----------------------

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

**Come work with us!**
----------------------

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Senior Manager-AI Innovation & Research
description:
AI Labs seeks a Senior AI Researcher (Senior Manager) to lead a team of Ai researchers that will powers credit, fraud and marketing decisions. The candidate serves as a thought leader and a problem-solver who can blend business, technical, and industry best practices when it comes to developing the models, and algorithms that power our customers’ digital experiences. This role sits at the intersection of applied AI research, large-scale AI platforms, and large-scale compute infrastructure. The Sr. Manager will help define and execute a forward-looking research agenda and help to translate cutting-edge machine learning, and systems innovation into scalable, governed, and business-critical AI capabilities. Role is focused on creation and integration of foundational models that can provide value for multiple modelling usecases.

The ideal candidate will combine deep hand-on ML research expertise with strong practical knowledge and experience in building scalable infrastructure and data science platforms.

Colleagues in AI Labs serve as key members of the Global Decision Science organization within Credit and Fraud Risk at American Express. This critical team is responsible for managing enterprise risks throughout the customer lifecycle, across our consumer and commercial businesses, and across all our global products. We develop industry-first data capabilities, build profitable decision-making frameworks, create machine learning-powered predictive models, and improve customer servicing strategies.

Our Global Decision Science teams use industry leading modelling and AI practices to predict customer behaviour. We develop, deploy and validate predictive models and support the use of models in economic logic to enable profitable decisions across credit, fraud, marketing and servicing optimization engines.

  

* Advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Engineering, Mathematics, Economics, Physics, or a related quantitative field or equivalent work experience. 4+ years of work experience in applied research lab organisations is required.
* Very strong record of applied research impact through platforms, patents, production systems, or enterprise-scale adoption, in addition to traditional publications.
* Expertise with GPU-accelerated ML workloads, high-performance computing, and advanced optimization techniques are essential.
* Expert knowledge of machine learning and statistical modeling methods for supervised and unsupervised learning in areas such as transformer and attention-based architectures, deep learning for structured sequential and graph data, multi-task and transfer learning.
* Exceptional programming skills in Python, Spark. Additional knowledge of C/C++ and Java is preferred
* Expertise in hybrid-cloud AI/ML infrastructure, including Google Cloud (e.g., Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataproc) and large-scale distributed computing environments.

Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Role Definition
  
  
The Engineering Manager – Data Science is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing multiple pods of data scientists and machine learning engineers while ensuring high-quality, timely delivery of data science products and platforms. This role partners closely with AI product owners, AI architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to ensure data science solutions are technically sound, scalable, and aligned to strategic outcomes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
People Leadership & Talent Development
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of data scientists and ML engineers
* Set clear performance expectations and support career development
* Foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture

Technical & Engineering Leadership
  
  

* Provide technical guidance across data science and ML solutions working closely with AI Architects
* Ensure adherence to engineering standards and MLOps practices
* Review model designs and deployment strategies

Delivery & Execution Management
  
  

* Own delivery execution and capacity planning
* Ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
* Manage risks, dependencies, and technical debt

Stakeholder Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with AI Product Owners and business stakeholders
* Communicate progress, risks, and outcomes clearly

Quality, Governance & Responsible AI
  
  

* Ensure solutions meet quality, security, and compliance standards
* Uphold responsible AI principles

Degree Requirement
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Post Graduate or higher is desired.
  
  
Skill Descriptors
  
  
**Engineering Management**
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop high‑performing technical teams delivering complex data science and machine learning solutions. Provides clear direction, sets expectations, and holds teams accountable for outcomes while supporting individual growth and engagement. Balances people leadership, technical oversight, and delivery execution in a fast‑moving environment.
  
  
**Data Science & Machine Learning**
Strong working knowledge of data science, machine learning, GenAI and statistical modeling concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, and experimentation. Able to guide and review technical approaches, challenge assumptions, and ensure solutions are fit for purpose without requiring hands‑on model development as a primary responsibility.
  
  
**Delivery & Execution**
Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute work in Agile or hybrid delivery environments. Manages team capacity, dependencies, and risks to ensure predictable delivery of high‑quality outcomes. Uses data and metrics to assess progress, identify issues early, and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Communication & Collaboration**
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to non‑technical audiences. Builds strong partnerships with product owners, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders to align expectations, manage trade‑offs, and deliver value.
  
  
Software Development Life Cycle
  
  
Demonstrated knowledge of software and data science development life cycles, including experimentation, prototyping, production deployment, and ongoing operations. Understands the differences between research‑oriented work and production‑grade solutions and guides teams accordingly.
  
  

* Works within formal delivery and governance methodologies
* Understands phases, activities, dependencies, and key decision points across the life cycle
* Identifies common risks and quality considerations at each stage
* Interprets and guides technical documentation, design artifacts, and delivery plans

Artificial Intelligence
  
  
Working knowledge of artificial intelligence, GenAI and machine learning concepts, risks, and opportunities, with the ability to guide teams toward solutions that deliver business outcomes responsibly.
  
  

* Understands AI methodologies, capabilities, and limitations
* Guides teams in applying responsible AI principles, including fairness, transparency, robustness, and governance
* Keeps informed of emerging AI technologies and evaluates their applicability to business needs
* Supports the adoption of AI practices that balance innovation with risk management

Programming & Technical Literacy
  
  
Strong technical literacy across programming and data science tools sufficient to effectively review code, designs, and technical approaches.
  
  

* Able to assess code quality, maintainability, and architectural alignment
* Collaborates effectively with hands‑on engineers and data scientists
* Understands testing, version control, and deployment concepts
* Hands‑on coding is not a primary responsibility, but technical depth is sufficient to guide and challenge solutions

Technical Troubleshooting
  
  
Demonstrated ability to lead teams through complex technical and operational issues across data, models, and production systems.
  
  

* Guides investigation and resolution of data, model, and system issues
* Reviews logs, metrics, and system behavior to support root cause analysis
* Partners with platform and operations teams to resolve production incidents
* Ensures issues are documented, learnings are captured, and preventative actions are implemented

Note
