title: Solutions Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled Data Analytics Specialist with strong analytical, statistical, and data visualization capabilities to transform complex datasets into actionable business insights. - Excellent data storytelling and communication skills.

- Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.

- Experience working with multiple data sources and collaborating with technical teams.

4. Technical Skills

Additional tools and technologies such as SQL, Python, Power BI, Azure Data Services, or other analytics platforms may be considered based on the project's technical requirements.

**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Health Economics Analyst to join our team.As a Health Economics Analyst, you will contribute to the development of health economic models that evaluate the cost-effectiveness of health technologies for global reimbursement applications. This position plays a key role in advancing the economic evidence that supports patient access to innovative therapies worldwide. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including clinical, regulatory, and commercial partners, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to project execution from model conceptualization through final delivery.
  
  
Responsibilities include data analysis, model building support, and assisting senior team members in project execution, with opportunities to deepen your expertise in health economics and expand your skills across clinical research and outcomes analysis. You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through rigorous economic evaluation and strategic reimbursement solutions. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Health Economics Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across health economics, outcomes research, and global market access.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform comprehensive data analysis to support health economic model development and validation
* Assist in building and adapting health economic models for country-specific applications and reimbursement requirements
* Conduct systematic searches for published health economic models and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) body guidance to inform model development
* Check and validate health economic models using appropriate software tools to ensure accuracy and elucidate the economic value of clients' products
* Support senior team members in project execution, including model documentation, quality assurance, and deliverable preparation

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Advanced computing skills, particularly in Microsoft Excel with proficiency in macros and VBA
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, especially in conveying technical information clearly
* Experience working in healthcare, pharmaceutical, or regulated research environments
* Self-motivation, enthusiasm, and flexibility in a dynamic project-based setting
* Keen interest in medical research, healthcare delivery, and the pharmaceutical industry

At first, you will meet specialist teams, identify valuable use cases and build focused proofs of concept that demonstrate what data science and AI can do. As these relationships mature, you will help develop our ability to deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with the wider data science team from discovery through implementation. Knowledge of energy would help, initiative, technical breadth and the ability to earn trust across disciplines are central to the role.

**What you will do**

* Meet colleagues across practice areas to understand their work, identify specific use cases and agree what a useful result would look like.
* Initially, scope and demonstrate focused proofs of concept, choosing suitable methods from statistical analysis and forecasting to machine learning and language models.
* Explain methods, limitations and potential value clearly to specialists and nontechnical colleagues. Use their feedback to improve the solution and build confidence in the team’s services.
* Assess data quality, feasibility, privacy and delivery needs, and define the evidence needed to take a prototype further.
* As demand grows, design and deliver data science and AI solutions across projects with the wider team, from modelling and evaluation to integration, documentation and adoption. Contribute to proposals and client presentations.
* Establish reusable ways of working and help turn early demonstrations into a sustainable pipeline of well-defined client work.

**What you will bring**

* Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data.
* Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures.
* Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks.
* Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing.
* Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use.
* Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences.
* A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field.

**Useful additional experience**

* Experience in energy, utilities, climate or environmental policy, particularly applied analysis with domain experts.
* Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment.
* Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills.

**How we work**

As the first data scientist in our India team, you will have the opportunity to shape how our established data science and AI services grow there. You will work alongside colleagues with a wide range of technical and subject expertise, tackle varied client challenges, and see promising ideas develop into project work. We will support your career development with ongoing training and opportunities to deepen both your technical and consulting skills.

**Bot and Third-Party Applications**

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.

**Working at ICF**

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

**Candidate AI Usage Policy**

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process.

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodations that involve the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.

title: E-commerce operations
description:
**We are looking for an experienced and proactive E-commerce Operations Manager to oversee and scale the day-to-day operations of our baby care and hygiene product portfolio across major online channels (Amazon, Flipkart, Quick Commerce, and D2C Shopify).

In this role, you will hold end-to-end ownership of catalog management, inventory health, order fulfillment coordination, platform promotions, and operational customer support to ensure seamless growth and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

1. Listing & Catalog Optimization

Create, manage, and optimize product listings across all platforms, including accurate product titles, bullet points, backend keywords, descriptions, and A+ / Enhanced Brand Content.

Maintain catalog hygiene: monitor buy boxes, resolve suppressed listings, fix barcode/SKU sync errors, and manage category approvals.

Ensure pricing parity, discount coupons, and bundling strategies align across channels.

2. Inventory & Supply Chain Coordination

Monitor daily sales velocity, inventory turn rates, and stock levels across warehouse hubs (FBA, seller hubs, local dispatch).

Forecast reorder points to prevent stockouts while avoiding excessive holding or platform storage fees.

Coordinate with production and third-party logistics (3PL) partners to ensure timely dispatch, inbounding, and delivery tracking.

3. Marketplace Growth & Campaign Execution

Plan and implement platform participation in major shopping festivals, flash sales, lightning deals, and seasonal campaigns.

Monitor on-platform ad performance (Sponsored Products/Brands) alongside organic ranking, coordinating budget adjustments to maximize Return on Ad Spend (ROAS).

Track competitor pricing, new product rollouts, and category trends in baby care/FMCG.

4. Performance Tracking & Customer Experience

Monitor account health metrics, seller ratings, order defect rates (ODR), and customer feedback across portals.

Review customer queries, returns, and reviews to identify recurring quality or packaging issues, coordinating improvements with packaging/fulfillment teams.

Prepare weekly and monthly reports on sales revenue, platform fees, return percentages, and net contribution margins.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 2–4 years of proven experience managing seller panels for e-commerce brands (Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart, Shopify, or Quick Commerce like Blinkit/Zepto).

Domain Knowledge: Direct experience in FMCG, personal care, baby products, or consumable goods is strongly preferred.

Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, conditional formulas for stock and order tracking).

Platform Mastery: Thorough understanding of marketplace compliance, FBA/marketplace inbounding processes, catalog guidelines, and review policies.

Soft Skills: High ownership, meticulous attention to detail, strong vendor coordination skills, and a data-driven approach to troubleshooting.**

title: System Analyst - Power BI/Python/VBA/R

At WSP, we're continuing to grow and develop our expertise in Earth and Environment, operating as a trusted advisor and technical expert on engineering design challenges for our clients across multiple industries. Our team is growing, and as a result we're adding a Data Scientist and Visualization Lead to our water quality group. A day in the life…
  
  

* Day-to-day, you will work with the water quality team to expand and strengthen our data processing and visualization tools, with opportunities to collaborate with other environmental digitization and database teams within WSP;

title: Revenue Assurance Manager
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Revenue Assurance Manager is responsible for ensuring complete, accurate, and timely revenue recognition from Enterprise customers across all CPaaS products and services. The role acts as a bridge between Sales, Operations, Product, Billing, and Finance to prevent revenue leakage, validate commercial terms, reconcile usage with billing, improve billing accuracy, and strengthen revenue controls.

The ideal candidate should have strong analytical capabilities, experience in telecom/CPaaS billing systems, and a sound understanding of enterprise contracts, invoicing, collections, and financial controls.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Revenue Assurance & Billing**

* Ensure 100% revenue capture for all Enterprise CPaaS services.
* Monitor revenue leakage across SMS, Voice, WhatsApp Business, RCS, Email, OTP, and other communication channels.
* Validate customer usage records against invoices generated.
* Identify and resolve billing discrepancies before invoice generation.
* Ensure billing is completed accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Monitor unbilled and deferred revenue and ensure timely invoicing.

**Contract & Commercial Validation**

* Review customer contracts, purchase orders, and commercial approvals.
* Validate tariffs, discounts, credit limits, and billing frequencies.
* Ensure pricing in billing systems matches approved commercial agreements.
* Verify implementation of contract amendments and change requests.

**Revenue Reconciliation**

* Reconcile:
* Carrier/vendor usage vs customer billing
* Platform usage vs invoices
* CRM/Sales Orders vs Billing System
* Revenue recognized vs collections
* Investigate revenue variances and recommend corrective actions.

**Enterprise Sales Support**

* Partner with Enterprise Sales teams during customer onboarding.
* Ensure all commercial documents are complete before activation.
* Support sales with revenue analysis and customer billing clarifications.
* Validate special pricing approvals and promotional offers.

**Financial Controls**

* Develop and maintain revenue assurance controls.
* Perform periodic audits of billing and revenue processes.
* Ensure compliance with accounting standards (Ind AS 115 / IFRS 15 where applicable).
* Support statutory, internal, and customer audits.

**Reporting & MIS**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly Revenue Assurance MIS.
* Publish dashboards covering:
* Revenue leakage
* Billing accuracy
* Unbilled revenue
* Credit note analysis
* Revenue realization
* Collection trends
* Present findings and recommendations to management.

**Automation & Process Improvement**

* Drive automation in reconciliation and billing validation.
* Work with Product and Technology teams to improve billing systems.
* Implement controls to eliminate manual intervention.
* Identify process improvements to reduce billing disputes.

**Collections Coordination**

* Coordinate with Accounts Receivable for disputed invoices.
* Assist in resolving billing-related customer escalations.
* Reduce revenue realization delays caused by billing issues.

**Experience**

* 5–10 years of experience in Revenue Assurance, Telecom Billing, Finance Operations, or Enterprise Finance.
* Minimum 3 years in the CPaaS, Telecom, SaaS, or Enterprise Technology industry.
* Experience with high-volume enterprise billing environments is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of CPaaS products:
* A2P SMS
* OTP
* Voice
* WhatsApp Business API
* RCS Messaging
* Email APIs
* Push Notifications
* Knowledge of telecom billing and mediation systems.

title: Manager - Process Excellence & Cost Optimization
description:
**Job Purpose**
This role controls plant cost and material loss and improves workforce productivity. It does this through standard measurement systems (BOM, cost per sq ft, manpower matrices) and shop-floor automation such as production scanning, smart scheduling and live dashboards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cost and Financial Control**

* Track monthly plant cost per sq ft against budget, and analyse and explain variances.
* Reconcile BB and COV material consumption and wastage against BOM, keeping variance within 1%.
* Build and maintain a BOM-based tracking system for general consumables, with cost variance within 5%.
* Reconcile and approve job-worker bills within the agreed billing cycle, with no delays.

**Automation and Digital Tracking**

* Implement operator-wise and team-wise production scanning (barcode for COV, QR code for BB) to measure throughput and reduce manpower cost by 10% YoY.
* Drive smart production scheduling and order-kit allocation to improve direct-worker efficiency by 20%.
* Develop an AI / Power BI tracker for media-wise material inflow versus wastage, with full traceability and variance under 1%.
* Maintain daily plant and department dashboards comparing budget and actual cost trends.

**Waste Management and Manpower Productivity**

* Develop at least two alternate or backup buyers for each saleable scrap item or category, targeting a 15% impact on sale value.
* Optimise waste disposal, including balers for cardboard, plastic and fabric, to cut waste volume by 30%.
* Build a manpower performance measurement matrix for non-sq-ft production and non-production departments.
* Support the skill matrix and skill-based operator allocation, and train supervisors and operators in method and productivity improvement (10 people per department).

**General Duties**

* Conduct time and motion studies, set standard times, and balance lines.
* Prepare monthly MIS and variance reports for management.
* Coordinate with production, stores, finance, IT and vendors.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen and 5S initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering. An MBA or PGDIE is preferred.
* 8–12 years in manufacturing industrial engineering, costing or productivity, including at least 3 years leading projects or a team.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong in BOM and inventory reconciliation, cost analysis, time study and production scheduling.
* Skilled in advanced Excel and Power BI, with exposure to ERP/MES and barcode or QR systems. AI or analytics knowledge is a plus.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable presenting data to senior management.
* Able to work across departments and train shop-floor teams.

title: AI Evaluation Lead (Part Time Contract, Engagement Based)
description:
**About us**

DATACLAP is an AI data services company based in Coimbatore, working with AI companies across North America and Europe on data annotation, human in the loop workflows, RLHF and MLOps. We're building a dedicated AI evaluation practice covering LLMs, AI agents, computer vision and audio models, and we're looking for experienced practitioners to lead client engagements and mentor our engineering team.

**The role**

This is a part time, engagement based contract role, not full time employment. You'll lead AI evaluation projects for our clients, typically 8 to 15 hours a week per engagement. You'll design the evaluation approach, guide a team of junior engineers who do the hands on execution, review their work, and own the quality of what we deliver. You'll also help us turn every engagement into reusable methods, so the practice gets stronger with each project.

**What you'll do**

* Scope evaluation projects with clients: understand the model, the use case, and what "good" looks like for them
* Design evaluation frameworks, including metrics, test sets, rubrics, and pass/fail criteria
* Build or guide the building of golden datasets and evaluation harnesses
* Design and calibrate LLM as a judge setups, and know when human evaluation is needed instead
* Plan red teaming, safety and robustness testing where relevant
* Lead and mentor 2 to 5 junior engineers per engagement through regular reviews and working sessions
* Review results, catch flawed methodology, and present findings to client stakeholders
* Document each engagement as a playbook, rubric set or template the team can reuse

**What we're looking for**

* 6+ years in machine learning, data science or applied AI, with at least 2 years focused on model evaluation, benchmarking or quality assurance of ML systems
* Hands on experience evaluating LLM applications: RAG systems, chatbots, agents or fine tuned models
* Solid grounding in evaluation fundamentals: metric selection, test set design, statistical significance, inter annotator agreement, and data leakage
* Experience with eval tooling such as DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, Inspect, Langfuse, Braintrust or EleutherAI's evaluation harness (or custom built equivalents)
* Experience leading or mentoring engineers, and comfort reviewing others' work critically
* Clear written and spoken communication; you'll present findings to international clients
* Python proficiency

**Strong plus**

* Computer vision evaluation experience (detection, segmentation, tracking; metrics such as mAP and IoU; tools such as FiftyOne or CVAT)
* Audio or speech model evaluation (word error rate, speaker diarization, MOS style human ratings)
* Experience with AI agent evaluation: task completion, tool use, multi step trajectories
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks such as the EU AI Act or NIST AI RMF
* Prior consulting or client facing delivery experienc
  **e**

**Engagement mode**

* Contract basis, paid per engagement, with a monthly retainer during active projects
* Flexible hours, mostly remote, with occasional in person sessions in Coimbatore
* Start with a short paid pilot project so we can both see if it's a fit
* If you're currently employed, please make sure your employer permits outside consulting work

**How to app**
ly

Send us a short note (not just a CV) describing one model evaluation you designed or led: what you were evaluating, how you decided what to measure, and one thing that surprised you in the results.

**Position Summary:**
The CRM Specialist (Supervising Associate) will own CRM opportunity tracking across Quantum/Physical AI/Other initiatives within EY’s Next Frontier workstream. The role will drive pipeline visibility, weekly reporting, conversion analysis and data accuracy to support strategic decisions and revenue growth.
  
  
The role requires strong working knowledge of EY CRM and sales processes, advanced Excel skills, and the ability to translate pipeline data into clear insights for leadership and workstream teams. Experience generating reports using AI tools is preferred; Power BI is not required.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage CRM opportunity tracking across Quantum/Physical/Other AI initiatives.
* Maintain accurate pipeline data, opportunity status and ownership details.

* Identify pipeline trends, risks, gaps and follow-up actions.
* Reconcile CRM data with workstream inputs and sales updates.
* Support revenue visibility by tracking progression, ageing and close probability.
* Prepare clear summaries, dashboards or Excel views for decision-making.
* Partner with sales, operations and initiative leads to improve data quality.
* Use AI tools to speed up report generation and insight development.

* Track opportunities across Quantum and Physical AI workstreams.
* Maintain opportunity stage, value, probability and close date accuracy.
* Follow up with owners to resolve missing or outdated CRM data.
* Monitor pipeline movement, blockers and items needing leadership attention.
* Support weekly review routines with clear CRM inputs and insights.
* Maintain a structured tracker for open, won, lost and stalled opportunities.
* Ensure CRM records reflect agreed sales and workstream updates.

**Pipeline Reporting and Insights:**

* Generate weekly pipeline visibility reports using Excel and CRM exports.
* Analyse opportunity conversion, ageing, win/loss movement and pipeline health.
* Highlight trends that may impact revenue, forecasting or prioritisation.
* Provide concise insights for Next Frontier leadership discussions.
* Summarise key changes, risks and recommended actions.
* Support ad hoc reporting requests for Quantum and Physical AI initiatives.
* Use AI tools where helpful to draft summaries and improve reporting speed.

* Apply EY CRM and sales process knowledge to improve consistency.
* Support initiative leads with CRM hygiene and reporting expectations.
* Align reporting definitions across operations, sales and workstream teams.
* Maintain simple documentation for reporting steps and data definitions.
* Identify process improvement opportunities in pipeline tracking.
* Coordinate with global stakeholders across time zones when required.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Strong knowledge of EY CRM and sales processes.
* Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, pivots and structured reporting.
* Ability to analyse sales pipeline data and explain clear business insights.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Experience preparing weekly reports for senior stakeholders.
* Good understanding of opportunity stages, pipeline health and sales conversion.
* Ability to identify trends, risks and follow-up actions from CRM data.
* Comfortable working with AI tools to improve reporting and summaries.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating across global teams.
* Strong stakeholder management and follow-up discipline.
* Power BI experience is not required.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, Data Analytics or a related discipline.
* 5–8+ years of relevant experience in CRM, sales operations, pipeline management, business operations or reporting.
* Experience working with CRM systems and sales process data.
* Experience producing recurring reports, dashboards or Excel-based insights.
* Experience supporting leadership reviews or revenue pipeline discussions.
* Exposure to emerging technology, innovation or consulting environments is preferred.
* Experience using AI tools for reporting, summarisation or analysis is preferred.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and recurring reporting deadlines.
* Willingness to work with global teams and support overlap with US hours when needed.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior NetSuite Administrator
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
  
  
Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
  
  
With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior NetSuite Administrator to own the health, performance, and evolution of our NetSuite ERP environment. This is a hands-on role for someone who can serve as the go-to expert across finance/ERP configuration, customizations, and integrations — balancing day-to-day system administration with strategic projects that scale the platform alongside the business. In addition to NetSuite, you will support our broader Finance Systems ecosystem, including Stripe, Zip, Ramp, Workato, and other integrated platforms.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the primary system administrator for NetSuite, managing configuration, security, roles/permissions, and user provisioning
* Design, build, and maintain customizations including custom records, fields, forms, workflows, saved searches, and dashboards
* Develop and maintain SuiteScript solutions, SuiteFlow workflows, and SuiteBuilder customizations to support evolving business requirements
* Contribute to automation initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline processes using workflows, AI tools, and integration technologies
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validate system enhancements prior to production deployment
* Administer and optimize core ERP modules including financials, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, revenue recognition, and inventory/fulfillment
* Manage the NetSuite release cycle: evaluate new features in each release, test in sandbox, and coordinate production deployments
* Own data integrity and governance, including bulk data loads/updates (CSV import, SuiteScript, or middleware), deduplication, and cleanup initiatives
* Troubleshoot and resolve system issues, performance bottlenecks, and user-reported bugs; manage support tickets and prioritize backlog
* Create and maintain system documentation, process flows, and end-user training materials
* Lead or support NetSuite-related projects such as module rollouts, multi-currency, subsidiary/multi-book implementations, M&A system integrations, or platform upgrades
* Support adjacent Finance Systems including Stripe, Zip, Anrok, Ramp, Navan, Workato, and related enterprise applications.

**What You'll Bring**

* 7+ years of hands-on NetSuite administration experience, including at least 2+ years in a senior, lead, or solution-architect capacity
* Strong proficiency in SuiteScript, SuiteFlow, SuiteTalk/REST web services, and SuiteBuilder
* Deep understanding of core NetSuite ERP modules: GL, AP/AR, Order Management, Revenue Recognition, and Multi-book/Multi-currency
* Experience with NetSuite Advanced Revenue Management
* Ability to breakdown stakeholder requirements to technical solutions that are robust and scalable
* Proven experience designing and supporting integrations with third-party systems (CRM, payroll, EDI, e-commerce, banking, etc.)
* Experience managing multi-subsidiary, multi-currency, and/or OneWorld NetSuite environments a strong plus
* Solid grasp of accounting and finance fundamentals (GAAP) sufficient to partner effectively with Finance stakeholders
* Experience with data migration, ETL tools, and middleware platforms (Celigo, Boomi, Workato, MuleSoft, or similar)
* Track record of managing NetSuite release testing, sandbox refreshes, and production deployments
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions
* Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with non-technical stakeholders
* NetSuite certifications (e.g., SuiteFoundation, ERP Consultant, SuiteCloud Developer) preferred
* Experience in a SOX-compliant or audited environment
* Familiarity with adjacent tools such as Stripe, Salesforce, Anrok, or ADP - Plus
* Prior experience supporting a company through an ERP implementation, M&A integration, or platform migration - Plus

**Harness In The News**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
  
  
At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/
  
  
**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
  
  
If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Database Administrator
description:
**Overview**
**About Business Unit:**
A consolidated team of database technology professionals, we deliver expert insights across all major database engines and Big Data solutions to support Epsilon products and platforms. The team has a one-of-a-kind alignment that combines a horizontal organizational structure with vertically aligned sub-groups dedicated to our clients. By adhering to consistent standards and methodologies, the team ensures operational excellence and has close ties with product teams at Oracle, IBM, Cloudera, Amazon and Microsoft.
  
  
**About The Role**
Seeking a highly motivated and well-rounded Oracle DBA with a strong development background to be part of a fast-paced production support and full-lifecycle implementation team.
  
  
Candidate is expected to be familiar with database architecture, logical and physical design, automation, documentation, installs, shell scripting, PL/SQL programming, backup & recovery concepts, and database performance and tuning. Candidate must have good analytical, verbal, and written skills.
  
  
Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Full life cycle support of client's database(s). Database system utilizes RAC and non-RAC for OLTP and warehouse, Active DataGuard for DR, partitioning on 12c and 19c on premises and cloud environment.
* Responsible for database backups, design, development, testing, and performance tuning.
* Will work with developers to design and build new structures to support application enhancements and promote database changes throughout the Dev, UAT and Prod databases.
* Responsible for quarterly patch applications (PSU) and periodic database upgrades with minimal downtime in database environment.
* Required to participate in 24x7 on-call rotation and be available to perform periodic after-hours support.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of related experience with implementation and administration of database systems.
* Bachelor Degree or equivalent experience required.
* Able to administer and manage Standalone/RAC production server environment(s) on-premises and cloud environments.
* Able to understand and meet the needs of end-users.
* Able to work with multiple projects in a dynamic, fast-paced and often changing environments.
* Strong design, development, administration skills.
* Strong knowledge of database upgrade/migrations.
* Expertise in using Backup and recovery tools(RMAN/EXPDP/IMPDP)
* Knowledge of managing Automatic storage management.
* AWS Oracle database administration on EC2s and RDS preferred. Areas of knowledge would include, but not limited to, EBS storage, S3 storage, parameter groups, security groups, and option groups.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting database performance issues.
* Knowledge of Oracle DataGuard
* Knowledge of Oracle Enterprise Manager.
* Experience in writing Shell scripts.
* Ability to write clear, concise technical documentation
* Have excellent written/oral communication and soft skills.
* Oracle certification can be plus.

**Additional Information**
Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we’ve provided marketers from the world’s leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels.
  
  
Epsilon’s comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9,000 employees around the world.
  
  
Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day.
  
  

* People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other.
* Collaboration: We work together, support one another, and collectively achieve goals.
* Growth: There are endless opportunities for growth through learning, development and career advancement.
* Innovation: We drive progress through cutting-edge solutions and forward-thinking approaches.
* Flexibility: We’ve created a balance between work and personal life, and we encourage adaptability to solve problems creatively.

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.
  
  

* Act with integrity
* Work together to win together
* Innovate with purpose
* Respect all voices
* Empower with accountability

These pillars and values are our foundation—shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.
  
  
**Epsilon is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
Epsilon is committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal employment opportunities by using reasonable efforts to attract, recruit, engage and retain qualified individuals of all ethnicities and backgrounds, including, but not limited to, women, people of color, LGBTQ individuals, people with disabilities and any other underrepresented groups, traits or characteristics.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Role Description**
**Why Join 7-Eleven Global Solution Center?**
When you join us, you'll embrace ownership as teams within specific product areas take responsibility for end-to-end solution delivery, supporting local teams and integrating new digital assets. Challenge yourself by contributing to products deployed across our extensive network of convenience stores, processing over a billion transactions annually. Build solutions for scale, addressing the diverse needs of our 84,000+ stores in 19 countries. Experience growth through cross-functional learning, encouraged and applauded at 7-Eleven GSC. With our size, stability, and resources, you can navigate a rewarding career. Embody leadership and service as 7-Eleven GSC remains dedicated to meeting the needs of customers and communities.
  
  
**Why We Exist, Our Purpose and Our Transformation?**
7-Eleven is dedicated to being a customer-centric, digitally empowered organization that seamlessly integrates our physical stores with digital offerings. Our goal is to redefine convenience by consistently providing top-notch customer experiences and solutions in a rapidly evolving consumer landscape. Anticipating customer preferences, we create and implement platforms that empower customers to shop, pay, and access products and services according to their preferences. To achieve success, we are driving a cultural shift anchored in leadership principles, supported by the realignment of organizational resources and processes.
  
  
At 7-Eleven we are guided by our
**Leadership Principles**
. Each principle has a defined set of behaviours which help guide the 7-Eleven GSC team to Serve Customers and Support Stores.
  
  

* Be Customer Obsessed
* Be Courageous with Your Point of View
* Challenge the Status Quo
* Act Like an Entrepreneur
* Have an “It Can Be Done” Attitude
* Do the Right Thing
* Be Accountable

**About This Opportunity**
**Job Title:**
Lead Data Engineer
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Required Experience**

* 7+ years of overall IT experience with a strong focus on Data Warehousing and Data Lake solutions.
* Minimum 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale Data Warehouse and DataLake architectures.
* Strong experience working with cloud-based database platforms in AWS and/or Azure environments.
* 4+ years of experience with SQL Server and PostgreSQL database administration, development, and performance optimization.
* Experience with MongoDB, Document DB, or other document-oriented databases.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of Data Warehouse modeling concepts, including Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, dimensional modeling, and data governance best practices.
* Strong expertise in SQL query tuning, performance optimization, indexing strategies, partitioning, and database troubleshooting.
* Solid understanding of database infrastructure, scalability, high availability, backup/recovery, security, and capacity planning.
* Experience designing and implementing standardized database frameworks, governance models, and best practices across enterprise platforms.
* Hands-on experience with Liquibase or similar tool for database version control, schema deployment, and change management.
* Experience building and supporting CI/CD pipelines for database and data platform deployments using tools such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or similar.
* Experience with cloud-native database services on AWS and/or Azure.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience defining enterprise database standards, reusable frameworks, and automation processes.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates, etc.) is a plus.
* Experience working with large-scale data platforms supporting analytics and reporting workloads.
* Understanding of database monitoring, observability, and cost optimization in cloud environments.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate with architects, developers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive database modernization and standardization initiatives.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience. Nice to Have
* AWS and/or Azure Cloud Certifications.

title: Oracle PAAS Admin Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle PAAS Admin - Consultant, Managed Services**
**Enterprise Performance**
Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations maximize value from enterprise technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. As a Cloud Technical Consultant within Managed Services, you will support clients in maintaining, enhancing, and optimizing cloud-based solutions that enable business performance and operational continuity. Deloitte’s practitioners bring together technology experience, process knowledge, and delivery discipline to help organizations address complex operational needs, improve system performance, and support ongoing transformation in a dynamic business environment.
  
  
Level: Consultant or equivalent

Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.

* Support Oracle Cloud technical operations across managed services engagements, including issue analysis, defect resolution, and system enhancements.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, extensions, and data conversion components using Structured Query Language (SQL), BI Publisher, Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence, Financial Reporting Studio, and File-Based Data Import templates.

Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.
  
  
The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.

title: Cloud Migration Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Cloud Migration Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provides assessment of existing solutions and infrastructure to migrate to the cloud. Plan, deliver, and implement application and data migration with scalable, high-performance solutions using private and public cloud technologies driving next-generation business outcomes.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Oracle Database Architecture
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
Oracle GoldenGate
  
  
**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Cloud Migration Engineer, a typical day involves evaluating current systems and infrastructure to determine the best approach for transitioning to cloud environments. This role includes strategizing and executing the migration of applications and data, ensuring that the solutions implemented are scalable and optimized for performance. The position requires close collaboration with various teams to align migration efforts with business goals, while continuously monitoring progress and addressing any challenges that arise during the migration process. The engineer plays a key role in enabling organizations to leverage both private and public cloud technologies to achieve advanced operational capabilities and improved business outcomes.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless migration and integration of applications and data.
* Monitor and troubleshoot migration processes to maintain high availability and performance.
* Document migration plans, processes, and outcomes to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
* Assist junior team members by providing guidance and support during migration activities.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Oracle Database Architecture.
* Good To Have Skills: Experience with Oracle GoldenGate.
* Strong knowledge of cloud migration strategies and best practices.
* Familiarity with private and public cloud platforms and their architectures.
* Ability to analyze and optimize database performance in cloud environments.

title: Specialist - SAP Basis
description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
Join Novonesis as an SAP Basis Specialist and help ensure the reliability of the SAP platforms that support our ability to produce and distribute our products. You will become part of an experienced five-person SAP Basis team responsible for two legacy SAP platforms as well as the SAP infrastructure and Basis workstream for our SAP S/4HANA project.
  
  
The role & your impact
  
  
In this role, your primary focus will be operational reliability across our SAP landscape. Alongside day-to-day execution, you will help optimize how we operate through automation, improved monitoring, standardization and lifecycle management. You will also contribute to our SAP S/4HANA project and help establish the future operations and maintenance model.
  
  
Your key responsibilities in this role
  
  
Ensure SAP system availability, stability and performance by administering SAP RISE Private Cloud environments, monitoring system health, managing capacity and resolving incidents and technical problems.
  
  
Manage the technical lifecycle of SAP systems, including configuration, kernel updates, support packages, SAP Notes, upgrades, system copies, refreshes, migrations and technical conversions across environments.
  
  
Coordinate SAP RISE services and operational dependencies, acting as a technical interface between Novonesis, SAP, internal IT teams, application owners and external partners.
  
  
Maintain SAP security, compliance and controlled change management through secure technical configurations, user and certificate administration, vulnerability remediation, documented changes and reliable transport and release processes.
  
  
Drive automation and continuous improvement by enhancing monitoring, alerting, housekeeping, operational reporting, standardization and repeatable cloud-based SAP operating processes.
  
  
What you'll need to be successful in this role
  
  
Solid hands-on experience with SAP Basis and SAP HANA.
  
  
Understanding of SAP RISE with SAP Private Cloud Edition, including the division of responsibilities between SAP and the customer.
  
  
Experience managing incidents, service requests, maintenance activities and operational dependencies in collaboration with SAP.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities to identify root causes and resolve complex SAP Basis, HANA, performance, connectivity and cloud-related issues.
  
  
A structured approach to operational reliability, with the ability to prioritize, take ownership and collaborate effectively with internal teams, business stakeholders and external partners.
  
  
**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**
An interest in continuously improving monitoring, documentation, standardization and operational processes.
  
  
A drive to identify repetitive activities that can be automated and establish reliable, repeatable ways of working.
  
  
Interest in cloud-based operating practices, scripting, automation and improved tooling.
  
  
What we offer you
  
  
An opportunity to join an experienced SAP Basis team responsible for business-critical SAP platforms and contribute directly to the SAP S/4HANA project. You will work across SAP, internal IT teams, functional teams, developers, integration specialists, application owners and business stakeholders while helping shape our future SAP operations and maintenance model.
  
  
Working conditions
  
  
This position is based in Bangalore and follows a hybrid working model. Standard working hours apply, with occasional travel.
  
  
Application deadline
  
  
26 October 2026.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

title: Lead Engineer - Data & AI
description:
**Job Description**
A.P. Moller - Maersk is an integrated container logistics company and member of the A.P. Moller Group. Connecting and simplifying trade to help our customers grow and thrive. With a dedicated team of over 80,000, operating in 130 countries; we go all the way to enable global trade for a growing world. We leverage cutting-edge technology to optimize operations, enhance customer experience, and drive business growth. We are seeking a Lead Engineer - Data & AI to join our team and play a pivotal role.
  
  
**About The Role**
Maersk moves a significant share of the world's containerized trade and is a major player in the logistics and services space. The data is large, complex and consequential. This role offers real architectural ownership of a platform that matters, with the freedom to build it yourself, within a team that treats AI tooling as a serious part of engineering practice.
  
  
This is a senior individual contributor role for an engineer who designs and builds the most critical parts of our systems. You will partner in setting the architecture for our data and AI platform, decide how the major pieces fit together, and then write and deploy the code that proves the design works. Design documents and diagrams are part of the job, but they are the beginning of the work rather than the output. The engineers who do well in this role are the ones whose designs are trusted because they have shipped the hard parts themselves.
  
  
The scope spans the full stack of a data and AI platform: storage and table formats, pipelines, services, applications, and the agentic systems built on top. You will make the calls on open standards and interoperability, on build against buy, and on how we sequence a migration without disrupting what is already running. You will also set how this organization uses agentic coding, which at this level means building the tooling and the standards that other engineers work within.
  
  
The role carries no direct reports. Influence comes from the quality of your designs, the code you ship, and the engineers who get better by working alongside you.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own the architecture for major platform components and data products, from storage layer through to the application and agent layer.
* Define target architectures and the migration paths to reach them, with attention to open standards, interoperability and long-term flexibility.
* Write and deploy production code. You will personally build the difficult components and the reference implementations others extend.
* Make build against buy decisions with clear reasoning on cost, operational load and dependency risk.
* Design the platform foundations that other teams rely on: data contracts, lineage, schema evolution, access control and cost management.
* Set the agentic engineering practice across the group, including internal tooling, MCP servers, reusable skills, evaluation harnesses and the standards for reviewing generated code.
* Take on the technical problems that are genuinely hard or genuinely ambiguous, and bring them to a working resolution.
* Raise the engineering bar through design review, code review and mentoring.
* Partner with Product, Business stakeholders and Engineering Managers on sequencing, trade-offs and technical risk.

**Core Skills:**

* Programming: Writing code to manipulate, analyze, and visualize data, often using languages like Python, R, and SQL.
* AI & Machine Learning: Creating systems that can perform tasks that typically require human intelligence. Using Machine learning (ML), a subset of AI that uses algorithms to learn from and make predictions based on data
* Data Analysis: Inspecting, cleansing, transforming, and modeling data to discover useful information, draw conclusions, and support decision-making
* Machine Learning Pipelines: Using automated workflows that manage the end-to-end process of training and deploying machine learning models.
* Model Deployment: Making a trained machine learning model available for use in production environments.

**Required skills:**
**Architecture and system design**

* Has designed and delivered systems that multiple teams build on, and has lived with the consequences of those decisions.
* Strong command of distributed systems fundamentals, including partitioning, consistency models, delivery guarantees, backpressure and schema evolution.
* Designs for the non-functional requirements from the start: reliability, recovery, latency, cost, security and operability.
* Has migrated live systems to a new architecture while keeping them running.
* Writes design documents that another engineer can build from without further explanation.

**Data engineering**

* Platform-level design of table formats and catalogs, covering Iceberg, Delta Lake or Hudi, along with partitioning, clustering, compaction and file layout strategy.
* Both batch and streaming architectures, including change data capture and event-driven ingestion.
* Transformation frameworks at scale, such as dbt, together with semantic layer design.
* Data modelling depth sufficient to set standards that other teams follow.
* Performance and cost tuning at platform level, including query engines, storage layout and compute sizing.
* Multi-tenant governance, data quality frameworks and lineage.

**Software engineering**

* Deep expertise in at least one language and working fluency in others.
* Service and API design, including versioning, backwards compatibility and contract management across teams.
* Observability as a design concern: instrumentation, tracing, structured logging and meaningful alerting.
* Infrastructure as code using Terraform, Bicep or equivalent, and container orchestration with Kubernetes.
* Security practice covering authentication, authorisation, secrets management and data protection.
* Front-end capability sufficient to build a usable interface when a product needs one.

**AI and agentic engineering**

* Expert-level use of agentic coding tools. You work through agents for a large share of your output and can explain your harness, your context strategy, how you run work in parallel and how you keep quality high.
* Has built tooling that extends what agents can do, such as MCP servers, custom skills, spec-driven workflows or evaluation harnesses.
* Has taken large language model systems to production, covering retrieval design, structured output, tool calling, evaluation, guardrails, cost and latency management, and human review where it belongs.
* Clear judgement on where a model belongs in a system and where deterministic code is the better answer.
* Sets the standard for how generated code is reviewed and how agentic work is verified.

**Open source**

* Meaningful exposure to open source, whether through contributions to established projects, maintaining a project with real users, or substantial public work of your own.
* Familiarity with the open standards in this space and a considered view on interoperability.
* Public artefacts such as repositories, technical writing or conference talks are a strong signal.

We would be interested to understand from you genuine depth in a minimum two or three of above areas and strong working command across the rest.
  
  
**What makes you a strong candidate?**
Demonstrated work carries the most weight in this role. The strongest candidates can point to systems they designed and built that are running in production, and can explain the decisions behind them, including the ones they would make differently now.
  
  
Additional indicators of a strong fit:
  
  

* A track record as a Staff, Principal or Lead engineer who remained hands-on, or as an architect who still writes and deploys code.
* Experience being the technical anchor on a platform or product that other teams depended on.
* A public body of work: an active GitHub profile with substantial projects, open source contributions, technical writing or talks.
* Has introduced a significant technical change into an organisation and carried it through to adoption.
* Comfort moving between architectural thinking and detailed implementation within the same week.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
  
  
We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: A.I Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer**

*iRONic Ventures | Kochi Office (No Remote/Hybrid) | Full-Time | 2 Openings*

**The Role**

We're looking for two AI Engineers to build AI features into a production SaaS product used by customers and businesses in Europe. You'll work in TypeScript across the stack, connecting LLMs and generative models to a real application: designing prompts and structured outputs, building evaluations and tests around them, and keeping AI suggestions inside the guard rails of validated business logic. This is a product engineering role, not a research or model-training role. We build with AI coding agents every day and expect you to do the same. The role suits engineers with 2-5 years of experience.

**What You'll Do**

* **AI Features:** Design and build LLM-powered features end to end, from prompt and structured output to API, UI, and tests
* **Generative Media:** Integrate image-generation and image-editing models, and measure output quality, latency, and cost per result
* **Guard Rails:** Treat AI output as a proposal that deterministic, validated code checks before anything reaches the user
* **Evaluation:** Build evaluation sets and automated checks so prompt and model changes are compared on evidence, not guessed
* **Data Integration:** Import, map, and validate structured data from external partners, using AI where it saves manual work
* **Configuration Tooling:** Build tools that let non-technical admins configure business rules safely
* **Production:** Add logging and monitoring around expensive AI calls, and troubleshoot and fix production issues
* **AI-Assisted Development:** Use coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) daily, with the test discipline that keeps their output trustworthy

* **LLM Engineering:** OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, schema validation (e.g. Zod), tool calling
* **Evaluation & Testing:** Automated tests and evals for code that depends on non-deterministic model output
* **Data:** PostgreSQL, data modelling, and working with messy external data

* **A European quality bar:** Build for customers in Germany and across Europe, where privacy, multi-language support, and reliability are expected from day one

**Job Description**

You will define and implement the end-to-end security architecture for Databricks on a major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This is a hands-on role responsible for the access, governance, and data-protection model across the platform. You have designed and implemented enterprise security controls for Databricks environments, and you will act as a cross-account authority on security guardrails, access governance, and compliance.

What You Will Do

**Own end-to-end security architecture.** Define and implement the security architecture for Databricks across the platform, from identity through data protection.

**Manage identity and access.** Own SSO/MFA integration and RBAC/ABAC access models, and establish access governance processes across accounts and workspaces.

**Secure Unity Catalog.** Design and enforce Unity Catalog security, data classification, and fine-grained access controls (row, column, and attribute level).

**Secure Delta Sharing and open sharing.** Ensure only approved data is exposed across cross-account and open sharing, with reliable, measurable revocation.

**Design least privilege and blast-radius containment.** Establish the lowest practical access boundary, preventing access to adjacent business-unit data and storage.

**Control privileged access and configuration drift.** Govern privileged elevation and break-glass access, and detect unauthorized changes with monitored alert latency and remediation.

**Protect data and secrets.** Establish controls for encryption, secrets management, and network security aligned to relevant regulatory compliance requirements.

**Build guardrails and auditability.** Set up security guardrails, auditability, and access governance so the platform stays compliant and controllable as it scales.

**Provide cross-account technical leadership.** Act as a go-to security reviewer across multiple accounts, contributing to design reviews and resolving access and governance issues that individual delivery teams cannot.

What You Bring (Required)

Hands-on experience designing and implementing security for enterprise Databricks environments.

Deep Unity Catalog security experience: RBAC/ABAC, fine-grained (row/column/attribute) access, data classification, and Delta Sharing / open sharing controls.

Least-privilege and blast-radius design across business units, containing access to adjacent data and storage.

Privileged access management experience: controlled elevation, break-glass, configuration-drift detection, and remediation.

Strong identity and access management background: SSO/MFA integration and access governance.

Expertise in encryption, secrets management, and network security on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements relevant to data platforms.

Ability to design and run proof-of-control tests and quantify outcomes (e.g., revocation time, data exposure, drift-detection and alert latency), not just implement.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

Databricks Cloud Platform Architect accreditation (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or Databricks Platform Administrator.

Recognized cloud security certification (e.g., AWS or Azure security specialty, or CISSP). Note that Databricks has no standalone security certification, so security credentials come from the cloud provider or an industry body.

Multi-cloud experience across two or more of AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Regulated-industry experience (financial services, healthcare, or similar).

What This Role Is Not

This is a Databricks-native security and access architect role. It is not a general enterprise or datacenter security role. The right candidate has genuinely designed and implemented access, governance, and data-protection controls inside Databricks environments, distinct from a generalist security engineer without hands-on Databricks depth.

description:

**Position Summary**

title: Sr. Analyst, Implementation
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary — The Why Now**
As Avalara scales its Go Live function to support New Product Introductions (NPI) and enterprise-level customer growth, we need Senior Analysts who do more than execute — they lead, design, and elevate. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) operates at the intersection of complex enterprise implementation delivery, cross-functional product collaboration, and practice development.
  
  
Where the I3 Analyst owns individual customer implementation success, the I3 Senior Analyst owns the quality and scalability of how implementations are delivered — for the most complex customers, across new and evolving products, and in close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  
  
This role exists to accelerate Avalara's ability to onboard enterprise customers at scale, introduce new products effectively, and continuously raise the implementation standard across the Go Live team. The I3 is a force multiplier: their impact is felt not just in their own portfolio, but in the capability and quality of the broader team.
  
  
How This Role Elevates Avalara
  
  

* For customers: Enterprise and multi-product customers receive expert implementation guidance, proactive risk management, and deep technical partnership — resulting in faster time-to-value and stronger long-term adoption.
* For the team: The Senior Analyst sets the implementation quality standard — authoring playbooks, mentoring I3 analysts, and identifying process improvements that raise team-wide performance.
* For the business: Directly supports ARR growth by enabling complex enterprise wins, supporting the sales cycle with pre-sales expertise, and accelerating NPI readiness across implementation teams.
* For our AI-first strategy: Designs and deploys AI-driven implementation workflows at a team level — moving beyond personal productivity to scalable automation that benefits the entire Go Live function.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Enterprise & Multi-Product Implementation Leadership**

* Lead customer implementations involving multiple Avalara products and enterprise-level platforms including complex ERP, POS, and ecommerce environments (e.g., NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce, SAP).
* Act as the primary implementation authority for high-complexity, high-stakes customer engagements — setting strategy, managing scope, and driving outcomes from kickoff to Go Live.
* Clearly define, articulate, and manage scope of work for client-initiated implementation and data service projects, including change management when scope evolves.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Enablement**

* Partner with Avalara Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop implementation approach documentation, onboarding frameworks, and training materials for new product launches.
* Serve as a subject matter expert during NPI cycles — identifying implementation risks, documenting configuration requirements, and ensuring Go Live readiness before product release.
* Identify bugs, integration gaps, or UX friction during NPI implementations and partner with Engineering to track and resolve them.

**Practice Development & Quality Elevation**

* Own and evolve Go Live practice standards — documenting business processes, designing implementation playbooks, and proposing best practices for sales and use tax automation onboarding.
* Develop and document business requirements related to implementation workflows, data transformation, and cross-system reporting.
* Lead testing plan design and execution for complex implementations, ensuring customers go live on validated, stable configurations.
* Mentor and provide structured guidance to I2 Analysts — reviewing implementation quality, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of junior team members.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support pre-sales activities — including scoping, solution design input, and customer-facing technical presentations.
* Engage cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance to resolve systemic implementation blockers and drive process improvements at scale.
* Represent the Go Live team's perspective in strategic planning discussions, NPI readiness reviews, and cross-departmental initiatives.

**Customer Success & Risk Management**

* Monitor project health across assigned accounts — proactively identifying risk factors, intervening early, and resolving escalations with speed and precision.
* Provide strategic guidance to customers on best practices and use cases across a range of business models and tax compliance needs.
* Support customers in developing and executing testing plans, ensuring technical readiness before Go Live.

**AI-Driven Practice Scaling**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows at a team level — building reusable Glean AI agents, prompt libraries, and automation tools that improve implementation quality and speed across the Go Live function.

**Bar Raiser Expectation**
At Avalara, We Hire Only Those Who Raise The Bar — Not Those Who Merely Meet It. A Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) Who Is a Bar Raiser
  
  

* Improves the average performance of the team simply by being present — through coaching, example, and a consistent commitment to quality.
