* Continuously develops technical, functional, and AI capabilities — and actively helps peers do the same.
* Demonstrates strong judgment in tradeoff decisions, especially when they affect customers, timelines, or team capacity.

Being a Bar Raiser at the I3 level means raising the entire team's execution quality — not just excelling individually.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**

title: Principal Engineering Analyst
description:
**Job Description**

* As a Principal Engineering Analyst, you will provide deep technical leadership within SURF (Subsea Umbilicals, Risers, and Flowlines) domain, leading large and complex multi-disciplinary projects while independently making high-impact engineering decisions and recognizing when to engage senior leadership. This role is critical to Oceaneering’s delivery and growth strategy, acting as a single point of contact for assigned business units, influencing functional strategy, mentoring engineers and SMEs, and driving continuous improvement in engineering quality, processes, and customer value.
* We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement, enabling effective collaboration with global stakeholders while maintaining flexibility for focused technical leadership and strategic contribution across projects and functions.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally, as required, to support multi-disciplinary project oversight, customer and business unit interactions, and enterprise-level technical initiatives.

**Responsibilities**
**Needs to perform following activities:**

* Lead a team of Engineering Analysts subsea SURF engineers on dynamic analysis of flexible flowlines .
* Lead multiple projects at the same time, including large and complex multi-disciplinary projects.
* Direct teams of SURF engineers to enable them handle dynamic analysis projects effectively .
* Review work carried out by SURF engineers .
* Approve deliveries made by the team.
* Ensure compliance to established engineering processes.
* Define functional processes and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as account manager for one or more business units for subsea SURF projects.
* Communicate with business units to understand design and analysis requirements.
* Define scope of work, plan jobs, allocate resources, and share regular progress updates.
* Monitor performance against relevant KPIs and identify growth opportunities.
* Participate in governance meetings with business units.
* Approve engineering process documents and team timesheets.
* Prepare and conduct technical trainings.
* Maintain performance records and support performance management activities.
* Develop competency matrices and identify training needs.
* Provide engineering guidance to other disciplines.
* Keep abreast of industry trends and issues.
* Evaluate resource needs and provide recommendations.
* Work towards organizational objectives and ensure team members accomplish performance goals.
* Comply with HR, HSE, and organizational policies and procedures.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Safety**
Ensure that the Safety policies and procedures are understood and adhered to so far as is reasonably practicable in order to ensure a safe working environment.
  
  
**Other**

* Carry out work in accordance with the Company Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality Systems.
* Perform assigned tasks with due diligence regarding the Integrated Management Systems of the Company.
* Eliminate waste, promote environmentally friendly practices, and contribute to continuous environmental improvement.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
This position may be required to lead a team of Engineers / Engineering Analysts.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience:**

* Post Graduation (Master's degree) in Mechanical/Civil/Ocean/ Naval Architecture/ Subsea (or related) Engineering with minimum 8 years of relevant industry experience, OR
* Graduation (Bachelor's degree) in Mechanical/Ocean/ Naval Architecture/ Subsea (or related) Engineering with minimum 10 years of relevant industry experience.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, And Other Characteristics**

* Expert level knowledge of FEA and SURF Local and Global Analysis using relevant CAE software (e.g., OrcaFlex, UFlex, ANSYS, RISA, Sesam).
* Strong knowledge of multiple applicable industry codes and standards (ASME, DNV, API, AISC, etc.).
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Communication skills.
* Teamwork and interpersonal skills.
* Analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Organizing and planning skills.
* Team building, coaching and mentoring skills.
* Leadership abilities.

**About Us**
Oceaneering is a global provider of engineered services and products, primarily to the offshore energy industry. We develop products and services for use throughout the lifecycle of an offshore oilfield, from drilling to decommissioning. We operate the world's premier fleet of work class ROVs. Additionally, we are a leader in offshore oilfield maintenance services, umbilicals, subsea hardware, and tooling. We also use applied technology expertise to serve the defense, material handling, aerospace, science, and renewable energy industries.
  
  
**Overview**
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
Since year 2003, Oceaneering’s India Center has been an integral part of operations for Oceaneering’s robust product and service offerings across the globe. This center caters to diverse business needs, from oil and gas field infrastructure, subsea robotics to automated material handling & logistics.
  
  
Our multidisciplinary team offers a wide spectrum of solutions, encompassing Subsea Engineering, Robotics, Automation, Control Systems, Software Development, Asset Integrity Management, Inspection, ROV operations, Field Network Management, Graphics Design & Animation, and more.
  
  
In addition to these technical functions, Oceaneering India Center plays host to several crucial business functions, including Finance, Supply Chain Management (SCM), Information Technology (IT), Human Resources (HR), and Health, Safety & Environment (HSE).
  
  
Our world class infrastructure in India includes modern offices, industry-leading tools and software, equipped labs, and beautiful campuses aligned with the future way of work. Oceaneering in India as well as globally has a great work culture that is flexible, transparent, and collaborative with great team synergy.
  
  
At Oceaneering India Center, we take pride in “Solving the Unsolvable” by leveraging the diverse expertise within our team. Join us in shaping the future of technology and engineering solutions on a global scale.

title: Team Lead - MV
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. Rockwell Automation is the world's largest company dedicated to industrial automation and digital transformation. We connect the imaginations of people with the potential of technology to expand what is humanly possible, making the world more productive and more sustainable. Our Global Engineering & Business Services (GEBS) group in India partners with Rockwell Automation offices worldwide to deliver world-class engineering.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a
**Team Lead – Medium Voltage**
you will be responsible to lead a team of application/electrical engineers engaged in the engineering of Medium Voltage (MV) Motor Control Center (MCCs), Switchgear and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), customizing as per customer requirement utilizing the AutoCAD tools, while providing engineering support to the manufacturing plants of RA. This role reports to the Engineering Manager and is part of Global Engineering & Business Services group in India, catering to regional Rockwell Automation offices across the globe. It's a hybrid work environment working in 12:00pm to 9:00 pm shift located in Pune/Noida - India.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor and develop a team of MV application/electrical engineers – allocating and prioritizing work, managing workload and ensuring on-time delivery, high quality engineering and customer satisfaction
* Manage day-to-day execution of CTO/ETO projects within defined timelines, ensuring high quality engineering while leveraging standard and reusable engineering practices
* Serve as the technical escalation point and subject-matter expert for MV products (MV MCCs, MV Switchgear, MV Drives), providing robust technical solutions, addressing queries and resolving technical deficiencies
* Work closely with internal and external customers, and collaborate with global stakeholders across regions and time zones, to review requirements and deliver customized technical solutions that comply with electrical standards and Rockwell Automation's engineering practices
* Coordinate overall system integration activities, maintaining accurate documentation and fostering effective collaboration across teams and functions
* Drive capability development, continuous improvement and knowledge-sharing within the team – coaching engineers, building technical depth and supporting other initiatives
* Monitor team performance, quality metrics, resource utilization and project KPIs, reporting progress and risks to the Execution Manager
* Ensure strict adherence to international engineering standards (NEC, UL, CSA, IEC) by consistently applying them throughout order execution activities

**The Essentials – You Will Have**

* Bachelor's in Electrical / Electronics
* Relevant Experience of more than 8-10 years in Hardware Designing for Medium Voltage MCC / Switchgear, Electrical knowledge and Automation Engineering
* Minimum 3 years of experience in leading and managing an engineering team
* Exposure of working in a global setup – collaborating with global stakeholders, customers and cross-functional teams across regions and time zones
* Strong domain expertise in Medium Voltage Drives, PLC & MCC System Designing
* Expertise of AutoCAD-Electrical software
* Thorough knowledge of DOL & S/D Starters, VFDs, Soft-Starters, Intelligent Motor Control, Safety Product's System Designing
* Knowledge of Electrical Components Selection, Busbar Calculation, Heat and Load Calculation
* In depth knowledge of International Standards used for Design and Manufacturing

**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**

* Field Installation & Commissioning experience on MV VFDs, MV Switchgear, PCC's, MCC's, PLC's & Instruments is preferrable
* Gone through complete project life cycle from design phase to commissioning
* Proven people-leadership skills – team building, mentoring, performance management and workload planning
* Good Command on SAP Documentation and Part Management
* Industry and application Knowledge, training skills, and familiar with Lean Six Sigma and EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) Principles.
* Experience with Creo software
* Experience on Panel Testing, I/O Testing and FAT
* Experience of managing or coordinating deliverables across a global / distributed engineering team is preferrable

**What We Offer**
Our benefits package includes …
  
  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
* Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation
* Employee Assistance Program
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
* On-demand digital course library for professional development
* and other local benefits!

**Equal Opportunity & Inclusion**
At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.
  
  
Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
* 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
* 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
* 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.

**About The Job**
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.
  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.
  
  
The AI and Infrastructure team works on the world’s toughest problems, redefining what’s possible and the possible easy. We empower Google customers by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Googler Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We’re at the center of amazing work at Google by being the “flywheel” that enables our advanced AI models, delivers computing power across global services, and offers platforms that developers use to build services.
  
  
In AI and Infrastructure, we shape the future of hyperscale computing by inventing and creating world-leading future technology, and drive global impact by contributing to Google infrastructure, from software to hardware (including building Vertex AI for Google Cloud). * Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams.

title: System Software Manager - Power Profiling and Infrastructure
description:
NVIDIA is a global leader in accelerated computing, powering breakthroughs in AI, graphics, autonomous vehicles, and scientific simulation.
  
  
Inside NVIDIA, the Software Power Profiling team is the power measurement authority for our most strategic platforms — RTX Spark, DGX Spark, discrete GPU desktop and notebook, and data center. The team measures power and performance-per-watt, qualifies power targets, co-engineers battery life with OEMs, runs nightly regression farms across the device fleet, and builds the profiling infrastructure — frameworks, analytics dashboards, and automated regression farms — that the rest of NVIDIA relies on to understand and optimize power.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Lead, grow, and mentor a cross-site team of power and infrastructure engineers across Pune and Bangalore — setting individual and team roadmaps, development plans, and clear ownership across all mandates.
* Drive the team's power profiling authority across the full product lifecycle: pre-silicon power engagement, power target qualification, regression monitoring, battery-life validation, and external software release qualification — including nightly development-branch and release-branch power and perf/watt monitoring across discrete GPU and data-center platforms.
* Own the physical lab — run a temperature-controlled, instrumented measurement lab across two sites, covering DUT fleet management, board procurement, intake and logistics, board instrumentation and rework, DAQ and power-path integrity, rack build-out, and cross-geo capacity planning.
* Shape measurability from pre-silicon through production — engage pre-silicon to challenge power modelling assumptions and establish measurement confidence levels; drive instrumented boards, rail maps, on-board sensors, and DAQ adapter design; specify, track, and escalate measurement prerequisites (telemetry, software build, validation, and agreed power targets with guard band policy), holding the requirement and escalating when it slips.
* Close power gaps and own release readiness — quantify and attribute power gaps to rail, IP, feature, and residency; drive debug and optimization alongside software and hardware power owners through experiments and recovery confirmation; deliver the power verdict that feeds program go/no-go decisions, backed by qualification data on every external software drop.
* Lead cross-company power engagement — converge measurement methodology and tooling with OEMs and software power owners; co-engineer shared battery-life targets, conduct joint root-cause analysis where measurements diverge, and maintain a common bug-and-analysis stream.
* Own the team's infrastructure portfolio and energy compliance — drive the in-house power profiling framework, power analytics dashboard, and automated power regression farm as production-grade shared assets; deliver energy-regulation compliance evidence (idle, standby, and off-mode power) required to clear product release gates.

What we need to see
  
  

* BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 8+ years of overall industry experience.
* 5+ years of engineering management experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex software and infrastructure at velocity across distributed teams.
* Deep background in power systems, computer architecture, and SoC/platform power — with hands-on experience in power measurement, analysis, or power-stack debugging.
* Experience running or closely supporting a hardware measurement lab — instrumentation, device fleet, and the logistics that keep it productive.
* Demonstrated ability to engage across the full program lifecycle — from pre-silicon power modeling through bring-up, qualification, and post-commercialization sustaining.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to operate across engineering teams, program management, partner labs, OEM customers, and executive stakeholders.
* Commitment to measurement quality and the defensibility of data that drives product decisions.

Ways to stand out from the crowd
  
  

* Hands-on power profiling experience — DAQ-based external rail capture, on-board sensor validation, or telemetry-driven regression root cause.
* Intimate knowledge of Windows on Arm or client SoC platforms — battery-life scenario methodology, Modern Standby measurement, or energy-efficiency regulatory compliance.
* Experience leading silicon bring-up power profiling — firmware sensor validation, first-power baselines, and bring-up-phase engagement with hardware teams.
* Track record of building or leading power regression infrastructure or automated test/analysis pipelines at scale.
* Experience with AI/agentic workflow development applied to lab automation, failure triage, or report generation.
* Prior cross-company lab convergence work — aligning methodology, build synchronization, and shared tooling between two or more power or validation labs.

2. Strong technical background in order to communicate effectively with Network Engineers
  
3. Experience in leading projects, preferably global projects
  
4. Experience with audits and/or compliance assessments/monitoring
  
5. PMI, CISSP, CISM, CISA a plus
  
6. Ability to operate in a fast-paced global environment
  
7. Ability to work under pressure, meet tight deadlines and embrace change
  
8. Ability to communicate clearly to various levels of management (including executive management), across various business functions (including engineering)

In line with our commitment to quality, you will consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives.

  

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced Manager (Validation/Tester – Veeva) to lead validation, testing activities and compliance across various Veeva modules, regulated and business critical computerized systems for global pharmaceutical clients. The ideal candidate will ensure compliance with global regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, MHRA) and drive strategic initiatives for business process transformation and operational excellence.

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead CSA/CSV strategy in collaboration with Governance and risk-based validation approach for the Veeva Vault platform, balancing modern CSA principles (critical thinking, risk-based test coverage) with CSV rigor where required for specific vaults/regulatory contexts.

* Support internal/external audits and health authority inspections — act as the platform's validation SME during inspection readiness and response.
* Partner with QA/Change Management to ensure Change Control records carry appropriate validation justification and evidence.
* Stay current on evolving CSA guidance (e.g., FDA's CSA draft guidance) and industry practice, advising the CoE on policy updates.

  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Biotechnology, Engineering, or related field.
* 8+ years in CSV within the pharmaceutical, life sciences or consulting organizations.
* Comfortable working with distributed teams across India, Prague, and US time zones.
Strong influencing skills to drive practice change (CSV* CSA) across a delivery team that includes multiple other vendor roles.

  

**Must-Have Skills & Attributes**

* Experience in Computer System Validation, with demonstrated leadership transitioning teams from traditional CSV to CSA practices.

* Experience defining risk-based testing/validation strategies that reduce documentation/testing burden without compromising compliance.
* Experience validating cloud/SaaS platforms (Veeva Vault experience strongly preferred) in a GxP environment.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections/audits as a validation SME.
* Strong stakeholder influencing skills — this role must drive adoption of CSA thinking across delivery teams (Configuration, Integration, QA) who may default to legacy CSV habits.
* Experience partnering with QA/Test Automation teams to align risk assessments with automated test coverage decisions.
* Strong project management, problem solving and communication skills
* Apply structured and analytical thinking to improve delivery efficiency and client outcomes.

  

**Good-to-Have Skills & Attributes**

* Prior experience specifically validating Veeva Vault implementations (any vault — Clinical, RIM, QMS, Safety, Medical, CRM).
* Experience building or updating an organization's CSA policy/SOP framework.
* Experience with Veeva Vault QMS/QualityDocs as the vehicle for validation documentation.
* ISPE GAMP 5 training/certification
* High attention to detail and analytical thinking.
* Familiarity with emerging regulatory trends, such as CSA or digital validation approaches.
* Adaptability to changing regulatory and business environments.

  

**Preferred Certifications**

* Certified Software Quality Engineer (CSQE), Certified Software Quality Assurance (CSQA)
* Information Security or Risk Management certifications.
* Any Veeva Quality certification.

  

**What we look for**

* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.

**What working at EY offers**

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. title: AI Agent Development Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**In this Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**
In this role, you will help shape the future of intelligent engineering and power plant operations by developing hands-on AI/ML and agent-based solutions that simplify engineering work, increase productivity, and unlock new operational capabilities.
  
  
You will build intelligent tools and AI agents that automate control logic generation, graphics configuration, reporting, and engineering workflows, enabling plant engineers to focus on higher-value innovation. By analyzing control system and operational data, you will uncover patterns, develop predictive capabilities, and deliver data-driven decision support for real-world power plant environments.
  
  

* Apply AI-based anomaly detection, diagnostics, and decision-support solutions to real power-plant operational challenges.
* Translate plant operating behavior, control logic, alarms, and historian trends into practical AI use cases and agent workflows.
* Work with time-series operational data from DCS/SCADA and plant historians (preferably Emerson Ovation) to identify abnormal patterns, degradation, and performance losses.
* Collaborate with sales and marketing,and reliability teams to validate AI insights against real plant conditions.
* Support development and tuning of AI/analytics models using Python and data tools (focus on application rather than algorithm research).
* Integrate AI outputs into dashboards, alerts, and engineering workflows without impacting plant safety or control integrity.
* Test, validate, and monitor AI solutions in live or near-real plant environments, ensuring reliability and low false-alarm rates.
* Continuously improve AI performance using operational feedback, historical fault data, and domain knowledge.
* Troubleshoot deployed analytics/AI tools and coordinate improvements with software or data teams.

**Who you Are:**
We are looking for a proactive professional who excels in dynamic, fast-paced environments. You demonstrate exceptional initiative, confidently tackling complex challenges in power plant control and optimization. With a strong commitment to innovation and excellence, you set ambitious goals and uphold the highest standards in every project.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Control Systems, Power Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 2–8 years of experience in coal-fired, combined-cycle, or utility power plants with strong knowledge of plant operations, control processes, and performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience with DCS platforms, preferably Emerson Ovation, including control logic, alarm management, plant monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of power plant systems such as boilers, turbines, generators, combustion controls, and balance-of-plant operations.
* Experience developing AI-powered applications using Python, including data processing, API integration, and workflow automation.
* Knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI Agent frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or similar.
* Ability to translate power plant operational knowledge and procedures into AI Agent use cases and intelligent automation solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across operations, engineering, and software development teams.

**Preferred Qualifications That Make You Stand Out:**

* Experience with Emerson Ovation DCS or other power plant control systems (ABB, Honeywell, Siemens, GE, Yokogawa).
* Hands-on experience developing AI Agents, operator assistants, troubleshooting tools, or knowledge management solutions for industrial applications.
* Knowledge of machine learning, predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, and time-series analytics.
* Familiarity with vector databases, cloud AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and industrial data integration.
* Passion for applying AI and automation technologies to improve power plant operations, reliability, and performance.

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
  
  
We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing flexible, competitive benefits plans to meet you and your family’s physical, mental, financial, and social needs. We provide a variety of medical insurance plans, with dental and vision coverage, Employee Assistance Program, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**
At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

description:

* Evaluate and implement design patterns for fault tolerance, high availability, and horizontal scalability.
* Collaborate with product managers, data architects, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into system-level designs and technical roadmaps.
* Conduct architectural reviews and provide engineering guidance to ensure alignment with strategic technology vision.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery**

* Lead the technical strategy, operational excellence, and professional delivery across multiple domains in Clearwater.

title: GCP DevOps Manager – Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

DevOps Manager – Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

Role Summary

We are looking for a DevOps Manager to own the reliability, observability, and cost

efficiency of our applications on Google Cloud Platform. The role covers end-to-end

responsibility for application usage monitoring, cloud cost management (FinOps), CI/CD

pipeline setup and governance, centralized logging, and billing oversight. You will lead a

team of DevOps/Cloud engineers and work closely with application development, security,

and infrastructure teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Application & Usage Monitoring

* Design and implement monitoring for application health, performance, and usage using

Google Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus/Grafana, or equivalent tools.

* Define and track SLIs/SLOs, uptime, latency, error rates, and capacity utilization across

environments.

* Build dashboards for application usage trends (API call volumes, transaction

throughput, active users) for engineering and business stakeholders.

* Set up proactive alerting (Cloud Monitoring alerts, PagerDuty/Opsgenie integration) and

drive reduction of alert noise.

* Conduct capacity planning and performance reviews based on usage data.

2. Cloud Cost Management & FinOps

* Own GCP cost visibility: set up cost dashboards by project, service, environment, and

team using GCP Billing reports, BigQuery billing export, and Looker Studio.

* Implement labeling/tagging standards for accurate cost attribution and

chargeback/showback.

* Identify and drive cost-optimization initiatives: rightsizing VMs/GKE nodes, committed

use discounts (CUDs), spot/preemptible instances, storage lifecycle policies, and idleresource

cleanup.

* Set up budgets, alerts, and quotas to prevent cost overruns; publish monthly cost

review reports with variance analysis.

* Forecast cloud spend and support annual budgeting for cloud infrastructure.

3. CI/CD Setup & Governance

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Cloud Build, GitHub Actions, GitLab

CI, or Jenkins, deploying to GKE, Cloud Run, App Engine, or Compute Engine.

* Standardize build, test, security-scan, and deployment stages across teams

(SAST/DAST, container image scanning, artifact management via Artifact Registry).

* Implement deployment strategies: blue-green, canary, and rollback automation.
* Enforce Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred) with code review and drift

detection.

* Manage environment promotion workflows (Dev → QA → UAT → Prod) with appropriate

approvals and audit trails.

4. Logging & Observability Setup

* Architect centralized logging using Cloud Logging with log sinks, routing, retention

policies, and export to BigQuery/Cloud Storage for long-term analysis.

* Define structured logging standards for application teams and ensure adoption.
* Set up log-based metrics and alerts for security and operational events.
* Ensure log retention and access controls meet compliance and audit requirements.
* Integrate logs with SIEM tooling where required.

5. Billing Administration

* Administer GCP billing accounts, projects, and IAM around billing (Billing Admin/Viewer

roles).

* Reconcile monthly GCP invoices against usage; coordinate with Finance on accruals and

payments.

* Manage billing account hierarchy, project-to-billing mapping, and sub-account

structures for multiple business units.

* Liaise with Google/partner account teams on pricing, credits, CUD purchases, and

support plans.

6. Team Leadership & Governance

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of DevOps/Cloud engineers; manage on-call rotations

and incident response processes.

* Define runbooks, SOPs, and DR/backup procedures; drive post-incident reviews (RCA)

with corrective actions.

* Partner with Security/InfoSec on IAM hygiene, VPC/network controls, and audit

readiness.

* Report DevOps KPIs (deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, change failure rate, cost

per transaction) to leadership.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent.
* 4+ years of hands-on GCP experience: GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud Run, Cloud Build,

Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, IAM, VPC, and BigQuery (billing export/analysis).

* Strong experience with CI/CD tooling (Cloud Build, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub

Actions) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/GKE).

* Proven track record in cloud cost optimization / FinOps practices on GCP.
* Infrastructure as Code expertise — Terraform strongly preferred.
* Scripting proficiency: Python, Bash, or Go.
* Experience setting up centralized logging, monitoring, and alerting at scale.
* Experience managing GCP billing accounts and working with Finance teams.
* 2+ years leading or mentoring a DevOps/SRE team.

Preferred / Good to Have

* GCP certifications: Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, Professional Cloud Architect, or

FinOps Certified Practitioner.

* Experience in regulated environments (BFSI/GovTech) with audit, compliance, and

data-residency requirements.

* Exposure to multi-cloud or hybrid setups.
* Familiarity with service mesh (Istio/Anthos Service Mesh), secrets management (Secret

Manager/Vault), and policy-as-code (OPA).

* Experience with SIEM integration and security monitoring.

Key Performance Indicators (First 12 Months)

* 99.9%+ availability against defined SLOs for critical applications.
* 15–20% reduction in GCP spend through optimization initiatives (baseline-dependent).
* CI/CD pipelines standardized across all active product teams with < 1 day lead time for

changes.

* Centralized logging live for all production workloads with compliant retention.
* Monthly cost and usage reporting operational with < 5% unexplained invoice variance.

Pay: ₹1,500,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: AI/ML Lead
description:
Kody Technolab Limited is seeking a Lead AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, and deploy cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, MLOps, and cloud-based AI deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and deploy machine learning and deep learning models for classification, regression, recommendation, NLP, computer vision, and/or generative AI tasks.
* Build end-to-end ML pipelines: data preprocessing, model training, validation, evaluation, and deployment.
* Implement state-of-the-art algorithms using frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar.
* Conduct experiments with LLMs and foundation models (e.g., GPT, BERT, Stable Diffusion, etc.).
* Collaborate with data engineers, product teams, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into ML solutions.
* Optimize model performance and scalability for production environments.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest research and developments in AI/ML/DL/Generative AI.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field.
* Experience in machine learning, deep learning, or AI product development.
* Proficiency in Python and ML libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, etc.
* Experience working with generative models (GANs, VAEs, diffusion models, or LLMs).
* Strong understanding of ML model lifecycle: training, tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
* Experience with MLOps tools (e.g., MLflow, Docker, Kubeflow) is a plus.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is preferred.
* Basic understanding of web development and APIs for integrating ML models into applications.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience with prompt engineering or fine-tuning large language models.
* Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or relevant publications.
* Exposure to data annotation, feature engineering, and model interpretability tools.
* Proficiency in C++ for performance optimization, model deployment, or systems-level programming in AI/ML applications.

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Senior Manager, Finance is a senior management role, accountable for managing various financial activities within the organization.  
  
This role involves overseeing financial planning, analysis, reporting and ensuring the organization's financial health and compliance with relevant regulations.  
  
This role is responsible for providing operational support to business stakeholders on matters pertaining to financial management and operational implementation.

Data is at the heart of every great people decision, and in this role, you will be the guardian of that data. As an HR Business Data Steward, you will ensure the quality, consistency, and integrity of employee data across HR systems and connected downstream applications. **Education:**

title: Software Licence Compliance Intelligence Manager
description:
**Role overview**

We are seeking a highly analytical, commercially minded and results-driven
**Software Licence Compliance Intelligence Manager**
to join our Global Licence Compliance team.

This role is suited to a data analyst with a strong understanding of software licence compliance and the ability to turn intelligence into well-founded investigative and commercial decisions. The successful candidate will analyse data gathered through software intelligence and monitoring tools—including platforms such as Revenera and Cylynt—to identify, assess and prioritise potential non-compliance and infringement opportunities.

The role requires more than producing analysis or reports. The analyst will assess the reliability and significance of available information, use sound judgement to determine appropriate next steps, and identify opportunities that can support business development and market expansion. This includes working with relevant stakeholders to decide which leads warrant further investigation, escalation or commercial follow-up.

The successful candidate will play a central role in managing and interpreting software piracy data collected through our monitoring technologies, identifying potential copyright infringements and transforming technical information into actionable Licence Compliance opportunities.

Our mission is to reduce non-compliant software use by proactively addressing infringements while fostering constructive engagement with businesses to create opportunities for the future.

**Key responsibilities**

***Data Analysis & Intelligence***

* Manage, process, analyse and interpret large volumes of software usage and piracy-related data collected through different monitoring technologies.
* Perform data cleaning, processing, and validation to improve investigation accuracy
* Use and interpret intelligence gathered through software monitoring and compliance tools, including Revenera and Cylynt, or comparable platforms.
* Conduct OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence) research to gather evidence on infringement cases.
* Maintain accurate records of investigations and compliance cases.
* Use data visualisation and business intelligence tools to identify trends, monitor performance and communicate findings.
* Identify patterns, anomalies, leads and market signals that may indicate potential non-compliance or reveal opportunities for further investigation and business development.

***Opportunity Validation & Commercial Assessment***

* Investigate and validate potential software piracy cases by assessing the quality, reliability and relevance of technical and other available evidence.
* Evaluate & validate opportunities based on commercial potential, market conditions, enforcement feasibility and relevant compliance or reputational considerations.
* Use sound judgement to prioritise leads and recommend whether they should be pursued, investigated further, referred for legal or compliance review, or closed.
* Identify evidence gaps and specify what additional information or validation is required; communicate recommendations and potential business value to business-development, sales and other relevant stakeholders.

***Project Management & Operational Improvement***

* Manage relationships with technology providers and other external partners involved in data collection and investigation.
* Support the development and implementation of new technologies and automated workflows to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the Licence Compliance Program.
* Monitor operational performance, identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
* Help assess the usefulness, accuracy and operational value of intelligence tools and data sources and recommend improvements where appropriate.

***Collaboration & Reporting***

* Collaborate with global sales teams, legal representatives and other internal stakeholders to support Licence Compliance activities and decisions.
* Develop dashboards, reports and presentations, and communicate analytical findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, explaining the supporting evidence, confidence level and potential commercial implications.

**Skills & Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in data analysis, business intelligence, software licence compliance, software piracy investigations, anti-piracy intelligence or a related field, with a demonstrated understanding of how compliance intelligence supports case assessment and follow-up.
* Working knowledge of software intelligence or monitoring platforms such as Revenera, Cylynt or comparable tools, with the ability to interpret and assess the intelligence they generate.
* Proficiency in data analysis and visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau or similar platforms; working knowledge of SQL, Python or other data-processing and automation technologies.
* Strong critical thinking, attention to detail and sound judgement, including the ability to assess incomplete or conflicting information, make reasoned recommendations and recognise commercial or business-development implications.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to explain findings clearly and collaborate with stakeholders in an international environment; fluent in written and spoken English.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
* High standards of integrity and confidentiality when handling sensitive data.
* Strong organisational and project-management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and coordinate multiple tasks.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience using OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence) techniques to gather data from public records, social media, and open-source platforms (e.g., LinkedIn, Google).
* Experience supporting business development, market expansion, sales intelligence or commercial opportunity assessment.

title: Category Lead
description:
About Lenskart.com

Lenskart is one of the world's fastest-growing eyewear brands 3,00+ stores and counting across India and a fast-expanding international footprint. Behind every store, every shelf, and every campaign sits a single question: what do we put in front of the customer, and why? That's the question this role owns.

**The opportunity**

As the brand scales across India and into new markets, we're looking for a Category Head to own its most important asset: the product.

This is a category-leadership role with real ownership. You'll decide what sells each season, how it's priced, how it's planned, and how it performs owning the category from the first sketch with the design team to the sell-through report at quarter-end. You'll balance a designer's eye for what's beautiful with a merchant's instinct for what sells, and you'll be measured on both the desirability of the range and the health of the P&L.

If you want to shape a brand's identity through its product and own the commercial outcome of those choices this is that role.

**What you'll own**

* **Category strategy & P&L.**
  Own the assortment and commercial performance of the category frames, sunglasses, and premium ranges driving revenue, margin, and full-price sell-through against clear targets.
* **Range & assortment architecture.**
  Define the seasonal range and good-better-best structure: hero products, newness, price tiers, and the breadth-versus-depth calls that keep the brand both premium and commercial.
* **Buying & merchandise planning.**
  Own open-to-buy, range planning, allocation, and inventory health the right product, in the right store and channel, in the right quantity, at the right time, with disciplined markdown management.
* **Pricing & margin.**
  Set the pricing architecture and promotional strategy that protects the brand's premium positioning while delivering category profitability.
* **Product lifecycle & launches.**
  Partner with Product and Design to brief, build, and launch new collections managing the full lifecycle from introduction and ramp-up to refresh and exit.
* **Cross-functional partnership.**
  Work hand-in-hand with Design, Marketing, Retail, Visual Merchandising, and Supply Chain to bring the range to life in-store and online and turn launches into commercial moments.
* **Data-led decisions.**
  Use sell-through, conversion, attach rate, and customer data to sharpen every assortment, pricing, and planning call and to course-correct fast.
* **Team leadership.**
  Build, lead, and mentor a category team of buyers, merchandisers, and planners as the brand scales.

**What you bring**

* Deep category management, buying, or merchandising experience in fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail, ideally with category P&L ownership.
* The rare blend of product instinct and commercial rigour an eye for what's desirable and the numbers to back what sells.
* Strong financial fluency: OTB, margin, markdown, and inventory planning are second nature.
* A feel for premium and brand-led product you understand how assortment choices build (or dilute) a brand.
* Excellent cross-functional leadership across Design, Marketing, Retail, and Supply Chain.
* The energy and structure to scale a category in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Merchandising, Retail Management, Business, Fashion, or a related field.
* 10–15+ years in category management, buying, or merchandise planning, including team leadership.
* Experience owning a category or range for a multi-store retail brand strongly preferred.
* Background in eyewear, fashion, lifestyle, accessories, or premium retail is a strong plus.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s leading Community Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. We have proudly facilitated 5 million+ members. By leveraging AI-based algorithms, we streamline the process of searching and connecting with compatible profiles. Our platform redefines how people perceive and approach marriage, ensuring an easy and efficient experience.

**Build the Team. Own the Architecture. Ship the Product. Solve the Hardest Problems.**

**Experience:**
Proven engineering leadership experience required

**Preferred background:**
Strong product-based technology companies

**Role:**
Hands-on Engineering Manager / Individual Contributor

**Expectation:**
High ownership, high execution velocity, zero dependency on constant supervision

The Role

We are looking for an engineering leader who can do both:
**build a high-performing engineering team and personally solve difficult engineering problems.**

You are not someone who stopped coding after becoming a manager. You can review a system architecture, understand an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a production outage, write a critical service, build an AI agent, and still know how to hire, coach, challenge, and manage engineers effectively.

You can take an ambiguous business objective, translate it into an engineering strategy, break it into executable work, assign ownership, remove bottlenecks, and drive it to production.

When the team is moving fast, you multiply its output. When a critical technical problem is blocking delivery, you can get into the details and help solve it yourself.

You are technology-agnostic, obsessed with execution, comfortable with complexity, and actively exploring how AI and autonomous agents can change the way software is built.

**We are not looking for a manager who needs a team to do the engineering for them but for an engineer who has developed the ability to make an entire team more effective without losing the ability to build themselves.**

**What You Will Own**

1. Engineering execution and delivery

* Take complete ownership of engineering delivery, from understanding business priorities to shipping reliable production systems.
* Convert ambiguous business objectives into clear technical plans, milestones, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution across multiple projects without allowing dependencies, indecision, or coordination overhead to become excuses for delays.
* Identify bottlenecks early, make trade-offs decisively, and unblock the team without waiting for escalations.
* Maintain high execution velocity without accumulating reckless technical debt or compromising security and reliability.
* Ensure the team ships working software, not just completed tickets, merged pull requests, or impressive-looking roadmaps.
* Take direct ownership of critical deliverables when timelines or technical complexity demand hands-on intervention.

2. Hands-on engineering and technical leadership

* Remain technically credible through active coding, code reviews, debugging, system design, and production ownership.
* Design and build backend services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, automations, and AI-powered systems as required.
* Navigate unfamiliar repositories and technology stacks without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* Make sound architecture decisions based on business needs, scalability, reliability, maintainability, cost, and time to market.
* Diagnose complex production failures, performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, and difficult integration issues.
* Establish engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, observability, deployment, and operational readiness.
* Know when to delegate, when to coach, and when to personally take the keyboard.

3. Team leadership and people management

* Build and manage a team of high-performing engineers with clear expectations, accountability, and ownership.
* Hire engineers who demonstrate exceptional problem-solving ability, technical depth, learning speed, and execution.
* Set a high engineering bar and address persistent performance issues directly and fairly.
* Coach engineers through difficult technical decisions instead of becoming the team's permanent debugging service.
* Develop engineers who can independently own systems, make decisions, and deliver outcomes.
* Create a culture where engineers challenge assumptions, surface problems early, take responsibility, and continuously improve.
* Balance delegation with hands-on involvement without becoming either a micromanager or an absent manager.
* Provide clear feedback, manage performance, resolve conflicts, and make difficult people decisions when necessary.

4. AI-native and agentic engineering

We expect you to be an active practitioner of modern AI-assisted engineering, not someone who merely encourages the team to experiment with ChatGPT.

* Use AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring.
* Build or integrate agentic workflows involving planning, tool calling, multi-step execution, external APIs, and verification.
* Identify engineering and business processes that can be automated using LLMs, agents, and conventional software.
* Establish practical workflows that increase engineering throughput without sacrificing correctness or security.
* Evaluate new AI tools based on measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, and cost.
* Teach the team how to use AI effectively, review AI-generated code critically, and validate agent-driven changes.
* Personally prototype and ship AI-powered solutions rather than limiting your involvement to strategy and vendor selection.

**We want a leader who uses AI to increase the output of the entire engineering organization, including their own.**

5. Cross-domain problem solving

You should be comfortable moving between fundamentally different technical challenges.

Depending on the problem, this may involve:

* Backend architecture, APIs, databases, caching, and distributed systems.
* Mobile, web, and end-to-end product workflows.
* Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, performance, and incident management.
* Payment gateways, third-party integrations, asynchronous workflows, and data consistency.
* AI applications, LLM integrations, agentic systems, and automation.
* Security, reliability, cost optimization, and scaling systems under real-world constraints.

6. Business ownership

* Understand the business metrics behind the engineering roadmap.
* Prioritize work based on customer impact, revenue, risk, and engineering effort.
* Challenge unnecessary complexity, low-value projects and choices that don't solve a meaningful problem.
* Make informed build-versus-buy decisions.
* Optimize infrastructure and engineering costs without creating fragile systems.
* Communicate technical risks, delivery trade-offs, and progress clearly to business stakeholders.

You are expected to understand not just whether something can be built, but whether it should be built, why it matters, and how quickly it needs to deliver value.

The Non-Negotiable Bar

**Technical credibility:**
You have personally built and shipped production software and can still reason deeply about code and architecture.

**Independent execution:**
You do not need your manager to tell you what to prioritize, how to solve a problem, or how to unblock your team.

**Leadership without hiding behind delegation:**
You can manage through others while remaining capable of direct technical contribution.

**Breadth of experience:**
You have dealt with different classes of engineering problems and can adapt beyond your primary specialization.

**AI-native thinking:**
You actively use AI and agentic workflows to improve individual and team productivity.

**Accountability:**
When a project fails, you investigate the causes, own your part, correct the course, and prevent avoidable recurrence.

**People leadership:**
You can attract, develop, challenge, and retain strong engineers while addressing underperformance directly.

What We Do Not Want

* A people manager who has lost the ability to understand or contribute to the code.
* A project manager whose primary output is meetings, status reports, and Jira updates.
* An architect who produces diagrams but cannot validate implementation details.
* A hands-off manager who delegates every difficult technical problem.
* A micromanager who becomes the approval bottleneck for every decision.

What Success Looks Like

* The team consistently ships high-quality software with predictable execution.
* Engineers operate with greater independence and take meaningful ownership.
* Architectural and technical decisions improve the product rather than create unnecessary complexity.
* Critical production issues are diagnosed and resolved systematically.
* AI and automation measurably improve engineering throughput.
* Engineering resources are allocated to the highest-impact problems.
* You can step into the hardest technical problems without becoming a permanent bottleneck.

Interview Process

* **Technical deep dive:**
  Walk us through complex systems you have personally designed, built, shipped, or operated.
* **Live problem solving:**
  Debug an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a failure, or solve a practical engineering problem.
* **System design:**
  Design a production system and defend your choices around reliability, scale, security, cost, and delivery speed.
* **AI-agent exercise:**
  Use an AI coding agent to solve a bounded engineering task and demonstrate how you verify its work.
* **Engineering management scenarios:**
  Handle missed commitments, underperformance, technical disagreements, competing priorities, and team bottlenecks.
* **Execution review:**
  Explain a difficult project you owned, the decisions you made, what went wrong, and the measurable result.
* **Ownership verification:**
  Distinguish what you personally contributed from what the team delivered.

We will evaluate the reasoning behind your decisions, not just the final answers.

**The expectation is simple: lead the team, own the outcome, understand the technology, and be ready to build when it matters.**

**About the Program**
The Eptura Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide recent graduates and early-career professionals with meaningful, hands-on experience within a global SaaS organization. Throughout this 12-month program, apprentices will receive mentoring, structured learning opportunities, and exposure to commercial operations and sales processes.
  
  
**Eligibility**
**To Be Considered For This Apprenticeship, Candidates Must**

* Have completed a Bachelor's degree within the past two years, OR
* Be in the final year of their degree program and eligible for apprenticeship participation
* Have no more than two years of professional work experience
* Be legally eligible to participate in an apprenticeship program in India

**Shape the Future of Work with Eptura**
At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Product Associate, you will work directly within our Gurugram engineering team, helping to shepherd product enhancements and customer-reported issues through Eptura's AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC). You'll connect product priorities and engineering execution, keeping work organized, clearly specified, and moving forward on our Jira kanban boards.
  
  
This is a role for someone who is curious, organized, and eager to learn how great software products are built. You don't need prior experience in product management. You do need strong attention to detail, clear communication, demonstrated capabilities in using AI, and a genuine interest in how technology solves real-world problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain the Jira kanban board: keeping tickets well-organized, clearly described, and appropriately prioritized in collaboration with engineering leads.
* Help triage incoming product enhancement requests and customer-reported defects, gathering the context engineers need to act on them.
* Work with AI to write clear, structured user stories and acceptance criteria that translate business needs into actionable engineering tasks.
* Coordinate with engineers to track progress, surface blockers, and ensure items move efficiently through the AIDLC stages.
* Participate in requirement-gathering conversations with product managers and stakeholders, capturing key decisions and open questions.
* Assist in drafting functional specifications and supporting documentation for new or enhanced product features, also working with AI.
* Support basic testing activities: reviewing completed work against acceptance criteria and flagging discrepancies.
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of our AIDLC processes and team ways of working.

**About You**
We're looking for a motivated self-starter who is keen to build a career in product or technology. The following will set you up for success in this role:
  
  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English: you'll be writing tickets, specs, and summaries that engineers and stakeholders rely on.
* High attention to detail and a methodical approach to organizing information.
* Comfort working in a structured, process-driven environment: you like things to be clear, tracked, and accounted for.
* Curiosity about how software products are built and a willingness to ask questions.
* Familiarity with project or task management tools (Jira experience is a plus).
* A proactive mindset: you spot gaps, follow up, and take ownership of your work.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess AI outputs, identify limitations or risks, and recommend improvements to enhance product value.
* AI-related experience:
* Understanding of AI fundamentals, including large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, automation workflows, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience using AI tools to improve productivity: research, data analysis, content creation, or workflow automation, either through academic, personal, or professional projects. Ability to build and demonstrate an AI agent.
* Ability to evaluate Ai-driven product opportunities, gathering feedback and translating it into feature recommendations.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to agile or kanban workflows (even in an academic or personal project context).
* Basic understanding of software development concepts: you don't need to code, but knowing what engineers do helps.
* Prior internship, project, or coursework related to business analysis, product management, or software delivery.

**Benefits**

* Monthly stipend
* Health Insurance fully paid – Self
* 13 Public Holidays
* Hyrid working policy
* Exposure to the latest trends and technologies in the SaaS industry.
* Mentorship from global experienced professionals in the sales, renewals and customer success fields.
* Potential for career advancement based on performance and dedication.

**Eptura Information**

* Follow us on Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook | YouTube
* At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

title: I&P GN - SC&E – Consultant - Enterprise AI Value Strategy-EVS
description:
You are curious about how artificial intelligence is reshaping the way global supply chains are designed, planned, and operated. You understand that the future of supply chain is not just about automation — it's about intelligent systems that learn, adapt, and collaborate. You bring a blend of functional supply chain knowledge and a growing fluency in enterprise AI concepts, and you're energized by the challenge of turning that combination into tangible value for clients.
  
  
You're comfortable moving between structured analysis and open-ended problem-solving. You ask good questions, synthesize complex information quickly, and communicate your thinking clearly — whether you're mapping a demand-planning process, drafting a functional specification, or helping a client imagine what an AI-powered supply chain could look like. You're eager to grow, take direction well, and understand that great consulting outcomes are built on meticulous preparation and disciplined thinking.
  
  
**THE WORK**
Utilize Relevant AI Tools Across All Tasks And Deliverable Creation, Including The Creation Of Agents And Other Tools To Help Facilitate
  
  
**Supply Chain AI Strategy & Use Case Development**

* Identify, assess, and prioritize AI use cases across supply chain domains — Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, Procurement, Aftermarket, and Fulfillment — by mapping current-state processes to AI-enabled future states.
* Support the development of Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs) grounded in supply chain functional knowledge and client-specific context.
* Contribute to AI reference architecture designs tailored for supply chain environments, illustrating how agentic AI components interact with enterprise data platforms, ERP systems, and planning tools.
* Assist in crafting AI value cases and business cases that articulate ROI, risk, and transformation timelines for supply chain-specific AI initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Advisory Support**

* Support client workshops and discovery sessions by preparing materials, capturing requirements, and synthesizing stakeholder inputs across supply chain functions.
* Prepare client-facing presentations, roadmaps, and strategy decks that translate AI and data concepts into accessible narratives for supply chain and operations leaders.
* Apply Design Thinking principles to facilitate structured problem definition and solution ideation sessions with client teams.
* Maintain and evolve the team's repository of supply chain AI frameworks, benchmarks, and industry case examples.

**Data & AI Foundations**

* Develop foundational fluency in enterprise data concepts — data products, data pipelines, and agentic AI hierarchies — as they apply to supply chain planning and execution systems.
* Support data analysis tasks to surface insights from supply chain datasets (e.g., forecast accuracy, inventory performance, supplier scorecards) in service of client recommendations.
* Explore and apply prompt engineering and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques to build or enhance AI tools that support supply chain advisory workflows.
* Complete assigned AI literacy and continuous-learning modules, contributing to a culture of applied innovation within the team.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, encompassing connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, and STEM. Proudly part of Inizio – the market-leading commercialization partner for health and life sciences. From early-stage development to loss of exclusivity, we simplify complexity, unlock value, and make collaboration seamless at every pivotal moment – supporting confident, insight-driven decisions that move innovation forward.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Putnam are seeking an experienced strategy consultant with
**existing life sciences experience and, where possible, deep domain expertise**
. Roles are
**practice-specific**
, hired directly into defined Putnam practices to build sustained capability and impact.
  
  
The Global Consultant will be
**fully dedicated to the end-to-end project lifecycle**
, providing continuity and hands-on delivery support to accelerate adoption within Putnam teams. This role is critical to providing
**deep domain expertise within their practice**
, increasing value creation for clients and teams.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Work in teams to solve complex business problems for clients.
* Gather and analyze information, formulate and test hypotheses, and develop recommendations.
* Communicate findings and recommendations to client teams and senior stakeholders.
* Support implementation of recommendations and work with client teams to achieve impact.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across teams and geographies.

**Key Requirements**

* Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and think creatively
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment
* Proven leadership skills and a strong sense of initiative
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work effectively with people at all levels of an organization
* Outstanding record of academic achievement
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and workstreams effectively
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, demanding, and ambiguous environment
* Professional maturity, integrity, and a strong work ethic
* Strong interest in, or experience with, life sciences and healthcare markets (biopharma, medtech, diagnostics, or health services)
* Familiarity with topics such as product strategy, portfolio prioritisation, market access, commercial excellence, or growth strategy is a plus
* Ability to rapidly build domain knowledge and apply strategy frameworks to highly technical client contexts

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of relevant life science consulting or strategy experience.
* Hands-on, execution-oriented approach with comfort working directly in data, analyses, and models.
* Ability to commit to and support defined projects or practice portfolios over time.

**Ideal candidate should be**

* You are proactive, dedicated and enthusiastic, with a ‘can do’ attitude and approach
* You demonstrate a high level of accuracy and attention to detail, as well as strengths in organisation and prioritisation
* You are a collaborative team player who works well with colleagues
* You communicate ideas and issues in an effective, straightforward fashion
* You are highly motivated and want to seize opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
