title: Knowledge Analyst - Product Development
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward.
  
  
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else.
  
  
When you join us, you will have:
  
  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will spend a significant part (~70% to 80%) of your time working onsite as part of consulting teams helping solve complex client problems in product development domain.
  
  
Your work majorly includes (and is not limited to) helping client teams estimate product cost based on clean sheet costing (and hence design a low cost product), rationalizing product design based on competitive teardown analysis and customer insights, working on new product development arena reducing new product development time, cost and quality attributes, carrying on survey to understand improvement aspects of the organization to support an efficient and effective product development and improving thereof to build a sustainable capability for the R&D organization for clients, etc.
  
  
The remaining time (~20% to 30%) will be spent on developing cutting-edge knowledge related to the Product Development (PD) domain and in delivering specialized remote services to clients.
  
  
You will focus on product development & design across industries. You will be expected to work on various product development engagements, provide expert client service by way of clean sheet costing, cost saving ideas/lever identification, and product teardown analysis.
  
  
You will also be required to support development and maintenance of various practice knowledge initiatives (build firm’s knowledge on product development related topics). This is a global role (cross geography, cross industry) and would work well for those who truly envision themselves growing into ‘experts’ within the PD domain.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* Engineering degree (Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical, Production, Electronics). In addition to an Engineering degree, an MBA from a school with a specialization in Operations will be an added advantage
* 1+ years of experience in should costing of parts or systems under procurement / R&D functions at OEM or Tier 1 (systems suppliers); prior experience in a multi-national environment is desirable
* Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate complex cost structures, identify root causes and drivers, and propose optimization solutions
* Proven experience building or using bottom-up cost models; familiarity with research-based modeling (e.g., process parameters, cycle times, material utilization, yields) is highly valued
* Proficient in reading engineering drawings and technical specifications
* Knowledge of the manufacturing process of various categories (OEM/Tier1/Tier 2)
* Excellent problem-solving skills, including the ability to disaggregate issues, identify root causes and recommend solutions
* Flexibility, patience and understanding of fluid, demanding, and unstructured environments, where priorities evolve constantly, and methodologies are regularly challenged
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, interact effectively with members from all levels in McKinsey and client organizations, with strong communication skills
* Good written and verbal communication skills. Fluent in both written and spoken English

title: Product Manager / Senior Product Manager – Travel Fintech
description:
QuadLabs Technologies builds travel technology for airlines, TMCs and corporates — booking engines, B2B/B2E corporate travel platforms, and AI-native Travel & Expense products. We are hiring a Product Manager who has already built travel products, not someone who has operated them.

You will own a product area end to end: discovery, PRDs, roadmap, delivery with engineering, and adoption with client teams. You will work directly with airline and TMC clients, so you must be able to talk GDS, NDC, fares and policy with confidence from day one.

Location: Gurugram / Delhi NCR

Experience: 4–10 years total, with at least 3 years as a PM in Travel Tech

Reports to: Head of Product

Type: Full-time

Who we're looking for

This role is open only to product managers whose PM experience comes from one of three backgrounds:

•      
**Travel tech product companies**
— booking engines, GDS/NDC aggregators, airline IT, hotel

distribution, corporate booking tools, T&E platforms

•      
**OTAs**
— B2C or B2B online travel agencies

•      
**TMCs**
— in the TMC's product or technology team, building its booking platform, self-booking tool, or

client-facing tech

The experience must be in a
**product management role**
(owning roadmap, writing PRDs, shipping with engineering).
**Travel operations, ticketing, fulfilment, reservations, customer support, or account management experience does not count toward the 3 years, even at the companies above.**

Key responsibilities

1.     Own the roadmap for a product area (e.g. air booking, hotel, corporate policy & approvals, expense,

payments) and tie it to client and revenue outcomes.

2.     Run discovery with airline, TMC and corporate stakeholders; turn it into clear PRDs, user stories and

acceptance criteria.

3.     Design booking and servicing flows: search, pricing, fare rules, ancillaries, seat/meal, PNR creation,

ticketing, exchanges, refunds and cancellations.

4.     Define integration requirements for GDS (Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport), NDC airline APIs, LCC

connectors, hotel aggregators and payment gateways.

5.     Build corporate travel features: travel policy, approval workflows, budgets, cost centres, duty of care,

reporting and HRMS/ERP integrations.

6.     Work daily with engineering, design and QA through sprint planning, backlog grooming, UAT and

release.

7.     Set and track product KPIs — search-to-book conversion, look-to-book ratio, online adoption,

booking failure rate, NPS.

8.     Support pre-sales and client delivery with demos, solution documents and scope sign-offs.

9.     Track the market — NDC adoption, competitor OTAs and TMC platforms, AI in travel — and bring it

into the roadmap.

Must-have

•      3+ years as a Product Manager at a travel tech company, OTA or TMC (see above)

•      Shipped at least one travel product or major module to live customers, and can walk through it in

detail

•      Working knowledge of air distribution: GDS vs NDC vs LCC content, PNR lifecycle, fare families, fare

rules, ticketing and reissue

•      Understanding of at least one of: hotel distribution, corporate travel (policy, approvals, SBT), or travel

expense

•      Can read API documentation and discuss request/response flows with engineers (Swagger/Postman

level)

•      Strong PRD writing, user flows and wireframing (Figma or similar)

•      Comfortable with Jira/Confluence and agile delivery

•      Clear written and spoken English; able to present to client leadership

Nice to have

•      B2B / corporate travel experience (self-booking tools, TMC platforms, CUG portals)

•      Experience with airline clients or airline-direct channels

•      Middle East (GCC) or Indian corporate travel market exposure

•      AI/LLM product features shipped (chat booking, smart search, receipt OCR, policy agents)

•      Payments in travel: corporate cards, virtual cards, BSP/ARC settlement, wallets

•      SQL or analytics tools for funnel analysis

Not a fit

Please do not apply if your background is mainly any of the following:

•      Travel operations, ticketing, reservations, fulfilment or back office

•      Customer support, service desk or implementation/onboarding support

•      Account management, travel desk or client servicing at a TMC

•      Sales or pre-sales without product ownership

•      Product roles outside travel (e-commerce, fintech, SaaS) with no travel product experience

•      Business analyst or project manager roles with no roadmap or PRD ownership

**Interested candidates can share their resume at hr@quadlabs.com or apply through LinkedIn.**

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Introduction**

Procurement functions in >80% companies are run on email/excel/phone calls - leading to inefficiencies, delays in procurement and cost leakages up to 20%. Procol is a platform to help procurement go from legacy, manual, excel/ email based processes to automated systems - becoming ~50% efficient, 2x faster, and delivering 2-10% overall cost savings.

Founded in 2018, Procol's solutions have been securely deployed at many $1B+ global companies helping procurement teams reduce costs, digitize procurements, and improve compliance by replacing emails and Excel workflows with the world's most easy-to-use and secure procurement platform managing a spend of $5Bn+.

Procol is rated 4.9/5 by trusted enterprises on G2 and has been featured by Forbes. We're a team of ex-Google New York, Zomato, OYO who've worked at high-impact, growth companies and believe that we're on the journey of building one. We are backed by investors like Blume Ventures, Peak XV Surge, Beenext, and Rainmatter.

**What will you do**

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for the Procol platform, including core services, APIs, integrations and shared capabilities used across products
* Partner with Engineering to define platform architecture priorities, balancing scalability, reliability, security and speed of delivery
* Translate needs from product teams, customer success, implementation and enterprise customers into clear requirements, PRDs and prioritised backlogs
* Drive the integration ecosystem, including ERP, finance and third-party systems, ensuring customers can onboard and connect quickly
* Define and track platform metrics such as API adoption, uptime, latency, integration success rate, time-to-onboard and developer experience
* Build self-serve capabilities, documentation and tooling that reduce dependency on engineering for configuration and customer onboarding
* Work with product managers across the company to reuse platform components, avoid duplicated work and keep a consistent experience
* Lead go-to-market readiness for platform releases with Customer Success, Implementation and Sales, and run feedback loops with customers
* Make data-informed decisions on prioritisation, deprecation, versioning and technical debt trade-offs
* Use AI and automation to improve platform capabilities and how teams build on them

**What would you bring to the table**

* Product management experience, with a track record of shipping platform, API, infrastructure or enterprise B2B SaaS products
* Strong technical grounding: you understand system design, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, data models, authentication and integration patterns, and can hold your own in architecture discussions
* Experience managing internal and external stakeholders, and prioritising across competing needs from multiple teams and customers
* Strong analytical skills, comfortable defining metrics, working with data and running experiments
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to write clear PRDs, specs and API documentation
* Experience with enterprise integrations (ERP, procurement, finance systems) is a strong plus
* Ownership mindset and comfort working in a fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment.

**Why Procol?**

At Procol, we believe our people are our greatest asset. You’ll get the opportunity to work in a
**fast-paced, collaborative environment**
with plenty of learning and growth.

**Perks include:**

* Flexi-pay benefits
* Free breakfast & snacks
* Employee & family health insurance
* Opportunity to work with a high-growth startup impacting thousands of businesses

title: Business Product Manager – Agentic AI
description:
**About the Role :**

We're hiring a Business Product Manager to lead FlixStock's Self-Learning AI Platform — an agentic AI system that combines Generative AI and fashion/creative domain expertise to produce high-quality creative output at scale.

You will be the business and product owner for the platform, responsible for customer outcomes, product quality, business roadmap, scalability and the commercial metrics that drive product performance. You will define what the product must achieve, why it matters and how success should be measured.

The question that defines this role: is the product materially better every week for customers, users and the business?

**What You Will Own :**

* Business outcomes & metrics: Define and track the numbers that matter — revenue, margin, cost per output/SKU, quality, customer acceptance, turnaround time and adoption — and drive the product decisions that improve them.
* Roadmap & priorities: Build and own a roadmap driven by customer needs, business impact and data — from problem identification through execution and measurement.Customer outcomes: Understand customer requirements, identify recurring needs and translate them into scalable product capabilities.
* Quality: Own quality outcomes, root-cause analysis of recurring failures and feedback loops connecting customer feedback, production outcomes and product development.
* Cross-functional alignment: Work across Tech/AI, Fashion & Creative, Quality, Operations and Account Management to translate business requirements into clear product priorities.

**What the Work Looks Like :**

* Business: Track the commercial health of the product — revenue, unit economics, cost per output and margins — and work with leadership and account teams on pricing, growth and commercial sustainability.
* Product & Technology: Work daily with Tech/AI teams on Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents and automated workflows. Understand the technology well enough to evaluate trade-offs and translate between business needs and technical possibilities — without building the systems yourself.
* Fashion & Quality: Partner with Fashion, Creative and Quality teams to define what "good" looks like — aesthetics, brand requirements and measurable quality standards. Turn recurring failures into improvements that solve problems at scale.
* Operations: Understand how work flows through production — bottlenecks, cost leaks and time sinks — and identify where automation or product changes improve throughput, efficiency and turnaround.
* Consumer: Engage with customers and account teams on requirements, feedback and priorities. Track acceptance and satisfaction, and turn recurring needs into scalable roadmap capabilities.

**What We're Looking For :**

* 3–5 years of Product Management experience, with experience owning a product or complex workflow end to end.
* Experience owning business metrics and influencing revenue, cost, margin or efficiency outcomes through product decisions.
* Strong analytical and systems-thinking ability, with comfort working with data, metrics and experimentation.
* Proven ability to translate customer problems into structured product requirements.
* Ability to prioritise between customer requirements, business impact and product scalability.
* Experience working effectively across both technical and non-technical teams.

**Bonus:**
Experience with AI-powered products or fashion/ecommerce/creative technology.

**Preferred Qualifications :**
BS/MS with an MBA, or BS/MS with relevant experience.

**What Success Looks Like :**

* Strong growth in product revenue and healthy unit economics.
* Measurable improvement in product quality and customer outcomes.
* Lower cost and improved operational efficiency.
* Faster turnaround and resolution of recurring product problems.
* Increasing customer adoption and scalability.
* A product that becomes increasingly repeatable, scalable and commercially sustainable across customers.

title: Product Manager
description:
**About the Company**

One of India's fastest-growing Portfolio Management Company's. Green Portfolio is a SEBI registered Portfolio Management company and a research house focused on the Indian equity markets. Alongside PMS, we have a vast network of investment advice-seeking retail clients across the globe. AUM and AUA as of August 2023 are worth of 800+Cr . We are constantly expanding our retail and PMS reach through fintech platforms and we require motivated, self-learning individuals to join our team and take up responsibilities.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our team. You'll own business and product initiatives across financial markets, research, data and technology, from the first conversation with a team to a working solution.

You'll work with different teams to understand what they need, define requirements, analyse data and get practical solutions built and adopted. A big part of the role is using AI and automation to fix real process gaps, not just exploring them.

Key Responsibilities

* Own product and process initiatives end to end: gather requirements from teams, scope the work, drive delivery and review results after launch.
* Turn business needs and user problems into clear product requirement documents, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work with tech teams to build them.
* Find where AI, automation and technology can improve workflows across the business, build the case, and lead implementation.
* Build and test prototypes and automation workflows using AI tools, and take the ones that work into regular use.
* Define and track product and business metrics, build dashboards, and use the data to set priorities.
* Run feature planning and maintain the roadmap and backlog for your areas.
* Plan and run testing and evaluation of new features, processes and AI-based solutions before rollout.
* Market Research: Evaluate industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for innovation.
* Present findings and recommendations to leadership and get teams aligned on decisions.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience in product management, product development, or a similar role.
* Bachelor's degree in B.Tech/BCA, BBA, or a related field. An MBA is a plus.
* Experience working closely with technology teams on digital products, platforms, or software applications.
* Strong understanding of product lifecycle management, requirement gathering, roadmap planning, and feature prioritisation.
* Proficiency in data analysis and tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, SQL, or product analytics platforms.
* Strong problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive projects from concept to execution.

title: Associate Manager Product Growth
description:
**Overview**
**How are you creating an impact?**
We are looking for a dynamic and commercially oriented
**Associate**
**Manager**
**Product Growth,**
to drive the strategy, development, positioning, launch, and lifecycle management of products and learning solutions for the
**Higher Education market.**
The role will be responsible for translating market, faculty, student, and institutional needs into compelling product propositions, while partnering closely with Editorial, Sales, Marketing, Technology, Customer Success, and Global Product teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be able to combine
**product thinking, market understanding, commercial acumen, digital fluency, and strong execution capability**
to build products that drive adoption, revenue, engagement, and long-term customer value.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**
**Product Lifecycle & Adoption**

* Create structured plans for product launch, adoption, renewal, and lifecycle management.
* Monitor adoption at institutions, faculty, course, and student levels.
* Develop intervention plans for products with low adoption or declining usage.
* Recommend product revision, repositioning, bundling, migration, or discontinuation based on performance.

**Revenue & Commercial Management**

* Own and contribute to product-level revenue and margin targets.
* Develop annual product business plans and revenue forecasts.
* Partner with Sales and Finance on pricing, discounting, commercial models, and profitability.
* Monitor product performance against budget and forecast.
* Identify corrective actions for underperforming products

Identify opportunities for:
  
  

- Institutional contracts
- Digital subscriptions
- Bundling
- Custom publishing
- Licensing
- Institutional solutions
- E-commerce
- Cross-sell and upsell

**Internal Positioning & Messaging**

* Defining and communicating the product’s unique value proposition, positioning, and key differentiators, translating product capabilities into clear, compelling messages that resonate with target audiences.
* Develop product positioning frameworks that clearly articulate the customer problem, product solution, key benefits, differentiators, and business value.
* Translate complex product features, content, and technology into simple, customer-centric benefits and outcomes.
* Develop competitor positioning and differentiation statements to help Sales teams communicate the product’s strengths effectively.
* Partner with Marketing to ensure consistency of product messaging across campaigns, websites, email, social media, webinars, events, and sales collateral.
* Equip Sales and KAM teams with product messaging toolkits, battlecards, pitch decks, talking points, and competitive response guides.
* Ensure that internal stakeholders have a clear understanding of “What the product is, Who it is for, Why it matters, and Why customers should choose it.”

**List Management & Product Data Governance**

* Own and maintain the master list of active products, ensuring completeness, accuracy, consistency, and timely updates.
* Maintain accurate product information including product name, ISBN/SKU, edition, discipline, segment, pricing, status, format, digital availability, and other relevant attributes.
* Establish strong data hygiene and governance processes for product and campaign-related databases.
* Ensure product lists are campaign-ready and sales-ready for Marketing, Sales Enablement, e-commerce, reporting, and business operations.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure new products, revisions, discontinued products, pricing changes, and product status updates are reflected accurately and on time.
* Maintain appropriate product lists for marketing campaigns, sales collateral, CRM, e-commerce, reporting, compliance, and management reviews.

**Sales Enablement & Planning**

* Enable Sales and KAM teams to effectively communicate product value, articulate differentiation, handle objections, and drive customer adoption.
* Develop and maintain sales enablement tools, including product decks, battlecards, pitch documents, FAQs, competitive guides, product comparison sheets, and objection-handling guides.
* Conduct regular product training and sales enablement sessions to ensure teams understand product features, positioning, target customers, use cases, and value propositions.
* Partner with Sales leadership to identify sales process gaps, productivity opportunities, and adoption barriers.
* Support the effective use and optimization of CRM and sales technology platforms to improve sales visibility, productivity, and execution.
* Develop and maintain sales reporting, dashboards, forecasting, and performance tracking to support data-driven decision-making.
* Support territory planning, account prioritization, opportunity management, and pipeline planning in collaboration with Sales and KAM teams.
* Ensure CRM data integrity, completeness, consistency, and governance across relevant product and customer records.
* Analyze sales and customer data to identify product trends, whitespace opportunities, adoption gaps, and revenue opportunities.

**We are looking for someone with:**
**Product Management Expertise**

* Strong understanding of product lifecycle management - ideation, development, launch, adoption, optimization, and retirement.
* Ability to develop product strategy, roadmap, positioning, and value proposition.
* Strong understanding of market research, customer insights, competitor analysis, and portfolio management.
* Ability to translate customer and market needs into product requirements and actionable product initiatives.
* Strong commercial understanding of revenue, pricing, margins, adoption, and profitability.

**Sales Enablement**

* Ability to translate product features into sales propositions and customer benefits.
* Experience developing sales decks, product brochures, battlecards, FAQs, competitor comparisons, objection-handling guides, and product demos.
* Strong understanding of sales processes, pipeline management, account prioritization, and opportunity management.
* Ability to conduct product training and enablement sessions for Sales and KAM teams.
* Strong collaboration skills to bridge Product, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.

**CRM, Marketing Automation & Technology**

* Strong working knowledge of CRM platforms such as Salesforce/SFDC.
* Experience with marketing automation platforms such as Marketo, HubSpot, or equivalent.
* Understanding of CRM data management, lead management, campaign workflows, and reporting.
* Ability to leverage technology to streamline processes and improve sales and marketing efficiency.
* Familiarity with e-commerce platforms and digital customer journeys is desirable.

**Data & Analytics Expertise**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to interpret sales, marketing, customer, product, and campaign data and convert insights into actions.
* Experience with dashboards, reporting, forecasting, and performance tracking.
* Knowledge of GA4 or similar digital analytics platforms.
* Strong understanding of marketing and product KPIs including conversion, engagement, adoption, retention, renewal, pipeline, and revenue.
* Advanced MS Excel skills; familiarity with Power BI or other visualization tools is an advantage.

**Communication & Stakeholder Management**

* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex product concepts in a simple, compelling, customer-focused manner.
* Strong stakeholder management skills across Sales, Marketing, Editorial, Technology, Finance, Operations, and senior leadership.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Strong facilitation and presentation skills for internal and external audiences.

**Strategic & Commercial Thinking**

* Strong business acumen and commercial orientation.
* Ability to connect product decisions with revenue, margin, customer value, and business objectives.
* Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on execution mindset
* Strong understanding of competitive dynamics and ability to develop data-backed recommendations.

**Education / Domain Knowledge**

* Preferred Educational Background: MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Product Management, Business Strategy, or related discipline.
* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.

**Preferred Industry Experience:**

* Higher Education Publishing
* EdTech / Digital Learning
* SaaS / Technology
* Education Services
* Academic Content / Learning Solutions

**Why Work for us?**
The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. As a leading education partner for millions of educators, learners, and professionals, we are expanding the possibilities of content and technology to make learning better in a connected world.
  
  
This position offers a strong foundation and a clear growth path toward product management for the right candidate. You will gain broad exposure to product, commercial, and operational functions within a globally recognized education business working with real data, real products, and real business decisions from day one.
  
  
McGraw Hill recruiters always use a “@mheducation.com or @careers.mheducation.com” email address and/or from our Applicant Tracking System, iCIMS. Any variation of this email domain should be considered suspicious. Additionally, McGraw Hill recruiters and authorized representatives will never request sensitive information in email.

Senior Specialist

Senior Specialist, Product Management – Operational Intelligence Commercialisation

This Senior Specialist role in Product Management will support the commercialisation and sales expansion of Operational Intelligence products across one of the five global regions. The role will focus on driving product adoption, identifying customer pain points, supporting sales enablement, and contributing to the development of commercialization strategies. The individual will work closely with regional ACS teams and the Global Product Management team to ensure alignment between product capabilities and market needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Collaborate with ACS teams to support product commercialisation efforts and drive customer engagement
  
  
Assist in identifying short-term and long-term whitespace opportunities and new use cases based on customer feedback and market trends

Assist in developing KPIs and tools to track commercialization success
  
  
Contribute to the creation of region-specific commercial constructs and go-to-market strategies
  
  
Develop customer value narratives and case studies to support sales conversations
  
  
Partner with regional teams to create and deliver sales training materials
  
  
Build strong working relationships across cross-functional teams to support commercialization goals
  
  
**All About You**
2+ years of consulting experience with a focus on go-to-market, pricing, and commercialisation in technology or data-driven solutions; experience in payments or financial services is preferred
  
  
Strong customer orientation and commercial acumen
  
  
Exposure to API and AI-based product commercialization is a plus
  
  
Ability to support strategic product initiatives and contribute to business transformation
  
  
Analytical mindset with a focus on solving customer problems and supporting sales efforts
  
  
Understanding of competitive landscape and industry trends
  
  
Experience working in cross-functional teams and managing multiple priorities
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in business or related field; MBA or equivalent experience is a plus

Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Pricing and Solutions Analyst
description:
APM Terminals
  
  
Product Development is responsible for the technical aspects of building a product. It involves creating and bringing new products to the market. It involves all activities and stages required to transform an idea or concept into a tangible and marketable product. Product development encompasses research and development, prototyping, testing, coding, designing and iterating on the product's features and functionalities. Professional stream includes those who are individual contributors with main emphasis on applying technical/discipline knowledge rather than managing people to achieve results – although coaching/mentoring less experienced staff, informal supervisory responsibilities, or overseeing work of other lower level professionals or manage processes and program are common. Individual work ranges from setting objectives and delivering on own work responsibilities to being a leading expert within a given field and influencing long term tactical decisions of the organization. Progression within this stream reflects increasing depth of professional knowledge, project management capability, and the ability to influence others. A colleague at this level works independently within defined boundaries and guidelines in a specific area but will need supervision and support on more complex tasks. Knowledge is required for the application of practical methods and techniques, work procedures and processes. Solutioning is through a choice between known alternatives, within the area of expertise and the leader will evaluate the appropriateness and effectiveness of the solution. The job requires previous work experience in a related area, or practical knowledge obtained via advanced education. Leaders at this level manage employees day-to-day and set priorities to ensure task completion.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.
  
  
Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.
  
  
**a Purpose Driven Company – 150 Years**
While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Lead, Business Systems Analyst on the Financial Risk Technology (Summit/Calypso) team, you will report to the Lead, Software Engineer (Financial Risk Technology) and partner with product owners, tech leads, designers, engineers and delivery professionals to drive quality assurance (QA) testing. You will act as the primary interface between Technology and specific business areas, identifying business requirements, creating project and process specifications, and coordinating with project teams. You will ensure projects stay on schedule and within budget while helping solve complex business problems and deliver innovative products, services, and experiences to delight our customers!
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Support the Lead, Software Engineer setting ambitious and clear product vision, and communicating ‘the story’ effectively to key stakeholders and the rest of the team; begin to identify opportunities to provide input to the team and coach others with occasional guidance
* Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact
* Work on extremely complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of often complex variables related to technology and/or data; exercise independent judgment in developing methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Own the end-to-end product strategy from inception and determine business value once solution enters production
* Ensure alignment of product features and stories (i.e., review, give feedback, and prioritize user stories in line with product vision)
* Understand the vision and own aspects of product management / roadmap activities
* Use programming languages including but not limited to SQL, Oracle SQL, Test Management Tools, Agile, SDLC, Git and GitHub, Jira (Basics), and Microsoft Tools

**The Skills And Expertise You Will Bring**

* Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering; Analytics or experience in related fields
* 5-7 years of experience in Calypso Application testing in critical modules including Collateral, Pricing Difference, UFT, VBScript, and API testing (SOAP & REST); experience in Functional and Regression testing with hands-on experience in the QFrame automation framework
* Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Knowledge of business concepts, tools and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
* Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges
* Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills
* Applied experience and/or expertise with several of the following:
* Project/Product Management: Planning, Progress Monitoring and Status Reporting, including visualization of works; Scaling Agile – Organizing, synchronizing multiple teams setup Estimations, ROI, project lifecycle
* Effective Communication: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Ability to facilitate dialogue at the right level of detail for all members of the Agile team
* Decision-Making & Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment
* Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations
* Interpersonal Relationships: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner. Ability to work seamlessly with business partners and software developers alike in a liaison role
* Financial Acumen: Knowledge of financial concepts, tools and processes and how financial metrics are used to monitor and drive outcomes. Includes understanding of company accounts/metrics (ex: balance sheet, profit/loss, cash flow, budget & forecast)
* Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems
* PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Manager, AI Strategy and Platforms
description:
Suntory Global Spirits is a world leader in premium spirits with beloved iconic brands, rooted in more than 200 years of heritage and craftsmanship. Our values are deep-rooted, and we aspire to live our purpose to ‘Inspire the Brilliance of Life’ in everything we do. Our ambition is to become the World’s Most Admired Premium Spirits Company. We want to be Most Admired not only for our incredible brands, but also for the brilliant experiences we foster, the ways in which we bring people together, the impactful marketing and innovation we deliver, and for the positive impact we have on the world around us. When you’re on our team, you can build a career of personal and professional growth across functions, business units and geographies. At Suntory Global Spirits, our employees work together to Unleash Their Spirit and realize their full potential each and every day.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
**Mission of Role**
The Senior Manager, AI Strategy and Platforms leads the development and execution of the AI strategy, platform and adoption agenda. The role translates business priorities into a coherent AI roadmap and practical operating processes; helps ensure approved AI platforms are trusted, usable and well governed; and enables colleagues to adopt AI responsibly at scale.
  
  
**Strategy, roadmap and demand portfolio**
Develop and maintain the enterprise AI strategy and roadmap, aligned to business priorities, Digital Products strategy and platform capabilities; provide recommendations on priorities and trade-offs to senior leadership.
  
  
Manage a prioritized AI demand portfolio, with clear problem statements, expected value, readiness criteria and recommended route to delivery.
  
  
Manage the AI Factory’s functional processes, including demand intake and qualification, prioritisation criteria, business-readiness requirements, functional acceptance, adoption measures and value-realisation process.
  
  
Create an approved, prioritised functional brief for each Factory engagement, covering the business problem, target users, expected value, process owner, governance route, business constraints, success measures and adoption plan.
  
  
Prepare investment logic and business cases for AI platforms, capabilities and priority use cases; support funding, budget-planning, cost stewardship and vendor decisions in partnership with Finance and Procurement.
  
  
Track strategic outcomes, adoption and value realisation, using evidence to adapt priorities and roadmap decisions.
  
  
**AI Platforms And Service Experience**
Develop platform-roadmap recommendations for enterprise AI platforms, model providers and supporting services, balancing business value, user experience, scalability, risk and cost.
  
  
Manage the platform-service model, including target users, service catalogue, onboarding paths, roles and permissions, support model, lifecycle standards and platform runbooks.
  
  
Monitor the AI platform as a business service, including user experience, adoption signals, access and support experience, provider performance, commercial fit and vendor roadmaps; lead business-side escalations and prioritisation.
  
  
Translate approved platform priorities into clear, actionable business requirements for Architecture and vendor partners.
  
  
Maintain a clear, scalable approach to platform onboarding, access, usage standards and lifecycle management.
  
  
**Governance and demand management**
Implement and operate the AI governance model, including policies, decision rights, intake criteria, approval pathways and governance forums.
  
  
Ensure AI demand is assessed consistently for strategic fit, business value, data readiness, security, privacy, model risk and adoption readiness.
  
  
Coordinate governance decisions and escalations with Security, Legal, Privacy, Architecture and business stakeholders; ensure decisions, risks and accountabilities are visible and actioned.
  
  
Define and maintain standards for responsible AI use, roles and permissions, human oversight, model and agent usage, and acceptable business practices.
  
  
Ensure governance is enabling rather than bureaucratic, maintaining appropriate control for the risk and scale of each use case.
  
  
**Adoption, literacy and capability**
Own the enterprise AI adoption strategy, including personas, target behaviours, adoption measures, literacy pathways, champion communities and change interventions.
  
  
Lead the AI literacy, enablement and community agenda so employees can use approved AI tools confidently, safely and productively.
  
  
Sponsor practical adoption programmes, onboarding waves, white-glove support and feedback loops that convert platform access into sustained use and measurable business value.
  
  
Partner with business leaders to identify barriers to adoption, strengthen local ownership and embed AI into priority workflows.
  
  
Establish repeatable adoption and value-realisation practices—baselines, target measures, review cadence and improvement actions—so AI becomes reliably and sustainably embedded in business workflows.
  
  
**Leadership and collaboration**
Manage and develop a small team of AI strategy, governance, platform and adoption resources, setting clear objectives and collaboration practices.
  
  
Act as a key business and platform interface for AI with executive stakeholders, business functions, enterprise architecture, security, finance, procurement and vendors.
  
  
Establish operating rhythms that connect strategy, demand, governance, platform requirements and adoption readiness to delivery priorities.
  
  
Represent the organization in relevant vendor and industry conversations; assess emerging capabilities for strategic relevance and controlled adoption.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Significant experience leading enterprise AI, digital platforms, cloud platforms or technology-enabled transformation in a global, complex organization.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to develop strategy, operating processes and multi-year roadmaps that connect business priorities, technology choices and measurable value.
  
  
Strong experience in platform adoption, product or service management, governance, change, enablement or portfolio prioritization.
  
  
Sound judgment in responsible AI, privacy, security, model risk and governance, with the ability to make pragmatic, proportionate decisions.
  
  
Experience managing senior stakeholders, cross-functional teams and external technology partners.
  
  
Ability to communicate a compelling AI vision and translate it into practical decisions, programmes and adoption actions for executive, business and technical audiences.
  
  
Strong analytical and commercial skills, including business cases, vendor evaluation, benefit tracking and investment prioritization.
  
  
Fluent English, written and spoken.
  
  
At Suntory Global Spirits, people are our number one priority, and we believe our people grow together in diverse and inclusive environments where their unique insights, experiences and backgrounds are valued and respected. Suntory Global Spirits is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, military veteran status and all other characteristics, attributes or choices protected by law. All recruitment and hiring decisions are based on an applicant’s skills and experience.

title: Head - NPL
description:
**Job Description**
**JoJob Description / Area of Responsibility**

* Lead the end-to-end Operations workstream for the development and flawless launch of advanced, safety-critical automotive mechatronic systems across two focus factories. Integrate mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software disciplines; align worldwide stakeholders, customers and suppliers; and deliver industrialization, quality, cost, timing, capacity and ramp-up targets. Provide decisive, hands-on leadership in a highly dynamic environment and coach launch teams.
* Support quotations and business cases with operations feasibility, industrial concepts, footprint and capacity scenarios, investment estimates, launch timing and risk assessment for complex mechatronic products. Ensure assumptions cover both focus factories and the required revenue-growth roadmap.
* Define Operations targets for safety, quality, cost, timing, scope, capacity and launch maturity across both focus factories. Establish project governance, decision rights, integrated master plan, gate deliverables, cadence, documentation and escalation paths.
* Build and lead the global launch team; secure resources and ownership with line management. Drive early risk management, manufacturing concept selection, make-or-buy inputs and work-package definition.
* Align factory readiness and industrialization strategy with the growth path from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue. Lead operations delivery for the complete mechatronic system, integrating mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces.
* Translate product requirements into robust manufacturing, assembly, testing, traceability and end-of-line concepts. Drive DfM/DfA, design reviews, process validation, equipment implementation, supplier readiness and capacity installation.
* Staff, direct and coach the two-factory launch team; resolve cross-functional dependencies and resource conflicts. Ensure all deliverables meet customer, regulatory, safety, cost, quality and timing requirements. Control the integrated plan and recover deviations through clear owners, countermeasures and escalation.
* Manage capital expenditure, tooling, launch costs, labor, ramp-up cost and obsolete-material exposure against approvals. Lead APQP, FMEA, control-plan, capability, test-coverage, traceability, line-release, PPAP and safe-launch readiness.
* Coordinate equipment, process, component, logistics and software-release maturity across both factories. Run risk-based launch reviews and drive rapid problem solving to achieve a stable, flawless ramp-up.
* Maintain one transparent, fact-based status for both factories covering milestones, budget, quality, capacity, resources, risks and decisions. Report gate maturity and forecast to Project Management, Operations leadership, plant management and executive steering committees.
* Escalate product, process, supplier, customer or safety-critical issues early, with impact, containment, recovery plan and required decision. Track actions to closure and ensure disciplined change control.
* Capture lessons learned and standardize reusable launch methods, equipment concepts, controls and best practices across both factories. Drive continuous improvement in yield, cycle time, scrap, reliability, test coverage and launch efficiency. Support warranty, 0-km, field and supplier-quality containment and root-cause resolution. Optimize capacity and requalification throughout the product lifecycle.
* Represent Operations and both focus factories on project, customer, supplier and executive meetings worldwide. Build alignment among diverse stakeholders and communicate complex issues clearly, directly and early. Lead feasibility, change and problem-resolution discussions using timing, cost, quality, safety and risk evidence. Maintain a strong customer focus while protecting operational readiness and launch integrity.
* Own the transition from launch through stable serial production and formal handover at both factories. Monitor ramp-up performance, capacity, yield, quality, delivery and cost until agreed exit criteria are achieved.
* Coordinate product maintenance, engineering changes, non-conformance resolution and requalification. Lead capacity adaptations and phase-out preparation in line with business and customer requirements.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, electronics, mechatronics, manufacturing, industrial engineering or a related technical field. At least 15 plus years of progressive experience in automotive or another safety-critical, high-volume industry, including complex mechatronic product development, manufacturing industrialization and launch. Experience across multiple functions or factories is required.
  
  
Demonstrated successful delivery of at least three new-product launches, including a complex multi-site or safety-critical mechatronic program. Strong competence in APQP/PPAP, industrialization, launch planning, risk management, budget control, capacity planning, supplier readiness and structured problem solving.
  
  
At least 5 years as a Launch Manager, Operations Project Manager or comparable cross-functional leader. Proven ability to lead international matrix teams, steer two factories, make timely decisions, escalate effectively and deliver under high pressure.
  
  
Proven leadership of worldwide, multicultural stakeholders across functions, factories, customers and suppliers. Fluent business English is required; additional languages are advantageous. Strong intercultural sensitivity, executive communication and willingness to travel are expected.
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Global Customer, Business Unit and Operations Governance: Expert knowledge of matrix decision-making, escalation paths and stakeholder management across factories and functions. Ability to establish clear governance, accountability and communication in a worldwide project environment
* New Product Launch and Product Lifecycle Management: Expert application of NPL processes, gate reviews, industrialization planning, launch readiness and serial-life handover. Strong command of multi-site launch governance and operational deliverables
* Safety-Critical Quality in Launches: APQP, PPAP, safe launch, line release, control plans, process capability, test coverage and end-to-end traceability. FMEA-based risk prevention and awareness of functional-safety implications for manufacturing and validation
* Operations Program Control and Reporting: Integrated planning, milestone and gate control, resource steering, risk and opportunity management, change control and executive reporting. Rapid problem resolution, disciplined escalation and recovery planning across two factories.
* Manufacturing and Launch Financials: Business-case understanding and management of Capex, tooling, launch cost, labor, ramp-up cost, capacity and obsolete-material exposure. Ability to align industrial investment with growth from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue.
* Advanced Mechatronic Product and Manufacturing Knowledge: Strong system-level understanding of mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces. Manufacturing, assembly, testing, calibration, traceability, software-release and configuration-control concepts
* Customer and Supplier Management: Customer-specific milestones, audits, PPAP, capability and drawing requirements. Executive-level communication, negotiation, expectation management and recovery alignment with customers and suppliers
* Matrix Team Leadership: Lead, motivate and coach international cross-functional teams without relying solely on direct authority. Delegate outcomes, resolve conflict, manage performance input and create ownership across both focus factories
* Change Management and Complex Problem Resolution: Evaluate changes across system interfaces and quantify impact on safety, quality, timing, cost, capacity and industrial readiness. Drive fast, structured decisions and implementation while keeping worldwide stakeholders aligned.
* Front Loading and Industrial Strategy: Lead early feasibility, manufacturing concept, footprint, capacity, investment and timing assessments for large, complex programs. Challenge assumptions early and convert lessons learned into robust launch concepts

title: Founder's Office - AI Implementation
description:
**Company Description**

NextDimension AI is building the operating system for specialty medicine. We deploy autonomous AI agents that handle the full scope of patient operations — scheduling, care coordination, billing, and more — so practices can run leaner and patients get a better experience.Our team comes from Google, Amazon, Nvidia, Adobe and Visa.We are rapidly growing and looking for builders who want to do the best work of their careers on problems that actually matter: Patient journey, Healthcare systems optimization, and a new AI-native Operating System for Health Systems.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram, working closely with the founders to drive product delivery across key customer implementations.

You’ll own what happens after a customer signs — getting them live, keeping them healthy, and helping them grow.

**Run the implementations**

* Own the plan and timeline for every account you’re assigned — who’s doing what, by when, and what’s blocking it
* Juggle several implementations at once and always know where each one stands
* Chase down client-side blockers and unblock

**Onboard new customers with Quality**

* Run onboarding start to finish — kickoff, setup, configuration with the engineers, testing, and go-live
* Be the customer’s main point of contact the whole way through
* Make sure every deployment is actually set up right before it goes live — quality, not just hitting the date

**Keep accounts healthy and growing**

* Watch the numbers that matter once a customer is live — adoption, resolution rate, AI-booked appointments, prior-auth automation, patient satisfaction
* Run regular check-ins and act as the early warning system the moment an account goes quiet
* Spot the opening to expand when an account is doing well and hand a warm, well-prepped expansion roadmap to customers

**Build the playbook**

* Turn what works into reusable SOPs, templates, and checklists as you go, organized by customer type
* Make each new customer an activation, not a project you start from scratch
* Set it up so all teams involved know what is next, and time to delivery keeps going down

**Who You Are**

You’ve done this before — carried customers from signed to live to growing, and you’ve done it for more than one at a time without losing the thread.

**You’ll need:**

* 3 to 6 years in hands-on, customer-facing delivery — implementation, onboarding, customer success, professional services, technical account management, or project management — ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, or healthtech
* A real track record running several implementations or accounts in parallel, on a timeline, and driving people to go-live
* Proof you’ve owned a deployment end to end yourself, from kickoff to adoption — not managing a relationship while someone else did the work
* Finisher energy — you go after the boring blocker and close the loop, every time
* Comfort with US-overlap hours for customer calls

**Strong plus:**

* You know US healthcare workflows or EHR/PMS systems or you’ve worked in RCM or practice operations
* You’re AI-native — you already use AI tools to automate your own work and you get what agentic systems can and can’t do

**What to expect**

* Location: Gurugram, India — 5 days in-office, 1 day work from home.
* Enterprise products shipped at startup speed.
* Salary + Bonus + Equity

description:

Manage day-to-day relationships with third-party solution providers, ensuring service level agreements are met and that technical issues are addressed promptly.
