title: Platform Engineer
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.
  
  
Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.
  
  
**a Purpose Driven Company – 150 Years**
While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Platform Engineer on the SaaS BlackLine application team within the Corporate Technology Finance Systems organization, you will report to the Lead, Platform Engineer and serve as a functional subject matter expert supporting enterprise finance systems. In this role, you will help manage the company’s BlackLine platform by providing functional and configuration support for onboarding new affiliated transactions and maintaining existing ones, with a strong focus on financial close automation, intercompany processes, and journal entry governance.
  
  
This role offers broad exposure to enterprise finance operations and places them at the forefront of an evolving financial close environment. The responsibilities are closely aligned with BlackLine-related disciplines, including automation, control execution, audit readiness, and process optimization.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**

* Lead the review and analysis of BlackLine incidents, ensuring naming conventions, downstream system requirements, and financial close controls are consistently maintained
* Partner with finance and controllership teams to design and maintain BlackLine configurations that support compliance and the onboarding of new and existing affiliated transactions
* Provide subject matter expertise in BlackLine controls, configurations, and financial close oversight
* Participate in enterprise finance transformation initiatives with an emphasis on BlackLine optimization, including process standardization, automation opportunities, and enhancements that improve efficiency and visibility
* Lead with a product and platform mindset by shaping the vision for BlackLine and related finance platforms, influencing stakeholders, and identifying opportunities to enhance platform capabilities, adoption, and business value
* Contribute to roadmap planning and continuous improvement efforts for BlackLine, supporting intercompany processes and financial close activities

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree is required; a degree in Finance, Information Systems, Business, or a related field is preferred
* 3+ years of practical experience in business analysis, finance systems, financial close, or related accounting and reporting processes is preferred
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess process gaps, control requirements, and dependencies across finance systems
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with accounting, finance, and technology stakeholders
* Exposure to BlackLine modules such as Intercompany Hub, Transaction Matching, or Journal Entry would be highly valuable
* Experience with Oracle ERP (particularly General Ledger) is a plus
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality and audit readiness across finance processes
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities across system enhancements, maintenance activities, and project deliverables while meeting deadlines
* Ability to learn quickly, work independently, and collaborate effectively in a diverse team environment
* Client-focused and results-oriented, with a strong interest in finance transformation, process automation, and scalable accounting operations

**What will set you apart?**

* Experience with BlackLine intercompany Hub is a plus.
* Knowledge of Agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Experience participating in ledger, reconciliation, close automation, or finance transformation initiatives is preferred
* Experience with SQL, Oracle Business Intelligence, or other analytics tools that support financial reporting and reconciliation analysis is a plus
* Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau or Microsoft Power BI for close reporting, reconciliation monitoring, or operational dashboards is a plus
* An inquisitive mindset and a passion for learning new technologies
* Financial or insurance accounting knowledge is a plus but not required
* PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

title: Manager, Tax Transformation & Technology - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
You will join a collaborative Tax Transformation and Technology team working at the intersection of indirect tax, technology, data, and business transformation. The team supports clients in turning complex e-Invoicing and indirect tax requirements into practical processes, system designs, data solutions, and implementation plans.
  
  
Based within the India GCC, you will work closely with colleagues, clients, ERP teams, system integrators, and technology providers across different markets, contributing to client engagements, proposals, and internal initiatives.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**
As a member of the A&M’s Tax Transformation & Technology team, you will:
  
  
**E-Invoicing**

* Support the delivery of e-Invoicing implementation projects across the GCC and other relevant markets.
* Review e-Invoicing regulations, implementation models, guidelines and technical specifications.
* Understand PEPPOL and review relevant PINT specifications and supporting technical documents.
* Translate regulatory requirements into clear business, functional, data and technical requirements.
* Document current and future processes, including invoice creation, validation, transmission, clearance, reporting and archiving.
* Prepare process maps, data flows, system-interaction diagrams and functional requirements. Applicants must have a comprehensive understanding of O2C, P2P, customer/supplier onboarding, intercompany, and VAT reporting compliance process impacts.
* Map invoice data between source systems, ERP systems, integration layers and e-Invoicing platforms.
* Review and prepare functional and technical documents, including requirements documents, field-mapping templates, testing scenarios and solution-design materials.
* Support testing activities, including test preparation, defect tracking, user acceptance testing and go-live readiness.
* Work with client tax, finance, IT and data teams, as well as ERP teams, system integrators and e-Invoicing service providers.

**Indirect Tax Technology**

* Support the implementation and enhancement of indirect tax technology solutions (Determination, compliance, and native ERP tax solutions).
* Translate indirect tax requirements into workflows, business rules, and system requirements. Drafting of BRD, functional design documents, and testing strategies).
* Prepare process flows and automation requirements for indirect tax processes.
* Support the configuration, testing and implementation of indirect tax tools (Determination, compliance, and native ERP tax solutions).
* Identify opportunities to automate/reengineer manual tax processes and improve the quality and availability of tax data.
* Support the preparation of solution options, implementation plans and technology roadmaps.

**Qualifications**

* 6-11 years of relevant professional experience
* Hands-on experience supporting e-Invoicing implementations in at least two of the following markets: UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.
* A practical understanding of different e-Invoicing models, including clearance, reporting and PEPPOL-based models.
* The ability to read and understand PEPPOL documentation, PINT specifications and other e-Invoicing technical documents.
* Experience preparing process maps, data flows, system requirements and functional documentation.
* The ability to understand how data moves between ERP systems, integration layers, and e-Invoicing platforms.
* Experience supporting the implementation or enhancement of indirect tax technology tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* The ability to prepare clear and well-structured client deliverables.
* The ability to work with team members and stakeholders across different locations and time zones.
* The following would be considered an advantage:
* E-Invoicing implementation experience across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.
* Previous consulting or professional-services experience.
* Experience working within a project-management or PMO function.
* Familiarity with ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle.
* Experience working with e-Invoicing platforms, service providers or system integrators.
* Relevant certifications in tax technology, ERP systems or project management.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)
description:
Product Ops & Growth (Full-time)

Location: Gurgaon · Type: Full-time 

About Voice Arena

Voice Arena builds frontier evals, models and datasets for voice AI. Our mission is to make machines talk like humans, and to measure honestly how close they are.

We run public leaderboards for speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and speaker diarization, with many more yet to come. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use them to see how speech models perform on real speech, in real conditions and across languages, rather than on clean read audio.

Behind the boards is a research and engineering team that builds its own datasets, trains the models that keep its evaluations accurate and publishes its methods. What sets us apart:

* Research that gets published. Three papers at Interspeech 2026, where Voice Arena is also the Diamond Sponsor. Our methods go through peer review, not just a blog post.
* Partners across the field. We brought Hindi and Indian English to Hugging Face's Open ASR Leaderboard, and we partner with NVIDIA. Model providers send us new models for public and private evaluation.
* Data nobody else has. Monsoon, our dataset initiative for the Global South, is working towards 1,000 languages by 2027. Our accented English corpus covers 8 accents and 6,000 hours. This data gives us held-out test sets that models have not seen in training.
* A research community. Voice Research Club runs paper-first sessions for voice AI researchers, starting in San Francisco and New York, with more cities to follow.

About the role

Voice Arena's boards are only as useful as the people who see them. When a new speech model launches, the right researcher, founder or AI leader should hear what our evals say about it within a day. Today that depends on a few people posting when they can. We want it to be a system.

We're hiring a Product Ops & Growth lead to own how Voice Arena reaches the people who matter: the researchers who build speech models, the founders and engineers who ship voice products, and the AI and data leaders who decide which models their companies buy. You will scale our presence on X and LinkedIn, and find new ways to put our leaderboards, benchmarks and datasets in front of the right people.

The core question for this role is simple: does everyone who builds, ships or buys voice AI know what Voice Arena says about the models they care about?

This is a highly autonomous role. You'll work directly with the founders and the research team, sitting between the product and its audience. Growth here is not about follower counts for their own sake. It is about reaching the right people, and that is how you will be measured.

In this role, you will

The work runs as one loop: know who we need to reach, get our work in front of them, learn what lands, and feed it back into the product:

1. Map the people we need to reach. Build and keep current the lists of who matters: speech and voice researchers at model labs, founders and engineers at voice platforms, and AI and data leaders at enterprises that buy voice AI. Know who they follow, where they spend time and what they share.
2. Scale Voice Arena on X. Own our X presence end to end: leaderboard updates, benchmark launches, threads and charts. Make sure most major voice AI model launches are covered on our boards within a day of release, and that the right people see it.
3. Scale Voice Arena on LinkedIn. Grow our company page and the founders' presence, and run targeted promotion so our posts reach researchers at labs, teams at voice platforms and AI leaders at large enterprises.
4. Run launches. Plan and ship every release, from new leaderboards and benchmarks to datasets and papers: timing, founder posts, threads, visuals, and the follow-up that keeps a launch alive after day one.
5. Build distribution beyond our own accounts. Work with creators, researchers and partners who already have the audience we need, so our results travel through voices people trust.
6. Run product ops. Keep the boards fresh and the site sharp: track new model releases, work with the research team on what gets evaluated next, and turn audience feedback into changes on voicearena.com.

In a typical week, you might:

* Track every voice AI model launch and get our results out the same day
* Plan and schedule a benchmark launch thread with the research team
* Build a target list of voice researchers and AI leaders, and set up a LinkedIn campaign to reach them
* Brief a group of creators on a new leaderboard and coordinate their posts
* Look at who each post reached and who engaged, and change next week's plan

What matters most

Everything in the loop serves two outcomes. They are how this role will be measured.

1. Reaching the right people

Reach only matters if it is the right reach. A post seen by a million people who will never build or buy a speech model is worth less than one seen by the hundred people who do. Your job is to make sure Voice Arena is in front of those people, consistently. In practice:

* Know the audience by name. Keep clear, current lists of the researchers, builders and buyers we need, and know which of them already follow us.
* Measure who, not just how many. Track reach and engagement among the people we target, not just impressions and follower counts.
* Be first on launches. Be the place people check when a new voice model ships, by getting our results out fast.
* Earn the reshare. Make posts researchers want to share: clear charts, honest numbers, no hype.

2. Scaling X and LinkedIn into systems

Today a few people post when they can. You'll turn that into a repeatable engine that runs every day, through launches and quiet weeks alike. In practice:

* Run a calendar. Keep a weekly calendar of leaderboard posts and releases across Voice Arena's accounts and the founders' accounts.
* Build templates. Create reusable formats for leaderboard updates, launch threads and charts, so quality stays high as volume grows.
* Spend on reach with intent. Use targeted LinkedIn and X promotion to reach specific groups, and cut whatever does not reach them.
* Grow a creator network. Build lasting relationships with creators and researchers who regularly cover voice AI.
* Close the loop. Report what worked each week, and feed what the audience wants back into the product and research roadmap.

What we offer

* High ownership. Own Voice Arena's reach from day one, with direct access to the founders.
* A front-row seat. See every new voice model and every result before it goes public.
* Real impact. Your work decides whether the labs, builders and buyers of voice AI see what our evals say.
* Room to grow. Build the growth function at an early company and shape how it scales.

Minimum qualifications

* 2+ years in growth, marketing, community or product ops, ideally at a tech, AI or developer-focused company
* A track record of growing an audience on X or LinkedIn, for a company or for yourself
* Strong writing: you can turn a technical result into a clear post, thread or chart caption
* Comfort with data: you track what each post reached and change course based on it
* Genuine interest in AI, and the curiosity to learn how speech models are built and evaluated
* High ownership: you ship without waiting to be told, and you sweat the details

Preferred qualifications

*You don't need to match every bullet. Apply even if you meet only some of these.*

* Experience running launches for a technical product, developer tool or AI company
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager or X ads and audience targeting
* An existing network among AI researchers, builders or creators
* Experience running creator or influencer campaigns
* Basic design skills for charts and visuals (Figma, Canva or similar)
* Comfort with outreach and data tools such as Apollo, spreadsheets or simple scripts, and with AI tools that help you move faster

Why join Voice Arena

* Shape how voice AI gets built. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use our boards to decide which models to build, ship and buy.
* See every model first. Work with the newest speech models across languages, often before most of the field has tried them.
* Grow something with substance. You'll be growing a brand built on real research: papers at Interspeech 2026, a Hugging Face partnership and benchmarks the field checks.
* Reach the whole world's speech. Our data and evals reach far beyond English, across the wider Global South, so the audience is global.
* Join early. Join a small, talent-dense team early, and shape the product, the team and how we grow.

How to apply

Send your CV, a short note and links to accounts, posts or campaigns you've grown to amritansh@voicearena.com.

title: Account Technology
description:
**Overview**
Synthesizes business insights and orchestrates global teams across the organization to deliver alternative solutions while applying deep expertise and thought leadership. Acts as a "virtual Chief Technical Officer" to provide Account Thought leadership in PSU / Government space, leverage deep knowledge of Microsoft's solutions, industry, and customer needs, and acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and team.
  
  
Leads technology strategy formulation by leading alignment of customer needs and technology solutions, execution of technology strategy/digital transformation, creation of mid- to long-term technical roadmaps, and translation of customer business objectives.
  
  
Develops and drives opportunities, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Coaches peers on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities.
  
  
Leads digital transformation using corporate and cross-industry resources, and partners with line-of-business leader or senior executive to articulate the benefits of Microsoft technology over competitor solutions.
  
  
Helps customer technical specialists sell Microsoft offerings.
  
  
Maps technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms. Orchestrates necessary teams and partners to ensure demand generation and establishes best practices for account planning.
  
  
Delivers regular industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision-makers technical teams. Uses readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Customer and Industry Insights
  
  
Applies expertise (deep expertise across few accounts or broad expertise across many accounts) and thought leadership to identify and inform the development of the right Industry Sales Kits and industry partners within the customer's vertical industry. Articulates and understands specific industry-related market trends, as well as customer threats, opportunities, and barriers to growth as they relate to the customer's broader industry. Leverages industry trends from other industries to gather insights and develop an informed perspective on similar issues that may occur within their industry/industries. Applies industry knowledge to support customers in solving issues.
  
  
Synthesizes and combines various business and industry insights from their team, global best practices, proof points from experience/case studies with countries and/or regions, and deep industry expertise (e.g., level 200) related to customers and their competitors to conduct forecasting and develop recommendations for managing accounts and subsidiary planning. Ensures that all levels of the organization challenge customers to consider alternatives and adapt strategies, plans, business models, and solutions to insights. Orchestrates cross-regional teams to gather information, collaborate on performance markers, and identify potential risks in customer accounts. Oversees technical teams for driving opportunities with others, as necessary. Brings in business and industry insights to address the broader business challenges for the customer and deliver solutions.
  
  
Differentiated Value Proposition
  
  
Partners with a line-of-business leader or senior executive within a large-scale or high-impact customer organization to articulate how complex Microsoft technology/services will meet future business needs better than the competition and will enable the achievement of long-term growth and success. Provides an outside-in view around existing and emerging compete or other solutions that are also a requirement for the customer.
  
  
Acts as the customer's Technology Mentor in established relationships with a line-of-business leader or senior executive within a large-scale or high-impact customer organization senior leaders, including technical decision makers (TDMs) and/or Business Unit leaders at the C-level (e.g., HR, Risk, Finance leadership). Develops extended relationships beyond core customers, advises on solutions, and aligns Microsoft capabilities with customer needs. Drives market share (e.g., cloud, collaboration, AI). Leads customer business transformations through digital technologies for assigned accounts to drive business outcomes and create business value for customers by understanding customer industry and position to provide guidance and to challenge customer thinking with innovative ideas that showcase the need for change and new strategic direction, and proactively involves corporate and cross-industry resources to drive customer transformation. Ensures line-of-business wins are captured (e.g., customer write-ups) as reference for scale, and represents the face of the business during public relations events for significant business wins.
  
  
Education and Thought Leadership
  
  
Leads customer technology engagement by engaging and influencing technical resources of customer, partner, and Microsoft towards customer’s business transformation. Delivers regular (e.g., quarterly, monthly) industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision-makers technical teams.
  
  
Uses existing and new readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans for large and high-stakes customers, and all-up Microsoft business. Drives innovations to help customers meet capacity and capability goals, maximize reach, and impact and drive long-term engagement and thought leadership on the Microsoft platform, and influences large customers to see and adopt the strategic value. Drives customer skilling initiatives and execution.
  
  
Mapping and Account Planning
  
  
Establishes best practices and standards around account planning for budgeting, quota attainment, consumption goals, and customer consumption gaps to inform quarterly and fiscal objectives. Coordinates highly complex extended account teams (e.g., spanning complex technologies, geographies, functions) and drives forecasting and tracking of the business. Owns the technical portion of the account plan and leads the customer plan delivery for large, critical, and/or strategic accounts. Captures all Account Planning input in MSX D365 Account Plan.
  
  
Helps customer technical specialists build the message to sell Microsoft offerings to other parts of their business or end users. Creates stakeholder maps for accounts, determines, and orchestrates a coverage plan, and builds out an execution framework across multiple Rooms of the House of the customer.
  
  
Orchestrates internal teams and local partners (inclusive of global systems integrators and consultancy partners) to ensure sufficient technical resources for demand generation, when appropriate.
  
  
Technology Sales: Demand Generation and Orchestration
  
  
Leads Account Strategy Envisioning (ASE, formerly IDTA) with the extended account team, customer, and partner to deliver the outcomes for the customer through joint envisioning, as a vehicle for Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays. Creates new Stage 1 opportunities, both billed and consumed, with technical decision maker (TDM) customer stakeholders, managing consumption pipeline with extended team to maintain velocity, and unblocking issues. Coaches peers (often as a mentor across a region or country) on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities. Defines the blueprint for opportunity initiation, and sets and shares standards and best practices for others to follow.
  
  
Leads the customer journey into the era of AI and Industrial Metaverse by creating a targeted approach tailored to their current business requirements and positions Microsoft as a leader for the future, both for accelerating productivity as well as helping the customer create new capabilities to support their business. Leverages expertise of current technology landscape and understanding of AI and Industrial Metaverse capabilities to plot the foundational elements on the technology roadmap that need to be in place to realize value for the customer. Builds a mid-term strategy for AI and metaverse projects as well as an immediate opportunity pipeline and orchestrates execution through the appropriate technical teams from the Specialist Team Unit (STU) and with appropriate Partners
  
  
Creates, develops, and drives opportunities based on industry best practices, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Develops a plan, within a broader strategy, to create and qualify a set number of opportunities for product sales, solutions sales, or consumption. Leverages partners and multiple channels (e.g., social media) to create demand. Orchestrates efforts to drive MCEM lifecycle and stage progression. Leverages experience and strategic foresight to lead technical teams by driving opportunities with Specialist Team Unit (STU), Customer Success Unit (CSU), and others, as necessary. Leads efforts to reach out to key stakeholders to give customer-driven pitches and drives the appropriate customer reach together with the account executive to generate new demand. Uses advanced technical knowledge of products to determine feasibility of technical customer requirements requests and works with core engineering teams to prepare solutions.
  
  
Technology Strategy Formulation
  
  
Creates mid- and long-term (e.g., 12 or more months) multi-horizon technology and business roadmaps for highly prominent, challenging, and/or strategic accounts based on a deep understanding of business and technology priorities and industry landscape. Challenges and validates the strategy and plan with customer stakeholders and drives envisioning and articulates business and program changes in the roadmaps around new and groundbreaking capabilities. Leads the translation of the customer's business objectives in conjunction with Industry Sales Kits and Solution Plays (including consumption-heavy workloads and cloud services) to develop an effective Industry Technology Architecture to plans for and drives consumption and adoption of Microsoft cloud and a higher share of customer potential and propensity (CPP).
  
  
Leads analysis of overall customer needs, outcomes, and blockers. Determines key stakeholders for driving execution on the largest and/or most complex accounts. Partners with global executives to lead overall strategy development (e.g., blocker identification, partner strategy) to identify and address gaps and drive end-to-end solutions. Leads the adoption of technologies by plotting the long-term vision of the customer's business strategy and driving action to bring to fruition.
  
  
Leads and ensures execution of technology strategy and digital transformation by anticipating and/or leading the resolution of technical blockers that arise during strategy planning and implementation, and driving technology adoption.
  
  
Trusted Advisor
  
  
Leverages a broad knowledge of Microsoft's product landscape, solutions, and strategy to address customer's needs. Proactively coordinates with internal and external network of industry experts (e.g., Regional Experts, industry-specific partners) to build strong knowledge of the industry and the competitive landscape. Drives and leverages leaders from the partner ecosystem to bridge process gaps. Leverages deep understanding of their customer to share knowledge with extended team and leverages advanced knowledge of competitors to promote customer business perspectives. Partners with others (e.g., enterprise-channel managers) to provide sponsorship and increase impact.
  
  
Provides Account thought leadership inclusive of information technology (IT), business strategy knowledge, and technology landscape, and shares best practices internally while providing coaching to subsidiary resources. Leverages account thought leadership in partnership with account executives to set strategy, own accountability for outcomes, and lead extended teams. Provides technical guidance to internal teams to position technology while using customer landscape knowledge. Creates connections and feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.
  
  
Acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and internal advocate by providing insights, feedback, and challenges from the customer to internal teams (e.g., product groups, engineers) across all levels of the organization. Drives action to ensure that internal teams understand and respond to insights. Articulates the business opportunity for Microsoft based on product gaps.
  
  
Creates security thought leadership with the customer's executives (e.g., technical decision maker [TDM]/business decision maker [BDM]) using the Microsoft Security and Zero Trust narratives and engages TDM and BDM stakeholders to position security as a business enabler and instill a security mindset in all aspects of the customer's technology landscape. Uses their understanding of the customers' technology and security needs to establish Microsoft’s security credentials and to build opportunities to improve the customer's security posture and orchestrates execution through security specialists.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 6+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
  
  
**Additional Or Preferred Qualifications**
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or related field AND 12+ years technical consulting, technical consultative selling, business consulting, practice building, or related technical/sales experience OR equivalent experience.
  
  
6+ years experience in relevant customer industry.
  
  
6+ years experience in digital transformation, or using technology to drive customer business outcomes.
  
  
This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
**About AutoZone**
AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 6,000 stores in the US, Puerto Rico, Mexico, and Brazil. Each store carries an extensive line of cars, sport utility vehicles, vans, and light trucks, including new and remanufactured hard parts, maintenance items, and accessories.
  
  
We also sell automotive diagnostic and repair software through ALLDATA, diagnostic and repair information through ALLDATAdiy.com, automotive accessories through AutoAnything.com, and auto and light truck parts and accessories through AutoZone.com.
  
  
Since opening its first store in Forrest City, Ark. on July 4, 1979, the company has joined the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AZO) and earned a spot in the Fortune 500.
  
  
AutoZone has been committed to providing the best parts, prices, and customer service in the automotive aftermarket industry. We have a rich culture and history of going the Extra Mile for our customers and our community. At AutoZone you’re not just doing a job; you’re playing a crucial role in creating a better experience for our customers while creating opportunities to DRIVE YOUR CAREER almost anywhere! We are looking for talented, customer-focused people, enjoy helping others, and have the DRIVE to excel in a fast-paced environment!
  
  
**Position**
**Summary**
AutoZone is seeking an experienced Architect to join the Enterprise Architecture (EA) team. Our goal is to grow and mature the EA practice at AutoZone by improving architecture and governance processes. We regularly partner with IT Leadership, Business Stakeholders, and Product Owners to produce detailed roadmaps, improve alignment, and increase visibility for Programs and Projects to drive digital transformation
  
  

* Own the suite of Enterprise Architecture standards, collaborating with other Architects and Stakeholders to develop and review all technology standards.
* Own the Governance Process for reviewing project designs and ensuring that solutions adhere to technology standards, are aligned with Business and IT strategy, and are appropriately robust.
* Collaborate with execution teams to provide timely recommendations and drive solution design to the best possible outcomes that align with our Long-Term Strategy and Standards

title: Principal AI Tech Architect
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

As part of the Enterprise Architecture (EA) practice at BCG Platinion, you will support architecture consulting engagements for Banking and Insurance clients. You’ll help define target-state architectures, drive digital modernization, and address key technology challenges including core transformation, cloud adoption, data enablement, and API-led innovation.
  
  
You’ll work closely with client CXOs, business leaders, and technology teams to translate strategy into actionable technology roadmaps and ensure architecture decisions create measurable business value. This role offers exposure to end-to-end transformation initiatives across financial services, including retail and corporate banking, insurance, payments, and wealth management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and deliver enterprise architecture engagements for banking, NBFC, and insurance clients.
* Define target architecture blueprints across applications, data, integration, cloud, infrastructure, and security layers.
* Assess current-state architectures and design modernization roadmaps aligned with digital transformation goals.
* Develop conceptual and solution architectures for core banking, PAS/LOS/LMS, and insurance platforms.
* Evaluate build vs. buy vs. reuse options and develop implementation strategies accordingly.
* Recommend best practices in DevSecOps, Agile delivery, and platform engineering.
* Drive technology governance, vendor selection, and implementation oversight.
* Provide advisory on emerging financial technologies such as open banking, digital lending, API ecosystems, and cloud-native core modernization.
* Collaborate with diverse teams to ensure architecture alignment with client’s business objectives.
* Present recommendations and architecture roadmaps to senior stakeholders and executive forums.

**Skills & Experience Required**

* B.Tech / M.Tech in Engineering from a top-tier institute; an MBA will be an added advantage.
* TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP certifications are highly desirable.
* 15+years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution design, or digital transformation within the Banking or Insurance domains.
* Strong understanding of BFSI business processes, including core banking, digital channels, payments, lending, and insurance systems.
* Expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience with architecture design across cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), data, and integration technologies.
* Familiarity with modern technology trends such as microservices, containerization, and API-led architecture.
* Experience with DevSecOps, Agile delivery models, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
* Exposure to digital transformation programs across banking, NBFC, or insurance organizations.
* Excellent communication and client engagement skills, with the ability to simplify complex technology topics.
* Proven track record in stakeholder management and working with multi-disciplinary teams.
* Strong analytical mindset, business acumen, and passion for technology-led innovation.

Industry Focus: Cross Industry (Non-FI)
  
  
As an Enterprise Architect at BCG Platinion, you will help organizations architect and deliver next-generation technology foundations that support business growth and transformation. You’ll work at the intersection of strategy and technology—defining architecture roadmaps, leading design and delivery, and guiding clients through modernization, cloud adoption, data enablement, and emerging tech integration. This role is cross-industry, offering opportunities to work across sectors such as consumer, energy, healthcare, manufacturing, telecom, and public sector—helping clients navigate complex enterprise landscapes and realize business value through technology.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture Strategy & Design
  
  

* Define target enterprise architecture across enterprise systems- digital, data, AI, application, cloud, and integration layers.
* Align technology strategy with business priorities and transformation goals.
* Create architecture blueprints, principles, and reference models tailored to client needs.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and their applicability to business use cases.

Delivery & Transformation
  
  

* Lead architecture assessments, define modernization roadmaps, and oversee implementation governance.
* Guide design and delivery of complex enterprise systems leveraging cloud-native, microservices, and API-first patterns.
* Ensure architecture compliance and quality assurance through technical reviews and best practices.
* Drive adoption of agile, DevSecOps, and platform engineering practices.
* Evaluate technology options to support target architecture, onboard and oversee end to end build.

Advisory & Leadership
  
  

* Act as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders.
* Provide thought leadership on digital platforms, data ecosystems, and technology strategy.
* Contribute to BCG Platinion’s knowledge base, frameworks, and capability development.
* Coach and mentor team members and client architects to build sustainable capabilities.

What You Bring
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  

* 15+ years of experience in technology architecture, solution design, or enterprise technology consulting.
* Proven experience in defining and implementing enterprise-scale architecture solutions across industries such as industrial goods, consumer goods, transportation, logistics, manufacturing.
* Proven experience in deploying one or more enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, SCM platforms, Manufacturing and IT.
* Exposure to multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and hybrid architectures.
* Strong understanding of integration patterns (APIs, ESB, event-driven), data architecture, and security design.
* Experience in digital transformation initiatives, technology roadmaps, or modernization programs.
* Experience working with system integrators or in house teams to drive end-to-end implementation.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Knowledge of architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Zachman, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with core enterprise platforms (ERP, CRM, SCM) and modern stacks (microservices, containerization, serverless).
* Experience in working on the client-side delivery collaborating across tech and functional teams.
* Understanding of data and analytics platforms, AI/ML enablement, and API-led connectivity.
* Hands-on experience or strong collaboration exposure in cloud migration, DevSecOps, and platform engineering.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Ability to work collaboratively in multi-disciplinary, cross-geography teams.
* Comfort in engaging C-level stakeholders and translating complex concepts into business value.

**About BCG Platinion**
BCG Platinion is part of the Boston Consulting Group (BCG) family, specializing in technology consulting that bridges strategic business challenges with modern technology solutions. BCG Platinion is a rapidly growing global team of leading IT experts. We are shaping the future of IT consulting by combining business expertise with cutting-edge technology capabilities. We help our clients solve their most pressing challenges by designing and delivering enterprise architecture solutions. We partner with clients across industries to design and implement enterprise architecture and digital transformation programs that drive innovation, agility, and scalable value.
  
  
Why Join BCG Platinion
  
  
**At BCG Platinion, You Will Enjoy**

* A challenging and rewarding career in enterprise architecture consulting
* A diverse and inclusive culture that values your unique perspective and contribution
* Enterprise Architecture consulting with implementation and value realization in a client setting
* A supportive and collaborative environment that fosters your personal growth and development
* A competitive compensation and benefits package that reflects your skills and experience

If you want a challenging and rewarding career in enterprise architecture consulting, apply now!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform Architecture & Strategic Direction: Define and drive the target-state architecture for our next-generation, cloud-native platform (Kubernetes, multi-region cloud topologies, and AI/workload enablement). Translate overarching business goals into scalable, resilient, and decoupled platform capabilities.

* Container Platforms & Orchestration: Architect resilient, multi-cluster Kubernetes topologies at scale. Define best practices for workload scheduling, networking (service mesh), custom controllers/operators, GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux), and multi-tenant isolation.
* Enterprise CI/CD & Developer Experience (DevEx): Architect automated, self-service golden paths and progressive delivery pipelines (canary, blue-green) that minimize cognitive load for application developers while ensuring strict deployment guardrails.
* Zero-Trust Security & Policy-as-Code: Embed DevSecOps at the architectural level—designing policy-as-code frameworks (OPA/Kyverno), centralized secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), secure supply chain standards (SBOM, image signing, Trivy), and compliance baselines (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
* Observability, SRE & Chaos Engineering: Design holistic telemetry strategies utilizing OpenTelemetry. Define enterprise SLI/SLO standards, error budget policies, resilience testing/chaos engineering, and lead complex root-cause analyses (RCA) for critical production incidents.
* FinOps & Performance Optimization: Architect cost-efficient cloud topologies. Establish capacity planning models, multi-region traffic routing, right-sizing strategies, and automated cost-governance guardrails.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, SRE, Distributed Systems, or Cloud Architecture, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale, production-grade distributed systems.
* Architecture & System Design: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure cloud topologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Deep Hands-on Coding & Automation: Proficiency in at least one modern systems programming language (e.g., Golang, Python) along with advanced scripting (Bash). Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and systems software design.
* Infrastructure-as-Code Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform(custom provider/module development, state locking, drift detection) and Policy-as-Code engines (e.g., OPA, Rego, Kyverno).
* Kubernetes Internals: Comprehensive understanding of Kubernetes internals (control plane components, CNI/CSI, custom controllers/operators, RBAC, API extensions, and scheduling primitives).
* Mentorship & Influence: Proven track record of guiding junior engineers, driving engineering consensus across disparate teams, and leading technical initiatives without direct authority.
* Observability & Reliability: Hands-on experience with modern observability platforms, distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana ecosystems, and enterprise SRE practices.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience architecting platforms within highly regulated domains (e.g., Financial Services, FinTech, Banking).
* Deep experience with Securing Cloud Native Platform.
* Experience designing, building, or operating large-scale Data Platforms is highly desirable.
* Active contributions to open-source cloud-native projects (CNCF ecosystem).

***We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.***

description:
The Infrastructure Engineering team is responsible for building and maintaining a self-service internal development platform that enables MongoDB engineering teams to reliably deploy and operate their own production services and products. We work with numerous engineering teams across the company to understand their infrastructure requirements and development workflows, develop broadly applicable self-service platform services and tooling, continuously monitor how platform services are being utilized, and look for ways to improve developer productivity through automation and education.
  
  
We are big open source enthusiasts and use a number of open source tools in our stack (contributing upstream whenever possible). Some of the tools we use regularly include Go, AWS, Kubernetes, Crossplane, Terraform, Helm, Drone, Prometheus, and Grafana. However, technology is nothing without a stellar team of engineers that are focused on doing high quality work and working as a team to solve complex distributed computing and platform engineering problems. This is where you come in!
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Our ideal candidate
  
  

* 2+ years of experience managing and mentoring a team of 3+ engineers
* Has 5+ years of experience owning the design and implementation of large software/infrastructure projects
* Has built and operated large-scale distributed systems in cloud providers (AWS strongly preferred)
* Has a strong backend programming background. Fluency in Go is strongly preferred; deep experience with another compiled or strongly-typed backend language is acceptable
* Pragmatic, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and understands the benefits of collaboration
* Strong experience operating production Kubernetes clusters, not just deployed to it
* Has practical experience defining and operating against SLI/SLOs for services they owned
* Strong experience with observability tooling: metrics, logging, traces, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
* Strong Linux and TCP/IP networking skills
* Familiar with standard authentication protocols (OAuth, OIDC)
* Familiar with web services and/or Kubernetes controller development
* Strong experience using CI/CD workflows to deploy production services
* Has experience working with AI coding agents and can demonstrate building high quality context to yield high quality outputs

Position Expectations
  
  

* Define, plan, and execute projects that help to run, grow, and transform MongoDB's self-service internal developer platform
* Take on direct reports and organize work for a team of platform engineers in coordination with other engineering leads
* "Lead by example" and act as a mentor to other engineers
* Work with engineering teams across MongoDB to investigate gaps and limitations in existing development workflows and understand new infrastructure and platform requirements
* Regularly write and review automation, configuration management, and application code
* Author and review functional specifications and scoping documents for large platform projects and services
* Own and operate much of the internal development platform that runs MongoDB
* Work on a distributed team that frequently interacts with remote engineers across multiple time zones (PST, EST, GMT, IST)

Success Measures
  
  

* In three months you'll have familiarized yourself with our teams and systems, taken on direct reports, and will be participating in high level scoping and roadmapping for platform projects
* In six months you'll have successfully investigated, scoped, and documented medium to large sized platform projects, and coordinated implementation with your direct reports
* In a year you'll have delivered measurable key results driven by a deep understanding of the goals/mission of Infrastructure Engineering, the needs of our stakeholders, and the objectives of MongoDB

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Senior Solution Lead, SAP IBP Cloud Solution
description:
The Sr. Solution lead is responsible for developing solution design and build for integrated systems within the enterprise SAP IBP Cloud solution area and corresponding set of applications. In this role the Sr. Solution lead will partner with Business Analysts and Technical Analysts to understand the overall business need, define overarching requirements and create high-level design specifications, ensuring feasibility, functionality, and integration with existing systems/platforms and develop an overarching architectural design and model that will support Stryker’s business needs. The Sr. Solution lead is responsible for verifying the detailed technical documents, validating the configuration within the assigned applications, and ensuring solutions are delivered based on the architected design.
  
  
The individual should be an expert with SAP IBP Cloud solution and it’s roadmap, that includes IBP Demand, Supply Planning, Response (Allocation) and other IBP Modules. And he/she must have 2-3 full cycle implementation experience with IBP Response solutions, including Configure-To-Order and Make-To-Stock production strategies and thorough understanding/expertise in latest SAP Release with end-to-Order to Shipment and Business Logics (i.e. ATP rules) to support order allocation.
  
  
Individual should be experienced with IBP Business Processes that connect IBP system with other systems and have good knowledge on various workstreams.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead the design, configuration, and deployment of SAP IBP solutions, delivering integrated end-to-end planning capabilities across the enterprise.
* Serve as the functional and technical subject matter expert for SAP IBP, supporting solution design, build, testing, implementation, training, and global template development.
* Drive SAP IBP initiatives across key planning areas, including S&OP, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, IBP Time Series, MRP, and Spare Parts Planning.
* Ensure all solution delivery activities align with established Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) standards, processes, and best practices.
* Review and govern business process documentation, functional and technical specifications, test strategies, and go-live readiness plans.
* Collaborate with global ERP teams, business stakeholders, IT partners, infrastructure teams, and deployment teams to deliver successful business outcomes.
* Partner with solution providers, process owners, architects, and key users to execute project deliverables and support deployment methodologies.
* Continuously optimize planning processes and system performance by identifying improvement opportunities and delivering scalable, business-aligned solutions, including support for quarterly SAP IBP releases and enhancements.

**What you need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field; Master’s degree (MBA, MIS, or equivalent) preferred.
* 10-13 years of experience delivering SAP full lifecycle implementations, with a proven track record of successful project execution.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with SAP IBP and/or SAP APO, including integration across end-to-end planning and supply chain processes.
* Strong expertise in SAP IBP Cloud solutions, including configuration, business process design, and integration with procurement, inventory, sales, and related functions.
* Experience integrating SAP with SAP and non-SAP enterprise applications such as Ariba, ECC, Oracle, PRMS, MFG Pro, and other third-party systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused solutions.
* Familiarity with ITIL, Agile methodologies, and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) practices, with the ability to work across data, integration, security, and reporting domains.
* Demonstrated success collaborating within global, cross-functional, and matrixed organizations, ideally within the medical device, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated industries.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Staff IAM Engineer
description:
**About Us**
With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.
  
  
Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.
  
  
At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.
  
  
Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.
  
  
Reports To
  
  
Senior Manager - AI & IT
  
  
What You Will Be Doing
  
  
ChargePoint is looking for a IAM Engineer to lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments. This role owns cloud identity, directory services, Okta identity workflows, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML). You will define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
  
  
You will establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows. You will build and implement Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), risk-based authentication, and Okta Identity Governance (OIG) programs. You will also scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations while maintaining reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical role. You will code, design, and implement IAM solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. You will partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
  
  
**What You Will Bring To ChargePoint**

* Lead enterprise identity strategy and platform architecture, encompassing cloud identity, directory services, and the transition of applications to modern authentication standards (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML).
* Define and implement reference architectures for secure authentication across CLI, browser, and agentic workflows.
* Establish agent identities as a foundational element within the identity platform, enabling access control and auditability for automated and machine-assisted workflows.
* Build and implement advanced identity security controls such as Conditional Access policies, Privileged Identity Management (PIM), and risk-based authentication.
* Scale device management and identity governance systems to meet the demands of AI-powered operations. Ensure reliability, performance, and compliance across large organizational environments.
* Partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams to align on architecture, build strategy, and operational ownership.
* Drive IAM application development: code, design, and implement solutions with deep knowledge in AWS, Azure, Teleport, and Terraform. Deliver reliable solutions that keep engineering teams productive.
* Drive IAM projects end-to-end: take ambiguous access problems, define requirements, architect solutions, and own the rollout and operationalization — not just the design.
* Refine role design and access patterns across AWS, Kubernetes, SaaS, and internal systems — eliminate unnecessary privileges, reduce manual grants, and establish scalable baseline access.
* Run and improve user access reviews (UAR): develop, execute, and design a UAR process and solution that meets compliance requirements while improving real security signal — minimize approver burden through scoping, automation, and clear decision support.
* Identify high-risk permissions and misuse paths, build controls and mitigations, and drive adoption with partner teams to reduce risk exposure.
* Operate with strong security judgment and high signal: distinguish meaningful IAM risk from noise, gather context efficiently, and escalate with crisp rationale and actionable mitigations.
* Document and standardize the paved road: write procedures, runbooks, and automation so access decisions are consistent, scalable, and not dependent on tribal knowledge.
* Conduct Agentic AI IAM requirement analyses, architecture reviews, and security gap assessments across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, AI services, and infrastructure environments.
* Develop automation for access management and secrets lifecycle operations.
* Develop and implement security controls for AI agents, machine identities, APIs, workloads, and autonomous workflows.
* Lead enterprise Agentic AI IAM program execution across multiple workstreams.
* Establish security controls for AI agents, autonomous workflows, bots, and machine identities.
* Standardize identity governance across multi-cloud ecosystems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience in IAM, cloud security, or cybersecurity engineering.
* Strong experience in Agentic AI IAM architecture, identity governance, secrets management, security engineering, and enterprise IAM program delivery.
* Strong expertise in requirement gathering, current-state assessments, gap analyses, control evaluations, and target-state Agentic AI IAM security architecture design.
* Experience securing cloud-native and hybrid environments and managing hybrid cloud IAM and secrets management programs.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and machine identity security.
* Experience implementing AI/Agentic security controls and secure automation frameworks.
* Platform experience: Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Google Cloud Secrets Manager, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, container security platforms.
* Experience with Terraform, CI/CD, and DevSecOps tooling.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CCSP. (good to have)

**Location**
Gurgaon/Bangalore, India

**.**
