title: Forward deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

**Company:**
Trida Labs

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**About Trida Labs**

Trida Labs builds AI-native products that help organizations work with enterprise data, analytics, and intelligent applications.

Our products include TridaPad, an AI-native data collaboration platform for querying, analyzing, visualizing, and managing enterprise data; AgentSQL, an agentic AI analytics solution for natural-language interaction with enterprise data; and TridaPad MCP Server, which enables AI assistants and MCP-compatible clients to interact with TridaPad capabilities.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work directly with customers and turn business and technical requirements into working solutions using Trida Labs products.

You will work across customer discovery, data integration, configuration, testing, deployment, and production troubleshooting. You will understand customer workflows, data environments, security requirements, and business needs, then configure and integrate our products to solve real-world problems.

You will also support customer pilots, technical demonstrations, and pre-sales engagements, validating solutions against customer-specific use cases and collaborating with engineering teams when product-level changes are required.

This is a customer-facing engineering role focused on configuring and extending existing capabilities rather than building customer-specific forks.

**What You'll Do**

**1. Customer Discovery & Solution Design**

* Understand customer workflows, technical requirements, data environments, and operational constraints.
* Translate business requirements into practical Trida Labs solutions.
* Identify required data sources, integrations, permissions, configurations, and deployment requirements.
* Assess technical feasibility, explain trade-offs, and define reusable implementation approaches.

**2. Pre-Sales, Pilots & Proofs of Concept**

* Support technical discussions, product demonstrations, pilots, and proofs of concept.
* Demonstrate how TridaPad and AgentSQL address customer use cases.
* Configure representative customer environments and validate technical requirements.
* Identify integration, security, and deployment constraints and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders.

**3. Product Implementation & Data Integration**

* Deploy and configure TridaPad and AgentSQL for customer requirements.
* Configure data sources, database connections, permissions, schemas, and analytics workflows.
* Integrate enterprise databases and platforms such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks.
* Understand customer data models, relationships, and business metrics.
* Validate data accessibility and troubleshoot connectivity, permission, schema, query, and integration issues.

**4. AI & Analytics Implementation**

* Configure existing AI and analytics capabilities for customer use cases.
* Adapt prompts, context, tools, and application workflows where appropriate.
* Validate natural-language analytics, SQL generation, analytical results, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries.
* Diagnose unreliable AI outputs and distinguish data, configuration, context, model, and product issues.
* Collaborate with specialist engineering teams when core product changes are needed.

**5. Security, Access & MCP Integrations**

* Support customer security questionnaires, technical reviews, and access requirements.
* Coordinate VPN, IP allowlisting, private connectivity, restricted network, and other environment-specific requirements.
* Support self-hosted deployments in customer cloud or on-premises environments where applicable.
* Apply least-privilege principles and follow requirements for handling production data, PII, credentials, logs, and debugging information.
* Configure and validate MCP integrations with AI assistants, internal applications, and customer workflows, including authentication, permissions, and tool access.

**6. Customer Evaluation & Validation**

* Build customer-specific golden question sets containing representative business questions, expected SQL, and verified analytical results.
* Test customer configurations against schemas, terminology, metrics, permissions, and real-world questions.
* Rerun relevant tests after product, model, prompt, or configuration changes.
* Validate SQL, analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and summaries against expected outcomes.
* Track regressions, communicate actionable findings, and maintain versioned customer-specific configuration artifacts.

**7. Deployment & Production Troubleshooting**

* Prepare implementation plans and technical validation checklists.
* Support deployments across development, staging, and production environments.
* Troubleshoot application, API, database, AI, integration, and deployment issues using logs, traces, errors, and reproduction steps.
* Validate fixes against customer-relevant scenarios and support releases, upgrades, and post-deployment checks.
* Coordinate infrastructure and platform-level issues with the appropriate engineering teams.

**8. Customer Feedback & Engineering Collaboration**

* Identify recurring customer problems and distinguish implementation needs from core product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback with technical details, reproduction steps, expected behavior, and customer impact.
* Identify opportunities to convert repeated implementation work into reusable product capabilities, tools, or documentation.
* Collaborate with AI, AI Agent, Data & AI, Backend, Platform, NLP/ML, and Product teams.
* Reduce customer-specific workarounds and avoid unnecessary product forks.

**Role Ownership**

* **Forward Deployed Engineer:**
  Owns customer discovery, solution design, implementation, integration, configuration, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and customer-facing technical delivery.
* **AI Engineer:**
  Owns reusable user-facing AI features and AI-powered application experiences.
* **AI Agent Engineer:**
  Owns agent orchestration, behavior, tool workflows, and core agent capabilities.
* **Data & AI Engineer:**
  Owns data connectivity, schema and metadata systems, semantic representations, and cross-database data correctness.
* **NLP/ML Engineer:**
  Owns model-level NLP and generation quality, including SQL-generation capabilities.
* **Platform Engineer:**
  Owns infrastructure, model access, deployment systems, observability, security, and platform-level connectivity.
* **Backend Engineer:**
  Owns core backend services, APIs, business logic, and shared application services.

The Forward Deployed Engineer configures and extends existing capabilities, validates customer deployments, and escalates core product changes to the appropriate teams rather than maintaining customer-specific forks.

**Customer Engagement Expectations**

* Work directly with customers across different technical and business environments.
* Support customer meetings and deployments across relevant time zones when required.
* Be willing to travel for customer meetings, workshops, deployments, and go-live activities when necessary.
* Manage multiple implementation activities while maintaining clear priorities and communication.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5 years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, technical consulting, or a related technical role.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience with APIs, databases, backend services, enterprise applications, and data integrations.
* Strong understanding of data workflows, SQL, and technical troubleshooting.
* Experience working with customers, stakeholders, or cross-functional technical teams.
* Familiarity with LLMs, Generative AI, and AI-powered applications.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate issues using logs, errors, configurations, and reproduction steps.
* Strong communication skills and comfort supporting customer environments and production deployments.
* Ability to manage multiple requirements and competing priorities effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Technical Implementation.
* Experience supporting product demonstrations, pilots, or proofs of concept.
* Experience with AI analytics, natural-language-to-SQL, or enterprise data applications.
* Experience with AI agents, tool calling, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with LangGraph, LangChain, or LlamaIndex.
* Experience with MCP and AI assistant integrations.
* Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.
* Experience with Docker and cloud or deployment platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Render, or Vercel.
* Experience with production deployments, AI evaluation, regression testing, observability, or production AI troubleshooting.

**Key Skills**

Python | SQL | APIs | Databases | Enterprise Data | System Integration | Generative AI | LLMs | AI Applications | Natural-Language-to-SQL | Data Analytics | AI Agents | MCP | Docker | Cloud | Customer Deployment | Production Troubleshooting | Technical Implementation | Technical Communication

**Why Join Trida Labs?**

At Trida Labs, you will work directly on real AI systems solving enterprise data and analytics problems.

You will collaborate with customers and engineering teams across solution design, AI implementation, enterprise data integration, evaluation, production troubleshooting, and product improvement—helping turn real customer requirements into reliable, reusable product capabilities.

**Equal Opportunity**

Trida Labs is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone has the opportunity to contribute and grow.

title: Data System Analyst
description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  
With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Ensuring processes are set up, operate efficiently and reliably, including data quality monitoring, automation development, and KPI reporting. Act as processual liaison between BMT operations and SAP COE, enabling data-driven decision-making and continuous process optimization.
  
  
Data Handover Process Design & Optimization
  
  

* Conduct current-state assessment of LoB billing data flows (interviews, process mapping, gap analysis)
* Design future-state data handover process with clear steps, roles (RACI), validation gates, and submission deadlines
* Develop and pilot to validate approach, select optimal solution (or hybrid) based on data quality, LoB effort reduction, scalability, and cost
* Deploy selected solution for Wave 1 (LoB 1) and refine for Waves 2-3 based on lessons learned

Data Quality Management
  
  

* Define "complete data" checklists by pricing type (fixed-fee, variable, basis points, T&E, complex)
* Design automated data validation rules (completeness, accuracy, consistency checks)
* Monitor data submissions for anomalies and quality issues
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies impacting invoice accuracy
* Coordinate with LoB operations teams on data quality improvements and training needs

Process Documentation & Knowledge Management
  
  

* Document end-to-end billing processes (as-is and to-be)
* Create standard operating procedures (SOPs) for data submission, validation, exception handling
* Develop data submission calendars, templates, and user guides for LoB teams
* Maintain process documentation repository ensuring version control and accessibility
* Support AD Academy with data handover training materials and LoB workshops

Reporting & Analytics
  
  

* Generate weekly data quality reports for PMO Lead and monthly summaries for Steering Committee
* Perform ad-hoc analysis supporting business questions

Stakeholder Coordination & Change Management
  
  

* Partner with LoB operations teams to co-design data handover workflows respecting their constraints
* Conduct LoB workshops training regional teams on new data submission processes
* Facilitate dry-run billing cycle validating end-to-end data flow
* Escalate chronic data quality issues to LoB Leaders and PMO Lead

**Your Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or related field
* 4-6 years experience in business process analysis, operations improvement, or data management (finance/billing domain preferred)
* Strong process mapping and optimization skills (Lean, Six Sigma Green Belt preferred)
* Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, macros, Power Query)
* Experience with data quality frameworks, validation rules, and reconciliation processes
* Familiarity with automation tools (UiPath, Power Automate, or similar RPA platforms)
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
* Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills (ability to work with LoB operations teams)
* SAP FI/AR knowledge helpful

**Key Compentencies**

* Process mapping and optimization (SIPOC, value stream analysis, workflow design)
* Data analysis and validation (quality frameworks, error taxonomies, reconciliation)
* Business analysis (requirements gathering, solution design, feasibility assessment)
* Stakeholder collaboration and facilitation (workshops, training, change management)
* Documentation and knowledge management (SOPs, templates, user guides)
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Communication (translating technical data concepts for operational audiences)

**What We Offer**
We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
  
  
**Our Global Benefits Also Include**

* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
  
  
(Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy-notice/)

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Job Description: Cloud Security Engineer
  
  
Reports to: Security Lead
  
  
Level: Mid (IC)
  
  
Mission
  
  
Own the identity, access, and network security control plane — CyberArk, Zscaler and Cloudflare — for a fast-scaling, AI-driven insurance infrastructure org. You'll take these tools from initial deployment handoff to steady, auditable, day-2 operations, and be the technical backbone the Security Lead relies on for privileged access and network security posture.
  
  
What you'll own
  
  

* CyberArk (PAM) — safe/policy design, privileged account lifecycle, credential rotation monitoring, access recertification
* Zscaler (SSE) — policy tuning, app onboarding, exception handling
* Cloudflare (WAF/CDN, and Zero Trust/Access if applicable) — rule tuning, DNS, edge security posture

Key responsibilities
  
  

* Take over day-2 administration of CyberArk from the implementation partner; ensure clean runbooks/SOPs exist and are maintained
* Run privileged access onboarding/offboarding and periodic access recertification, feeding evidence to the GRC Analyst for audit cycles
* Own Zscaler and Cloudflare policy baselines; manage exceptions without degrading security posture
* Partner with engineering teams as headcount scales to keep IAM and network controls usable, not just secure
* Support technical deep-dives requested by auditors or pen testers on identity/network architecture
* Identify opportunities to automate policy-drift detection and routine PAM/SSE administration, in line with the team's AI-driven, lean operating model
* Escalate control-design questions or audit findings on these tools to the Security Lead

What we're looking for
  
  

* 3–6+ years in security engineering, with hands-on ownership of at least one PAM platform (CyberArk strongly preferred) in production
* Working experience with a cloud SSE/ZTNA platform (Zscaler, Cloudflare Access, or similar) and a CDN/WAF
* Comfortable being the sole owner of high-scrutiny controls in an audited environment (SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar)
* Strong scripting/automation ability (Python, Terraform, or similar) to keep a lean team's operational load sustainable
* Clear written communication — you'll produce evidence and explanations auditors and pen testers can follow

Nice to have
  
  

* Insurance, financial services, or other regulated-industry background
* Experience standing up or maturing a PAM program from a fresh implementation
* Exposure to NAIC Insurance Data Security Model Law or similar state insurance regulatory frameworks

How we'll know you're succeeding
  
  

* CyberArk, Zscaler, and Cloudflare pass audit control tests with minimal findings
* Privileged access recertification completed on schedule every cycle
* No unplanned production impact from policy changes across owned tools
* Routine administration increasingly automated rather than manual quarter over quarter

title: Operational Risk, Assistant Manager
description:
Role Summary
  
  
State Street uses third parties to support internal processes and the delivery of products and services to clients. These relationships are evaluated and risk-assessed through the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Program.
  
  
The Third-Party Risk Management Associate will support the effective execution of activities across one or more TPRM lifecycle pillars. Depending on business requirements, the role may include reviewing TPRM cases and engagement records, reviewing and challenging inherent risk assessments, coordinating supplier due diligence outreach, monitoring and reviewing due diligence submissions, preparing executive summaries, and managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will apply sound risk judgement, identify and resolve data or process inconsistencies, maintain complete and accurate records, and communicate TPRM requirements and assessment outcomes clearly. The role requires close collaboration with Engagement Managers, third-party suppliers, risk-domain subject matter experts, Business Advisors, Procurement, Legal, and TPRM teams to support timely, consistent, policy-aligned, and audit-ready outcomes.
  
  
**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of State Street’s business lines, products and services, third-party operating model, and TPRM lifecycle requirements.
* Review and evaluate TPRM SNOW cases, Archer engagement records, assessment records, and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and compliance with applicable policies, standards and procedures
* Manage assigned case queues, review and effectively challenge TPRM cases and support business lines in faster onboarding of third-party suppliers.
* Identify inconsistencies or gaps in inherent risk questionnaire responses and work with Engagement Managers and relevant stakeholders to resolve issues before approval.
* Apply knowledge of inherent risk questionnaire logic, scoring, question interdependencies, and due diligence triggers to confirm that the resulting inherent risk rating and due diligence requirements are appropriate.
* Prepare and distribute due diligence questionnaires and supporting requirements to third-party suppliers or internal service providers within established timelines.
* Monitor due diligence progress, perform follow-ups and escalations, and maintain clear records of outreach, responses, decisions, and outstanding actions.
* Perform completeness and quality reviews of returned due diligence questionnaires and supporting artifacts before routing the assessment to the appropriate risk-domain subject matter experts.
* Coordinate follow-up questions, clarification discussions, and supplier meetings; track responses and facilitate resolution of outstanding items.
* Review and analyze due diligence results, assessment conclusions, control-effectiveness ratings, and identified findings to confirm that outcomes are sufficiently supported and accurately documented.
* Prepare clear, concise, and audit-ready executive summaries that communicate the engagement scope, inherent risk profile, due diligence results, control effectiveness, findings, residual concerns, and required acknowledgement or next steps.
* Coordinate executive-summary review and issuance with Engagement Managers, Executive Sponsors, Business Advisors, risk-domain subject matter experts, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with third-party suppliers, Engagement Managers, business stakeholders, Procurement, Legal, risk-domain subject matter experts, and TPRM partner teams.
* Explain TPRM requirements, risk-analysis conclusions, findings, and remediation expectations clearly and professionally, and guide stakeholders toward timely resolution.
* Ensure that TPRM decisions, approvals, exceptions, and supporting evidence are accurately captured in Archer and relevant repositories to support governance, audit, and regulatory review.
* Support the preparation of management information, metrics, trend analysis, and status reporting for TPRM leadership and governance forums.
* Maintain and enhance procedures, checklists, templates, job aids, frequently asked questions, and other process documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, data quality, control effectiveness, stakeholder experience, and consistency of TPRM outcomes.
* Participate in system testing, process-change initiatives, remediation programmes, quality-assurance reviews, audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Maintain flexibility to work across TPRM pillars and support emerging programmed priorities arising from business, regulatory, policy, technology, or operating-model changes.
* Perform all responsibilities in accordance with State Street’s risk appetite, policies, standards, ethical requirements, and control expectations.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of third-party risk management principles, lifecycle activities, and governance requirements within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Sound risk judgement and the ability to assess the reasonableness, completeness, and consistency of information and supporting evidence.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to identify gaps, challenge assumptions, and develop practical resolution paths.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong stakeholder and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes while maintaining professional and constructive working relationships.
* Ability to manage multiple cases, competing priorities, and tight deadlines in a high-volume, control-focused environment.
* Strong organizational, documentation, and time-management skills, with close attention to detail.
* Strong customer-centric mindset and commitment to providing clear guidance and responsive support to business and supplier stakeholders.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and related reporting tools.
* Working knowledge of Archer or a comparable governance, risk, and compliance platform is preferred.
* High ethical standards, professional integrity, and commitment to maintaining appropriate confidentiality.

**Qualifications**

* Overall professional experience of 7 or more years, preferably within banking, financial services, risk management, compliance, procurement, audit, controls, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in Third-Party Risk Management, operational risk, supplier risk, vendor management, due diligence, or another risk-and-control function.
* Practical experience in one or more of the following areas is preferred: TPRM case review, inherent risk assessment, due diligence outreach and completeness review, risk assessment coordination, findings management, executive-summary preparation, or stakeholder relationship management.
* General knowledge of third-party risk domains, including Operational Resiliency, Operational Risk, Cybersecurity, Information Sensitivity and Access, Privacy, Physical Security, Reputational Risk, Compliance, Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Bribery and Corruption, Financial Viability, and Tax Evasion.
* Experience working with internal stakeholders, third-party suppliers, and subject matter experts in a matrixed and globally distributed organization.
* Experience preparing management reporting, governance materials, executive communications, audit evidence, or regulatory-response documentation is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in business or a postgraduate management qualification is preferred.
* Relevant professional certification such as CRVPM, CRISC, CISM, CISA, CBCI, or an equivalent risk-management qualification is advantageous.
* Prior experience with Archer or a comparable governance, risk, and compliance platform is preferred.
* Please note: The role is required to support internal clients during the first half of US working hours.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
  
  
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

title: QA Automation Engineer (Remote, Full-Time) [HR217]
description:
**About Smart Working**

  
  

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

  
  

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

  

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

  
  

**About the Role**

  

As a QA Automation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality across a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo digital health platform. You will build the automated test framework hands-on, define expected behaviour, and help improve reliability from an existing baseline where test coverage and pass rates need strengthening.

  

You will work with an engineering team of 4, collaborating to understand how the system should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives. The role is predominantly hands-on and independent, with shared responsibility for product quality.

  

The first phase will involve speaking with stakeholders, clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and building out automation that enables faster, safer releases.

**Responsibilities**
  

  
* Own the quality process end to end and build the automated test framework hands-on.
  
* Understand how a large, roughly 10-year, multi-repo system works and how it should work from client, end-user and internal operations perspectives.
  
* Ask the right questions and document expected behaviour where inherited documentation is partly out of date.
  
* Author English-readable scenarios in Cucumber and Gherkin.
  
* Build automation in JavaScript and TypeScript.
  
* Drive the UI through a page object model.
  
* Add data-test-ids to React code where missing.
  
* Validate correct database state using SQL.
  
* Maintain the automated tests as new features arrive.
  
* Feed into requirements upfront as new features are planned.
  
* Flag compliance, regulatory and security implications.
  
* Run exploratory testing to identify where the product behaves incorrectly.
  
* Improve reliability and enable faster, safer releases through automation.
  
* Reproduce multi-step defects precisely and identify edge cases.
  
* Build a repeatable, documented QA process from an unreliable baseline.
  
* Work out how the system should behave across multiple user perspectives and how it might break.
  

  
**Requirements**
  

  
* 4+ years of experience in QA or test automation, hands-on with TypeScript or JavaScript.
  
* 4+ years of hands-on test automation coding in TypeScript or JavaScript.
  
* 2+ years of BDD test authoring with Cucumber and Gherkin.
  
* 3+ years of web UI test automation using a page object model, preferably with Playwright.
  
* 2+ years of end-to-end QA ownership, including defining, documenting, building and maintaining tests.
  
* 3+ years of requirements analysis and stakeholder communication.
  
* 2+ years of SQL querying to validate database state, using MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  
* 3+ years of exploratory testing and precise multi-step defect reproduction.
  
* Ability to drive automation and own the build with limited direction.
  
* Strong detail orientation, including the ability to spot edge cases and gaps in specifications.
  
* Hands-on JavaScript or TypeScript automation coding is non-negotiable; willingness to learn is not sufficient.
  

  
**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Mobile app testing and automation experience, especially with Flutter apps.
  
* Experience with Appium or Flutter integration\_test.
  
* Experience reading and working with React front-end code.
  
* Experience with Angular, Vue or another modern JavaScript framework.
  
* Security and regulatory awareness, including ISO 27001, GDPR or NHS DTAC.
  
* Experience in another regulated or audited environment.
  
* ISO 13485 medical-device regulated-environment testing.
  
* Experience in an adjacent regulated domain such as medtech, fintech or NHS/DTAC.
  
* Healthtech or digital health domain experience.
  
* Comfort using AI in the engineering workflow.
  

  
**Benefits**
  

  
* Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
  
* No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words
  
* Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided
  
* Support That Matters:Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
  
* True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued

title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Enterprise Automation
description:
As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Revenue Platform Automation division, you’ll lead the engineering efforts driving our Sales, Customer Success (CS), and Finance technology stack. You’ll ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across these platforms, with a strong focus on backend and data-driven solutions. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our systems are robust, integrated, and aligned with the company's strategic objectives. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend technical expertise with leadership skills, driving impactful change in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
You will build and lead a team of talented engineers responsible for developing and maintaining automation solutions for our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technologies. You’ll train and mentor team members, identify and resolve impediments, oversee the integrity of software estimations, and ensure that code and tests meet high standards while keeping scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind.
  
  
This is a backend-focused role, leveraging your strong background in Java, Python, workflow automation solutions (Workato), web services (REST/OpenAPI), messaging frameworks (Kafka), data platforms (Snowflake), cloud technologies (AWS/GCP), and containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) to build innovative solutions. You’ll use your strong knowledge of Sales, Customer Success, and Finance business domains and tools to build complete solutions in sales automation (Salesforce, Service Cloud), finance automation (ERP/billing/CPQ/payment), and customer insights (Catalyst/Gainsight). You’ll ensure your team masters their discrete business domains, maintaining ownership, and accountability for their deliverables. You will oversee the development of strong test automation suites, aligning with automated build & CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native delivery.
  
  
Your ability to collaborate with product management, provide leadership across multiple locations, set high standards for the team, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to your success. You’ll solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, inspire creative thinking, and help foster a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose.
  
  
Your responsibilities span across the Sales & Customer Success Platform and Finance Platform teams, each of which are cross-functional teams consisting of product management, product ownership, and engineers who are responsible for our core Revenue Technology stack. The Senior Engineering Manager oversees the engineers/testers on the teams, identifying and overseeing the solutions that meet internal customers’ needs.
  
  
**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and inspire a team of skilled engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability. Provide guidance and support to ensure team growth and success, empowering them with autonomy and ownership
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of automation solutions for our revenue platforms. Ensure the highest quality code with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Your back-end expertise allows you to dive into the codebase when needed, ensuring alignment with best practices
* Ensure that our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance systems, particularly those centered around Salesforce and its ecosystem, are robust, optimized, and seamlessly integrated
* Lead efforts to enhance system performance, drive innovation, and implement scalable solutions that align with the company’s strategic objectives
* Leverage your strong background in Java, Python, data platforms, workflow automation, software architecture, messaging frameworks, and cloud technologies to drive the technical direction of our revenue platforms. Ensure the adoption of best practices in automation, web services, test automation, and cloud-native delivery
* Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams to align engineering efforts with business goals. Translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies to drive impactful change
* Oversee the integrity of software estimations and ensure high standards of performance, reliability, and security in the systems developed by your team. Vigilantly identify and resolve impediments, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope
* Drive innovation within the revenue technology stack. Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, tools, and systems, ensuring our technology remains at the cutting edge
* Play a key role in hiring, training, and retaining top engineering talent. Set a high bar for performance, create opportunities for professional growth, and cultivate an environment where team members feel valued and motivated
* Establish and drive a culture rooted in belonging, psychological safety, candor, connection, cooperation, and fun. Solicit feedback, engage with empathy, and build strong relationships across the organization to foster an environment where innovative ideas can thrive
* Apply Agile, Lean, and principles of fast flow to enhance team efficiency and productivity
* Model and encourage desired behaviors to support the company’s vision and values. Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested

**Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering with deep experience in software integration and workflow automation, particularly in Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technology stacks
* 7+ years in an Engineering leadership role with direct management responsibilities of at least 3 people
* 7+ years of experience in hands-on coding and delivering services that are provided “as a service” to other teams as part of a large-scale distributed microservices architecture
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and mentoring engineering teams
* Expert-level skills in Java, Python, and SQL
* Deep understanding of sales automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and related technologies, including ERP tools, payment automation, billing automation, and CPQ
* Experience with containerization technologies, including Kubernetes and Docker, and an understanding of how to build cloud-scale delivery, including scalability, resiliency, and recoverability
* Solid understanding of software development methodologies, Agile practices, and DevOps principles
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on innovation, efficiency, and scalability
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Experience in the financial industry or B2B platforms is a plus

**Working Conditions**
The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

description:
**About This Role**
**About Global Fixed Income Team**
BlackRock’s active fixed income portfolio strategies stretch across a range of investment styles and segments of the fixed income universe. The breadth and depth of our platform puts us in a strong position to potentially deliver attractive returns in various market environments. With a focus on alpha generation and risk management, the team uses a top-down view from lead portfolio managers and bottom-up expertise from our sector specialists
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Software Testing Analyst to help deliver reliable web applications, APIs, data integrations, and AI-powered features. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to define quality criteria, identify risks early, and assess whether features are ready for release.

* Review requirements and define acceptance criteria, test plans, and regression scenarios.
* Assess AI-generated responses for relevance, factual support, consistency, and correct use of supporting sources.
* Validate data across application screens, APIs, databases, and generated outputs.
* Cover edge cases and failure scenarios, including invalid inputs, timeouts, interrupted requests, and access restrictions.
* Own defects from discovery through resolution: investigate issues, communicate their impact, and verify fixes.
* Build and maintain automated checks, reusable test data, and quality documentation.
* Communicate quality risks and provide clear recommendations on release readiness.

**Must know**

* Test-case design, manual testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Programming in Python, Java, or a similar language, with the ability to write validation scripts.
* API testing, including HTTP, JSON, and response validation.
* SQL for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Test automation using a framework such as pytest, Selenium, or Playwright.
* SDLC, STLC, Git, and collaborative delivery practices.
* Structured problem-solving and clear communication.

**Good to know**

* Quality evaluation for AI applications, including prompt variations, unsupported claims, source grounding, and response quality.
* Large language model and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) concepts.
* CI/CD pipelines, application logs, and browser developer tools.
* Accessibility, performance, and security testing.

Relevant experience may come from professional work, internships, or substantial projects. We value someone who takes initiative and can drive quality from requirements through release.
  
  
**Education & Qualifications**

* 1-3 years of relevant work experience

**Problem-Solving**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About us:**

At PadCare, we’re on a mission to make hygiene sustainable. Founded in 2018, we have developed India’s first patented sanitary napkin recycling technology—PadCareX.

But we’re not just solving a waste problem, we’re building a circular economy that champions environmental resilience and social equity. Our service model closes the loop starting from collection, recycling, and transforming single-use sanitary napkins into sustainable materials, while also creating dignified jobs for marginalized waste workers, especially women, across the country.

With 100+ changemakers across 25+ cities, PadCare is driving real impact—for people and the planet. Recognized by Forbes, the World Economic Forum, and more, we believe business can be a force for good. If you do too, PadCare is where your purpose finds a home.

Oh, and you must have seen us on an episode of Shark Tank India, Season 2 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q0cmPtpJRo

To learn more about the work that PadCare is doing, check out the website: www.padcarelabs.com

**Role overview & Key Responsibilities:**

We are hiring a full-time Product Analyst to own modules of our internal Order-to-Cash platform, end to end, working directly with the Product Lead. The core of the role is building requirements: understanding the business process, identifying its gaps, and structuring it into a complete system module that accounts for every case, validation and dependency. You will also test what gets built and make sure the delivered solution matches what was defined.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Requirement building (core)

• Understand business workflows across Sales, Onboarding, Operations and Finance, and identify

process gaps and inefficiencies

• Structure each process into a system module with clear flows and flow charts

• Cover every scenario the module must handle (standard, exception and edge cases) before it

goes to development

• Define fields and data structures, validation rules, dependencies and conditions

• Own and maintain the functional specification for each assigned module

2. Testing and quality assurance

• Write and execute functional test cases for every release

• Run end-to-end workflow testing and user acceptance testing (UAT)

• Log, prioritise and re-test bugs through the periodic bug-fix cycles

3. Development partner coordination

• Work with the external development team on assigned modules

• Track tasks, follow-ups and requirement clarifications

• Ensure the delivered solution matches the defined requirement

4. Data checks for owned modules

• Validate data for the modules you own, including post-go-live accuracy checks

• Work alongside the data management team where module data is involved

**What we're looking for:**

**Must-have**

• 1–3 years in a product, business analyst or functional/QA role on software or ERP projects

• Hands-on experience writing functional specs or BRDs and test cases

• Experience working with development teams through build, testing and release

• Strong analytical and logical thinking; able to structure problems into clear workflows

• Basic understanding of APIs and system design: data flow, validations, logic layers

• Attention to detail and execution focus

• Clear communication across business and tech teams

**Good-to-have**

• Exposure to ERP tools, especially Zoho Books

• Familiarity with Order-to-Cash or billing processes

• Basic SQL

• Exposure to AI or automation use cases (document processing, workflow automation)

Tools you will use

• HTML (basic UI understanding)

• AI tools for productivity and documentation

• Excel and basic analytics tools

**Culture Fit:**
Must align with PadCare’s values – Integrity, Entrepreneurship, Collaboration, Customer-First, Innovation.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time; based in Pune.

**Why join us:**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive salary in line with industry standards.
* **Growth Path:**
  Opportunity to scale into Head of Research and beyond as PadCare expands globally.
* **Purpose With Impact:**
  Join a mission-driven team transforming menstrual hygiene through sustainable solutions that uplift women’s health, the environment, and sanitation workers' dignity.
* **Eco-Warrior in Action:**
  Help recycle millions of sanitary pads and actively reduce landfill waste and carbon emissions—real impact, not just buzzwords.
* **Innovation Meets Heart:**
  Be part of a team that blends empathy with patented 5D recycling tech to build the future of circular economy.
* **Grow With Us:**
  We’re a fast-gowing, venture-backed startup offering real opportunities to scale your career as we scale our impact.
* **A Culture That Cares:**
  Work in a space where collaboration, inclusivity, and purpose aren’t just values—they’re how we roll every day.

title: SW QA Engineer - Associate , Physics AI
description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Our Shared Engineering Services team is at the forefront of validating and releasing the cutting-edge Simcenter™ portfolio. Our simulation software and test solutions help companies predict product performance across a broad range of engineering domains - from 3D CAE and system simulation to physical testing.
  
  
We are looking for a technically strong Software QA Engineer - Physics AI to help ensure the quality, accuracy, robustness, and reliability of AI-enabled engineering simulation capabilities.
  
  
In this role, you will combine your knowledge of CAE, physics-based simulation, Engineering AI, and software quality to validate AI/ML models and their integration into desktop simulation products. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, product teams, software developers, and applications engineers to assess whether AI predictions are accurate, robust, physically meaningful, and reliable when compared with traditional simulation or solver results.
  
  
This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys complex technical problem-solving, understands engineering simulation workflows, and wants to contribute to the evolution of AI-enabled physics and simulation software.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Validate Physics AI capabilities: Work closely with AI/ML engineers to understand the underlying physics models, simulation workflows, and algorithms, and validate the accuracy, robustness, fidelity, and consistency of AI predictions against traditional solver or reference results.
* Own end-to-end quality: Drive QA activities across the software development lifecycle, independently planning and executing quality activities to ensure reliable delivery of AI-enabled simulation capabilities.
* Design comprehensive testing: Review user stories, requirements, and design documentation for testability and develop functional, stress, performance, and end-to-end test scenarios aligned with engineering use cases.
* Develop and maintain test automation: Create, execute, and maintain automated tests using scripting and automation frameworks, while improving existing test suites and porting automation to high-performance systems where appropriate.
* Investigate complex technical issues: Go beyond identifying defects by reproducing issues, analyzing logs and system behavior, investigating root causes, and collaborating with Development and AI/ML teams to drive resolution.
* Improve quality engineering practices: Identify potential risks proactively, research complex problems, introduce effective solutions, and champion best practices in software quality, automation, and testing of Physics AI capabilities.
* Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with Development, AI/ML Engineering, DevOps, Product Management, Applications Engineering, and other teams in a globally distributed environment.

**Qualifications**

* 4–6+ years of relevant technical experience in CAE, engineering simulation, design verification, Physics AI, Engineering AI, or a related domain, along with hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering or software validation.
* 1–3+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, preferably for complex engineering or desktop software products.
* Strong understanding of CAE and engineering simulation workflows, with the ability to analyze simulation results and assess their technical and physical reasonableness.
* Exposure to AI/ML or Engineering AI, with the ability to understand and validate AI-driven predictions against physics-based, simulation, or solver-generated reference results.
* Experience with desktop simulation or engineering software such as Simcenter, CAD/CAE applications, or similar products; experience with HyperView, Simcenter 3D Post, or equivalent post-processing tools is highly valuable.
* Proficiency in Python, C, or similar scripting/programming languages, with hands-on experience developing or maintaining automated tests using PyTest, Ranorex, Selenium, or comparable frameworks.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently, investigate complex technical issues, and contribute effectively in cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience testing or validating AI/ML models, Physics AI, surrogate models, or AI-enabled engineering applications.
* Experience comparing AI predictions with traditional CAE/CFD/FEA solver results, experimental data, or other engineering reference data.
* Familiarity with Windows and UNIX/Linux environments and cross-platform desktop software testing.
* Experience with JIRA, Xray, Git, and modern test automation frameworks.
* Experience with functional, regression, stress, performance, and system-level testing.
* Strong attention to detail, curiosity, self-motivation, and the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar engineering and software technologies.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. At Siemens, we believe people who've had real experiences dealing with being different will excel as leaders. Let's foster a culture of creativity and innovation. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. title: RCM Quality Auditor - Payment Posting
description:
In office - Shift hours M-F 730pm IST to 430am IST
  
  
The RCM Quality Auditor Payment Posting checks the work our Revenue Cycle Services teams produce, including coding, charges, claims, payment postings, AR follow-up and denial work, and catches errors before they cost our clients money or create compliance risk.
  
  
The role will score work fairly and consistently, explain clearly what went wrong and why, and help teams fix the underlying problem so it doesn't keep happening. The area you audit will depend on your background and where the business needs coverage, and you may audit more than one.
  
  
**Audit the work**

* Audit plan: Run audits against the approved monthly plan, including random samples, targeted samples (high-dollar accounts, complex specialties or remits, new payers and new clients) and 100% audits for new joiners or associates on a performance improvement plan.
* Source checks: Validate each audited item against source documents such as superbills, encounter forms, EMR notes, charge logs, ERAs/EOBs and payer correspondence.
* Coding and charge entry: Verify demographics, insurance, date and place of service, rendering/billing/referring provider, CPT/HCPCS and ICD-10-CM codes and linkage, modifiers, units, charge amounts and authorisation numbers, along with NCCI, MUE and LCD/NCD requirements.
* Payment posting: Verify billed, allowed and paid amounts, contractual adjustments, patient responsibility, group and CARC/RARC codes, PLB adjustments, secondary claim triggers and deposit reconciliation.
* AR and denials: Confirm that follow-up actions are correct, documented and on time, that denials land in the right work queue, and that appeals meet payer requirements.
* Rejections and exceptions: Review clearinghouse rejections, scrubber edits and auto-post exceptions, and confirm fixes were made correctly and on time.
* Gaps and leakage: Flag missed, duplicate or late charges, suspected underpayments, incorrect write-offs and unreconciled variances.

**Find the root cause and fix it**

* Error classification: Classify errors using the approved scoring matrix: critical or non-critical, financial or non-financial, process-based or knowledge-based.
* Feedback: Give associates and Team Leads clear, evidence-backed feedback within 24–48 hours, and track that it is acknowledged and closed.
* Root cause analysis: Dig into repeat or high-impact errors, find the root cause, and help build and track corrective actions (CAPA) such as retraining, SOP updates and checklist changes. Then check that the fix worked.
* Calibration: Run or join regular calibration sessions with peer auditors, Team Leads, operations and client QA so scoring stays consistent and defensible.
* Training support: Spot skill gaps from audit data, recommend refresher training, help onboard new joiners, and keep job aids and reference guides current.
* Trends: Share payer-level patterns, such as denial spikes, recoupments and underpayments, with the AR and Denial Management teams.

**Report, escalate and stay compliant**

* Records: Keep audit logs, error trackers, feedback sheets and calibration records complete, with evidence for every finding in an audit-ready file structure.
* Reporting: Publish daily, weekly and monthly quality reports and scorecards at associate, team and client level, including RCA reports and trend charts for leadership.
* Escalation: Escalate critical errors right away, especially anything with revenue, compliance or timely filing impact.
* Client support: Prepare quality summaries and action plans for client quality calls, answer client quality questions with data and clear timelines, and submit client scorecards on time.
* Compliance: Follow HIPAA, PHI handling standards, CMS rules and Veradigm information security policies at all times, and support internal and client compliance audits.
* Staying current: Track annual CPT, HCPCS and ICD-10-CM updates and payer policy changes, and flag any needed changes to SOPs and payer rule references.

**Help improve the process**

* Automation: Point out repetitive QA tasks that could be automated, and take part in Lean, Six Sigma and AI-assisted audit pilots.
* Transitions: Support new client transitions, process documentation and knowledge assessments.

**Benefits**
Veradigm believes in empowering our associates with the tools and flexibility to bring the best version of themselves to work. Through our generous benefits package with an emphasis on work/life balance, we give our employees the opportunity to allow their careers to flourish.
  
  

* Quarterly Company-Wide Recharge Days
* Peer-based incentive “Cheer” awards
* Tuition Reimbursement Program

Veradigm is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse and inclusive workforce.

title: Performance Engineer -  Performance Testing, JMeter, Load Runner, API Performance & Java/JVM
description:
**Scope**

* We provide 3PL customers with the integrated supply chain solution for planning, TMS, OMS & WMS.
* The 3PL PSR team works closely with QA, Development, DevOps, DBA, Solution Architect and Infrastructure teams to ensure applications meet performance and scalability requirements.
* The role requires both hands-on performance engineering and architectural understanding, ensuring scalable and future-ready implementations.
* The individual will be responsible for designing, planning, and executing performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability testing for enterprise applications.
* Also, the individual will be responsible for analysing application behaviour and identify performance bottlenecks across application, database, infrastructure, and network layers.

**Technical Environment**

* Performance Testing Tools: Jmeter
* API/Application: REST APIs, JSON/XML, HTTP/HTTPS, Web applications, Microservices, Postman
* Scripting & Development: JavaScript, Groovy, Python, Shell scripting
* Databases: Oracle, MariaDb; SQL query analysis and database performance analysis
* Database Performance: Oracle AWR/ASH, execution plans, SQL tuning, database CPU/memory/I/O analysis
* Application & JVM Monitoring: JVM, Garbage Collection (GC), Heap/Thread Dumps, JProfiler, Eclipse MAT or equivalent tools
* Infrastructure & Monitoring: Linux, Kubernetes, Docker, OCI/Azure, CPU/Memory/Disk/Network monitoring, Grafana, OEM
* DevOps/Agile: Git, Jenkins
* Cloud: OCI/Azure integrations
* Others: RDP/SSH, Linux command-line utilities, log analysis, performance profiling, capacity planning, and production performance monitoring.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and execute performance, load, stress, endurance, and scalability tests for enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain JMeter/API performance test scripts, workload models, test data, and execution scenarios.
* Analyse application performance across application, database, JVM, infrastructure, and network layers.
* Monitor system behaviour during load tests and identify CPU, memory, database, JVM, I/O, and response-time bottlenecks.
* Perform root-cause analysis of performance issues using application logs, monitoring tools, AWR/ASH reports, thread dumps, heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Work closely with Developers, QA, DBAs, DevOps, and Infrastructure teams to troubleshoot and resolve performance issues.
* Analyse test results and prepare performance reports, dashboards, and recommendations for stakeholders.
* Support capacity planning, scalability assessment, and production-readiness reviews.
* Identify opportunities to automate performance testing, monitoring, and reporting to improve efficiency and repeatability.
* Participate in release planning and provide performance assessment and recommendations for production deployment.
* Communicate performance findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in Performance Testing / Performance Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with JMeter and performance test scripting.
* Good understanding of load, stress, endurance, scalability, and volume testing.
* Strong experience in API performance testing using REST/HTTP, JSON/XML, and Postman.
* Good understanding of Java/JVM, including heap, threads, GC, and JVM tuning.
* Experience with JProfiler, Eclipse MAT, thread/heap dumps, and GC logs.
* Experience with Linux/Unix, shell scripting, and application/log analysis.
* Good knowledge of SQL and database performance, preferably Oracle, including AWR/ASH and execution plan analysis on OEM.
* Experience with Grafana, Prometheus, InfluxDB, or equivalent monitoring tools.

title: Sr. Analyst, Implementation
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary — The Why Now**
As Avalara scales its Go Live function to support New Product Introductions (NPI) and enterprise-level customer growth, we need Senior Analysts who do more than execute — they lead, design, and elevate. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) operates at the intersection of complex enterprise implementation delivery, cross-functional product collaboration, and practice development.
  
  
Where the I3 Analyst owns individual customer implementation success, the I3 Senior Analyst owns the quality and scalability of how implementations are delivered — for the most complex customers, across new and evolving products, and in close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  
  
This role exists to accelerate Avalara's ability to onboard enterprise customers at scale, introduce new products effectively, and continuously raise the implementation standard across the Go Live team. The I3 is a force multiplier: their impact is felt not just in their own portfolio, but in the capability and quality of the broader team.
  
  
How This Role Elevates Avalara
  
  

* For customers: Enterprise and multi-product customers receive expert implementation guidance, proactive risk management, and deep technical partnership — resulting in faster time-to-value and stronger long-term adoption.
* For the team: The Senior Analyst sets the implementation quality standard — authoring playbooks, mentoring I3 analysts, and identifying process improvements that raise team-wide performance.
* For the business: Directly supports ARR growth by enabling complex enterprise wins, supporting the sales cycle with pre-sales expertise, and accelerating NPI readiness across implementation teams.
* For our AI-first strategy: Designs and deploys AI-driven implementation workflows at a team level — moving beyond personal productivity to scalable automation that benefits the entire Go Live function.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Enterprise & Multi-Product Implementation Leadership**

* Lead customer implementations involving multiple Avalara products and enterprise-level platforms including complex ERP, POS, and ecommerce environments (e.g., NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce, SAP).
* Act as the primary implementation authority for high-complexity, high-stakes customer engagements — setting strategy, managing scope, and driving outcomes from kickoff to Go Live.
* Clearly define, articulate, and manage scope of work for client-initiated implementation and data service projects, including change management when scope evolves.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Enablement**

* Partner with Avalara Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop implementation approach documentation, onboarding frameworks, and training materials for new product launches.
* Serve as a subject matter expert during NPI cycles — identifying implementation risks, documenting configuration requirements, and ensuring Go Live readiness before product release.
* Identify bugs, integration gaps, or UX friction during NPI implementations and partner with Engineering to track and resolve them.

**Practice Development & Quality Elevation**

* Own and evolve Go Live practice standards — documenting business processes, designing implementation playbooks, and proposing best practices for sales and use tax automation onboarding.
* Develop and document business requirements related to implementation workflows, data transformation, and cross-system reporting.
* Lead testing plan design and execution for complex implementations, ensuring customers go live on validated, stable configurations.
* Mentor and provide structured guidance to I2 Analysts — reviewing implementation quality, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of junior team members.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support pre-sales activities — including scoping, solution design input, and customer-facing technical presentations.
* Engage cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance to resolve systemic implementation blockers and drive process improvements at scale.
* Represent the Go Live team's perspective in strategic planning discussions, NPI readiness reviews, and cross-departmental initiatives.

**Customer Success & Risk Management**

* Monitor project health across assigned accounts — proactively identifying risk factors, intervening early, and resolving escalations with speed and precision.
* Provide strategic guidance to customers on best practices and use cases across a range of business models and tax compliance needs.
* Support customers in developing and executing testing plans, ensuring technical readiness before Go Live.

**AI-Driven Practice Scaling**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows at a team level — building reusable Glean AI agents, prompt libraries, and automation tools that improve implementation quality and speed across the Go Live function.
* Share AI innovations, document their impact, and drive adoption across I2 and I3 peers.

**12-Month Success Signals**
A successful Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) at the end of 12 months will have:
  
  

* Led multiple enterprise or multi-product implementations to successful Go Live with measurably shorter cycle times and low escalation rates, demonstrating ownership at a higher complexity tier than I2.
* Delivered at least two NPI readiness contributions — documented implementation playbooks, training materials, or bug reports — that were formally adopted by the Go Live or Product teams.
* Authored or significantly improved at least two Go Live practice standards or playbooks, with measurable adoption and quality impact across the team.
* Mentored at least two I2 Analysts with demonstrable improvement in their implementation quality metrics or time-to-competency.
* Built and deployed at least one AI-powered workflow (e.g., a Glean agent, automation script, or prompt framework) that generated measurable time savings or quality improvements at a team level — not just personally.
* Supported at least one pre-sales engagement in partnership with the Sales or Account Management team, contributing to a customer expansion or new business outcome.

AI Expectations
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first company. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) is expected to operate as an AI Bar Raiser — not just embedding AI into their own work, but actively raising AI capability across the Go Live team.
  
  
**Specific Expectations Include**

* Design and build reusable AI tools — including Glean AI agents, automated documentation workflows, and AI-assisted risk detection models — that are shared and adopted across the team.
* Use AI to analyze implementation portfolio data at scale, identifying patterns in at-risk implementations, NPI friction points, or recurring ERP configuration issues, and translating insights into proactive action.
* Deploy AI to accelerate NPI documentation, training material generation, and business requirements capture — dramatically compressing the time from product release to team readiness.
* Use AI to support customer communication at scale — generating implementation status summaries, tailored onboarding guidance, and escalation documentation with speed and precision.
* Coach I2 Analysts on applied AI usage, sharing effective practices and helping peers move from casual familiarity to embedded, outcome-driven AI workflows.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, in full compliance with Avalara's data governance and AI ethics policies.

Candidates must demonstrate specific, quantified examples of AI usage that improved team-level outcomes — not just personal efficiency. Senior Analysts who cannot clearly articulate their AI impact across a team or function do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard for this level.
  
  
What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Required**
Bachelor’s in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline (BCA, MCA, B.Tech from an accredited institution). Open to hire from Commerce background given strong technical acumen or expertise of implementation.
  
  

* 4–7 years of software implementation or delivery experience, preferably within the B2B SaaS sector, with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity.
* Proven ability to lead complex, enterprise-level software implementations across multiple products and ERP/ecommerce environments.
* Strong ability to articulate process logic and technical architecture — including design and delivery of functional and technical presentations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of accounting and tax processes, including sales and use tax compliance automation concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional conversations and drive alignment.
* Experience contributing to practice improvement — documenting business processes, designing best practices, or owning team-level standards.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset — takes initiative at a team level, holds peers accountable with coaching (not criticism), and drives outcomes without requiring direction.
* Embodies Avalara's Success Traits: Ownership, Simplicity, Curiosity, Adaptability, Urgency, Optimism, and Humility.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience configuring or integrating enterprise ERPs such as NetSuite, Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce Commerce, Sage, or WooCommerce.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Jira, or equivalent CRM and project tracking platforms.
* Prior exposure to tax automation software implementation or tax-related roles.
* Experience in NPI or product launch support — working alongside Product Management or Engineering to prepare implementation teams for new releases.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and integration architecture concepts.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or developing junior team members.

**Bar Raiser Expectation**
At Avalara, We Hire Only Those Who Raise The Bar — Not Those Who Merely Meet It. A Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) Who Is a Bar Raiser
  
  

* Improves the average performance of the team simply by being present — through coaching, example, and a consistent commitment to quality.
* Brings data, structure, and strategic thinking to conversations about risk, prioritization, process design, and escalation.
* Challenges assumptions respectfully and proposes better approaches — even when it's uncomfortable.
* Leaves every customer engagement, process, team interaction, and system in a measurably stronger state than they found it.
* Continuously develops technical, functional, and AI capabilities — and actively helps peers do the same.
* Demonstrates strong judgment in tradeoff decisions, especially when they affect customers, timelines, or team capacity.

Being a Bar Raiser at the I3 level means raising the entire team's execution quality — not just excelling individually.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.
