Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data.
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth.
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery.
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap.

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

* Maintain OIDC-based workload identity federation and secure deployment practices.

* Improve developer workflows, pre-commit tooling, and code quality automation.
* Establish internal platform standards and engineering best practices.
* Support trunk-based development and modern release management.

**Reliability and Operations**

* Monitor infrastructure health, availability, and cloud costs.
* Troubleshoot production incidents and deployment issues.
* Implement backup, failover, and disaster recovery strategies.
* Maintain highly available production infrastructure and shared services.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6–9 years of hands-on experience in DevOps or Platform Engineering, preferably in a product or SaaS environment.
* Strong expertise in AWS infrastructure and practical experience with Azure cloud services.
* Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Docker, containerization, Linux, and scripting using Bash, Python, or similar languages.
* Experience with IAM, RBAC, ABAC, and cloud security best practices.
* Good understanding of networking, DNS, VPCs, load balancing, and cloud architecture.
* Understanding of OIDC federation and credential-less deployment patterns.
* Experience with enterprise security and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 or HIPAA.
* Strong systems-thinking skills and the ability to collaborate across engineering and product teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing multi-tenant or enterprise SaaS environments.
* Familiarity with identity and authentication technologies such as JWT, RS256, RBAC, MFA, and Casbin.
* Exposure to Snowflake or other modern data platforms.
* Hands-on Kubernetes experience.
* Experience in pharmaceutical technology, life sciences, healthcare, or health data products.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation aligned with industry benchmarks.
* Direct access to leadership and ownership of platform strategy.
* An opportunity to build and operate modern AI analytics infrastructure.
* A fast-paced, high-growth environment that encourages learning, innovation, and experimentation.

Translate overarching business goals into scalable, resilient, and decoupled platform capabilities.

* Enterprise CI/CD & Developer Experience (DevEx): Architect automated, self-service golden paths and progressive delivery pipelines (canary, blue-green) that minimize cognitive load for application developers while ensuring strict deployment guardrails.
* Zero-Trust Security & Policy-as-Code: Embed DevSecOps at the architectural level—designing policy-as-code frameworks (OPA/Kyverno), centralized secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), secure supply chain standards (SBOM, image signing, Trivy), and compliance baselines (SOC 2, ISO 27001).
* Observability, SRE & Chaos Engineering: Design holistic telemetry strategies utilizing OpenTelemetry. Define enterprise SLI/SLO standards, error budget policies, resilience testing/chaos engineering, and lead complex root-cause analyses (RCA) for critical production incidents.
* FinOps & Performance Optimization: Architect cost-efficient cloud topologies. Establish capacity planning models, multi-region traffic routing, right-sizing strategies, and automated cost-governance guardrails.

* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in Platform Engineering, SRE, Distributed Systems, or Cloud Architecture, with a proven track record of designing and operating large-scale, production-grade distributed systems.
* Architecture & System Design: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex, highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure cloud topologies (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

* Infrastructure-as-Code Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform(custom provider/module development, state locking, drift detection) and Policy-as-Code engines (e.g., OPA, Rego, Kyverno).
* Kubernetes Internals: Comprehensive understanding of Kubernetes internals (control plane components, CNI/CSI, custom controllers/operators, RBAC, API extensions, and scheduling primitives).
* Mentorship & Influence: Proven track record of guiding junior engineers, driving engineering consensus across disparate teams, and leading technical initiatives without direct authority.
* Observability & Reliability: Hands-on experience with modern observability platforms, distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana ecosystems, and enterprise SRE practices.

* Experience designing, building, or operating large-scale Data Platforms is highly desirable.
* Active contributions to open-source cloud-native projects (CNCF ecosystem).

title: Lead, Platform Engineering
description:
The Infrastructure Engineering team is responsible for building and maintaining a self-service internal development platform that enables MongoDB engineering teams to reliably deploy and operate their own production services and products. We work with numerous engineering teams across the company to understand their infrastructure requirements and development workflows, develop broadly applicable self-service platform services and tooling, continuously monitor how platform services are being utilized, and look for ways to improve developer productivity through automation and education.
  
  
We are big open source enthusiasts and use a number of open source tools in our stack (contributing upstream whenever possible). Some of the tools we use regularly include Go, AWS, Kubernetes, Crossplane, Terraform, Helm, Drone, Prometheus, and Grafana. However, technology is nothing without a stellar team of engineers that are focused on doing high quality work and working as a team to solve complex distributed computing and platform engineering problems. This is where you come in!
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Our ideal candidate
  
  

* 2+ years of experience managing and mentoring a team of 3+ engineers
* Has 5+ years of experience owning the design and implementation of large software/infrastructure projects
* Has built and operated large-scale distributed systems in cloud providers (AWS strongly preferred)
* Has a strong backend programming background. Fluency in Go is strongly preferred; deep experience with another compiled or strongly-typed backend language is acceptable
* Pragmatic, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and understands the benefits of collaboration
* Strong experience operating production Kubernetes clusters, not just deployed to it
* Has practical experience defining and operating against SLI/SLOs for services they owned
* Strong experience with observability tooling: metrics, logging, traces, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry
* Strong Linux and TCP/IP networking skills
* Familiar with standard authentication protocols (OAuth, OIDC)
* Familiar with web services and/or Kubernetes controller development
* Strong experience using CI/CD workflows to deploy production services
* Has experience working with AI coding agents and can demonstrate building high quality context to yield high quality outputs

Position Expectations
  
  

* Define, plan, and execute projects that help to run, grow, and transform MongoDB's self-service internal developer platform
* Take on direct reports and organize work for a team of platform engineers in coordination with other engineering leads
* "Lead by example" and act as a mentor to other engineers
* Work with engineering teams across MongoDB to investigate gaps and limitations in existing development workflows and understand new infrastructure and platform requirements
* Regularly write and review automation, configuration management, and application code
* Author and review functional specifications and scoping documents for large platform projects and services
* Own and operate much of the internal development platform that runs MongoDB
* Work on a distributed team that frequently interacts with remote engineers across multiple time zones (PST, EST, GMT, IST)

Success Measures
  
  

* In three months you'll have familiarized yourself with our teams and systems, taken on direct reports, and will be participating in high level scoping and roadmapping for platform projects
* In six months you'll have successfully investigated, scoped, and documented medium to large sized platform projects, and coordinated implementation with your direct reports
* In a year you'll have delivered measurable key results driven by a deep understanding of the goals/mission of Infrastructure Engineering, the needs of our stakeholders, and the objectives of MongoDB

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Databricks and Risk Application Production Support Lead
description:

Gurgaon, Haryana, India
  
  
The role exists to ensure stable, secure, cost-efficient, and predictable operations (BAU) of the GRM application ecosystem connected to GDP (Global Data Platform), with a good focus on Databricks as the execution and industrialization engine. The role holder will act as production support lead (and operational engineering owner) across Databricks workloads, data pipelines, and app components, while contributing occasionally to strategic projects.
  
  
What you’ll be DOING
  
  
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  
End-to-end BAU (Run) responsibility for the GRM risk tooling ecosystem leveraging Microsoft Azure / Databricks, including:
  
  

* Natural Event Platform application landscape (run + operational support)
* STEC application landscape (run + operational support)

This role includes involvement in some punctual projects needing good Databricks skills.
  
  
You will report to be defined – GRM Tech Owner / Run Manager).
  
  
What you will BRING
  
  
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**- BAU / Run operations ownership (core mission)
- Own the day-to-day operational support for GRM GDP-connected applications (Natural Event Platform apps, STEC apps).
- Run incident management (triage, root cause analysis, resolution, post-mortems), including coordination with platform/provider teams where needed.
- Manage problem management: recurring issues elimination, reliability improvements, backlog prioritization for operational fixes.
- Ensure operational readiness for releases: runbooks, monitoring, alerting, rollback procedures, support model/TOM alignment.

- Databricks engineering for production stability
- Operate and optimize Databricks Jobs / Workflows, notebooks, clusters, libraries, and scheduling patterns for production-grade reliability.
- Implement and maintain monitoring & observability (job health, pipeline success rates, latency, data quality checks, logs).
- Drive performance and cost optimization, especially for compute-intensive workloads
- Data flow operations & integration support (GDP ecosystem)
- Support and troubleshoot data ingestion/exchange flows connected to GDP and downstream applications, including interactions with integration mechanisms mentioned in the governance materials (e.g., interfaces such as UDM / API/APIM patterns used for exchanges in the ecosystem).
- Maintain/operate data quality controls relevant to the application ecosystem
- Project support (punctual contribution)
- Provide hands-on engineering support to project initiatives when needed (capacity-based), including:

* Notus modernization / recoding / migration activities (e.g., the confirmed move from Azure Batch to Databricks in GDP; PoC/benchmark contributions; industrialization work).
* Contributions to GDP-connected initiatives under the GRM governance streams (Natural Event Platform, Solvency 2 Internal Model and related technical excellence tracks).
* Participate in design reviews to ensure “build-to-run” quality: operability, monitoring, cost guardrails, and documentation before production release.
* Stakeholder management & governance rhythm
* Act as the operational focal point for GRM and platform stakeholders, participating in governance/rituals (initiative reviews, risk follow-ups) as required.
* Provide clear communication on incidents, risks, dependencies, and operational improvements.

**Specialist Skills & Experience (must-have)**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* good hands-on expertise with Databricks in production contexts (workflows/jobs scheduling, cluster policies, libraries, notebooks, troubleshooting).
* Advanced PySpark and SQL skills for investigation and remediation of data and pipeline issues.
* Experience with production support for data platforms/app ecosystems (L2/L3).

Run/Service Management
  
  

* Proven experience operating services under SLA/OLA constraints: incident/problem/change management, runbooks, operational reporting.

Cost / Performance / Reliability
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to manage compute cost, performance tuning, and reliability improvements—particularly relevant for scalable run workloads

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Experience in cloud data platforms and enterprise data governance constraints (access management, secure data handling).
* Familiarity with integration patterns (API management, managed file transfer approaches) in data exchange ecosystems.
* Exposure to risk modeling / catastrophe modeling application contexts (helpful but not required).

Key interfaces (who the role works with)
  
  

* GRM Tech & Product stakeholders (application owners, BAU owners, governance leads) across Natural Event Platform, STEC apps
* AXA GO, mainly GDP & CFGP teams (engineering) but as well transversal GO families such as security, access management, architecture supporting the platform releases and readiness.
* Project teams during transformations

Success measures (KPIs / outcomes)
  
  

* High service stability: reduced incident volume, improved MTTR, fewer recurring problems.
* Operational readiness: complete runbooks, monitoring coverage, predictable release transitions.
* Cost and performance control: measurable improvements in compute cost monitoring and optimization (especially on Notus run consumption).
* Stakeholder satisfaction (derived from the three criteria above): clear communication, reliable support, proactive risk management.

Working model (ESS – India)
  
  

* Coverage aligned to GRM needs.
* On call / extended support windows if required during major releases or critical incidents.

AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
What we OFFER
  
  
Inclusion
  
  
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
Sustainability
  
  
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.

Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.

These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

**Introduction To Team**
Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.
  
  
The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.
  
  
We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.
  
  
As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
* Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low-level designs.
* Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including integration with batch or streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow) and backward-compatible APIs.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, or analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data-informed tradeoffs on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SRE practices, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML-enabled features into existing services.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and mentoring others to grow their technical depth and delivery capability—including guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

* Must have hands-on experience in Web Services Automation using Java/groovy.
* Must have hands-on experience in Database testing. Well versed with writing complex SQL.
* Must have knowledge of any build tool Gradle/Maven/ANT etc.
* Must have good knowledge of CI/CD on Jenkins/ Gitlab
* Experience with Agile Methodologies, Tools (JIRA, Confluence).
* Must have hands-on knowledge in AI usage and AI tools.
* Must have exposure to design custom automation framework
* Must have exposure in Continuous Integration using Bamboo/Jenkins
* Must have exposure of Agile Methodology
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, distributed systems, asynchronous processing, and event-driven workflows.
* Good to have knowledge in performance & Security testing
* Exposure of stored procedure and PL/SQL
* Working knowledge of Unix commands
* Good to have exposure in Mobile Automation using Appium/browserstack.
* Exposure of monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace etc.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and analytical skills; attention to detail, thoroughness and strong ownership of work.
* Strong expertise in API automation and REST API testing; familiarity with GraphQL is an advantage.
* Experience in performance and scalability testing, including load generation, bottleneck identification, and system behaviour analysis.
* Proficiency with Git-based workflows, debugging, troubleshooting, and code reviews.

**Preferred Qualification**

What We’re Looking For

title: App Dev Engr/Scient, Inter
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
**About The Role**
PowerArtist is a leading RTL power analysis and optimization platform widely adopted across top semiconductor and SoC companies for early power estimation and debug. With increasing industry focus on low-power design and faster tape-outs, PowerArtist plays a critical role in enabling early power closure and design efficiency.
  
  
This position offers strong customer visibility, exposure to advanced SoC programs, and the opportunity to work closely with leading semiconductor customers to drive power optimization/estimation success.
  
  
This role focuses on
**product validation**
, feature qualification, and
**Application Engineering (AE) backend support**
. You will work closely with Product Development, Application Engineering, and key semiconductor customers to validate new capabilities, reproduce and analyze customer-reported issues, develop comprehensive validation strategies, and enable rapid issue resolution. The position offers broad exposure to advanced SoC design flows, strong cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to directly influence product quality, customer success, and future feature development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Validate new PowerArtist features, enhancements, and bug fixes across diverse design environments and customer use cases.
* Develop and maintain feature validation test plans, design suites.
* Perform functional, performance, and quality verification of RTL power analysis flows.
* Reproduce, analyze, and debug customer-reported issues in collaboration with R&D and AE teams.
* Create testcases to verify bug fixes and ensure no regressions are introduced.
* Validate support for new technologies, libraries, simulators, synthesis tools, and waveform formats.
* Analyze RTL power estimation results and verify accuracy against expected behavior.
* Automate validation workflows, regression execution, and result analysis using scripting.
* Provide backend technical support to AE teams by investigating complex customer issues and identifying root causes.
* Collaborate closely with R&D during feature development cycles to improve product quality and usability.
* Support release qualification activities and ensure timely delivery of high-quality product releases.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills:**

* 3+ years of experience in RTL design, verification, power analysis, or EDA tool validation.
* Strong understanding of RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog) and digital design fundamentals.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including their application in EDA workflows, validation automation, regression analysis, testcase generation, and productivity enhancement.
* Hands-on experience with PowerArtist or RTL power estimation and analysis methodologies.
* Knowledge of switching activity formats (VCD, FSDB, SAIF) and power modeling concepts.
* Familiarity with dynamic power, clock power, and activity-based power estimation techniques.
* Experience debugging RTL power analysis flows, libraries, constraints, and waveform-related issues.

description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Network Infrastructure
* Implement, configure, maintain, and support LAN and wireless network environments.
* Manage and support Cisco routers, switches, and related network infrastructure.
* Manage and support HPE Aruba wireless and network infrastructure.
* Configure and maintain FortiGate firewalls and related security infrastructure.

* Support VLAN, routing, switching, and network segmentation activities.
* Perform network capacity and performance assessments when required.
* Network Monitoring and Operations
* Monitor network infrastructure performance, availability, bandwidth utilization, latency, packet loss, and connectivity using Valeo monitoring tools such as MoVI.
* Proactively investigate monitoring alerts and network abnormalities.
* Conduct regular network health checks .
* Identify potential network issues before they impact business operations.
* Maintain high network availability and reliability.
* Perform daily network operational tasks and ensure timely resolution of issues.
* Incident Management and Troubleshooting
* Respond to network incidents according to defined SLA and operational procedures.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, routing, switching, wireless, firewall, VPN, and performance-related issues.
* Analyze network logs, monitoring information, packet captures, and device diagnostic information.
* Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major or recurring network incidents.
* Implement corrective and preventive actions to avoid recurrence.
* Escalate complex technical issues to internal teams or network equipment vendors when required.
* Firewall and Network Security
* Configure and maintain FortiGate firewall policies, NAT, routing, and security settings.
* Manage and support IPSec and SSL VPN connectivity.
* Support network segmentation and access-control requirements.
* Review firewall rules and identify unnecessary, obsolete, or overly permissive rules.
* Support security-related investigations and remediation activities.
* Work with cybersecurity teams to address network security vulnerabilities and incidents.
* Support endpoint/network security technologies such as Windows Defender and Trellix where required.
* Change Management
* Plan and execute network changes in accordance with Valeo Change Management procedures.
* Prepare implementation plans, test plans, validation procedures, and rollback plans.
* Perform network changes during approved maintenance windows.
* Conduct post-change validation and confirm service availability.
* Ensure all network changes are properly documented.
* Minimize business and production impact during network maintenance activities.
* Documentation
* Maintain up-to-date network diagrams and infrastructure documentation.
* Maintain IP address, VLAN, subnet, routing, firewall, and network device information.
* Document network configurations, operational procedures, and troubleshooting procedures.
* Update documentation following network changes, upgrades, or infrastructure modifications.
* Create and maintain Knowledge Base articles and operational guides.
* Network Projects and Improvements
* Support network infrastructure projects, migrations, upgrades, and expansions.
* Participate in new network deployments and infrastructure improvements.
* Support network architecture and design activities when required.
* Identify opportunities to improve network performance, reliability, security, and operational efficiency.
* Support Valeo VIQCT asset improvement activities.
* Ensure network assets and configuration information are accurately maintained.
* Vendor and Service Provider Management
* Coordinate with Cisco, Fortinet, HPE Aruba, ISP, and other network equipment/service providers.
* Open and manage technical support cases with vendors.
* Provide technical information, logs, configuration data, and troubleshooting results to vendors.
* Follow up on hardware replacement, RMA, firmware issues, and technical escalations.
* Coordinate with Cisco, Fortinet, HPE Aruba, ISPs, and other network equipment/service providers.
* OJT and Knowledge Transfer
* Receive and provide OJT and knowledge transfer related to Valeo network infrastructure.
* Complete initial knowledge transfer within a minimum of 2 weeks and a maximum of 4 weeks.
* Participate in periodic OJT and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Maintain and update OJT and operational documentation.
* Participate in weekly follow-up meetings during the initial transition period, when required.
* Demonstrate the ability to independently perform daily network operations and troubleshooting after the OJT period.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* Minimum 3 years of hands-on network engineering experience.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals.
* Practical experience in enterprise network environments.
* Hands-on experience with Cisco routers and switches.
* Experience with HPE Aruba wireless/network infrastructure is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with FortiGate firewalls.
* Experience with VPN technologies, including IPSec and SSL VPN.
* Good understanding of VLAN, STP, routing, and switching.
* Working knowledge of routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP.
* Experience in network troubleshooting and incident response.
* Experience with network monitoring tools.
* Ability to analyze network logs and perform packet-level troubleshooting.
* Experience with tools such as Wireshark is preferred.
* Understanding of network security principles and access control.
* Experience working with Change Management / ITSM processes.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in an enterprise or manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting production networks.
* Cisco certification such as CCNA or CCNP.
* Fortinet equivalent experience.
* HPE Aruba equivalent experience.
* ITIL / ITSM knowledge or certification.
* Experience with network monitoring and management platforms.
* Experience with firewall policy review and network security assessments.
* Experience with network automation or scripting is a plus.

**Valeo Support / Onboarding**

* Initial OJT and knowledge transfer: Minimum 2 weeks, maximum 4 weeks.
* Periodic OJT and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Weekly follow-up during the initial transition period, if required.
* Review and maintain network documentation during the onboarding period.
* Gradually transition responsibilities from supervised operation to independent network management.

**Key Performance Expectations**
**The Network Engineer Is Expected To**

* Maintain stable and reliable network operations.
* Respond to network incidents within the agreed SLA.
* Minimize network downtime and business impact.
* Complete planned network changes and upgrades successfully.
* Perform effective Root Cause Analysis for significant incidents.
* Maintain accurate network documentation and configuration backups.
* Proactively identify and resolve network risks.
* Continuously improve network performance, security, and operational efficiency.
* Maintain effective communication with internal teams, users, vendors, and service providers.

title: Senior Engineer - Security Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Zscaler & Network Security Engineer responsible for administering, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuously improving secure internet access, endpoint connectivity, remote access, and security controls. The role will work closely with security operations, network teams, and senior security stakeholders to maintain a strong security posture while ensuring reliable user connectivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Administer and maintain Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) policies, including:
* SSL inspection
* Application control
* Sandbox policies
* URL filtering
* CASB controls
* Malware exceptions, blocks, and security policies
* Manage and troubleshoot Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) deployments, including installation, connectivity, authentication, policy enforcement, and endpoint-related issues.
* Manage PAC file changes through a controlled, tested, peer-reviewed, and approved deployment process.
* Monitor security alerts and operational dashboards, investigate issues, and resolve day-to-day security incidents within defined SLAs.
* Raise, document, implement, and drive changes through formal Change Control processes, particularly where changes deviate from the approved security baseline.
* Manage and troubleshoot VPN/remote-access solutions, such as Palo Alto GlobalProtect, addressing connectivity, authentication, performance, and user-access issues.
* Use asset inventory and vulnerability-management tools, such as Qualys or similar platforms, to support troubleshooting, asset identification, security investigations, and vulnerability-management activities.
* Review and assess policy, URL, application, and whitelisting requests, escalating higher-risk requests to senior security stakeholders for appropriate risk assessment and approval.
* Apply least-privilege access principles across different user populations, including employees, contractors, privileged users, and executives.
* Support security audits and compliance reviews by collecting, validating, and providing appropriate control evidence and supporting documentation.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles to improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Hands-on experience administering Zscaler ZIA and Zscaler Client Connector.
* Strong understanding of web security concepts, including SSL inspection, URL filtering, application control, CASB, sandboxing, and malware protection.
* Experience troubleshooting ZCC, PAC files, proxy connectivity, and endpoint access issues.
* Experience with VPN technologies, preferably Palo Alto GlobalProtect.

title: Staff/Senior Operations Engineer
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees:**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About the Role:**
To support the delivery of CloudBees products (both internal and external), our Operations team designs, deploys, secures and manages a variety of software systems and the related GCP / AWS infrastructure that underpins these software engineering objectives. Our guiding principle is simple - “Make Engineering Faster”. Underpinning this are the challenges of security, process change, technical change that all must be met to varying degrees. Further, we are passionate about reducing the manual work that plagues IT teams - Engineering / Ops / Support / Security - and are empowered to re-engineer processes and technology to achieve those objectives.
  
  
We are looking for someone who:
  
  

* Is able to troubleshoot complex issues calmly.
* An open communicator, capable of bringing new ideas to the team
* Is able to learn from colleagues at all levels
* Understands, and is motivated by, rapidly changing technologies and has demonstrable competence with modern AI tools.

You are:
  
  

* self-motivated and enjoy solving problems
* excited by the opportunity to automate yourself out of recurring workable to self-organize and document your work and decisions effectively
* You will liaise directly with the software engineers across all teams, ensuring that decisions are agreed internally and externally to Operations and that they meet our technical and non-technical objectives.

How you’ll work:
  
  

* In a geographically distributed team (APAC, US, EMEA) of peers
* Choose your own work in tandem with the team, team-leader, and manager
* Flexible working hours - while there will be some core hours required for meeting with Engineering and Operations teams - much latitude is given in getting work done.
* Hybrid work based out of our Chennai hub

**Requirements**
**What you’ll Do:**
**Team-building**
- inside the team and across teams - you’ll be proposing new ideas and helping implement them
**Thinking**
- coming up with new ways of solving problems - and working with the team to prove them out and then implement them. Keeping up to speed with the latest technology, and proactively making use of tools like coding assistants and AI agents to accelerate your work.
**Documenting**
- describing problems, how your proposed solution solves those problems, and how your implemented solutions are operated.
**Optimizing**
- working with Engineering teams to optimize their build systems. Managing and developing tools which enable Engineers to ship faster.
**Defining**
- writing / modifying Terraform to handle our infrastructure, and helping teams define their infrastructure using our modules.
**Coding**
- you’ll be writing code in Golang - we occasionally write code in TypeScript, Python, and Groovy
**Securing**

* working with our security team to drive operational change in engineering teams
* working with our security team to drive organizational security changes (logging, auditing, monitoring, alerting)

**Observing**
- adding the right monitoring so that we are alerted before our customers notice, and not alerted when the system is able to heal itself
**Alerting**
- getting alerts and working with team members to solve the initial problem, documenting the problem and then working out how to stop them happening again
**DevOps / DevSecOps**
- We’re not “DevOps” engineers, but we do help our teams become more proficient in doing Dev and Ops (and embracing Total Ownership). We build the guard rails to help them do it safely and align tech-stacks across the company.
**What you will work on**
-
  
  

* IaaS - GCP, AWS
* AI tooling and automation - Claude Code, Codex, AWS Bedrock Agentcore, Software Factories
* Platform tools - Kubernetes, terraform, helm, docker
* Language tools - Golang
* Engineering tools - Jenkins, Backstage
* Operations tools - PagerDuty, DataDog

**Role Requirements:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
* 8+ years working in a DevOps style environment - building automations, writing software, solving problems
* 2+ years working in AWS (preferred) or GCP
* 2+ years experience in a high level programming language (Golang / Python / Ruby / Java or similar)
* Experience of working asynchronously in a distributed team.
* Experience of contributing to your team’s technical strategy
* Strong self organization skills and communication skills

You have experience in:
  
  

* programming in various languages and domains
* Development with agentic AI and administration of tools
* the "modern Ops stack" (e.g. monitoring, alerting, cloud-based provisioning, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Linux systems administration
* cloud-based operations (GCP, AWS, or Azure)
* cluster orchestration and management tools (e.g. k8s / ECS / Terraform / etc)
* continuous integration / continuous delivery tools (Jenkins / Tekton etc)
* modern software engineering practices: code reviews, unit / acceptance testing, source control, etc.

Key job responsibilities
  
  
This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
  
  
Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
  
  
You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.

You will manage the lifecycle of our high-scale API gateways, tokenization registries, entity resolution (identity matching) algorithms, and orchestration engines. * Define and track core platform KPIs such as API Uptime (SLAs), Latency (p99 metrics), and Match Rates.
* Partner closely with Enterprise Architects, Cloud Engineers, Infosec, Data Science, and Application Product
* Managers to ensure the underlying platform seamlessly supports new product launches.
* Embed data governance, access controls, data localization frameworks, and compliance policies (such as the DPDP Act and RBI guidelines) directly into the platform architecture by design.
* Maintain a continuous pulse on the global Equifax product portfolio.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.
  
  
We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.
  
  
Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.
  
  
As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.
  
  
**What The Team Owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.
* Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily.
* Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points — find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds.
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles.
* Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.

**Job Description**

As a Data Engineering Manager within the Enterprise Data Platform team at PitchBook, you will lead a team of skilled data engineers responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines, managing large-scale data models, and ensuring the quality, availability, and performance of enterprise data assets. Our analysts, executives and AI agents should all query the same governed, documented, well-described data and get the same answers. You will lead the team to make that real, with semantic layers, governed metrics, rich metadata, agent-safe access, and evaluation of agent output, and in using agents to build faster and with higher quality.

* Lead, mentor, retain top talent and develop a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement

* Lead AI learning initiatives and integrate AI/ML-driven solutions into data products to enhance automation, predictive insights, and decision intelligence

* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation, transformation, and automation
* Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), and distributed messaging systems (e.g., Kafka)

title: WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager
description:
WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager

**We offer:**
=============

The WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager combines two equally important responsibilities within KION's Enterprise Network service. Approximately 50% of the role governs the global WAN managed service, and approximately 50% coordinates service delivery and BAU operations across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI.

For WAN governance, the role monitors supplier delivery, contractual performance, service levels, lifecycle, risks, costs and improvement actions. The role prepares analysis, forecasts, recommendations and decision proposals for the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Budget accountability, cost-centre responsibility, contract ownership and final commercial decisions remain with the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Day-to-day operational coordination with the WAN managed service provider is performed by a designated WAN Operations Coordinator under the functional guidance of this role; overall WAN governance responsibility remains with this position.

For network service delivery, the role coordinates the shared operating model, queues, incidents, service requests, changes, problems, operational readiness and performance reporting. The role has no disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility for network engineers. Engineering capacity and line management remain with the responsible managers, while this role provides process coordination, prioritisation transparency and cross-domain escalation.

The role works closely with the Enterprise Network Service Owner, Lead Network Architect, network engineers, IT Service Management, regional IT teams, Procurement, Finance and external network providers.

**Tasks and Qualifications:**
=============================

  

**1. WAN governance, roadmap and lifecycle - 15%**

* Prepare and maintain the proposed WAN service roadmap in alignment with the Enterprise Network Service Owner and Lead Network Architect.

* Identify lifecycle, resilience, capacity, sourcing and technical-debt risks and prepare recommendations for accountable decision makers.

* Track approved governance decisions and improvement actions to completion.

**2. WAN supplier and contractual-performance governance - 15%**

* Act as the primary operational governance interface for the WAN managed service provider, carriers and access providers.

* Monitor SLAs, KPIs, contractual obligations, potential service credits, risks and supplier commitments.

* Prepare evidence and recommendations for contract, renewal and commercial decisions owned by the Enterprise Network Service Owner.

* Lead supplier service reviews and escalate recurring underperformance, weak corrective actions and unresolved risks.

**3. WAN cost transparency, demand and transition assurance - 10%**

* Prepare cost, consumption and forecast transparency for review and approval by the Enterprise Network Service Owner; the role has no budget or cost-centre accountability.

* Assess the WAN service, supplier, commercial and operational implications of approved demands.

* Coordinate provider estimates, service acceptance and transition requirements with the demand owner, Lead Network Architect and Enterprise Network Service Owner.

* Ensure operational acceptance covers documentation, monitoring, testing, support routes, supplier acceptance and handover.

**4. WAN performance, data and continual improvement - 10%**

* Maintain WAN scorecards covering availability, incidents, capacity, resilience, change quality, supplier performance and cost transparency.

* Coordinate supplier follow-up after significant interruptions, including RCA quality and preventive actions.

* Maintain accurate governance artefacts and promote consistent data across ITSM, CMDB, monitoring, inventory and source-of-truth capabilities.

* Identify opportunities for automation, observability, data-quality improvement and reduced manual coordination.

**5. Enterprise Network operations coordination - 20%**

* Coordinate the BAU operating model across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI without assuming disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility.

* Run queue reviews, service-health reviews and handover checkpoints; make ageing, blocked work and coverage gaps transparent.

* Coordinate operational priorities with line managers and engineering leads and escalate unresolved capacity conflicts to the Service Owner.

* Provide functional guidance to the designated WAN Operations Coordinator responsible for daily KION-provider coordination.

**6. Incident and service-request coordination - 15%**

* Coordinate triage, ownership, progression and documentation for incidents and service requests in the shared Enterprise Network queue.

* Coordinate cross-domain and high-priority incidents, bringing together network, security, application, infrastructure and supplier teams.

* Ensure clear ownership, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and disciplined technical handovers; specialist teams retain technical resolution responsibility.

* Monitor ticket ageing, reassignments and documentation quality and drive corrective action where required.

**7. Change, problem and operational-readiness governance - 10%**

* Coordinate operational risk reviews for significant or high-risk network changes, including production dependencies and rollback readiness.

* Drive follow-up of recurring problems, RCAs, known errors and preventive actions.

* Confirm that new or changed services enter BAU with monitoring, documentation, runbooks, support ownership, access and escalation routes in place.

**8. Operational performance and service improvement - 5%**

* Report queue health, response and restoration performance, recurring incidents, backlog, monitoring coverage and handover quality.

* Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, escalation contacts, service maps and operational knowledge.

Use operational trends to recommend improvements to resilience, automation, standards and training  

  

Interfaces

Internal:

* Secure Connectivity platform leadership, functional and team leads, and rotating operations engineers

* Enterprise and Network architecture; Cybersecurity and Information Security

* IT Service Management, e.g. Service Desk, (Major) Incident, Problem and Change

* Procurement, Legal, Finance/Controlling and Vendor Management

* Regional and onsite IT, business partners, programme and project managers

Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization.
  
  
You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities.
  
  
Working at Atlassian
  
  
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data.
  
  
**As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will**

* Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
* Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
* Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
* Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
* Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
* You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
* You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost.

* Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
* Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
* Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
* Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
* Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
* Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
* Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
* Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
* Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.

description:

**EY-Cyber Security-Senior IAM Consultant-ISAM**
As part of our EY-cyber security team, you shall Engage in Identity & Access Management projects in the capacity of execution of deliverables. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Security Consultant in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with senior members of the team.
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for customer applications using policy driven security, SSO, authentication and authorization, user provisioning/de-provisioning, and federation focusing on multiple protocols (SAML2.0, OpenID, OAuth2.0, WS-FED).
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress
* Execute the engagement requirements, along with review of work by junior team members
* Help prepare reports and schedules that will be delivered to clients and other interested parties
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel
* Build strong internal relationships within EY Consulting Services and with other services across the organization
* Help senior team members in performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for staff/junior level team members
* Contribute to people related initiatives including recruiting and retaining IAM professionals
* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management solutions.
* Strong experience in designing and implementing Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions, including customer registration, profile management, and self-service account capabilities.
* Knowledge of CIAM best practices, including customer lifecycle management, identity federation, consent management, privacy compliance, and secure customer onboarding.
* Hands-on experience on IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access end-to-end implementation involving requirement gathering, designing, implementation, customization and testing.
* Implementation experience in Web Module, Federation Module and Advance Access control module of IBAM/ISVA
* Hands-on experience with IBM ISAM WebSEAL administration, including configuration and management of various junction types, reverse proxy services.
* Experience implementing Single Sign on, Multi Factor Authentication, adaptive authentication, and customer/partner identity solutions using ISAM/ISVA.
* Working experience in application integration with header-based, SAML2.0, OIDC, OAuth2.0, WS-Fed protocols.
* Experience in implementing social login and third-party Identity Provider (IdP) integrations using ISAM/ISVA for secure authentication and federation use cases.
* Ability to design and customize authentication policies, access controls, identity workflows, and customer-facing access experiences.
* Experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, web services, and identity-related connectors to enable seamless customer and application integrations
* Ability to develop and maintain ISAM custom JavaScript mapping rules, API protection policies, and federation configurations.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, and scripting technologies used for IAM customizations and automation.
* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.
* Experience in supporting platform administration activities, including upgrades, deployments, patching, and environment maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of certificate administration in ISAM, including troubleshooting SSL/TLS, signer, personal, and key database certificate-related issues.
* Understanding of IAM governance, configuration management, operational controls, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to work in a client-focused environment with flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Should have had direct client experience, including working with client teams in an on-site or offshore mode.
* Need to liaise with Business stakeholders and seek requirement clarification. Should be able to map business requirements to technical specifications.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 6 – 9 Years’ Work Experience

**Certification:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. description:

BigEndian Semiconductors is a fabless semiconductor startup developing secure, high-performance System-on-Chips (SoCs) in India for global markets. The company builds silicon platforms that power next-generation surveillance, telecom, IoT, and enterprise systems, guided by a “security by design” philosophy that tightly integrates hardware and software.
