title: Team Lead, ADM Ops
description:
**Who We Are**

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

#### **The Role**

Addepar's Private Fund Look-Through (PFLT) offering gives clients deep visibility into the underlying holdings of their private fund investments by extracting holding-level data directly from GP financial statements—primarily the Schedule of Investments (SOI). This white-glove solution combines proprietary AI/ML extraction technology with human-in-the-loop review to ensure maximum accuracy and full portfolio transparency.

As part of the broader Addepar Data organization, the **PFLT Data Operations Team Lead** is responsible for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts focused on reviewing, validating, and enriching complex fund holding data within target SLAs. This role acts as a domain subject matter expert, overseeing exception resolution, pipeline monitoring (Databricks, Retool, Monday.com), and data entity mapping. You will play a pivotal role in driving team performance metrics, leading ML model retraining initiatives, and collaborating across Product, Engineering, ML Operations, and Client Success teams.  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Lead and manage a team of PFLT Analysts & Senior Analysts, driving effective work allocation, daily queue management (Monday.com), and SLA compliance across peak quarter-end processing periods.
* Track and drive key team performance metrics, including SLA compliance, processing accuracy, and throughput.
* Support operational workflows, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for private fund Look-through processing.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation across the pipeline.
* Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) supporting the team on complex Schedule of Investments (SOI) processing, special asset classes (e.g., crypto/token assets, real estate), and intricate fund accounting mechanics (e.g., PQ reconciliation, derived metric calculations, corporate actions).
* Guide and oversee the team in troubleshooting complex extraction errors across pipeline stages and front-end verification checks.
* Perform quality control reviews and high-level audits to assist the team in correcting improperly extracted or mapped holdings data.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for data quality discrepancies, pipeline failures, and complex mapping issues (SOAP UI, GSM Search, PitchBook).
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and AIP teams to enhance operational efficiency by identifying extraction errors, curating edge-case datasets for AI model retraining, and refining pipeline tooling and UI (Retool/Databricks).
* Engage directly with clients, GPs, and Fund Administrators to resolve technical data inquiries, document discrepancies, and reporting edge cases.

#### **Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a relevant role and domain
* Minimum 2+ years of people Team leader experience
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, or a related field
* Experience in Private equity / Alternatives investment process
* Experience in the financial investment/advisory industry with strong knowledge of capital markets, middle/back-office operations systems, and preferably with experience dealing with Alternatives (Private/Draw-down) Funds reporting statements and data
* Track record of demonstrating excellent attention to detail, effective problem-solving skills, and an ability to thrive in a fast paced environment
* Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills for engaging clients, data providers, and internal stakeholders across Sales, Services, and R&D
* Highly self-motivated to take on responsibility, forward thinking and pragmatic, and possess a collaborative team-player mentality
* Technical skills preferred in any or all of the following: Microsoft Excel, Google Suite, Atlassian Jira/Confluence, SQL, Salesforce, or other common financial services systems and applications
* Willing to work in overlapping US/EMEA shifts or flexible hours to align with global stakeholders

**Our Values**

* **Act Like an Owner -** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* **Build Together -** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* **Champion Our Clients -** Exceed client expectations. Our clients' success is our success.
* **Drive Innovation -** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* **Embrace Learning -** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: SME - SDWAN
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SD-WAN Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead multi-vendor SD-WAN operations, provide technical leadership, manage customer escalations, and ensure compliance with defined KPIs, SLAs, security standards, and operational processes.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing SD-WAN solutions across Cisco, Fortinet, Cisco Meraki, and Versa platforms, ensuring network availability, service performance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. The role also requires strong expertise in MPLS, ISP connectivity, routing protocols, underlay and overlay troubleshooting, controller management, and technical team development.
  
  

* Key Roles and Responsibilities
* SD-WAN Technical Leadership

Act as the technical SME and lead for multi-vendor SD-WAN technologies, including Cisco, Fortinet, Cisco Meraki, and Versa.
  
  
Provide technical leadership for SD-WAN deployment, migration, upgrades, configuration changes, and service assurance.
  
  
Review and validate High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), and Method of Procedures (MOPs).
  
  
Troubleshoot complex underlay and overlay connectivity issues, routing instability, tunnel failures, and application performance problems.
  
  
Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures for recurring network incidents.
  
  

* Day-to-Day Network Operations

Oversee daily SD-WAN and WAN operations across enterprise managed services environments.
  
  
Ensure proactive monitoring, incident management, problem management, and change management.
  
  
Manage SD-WAN controllers, orchestrators, management platforms, and associated components.
  
  
Coordinate network upgrades, device replacements, configuration changes, and planned maintenance activities.
  
  
Ensure network availability, stability, and service continuity across customer environments.
  
  

* KPI and SLA Management

Track and review operational KPIs, SLAs, MTTR, incident trends, availability, and service performance.
  
  
Ensure incidents, service requests, and changes are resolved within agreed SLA timelines.
  
  
Prepare periodic operational dashboards, performance reports, and management reviews.
  
  
Identify service improvement opportunities and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  
  

* Partner and OEM Governance

Manage service delivery and technical governance with OEMs, ISP partners, and third-party service providers.
  
  
Conduct regular OEM support reviews, technical discussions, and service performance assessments.
  
  
Coordinate critical escalations, hardware replacements, software upgrades, and defect resolution.
  
  
Track vendor commitments, pending actions, RCA submissions, and permanent corrective measures.
  
  

* Customer and Escalation Management

Handle critical customer escalations and major network incidents.
  
  
Lead technical bridge calls and coordinate resolution across internal teams, OEMs, ISPs, and service partners.
  
  
Communicate incident updates, service restoration plans, and RCA findings to customers and management.
  
  
Maintain strong customer relationships through effective communication, ownership, and timely resolution.
  
  

* Network Security and Compliance

Ensure compliance with operational processes, security policies, change management, and audit requirements.
  
  
Conduct security audits of managed network devices, including routers, firewalls, and SD-WAN appliances.
  
  
Coordinate vulnerability assessments, firmware and software compliance reviews, and security remediation activities.
  
  
Track security advisories, vulnerabilities, configuration deviations, and remediation closure.
  
  
Ensure compliance with approved configuration baselines and operational security standards.
  
  

* Team Development and Cross-Functional Collaboration

Build technical capabilities within L1.5 and L2 operations teams through training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  
  
Develop troubleshooting guides, standard operating procedures, and technical documentation.
  
  
Collaborate with engineering, service delivery, project, security, and other cross-functional teams.
  
  
Drive operational standardization, automation opportunities, and continuous service improvement.
  
  
Position Specific Skills
  
  
Hands-on experience in SD-WAN technologies, preferably Cisco SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Meraki, and Versa.
  
  
Strong experience in MPLS, Internet Service Provider (ISP) connectivity, and enterprise WAN architectures.
  
  
**Strong Understanding Of Routing Protocols**
Static and dynamic routing
  
  
BGP
  
  
OSPF
  
  
EIGRP
  
  
IS-IS
  
  
Expertise in underlay and overlay troubleshooting, IPsec tunnels, routing convergence, path selection, and application connectivity.
  
  
Experience in SD-WAN controller, orchestrator, and centralized management platform administration.
  
  
Working knowledge of Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), including TACACS+ and RADIUS-based device administration and access control.
  
  
Experience in network security audits, vulnerability assessment, firmware compliance, and remediation tracking.
  
  
Strong knowledge of incident, problem, change, and configuration management processes.

We are an aviation IT solutions company delivering airport systems integration, enterprise middleware, operational technology platforms, and digital transformation services to airports and aviation stakeholders. Our projects run in high-availability environments where secure, scalable, and reliable integrations across multiple airport systems are essential.

Role Summary

We are hiring an experienced MQ Administrator to own our enterprise messaging and middleware infrastructure in a 24x7 operational setting. You will handle installation, configuration, monitoring, security, troubleshooting, and performance tuning of IBM MQ and related middleware, working closely with application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and operations teams.

Key Responsibilities

**MQ & Middleware Administration**

* Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain IBM MQ across development, test, staging, and production environments.
* Set up and manage queue managers, queues, channels, listeners, clusters, topics, and security settings.
* Support distributed MQ deployments on Linux, Windows, and cloud platforms.
* Implement and maintain clustering, multi-instance queue managers, failover, and high-availability designs.
* Run regular health checks and preventive maintenance.
* Track queue depth, channel status, message flow, and overall middleware performance.
* Diagnose messaging failures, connectivity problems, latency, and integration incidents.
* Manage SSL/TLS configuration and certificates to keep messaging secure.
* Put backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures in place.
* Maintain middleware standards, naming conventions, and operating procedures.

**Integration Support**

* Work with application teams, system integrators, OEM vendors, and infrastructure teams during deployments and integrations.
* Support integrations between mission-critical airport operational systems.
* Help troubleshoot interfaces across enterprise systems, operational databases, APIs, and third-party applications.
* Review message flow logs and transaction traces to resolve issues.
* Support SIT, UAT, production rollouts, and cutovers.

**Monitoring & Incident Management**

* Provide L2/L3 support for production middleware incidents.
* Take part in 24x7 support and on-call rotations as needed.
* Conduct root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Meet SLA, availability, and operational KPI targets.
* Keep incident records, operational logs, and technical documentation up to date.

**Security & Compliance**

* Align middleware infrastructure with organizational cybersecurity policies.
* Apply authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit logging controls.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security audits, and compliance work.
* Partner with cybersecurity teams on hardening and risk reduction.

**Automation & Improvement**

* Build and maintain scripts for monitoring, deployment, backup, and maintenance.
* Identify opportunities for performance tuning and process improvement.
* Contribute to infrastructure modernization and cloud migration initiatives where relevant.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of hands-on IBM MQ administration experience.
* Proven experience administering enterprise middleware in production.
* Working knowledge of Linux and Windows server environments.
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP, networking, firewalls, and secure communication protocols.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery setups.
* Shell or other automation scripting skills.
* Familiarity with ITIL incident and change management.

Preferred Skills

* Background in aviation, airport systems, transportation, or other mission-critical domains.
* Exposure to IBM ACE/IIB, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or similar platforms.
* Experience with containerized or cloud-based middleware.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, AppDynamics, or Splunk.
* Understanding of REST/SOAP APIs and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience on large-scale system integration projects.
* Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices.

Behavioral Competencies

* Ownership and accountability.
* Composure under pressure in 24x7 environments.
* Clear communication and coordination.
* Attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Ability to work with cross-functional, multicultural teams.
* Strong documentation and reporting habits.
* Willingness to learn new technologies.

Working Conditions

* Shift work and on-call rotations may be required.
* Support may be needed during production cutovers, migrations, and critical operational events.

What We Offer

* Work on large-scale international aviation and airport technology projects.
* Hands-on exposure to mission-critical enterprise systems.
* A collaborative, technology-focused team.
* Career growth in enterprise integration and middleware.
* Competitive pay and professional development support.

How to Apply

Send your updated resume with relevant project experience, certifications, and current notice period.

**Work Location:** In person

Pay: ₹65,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
**Company:** Finerr  
**Department:** Customer Success & Support  
**Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reports To:** Customer Success Executive

About Finerr

Finerr provides solutions including **Finerr Central, Finerr Connect, Finerr Fax, Scheduling, Finerr Pay, Messaging, RX Alerts, Campaigns, Analytics, Social Media, Forms, Website Widgets, and healthcare-system integrations**.

We are looking for a **Customer Support Executive** who can provide excellent support to healthcare providers, troubleshoot product-related issues, coordinate with internal technical teams, and ensure customers receive timely and accurate resolutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Support

* Handle customer support requests through email, tickets, calls, and other communication channels.
* Understand customer issues and provide clear, professional, and timely responses.
* Assist healthcare providers with questions related to Finerr products, features, settings, and workflows.
* Follow up with customers to ensure reported issues are resolved and the customer is satisfied.
* Maintain professional communication with healthcare providers, administrators, staff, and other users.
* Escalate complex or technical issues to the appropriate internal team when required.

2. Finerr Product Support

Provide first-level support for Finerr products and features, including:

* **Finerr Central**
* **Finerr Connect / Voice**
* **Messaging / 2-Way SMS**
* **RX Alerts and Reminders**
* **Finerr Scheduling**
* **Finerr Fax**
* **Finerr Pay**
* **Campaigns and Patient Outreach**
* **Analytics and Reporting**
* **Reviews and Social Media**
* **Patient Forms and Website Widgets**
* **Patient profiles and communication workflows**
* **Healthcare provider integrations**

The executive should understand how these products work and must be able to guide customers through common configuration and troubleshooting scenarios.

3. Healthcare System Integrations

Assist customers with issues related to integrations with healthcare and practice-management systems, including supported third-party platforms.

Responsibilities may include:

* Identifying whether patient, prescription, appointment, order, or other relevant data is being received correctly.
* Troubleshooting missing, delayed, or incomplete data.
* Checking integration-related configurations.
* Understanding common API, webhook, listener, and connectivity issues.
* Collecting required information from the healthcare provider before escalating an issue.
* Coordinating with the Integration/Engineering team for advanced issues.
* Communicating technical findings to customers in simple, non-technical language.

4. Voice & Communication Support

* Troubleshoot automated IVR and voice-related issues.
* Assist customers with call-routing and communication workflows.
* Help troubleshoot extensions, call routing, voicemail, missed calls, and related issues.
* Coordinate with the VoIP/technical team for advanced communication issues.
* Assist with IVR configuration and routing when required.

5. SMS, Messaging & A2P 10DLC Support

* Assist customers with Finerr SMS and messaging-related questions.
* Troubleshoot SMS delivery and campaign-related issues.
* Assist with A2P 10DLC registration requirements and campaign information.
* Help customers understand messaging consent, opt-in/opt-out requirements, Terms & Privacy requirements, and sample messaging.
* Investigate common campaign rejection reasons and coordinate with the appropriate team when necessary.
* Monitor and report recurring messaging issues.

6. Website & Patient Engagement Support

* Assist healthcare providers with Finerr website features and widgets.
* Support patient registration and account-related issues.
* Troubleshoot website forms, appointment requests, payment links, and patient communication workflows.
* Verify customer-provided information when investigating patient-facing issues.
* Coordinate with the website/development team when a technical fix is required.

7. Technical Troubleshooting

The Customer Support Executive should be comfortable performing basic technical troubleshooting, including:

* Checking internet/network connectivity.
* Performing basic browser troubleshooting.
* Testing URLs and API endpoints when required.
* Understanding basic HTTP status codes.
* Performing basic connectivity checks such as ping and port testing.
* Identifying whether an issue is related to the Finerr platform, healthcare provider's environment, third-party software, or configuration.
* Collecting screenshots, error messages, timestamps, account details, and other information required for escalation.
* Reproducing issues whenever possible before escalating them.

8. Ticket Management

* Create, update, and maintain customer support tickets.
* Categorize and prioritize issues based on severity and customer impact.
* Maintain accurate ticket notes and troubleshooting history.
* Follow internal escalation procedures.
* Monitor open tickets and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Keep customers informed throughout the resolution process.
* Document recurring issues and potential product improvements.

9. Customer Onboarding Assistance

Support the Customer Success team during new healthcare provider onboarding by:

* Helping customers understand Finerr products and workflows.
* Assisting with basic configuration.
* Coordinating required information for integrations.
* Helping customers prepare for training sessions.
* Supporting customers after onboarding and during the initial adoption period.
* Identifying customers who may require additional training or assistance.

10. Internal Coordination

Work closely with:

* Customer Success Managers
* Engineering / Development Team
* Integration Team
* VoIP / Telecom Team
* Product Team
* Billing Team
* Implementation / Onboarding Team

Provide complete and accurate information when escalating issues so technical teams can investigate efficiently.

Required Skills

* Excellent written and verbal English language communication skills.
* Strong customer-service mindset.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts in simple language.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask and manage multiple customer issues.
* Good documentation and ticket-management skills.
* Comfortable working with web-based SaaS applications.
* Basic understanding of APIs, webhooks, URLs, HTTP, and networking is preferred.
* Ability to learn healthcare technology and provider workflows.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* SaaS customer support
* Technical support

* Patient engagement platforms
* Practice-management systems
* VoIP/telephony support

The Customer Support Executive will be measured on:

* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Follow-up completion

title: Venture Fellow - Internship
description:
Aadi Labs is a venture creation studio. We help founders turn promising ideas into working products, first customers and the foundations of real companies, and we build some of those companies ourselves, with Venture Fellows leading the work.

You will own a real function inside an early-stage venture for six months: real users, real numbers, real consequences if something does not work.

**What you will actually do**

Depending on the venture and the function you choose, that could mean running growth experiments and watching the numbers move, shipping product decisions that get tested by real users within days, writing and deploying code that goes live the same week, or designing the first experience a customer ever sees of something that did not exist a month ago. You will not be handed a six-month roadmap on day one. You will be handed a problem and the room to go solve it.

**Who this is for**

AI is already part of how you work daily. You use it to get more done than your headcount would suggest, not as a novelty you dabble in occasionally. You want responsibility earlier than a conventional internship gives you, and you are comfortable with a role that is not fully defined yet.

Prior experience in a function helps, but a real track record of building or shipping something, anywhere, counts for more than a résumé line.

**Pick your track**
— Venture Fellows lead one of five functions. You choose which one you are applying for on our site.

* **Growth**
   — positioning, acquisition and retention, with AI handling the busywork so your judgment goes toward what to test next.
* **Product**
   — the customer, the first use case, the smallest version worth shipping, prototyped with AI to move at founder speed.
* **Engineering**
   — production code, using AI coding tools to multiply your own output.
* **Design**
   — the end-to-end experience, from UX to the first impression a user gets.
* **Other**
   — sales, operations, customer success, or a function that doesn't fit neatly above.

title: Staff Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
At Index Exchange, we’re reinventing how digital advertising works—at scale. As a global advertising supply-side platform, we empower the world’s leading media owners and marketers to thrive in a programmatic, privacy-first ecosystem.
  
We’re a proud industry pioneer with over 20 years of experience accelerating the ad technology evolution. Our proprietary tech is trusted by some of the world’s largest brands and media owners and plays a crucial role in keeping the internet open, accessible, and largely free.
  
We process more than 550 billion real-time auctions every day (in comparison, Google processes 8.5 billion searches per day) with ultra-low latency. Our platform is vertically integrated from servers to networks and runs primarily on our own metal and cloud infrastructure. This end-to-end infrastructure is designed to provide both stability and agility, enabling us to adapt quickly as the market evolves.
  
At the core of it all is our engineering-first culture. Our engineers tackle internet-scale problems across tight-knit, global teams. From moving petabytes of data and optimizing with AI to making real-time infrastructure decisions, Indexers have the agency and influence to shape the future of advertising. We move fast, build thoughtfully, and stay grounded in our core values.
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Staff Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to serve as a technical leader and quality champion across Index. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with broad cross-team and cross-divisional influence where you will define and drive modern quality engineering practices, build scalable automation, tools, test infrastructure, and enable teams to deliver high-quality, high-performance software with confidence.
  
You will operate at the intersection of architecture, quality, developer experience, and operations, ensuring quality is built into every stage of the software lifecycle. You will also leverage AI to improve testing efficiency and insights.
  
As a SDET champion on the engineering team, you will own the vision for test infrastructures, build frameworks that allow developers to easily write reliable tests, and invent new mechanisms for ensuring that every change we make can be deployed safely and quickly. You will help solve our most difficult challenges and will coach other engineers to foster a culture of relentless high standards.
  
This position reports directly to Senior Engineering Manager based in Bangalore and will work closely with members of the Quality and Delivery teams.
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering/SDET role with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong software engineering skills, including proficiency in programming languages such as Golang, Java or C#.
* Proven experience building scalable, reusable, enterprise grade test frameworks, tools and infrastructure for large-scale distributed systems.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD (GitLab preferred), Containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes).
* Experience with microservices architectures, APIs, and data-intensive systems, validating large datasets and pipelines.
* Deep expertise in test strategies, methodologies, and automation at scale.
* Have systems thinking and end-to-end accountability, proactively identifying risks and influencing cross-team quality without direct authority.
* Exceptional analytical skills and structured problem-solving to drive clarity and outcomes in ambiguous environments.
* A technical role model, guiding engineers and consistently raising the bar through design, reviews, and best practices.
* Proven ability to lead cross-team initiatives, align stakeholders, and drive engineering excellence at scale
* Demonstrates a learn-and-be-curious mindset, with a strong bias for ownership, innovation, and continuous improvement

**Here’s What You’ll Be Doing**
**Technical Leadership & Quality Strategy**

* Working on cutting edge programmatic ad tech that touches millions of users every single day.
* Collaborate with the Manager to define and evolve the quality engineering vision and strategy for Index’s high-scale distributed systems.
* Drive shift-left testing and quality-by-design principles, influencing system architecture for testability and reliability.
* Establish best practices across functional, integration, end-to-end, performance, and resilience testing.
* Assess current practices, tooling, and workflows to identify gaps and translate them into actionable plans that balance impact, feasibility, and organizational readiness.
* Bring clarity to complexity, probing assumptions, identifying quality risks, evaluating trade-offs, and optimization opportunities.

**Test Frameworks, Tooling & Infrastructure**

* Design and build scalable, reusable automation frameworks and test infrastructure.
* Develop tools that enable teams to independently own, measure, and continuously improve quality.
* Enhance and optimize CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitLab) to ensure fast, safe, and reliable releases.
* Enable data validation, observability-driven testing, and production validation strategies.

**Cross-Team Influence & Developer Enablement**

* Partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, and DevOps teams to ensure high-quality releases by enforcing quality standards and best practices.
* Influence design and architecture decisions to improve scalability, performance, and testability.
* Identify systemic gaps and drive across engineering improvements in testing practices and tooling.
* Standardize quality metrics, reporting, and release quality gates across teams
* Drive improvements in production quality, incident reduction, and system resilience

**Mentorship, Coaching & Hiring**

* Mentor and coach engineers on test design, automation, tooling and quality best practices.
* Raise engineering standards through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.
* Actively participate in hiring and bar-raising activities.
* Foster a culture of ownership, learning, and high engineering standards.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

* Comprehensive health plans for you and your dependents .
* Paid time off, health days, and personal obligation days plus flexible work schedules
* Competitive retirement matching plans
* Equity packages
* Company contribution to Provident Fund
* Monthly internet stipend
* Generous parental leave available to birthing, non-birthing, and adoptive parents
* Annual well-being allowance plus fitness discounts and group wellness activities
* Employee assistance program
* Mental health first aid program that provides an in-the-moment point of contact and reassurance
* One day of volunteer time off per year and a donation-matching program
* Monthly town halls and regular community-led team events
* Multiple resources and programming to support continuous learning
* A workplace that supports a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment – learn more here

**Equal employment opportunity**
At Index Exchange, we believe that successful products are built by teams just as diverse as the audience who uses them. As such, we are committed to equal employment opportunities. We celebrate diversity of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Additionally, we realize that diversity is deeper than any status or classification—diversity is the human experience. For those who show grit, passion, and humility—Index will welcome you.
  
**Accessibility For Applicants With Disabilities**

If you require an accommodation, please share the details of your request and any information how we can assist you with the hiring recruiter when they contact you. Index Exchange will make reasonable efforts to ensure accommodation requests are met throughout the recruitment process.
  
**Index everywhere, Index anywhere**
Our corporate headquarters are in Toronto, with major offices in New York, Montreal, Kitchener, London, San Francisco, and many other global cities. As a major global advertising exchange, we are committed to operating as a tightly knit global team and embracing and empowering talent wherever our colleagues may be.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology—enabling faster, better, connected insights. Konovo is backed by Frazier Healthcare, a healthcare-only growth private equity firm committed to supporting the vision and expertise of our executive leadership team.
  
  
Konovo's solutions empower organisations to make data-driven decisions that enhance patient outcomes and streamline healthcare processes. We supply healthcare organisations with real-time access to over 2 million healthcare professionals and patients, the largest available anywhere in the world. Our 300+ employees are spread across five countries, collaborating to support some of the largest organisations in the healthcare industry. Our customers include over 300 leading global pharmaceutical, medical device, market research agency, and consultancy companies.
  
  
We are an established but fast-growing business — powered by innovation, data, and technology. Konovo's capabilities are delivered through our cloud-based platform, enabling customers to collect data from healthcare professionals and transform it into actionable insights using cutting-edge AI combined with proven market research tools and techniques.
  
  
As we continue to grow we are expanding our Bengaluru, India engineering team. We are seeking an Engineering Manager to serve as the technical right hand to our Senior Director of Engineering, driving the day-to-day delivery of cutting-edge solutions that power Konovo's platform.
  
  
AI is embedded in our product and internal tooling. You and your team will help us deepen, scale, and operationalise those capabilities across our platform, data systems, and engineering workflows with production reliability and enterprise discipline. This role is for someone who is very strong technically but solution-oriented rather than a pure technician. As a EM you will bring energy, impact, and a drive to get things done collaboratively with a team operating on a global scale. You will inspire, lead, and mentor the team to make things happen.
  
  
**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Act as the technical right hand to the Senior Director of Engineering — translating strategy into day-to-day execution across the Bengaluru engineering team.
* Apply deep technical expertise hands-on: architecture reviews, code reviews, design discussions, and unblocking engineers on hard problems.
* Manage and mentor a cross-functional group of Software, Quality, and Data Engineers, helping each grow their skills and career.
* Drive agile delivery (Scrum) in close partnership with Product and Design, keeping the team focused on outcomes, not just output.
* Bring energy and a get-things-done mindset — identify blockers, propose solutions, and push initiatives to completion.
* Build and ship new product capabilities, balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery timelines.
* Champion engineering best practices — code quality, testing, CI/CD, monitoring — raising the bar across the team.
* Partner with global engineering leadership and peers in other regions to align local execution with company-wide standards.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, integrity, and ownership within the team.
* Evangelize and accelerate AI adoption within both engineering practices and our product.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–5+ years managing and growing a team of software and/or multi-discipline engineers as an Engineering Manager or Team Lead.
* Very strong technically — credible in architecture and design discussions with a solutions-orientation.
* A bias toward action: energetic, collaborative, and relentless about getting things done.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively across a global, distributed organisation.
* Self-starter who can think strategically, creatively, and analytically, and is comfortable operating with ambiguity.
* Passion for learning new technologies and solving complex problems with innovative methods.

**Demonstrated expertise in:**

* Agile methodology and tools, applied hands-on in a team environment.
* Software architecture and design, applied to complex real-world systems.
* Software craftsmanship, SDLC, CI/CD, quality, and monitoring.
* Scaling and growing engineering teams.
* Cloud technology and tooling — comfort with AWS.
* Supporting business-critical systems and products in a SaaS environment.
* Working with and managing global, distributed teams.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science (or equivalent).

**Tech Stack — Direct Experience or Willingness to Quickly Learn**

* Back end: Scala, Java, NodeJS, Go.
* Front end: JavaScript, React, Next.js.
* Database: Databricks, SQL, NoSQL (MongoDB/DocumentDB).
* AI/ML: ML/AI capabilities, Claude Code, AI SDLC, and related concepts.

**Why Konovo?**

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation empowering life science researchers and data scientists with the broadest ecosystem of healthcare audiences and an intelligent, AI-enabled platform — so insights aren't just collected, they're connected.
* Work with a team of smart, nice people who get things done.
* Be the technical right hand to a growing engineering leadership team at a critical global hub undergoing transformative growth and innovation.
* Join a fast-growing global team with real opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* Enjoy a collaborative and hybrid work environment designed for employee well-being, growth, and balance.
* Access long-term incentives and comprehensive benefits, including group medical coverage, accident insurance, and a robust leave policy.
* Make a real-world impact by helping healthcare organisations innovate faster.

If you're eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research — and you're smart, nice, and driven to make an impact — we'd love to hear from you!
  
  
**Apply now to be a part of our journey.**

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Assistant Director – Product Quality**
**Purpose Of The Role**
The role provides specialist expertise in product quality, UAT, data validation and delivery assurance across Power BI, platforms, applications and automation solutions. It ensures that product requirements are translated into testable scenarios and that products are accurate, consistent, aligned to design standards and operationally stable.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own and lead UAT and quality assurance activities across Power BI, data platforms, applications, automation solutions and other digital products.
* Lead UAT planning and execution, coordinating activities across PODs and facilitating sessions with stakeholders across multiple geographies.
* Translate PRDs, functional requirements and acceptance criteria into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases, maintaining traceability through testing and release.
* Perform and coordinate functional, data and output validation, including source-to-report reconciliation, KPI calculations, business rules, filters, security, refreshes and automation outputs.
* Test Power BI reports and semantic models for accuracy, usability and functionality, including visuals, measures, drill-throughs, interactions, filters, navigation, RLS and report consistency.
* Validate platforms, applications, integrations, automation workflows and AI-enabled outputs to ensure they operate as designed and meet agreed requirements.
* Maintain product quality and design standards, conduct regression and release validation, and ensure products remain stable following enhancements and fixes.
* Maintain defect and enhancement backlogs, report UAT status and release readiness, monitor SLAs and work with developers and technical teams to drive issues through to timely resolution.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, UAT, BI testing, data testing, application testing, product quality or technology delivery assurance.
* Strong experience testing Power BI reports, semantic models, measures, relationships, filters, interactions, drill-throughs, RLS and refresh behaviour.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with data validation, reconciliation and data-quality testing across source systems, data platforms and reporting outputs.
* Experience testing applications, platforms, automation workflows, APIs, integrations, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse or Microsoft 365 solutions.
* Strong understanding of test planning, test cases, defect management, regression testing, release validation and traceability.
* Experience converting PRDs and functional requirements into detailed test scenarios, identifying requirement gaps, unclear business rules and edge cases.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps or equivalent tools, including backlog management, defect tracking, SLA monitoring and quality reporting.
* Strong analytical, organisational and collaboration skills, with experience working in Agile, matrixed environments and driving quality outcomes with development, data and technology teams.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, colour, national origin, veteran status, etc. We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Lead Quality Engineer
description:
Syndigo gets great products chosen. Every choice in commerce, whether by a shopper, a search engine, a marketplace, or an AI assistant, is made on product data, and our software makes that data complete and trusted and moves it across the industry's largest two-sided commerce network: 15,000+ brands and 3,500+ retailers. Companies like AutoZone, Colgate-Palmolive, Dole International, Unilever, and Walgreens trust Syndigo to get their products chosen. Learn more at 
www.syndigo.com
.

**\*\*This is a hybrid position that requires 3 days per week in office at our Bangalore location\*\***

Syndigo is looking for a

**Lead Quality Engineer**

to drive quality across the software development lifecycle for enterprise SaaS products. The role involves working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams to ensure high-quality product releases through both manual and automated testing.

**HOW WE’LL BE WINNING TOGETHER DAY TO DAY**

 

* Work closely with product management, development, and support teams and proactively lead quality function to build in quality across SDLC stages.

* Certify the functional and non-functional aspects using the QA best standards to deliver top quality products.

* Take ownership of strategic products (spanning multiple modules) and implement STLC processes.

* Design automation frameworks (using AI, Java, Python & PlayWright) that can be used to implement automation for API, Functional or UI features of the products.

* Use AI / Generative AI to create testing solutions and associated processes.

WE SHOULD TALK IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

* 8-12 years of total experience in testing enterprise software/product with 8+ years of experience in automation framework development and design for APIs, Integrations, UI/UX, Performance, Security, etc.
* Fluent in AI with practical adoption experience (AI, Generative AI, prompt engineering, context design, models, evaluation, etc.).
* Proven experience with automating testing for REST or SOAP APIs and Integrations using necessary tools like RestAssured, Postman, Swagger, Katalon, JMeter, etc.

* Hands on experience with designs and programming/scripting languages (Java, Python). Development or white box testing experience will be preferred.

* Advanced knowledge of web services, web applications, and related areas of non-functional testing like Performance, Scalability, etc.

* Hands-on with Github source control, Test Mgmt tools and JIRA, Confluence, etc.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including an ability to effectively communicate with both product and technical teams.

* Experience working in CI/CD model with SaaS and Cloud technologies (Azure, AWS)

**Preferred Qualifications:**

 

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or relative work experience
* Working experience in Retail/E-Commerce domain or knowledge of MDM/PIM

**Diversity, Equity & Inclusion**

To achieve the best version of our organization, we know it takes new ideas, new approaches, new perspectives and new ways of thinking. A purpose we are 100% committed to cultivating.  Diversity is woven into our fabric at Syndigo and it’s how we stay an industry leader, innovating technology solutions that equip our customers with everything they need to be successful!

All are welcome here and we invite you to join our team if you are ready to help us continue that growth!

**GDPR/CCPA**

Syndigo, to process applications, holds onto data for a "reasonable time" after applications are submitted. This data is stored for Syndigo's internal use by HR/Recruiting Staff only. Verified requests for data deletion and exports will be completed upon request.

**Syndigo Job Applicant Privacy Notice**

At Syndigo, we care about your privacy. As you go through our recruitment process, we are committed to being transparent about how we process your personal data. To learn more about how Syndigo processes your personal data, go to our Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

title: LEAD-Customer Delivery
description:
**About Zinier**
80% of the workers across the globe are Deskless. These are the people who keep our lights on and gas flowing, build roads and bridges, run our manufacturing factories, ensure that we get healthcare service, and provide us with reliable phone and internet connectivity. As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?
  
  
Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.
  
  
We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
We are seeking a Lead, Customer Delivery to lead the successful delivery of complex implementation projects related to deployment of field service and asset management solutions. This role is critical in ensuring our customers achieve measurable business outcomes from our solutions. You will be responsible for driving projects from kickoff through go-live, liaising with cross functional teams, and ensuring scope, schedule, quality, and most importantly customer satisfaction targets are met.
  
  
If you are passionate about solving customer problems, savvy about dealing with multiple stakeholders on both customer and internal sides, and detail oriented enough to be hands-on while driving these complex technical projects, come talk to us.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Facilitate efficient & successful project definition, discovery, design, planning, execution and smooth launch in leading high-performance project teams.
* Manage projects within scope, quality, time, and cost constraints, and ensure any changes are documented and approved through a change control process.
* Build and maintain release and project plans, managing schedules, dependencies, risks, and mitigations, across cross-functional teams, both internal and external.
* Track and report on project milestones and provide regular status reports to all stakeholders, highlighting risks and ensuring agreement and alignment is gained across teams.
* Form strong project team relationships by leading, coaching, and motivating team members, and identifying and resolving blockers or conflicts.
* Enhance delivery excellence by analyzing existing processes, eliminating inefficiencies, and leveraging tools, technology, and intelligent automation to implement scalable frameworks. Champion best practices, metrics, and high-quality standards across delivery programs.
* Coach and mentor teams, fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor’s Degree; PMI certification a plus
* 9+ years experience in software professional services technical project management
* In-depth knowledge and experience implementing Enterprise software applications
* Experience with client services, project management, and solution delivery in both Waterfall and Agile environments;
* Proven ability to deliver results in fast-paced, ambiguous environments through strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, prioritization, and leadership skills.
* Excellent verbal, presentation, and written communication skills including creating usable documentation and tools.
* Proven ability to present technical solutions effectively to diverse stakeholder groups and to engage effectively with senior executives of large enterprises on both technical and business topics.
* Experience working with a cross-functional and geographically dispersed team and customer base with travel up to 10% of the time (including possible international travel).
* Drive technical discussions across architecture, integrations, APIs, data, environments, security, and platform dependencies.
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Architecture and Customer technical teams to translate business requirements into executable technical plans.
* Understand system dependencies and technical risks well enough to challenge assumptions, identify gaps, and drive resolution.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI, intelligent automation and data-driven insights to improve project execution, predict risks, reduce manual processes and improve delivery efficiency.
* Hands-on experience with JIRA, Confluence , standard PM tools and templates.

title: Staff Software Infrastructure Test Architect
description:
**About us:**

  

Aeva’s mission is to bring the next wave of perception to a broad range of applications from automated driving to industrial robotics, consumer electronics, consumer health, security, and beyond. Aeva is transforming autonomy with its groundbreaking sensing and perception technology that integrates all key LiDAR components onto a silicon photonics chip in a compact module. Aeva 4D LiDAR sensors uniquely detect instant velocity in addition to 3D position, allowing autonomous devices like vehicles and robots to make more intelligent and safe decisions.

  
  

**Role Overview:**

  

You will drive the architecture and development of software infrastructure used for testing LiDAR firmware, perception software and associated artifacts. You will also drive strategic technology management and future software solutions architecture that meets automotive compliance requirements.

**What you'll do**
  

  
* Architect, design, and develop a robust and scalable Python based test automation framework for performing fully automated tests for embedded devices and providing traceable matrix for requirements to test-case to defect tracking. Develop automation features that allow end-to-end test coverage for all software and system components
  
* Mentor a team of skilled engineers dedicated to developing test cases, following standard coding practices. Drive code reviews to ensure consistent coding standards across all team members
  
* Develop, implement, and optimize test strategies and plans for automotive software, including functional, regression, performance, and security testing
  
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Firmware, digital signal processing algorithms, and Quality Assurance) to define test requirements and review product specifications
  
* Collaborating with the product owners, architects and other stakeholders to understand the business requirements and plan the quality assurance strategies accordingly
  
  

  
**What you'll have**
  

  
* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
  
* 8 - 12 years of experience in software testing of embedded devices, preferably in the automotive industry
  
* Expert proficiency in Python and C++ programming and relevant libraries/frameworks for test automation
  
* Prior experience architecting test frameworks
  
* Proficiency in test-case development with docker/Kubernetes
  
* Practical knowledge of verification and validation means using testbeds and simulators as well as experience with hardware in the loop (HIL) and software in the loop (SIL) test environments
  
* Knowledge of Embedded device testing, REST APIs, UI testing, Selenium/Playwright, Embedded Linux, Docker, SSH, Shell scripting, Linux services, Computer networks
  
* Experience with continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) practices using Jenkins, Jira, Bitbucket, Agile methodologies, following sprint cycle for test-case development, system and integration testing
  
* Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and break down into simple sprint stories
  
* You have a problem-solving mindset and, able to mentor and guide juniors in solving daily development challenges
  
* Proven ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and projects simultaneously
  
  

  
**What's in it for you**
  

  
* Knowledge of automotive testing standards and frameworks, such as ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, ASPICE, etc
  
* Understanding of automotive software systems, including embedded systems, ADAS, infotainment, or electric vehicle control software
  
* Experience with JAMA for requirements management software (or equivalent)
  
* Experience with JIRA for defect tracking and familiar with Agile methodologies

title: Engineer II, Software
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
**About the Company:**
Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of more than $25 billion and approximately 1,30,000 employees globally. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve complex analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics, deliver medicines to market and increase laboratory productivity.
  
  
Through our world-class brands – Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific and Unity Lab Services – we offer an unmatched combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and comprehensive services.
  
  
**About Team:**
We are the Digital Foundation Platform team, the software centre of excellence (CoE) for Thermo Fisher Scientific. We develop and deliver foundational components, SaaS-based applications, digital lab (Cloud-based) tools, and foundational AI and agentic AI solutions to help scientists work more efficiently and precisely, enabling them to make our world healthier, cleaner, and safer. Our elite software products and solutions accelerate scientific discovery and lab productivity. These solutions
  
  

* Provide rich content, selection tools, teamwork tools, and scientific apps that allow our customers to focus on innovation and the complexities of their science.
* Build a connected world for our customers where discoveries happen in a thoughtful way — where every device/product is connected, self-aware, and self-healing—thereby enabling efficient workflows and collaborative science.
* Enable our customers to efficiently handle their labs by providing them with insight into workflow processes, asset uptime, and product availability.

We give them the flexibility to access what they need when they need it, allowing them to select and receive products and services across multiple channels. We apply industry-standard methodologies to the design, development, and deployment of best-in-class software products built to demonstrate the power and scalability of the cloud.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Purpose:**
The role is for a hands-on Senior Engineer who could make a difference to the product in terms of the design and architecture, and actively contribute to the development of new features. This person will be a member of a cross-functional team building a public cloud-based SaaS delivery platform and associated application services.

* Active contributions to identifying technical risks, alternative solutions to various problems, etc.
* Responsible for ownership of multiple significant software modules
* Responsible for leading the integrity of technical work on significant concurrent projects.
* Plans, participates, and performs the technical work of an assignment.
* Provides guidance regarding design activity to other programmers on technical aspects relating to the project.
* Leads the implementation, automated unit and integration testing, debugging, and integration of code of extreme complexity across multiple concurrent projects.
* Establishes and maintains thorough and accurate documentation of all work.
* Proactively looks for ways and patterns to continuously automate feature testing with measurable and tangible goals

**Candidate Requirement:**
**Education & Experience levels:**
Bachelor's in Engineering/Computer Science or Master's degree or equivalent; proven experience of around 5+ years
  
  
**Skills, Knowledge and Experience:**

* Hands-on experience designing web-based applications in Java/Python technologies and UI technologies
* Hands-on experience in Java application development frameworks and technologies: Java Spring and Hibernate, Python FastAPI or Flask
* Experience with databases, persistence frameworks, and SQL
* Solid design and programming experience and very strong in programming fields like object-oriented principles, design patterns, data structures, and unit testing
* Significant experience using Agile Scrum development processes.
* Excellent analytical and technical skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work effectively with dispersed, remote, and global teams when needed.
* Having a wide range of experience and understanding of trends and technologies; uses technical knowledge to resolve complex issues in creative and effective ways

**Preferred Skills and Experience:**

* Amazon (AWS), Microservices, Agile Team, Angular JS, Python, Selenium, Maven, Spring, Grunt, Shell Scripting
* Amazon (AWS) services experience including AWS IOT, Kinesis, Redbrick, QuickSight, PTC

title: Business Lead, Digital Product Management
description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Data Analytics & Computational Sciences
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Business Intelligence
  
  
**Job Category**
Professional
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead is an experienced role bridging business needs and digital solutions while leading and developing a team of professionals.
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements that enable successful delivery and adoption of digital, analytics, automation, data science, and AI products. The role works across business, product, design, data, engineering, quality, and technology partners to identify business needs, define requirements and future-state capabilities, shape product priorities, and guide digital solutions from discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role collaborates closely with Product Managers, and is responsible for leading and developing a team, setting priorities, managing performance, and strengthening business analysis and product management capabilities
  
  
Business Analysis & Problem Definition
  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders, product teams and business analysts to ensure strategic priorities, business processes, pain points, opportunities, risks, and desired outcomes are effectively understood and documented.
* Guide and mentor business analysts in planning and facilitating discovery sessions through stakeholder interviews, workshops, process analysis, data analysis and user research.
* Provide oversight and direction on process and systems assessments, business requirements documentation, epics, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions align with business objectives and product management best practices.
* Review and coach analysts on developing structured recommendations and business cases that support informed decision-making and investment prioritization.

Digital Product Management
  
  

* Lead and develop business analysts, providing guidance on product management practices, prioritization, and execution.
* Support adherence to product management frameworks, governance processes, and ways of working to ensure consistency across products and teams.
* Oversee product vision, roadmaps, backlogs and establish clear priorities for delivery teams.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, data, UX/design, and other teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to leverage digital technologies, data, automation, analytics, and AI to improve business outcomes, assessing whether AI is the appropriate solution based on value, user need, data readiness, feasibility, risk, and required oversight.

**Product Performance & Business Value**

* Review and coach analysts on defining measurable product outcomes, KPIs, adoption metrics, and value measures, including relevant measures for AI-enabled capabilities such as reliability, output quality, user trust, exception rates, and productivity improvement.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for optimization and enhancement, using AI-assisted analysis to detect patterns, adoption barriers, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Track expected and realized value from digital investments, using AI to synthesize performance, financials, adoption, and user data.
* Recommend whether products or capabilities should be enhanced, scaled, consolidated, or retired based on value, performance, adoption, risks, and strategic fit.

Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership
  
  

* Serve as a key connection point between SCE Product Managers and Business Analyst using AI-assisted synthesis to improve shared understanding of needs, decisions, requirements, and delivery implications.
* Build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities and perspectives, using AI to organize inputs, compare options, clarify areas of agreement, conflict, and unresolved risks.
* Facilitate decisions on requirements, priorities, scope, trade-offs, and delivery, using AI-supported analysis to present options and implications while ensuring accountable stakeholders make final decisions.
* Communicate product roadmaps, progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to leadership, using approved AI tools to accelerate concise, audience-appropriate updates that are reviewed for accuracy and context.
* Translate technical and AI concepts, capabilities, limitations, risks, and trade-offs into clear business language, and translate business needs into actionable direction for technology teams.

People Management & Team Development
  
  

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of business analysts, product professionals, and related roles, including building their ability to use approved AI tools responsibly to improve work quality, speed, and business impact.
* Establish clear objectives, priorities, roles, and performance expectations, including expectations for appropriate AI use, verification of outputs, data protection, and accountability for final work products.
* Provide ongoing feedback, coaching, performance management, and career development, using AI-assisted preparation where appropriate while retaining personal judgment and accountability for employee decisions.
* Allocate work and resources based on priorities, capacity, skills, and development opportunities, using AI-supported workload and scenario analysis to inform—not determine—management decisions.
* Mentor team members in business analysis, product management, stakeholder engagement, Agile ways of working, and responsible application of AI to research, synthesis, requirements, testing, and communication.
* Establish consistent standards and best practices for requirements, product documentation, prioritization, delivery, and AI-assisted ways of working, including validation, traceability, privacy, security, and governance expectations.
* Identify capability gaps and create development plans to strengthen team effectiveness, including AI literacy, prompt and context design, critical evaluation of outputs, data fluency, and value measurement.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team culture that encourages responsible experimentation, shared learning, and scaling of proven AI-enabled practices.

**Other Duties**
Cultivate and Sustain Collaboration: Collaborate across teams to build trust, open communication, and shared ownership of project goals.
  
  

* Champion J&J Values: Model J&J C.E.O. Leadership Behaviors and values to reinforce a healthy and motivating workplace culture.
* Support Team Cohesion: Plan and participate in team-building activities, knowledge-sharing sessions, and feedback loops that foster trust, collaboration, and team cohesion.
* Encourage Growth: Support mentorship, and continuous learning within the team.

**Required Minimum Education**
: Bachelor’s Degree (with 7+ years of experience) and/or Master’s Degree (with 5+ years of experience)
  
  
**Required Years Of Related Experience**

* 5+ years of relevant experience

**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Bachelor's degree and/or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering or Supply Chain.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, product management, digital transformation, technology delivery, or related disciplines in highly regulated business environments.
* Demonstrated people management experience, including coaching, performance management, prioritization, and employee development.
* Digital acumen and strong business analysis experience, including process analysis, requirements definition, future-state design, and stakeholder facilitation.
* Experience managing digital products or technology-enabled capabilities through multiple stages of the product lifecycle.
* Experience developing product roadmaps, managing backlogs, writing requirements/user stories, and prioritizing features.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development and cross-functional delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with business, engineering, architecture, data, and other technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and decision-making skills.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to engage senior leaders
  
  
**Required Skills**
**Preferred Skills:**
Accountability, Advanced Analytics, Analytical Reasoning, Business Intelligence (BI), Business Requirements Analysis, Communication, Data Analysis, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data Privacy Standards, Organizing, Problem Solving, Statistical Analysis Systems (SAS) Programming, Systems Development, Technical Credibility, Technical Writing, Workflow Analysis

title: Senior Development Manager, Technology
description:
Senior Development Manager – AI First Delivery & Transformation
  
  
LSEG Data | Corporate Actions
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Engineering Manager is accountable for the delivery, migration, modernisation, and transformation of one or more Corporate Actions products. The role combines people leadership, technical leadership, product delivery accountability, and AI-first engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and commercially critical platforms.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead teams through complex transformation programmes while establishing and scaling AI-enabled software delivery, multi-agent engineering practices, and governed engineering control planes across the Software Development Lifecycle.
  
  
Technical
  
  
I lead AI-first engineering teams delivering complex products, migrations, and transformation programmes. I bring deep expertise in multi-agent software delivery, engineering control planes, agent orchestration, context engineering, and AI-enabled SDLC practices.
  
  
I establish standards for agent-assisted requirements, architecture, development, testing, governance, security, and operations while ensuring human accountability remains clear for all material decisions.
  
  
Mandatory Experience
  
  
Strong hands-on engineering background in either .NET/C# or Java enterprise development.
  
  
Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell or Bash.
  
  
Experience developing and operating containerised applications using Docker and modern cloud-native engineering practices.
  
  
Experience leading engineering teams delivering distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, and modern software platforms.
  
  
Experience implementing AI-assisted or agent-enabled software delivery practices.
  
  
Desirable Experience
  
  
React
  
  
Python
  
  
Go
  
  
Rust
  
  
C
  
  
C++
  
  
Azure
  
  
AWS
  
  
Kubernetes
  
  
Platform Engineering
  
  
AI orchestration frameworks, MCPs, agent governance, and model evaluation frameworks
  
  
Customer Focus
  
  
I ensure engineering teams remain focused on customer outcomes, service quality, and business value. I use AI and automation to accelerate delivery, improve product quality, reduce operational friction, and modernise legacy platforms without compromising reliability or trust.
  
  
Risk Management
  
  
I establish governance and control frameworks for AI-enabled engineering. I ensure agents, models, tools, and delivery workflows operate within defined security, compliance, operational resilience, and risk boundaries.
  
  
I balance delivery speed with appropriate engineering controls, auditability, observability, and release readiness.
  
  
Leadership

title: Senior Release Engineer
description:
**Bring more to life.**
At Danaher, our work saves lives. And each of us plays a part. Fueled by our culture of continuous improvement, we turn ideas into impact, innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
Our 60,000+ associates work across the globe at more than 15 unique businesses within life sciences, diagnostics, and biotechnology.
