At Danaher, you can build an incredible career at a leading science and technology company, where we are committed to hiring and developing from within. You will thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter.
  
  
Learn Danaher Business System, which makes everything possible.
  
  
The Senior Release Engineer owns the planning, coordination, governance, and continuous improvement of releases across Danaher's Enterprise Data Platform, including Snowflake, Azure, Matillion, dbt, Airflow, GitHub, and related data services. This role orchestrates releases across platform, data engineering, operations, security, and OpCo teams, ensuring changes are tested, approved, traceable, communicated, and deployed with minimal business disruption. The Release Manager strengthens release discipline through automation, standard controls, metrics, and pragmatic delivery practices while supporting both planned releases and urgent production changes.
  
  
This position reports to the Director - Data Platform and Operations and is part of the Enterprise Data Engineering team located in the Bangalore IDC office. The specific working arrangement will be confirmed by the interview team.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**

* Lead end-to-end release management and governance for the data platform, including release planning, scope, schedules, dependencies, readiness reviews, go/no-go decisions, change approvals, production readiness checks, deployments, validation, rollback, hypercare, closure activities, and post-release reviews with clear decision tracking and accountability.- Coordinate cross-functional delivery and stakeholder alignment by partnering with platform engineering, data engineering, DataOps, architecture, security, service management, vendors, and OpCo teams to manage dependencies, mitigate risks, represent releases at Change Approval Boards, ensure adherence to DHR standard processes, and align release trains with enterprise platform priorities, data product delivery, compliance commitments, and OpCo onboarding.- Establish and continuously improve release processes, standards, and automation by defining and maintaining release calendars, checklists, entry and exit criteria, deployment and rollback plans, runbooks, evidence requirements, and release reporting, while advancing GitHub Actions, CI/CD, GitOps, automated testing, environment promotion, and deployment controls.- Ensure change, risk, compliance, and production stability management by enforcing change-management, segregation-of-duties, security, audit, compliance, and emergency change requirements; coordinating release windows, production validation, incident handoffs, rollback decisions, and release communications to minimize failed changes and service disruptions.- Drive release transparency, performance measurement, and continuous improvement through stakeholder communications, reporting of release status, milestones, dependencies, risks and decisions, and by leveraging release outcomes, defects, incidents, lead time, deployment frequency, rollback trends, and lessons learned to improve delivery reliability, efficiency, and operational excellence.

**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**

* 5+ years of progressive experience in release management, change management, platform operations, software delivery, or related technology disciplines, including responsibility for coordinating enterprise production releases across complex technology environments.- Proven experience managing releases across cloud, data, or software platforms, working across multiple teams, environments, dependencies, and stakeholder groups while balancing competing priorities and ensuring successful delivery outcomes.- Strong technical understanding of modern data platform technologies, including Snowflake, Azure, Matillion, dbt, and Apache Airflow, with the ability to assess deployment dependencies, operational impacts, and production risks.- Hands-on knowledge of modern software delivery and change-control practices, including GitHub Enterprise or comparable source-control platforms, CI/CD methodologies, branching and promotion strategies, automated testing, deployment approvals, rollback procedures, and IT service management/change processes using ServiceNow or equivalent tools, including standard, normal, and emergency changes.- Exceptional planning, facilitation, documentation, risk management, and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple releases, translate complex technical release information into concise status, readiness, risk, and decision communications for both engineering teams and executive leadership; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements**

* Ability to travel up to 10% domestically and occasionally internationally for team meetings, planning workshops, vendor engagements, and OpCo collaboration.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Release management for regulated or audit-sensitive platforms under SOX, SOC 1/2, GxP, privacy, or similar control frameworks.
* GitOps, reusable GitHub Actions workflows, automated quality gates, artifact versioning, and progressive delivery practices.
* Data platform observability, incident management, problem management, disaster recovery, and operational readiness.
* Coordinating releases in a multi-OpCo, multi-tenant, or federated enterprise environment.
* Certifications such as ITIL 4, SAFe, Scrum.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
  
  
For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Sr Manager, Software Engineering
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. You will define and drive the application architecture for our platform — designing scalable, resilient systems in .NET and Angular/React — while embedding quality engineering into every architectural decision. You'll champion AI-powered development practices across the entire SDLC, set the technical vision for quality at the architecture level, and mentor engineering teams on building software that is correct by construction, not just tested after the fact. We're looking for someone who sees quality not as a phase but as an architectural property, who leads through technical excellence, and who thrives at the intersection of product engineering, quality engineering, and AI-driven innovation.
  
  
**Required Skills:**

* Education: BE, B. Tech, M. Tech Only
* Experience Level: 10-15+ Years of hands-on software engineering experience, with 4+ years in Leading or staff engineer role

**Mandatory Skills (Full-Stack + Quality & Product Engineering)**

* Deep expertise in .NET framework (C#, ASP.NET, .NET Core) and modern frontend frameworks (Angular 10+ and/or ReactJS with TypeScript).
* Proven experience designing and owning application architectures: service decomposition, API design, data modelling, and system integration patterns.
* Strong proficiency in microservice architecture, event-driven programming, async design patterns, and distributed systems.
* Extensive experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and Web APIs with a focus on contract-first design.
* Strong knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript for building robust, accessible user interfaces.

* Expert-level quality engineering mindset: deep experience with test automation frameworks, unit/integration/end-to-end testing, contract testing, and performance/load testing at the architecture level.
* Proven ability to embed quality gates in CI/CD pipelines — linting, static analysis, test coverage thresholds, security scanning, and automated regression.
* Strong understanding of quality management principles: defect prevention strategies, root cause analysis, test planning, quality metrics, and continuous quality improvement across the product lifecycle.

* Strong architecture documentation skills — ADRs, system design documents, sequence diagrams, and quality engineering playbooks.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to articulate technical decisions to both engineering and business audiences.
* Proven ability to mentor and lead engineers across multiple teams; strong track record of raising the technical and quality bar.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own and evolve the application architecture for full-stack systems built on .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core) and Angular/React, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and quality by design.
* Design quality-first architectures: embed testability, observability, fault isolation, and graceful degradation as first-class architectural concerns — not afterthoughts.

* Design and build microservice-based, event-driven systems with async design patterns, ensuring resilience, loose coupling, and horizontal scalability.
* Lead the quality engineering practice at the architecture level: define test automation strategies, contract testing frameworks, performance/load testing architectures, and shift-left quality gates embedded in CI/CD pipelines.
* Establish and enforce coding standards, design patterns, and architectural decision records (ADRs) that raise the quality bar across all product engineering teams.

* Mentor and coach senior and mid-level engineers on architecture principles, quality engineering practices, AI tool adoption, and full-stack development excellence.

**Your work profile**

  

We are seeking an experienced Unix Administrator – Senior Consultant to support, manage, and optimize enterprise Linux/Unix environments across on-premises data centers and hybrid infrastructures. This role requires strong hands-on expertise with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Ubuntu Server, Linux clustering technologies, and advanced troubleshooting skills. The Senior Consultant will provide L2/L3 technical support, drive operational excellence, ensure platform stability, and contribute to automation and modernization initiatives within the Unix/Linux tower. Key Responsibilities UNIX, Red Hat HA, SUSE HA, Red Hat Clustering, Veritas Clustering, Apache Unix/Linux Server Administration

* Perform installation, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu Server environments.

* Conduct OS patching, kernel updates, security hardening, performance tuning, and lifecycle management.

* Manage logical volumes (LVM), file systems, RAID configurations, and storage integrations. Clustering & High Availability

* Implement, configure, and support Linux clustering technologies, such as: o Red Hat Cluster Suite (Pacemaker/Corosync) o HAProxy / Keepalived o DRBD, fencing agents, failover resources

* Perform cluster validation, failover testing, quorum configuration, and cluster performance diagnostics.

* Troubleshoot cluster failures, split-brain issues, node communication problems, and HA resource constraints. Scripting, Automation & Tools

* Develop and maintain automation scripts using Shell/Bash, Python, and Ansible.

* Automate routine tasks such as patching, configuration deployment, monitoring, and health audits.

* Work with configuration management and orchestration tools (Ansible, Puppet, SaltStack preferred). Networking & Security

* Manage Linux network configurations including bonding, VLANs, routing, DNS configurations, and firewall rules (firewalld/iptables).

* Implement OS-level security best practices, SELinux policies (enforcing/permissive), and vulnerability remediation.

* Support authentication integrations with LDAP/AD/Samba/Kerberos. Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Operations

* Monitor system health, performance, logs, and hardware components using tools like Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus, or Red Hat Insights.

* Handle L2/L3 escalations for OS performance issues, application failures, kernel panics, filesystem corruption, and networking defects.

* Provide root-cause analysis (RCA), incident resolution, and support planned maintenance activities. Documentation & Collaboration

* Maintain accurate SOPs, topology documentation, server inventories, and configuration guides.

* Collaborate with middleware, database, storage, network, and security teams for cross functional troubleshooting.

* Participate in DR drills, compliance audits, and capacity planning exercises. Required Skills

* Strong hands-on experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu Server in enterprise environments.

* Expertise in Linux clustering technologies (Pacemaker/Corosync, HAProxy, Keepalived, etc.).

* Proficiency with Shell/Bash scripting, and familiarity with Ansible automation.

• Strong understanding of Linux internals: processes, memory, storage, networking, and kernel-level troubleshooting. • Experience with LVM, filesystems (ext4, XFS), permissions, SELinux, systemd, and performance analysis tools.

* Ability to troubleshoot hardware, OS, networking, and storage-related issues in a multi-tier environment.

  

**Key skills required:**

* Education : Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

* 3+ years of experience in Unix/Linux system administration.

description:

**Job Summary**
We are seeking a Senior Techno Functional Analyst with strong hands on experience in Model N Revenue Manager and Oracle Database to support and enhance critical Revenue Management processes, including Chargebacks, Rebates, Managed Care, Government Pricing, and integrations with upstream and downstream systems.

* Analyze and resolve batch job failures, performance bottlenecks, and Oracle Scheduler–based processing issues.
* Perform advanced Oracle SQL and PL/SQL analysis for:
* Data validation and reconciliation
* Defect investigation and resolution
* Ad‑hoc and audit support analysis
* Troubleshoot and support system integrations and interfaces, including:
* PL/SQL‑based inbound and outbound feeds
* High‑volume transactional / EDI‑style data loads and extracts
* Support data fixes, backend loads, and controlled updates across lower and production environments, following established change and governance processes.
* Assist with SIT, UAT, and regression testing, including test scenario creation, execution, and defect triage.
* Investigate and resolve data discrepancies in reports, extracts, and downstream feeds in collaboration with business, integration, and reporting teams.
* Support platform upgrades and regulatory releases by assessing impact, validating customizations, and ensuring data integrity.
* Collaborate with functional, business, and vendor teams to produce Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation and define preventive actions.

**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* 10+ years of experience as a Technical / Techno‑Functional Analyst or Application Support Analyst in enterprise systems.
* Strong hands‑on experience with Model N Revenue Manager, including:

+ Chargebacks
+ Rebates
+ Managed Care
+ Government Pricing
+ Validata
+ MDM

* Advanced proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL, including complex joins, performance tuning, and large‑volume data analysis.
* Experience supporting Oracle Scheduler jobs, batch frameworks, and high‑volume data processing.
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical Revenue Management and gross‑to‑net processes.
* Hands‑on experience with system integrations and data interfaces.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in a production‑support, ticket‑driven environment.

**Qualifications**

* Experience with Model N SaaS / AWS‑based deployments.
* Exposure to EDI transactions and pharmaceutical gross‑to‑net data flows.
* Familiarity with IT governance, change management, and validation methodologies (SIT/UAT).
* Experience working with cross‑functional stakeholders and external vendors.

**Why Sandoz?**
Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
  
  
**Join us!**

Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  
Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**

You will define and implement the end-to-end security architecture for Databricks on a major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This is a hands-on role responsible for the access, governance, and data-protection model across the platform. You have designed and implemented enterprise security controls for Databricks environments, and you will act as a cross-account authority on security guardrails, access governance, and compliance.

What You Will Do

**Own end-to-end security architecture.** Define and implement the security architecture for Databricks across the platform, from identity through data protection.

**Manage identity and access.** Own SSO/MFA integration and RBAC/ABAC access models, and establish access governance processes across accounts and workspaces.

**Secure Unity Catalog.** Design and enforce Unity Catalog security, data classification, and fine-grained access controls (row, column, and attribute level).

**Secure Delta Sharing and open sharing.** Ensure only approved data is exposed across cross-account and open sharing, with reliable, measurable revocation.

**Design least privilege and blast-radius containment.** Establish the lowest practical access boundary, preventing access to adjacent business-unit data and storage.

**Control privileged access and configuration drift.** Govern privileged elevation and break-glass access, and detect unauthorized changes with monitored alert latency and remediation.

**Protect data and secrets.** Establish controls for encryption, secrets management, and network security aligned to relevant regulatory compliance requirements.

**Build guardrails and auditability.** Set up security guardrails, auditability, and access governance so the platform stays compliant and controllable as it scales.

**Provide cross-account technical leadership.** Act as a go-to security reviewer across multiple accounts, contributing to design reviews and resolving access and governance issues that individual delivery teams cannot.

What You Bring (Required)

Hands-on experience designing and implementing security for enterprise Databricks environments.

Deep Unity Catalog security experience: RBAC/ABAC, fine-grained (row/column/attribute) access, data classification, and Delta Sharing / open sharing controls.

Least-privilege and blast-radius design across business units, containing access to adjacent data and storage.

Privileged access management experience: controlled elevation, break-glass, configuration-drift detection, and remediation.

Strong identity and access management background: SSO/MFA integration and access governance.

Expertise in encryption, secrets management, and network security on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements relevant to data platforms.

Ability to design and run proof-of-control tests and quantify outcomes (e.g., revocation time, data exposure, drift-detection and alert latency), not just implement.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

Databricks Cloud Platform Architect accreditation (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or Databricks Platform Administrator.

Recognized cloud security certification (e.g., AWS or Azure security specialty, or CISSP). Note that Databricks has no standalone security certification, so security credentials come from the cloud provider or an industry body.

Multi-cloud experience across two or more of AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Regulated-industry experience (financial services, healthcare, or similar).

What This Role Is Not

This is a Databricks-native security and access architect role. It is not a general enterprise or datacenter security role. The right candidate has genuinely designed and implemented access, governance, and data-protection controls inside Databricks environments, distinct from a generalist security engineer without hands-on Databricks depth.

title: Lead Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!

**Lead Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Oracle RAC**

**Self-Managed Oracle RAC | HA/DR | Performance | Automation | Engineering Influence**

**Level**

Lead DBRE

**Domain**

Oracle RAC and Mission-Critical Relational Infrastructure

**Primary Focus**

Hands-on Oracle RAC reliability, lifecycle ownership, technical escalation, automation, application partnership, and cross-functional execution

**Work Expectations**

U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required

**1. Role Summary**
===================

We are seeking an experienced Lead DBRE with deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Database and self-managed Oracle RAC environments. The role owns technical execution for a major Oracle domain and improves reliability, performance, scalability, lifecycle management, automation, and operational discipline.

Beyond traditional DBA operations, the Lead DBRE partners with application and infrastructure teams to influence schema, SQL, connection management, resiliency, observability, and safe deployment practices. The role remains hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and incident escalation.

**2. Level Scope and Leadership Expectations**
==============================================

Lead DBRE is a senior technical leadership role focused on owning execution for a major database domain. The expectation is to solve difficult production problems, lead initiatives end to end, guide engineers, create durable operating standards, and drive cross-functional closure without default people-management responsibility.

**Dimension**

**Expectation at This Level**

**Scope of Ownership**

Owns reliability and execution for a significant Oracle platform domain, including incidents, lifecycle activities, routine maintenance, capacity risks, HA/DR readiness, and service-impacting improvements.

**Technical Depth**

Diagnoses complex RAC, Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, SQL performance, storage, interconnect, OS, backup, and recovery problems.

**Technical Leadership**

Acts as a primary escalation point, mentors engineers, reviews designs, raises standards, and influences application and infrastructure decisions.

**Execution**

Leads complex initiatives end to end, aligns stakeholders, manages dependencies, and drives permanent corrective actions to closure.

**Communication**

Explains technical tradeoffs, communicates clearly during incidents, and keeps risks, ownership, dependencies, and timelines visible.

**Automation and Standards**

Builds repeatable automation, CI/CD practices, runbooks, monitoring, and golden paths that reduce toil and failure risk.

**3. Key Responsibilities**
===========================

**A. Oracle RAC Platform Ownership**
------------------------------------

* Administer and improve Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, Clusterware, ASM, services, SCAN/listeners, and interconnect configurations.
* Plan and execute patching, upgrades, migrations, capacity changes, and lifecycle activities with controlled change and rollback practices.
* Design, operate, and validate Data Guard, RMAN, backup/recovery, failover, switchover, and disaster-recovery procedures.

**B. Performance and Incident Leadership**
------------------------------------------

* Lead performance analysis using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, SQL Trace, TKPROF, and OS/storage diagnostics.
* Diagnose Cache Fusion, GC waits, workload placement, connection storms, cluster instability, storage latency, and interconnect issues.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, lead stabilization and RCA, and drive permanent corrective actions.

**C. Engineering Influence and Shift-Left Reliability**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Partner with application teams on SQL, indexing, partitioning, schema design, bind usage, connection pooling, transaction boundaries, and resilient failover behavior.
* Establish database design reviews, deployment guardrails, developer guidance, and production-readiness standards.

**D. Automation and Observability**
-----------------------------------

* Automate provisioning, validation, patching, maintenance, backup checks, DR exercises, health checks, and recurring remediation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Improve Oracle observability using OEM, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable tools; define actionable service indicators and objectives.

**4. Required Qualifications and Experience**
=============================================

* 8+ years of database or reliability engineering experience, including significant Lead or Senior responsibility for self-managed production Oracle RAC.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure/Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, RAC Services, SCAN/listeners, Cache Fusion, and interconnect behavior.
* Strong Oracle performance tuning and diagnostics experience using AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL Trace, and Linux diagnostics.
* Experience with patching, upgrades, migrations, backup/recovery, DR exercises, and controlled production change.
* Strong Linux/Unix systems troubleshooting skills.
* Hands-on automation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or comparable tooling.
* Strong technical leadership, mentoring, incident communication, and cross-functional execution skills.

**5. Preferred Qualifications**
===============================

* Oracle Exadata, OCI, Cloud@Customer, AWS, or hybrid Oracle deployment experience.
* Application Continuity, FAN, TAF, FSFO, Far Sync, GoldenGate, GDS, TDE, ZDLRA, or advanced Oracle HA capabilities.
* Database schema CI/CD using Liquibase, Flyway, Bytebase, or comparable tooling.
* Oracle certifications or relevant SRE/cloud architecture credentials.

**6. Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months**
=================================================

* Establish measurable reliability, MTTR, patching, backup/recovery, and DR-readiness baselines and deliver material improvement.
* Automate high-frequency and high-risk operational workflows, prioritizing safety, maintainability, and auditability.
* Establish a practical database architecture and production-readiness review process with measurable adoption by application teams.
* Deliver documented capacity, lifecycle, resiliency, and corrective-action plans for critical RAC environments.

**7. What This Role Does Not Include**
======================================

* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is expected through technical direction, mentoring, and execution ownership.
* This is not a project-management-only role; the Lead DBRE must remain deeply hands-on.
* This is not a traditional DBA ticket queue; durable fixes, automation, standards, capacity planning, and reliability improvements are expected.
* This role does not own application code or business logic, although it influences database-impacting application design.
* The role does not assume unlimited or last-minute DBRE capacity; work must be planned, prioritized, communicated, and committed through the appropriate process.

**8. Work Expectations and Location**
=====================================

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

**Database Administrator (L2)**
with 5 to 9 years of hands-on experience in supporting and managing databases such as MySQL, Secondary skill (MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Oracle). The role involves database administration, performance optimization, backup, and recovery management, and ensuring high availability across various environments like Development, QA, UAT, and Production.

title: Lead Database Reliability Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**Lead Database Reliability Engineer (DBRE) - Oracle RAC**
**Self-Managed Oracle RAC | HA/DR | Performance | Automation | Engineering Influence**
**Level**
Lead DBRE
  
  
**Domain**
Oracle RAC and Mission-Critical Relational Infrastructure
  
  
**Primary Focus**
Hands-on Oracle RAC reliability, lifecycle ownership, technical escalation, automation, application partnership, and cross-functional execution
  
  
**Work Expectations**
U.S. Eastern Time business hours; on-call participation as required
  
  

* Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Lead DBRE with deep hands-on expertise in Oracle Database and self-managed Oracle RAC environments. The role owns technical execution for a major Oracle domain and improves reliability, performance, scalability, lifecycle management, automation, and operational discipline.
  
  
Beyond traditional DBA operations, the Lead DBRE partners with application and infrastructure teams to influence schema, SQL, connection management, resiliency, observability, and safe deployment practices. The role remains hands-on while providing technical leadership, mentoring, and incident escalation.
  
  

* Level Scope and Leadership Expectations

Lead DBRE is a senior technical leadership role focused on owning execution for a major database domain. The expectation is to solve difficult production problems, lead initiatives end to end, guide engineers, create durable operating standards, and drive cross-functional closure without default people-management responsibility.
  
  
**Dimension**
**Expectation at This Level**
**Scope of Ownership**
Owns reliability and execution for a significant Oracle platform domain, including incidents, lifecycle activities, routine maintenance, capacity risks, HA/DR readiness, and service-impacting improvements.
  
  
**Technical Depth**
Diagnoses complex RAC, Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, SQL performance, storage, interconnect, OS, backup, and recovery problems.
  
  
**Technical Leadership**
Acts as a primary escalation point, mentors engineers, reviews designs, raises standards, and influences application and infrastructure decisions.
  
  
**Execution**
Leads complex initiatives end to end, aligns stakeholders, manages dependencies, and drives permanent corrective actions to closure.
  
  
**Communication**
Explains technical tradeoffs, communicates clearly during incidents, and keeps risks, ownership, dependencies, and timelines visible.
  
  
**Automation and Standards**
Builds repeatable automation, CI/CD practices, runbooks, monitoring, and golden paths that reduce toil and failure risk.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Oracle RAC Platform Ownership
* Administer and improve Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure, Clusterware, ASM, services, SCAN/listeners, and interconnect configurations.
* Plan and execute patching, upgrades, migrations, capacity changes, and lifecycle activities with controlled change and rollback practices.
* Design, operate, and validate Data Guard, RMAN, backup/recovery, failover, switchover, and disaster-recovery procedures.
* Performance and Incident Leadership
* Lead performance analysis using AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQL Monitor, execution plans, SQL Trace, TKPROF, and OS/storage diagnostics.
* Diagnose Cache Fusion, GC waits, workload placement, connection storms, cluster instability, storage latency, and interconnect issues.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for critical incidents, lead stabilization and RCA, and drive permanent corrective actions.
* Engineering Influence and Shift-Left Reliability
* Partner with application teams on SQL, indexing, partitioning, schema design, bind usage, connection pooling, transaction boundaries, and resilient failover behavior.
* Establish database design reviews, deployment guardrails, developer guidance, and production-readiness standards.
* Automation and Observability
* Automate provisioning, validation, patching, maintenance, backup checks, DR exercises, health checks, and recurring remediation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
* Improve Oracle observability using OEM, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable tools; define actionable service indicators and objectives.
* Required Qualifications and Experience
* 8+ years of database or reliability engineering experience, including significant Lead or Senior responsibility for self-managed production Oracle RAC.
* Deep hands-on knowledge of Oracle RAC, Grid Infrastructure/Clusterware, ASM, Data Guard, RMAN, RAC Services, SCAN/listeners, Cache Fusion, and interconnect behavior.
* Strong Oracle performance tuning and diagnostics experience using AWR, ASH, execution plans, SQL Trace, and Linux diagnostics.
* Experience with patching, upgrades, migrations, backup/recovery, DR exercises, and controlled production change.
* Strong Linux/Unix systems troubleshooting skills.
* Hands-on automation using Python, Shell, Ansible, Terraform, or comparable tooling.
* Strong technical leadership, mentoring, incident communication, and cross-functional execution skills.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Oracle Exadata, OCI, Cloud@Customer, AWS, or hybrid Oracle deployment experience.
* Application Continuity, FAN, TAF, FSFO, Far Sync, GoldenGate, GDS, TDE, ZDLRA, or advanced Oracle HA capabilities.
* Database schema CI/CD using Liquibase, Flyway, Bytebase, or comparable tooling.
* Oracle certifications or relevant SRE/cloud architecture credentials.
* Expected Outcomes in the First 6-12 Months
* Establish measurable reliability, MTTR, patching, backup/recovery, and DR-readiness baselines and deliver material improvement.
* Automate high-frequency and high-risk operational workflows, prioritizing safety, maintainability, and auditability.
* Establish a practical database architecture and production-readiness review process with measurable adoption by application teams.
* Deliver documented capacity, lifecycle, resiliency, and corrective-action plans for critical RAC environments.
* What This Role Does Not Include
* This is not a people-management role unless separately assigned; leadership is expected through technical direction, mentoring, and execution ownership.
* This is not a project-management-only role; the Lead DBRE must remain deeply hands-on.
* This is not a traditional DBA ticket queue; durable fixes, automation, standards, capacity planning, and reliability improvements are expected.
* This role does not own application code or business logic, although it influences database-impacting application design.
* The role does not assume unlimited or last-minute DBRE capacity; work must be planned, prioritized, communicated, and committed through the appropriate process.
* Work Expectations and Location

This role requires working during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) business hours and participating in on-call support as required.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer-first approach. It also mentors less-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long-term maintainability before go-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source-to-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data.
* Confirm and pressure-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design.
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go-live.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process.
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth.
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery.
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap.

**Requirements And Preferred Experience**

* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5+ years of hands-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field

**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
  
  
**Opportunity to Innovate**
The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
This isn’t your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
  
  
**A Place to Make Your Mark**
We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
  
  
**Benefits That Work For You**
Enjoy an award-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
  
  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: BC Sector O and G-Cognite-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS | COGNITE DATA ENGINEERING LEAD**
**Oil & Gas | Manager**
**Job Title Cognite Data Engineering Lead – Manager**
**Experience Level 10+ Years**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Cognite Data Engineering Lead to implement reliable data pipelines, industrial data models and contextualization workflows in Cognite Data Fusion (CDF). You will own implementation quality, make component-level engineering decisions within the agreed architecture, and deliver data that operational applications and analytical solutions can reliably consume.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include:**
**Extraction and ingestion**

* Configure supported Cognite extractors and implement API or custom integrations where required.
* Build source-appropriate incremental loads with persistent checkpoints, retries and restart behaviour; handle pagination, throttling, historical backfills and late-arriving updates.
* Implement repeatable writes and reconciliation checks so rerunning failed loads does not create inconsistent results.
* Validate source-to-target counts, time ranges and completeness while preserving identifiers, units and quality information.
* Diagnose failures involving connectivity, permissions, source changes and malformed records.

**Data modelling and transformation**

* Implement approved spaces, containers, views, data models, instances and relationships.
* Reuse or extend Core Data Model concepts in line with the solution design.
* Develop SQL transformations and Python processing for cleansing, normalization, mapping and enrichment.
* Implement stable identifiers and source crosswalks, including collision checks for repeated tags across sites.
* Preserve distinctions between equipment, functional locations and changing assignments; test schema changes and execute migrations without breaking dependent consumers.

**Contextualization and Oil & Gas data**

* Implement identifier-based matching, rules and supported contextualization services to connect operational and engineering records.
* Link time series, maintenance activities and documents to the correct equipment or functional location.
* Validate matches against reference mappings, assess coverage and false matches, and route unresolved cases for domain review.
* Maintain mappings when tags, equipment assignments, hierarchies or document revisions change.
* Preserve upstream well and wellbore identities, provenance, tests and intervention history; preserve downstream equipment relationships, units, laboratory timing, and links between diagrams, documents and measurements.

**Testing, deployment and application handoff**

* Write and review production Python and SQL code with automated tests.
* Test completeness, freshness, uniqueness, relationship integrity, time-zone handling and recovery after interruption.
* Maintain configuration in Git and automate supported deployment using Cognite Toolkit.
* Monitor extraction, transformation and workflow execution with actionable logs and failure handling; configure least-privilege access.
* Deliver documented consumer views and example SDK/API queries, verify access and performance, maintain runbooks, and identify design changes requiring architecture review.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A relevant engineering, computer science or information systems degree, or equivalent technical experience.
* Substantial hands-on Cognite Data Fusion implementation experience and understanding of production operation.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including Cognite SDK and REST API usage.
* Experience implementing CDF data models, transformations and contextualization.
* Experience building pipelines with incremental loading, reconciliation, backfill and recovery.
* Practical knowledge of Git, automated testing, CI/CD and deployment configuration.
* Familiarity with authentication and the CDF capabilities required by integration services.
* Strong implementation knowledge in at least one upstream or downstream setting, with ability to apply relevant concepts to the other.
* Evidence of personally delivering and troubleshooting data pipelines used by operational or engineering applications.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Cognite Toolkit, extraction pipeline monitoring and workflow orchestration.
* Familiarity with AVEVA PI, SAP maintenance data, IBM Maximo, laboratory systems or well-data services.
* Experience with WITSML, OPC UA, database extraction or enterprise APIs.
* Experience with document or diagram contextualization and 3D associations.
* Working knowledge of a major cloud platform and containerized integration services.
* Relevant Cognite Academy training or certifications.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact industrial data and analytics challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A hands-on leadership role with scope to establish reusable practices and guide multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data, technology, product and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A technical lead who can demonstrate a functioning ingestion-to-consumption workflow, explain their personal implementation contribution, and show how failed loads, duplicate records, incorrect relationships and application-access issues are detected and corrected.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Head - Data M&E & Institutional Intelligence
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk operates on the principle that 'what gets measured, gets governed.' This role owns the data spine of the organisation — the independent control room that tells every layer of RightWalk whether systems are working, outcomes are real, and learning is being captured. Critically, this function must be independent of the program teams whose performance it measures. Data inflation and incentive-driven reporting are existential threats to RightWalk's credibility. The Head – Data, M&E & Institutional Intelligence is the institutional conscience of the organisation's evidence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Data and indicator architecture**

* Design and own the end-to-end data architecture: from field input to impact indicators — definitions, collection protocols, validation logic, and storage.
* Build common data dictionaries across programs and states.
* Ensure indicator definitions are clear, auditable and usable by teams.
* Align program indicators with donor reporting, government dashboards and internal learning needs.

**2. Dashboards and institutional intelligence**

* Build and maintain real-time dashboards and standard report packs for the CEO, state teams, and donors.
* Drive institutional intelligence: cross-state comparisons, learning loops, and evidence synthesis for policy refinement.
* Convert data into actionable intelligence for policy, program and product decisions.
* Manage the Knowledge Management function — evidence library, document repositories, and institutional memory.

**3. M&E systems and quality assurance**

* Lead the M&E framework: indicator design, sampling methodology, periodic evaluation cycles, and external evaluation partnerships.
* Own data governance — data quality audits, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag dashboards, and anomaly detection.
* Lead and develop State M&E Leads (embedded in states, functionally reporting to this role).
* Conduct periodic verification, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag reviews and quality audits.
* Maintain strict independence from Program and State teams — this role's credibility depends on it.

**4. Learning loops and evidence building**

* Ensure field learning feeds into policy redesign, process improvement and product updates.
* Support impact evaluation readiness and external evaluation partnerships.
* Produce public-good outputs — impact reports, evidence briefs, and external publications that build RightWalk's credibility.

**5. Data governance and ethics**

* Define data access, privacy, anonymisation and data security protocols with Tech and People teams.
* Ensure responsible handling of beneficiary, field and government data.
* Create data discipline without making teams feel they are entering a tax raid.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — SIX MONTHS**

* Organisation-wide M&E and data architecture drafted and adopted.
* A live dashboard exists that the CEO, State Directors, and donors can access — real-time, reliable, and action-oriented.
* Data quality audits are conducted every quarter; anomalies are surfaced, not suppressed.
* The organisation makes at least two key program design changes in direct response to M&E evidence.
* RightWalk publishes at least one credible external evidence brief that strengthens its policy positioning.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Setting programmatic targets — that is the program team's domain.
* Managing field delivery or GDN operations.
* Policy authorship or advocacy strategy.
* Tech platform development (though close collaboration with Tech is essential).
* Sit under state programs whose performance it must assess.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Experience:**
  10–16 years in M&E, data systems, evaluation, or research — ideally within development sector, government advisory, or research institutions.
* **Methods:**
  Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills — comfortable with both survey-based M&E and systems-level data architecture.
* **Tools:**
  Experience with MIS/dashboard design and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* **Independence:**
  Track record of building independent M&E functions that are trusted by leadership and donors alike.
* **Orientation:**
  Governance mindset - more interested in data integrity than in making numbers look good.
* **Sector:**
  Exposure to government data systems, HMIS, DISE, or similar public data infrastructure

**Area of expertise**
Roster of International consultant – Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance and/or laboratory strengthening for AMR
  
  
**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia is establishing a roster of qualified consultants who may be engaged for specific assignments to strengthen national and regional AMR surveillance, clinical microbiology services and laboratory systems. Assignments may cover surveillance design and assessment; implementation and reporting through the Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System (GLASS); bacteriology and mycology capacity; diagnostic stewardship; laboratory networks and quality systems; data quality, analysis, interpretation and visualization; One Health and genomic surveillance; capacity development; operational research; and translation of surveillance evidence into policy and programme action.
  
  
Depending on the individual Terms of Reference, consultants will provide technical assistance for planning, implementation, analysis and reporting using WHO tools, standards and recommendations. They may also contribute to evidence-based technical guidance, protocols, standard operating procedures, training packages and implementation tools.
  
  
**Background**
Antimicrobial resistance is a major public health and development challenge in the WHO South-East Asia Region. Member States need timely, representative and quality-assured data on resistance patterns and antimicrobial use to guide national action plans, clinical and public health interventions, laboratory strategies, stewardship, infection prevention and control, and resource allocation.
  
  
Reliable laboratory systems are essential for effective AMR surveillance, including accurate bacterial and fungal identification, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, diagnostic stewardship, specimen referral, quality management and standardized data flows. WHO supports Member States, country offices and partners to strengthen sustainable surveillance and laboratory systems aligned with WHO standards and GLASS. This roster will help WHO SEARO identify specialists for time-bound regional or country assignments based on emerging needs.
  
  
**Deliverables**
Under The Overall Guidance Of WHO Technical Unit, Consultants May Be Requested To Perform One Or More Of The Following Assignments (a More Specific Terms Of Reference (TORs), Including The Exact Deliverables, Duration Of Assignment And Place Of Assignment Will Be Shared With The Selected Candidate At The Time Of Hiring For a Specific Assignment):
  
  
****Deliverable 1: Surveillance and laboratory assessment.****
Conduct desk or country assessment of AMR surveillance systems, data flows, governance arrangements, indicators, data quality, bacteriology and mycology capacity, laboratory networks, diagnostic stewardship and reporting processes, with prioritized and feasible recommendations
  
  
****Deliverable 2: Technical products and implementation tools.****
Design assignment-specific protocols, standard operating procedures, data dictionaries, validation checklists, surveillance tools, indicator frameworks, laboratory-strengthening plans, survey materials, diagnostic-stewardship tools, guidance documents or One Health implementation products
  
  
****Deliverable 3: Data and analytical outputs.****
Develop cleaned or validated datasets; statistical, microbiological or genomic analyses; reproducible code or pipelines; tables, figures, maps, dashboards or visualization specifications; interpretation notes; and quality documentation, as applicable
  
  
****Deliverable 4: Laboratory and diagnostic products.****
Adapt guidance documents, training packages and tools for clinical bacteriology and mycology; laboratory quality management; antimicrobial susceptibility testing; external quality assurance; specimen referral; laboratory networks; and diagnostic stewardship.
  
  
****Deliverable 5: Capacity-development package.****
Develop training needs findings, curricula, presentations, exercises, job aids, workshop or webinar facilitation, mentoring records and a brief evaluation of learning and follow-up needs.
  
  
****Deliverable 6: Reporting and knowledge products.****
Prepare GLASS submission-related outputs, national or regional surveillance reports, laboratory-capacity reports, policy briefs, technical reports, manuscripts, systematic reviews, presentations or other communication products.
  
  
****Educational Qualifications****
**Qualifications, experience, skills and languages**
**Essential:**
**Band level B:**

An advanced university degree or medical degree with postgraduate specialization in one of the fields listed above or another field relevant to the assignment.
  
  
Desirable: Additional postgraduate training, specialization or professional certification relevant to the technical profile, such as clinical microbiology, bacteriology, mycology, field epidemiology, laboratory quality management, diagnostic stewardship, data analytics, geographic information systems, genomic epidemiology, health information systems, monitoring and evaluation, or adult learning.
  
  
****Experience****
Essential
  
  
Band level B: At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the technical profiles advertised.

**Essential**
**Skills and knowledge**

****Languages And Level Required****

Desirable: Intermediate or expert knowledge of another official United Nations language or a language used in a WHO South-East Asia Region Member State, where relevant to the assignment.

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB’s mission is to empower innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries by unleashing the power of software and data. We enable organizations of all sizes to easily build, scale, and run modern applications by helping them modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our industry-leading developer data platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available in more than 115 regions across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. Atlas allows customers to build and run applications anywhere—on premises, or across cloud providers. With offices worldwide and over 175,000 new developers signing up to use MongoDB every month, it’s no wonder that leading organizations, like Samsung and Toyota, trust MongoDB to build next-generation, AI-powered applications.
  
  
MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud, and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork, and a great sense of humor to help our customers be successful with MongoDB.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The position will be based in our Gurugram office. The standard work week will be Sunday to Thursday, every week.
  
  
Cool things you’ll do
  
  
You'll be working alongside our largest customers, solving their complex challenges - resolving questions on architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between. You'll be an expert resource on best practices in running MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You'll be an advocate for customers' needs - interfacing with our product management and development teams on their behalf. And you'll contribute to internal projects, including software development of support tools for performance, benchmarking, and diagnostics.
  
  
What you need
  
  
You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.
  
  
The ideal candidates should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas
  
  

* Systems engineering experience, including Linux performance, memory management, I/O tuning, configuration, security, networking, clusters, and troubleshooting
* Understand core Kubernetes concepts, including containers, namespaces, custom resources and multi-cluster deployments
* Should have a good understanding of Networking concepts and protocols (DNS, TCP/IP, SSL/TLS, etc.)
* Storage engineering experience, including NAS, SAN, SSD, multi-pathing, and caching
* Experience building and maintaining complex mission-critical production database systems
* Broad awareness of customer workloads and use cases, including performance, availability, and scalability
* Experience analyzing issues holistically, from the application tier through the database, down to the storage
* Be able to read code, and basic coding/scripting ability in one or more languages: Java, Python, Ruby, C, C++, C#, Javascript, node.js, Go, etc.
* Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills

If you have an operations background, we prefer experience administering large-scale production environments, including hardware, operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows), networks (including firewalls and load balancers), as well as cloud-based resources (e.g. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
  
  
You should possess a genuine desire to help people, the ability to think on your feet and remain calm under pressure while solving problems in real-time. There’s a lot to learn, so the desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills is paramount. We work in a collaborative team environment, so a willingness and ability to get help from team members when required, and good judgment to know when to seek help, is essential. We also aim to have diverse technical backgrounds and therefore different subject matter expertise is welcome.
  
  
*You do not need to have prior experience with MongoDB. We can teach you that!*
Bonus Points
  
  

* Experience managing large scale databases (e.g. RDBMS, NoSQL)
* Experience with authentication systems such as LDAP, Kerberos, AD
* Experience using or managing MongoDB
* Experience using distributed version control systems, and in particular git
* Experience using any cloud services stack such as AWS, Azure or GCP
* Experience with virtualization, Docker, Kubernetes (including CLI), ability to inspect resource / container status using relevant utilities and commands

Success Measures
  
  

* In 3 months, you’ll have gained a deep understanding of MongoDB and its ecosystem. You will complete New Hire Training.
* In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam.
* In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within MongoDB and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently.

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Databricks and Risk Application Production Support Lead
description:
Senior Databricks BAU & Risk Application Support Lead
  
  
Gurgaon, Haryana, India
  
  
The role exists to ensure stable, secure, cost-efficient, and predictable operations (BAU) of the GRM application ecosystem connected to GDP (Global Data Platform), with a good focus on Databricks as the execution and industrialization engine. The role holder will act as production support lead (and operational engineering owner) across Databricks workloads, data pipelines, and app components, while contributing occasionally to strategic projects.
  
  
What you’ll be DOING
  
  
What will your essential responsibilities include?
  
  
End-to-end BAU (Run) responsibility for the GRM risk tooling ecosystem leveraging Microsoft Azure / Databricks, including:
  
  

* Natural Event Platform application landscape (run + operational support)
* STEC application landscape (run + operational support)

This role includes involvement in some punctual projects needing good Databricks skills.
  
  
You will report to be defined – GRM Tech Owner / Run Manager).
  
  
What you will BRING
  
  
We’re looking for someone who has these abilities and skills:
  
  
**Required Skills And Abilities**- BAU / Run operations ownership (core mission)
- Own the day-to-day operational support for GRM GDP-connected applications (Natural Event Platform apps, STEC apps).
- Run incident management (triage, root cause analysis, resolution, post-mortems), including coordination with platform/provider teams where needed.
- Manage problem management: recurring issues elimination, reliability improvements, backlog prioritization for operational fixes.
- Ensure operational readiness for releases: runbooks, monitoring, alerting, rollback procedures, support model/TOM alignment.
- Provide service reporting (availability, performance, incidents, SLAs/OLAs, trends) to GRM stakeholders.
- Databricks engineering for production stability
- Operate and optimize Databricks Jobs / Workflows, notebooks, clusters, libraries, and scheduling patterns for production-grade reliability.
- Implement and maintain monitoring & observability (job health, pipeline success rates, latency, data quality checks, logs).
- Drive performance and cost optimization, especially for compute-intensive workloads
- Data flow operations & integration support (GDP ecosystem)
- Support and troubleshoot data ingestion/exchange flows connected to GDP and downstream applications, including interactions with integration mechanisms mentioned in the governance materials (e.g., interfaces such as UDM / API/APIM patterns used for exchanges in the ecosystem).
- Maintain/operate data quality controls relevant to the application ecosystem
- Project support (punctual contribution)
- Provide hands-on engineering support to project initiatives when needed (capacity-based), including:

* Notus modernization / recoding / migration activities (e.g., the confirmed move from Azure Batch to Databricks in GDP; PoC/benchmark contributions; industrialization work).
* Contributions to GDP-connected initiatives under the GRM governance streams (Natural Event Platform, Solvency 2 Internal Model and related technical excellence tracks).
* Participate in design reviews to ensure “build-to-run” quality: operability, monitoring, cost guardrails, and documentation before production release.
* Stakeholder management & governance rhythm
* Act as the operational focal point for GRM and platform stakeholders, participating in governance/rituals (initiative reviews, risk follow-ups) as required.
* Provide clear communication on incidents, risks, dependencies, and operational improvements.

**Specialist Skills & Experience (must-have)**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* good hands-on expertise with Databricks in production contexts (workflows/jobs scheduling, cluster policies, libraries, notebooks, troubleshooting).
* Advanced PySpark and SQL skills for investigation and remediation of data and pipeline issues.
* Experience with production support for data platforms/app ecosystems (L2/L3).

Run/Service Management
  
  

* Proven experience operating services under SLA/OLA constraints: incident/problem/change management, runbooks, operational reporting.

Cost / Performance / Reliability
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to manage compute cost, performance tuning, and reliability improvements—particularly relevant for scalable run workloads

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Experience in cloud data platforms and enterprise data governance constraints (access management, secure data handling).
* Familiarity with integration patterns (API management, managed file transfer approaches) in data exchange ecosystems.
* Exposure to risk modeling / catastrophe modeling application contexts (helpful but not required).

Key interfaces (who the role works with)
  
  

* GRM Tech & Product stakeholders (application owners, BAU owners, governance leads) across Natural Event Platform, STEC apps
* AXA GO, mainly GDP & CFGP teams (engineering) but as well transversal GO families such as security, access management, architecture supporting the platform releases and readiness.
* Project teams during transformations

Success measures (KPIs / outcomes)
  
  

* High service stability: reduced incident volume, improved MTTR, fewer recurring problems.
* Operational readiness: complete runbooks, monitoring coverage, predictable release transitions.
* Cost and performance control: measurable improvements in compute cost monitoring and optimization (especially on Notus run consumption).
* Stakeholder satisfaction (derived from the three criteria above): clear communication, reliable support, proactive risk management.

Working model (ESS – India)
  
  

* Coverage aligned to GRM needs.
* On call / extended support windows if required during major releases or critical incidents.

Who WE are
  
  
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
What we OFFER
  
  
Inclusion
  
  
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. That’s why we have made a strategic commitment to attract, develop, advance and retain the most inclusive workforce possible, and create a culture where everyone can bring their full selves to work and reach their highest potential.
*It’s about helping one another — and our business — to move forward and succeed.*

* Five Business Resource Groups focused on gender, LGBTQ+, ethnicity and origins, disability and inclusion with 20 Chapters around the globe.
* Robust support for Flexible Working Arrangements
* Enhanced family-friendly leave benefits
* Named to the Diversity Best Practices Index
* Signatory to the UK Women in Finance Charter

Learn more at axaxl.com/about-us/inclusion-and-diversity. AXA XL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.
  
  
We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
Sustainability
  
  
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.
  
  
**Our Pillars**

* Valuing nature: How we impact nature affects how nature impacts us. Resilient ecosystems - the foundation of a sustainable planet and society – are essential to our future. We’re committed to protecting and restoring nature – from mangrove forests to the bees in our backyard – by increasing biodiversity awareness and inspiring clients and colleagues to put nature at the heart of their plans.
* Addressing climate change: The effects of a changing climate are far-reaching and significant. Unpredictable weather, increasing temperatures, and rising sea levels cause both social inequalities and environmental disruption. We're building a net zero strategy, developing insurance products and services, and mobilizing to advance thought leadership and investment in societal-led solutions.
* Integrating ESG: All companies have a role to play in building a more resilient future. Incorporating ESG considerations into our internal processes and practices builds resilience from the roots of our business. We’re training our colleagues, engaging our external partners, and evolving our sustainability governance and reporting.
* AXA Hearts in Action: We have established volunteering and charitable giving programs to help colleagues support causes that matter most to them, known as AXA XL’s “Hearts in Action” programs. These include our Matching Gifts program, Volunteering Leave, and our annual volunteering day – the Global Day of Giving.

For more information, please see axaxl.com/sustainability.
