title: Manager - Data Steward
description:
Join our team and you will have an opportunity to work in a collaborative and dynamic environment. This newly created role will join a team of data professionals focused on advancing data management capabilities and strengthening data as a strategic asset.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role, as a Data Steward, you will play a critical part in ensuring the integrity, quality, and governance of data across the organization for data delivered through Macquarie’s central data warehouse and Data Hub. You will work across business and technology teams to develop a clear understanding of critical data, its business meaning, ownership, source, transformation, lineage, quality, and usage. You will partner with data owners, subject matter experts, data producers, architects, and consumers to maintain trusted data, identify governance gaps, and coordinate practical remediation. You will also support the consistent adoption of data governance standards, metadata management, data lineage, data quality, and ownership practices across FPE data domains. This is an exciting opportunity to work closely with stakeholders across various levels, ensuring compliance with data governance principles and supporting the delivery of best practices in data management.
  
  
**What You Offer**

title: Senior Analyst, AI & Data Strategy-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Analyst, AI & Data Strategy-1
  
  
Sr. Analyst, Master Data Management
  
  
Location: Gurgaon, India
  
  
Reports to: Vice President, Master Data Management
  
  
**About The Position**
The Sr. Analyst of Master Data Management (MDM) is responsible for execution of Mastercard’s MDM strategy across the enterprise. This role is instrumental in shaping and implementing the strategic vision for MDM initiatives, ensuring alignment with broader enterprise data governance goals.
  
  
In close partnership with business and technology stakeholders, the Sr. Analyst will operationalize MDM and governance practices to uphold the consistency, accuracy, and integrity of mastered data assets. This role demands strong cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders across Franchise, Product, Corporate, Mastercard Technology, and global business units to drive and sustain the data management strategy.
  
  
As a subject matter expert in master and reference data management, this individual will represent the Office of the Chief Data Officer (CDO) in executing MDM best practices to promote enterprise-wide data excellence.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design & Implementation: Design and implement Master Data Management (MDM) solutions aligned with strategic business objectives and guided by leadership direction. Key responsibilities include gathering requirements, architecting solutions, configuring platforms such as Reltio, and maintaining ongoing operations. This role also oversees system upgrades, migrations, and new deployments, ensuring timely execution of MDM initiatives while fostering continuous improvement in data management practices.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a liaison between IT, business stakeholders, and data governance teams to ensure seamless integration and adoption of MDM solutions across enterprise systems (e.g., Merchant data platform, Oracle Financials, Coupa, Salesforce, Mastercard Billing System).
* Data Quality & Governance: Partner with the data quality team to streamline data profiling, cleansing, enrichment, and lifecycle management. Monitor and report on data quality KPIs. Partner with governance teams to establish and enforce standards, frameworks, and best practices across master data domains (e.g., merchant, customer, consumer, product, supplier, legal entity).
* Automation & Integration: Drive automation of data ingestion and mastered data consumption processes. Ensure integration of MDM solutions with enterprise applications, Mastercard product and related data pipelines.
* Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure adherence to data privacy, quality, and regulatory requirements while building global solutions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Experience: Demonstrated experience in Master Data Management (MDM) roles within large enterprise environments, with a minimum of 3 years of relevant MDM experience and at least 1 full-cycle MDM implementations. Proven hands-on expertise in large-scale MDM platforms such as Reltio or Informatica, along with familiarity with data warehousing, analytics and ERP systems.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Experienced data professional with strong problem-solving skills and expertise in enterprise data products and architecture. Proficient in Hadoop, Databricks, RDBMS, SQL, Alteryx, and Excel. Skilled in data integration, metadata management, and taxonomy modeling. Adept at designing scalable data platforms, including data lakes, warehouses, lakehouses, and real-time pipelines. Proven ability to lead data strategy and unify fragmented ecosystems in complex organizations.
* Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with master data domains relevant to the financial services and technology industries—such as merchant, customer, consumer, product, and financial master data—is preferred.
* Leadership: Implement MDM and governance frameworks, collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive change.
* Communication & Collaboration: Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated success in stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration.
* Mindset: Self-starter with a balance of strategic thinking and hands-on execution. Ability to deliver results under tight deadlines.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
  
  
Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
  
  
**Introduction To Team**
Data is central to how Expedia Group operates, serves travelers, and makes decisions. When data is incomplete, inaccurate, delayed, or difficult to interpret, the impact can extend across products, analytics, operations, and customer experiences.
  
  
The Data Quality Platform team is responsible for building a centralized, scalable, and extensible platform that helps teams proactively understand, validate, and trust their data across batch and streaming datasets. We provide automated profiling, configurable quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, alerting, and data health visibility so data producers can identify and resolve issues closer to the source.
  
  
We focus on building reliable, high-performance, secure, and cost-effective platform services that integrate with data pipelines and analytical systems. Typical technologies include Java, Kotlin, Spring, REST, gRPC, Amazon Web Services, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, and Agentic AI. We encourage experimentation with new technologies, including machine-assisted data quality workflows, while balancing short- and long-term goals and maintaining a high bar for platform quality and operational excellence.
  
  
As a Senior SDE, you will set the technical direction for core Data Quality Platform services and drive their design, delivery, and operation end to end. You will be a hands-on technical leader—writing and reviewing code, shaping architecture across data profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, alerting, and data health experiences, and raising the engineering bar for the team. Your work will directly determine how effectively engineering, analytics, and data teams across Expedia Group can trust and act on their data at scale.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design, build, and maintain complex, highly available Data Quality Platform services and applications, including robust system design (low-level design), API design (REST/gRPC), and data modeling across batch and streaming domains.
* Lead end-to-end delivery of features and services—from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing optimization in production—spanning profiling, quality rules, data contracts, anomaly detection, incident workflows, and alerting.
* Improve technical quality and operational excellence by driving code quality standards, reducing incidents, strengthening observability, and optimizing performance, reliability, and cost of high-throughput data systems.
* Mentor and guide other engineers, sharing best practices in software engineering, testing, and distributed-systems architecture, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
* Collaborate with product, architecture, data platform teams, and data domain owners to translate business and data-trust problems into scalable technical solutions that can be reused across domains.
* Safely integrate and operate AI/ML-enabled and machine-assisted capabilities that improve rule authoring, anomaly detection, and issue explanation, applying AI/ML concepts to practical data platform workflows.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field; or equivalent related professional experience.
* 8+ years of professional backend software development experience in an object-oriented language (e.g., Java, Kotlin, or similar).
* Proven experience owning end-to-end delivery for services or components—including design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support—within a multi-service or domain environment.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language and core software engineering practices, including object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, testing, and version control.
* Hands-on experience designing and consuming APIs, working with data models and storage systems, and applying system design principles to build reliable and maintainable systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing and evolving service and application architectures for high-traffic, distributed systems, including clear API contracts, data models, and low-level designs.
* Track record of designing and evolving high-throughput data systems, including integration with batch or streaming pipelines (e.g., Spark, Kafka, Airflow) and backward-compatible APIs.
* Experience working with data platforms, data quality, data observability, data pipelines, data contracts, or analytics systems, or a closely related domain.
* Demonstrated track record driving technical direction for services or domains, making data-informed tradeoffs on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.
* Strong focus on operational excellence, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, SRE practices, and continuous improvement of production systems and developer workflows.
* Familiarity with AI-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real-world products, including safely integrating AI/ML-enabled features into existing services.
* Experience leading cross-team technical initiatives or migrations, influencing engineering best practices across a domain, and mentoring others to grow their technical depth and delivery capability—including guiding teams on effective and responsible use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

**Accommodation requests**
Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation.
  
  
**About Expedia Group**
Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.
  
  
**Important notice**
Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Expedia is committed to creating an inclusive work environment with a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

description:

**What You Can Expect**

* Develop high-quality, well-documented and efficient code adhering to all applicable Prudential standards
* Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact

title: Principal Consultant
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart(R).
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Principal Consultant to join our team. As a consultant, you will provide strategic guidance and technical expertise to drive the success of our Drug Safety consulting operations. This position plays a key role in delivering innovative pharmacovigilance solutions, ensuring regulatory compliance, and advancing patient safety across complex global engagements. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, translate business requirements into robust technical solutions, and contribute to client success from project planning through implementation and closeout. Responsibilities include leading solution design and implementation, mentoring technical teams, and ensuring adherence to industry best practices and Parexel methodologies.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through innovative pharmacovigilance solutions and client-centric delivery. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Pharmacovigilance Consulting Services Lead can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research, drug safety, and enterprise technology solutions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze business needs and provide strategic guidance to ensure drug safety solutions meet customer objectives and drive successful project outcomes
* Lead solution design and implementation for client engagements, ensuring high-quality, integrated software solutions delivered within project constraints of time and budget
* Serve as a subject matter expert and thought leader, providing technical expertise in drug safety systems including Veeva Systems, Insight, Mart, Analytics, OBIEE, and Axway EDI platforms
* Manage and mentor a team of technical consultants and developers, providing coaching, guidance, and feedback to develop team member skills and drive project success
* Present and demonstrate solutions to customers, influencing customer management in acceptance of solutions and ensuring successful business implementation
* Apply hands-on technical expertise in SQL and PL/SQL with strong troubleshooting skills across Veeva Systems, Axway, and associated modules to resolve complex technical challenges

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strategic thinking and technical leadership capabilities to guide complex drug safety implementations
* Deep experience in drug safety systems, implementation methodologies, and best practices
* Strong SQL and PL/SQL programming skills with excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities
* Proven ability to lead teams, mentor consultants, and collaborate effectively across organizations
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholder decisions

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's / master’s degree in computer science, information technology, or any engineering degree
* 8+ years of experience relevant to this position, including 5 years of consulting experience in drug safety or clinical research
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Experience with pharmacovigilance platforms such as Veeva Systems, Insight, Mart, or similar systems
* Extensive knowledge of writing SQL queries and PL/SQL code
* In-depth knowledge of drug safety application implementation, upgrade, and maintenance
* Ability to craft and articulate strategic technology solutions that address complex business challenges

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with E2B(R3) or EDI protocols for adverse event reporting
* Familiarity with additional pharmacovigilance analytics and visualization tools
* Experience in consulting or client-facing roles within the pharmaceutical industry

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Business Support & Control System
description:
**Join our Team**
**About The Opportunity**
Ericsson is looking for a Telecom Billing L2 Production Support Specialist to support billing and invoicing operations. The role involves 24x7 production support, billing-cycle monitoring, incident resolution, application troubleshooting, and coordination with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Provide L2 production and operational support for telecom billing and invoicing systems.
  
  
Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly billing cycles, including bill generation, final billing, invoice generation, validation, archival, and downstream processing.
  
  
Troubleshoot job failures, processing delays, invoice issues, data discrepancies, and integration failures.
  
  
Analyze application logs, database records, input/output files, and job execution status to identify root cause and recovery actions.
  
  
Perform approved job restarts, reprocessing, reconciliation, recovery, and data-validation activities.
  
  
Monitor batch jobs, schedulers, FTP/SFTP transfers, and upstream/downstream interfaces.
  
  
Use SQL, application logs, files, and operational tools for issue analysis and billing-data validation.
  
  
Handle incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs and participate in critical incident support.
  
  
Coordinate with L3/L4 application, database, infrastructure, vendor, business, and other stakeholder teams.
  
  
Support approved changes, releases, and post-deployment validation.
  
  
Prepare RCA documents, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
  
  
Identify opportunities for automation and operational improvement.
  
  
**Key Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  
  
Relevant hands-on experience in Telecom Billing or Application Production Support.
  
  
Strong knowledge of telecom billing and invoicing processes; Ericsson billing experience is preferred.
  
  
Experience with Interactive Billing Application (IBA) or an equivalent telecom billing application, including Windows-based applications.
  
  
Good understanding of the end-to-end billing lifecycle.
  
  
Strong SQL skills with experience in Oracle and/or MS SQL for validation, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
  
  
Good knowledge of Unix/Linux commands, shell scripting, file handling, and log analysis.
  
  
Experience with batch processing, job scheduling, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
  
  
Understanding of file-based integrations, FTP/SFTP, and system interfaces.
  
  
Experience in a 24x7 production support environment.
  
  
Knowledge of ITIL, Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.
  
  
Strong analytical, communication, troubleshooting, and stakeholder-management skills.
  
  
**Preferred Competencies**
Experience supporting high-volume, business-critical telecom billing operations.
  
  
Ability to work independently, manage escalations, perform RCA, and operate effectively under pressure.
  
  
Proactive approach to automation, process improvement, customer focus, and knowledge sharing.

title: Principal Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Overview**
Are you passionate about data platforms and tools? Are you an open-minded, structured thinker who is passionate about building systems at scale. Do you understand data platforms, know how to build them and want to help our users to make data actionable? If so, this role with our team at Atlassian is for you.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Data Platform Team to build a world class data platform that powers crucial business decisions throughout the organization.
  
  
You will partner with analytics teams, data engineers and data scientists across various initiatives and work with them to understand the gaps and bring your findings back to the team to build these capabilities.
  
  
Working at Atlassian
  
  
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
We build analytical data platforms for Atlassian that serve both Engineering and Data Engineering to help them generate valuable insights from data.
  
  
**As a Principal Engineer On This Team You Will**

* Own the long term architecture and technical direction for core platform capabilities and be accountable for their reliability, cost efficiency and adoption
* Design and build foundational platform components that other engineering teams build on top of, across areas like ingestion, transformation, orchestration, compute and consumption
* Architect robust multi-tenant platform standards by establishing clear cross-layer contracts, tenant isolation, and SLOs to enable autonomous producers and consumers, while driving compute and storage efficiency across workloads
* Lead cross team technical initiatives and architecture reviews, influence platform strategy with senior stakeholders and act as a technical mentor and multiplier for Senior engineers
* Stay hands on. You will be in the code on the hardest problems, not just reviewing designs

**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* 12+ years of software or data engineering experience, with at least 6 years building data platform infrastructure
* You have built a data platform or a significant component of one and operated it in production. For example an ingestion framework, a transformation framework, a compute or query layer, an orchestration layer, a metadata or lineage service or a data quality framework
* You can describe the scale that component ran at in concrete numbers. Data volume, ingest throughput, number of pipelines or jobs, query concurrency and latency, number of onboarded teams or tenants and infrastructure cost.
* Deep understanding of big data and distributed systems challenges including partitioning, shuffle behaviour, skew, idempotency and backfills
* Experience designing both batch and streaming architectures and clear judgement on when each is the right answer
* Expert level programming skills in language such as Java, Kotlin or Python and built solutions on public cloud offerings such as Amazon Web Services
* Experience with big data processing and storage technologies such as Spark, DBT and with open table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake
* A track record of owning ambiguous cross team problems end to end and of influencing without authority
* Degree in Computer Science, EE or a related STEM discipline or equivalent practical experience

Nice to have
  
  

* Experience with high performance analytical or MPP databases such as StarRocks, Druid, ClickHouse or Pinot
* Experience with change data capture and event driven ingestion at high volume
* Experience building a semantic layer or metrics store and governing shared metric definitions
* Experience with the data foundations of ML platforms, such as point-in-time correct training data, online and offline feature parity or backfilling features at scale
* Experience with data governance, access control, lineage and compliance, including regulated environments such as FedRAMP
* Experience running platform components on Kubernetes
* Experience with multi region data architectures, including replication, failover and consistency tradeoffs

Benefits & Perks
  
  
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. title: Cyber Security Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**

This hybrid day shift role for a Cyber Security Analyst focuses on assessing and managing technology risk across enterprise systems while supporting business operations. The analyst will apply deep risk management experience to safeguard critical assets strengthen control environments and reduce exposure to evolving cyber threats. Experience in check processing domains is beneficial for understanding financial transaction risks and ensuring secure compliant operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Assess enterprise technology environments to identify cyber risks and control gaps applying risk management practices to prioritize remediation efforts that protect critical systems and data.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive risk registers that clearly document vulnerabilities threat scenarios impact ratings and mitigation plans to support transparent risk decisions by stakeholders.
* Conduct detailed risk assessments for new and existing applications infrastructure changes and third party services to ensure cyber risk is evaluated before deployment or integration.
* Collaborate with security engineering and operations teams to define practical risk reduction actions translate findings into clear requirements and ensure mitigation steps align with business needs.
* Monitor security alerts risk indicators and incident trends to detect emerging risk patterns and provide timely recommendations that strengthen defenses and reduce recurrence.
* Coordinate periodic control testing and validation activities to verify that implemented risk treatments are effective measurable and aligned with internal standards and regulatory obligations.
* Prepare concise risk reports and dashboards for management that highlight key risk drivers residual exposure levels and the progress of remediation initiatives across technology domains.
* Support policy and standard development by providing input based on observed risks and incidents ensuring that documented expectations are practical and aligned with recognized security frameworks.
* Advise project teams during system design and change initiatives to embed appropriate security controls ensuring risk considerations are addressed early and reducing the need for costly rework.
* Engage with business stakeholders to explain cyber risk in clear terms enabling informed decisions that balance protective measures with operational efficiency and customer impact.
* Apply knowledge of payment and transaction flows especially in check processing environments to identify fraud and operational risks and propose control enhancements that secure financial operations.
* Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting lessons learned from assessments and near miss events recommending updates to risk methodologies tools and processes for better outcomes.
* Maintain accurate and current documentation of risk management activities methodologies and outcomes to support audits compliance reviews and organizational learning.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate five to seven years of professional experience in cyber security roles focused on risk management including practical exposure to risk assessment mitigation planning and control evaluation.
* Possess strong knowledge of core risk management concepts such as likelihood analysis impact determination control effectiveness and residual risk calculation within technology environments.
* Apply familiarity with industry security frameworks and standards using them as references for designing and assessing controls across applications networks and data handling processes.
* Exhibit analytical skills to interpret complex technical information security alerts and vulnerability data translating them into understandable risk statements and prioritized actions.
* Utilize excellent communication abilities to prepare clear documentation risk reports and stakeholder updates that support decision making and foster shared understanding of cyber exposures.
* Bring working knowledge of financial or payment processing domains including check processing to enhance understanding of transaction risks and to guide secure process and system design.

title: Analyst I, Cybersecurity
description:

Full time

Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)

The future of money is being built right now. At FIS, we help the world’s businesses, banks and communities move, manage and grow money with confidence. Join a team that values fresh thinking, works together to solve complex challenges, and creates technology that powers everyday life.

**About the role**

As a member of the **Vulnerability Management and Patching team**, you will help strengthen the organization’s security posture by identifying vulnerabilities, prioritizing remediation, and supporting effective patch management across the technology environment. The role involves working closely with system owners and application teams to drive timely remediation while maintaining visibility into vulnerability, patching, and compliance status.

**Your key responsibilities**

* Perform regular vulnerability scans using tools such as **Qualys, Tenable, or Rapid7**.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results and prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk.
* Coordinate remediation and mitigation activities with system owners and application teams.
* Track vulnerability remediation progress, metrics, and compliance status.
* Maintain vulnerability management documentation, processes, and procedures.
* Administer and maintain **IBM BigFix** infrastructure for patch deployment and compliance reporting.
* Develop and test custom **Fixlets, baselines, and automation scripts**.
* Schedule and deploy operating system and third-party patches across **Windows, Linux, and macOS environments**.
* Support vulnerability remediation across **Windows and Linux server environments**.
* Monitor patch deployment successes and failures and troubleshoot deployment issues.
* Generate compliance reports and dashboards to support internal reporting and audit requirements.

**What you bring**

* Hands-on experience with vulnerability scanning and management using **Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or similar tools**.
* Experience administering **IBM BigFix** and managing enterprise patch deployments.
* Practical knowledge of vulnerability remediation for **Windows and Linux servers**.
* Experience deploying operating system and third-party patches across **Windows, Linux, and/or macOS** environments.
* Ability to analyze vulnerability findings, understand risk and prioritize remediation activities.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with infrastructure, application, and system-owner teams.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and stakeholder coordination skills.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience developing and maintaining **IBM BigFix Fixlets and baselines**.
* Experience creating automation scripts to support patching or vulnerability remediation activities.
* Exposure to multiple vulnerability management platforms, particularly **Qualys, Tenable, or Rapid7**.
* Experience preparing security, vulnerability, patching, and compliance dashboards for internal stakeholders or audits.
* Experience supporting vulnerability and patch management across a mixed **Windows, Linux, and macOS** environment.

**The impact you’ll make**

In this role, you will contribute directly to reducing security exposure by helping teams identify, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities across the technology environment. Through effective vulnerability management, patch deployment, automation, reporting, and cross-functional coordination, you will help improve remediation effectiveness and provide greater visibility into patching and compliance.

**What We Offer you**

Bring your ideas. Build your future. At FIS, you'll find the support, resources and opportunities to develop your career while helping shape the future of financial technology.

We offer:

* Internal career growth opportunities
* Opportunities to innovate in fintech
* Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
* Professional and personal development
* Resources to contribute to your community

**Privacy Statement**

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

**Sourcing Model**

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise

title: Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a skilled and motivated **Full-Stack AI Engineer** with hands-on experience in Python-based application development, modern frontend frameworks, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI.

The ideal candidate should be capable of developing end-to-end AI-powered applications, building scalable backend services and intuitive user interfaces, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), and implementing AI-driven workflows. The candidate should have a strong foundation in software engineering, problem-solving, and the ability to translate business requirements into reliable, production-ready solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end full-stack applications using Python backend frameworks and modern frontend technologies.
* Build RESTful APIs and backend services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using React.js or other modern frontend frameworks.
* Design and integrate Machine Learning and Deep Learning models into real-world applications.
* Develop Generative AI solutions using LLMs, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, and semantic search.
* Design and implement AI agents and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar technologies.
* Integrate AI models and services through APIs, including cloud-based AI platforms.
* Work with relational and NoSQL databases, data processing pipelines, and external service integrations.
* Develop efficient, maintainable, secure, and scalable code following software engineering best practices.
* Perform debugging, testing, performance optimization, and deployment of applications.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and deliver AI-driven business solutions.
* Explore emerging AI technologies and contribute to technical innovation and continuous improvement.

**Required Technical Skills**
-----------------------------

### **1. Full-Stack Development**

* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Hands-on experience with at least one Python backend framework: FastAPI, Flask, or Django.
* Experience building REST APIs, integrating third-party services, and implementing backend business logic.
* Working knowledge of React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, or an equivalent modern frontend framework.
* Understanding of frontend-backend integration, authentication, application architecture, and state management.

### **2. Machine Learning and Deep Learning**

* Understanding of core Machine Learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, classification, regression, clustering, and model evaluation.
* Familiarity with Deep Learning concepts and neural network architectures.
* Hands-on experience with libraries such as Scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
* Knowledge of data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and inference.

### **3. Generative AI and LLM Applications**

* Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs from providers such as OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, or other equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and context management.
* Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.
* Familiarity with embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and document processing.
* Understanding of LLM evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and response quality optimization.

### **4. Agentic AI and AI Workflows**

* Understanding of AI agents, tool calling, workflow orchestration, and state management.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, or equivalent technologies.
* Knowledge of multi-agent systems, planning, task decomposition, and tool integration.
* Ability to build AI workflows that interact with APIs, databases, and external systems.
* Understanding of agent evaluation, error handling, observability, and reliable execution.

### **5. Databases, Cloud, and Deployment**

* Working knowledge of SQL databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Familiarity with NoSQL databases and vector databases.
* Understanding of Git, version control, debugging, and testing.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD, and application deployment.
* Exposure to cloud platform (Microsoft Azure).
* Understanding of application security, logging, monitoring, and performance optimization.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of relevant software engineering or AI application development experience.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, learn new technologies quickly, and collaborate effectively with a team.

title: Senior Fraud QA and Enablement Analyst
description:
We are seeking a **Fraud Operations QA & Enablement analyst** to join our 24×7 fraud operations function and help protect our customers through rigorous quality standards, transaction auditing, and operational enablement.  
You will serve as the quality anchor and "connective tissue" of our fraud team. You won't just be clearing alerts; you will drive high decision standards across the entire function. Your mission is to establish and maintain robust QA frameworks, ensure every analyst makes high-quality, compliant decisions, and turn audit insights into actionable training, SOP updates, and process improvements

#### **What You'll Do**

* **Quality Assurance & Auditing (Primary Focus):** Perform regular, comprehensive audits of analyst transaction decisions, risk scores, and case notes to ensure consistency, accuracy, and strict adherence to compliance standards.
* **Root-Cause & Pattern Analysis:** Analyze QA audit data to identify recurring decision errors, knowledge gaps, and emerging fraud typologies, transforming findings into actionable team insights.
* **Calibration & Coaching:** Lead regular quality calibration sessions for the team and provide constructive feedback and targeted coaching to analysts to elevate decision quality.
* **Knowledge Architecture & SOPs:** Own and maintain the central "Source of Truth" (Knowledge Base) for Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), updating guidelines based on QA findings and evolving fraud tactics.
* **Training & Onboarding:** Design and deliver onboarding modules for new hires and ongoing "delta training" to address quality trends and process updates.
* **Process Excellence & System Gap Analysis:** Monitor team-wide quality metrics and SLAs. Act as a feedback loop between Operations and Product/Engineering to fix system limitations causing manual error or security risks.
* **Operational Visibility:** Aggregate and report QA scores, error trends, and compliance metrics to provide leadership with clear visibility into operational health.

#### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 5 years of experience in fraud operations, transaction monitoring, payments risk, or trust and safety. This must include hands-on experience developing Quality Assurance (QA) frameworks, sampling strategies, conducting audits, and coaching analysts.
* Proven expertise in evaluating transaction reviews, case documentation, and fraud determinations against established compliance and operational standards.
* Strong background in building or maintaining decision frameworks, QA scorecards, and SOP documentation.
* Hands-on background leveraging artificial intelligence technologies to streamline, enhance, and scale manual quality auditing workflows.
* Comfort reviewing complex transactions and conducting outbound customer verifications when needed.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of delivering constructive feedback and leading training sessions.
* High attention to detail and strong analytical skills to translate QA data into operational improvements.
* Ability to work in a high-volume, fast-paced operational environment while maintaining high quality standards.
* Willingness and flexibility to work across three rotating shifts as part of a 24×7 operations team.
* Experience in fintech, travel, payments, or e-commerce environments is strongly preferred.

title: Associate , Investment Operations Specialist, SMA (Separately Managed Accounts) Solutions
description:
Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra Team: Reconciliations Job Requisition #: R266865 Date posted: Oct. 16, 2026

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**Team Overview**

  
  

BlackRock Separately Managed Accounts (SMA) Solutions helps clients customise portfolios for tax efficiency, values alignment, and specific investment exposures across direct indexing, fixed income, active equity, and multi-asset strategies. The Investment Operations team supports the integrity and effective functioning of SMA portfolios through reconciliation, exception management, operational controls, reporting, and close collaboration with investment, technology, custodian, and operations partners.

  
  

**Your Role and Impact**

  
  

As an Investment Operations Analyst, you will support middle-office activities across SMA portfolios, with a focus on cash and position reconciliation, exception management, data integrity, risk and control execution, and continuous process improvement. You will apply strong analytical and problem-solving skills to manage operational priorities, resolve issues across partners and platforms, and help strengthen the reliability and scalability of portfolio operations.

  
  

**Your Responsibilities**

  
  

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:

  
  

* Perform daily cash and position reconciliations, investigating and resolving breaks and data discrepancies across internal books and records, custodians, and investment platforms.
* Monitor positions, cash, transactions, tax lots, pricing, corporate actions, and other portfolio data, supporting operational reporting, data-integrity monitoring, and post-trade controls.
* Partner with portfolio management, custodians, technology teams, and internal operations partners to resolve exceptions and coordinate timely issue escalation.
* Execute operational controls, maintain complete and audit-ready evidence, and identify and escalate material breaks, data-quality concerns, access issues, control weaknesses, and operational risks.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures, while contributing to cross-training and knowledge sharing that support consistent and resilient operational execution.
* Manage competing priorities, dependencies, operational commitments, and deadlines, communicating risks or delays proactively and providing coverage during periods of increased activity.
* Identify opportunities to streamline workflows and automate manual activities, using operational data to identify recurring breaks, capacity constraints, and errors while supporting testing, documentation, implementation, and control validation.
  

  

**Your Experience**

* 3-5 years of experience in investment operations, middle-office operations, portfolio operations, fund accounting, or a related financial-services function; exposure to separately managed accounts or tax-managed investment strategies is preferred.
* Working knowledge of the trade lifecycle, including positions, cash, securities, corporate actions, tax lots, pricing, reconciliation, exception management, and post-trade controls.
* Experience investigating reconciliation breaks and resolving data discrepancies across investment platforms, custodians, and internal books and records.
* Strong risk and control mindset, including experience following Standard Operating Procedures, performing maker-checker reviews, maintaining audit-ready evidence, and handling sensitive portfolio data.
* Strong analytical, organisational, and problem-solving capabilities, with attention to detail and the ability to independently prioritise multiple deliverables and meet operational deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders across functions and regions.
Familiarity with investment-management platforms and advanced Excel skills; exposure to VBA, Python, Power BI, workflow tools, automation, and process-improvement initiatives is preferred.  

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Oracle HCM Cloud Integration Consultant
description:
Job Description

**Oracle Integration & Validated Integration Certification Consultant**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for an experienced Oracle HCM Cloud Integration Consultant / Expert with strong hands-on experience in Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), Oracle HCM Journeys and Oracle HCM integrations, and additional experience supporting Oracle Validated Integration and Partner Integration Framework (PIF) certification.**

**The consultant will support Oracle integration initiatives by providing technical and functional guidance, evaluating integration feasibility, recommending solution architectures, and supporting implementation teams. The role also requires specialized knowledge of Oracle's validated integration and certification process, including certification requirements, documentation, submissions, Oracle reviews, and related activities.**

**The ideal candidate should therefore have both strong Oracle HCM integration expertise and practical Oracle certification experience.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Oracle Integration**

* **Provide technical and functional guidance on Oracle HCM integrations across different client projects.**

* **Review customer integration requirements, including ORC and Journeys requirements, and run a feasibility check that classifies each as native, configuration, extension, or not feasible.**

* **Recommend appropriate Oracle integration approaches and patterns and work with Harbinger/Customer teams to define integration architecture, data flows, APIs, security, and field mappings.**

* **Provide guidance on Oracle integration technologies and capabilities, including Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, business events and webhooks, HCM Data Loader (HDL), HCM Extracts, ORC and Journeys task and status updates, and other relevant Oracle mechanisms.**

* **Advise on SSO design for Oracle Cloud.**

* **Review integration designs and identify technical or implementation gaps, including API rate limits and API versioning.**

* **Support troubleshooting and resolution of Oracle integration-related issues.**

* **Advise Harbinger/Customer teams on Oracle-specific considerations, limitations, and best practices.**

title: SME - SDWAN
description:
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced SD-WAN Subject Matter Expert (SME) to lead multi-vendor SD-WAN operations, provide technical leadership, manage customer escalations, and ensure compliance with defined KPIs, SLAs, security standards, and operational processes.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing SD-WAN solutions across Cisco, Fortinet, Cisco Meraki, and Versa platforms, ensuring network availability, service performance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. The role also requires strong expertise in MPLS, ISP connectivity, routing protocols, underlay and overlay troubleshooting, controller management, and technical team development.
  
  

* Key Roles and Responsibilities
* SD-WAN Technical Leadership

Act as the technical SME and lead for multi-vendor SD-WAN technologies, including Cisco, Fortinet, Cisco Meraki, and Versa.
  
  
Provide technical leadership for SD-WAN deployment, migration, upgrades, configuration changes, and service assurance.
  
  
Review and validate High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs), and Method of Procedures (MOPs).
  
  
Troubleshoot complex underlay and overlay connectivity issues, routing instability, tunnel failures, and application performance problems.
  
  
Drive root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures for recurring network incidents.
  
  

* Day-to-Day Network Operations

Oversee daily SD-WAN and WAN operations across enterprise managed services environments.
  
  
Ensure proactive monitoring, incident management, problem management, and change management.
  
  
Manage SD-WAN controllers, orchestrators, management platforms, and associated components.
  
  
Coordinate network upgrades, device replacements, configuration changes, and planned maintenance activities.
  
  
Ensure network availability, stability, and service continuity across customer environments.
  
  

* KPI and SLA Management

Track and review operational KPIs, SLAs, MTTR, incident trends, availability, and service performance.
  
  
Ensure incidents, service requests, and changes are resolved within agreed SLA timelines.
  
  
Prepare periodic operational dashboards, performance reports, and management reviews.
  
  
Identify service improvement opportunities and drive corrective and preventive actions.
  
  

* Partner and OEM Governance

Manage service delivery and technical governance with OEMs, ISP partners, and third-party service providers.
  
  
Conduct regular OEM support reviews, technical discussions, and service performance assessments.
  
  
Coordinate critical escalations, hardware replacements, software upgrades, and defect resolution.
  
  
Track vendor commitments, pending actions, RCA submissions, and permanent corrective measures.
  
  

* Customer and Escalation Management

Handle critical customer escalations and major network incidents.
  
  
Lead technical bridge calls and coordinate resolution across internal teams, OEMs, ISPs, and service partners.
  
  
Communicate incident updates, service restoration plans, and RCA findings to customers and management.
  
  
Maintain strong customer relationships through effective communication, ownership, and timely resolution.
  
  

* Network Security and Compliance

Ensure compliance with operational processes, security policies, change management, and audit requirements.
  
  
Conduct security audits of managed network devices, including routers, firewalls, and SD-WAN appliances.
  
  
Coordinate vulnerability assessments, firmware and software compliance reviews, and security remediation activities.
  
  
Track security advisories, vulnerabilities, configuration deviations, and remediation closure.
  
  
Ensure compliance with approved configuration baselines and operational security standards.
  
  

* Team Development and Cross-Functional Collaboration

Build technical capabilities within L1.5 and L2 operations teams through training, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
  
  
Develop troubleshooting guides, standard operating procedures, and technical documentation.
  
  
Collaborate with engineering, service delivery, project, security, and other cross-functional teams.
  
  
Drive operational standardization, automation opportunities, and continuous service improvement.
  
  
Position Specific Skills
  
  
Hands-on experience in SD-WAN technologies, preferably Cisco SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, Cisco Meraki, and Versa.
  
  
Strong experience in MPLS, Internet Service Provider (ISP) connectivity, and enterprise WAN architectures.
  
  
**Strong Understanding Of Routing Protocols**
Static and dynamic routing
  
  
BGP
  
  
OSPF
  
  
EIGRP
  
  
IS-IS
  
  
Expertise in underlay and overlay troubleshooting, IPsec tunnels, routing convergence, path selection, and application connectivity.
  
  
Experience in SD-WAN controller, orchestrator, and centralized management platform administration.
  
  
Working knowledge of Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), including TACACS+ and RADIUS-based device administration and access control.
  
  
Experience in network security audits, vulnerability assessment, firmware compliance, and remediation tracking.
  
  
Strong knowledge of incident, problem, change, and configuration management processes.
  
  
#BAL

title: T & E ANALYST
description:
**T & E ANALYST**
=================

GURGAON, IN, 122001

At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.

  

Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

  

While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America

**Position Overview**

The key responsibility of this role is to manage the Travel and Travel & Expense (T&E) portfolio, identify opportunities for process improvement, and support the North America (NA) and Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) Travel and T&E Team Managers in simplifying and standardizing travel and expense operations.

The role involves working with employees at all levels across the organization to ensure compliance with Travel and T&E policies, maximize cost efficiencies, and provide travel-related services that support business objectives.

Additionally, the role will collaborate with system providers to identify and implement system enhancements, support T&E and Purchasing Card (P-Card) audits, and provide reporting and analysis on company spending related to Travel and T&E.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Travel and T&E Portfolio Management

* Support the NA and EMEA Travel and T&E Team Managers in simplifying and standardizing travel and expense operations.
* Manage the Travel and T&E portfolio, including corporate credit card program administration, SAP Concur administration, and travel program support.
* Provide day-to-day training, guidance, and advice on Travel and T&E policies and procedures.
* Provide support to the Ethics & Compliance (E&C) audit team.
* Manage departmental email inboxes and ensure timely support for internal and external customers.

2. Reporting, Process Improvement, and Compliance

* Create, analyze, and interpret value-added and customized reports to support audits, delinquency monitoring, supplier analysis, policy exceptions, spending trends, and variance analysis.
* Identify process improvement opportunities, map new processes, and maintain and update existing process documentation.
* Collaborate with the Treasury department to maintain and improve the cardholder experience under corporate banking programs.
* Work with SAP Concur to identify and implement system and site enhancements.
* Collaborate with the NA Travel and Procurement teams to manage and improve travel processes, while overseeing implementation activities across EMEA.
* Work with the EMEA Travel Management Company (TMC) to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience.
* Collaborate with Corporate Security to implement and monitor travel safety processes across EMEA.
* Prepare and sign off on Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) controls documentation.
* Prepare documentation and complete tasks assigned through internal and external audits related to Travel and T&E processes.

3. Training and Policy Administration

* Create, update, and deliver Travel and T&E training for SAP Concur users.
* Create, update, and implement the Travel and T&E Policy Affirmation process.

4. Project and Team Support

* Support team members in executing new projects and initiatives.
* Take ownership of ad hoc tasks and additional responsibilities as assigned.

Additional / Secondary Responsibilities

* Execute assigned SOX controls and audit-related activities.
* Travel requirements: Up to 10% of working time.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree (BSc) required.
* A degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or an equivalent discipline would be an asset.

**Experience**

* A minimum of three years of relevant business experience in one or more of the following areas:

  + Travel management
  + Corporate card administration
  + General Ledger (G/L)
  + Accounts Payable (AP)
  + Expense processing or related functions
* Proficiency in English and Italian is required.
* Knowledge of additional languages, such as Polish, French, Spanish, or Portuguese, would be an asset.

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Ability to work effectively with internal and external customers at all levels of the organization, including management.
* Ability to maintain up-to-date knowledge of travel and T&E regulations, policies, and procedures.
* Proven ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-paced, and deadline-driven environment.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and practical problem-solving skills.
* Flexibility and a proactive, can-do attitude in an environment with changing priorities.

**Other Skills and Competencies**

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Good working knowledge of SAP.
* Knowledge of SAP Concur would be an asset.
* Familiarity with banking systems would be an asset.
* Knowledge of travel booking platforms would be an asset.
* Understanding of McCormick's contract with the corporate card service provider, including reporting timelines and timely payments to the bank.
* Understanding of system interfaces between McCormick and the bank to identify and resolve issues that may prevent expense data from being received or delay payments.
* Understanding of McCormick's budgeting processes and expense allocation by cost center to respond to Finance Managers' queries and provide relevant T&E reports.
* Knowledge of standard industry payment card capabilities and types, including chip-and-PIN cards, magnetic-stripe cards, event planner cards, Purchasing Cards (P-Cards), and One Cards, to ensure the appropriate card type is assigned to each end user.

**Preferred Qualifications and Role Context**

* The role is based in Poland and primarily supports employees across North America (NA) and EMEA, while also providing support, as required, to global travelers and the global travel program.
* Strong understanding of policy and process execution.
* Global business scope, with current primary coverage across NA and EMEA.
* Ability to work closely with Corporate Procurement, Corporate Security, Ethics & Compliance (E&C), and other Procure-to-Pay (P2P) teams.

Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

Configure application-aware routing, traffic steering, and failover policies
  
  
Monitor WAN edge health, tunnels, and application performance using telemetry and analytics

Optimize user experience using SLE metrics (latency, throughput, roaming, client health)
  
  
Implement configuration changes, RF optimization, and performance tuning
  
  

* Network Operations (VNOC/NOC)

Perform 24 7 monitoring, alert validation, and incident management
  
  
Execute proactive issue identification using trends and telemetry
  
  
Validate service restoration and maintain SLA/KPI compliance
  
  
Collaborate with L2/L3/OEM/ISP teams for escalations and permanent fixes
  
  
Maintain incident documentation, RCA, and continuous improvement initiatives

Perform integration testing, change execution, and rollout planning
  
  
Develop LLD, HLD, SOPs, and topology documentation

Leverage Mist APIs / automation tools for operational efficiency
  
  
Use AI insights to reduce MTTR / MTTI and incident volumes
  
  
Identify opportunities for automation and self-healing networks

Provide technical updates, reports, and service health dashboards
  
  
Support audits, compliance, and governance processes

Technical Skills
  
  
Strong knowledge of:
  
  

* Routing protocols: BGP, OSPF

Hands-on with:
  
  

* Juniper Mist AI (Wireless/Wired/WAN Assurance)

Experience in:
  
  

* Network troubleshooting & diagnostics tools
* Monitoring & analytics (telemetry-based operations)

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  
  
Ability to work in high-pressure NOC/VNOC environments

Fast learner with adaptability to new technologies

* Knowledge of networking concepts including LAN, WAN, redundancy, failover, and load balancing.
* Experience with DR planning, recovery testing, failover/failback, dependency mapping, and recovery validation.

title: Manager, Offensive Security
description:
**About SiTime**
SiTime is the Precision Timing company.
  
  
Timing is the heartbeat of all electronics, ensuring performance, resilience and scalability. For decades, quartz devices, non-silicon technology, have kept systems in sync, but they struggle in harsher, more demanding environments. MEMS-based Precision Timing delivers greater accuracy, smaller size and resilience. Today, MEMS timing powers over 400 applications, including high-growth ones in AI datacenters, automated driving, industrial and humanoid robots, wearables and IoT.
  
  
Our semiconductor MEMS programmable solutions offer a rich feature set that enables customers to differentiate their products with higher performance, smaller size, lower power, and better reliability. With more than 4 billion devices shipped, SiTime is changing the timing industry. For more information, visit:
**www.sitime.com**
.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Reporting to the Head of Security Assurance, one of three functions in SiTime's Security Organization under the CISO, this role leads SiTime's Offensive Security function. It owns penetration testing, red and purple team exercises, vulnerability disclosure and bug bounty, and validation that the controls SiTime has bought and built actually work.
  
  
This is a build role. The candidate will design a recurring testing program that covers the enterprise, cloud, SaaS, application and laboratory estates, establish adversary simulation against realistic objectives, and create the feedback loop that turns findings into improved detection and hardening rather than a report that is filed away.
  
  
It is also a people-leadership role. The candidate starts hands-on, personally running the first cycle of testing, then scales through a mix of full-time testers and specialist firms engaged where independence or niche capability is required.
  
  
**Role**
This is an accountable owner role, not an advisory one. Findings are owned through to verified closure in partnership with IT, Engineering, and its peers in Security Assurance, and with the Security Organization's other two functions:
  
  

* Security Operations, whose detections this team validates through purple team exercises.
* Security Architecture, whose target state and control baselines this team tests against.

We value diverse experiences, perspectives, and career paths, and welcome candidates who are excited to contribute to our mission.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Offensive Testing Program**

* Run a recurring penetration testing program across enterprise, cloud, SaaS, application, network and laboratory environments, covering both grey box and black box engagements.
* Scope, plan and execute internal testing, and manage external testing firms where specialist capability or independence is required.
* Prioritize testing around the paths that reach design data, source code repositories, laboratory and test networks, and partner and OSAT connectivity.
* Own the finding lifecycle end to end: severity, named owner, remediation service level, retest and closure with evidence.
* Move the program from point-in-time assessment toward continuous validation of the controls that matter most.

**Red Team, Purple Team and Detection Validation**

* Design and run threat-informed red team exercises against realistic objectives, with clear rules of engagement and authorization.
* Run purple team exercises jointly with Security Operations to validate and improve detection coverage, mapping results to MITRE ATT&CK.
* Validate that deployed controls detect and prevent, and route the gaps to Security Engineering and Security Operations with reproducible evidence.
* Simulate insider and data exfiltration scenarios to test data loss prevention, access controls and monitoring on the design environment.
* Contribute technical injections and scenarios to ransomware and crisis tabletop exercises.
* Track adversary tradecraft relevant to semiconductors, hardware and intellectual property theft, including state-linked activity, and translate it into test scenarios.

**Disclosure, Bug Bounty and Program Scaling**

* Stand up and run vulnerability disclosure and bug bounty programs, including scope definition, triage, reward policy and researcher relations.
* Define the rules, authorization and safety controls that keep offensive activity inside agreed boundaries and out of production impact.
* Build the internal testing capability over time, and manage the specialist firms that supplement it.
* Support customer-facing security assurance by providing independent evidence of testing coverage and remediation.
* Feed recurring themes back into the security roadmap, architecture standards and awareness content.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* 6+ years in offensive security, penetration testing or red teaming, including 2+ years leading a program or a team.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical field — or equivalent practical experience.
* At least one of the following certifications: OSCP, OSEP, OSCE, , or equivalent.
* Demonstrated hands-on exploitation capability across network, cloud, application, identity and endpoint.
* Experience designing and running red and purple team exercises and mapping coverage to MITRE ATT&CK.
* Experience managing external testing vendors and running a vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty program.
* Ability to write findings that engineers can act on and executives can understand.
* People leadership or technical lead experience.
* English proficiency is required, including the ability to effectively communicate, collaborate, and perform job responsibilities in a professional business environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a semiconductor, hardware, embedded or OT-adjacent environment.
* Hardware and firmware testing experience, including secure boot and debug interface exposure.
* Cloud exploitation and identity attack path analysis in Azure and AWS.
* Source code review and application security testing capability.
* Experience testing engineering, design or laboratory environments without disrupting them.

**Desired Characteristics & Attributes**

* Strong ethics and judgment: operates within authorization, documents everything, and knows when to stop.
* Evidence-driven and measured on risk reduced and detections improved
* Constructive with the teams being tested; builds partnership rather than an adversarial dynamic.
* Able to work effectively with a U.S.-based security leaders, peers and US stakeholders across time zones.

**Compensation Range**
At SiTime, we believe great work deserves great rewards. We offer a comprehensive and highly competitive compensation package designed to attract top talent.
  
  
In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for a quarterly bonus tied to the achievement of innovation goals—reflecting our commitment to recognizing meaningful impact. We also offer equity grants, providing a meaningful opportunity to share in the company’s future growth and success.
  
  
SiTime is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law.

Review the Get to Know SiTime section of our career page to explore our culture, values, and what makes us unique.
