title: Applied Researcher
description:
Job description:
  
  

The Applied Researcher – AI Security is responsible for conducting applied research in AI security with a focus on analysing, evaluating, and strengthening AI models and pipelines. The role bridges theory and practice by translating research ideas into validated prototypes, experimental results, and reusable security techniques that enable secure, compliant, and trustworthy AI systems.

Key Responsibilities

- Conduct applied research across AI security topics including model behaviour analysis, provenance analysis, and model unlearning.

- Design and execute experiments, benchmarks, and comparative evaluations for AI security techniques.

- Develop proof-of-concept implementations and research artefacts to demonstrate feasibility and effectiveness.

- Analyse model internals such as weights, activations, and outputs to identify anomalous or insecure behaviour.

- Collaborate closely with Research Leads and engineers to operationalise research outcomes.

- Document methodologies, results, and findings for internal reuse and external publication.

- Contribute to technical papers, patents, and research disclosures as required.

Required Qualifications & Experience

**Education:**

- Master’s or PhD degree (CS, AI/ML, Crypto, Cybersecurity) from
**Premier Institute\*\***
with research credentials in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

**Experience:**

- 5–8+ years of experience in applied AI/ML research or security research.

- Earlier Experience in R&D labs, Research projects, Product companies, AI Projects, Enterprise solutions, AI Engineering

- Publications in top tier conferences (mandatory)

- Demonstrated experience translating experimental ideas into working prototypes.

**\*\* It is suggested to prefer Post-Doc, in case difficult to find suitable candidates with 5-8 yrs of relevant experience\*\***

Required Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of large language models and modern ML architectures, including fine-tuning, LoRA/adapters, and RAG systems.

- Understanding of model internals including weight-space behaviour, activation patterns, and interpretability methods.

- Hands-on exposure to AI security techniques such as model fingerprinting, backdoor analysis, derivation detection, and behavioural testing.

- Familiarity with model unlearning concepts, verification approaches, and privacy risk mitigation.

- Proficiency with ML experimentation frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX) and reproducible research workflows.

- Strong programming skills in Python and experience working with research codebases.

* Ensure security tickets are properly organized and tracked
* Assist with the creation and maintenance of incident response playbooks
* Create and enhance operational metrics to ensure the security programs are effective

Proven ability to monitor and triage security alerts from SIEM, EDR, cloud, and other security technologies; investigate suspicious activities; and correlate events across multiple data sources.
* Enterprise Infrastructure & Security: Hands-on proficiency in deploying and operating enterprise-scale security solutions across cloud and on-premises environments, with a strong understanding of security principles, network architecture, and modern development practices. Experience integrating and analyzing multi-source telemetry across endpoint, identity, cloud, and DLP platforms to provide comprehensive security visibility.
* Automation & Development: Scripting or software development expertise (e.g., Python) to automate security workflows of routine tasks and Improve SOC workflow.
* AI Tools & Agent Workflows: Practical experience adopting AI technologies, including LLM-based assistants, copilots, and autonomous agents, to improve security operations and investigation workflows. Experience with prompt engineering, tool orchestration, and MCP/API integrations to automate analysis and enhance SOC efficiency.
* Process Adherence: Ensure all security incidents are detected, investigated, and escalated within defined SLAs and SOC procedures.Maintain timely and accurate incident documentation and ensure prompt escalation of critical incidents.
* Problem Solving & Threat Mindset: Demonstrate strong analytical capabilities to investigate complex security incidents, adopt an offensive security mindset, and apply structured problem-solving methodologies to identify root causes and drive effective resolutions
* Collaboration & Communication: Self-motivated, detail-oriented team player capable of working independently or in distributed teams, with excellent communication skills to tailor technical insights for diverse stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications such as CEH, GCIH, CompTIA Security+, AWS, GCP or equivalent credentials.
* Academic Background in Computer Science, Cyber Security or related field
* Familiarity with various security management tools (Eg: EDR, SIEM, DLP, Email Security, Threat & Vulnerability Management)

The world’s most innovative companies turn to ThoughtSpot’s AI-Powered Analytics to put data in the hands of everyone, from the C-suite to the frontline. * Speak to the experience of using AI for research, content creation, and document summarization while maintaining ownership of judgment and final decisions.

title: Chief Cloud Infrastructure & Security Officer
description:
Job Description

**Senior Director / Vice President, Cloud Operations & Security Engineering**

**Location:**
Chennai DLF

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
20+ years

**Role Summary**

Talentgigs is seeking an experienced technology leader to own and advance Production Operations, Cloud Infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevSecOps, and Security Engineering.

This leader will bring deep technical judgment and a strong record of leading cloud-native production environments. They will build a capable, accountable organization that protects and operates critical services through reliable engineering, proactive security, automation, continuous monitoring, and disciplined incident management.

The role extends beyond traditional infrastructure management and information security management system (ISMS) compliance. The successful candidate will embed security and reliability in engineering and operational practices, reduce risk before it becomes an incident, and use automation and AI-driven operations to improve service health and response.

**Key Responsibilities**

Production Operations and Reliability

* Own the reliability, availability, performance, and operational readiness of production services.
* Establish clear service ownership, operational accountability, escalation paths, and on-call practices.
* Lead incident response, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and follow-through on corrective actions.
* Define and improve service-level objectives, service-level indicators, error budgets, and operational health measures.
* Strengthen change, release, capacity, resilience, backup, and disaster-recovery practices.
* Reduce recurring incidents and operational toil through engineering-led improvements.

**Cloud Infrastructure and Platform Engineering**

* Set the direction for secure, scalable, resilient, and cost-aware cloud infrastructure.
* Lead the design and operation of cloud-native platforms, environments, networks, identity controls, and shared services.
* Promote infrastructure as code, standard platform patterns, self-service capabilities, and repeatable environment provisioning.
* Ensure platform design supports availability, recovery, observability, performance, and secure delivery.
* Guide capacity planning, cloud cost visibility, and optimization without compromising reliability or security.

**SRE and Operational Excellence**

* Build and mature SRE practices that make reliability measurable and part of day-to-day engineering.
* Develop observability across services using actionable metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and service health views.
* Improve deployment safety through progressive delivery, automated checks, rollback readiness, and resilient release practices.
* Use incident trends, operational data, and post-incident reviews to guide prioritized improvements.
* Create a culture of learning and accountability in which incidents lead to durable fixes.

**DevSecOps and Security Engineering**

* Embed security into software delivery, infrastructure management, and operational workflows.
* Lead practical security engineering across identity and access, secrets, configuration, network controls, workload protection, and data safeguards.
* Build automated security checks into build, test, deployment, and infrastructure pipelines.
* Establish continuous monitoring and threat detection with clear triage, escalation, and response ownership.
* Drive vulnerability prevention and remediation through asset visibility, risk-based prioritization, patching, secure configuration, and dependency controls.
* Strengthen cloud security posture and address risks across applications, platforms, identities, and operational processes.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to resolve security issues early and sustainably.
* Ensure audits and ISMS obligations are supported by effective technical controls and evidence, while keeping operational security and risk reduction at the center.

**Automation and AI-Driven Operations**

* Set an automation strategy that reduces manual work, improves consistency, and speeds up safe delivery and recovery.
* Apply AI and advanced analytics to suitable operational use cases, such as anomaly detection, alert correlation, incident triage, capacity forecasting, and knowledge retrieval.
* Establish appropriate safeguards, human oversight, validation, and access controls for AI-supported operational workflows.
* Measure automation outcomes through reduced toil, faster response, fewer repeat incidents, and improved service health.

**Organization and Leadership**

* Build, develop, and retain strong teams across production operations, cloud infrastructure, SRE, DevSecOps, and security engineering.
* Define organizational structure, role clarity, decision rights, service ownership, and measurable accountability.
* Develop senior technical leaders and create growth paths for engineering and operations talent.
* Work closely with product, application engineering, architecture, risk, and business leaders to align technology priorities with business outcomes.
* Communicate operational risk, service health, security posture, and investment needs clearly to executive stakeholders.
* Lead through technical credibility, sound judgment, collaboration, and consistent follow-through.

Required Technical Qualifications

* 20+ years of progressive experience in technology, infrastructure, production operations, cloud engineering, reliability, or security, including substantial leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated hands-on technical leadership in cloud-native production environments.
* Strong understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, networking, identity, compute, storage, and platform operations.
* Experience designing and operating containerized and orchestrated workloads, such as Kubernetes or comparable platforms.
* Practical knowledge of infrastructure as code, configuration management, CI/CD, source control, and deployment automation.
* Deep working understanding of SRE principles, observability, service-level objectives, incident management, resilience, and disaster recovery.
* Experience implementing security controls in cloud and software delivery environments, including identity management, secrets, vulnerability management, secure configuration, and threat detection.
* Experience establishing continuous monitoring, alerting, incident response, and security operations practices.
* Ability to assess architecture and operational risk, make trade-offs, and guide teams through complex technical decisions.
* Familiarity with cloud cost management and capacity planning in production environments.

**Required Leadership Qualifications**

* Experience leading multiple technical functions and managing managers or senior technical leaders.
* Track record of building technically strong teams with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to stay close to technical decisions while setting direction and enabling teams to execute.
* Proven leadership in major incidents, security events, operational change, or complex service transformations.
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risk and investment priorities to executive and non-technical audiences.
* A practical, engineering-led approach to governance, risk management, and compliance.
* Demonstrated ability to build trust and work across organizational boundaries.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience leading operations and security in a high-scale, high-availability, or business-critical environment.
* Experience modernizing legacy infrastructure and operational models into cloud-native platforms and practices.
* Familiarity with zero-trust principles, security architecture, threat modeling, and secure software supply chains.
* Experience with chaos engineering, resilience testing, game days, and recovery exercises.
* Experience using AI or machine learning to improve operational monitoring, incident workflows, or engineering productivity.
* Familiarity with security and service-management frameworks or standards relevant to the organization.
* Relevant cloud, security, SRE, or leadership certifications.

**Success Measures**

Success in this role will be assessed through sustained improvements in:

* Production service availability, reliability, performance, and recovery readiness.
* Incident frequency, severity, time to detect, time to restore, and recurrence rates.
* Adoption and quality of service-level objectives, observability, and service ownership.
* Vulnerability exposure, remediation timelines, secure configuration, and cloud security posture.
* Security monitoring coverage, alert quality, response readiness, and closure of corrective actions.
* Automation coverage, reduction in manual toil, and safe deployment frequency.
* Resilience, backup, disaster-recovery, and continuity test outcomes.
* Cloud cost visibility and efficiency while meeting reliability and security requirements.
* Team capability, role clarity, leadership depth, and accountability across the functions.
* The ability of engineering teams to adopt secure and reliable practices as part of normal delivery.

title: Senior Security Incident Responder
description:
**WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.**
**We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.**

**Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.**
**For more information, visit WPP.com.**
**Why we're hiring:**
The Senior Security Incident Responder is a lead technical authority for incident response execution, responsible for handling the most complex, high-impact, and business-critical security incidents across WPP. The role does not have line management responsibility; people management remains with the Security Incident Management Lead.
  
  
**What you'll be doing:**

* Extensive hands-on experience responding to enterprise-scale security incidents.
* Deep technical expertise across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, identity, email, and cloud platforms.
* Strong forensic, investigation, and root cause analysis skills.
* Ability to operate calmly under pressure and communicate clearly.

**Desirable:**

* Experience acting as incident commander or senior escalation point.

title: Architect
description:
"The AWS & DevSecOps Architect serves as the principal, client-facing technical leader responsible for driving hybrid cloud infrastructure (AWS + On-Premise OpenShift), DevSecOps automation, technical reviews, team guidance, and client engagement for the VCB Corporate Digibank MVP1 program.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
Hybrid Infrastructure Architecture: Design AWS multi-account landing zones (AFT, EKS, Transit Gateway) connected to VCB's backend core systems and on-premise OpenShift. Maintain component parity across environments (e.g., AWS WAF/S3 vs On-Prem F5 WAF/Ceph).
  
  
DevSecOps & Security Automation: Architect GitLab CI/CD pipelines with integrated shift-left security (SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning). Implement zero-trust security, data encryption (TLS 1.3, AES-256), and identity federation (ForgeRock CIAM, Keycloak, HashiCorp Vault).
  
  
GitOps & Release Governance: Lead ArgoCD-based GitOps deployments, Main-Based release branching, immutable artifact promotion, and Change Advisory Board (CAB) approval gates.
  
  
Observability, DR, & Client Engagement: Establish unified hybrid monitoring (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Dynatrace), validate RTO/RPO DR failover strategies, and act as the primary advisor to VCB leadership
  
  
Client Interface & Query Management: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for Vietcombank (VCB) IT, Security, and Enterprise Architecture stakeholders. Proactively address client inquiries, resolve complex architecture/infrastructure queries, present design proposals, and lead discussions in ARB, DRB and Change Control Boards.
  
  
Team Guidance & Technical Enablement: Lead, coach, and mentor cross-functional engineering and DevOps teams on GitOps practices, cloud-native design, and mobile security. Foster a DevSecOps culture, establish engineering standards, and build reusable documentation and training materials via the Dev Portal.

title: Red Teaming - Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
Join Deloitte Cyber and help organizations address evolving cyber threats through offensive security, threat simulation, and resilience services. As a Senior Consultant in the Cyber Defense & Resilience practice, you will support client engagements focused on adversary emulation, vulnerability assessment, and security operations improvement. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to complex cybersecurity projects across attack simulation, threat management, and security transformation.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant on the Cyber team, you will be responsible for supporting project delivery across offensive security and cybersecurity transformation engagements.
  
  

* Support delivery of offensive security and cyber defense engagements under defined operating procedures and service level expectations.
* Perform development and customization activities for security and data protection technology implementation projects.
* Execute assessments, simulations, and analysis activities with limited supervision while contributing to quality and timeliness of deliverables.
* Apply knowledge of business processes, information technology management processes, and Deloitte methodologies, frameworks, and tools.
* Contribute to practice development initiatives, documentation, reporting, and engagement coordination activities.

Cyber Defense & Resilience teams assist clients in defending against advanced threats by transforming security operations, and by monitoring technology, data analytics, and threat intelligence. They help manage and protect dynamic attack surfaces and provide rapid crisis and cyber incident response, thereby ensuring that clients can be ready for, respond to, and recover from business disruptions. title: Cyber Threat Management Analyst, Specialist- Secure AI Enablement ESF
description:
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Cyber Threat Management Analyst, Specialist role provides expert level technical support for cyber threats and threat attack methodologies. Collects and analyzes system data to identify, contain, mitigate, and recover from cyber security threats or incidents. Conducts research and gathers information from global threat intelligence sources, pertaining to emerging cyber threats and threat attack methodologies. Additionally, the role involves designing and testing secure systems to protect sensitive information, managing virus protection and intrusion detection systems, performing comprehensive risk audits, and implementing disaster recovery strategies to ensure business continuity during security incidents.
  
  
**Responsibilites**

* Leads and responds to escalated cyber security alerts, cyber incidents, or related security investigations. Identifies real-time complex attack patterns and suggests mitigation strategies.
* Leads the processes, tools and measures to monitor and detect compromises, risks, vulnerabilities, network security threats, tools and tactics used by modern and emerging threat actors. Facilitates security operations and incident response technologies and methodologies.
* Develops, manages, maintains and enhances security controls (alerts, rules, policies, and signatures) for the security platforms.
* Reviews the network environment for new and evolving cyber threats and provides preventive and remedial solutions. Identifies malicious activity by performing analysis on logs, traffic flows, and other investigative detective activities.
* Conducts penetration testing, vulnerability assessments and threat modeling. Evaluates risks and makes recommendations.
* Provides written assessments focused on threats, vulnerabilities, and technologies relevant to Vanguard Infrastructure.
* Leads with IT and business teams to ensure prompt and effective distribution of findings so incidents are effectively addressed. Provides department support to the business on enterprise-wide security initiatives and projects.
* Mentors junior team members to improve their technical acumen.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Designs and tests secure operating systems, networks, and databases to safeguard infrastructure and protect sensitive information.
* Conducts password audits and manages virus protection, ensuring strong intrusion detection systems are in place.
* Performs comprehensive risk audits with actionable insights for improving application and infrastructure security.
* Implements backup and disaster recovery strategies to ensure business continuity during security incidents.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of experience in cyber threat detection, security operations, or incident response, including leading security investigations and team mentoring.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Cybersecurity or Network Security.
* Strong understanding of cyber attack methodologies, intrusion detection systems, network traffic analysis, and threat actor tactics.
* Hands-on experience in penetration testing, vulnerability scanning (e.g., Nessus, Qualys), and using tools like Splunk, Wireshark, and EDR solutions.
* Deep knowledge of system hardening, secure network architecture, and endpoint protection strategies.
* Proficiency in JIRA, Confluence, and working within Agile/Scrum environments with CI/CD integration.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
**Benefits**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Associate, AI Model Validation, RQA
description:
**About This Role**
**Business Overview**
The Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s fiduciary and enterprise risks.  RQA’s principal objectives are to advance the firm’s risk management practices and to deliver independent risk expertise and constructive challenge to drive better business and investment outcomes.
  
  
RQA is committed to investing in our people to increase individual enablement and ultimately build a stronger team. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion which encourages collaboration, innovation, diversity and the development our future leaders.  We actively engage in discussions on career growth and work with team members to understand how personal passions and strength connect with our purpose.
  
  
**Role Description**
The Enterprise Risk team within RQA oversees those risks which directly impact the corporate entity (i.e. BlackRock, Inc., or one of its subsidiaries), rather than the fiduciary risks assumed by funds/clients, such as investment risks and counterparty risks. The team’s focus includes but is not limited to operational risk, technology, vendor, model and market risk, stress testing for market risk and the quantitative estimation of capital adequacy requirements.
  
  
The
**AI Validation**
Associate will perform independent reviews of AI tools and agents used across BlackRock, including agentic systems, RAG applications and other business workflows. This role requires strong technical expertise combined with risk management skills to challenge system design, data integrity, and performance monitoring. The role will be based onsite in our GGN office.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct independent validation of AI usage in workflows, including testing for accuracy, efficiency of guardrails, orchestration, memory management and token usage.
* Design and implement comprehensive validation strategies and test plans tailored to each AI use case. Define clear success criteria and quality benchmarks to measure whether the AI solution meets all requirements and standards.
* Understand tool architecture, potential vulnerabilities and weaknesses.
* Assess conceptual soundness, methodology, and alignment with intended business use.
* Review data quality, preprocessing steps and engineering decisions for AI use cases.
* Execute functional and performance tests.
* Evaluate performance metrics, robustness, and limitations under various scenarios.
* Document validation findings, provide recommendations
* Stay current on emerging AI technologies, validation techniques, and regulatory developments.
* Communicate validation conclusions to relevant stakeholders, including escalating identified findings, risks or gaps to senior leadership and approval committees
* Collaborate with AI Engineering, Data Science, and Risk teams to enhance AI transparency and trustworthiness.

**Experience, Skills And Qualification**

* With 3-7 years’ works experience in the IT or financial industry.
* Degree or Advanced degree (MS, PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
* Strong understanding of generative AI technologies, including large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic systems, prompt engineering, tool use, and modern AI application architectures.
* Experience with Python and common AI development libraries and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar).
* Excellent analytical, communication, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and challenge stakeholders constructively.
* Experience with one or more of the following:
* Validating usage of large language models (LLMs) in business context
* Evaluation methodologies, benchmark development, ground-truth creation, and AI quality assessment
* AI observability, monitoring, performance measurement, and operational controls
* AI orchestration frameworks, agent architectures, prompt engineering, memory management, and context optimization
* Exposure to cloud-based AI platforms and scalable model deployment
* MCP, APIs, connectors and integrations of AI solutions with enterprise systems and data sources
* Responsible AI practices, including fairness, explainability, bias assessment, transparency, and model governance
* Fine-tuning or model customization techniques
* Security testing and risk assessment of AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreak, and data leakage testing

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Senior Specialist - Application Security
description:
It's about Being What's next.

The Senior Specialist in this position will enterprise application security SME – VAPT of Web, API, Android and iOS and manager end-to-end VAPT – planning, execution, reporting, remediation and retesting. Along with vulnerability management – triage, prioritisation, ownership and risk-based closure and security assurance across design, development, deployment and production support.
  
  
At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. Team
  
  

Making an impact.

* The Senior Specialist in this position will lead end-to-end VAPT for web applications, APIs, Android and iOS using manual and automated techniques
* You will also define assessment scope, test strategy, attack scenarios and rules of engagement
* Apply OWASP, CWE, CVSS and relevant NIST guidance throughout assessments

* And manage UVM intake and triage – validation, deduplication, ownership, prioritisation and SLA tracking
* Also, assess patch and remediation options – applicability, dependencies, implementation risk and compensating controls

* Review and correlate SAST, DAST, SCA and cloud/container security findings
* You will develop reusable testing methodologies, checklists, scripts and automation

Winning in your role.

As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. title: Senior Network/Automation QA Engineer
description:
This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
***Job Family Definition:***
Set and maintain quality standards for company products through the use of systematic processes. Develops, modifies, and executes software test strategies, plans and suites. Analyzes and writes test standards and procedures. Maintains documentation of test results to assist in debugging and modification of software. Analyzes test results to ensure existing functionality and recommends corrective action. May develop tools and environments to automate test execution. Consults with development engineers in resolution of problems.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and maintain system testbeds involving Mist Edge (L2TPv3/IPsec concentrator) along with switches, routers, and servers.
* Perform QA validation of Mist Edge datapath, tunneling, and security features.
* Validate end-to-end client-to-cloud architecture, including traffic flow across L2TPv3/IPsec tunnels.
* Recreate complex customer networking and datapath issues in lab environments and collaborate with US and Beijing Engineering teams for resolution.
* Work closely with CS teams to review customer-reported issues and enhance test coverage for real-world deployments.
* Create and manage bugs in Jira and drive closure with Engineering teams.
* Perform timely escalation of critical datapath, scale, or performance issues.
* Develop technical documentation for QA and CS teams in Confluence.
* Train and mentor Level 1/2 Engineers on advanced networking, tunneling protocols, and troubleshooting techniques.
* Leverage AI-powered tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate test creation, log analysis, and debugging workflows.
* Contribute to automation frameworks using AI-assisted code generation to improve test coverage, regression efficiency, and defect detection.
* Apply AI-assisted approaches for anomaly detection, traffic pattern analysis, and faster root cause identification.

**What You Need To Bring**

* BE/ME/MS in EE, CS, or related discipline.
* Strong understanding of low-level datapath and packet processing.
* Hands-on experience with L2TPv3 and IPsec (tunnel establishment, encapsulation, troubleshooting).
* Solid knowledge of Layer 2 Switching and Layer 3 Routing concepts (VLANs, DHCP, DNS, NAT, trunking).
* Experience with DHCP Relay, RadSec, and authentication flows.
* Working knowledge of multicast and service discovery protocols such as IGMP, MLD, and mDNS.
* Strong troubleshooting skills using packet captures (Wireshark/tcpdump) and log analysis.
* Ability to analyze and debug complex networking issues across control and data planes.
* Familiarity with automation frameworks and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot).
* Passion for solving customer issues in a fast-paced, highly technical environment.
* Ability to quickly and accurately assess and drive resolution of technical problems.
* Experience level: 10–15 years

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CWNA/CWSP/CWAP/CWNE Certified.
* Scripting in Python.
* Hands on experience on ISE/ClearPass.
* Basic knowledge of L2TPv3/IPsec.

title: TCMS Test Engineer
description:
**Hello Visionary!**
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!
  
  
**We are looking for TCMS Test Engineer**
He/she manages validation and verification of all TCMS subsystems and components in line with make or buy strategy on the project
  
  
**You’ll make a difference by**

* Understanding the TCMS architecture of Rolling Stock platforms such as Metro and Locomotives and gaining domain knowledge of rolling stock business operations.
* 100% of TCMS requirements are covered by test.
* 100% TCMS requirements tests performed / all tests.
* On time delivery on all Verification & Test deliverables.
* Continuous improvement or REX management from previous projects.
* Level of application of standard methodologies and Processes: 100%
* 100% compliant with EHS rules (regarding activities performed on train and test bench).
* Management of TCMS validation and verification tools configuration.
* Delivery of TCMS test procedures & reports.
* Configuration Management of Verification & Test deliverables.
* Management of validation status of change requests (CR).
* Management of CR: all NOK results in test reports related to a CR
* Software quality of the vehicle control system (TCMS) by conducting tests in accordance with EN50716.
* Creating cross-project test specifications for tests in the laboratory and on the actual vehicle.
* Developing and maintaining Python-based scripts, tools, and automation frameworks to support laboratory and integration testing.
* Automating laboratory tests using Python to achieve continuous and repeatable test execution.
* Using Eclipse IDE for software integration tasks, source code navigation, debugging, log analysis, and verification of embedded TCMS applications.
* Carry out tests in accordance with specifications and document the results.
* In the event of deviations, clarify the causes with the developers.
* Further develop our existing test strategies and methods for your area of expertise and ensure the transfer of know-how between projects.
* Close collaboration with the software development engineers as well as with the software assessors.
* Together with the team plan and implement test automation

**Desired Skills**

* Successfully completed a technical degree in computer science, electrical engineering, railway engineering or a related subject.
* Alternatively, you have relevant technical vocational training supplemented by a technician's degree or several years of experience in testing embedded software in safety-related systems.
* Experience with test management and knowledge in agile software development is a plus.

The result is faster decisions, reduced downtime, improved efficiency, and stronger operational performance.
  
  
**Role:**
QA Engineer – Manual & Automation Testing
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience:**
2+ years
  
  
**Department:**
Engineering

We are looking for a
**QA Engineer with 2–3 years of experience**
in manual and automation testing, along with basic exposure to
**ML & GenAI model/application testing**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong software testing fundamentals, hands-on experience with web/API testing and test automation, and an understanding of how to validate ML-based applications and their outputs.
  
  
The candidate will work closely with developers, product managers, and QA engineers to ensure the quality, reliability, and accuracy of applications and ML-powered features.

+ Cypress
+ Appium

+ Java
+ JavaScript/TypeScript

* Experience testing ML/AI/GenAI applications.
* Exposure to ML model evaluation or data validation.

* Exposure to CI/CD-based automated test execution.
* Basic knowledge of Docker or cloud-based testing environments.

description:

It is comprised of three industry-leading businesses which, combined, provide end-to-end solutions across the investment lifecycle.
  
  
**Overview Of The Lead Associate, Quality Assurance And Engineering**
BETA is a self-clearing securities processing platform that supports critical back office, middle office, and front office capabilities for wealth management firms. Built on years of expert knowledge and hands-on experience, BETA provides critical back-office controls including corporate action management, middle office exception management, and front office account management and trading tools for advisors.
  
  
We’re seeking a Lead Associate, Quality Assurance and Engineering to join one of our Scrum teams and help shape how quality and automation scale across customers facing financial platforms. This role goes beyond test execution, you’ll influence test strategy, automation standards, and quality gates, while owning the end-to-end quality of your team’s deliverables. You’ll partner closely with developers, product owners, and fellow QEs to ensure our solutions are reliable, maintainable, and ready to scale.
  
  
Reporting to the Manager, Technology Development, you’ll be embedded within a team, supporting data‑centric platforms and services built on Snowflake, focused on large‑scale data ingestion, transformation, and downstream integrations. As part of our global Quality Engineering organization, you’ll help expand and stabilize our automated testing capabilities while working in a hybrid model alongside teams based in Bangalore, India.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities of the Lead Associate, Quality Assurance and Engineering:**
**Quality & Test Strategy**

* Own the overall quality of your team’s deliverables across functional, integration, and regression testing
* Review product requirements and design effective test plans, scenarios, and test cases with clear traceability
* Partner with stakeholders to define testing scope, inputs/outputs, and quality expectations
* Apply risk-based thinking to prioritize high value test coverage and release confidence

**Focused Testing**

* Design and execute data quality tests across Snowflake and data warehouses/data lakes.
* Hands-on in dealing complex SQL queries to validate Data completeness, consistency and Business rule enforcement.
* Test ETL/ELT pipelines that load data into Snowflake (batch and/or near‑real‑time). Validate: Incremental vs full loads, Late-arriving data handling, Schema changes and backward compatibility.
* Validate API responses against data persisted in both onprem and Snowflake.
* Build and maintain automated test suites for REST API testing and validation against non-snowflake data sources.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab) to provide fast, actionable feedback
* Execute and support testing activities including functional, integration, regression, and UAT support

**Continuous Improvement**

* Troubleshoot failures end-to-end across automation code, environments, test data, and application defects
* Passion for staying on top of tech trends, experimenting with and learning new technologies, and participating in technology communities.

title: Senior Fraud QA and Enablement Analyst
description:
We are seeking a
**Fraud Operations QA & Enablement analyst**
to join our 24×7 fraud operations function and help protect our customers through rigorous quality standards, transaction auditing, and operational enablement.
  
  
You will serve as the quality anchor and "connective tissue" of our fraud team. You won't just be clearing alerts; you will drive high decision standards across the entire function. Your mission is to establish and maintain robust QA frameworks, ensure every analyst makes high-quality, compliant decisions, and turn audit insights into actionable training, SOP updates, and process improvements
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Quality Assurance & Auditing (Primary Focus): Perform regular, comprehensive audits of analyst transaction decisions, risk scores, and case notes to ensure consistency, accuracy, and strict adherence to compliance standards.
* Root-Cause & Pattern Analysis: Analyze QA audit data to identify recurring decision errors, knowledge gaps, and emerging fraud typologies, transforming findings into actionable team insights.
* Calibration & Coaching: Lead regular quality calibration sessions for the team and provide constructive feedback and targeted coaching to analysts to elevate decision quality.
* Knowledge Architecture & SOPs: Own and maintain the central "Source of Truth" (Knowledge Base) for Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), updating guidelines based on QA findings and evolving fraud tactics.
* Training & Onboarding: Design and deliver onboarding modules for new hires and ongoing "delta training" to address quality trends and process updates.
* Process Excellence & System Gap Analysis: Monitor team-wide quality metrics and SLAs. Act as a feedback loop between Operations and Product/Engineering to fix system limitations causing manual error or security risks.
* Operational Visibility: Aggregate and report QA scores, error trends, and compliance metrics to provide leadership with clear visibility into operational health.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* At least 5 years of experience in fraud operations, transaction monitoring, payments risk, or trust and safety. This must include hands-on experience developing Quality Assurance (QA) frameworks, sampling strategies, conducting audits, and coaching analysts.
* Proven expertise in evaluating transaction reviews, case documentation, and fraud determinations against established compliance and operational standards.
* Strong background in building or maintaining decision frameworks, QA scorecards, and SOP documentation.
* Hands-on background leveraging artificial intelligence technologies to streamline, enhance, and scale manual quality auditing workflows.
* Comfort reviewing complex transactions and conducting outbound customer verifications when needed.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of delivering constructive feedback and leading training sessions.
* High attention to detail and strong analytical skills to translate QA data into operational improvements.
* Ability to work in a high-volume, fast-paced operational environment while maintaining high quality standards.
* Willingness and flexibility to work across three rotating shifts as part of a 24×7 operations team.
* Experience in fintech, travel, payments, or e-commerce environments is strongly preferred.

description:
**About Chargebee**

Chargebee is a leading provider of billing and monetization solutions, empowering businesses with recurring revenue models to streamline revenue and finance operations, capture actionable insights, and drive growth.

Chargebee is trusted by businesses of all sizes, including Zapier, LegalZoom, Lambda, Freshworks, DeepL, Condé Nast, and Pret a Manger, and is proud to have been consistently recognized by customers as a Leader in Subscription Management on G2.

With headquarters in North Bethesda, Maryland, our team members are based primarily in India, the U.S., and Europe.

**About the Team**

Our AI Products team builds Chargebee Copilot and other product experiences that bring Chargebee’s AI Agents platform to real users. We turn the platform’s agents, tools, and APIs into products people use every day, from the backend services and APIs that power them to the interfaces on top. We care about good conversational experiences and about giving people the tools to configure and improve how an AI agent behaves.

**About the role (Job Summary)**

We’re looking for an AI Quality Engineer to own the quality of our AI-powered products and agents throughout their lifecycle. Unlike traditional QA, AI systems aren’t deterministic, so they need continuous evaluation before release and ongoing improvement based on real-world usage. You’ll make sure our AI delivers accurate, reliable, high-quality experiences by designing effective evaluations, validating new capabilities, analyzing production behavior, and driving improvements across the AI stack. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys understanding why AI systems behave the way they do and is passionate about improving AI products through evidence, experimentation, and engineering collaboration.

**What you’ll do**

* Design, review, and improve AI evaluation datasets, benchmarks, and regression suites, ensuring coverage reflects real customer scenarios, edge cases, and expected user behavior
* Validate new AI capabilities before they are released to customers, and continuously improve evaluations and release criteria
* Monitor AI quality in production using customer feedback, sampled conversations, telemetry, and quality metrics
* Perform root cause analysis to understand why AI interactions succeed or fail, classifying issues across prompts, retrieval, tool usage, model behavior, workflows, product knowledge, and application logic
* Identify recurring quality patterns and recommend engineering improvements
* Convert production learnings into evaluation cases to prevent future regressions
* Partner with Engineering, Product, and Support to improve prompts, agent workflows, retrieval systems, tools, and evaluation frameworks
* Define and track AI quality KPIs, and measure the impact of improvements using benchmarks and production metrics

**What you’ll bring (required skills and experience)**

* Strong analytical and investigative mindset with excellent problem-solving skills
* 2+ years of experience
* Ability to identify root causes rather than symptoms
* Excellent written communication and documentation skills
* Comfort working with APIs, logs, structured data, and technical systems
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering teams
* Passion for building high-quality AI products

**Nice to have (preferred)**

* Experience in QA, SDET, Technical Support Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Product Analysis, or AI/ML applications
* Familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, MCP, AI agents, or AI evaluation frameworks
* Experience designing evaluation datasets, benchmarks, or testing strategies
* Basic programming or scripting skills (Python, SQL, JavaScript, etc.)

At Chargebee, we believe that feeling supported is the foundation for doing great work. We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your personal, financial, and professional growth and ensure you thrive in every aspect of your life. Our commitment to supporting our employees is universal, while our benefits are thoughtfully designed to meet the unique needs of each region. We offer comprehensive packages that generally include:

* Financial Security: Initiatives to help you build long-term financial stability.

At Chargebee, we believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences is not a “good-to-have” but a “must-have” as it strengthens us as a company and as individuals. description:

We are a diverse and dedicated team working on life-sciences data and digital solutions. We maintain services that support research across drug discovery, development, safety, and healthcare. Our mission is to ensure scientific content is accurate, well organized, and trustworthy. We build AI-driven products people can rely on. We focus on data integrity, reliable insights, teamwork, and continuous learning across disciplines.

You will independently drive detailed scientific content quality and validation activities for life-sciences information products. Your focus will be interpreting biomedical and chemical information, analyzing outputs from very large scientific datasets, and assessing the accuracy, consistency, completeness, and relevance of content. You will help define quality standards, identify root causes, and provide evidence-based recommendations to product, data, and engineering teams.

* Design representative, edge-case, and challenge test sets with traceable expected outputs.
* Conduct manual and automated scientific evaluations of Agentic AI outputs.

* Translate evaluation findings into clear, documented recommendations for cross-functional teams.

**Requirements**

* Advanced degree or equivalent experience in pharmacoinformatics, pharmacology, pharmaceutical sciences, bioinformatics, medicinal chemistry, or a related discipline.
* Strong knowledge of scientific data-quality standards and methods for evaluating Agentic AI outputs.
* Experience with large scientific databases, taxonomies, and ontologies.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and attention-to-detail skills.

title: SAP Functional Testing - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a SAP Functional Testing Manager you will lead client support testing efforts within our Software and Product Innovation practice, guiding the planning and delivery of testing activities that help validate SAP solutions before they move into production. As a Manager you will lead teams, coach junior staff, manage client accounts, and take ownership of workstreams while applying sound judgment, business knowledge, and a practical approach to quality, timelines, and deliverables. In this role at PwC, you will oversee test strategy, coordinate issue tracking, review results, and help shape clear reporting that supports informed decisions across complex SAP programs.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Leading SAP functional testing workstreams across client engagements and coordinating deliverable timelines with project leads
* Managing testing plans, estimates, and execution activities for functional, systems integration, regression, and user acceptance testing
* Directing teams in the creation, review, and maintenance of test cases, test scripts, defect logs, and testing documentation
* Overseeing defect triage, root cause review, and retesting activities to support timely resolution across release cycles
* Applying quality engineering methods and testing tools to assess application functionality, integrations, and business process performance
* Coaching junior staff on testing methods, issue tracking, and documentation standards while providing clear review feedback
* Evaluating system changes, process impacts, and business requirements to identify testing risks and coverage gaps
* Building relationships with client and internal stakeholders to align testing activities with implementation milestones and business priorities

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 8 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  
**Core module expertise:**
Hands-on functional knowledge in at least two modules, such as FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, EWM, or QM, including the ability to read and validate configuration rather than only execute scripts.
  
  

* End-to-end process knowledge: Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce, including cross-module touchpoints and period-end close.
* ECC to S/4HANA transition knowledge: Understanding of key conversion changes, including Business Partner, Universal Journal (ACDOCA), new asset accounting, and MATDOC. Brownfield, greenfield, and RISE with SAP exposure are preferred.
* Fiori and integration awareness: Functional familiarity with Fiori apps and roles, as well as interfaces to SAP and non-SAP systems, including IDocs, OData/APIs, and SAP Integration Suite.
* Adjacent SAP solutions (good to have): Exposure to SuccessFactors, Ariba, IBP, or Concur.
* Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Graphic Design, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, Mathematics
* Demonstrating SAP functional testing leadership across client engagements
* Managing test planning, execution, and defect triage activities
* Driving quality engineering improvements through automation and process design
* Coaching teams on UAT, regression, and systems integration testing
* Translating business needs into clear test scenarios and deliverables

description:
**About Autonomize AI**
Autonomize AI is on a mission to help organizations make sense of the world's dark data. Unstructured data contains critical insights that, when paired with human context, unlock transformative business outcomes. Our goal is to make that process effortless and accessible.
  
  
We are an ambitious, global, remote team committed to human-machine collaboration. Our founders are serial entrepreneurs who have successfully scaled multiple venture-backed companies. We combine expertise in building cutting-edge data products, captivating user experiences, and scaling enterprise AI solutions.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a seasoned, strategic
**QA Manager**
with
**12+ years of experience**
to build, scale, and govern our quality engineering and software release ecosystem.
  
  
In this dual-impact leadership role, you will define and execute the overall QA strategy while taking end-to-end ownership of delivery schedules, CI/CD release governance, and cross-functional release management. You will manage and mentor a team of high-performing SDETs and QA Engineers, ensuring our enterprise AI products are delivered predictably, securely, and with uncompromised quality.

**Quality Engineering & Leadership**

* Strategic QA Leadership: Define, own, and execute the global QA vision, quality metrics (KPIs/OKRs), and long-term testing roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Team Governance & Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and grow a high-caliber team of SDETs and QA engineers; drive continuous learning and establish engineering best practices.
* Automation & ML Testing: Oversee the architectural strategy for scalable, robust test automation frameworks (Web UI, API, Data Pipelines, and Machine Learning/AI model testing).
* Enterprise Quality Assurance: Drive shift-left testing methodologies, security/compliance validations, performance/load testing, and overall dark-data pipeline reliability.

**Delivery & Release Management**

* End-to-End Release Management: Own the release lifecycle for multi-tenant and enterprise AI deployments—managing release cadence, risk assessments, scope stability, and go/no-go decisions.
* CI/CD Pipeline Governance: Collaborate closely with DevOps and Engineering to integrate automated quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, enabling smooth, repeatable, zero-downtime deployments.
* Cross-Functional Delivery Alignment: Act as the central liaison between Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, and Leadership to ensure delivery timelines are met without compromising quality.
* Incident & Risk Management: Establish post-release verification protocols, track production issues, lead root cause analyses (RCA), and implement preventive measures to continuously elevate delivery reliability.

**You’re a Fit If You Have**

* Experience: 12+ years of progressive experience in Software Quality Engineering, with 5+ years in a manager or leadership capacity.
* Release & Delivery Expertise: Proven track record in release management, release governance, and orchestrating complex deployment cycles for enterprise SaaS/Cloud platforms.
* Technical & Automation Mastery: Deep expertise in building/architecting test automation frameworks using Python, Selenium, PyTest, Cypress, or similar tools, along with API testing (Postman, REST Assured).
* AI/ML & Data Platform Exposure: Demonstrated experience testing data-intensive applications, unstructured data processing pipelines, or Machine Learning/AI platforms.
* CI/CD & DevOps Integration: Hands-on familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Process & Agile Leadership: Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery models, test management systems (Jira, Xray/Zephyr), and tracking key quality metrics (Defect Escape Rate, Test Coverage, Release Cycle Time).
* Communication & Executive Presence: Outstanding stakeholder management, problem-solving skills, and the ability to articulate quality/release risks to technical and non-technical leaders alike.

**What We Offer**

* Influence & Impact: Shape the core quality and delivery strategy for enterprise AI implementations.
* Outsized Opportunity: Join at an influential level in a rapidly scaling, VC-backed startup.
* Ownership & Autonomy: End-to-end ownership of QA and release processes with the freedom to innovate.
* Learning & Growth: Constant exposure to serial founders, cutting-edge AI technologies, and a dedicated professional development budget.

title: Linux System and Hardware Administrator
description:
**General Information**

**Job Title:** Linux System and Hardware Administrator

**Primary Job Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Location Flexibility:** Hybrid, Bengaluru based (minimum 3 days a week in office)

**Employment Type:** Permanent, Full-Time

**Hiring Timeline (Hiring month):** Immediate

**Reporting Line:** Head of Corporate Technology

**Application Deadline:** Open until filled

**Notice Period:** 30 days or less preferred, 60 days maximum

**Existing Vacancy:** Yes

**Application Deadline:** Open until Filled

**Shift Timings:** 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST

**About Fulfillment IQ (FIQ):**

Fulfillment IQ is a supply chain engineering and transformation company that helps brands, retailers, and 3PLs design, build, and scale high-performance logistics operations.

We work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology where we solve complex, real-world problems across warehouse design, automation, order management, transportation, and end-to-end supply chain execution.

Our teams combine deep domain expertise with strong technical capability, delivering outcomes through consulting, systems implementation, and proprietary platforms that accelerate time-to-value and reduce delivery risk.

**Role Overview:**

The Linux System and Hardware Administrator is the hands-on owner of day-to-day operations for Fulfillment IQ’s Linux servers and for the laptops and hardware used by our India-based team. The role sits in the Corporate Technology team within FIQ Group Shared Services, which supports both our services and product businesses. You will run routine server administration, set up and recover devices across Linux, Windows, and macOS, and resolve support tickets, working from the runbooks, policies, and security controls set by the Head of Corporate Technology and alongside colleagues based mainly in Canada.

**Mandate:**

* Keep laptops and hardware for India-based staff set up, tracked, and working
* Handle routine Linux server administration using defined runbooks
* Resolve support tickets quickly and escalate what you cannot fix with clear notes
* Keep documentation, asset records, and ticket history accurate

**Must-Have Qualifications:**

* 3 to 5 years of system administration experience, including hands-on hardware and end-user support
* Strong Linux administration from the command line (Ubuntu or RHEL family): users and permissions, file systems, services, packages, and logs. Linux is non-negotiable for this role
* Experience setting up and troubleshooting web servers (Apache or Nginx) on Linux, with Bash scripting for routine tasks
* Comfort working across Windows 11 and macOS alongside Linux. Strong Linux plus one of the other two is acceptable
* Experience administering a directory and identity platform, such as Microsoft 365 and Entra ID or an on-premise Windows Active Directory domain
* Hardware troubleshooting and component replacement, plus networking fundamentals: IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, and VPN

**Nice to Have:**

* Active Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104) certification. Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) is a strong advantage
* An active Linux certification, such as CompTIA Linux+, RHCSA, or LFCS
* Microsoft Intune administration (device enrolment, compliance policies, app deployment)
* Exposure to DevOps tooling such as Docker, cloud virtual machines (Azure or AWS), or CI/CD runners
* PowerShell or Python scripting
* Any certification listed on your resume must be active.
* Successful candidates who do not yet hold AZ-104 and AZ-305 will be expected to complete both after joining.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Hardware & Device Support**

* Set up, image, and configure Windows 11 laptops and Mac devices for new joiners, and enrol them in device management
* Collect, wipe, and reissue devices from leavers within agreed timelines
* Troubleshoot hardware issues and coordinate repairs and warranty claims with OEMs and local vendors
* Maintain the asset register for every device, linked to the employee it is assigned to
* Support Bengaluru office equipment, including network devices, Wi-Fi, printers, and meeting room technology

**Linux System Administration**

* Perform routine Linux server administration: user accounts, permissions, service restarts, disk space, and log checks
* Apply OS updates and patches following the schedule and runbooks set by Corporate Technology
* Monitor server health alerts and escalate issues to senior team members with clear notes
* Run scheduled backup checks and report any failures

**User Support**

* Respond to and resolve support tickets for hardware, software, accounts, and access
* Support Microsoft 365 account setup, password resets, and MFA enrolment
* Escalate issues you cannot resolve to the right owner in Corporate Technology or DevOps, with the steps already taken
* Give staff practical guidance on using their devices safely

**Security & Compliance**

* Confirm endpoint protection, disk encryption, and required updates are active on every device
* Follow the access, device, and data handling policies set by Corporate Technology
* Report suspected security incidents immediately
* Support license and subscription tracking by assigning and reclaiming seats for joiners and leavers

**Documentation & Improvement**

* Keep tickets, asset records, and runbooks current
* Document recurring issues and their fixes so the team can resolve them faster next time
* Write simple scripts to automate repetitive tasks, reviewed by senior team members

**What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days:**

**30 Days In**

* Learn FIQ’s systems, tools, ticketing process, and runbooks
* Set up devices for new joiners independently
* Reconcile the India asset register against active headcount
* Build working relationships with the Corporate Technology and DevOps teams

**60 Days In**

* Resolve support tickets within agreed response and resolution times
* Handle routine Linux administration and patching independently using runbooks
* Own joiner and leaver device workflows from start to finish

**90 Days In**

* Be the go-to contact for hardware and device support in India
* Add runbook entries for the most common recurring issues
* Deliver at least one script that removes a manual step from a routine task

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Ticket response and resolution times
* New joiner devices ready on Day 1, and leaver devices recovered on time
* Asset register accuracy
* Patch compliance on assigned servers and devices
* Internal customer satisfaction

**Interview Process:**

* Screening call with our Talent Acquisition team
* A 90-minute in-person technical assessment at our Bengaluru office with the Head of Corporate Technology. The first part is scenario-based Q&A. The second part is hands-on at a computer: you will work in a Linux environment, set up a web server, and troubleshoot basic operations on that server, and you will be questioned on networking and typical hardware issues

**Why You’ll Love Working Here:**

At Fulfillment IQ, we don’t just build supply chain solutions; we build long-term careers.  
We believe in giving our people real ownership, real influence, and meaningful responsibility. Whether you’re leading a client relationship, shaping a solution, or building internal capability, your decisions have a visible impact.

We operate with a high-trust, high-standards culture that values clear thinking, collaboration, and accountability without unnecessary hierarchy or bureaucracy.

Here’s what makes Fulfillment IQ a rewarding place to work:

**Work That Matters**  
You’ll help solve real operational challenges that directly impact global commerce, customer experience, and supply chain performance.

**Career Growth That Matters**  
We invest in mentorship, leadership development, and continuous learning — supporting both vertical growth and long-term career progression.

**Flexibility to Thrive**  
We support remote and hybrid work models, flexible schedules, and trust our teams to manage their time responsibly.

**We Celebrate Impact**  
From project wins to personal milestones, we recognize contribution, celebrate progress, and value consistency over heroics.

**A Collaborative Culture**  
You’ll work alongside experienced consultants, engineers, product leaders, and commercial professionals who value ownership, transparency, and high standards.

**Perks you’ll appreciate:**

**Health and Wellness**

* Comprehensive group medical insurance for you and your family, in line with local practice
* Employee wellness programs where applicable

**Time Off**

* Competitive paid time off, sick leave, and public holidays

**Additional Perks**

* Equipment and workstation allowances, internet and business travel reimbursements, team events and offsites

**Work Authorization:**

* Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence in Hiring:**

FIQ uses artificial intelligence to assist in the screening, assessment, and shortlisting of applications for this position, including features within our applicant tracking system. AI supports human reviewers and does not make hiring decisions on its own. Final hiring decisions are made by FIQ personnel. If you have questions about how AI is used in this process, contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

**Accommodations:**

FIQ is committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Consistent with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, accommodations are available on request at any stage of recruitment and assessment. Contact hr@fulfillmentiq.com, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

**Candidate Privacy:**

Your personal information is collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with FIQ's Candidate Privacy Notice, available at here, and in accordance with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. This includes the use of AI-assisted screening described above and cross-border storage or processing that may occur in the United States. By applying, you acknowledge this notice. Questions: hr@fulfillmentiq.com.

**Equal Opportunity:**

Fulfillment IQ is a people-first company built on trust, collaboration, and ownership. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing workplace. We provide equal opportunity in line with the Constitution of India and consider all qualified applicants without regard to religion, race, caste, sex, place of birth, disability, or any other characteristic protected under applicable Indian law.

**Safe and Respectful Workplace:**

FIQ maintains a safe and respectful workplace and complies with the Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013 (POSH). We have a constituted Internal Committee to receive and address complaints, and every employee is covered by our anti-harassment policy from day one.
