title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  

* Business acumen, and the ability to communicate to executives, business domain stakeholders and technical staff.
* Strong project management, acumen and familiarity working in agile environments.
* Experience with innovation and ideation methods, such as design thinking and product management.
* Demonstrated influence, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work well with others and exhibit leadership.
* Be an excellent communicator and collaborator, engaging with multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders. Team player with collaborative and inclusive approach.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  

* 10+ years in data governance, model risk, technology risk, compliance or a related analytical role.
* Bachelors degree in field like Computer Science, Information technology, Math, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance (with focus on analysis) etc. and/or relevant proven work experience is required

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

Are you looking for a dynamic, international career where your contributions truly matter? Join Avolta and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of travel - together.

ROLE SUMMARY  
The Scraper Developer will design, develop, test, and maintain scalable web data extraction solutions for competitor  
and market intelligence. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in Python and Scrapy, along with the ability to  
select the most suitable extraction approach based on the target website. Scrapy/direct HTTP extraction should be  
used where appropriate, while Selenium or Playwright should be used for JavaScript-heavy, dynamically rendered,  
or interaction-dependent websites where HTTP-based extraction is not sufficient. The engineer will build reliable and  
maintainable scrapers, validate extracted data, troubleshoot website changes and blocking issues, and ensure output  
meets defined data quality standards.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
Web Scraping & Competitor Onboarding - 65%  

* Analyse assigned websites using Chrome DevTools (Network, Elements and Console) to determine whether data is

best extracted from HTML, XHR/Fetch requests, REST/JSON APIs, embedded JSON, or browser-rendered content.  

* Develop production-grade spiders using the Scrapy framework, including Spiders, Requests/Responses, Items,

Item Loaders, Pipelines, Middlewares and project/settings configuration.  

* Use Selenium WebDriver or Playwright for Python when required data cannot reliably be obtained through Scrapy

or direct HTTP requests.  

* Handle JavaScript-rendered content and browser interactions such as dropdowns, pop-ups, location/airport

selection, load-more buttons and infinite scrolling.  

* Implement and maintain location-specific crawls where product assortment, pricing, promotions, availability or

content varies by country, region, airport, store or selected location. Handle location selection through URLs, APIs,  
cookies, sessions or browser interactions as required.  

* Handle product variants accurately, including size, volume, pack size, colour or other product options, ensuring

relevant variants and their associated prices, availability, identifiers and attributes are extracted and mapped  
correctly.  

* Build robust XPath and CSS selectors capable of handling nested and changing HTML structures.
* Implement numbered, next-page, load-more, infinite-scroll and API/cursor-based pagination.
* Extract structured product information such as product name, brand, category, regular/promotional price, currency,

availability, product URL, image URL, SKU/product identifiers and other required attributes.  

* Work with requests/httpx and direct APIs where browser automation is unnecessary; parse nested JSON and

embedded JavaScript/JSON objects.  

* Implement request/session management including headers, cookies, retries, timeouts, redirects, throttling and proxy

configuration.  

* Develop reusable scraping components and avoid duplicated website-specific logic wherever practical.

Data Quality, Testing & Validation - 20%  

* Validate scraper output against the source website and defined data schema.
* Implement field validation, normalization and cleaning for prices, currencies, identifiers, availability and text fields.
* Handle missing fields, malformed responses, duplicate records and unexpected page structures gracefully.

**Your work profile**

  

We are seeking an experienced Unix Administrator – Senior Consultant to support, manage, and optimize enterprise Linux/Unix environments across on-premises data centers and hybrid infrastructures. This role requires strong hands-on expertise with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Ubuntu Server, Linux clustering technologies, and advanced troubleshooting skills. The Senior Consultant will provide L2/L3 technical support, drive operational excellence, ensure platform stability, and contribute to automation and modernization initiatives within the Unix/Linux tower. Key Responsibilities UNIX, Red Hat HA, SUSE HA, Red Hat Clustering, Veritas Clustering, Apache Unix/Linux Server Administration

* Perform installation, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu Server environments.

* Conduct OS patching, kernel updates, security hardening, performance tuning, and lifecycle management.

* Manage logical volumes (LVM), file systems, RAID configurations, and storage integrations. Clustering & High Availability

* Implement, configure, and support Linux clustering technologies, such as: o Red Hat Cluster Suite (Pacemaker/Corosync) o HAProxy / Keepalived o DRBD, fencing agents, failover resources

* Perform cluster validation, failover testing, quorum configuration, and cluster performance diagnostics.

* Troubleshoot cluster failures, split-brain issues, node communication problems, and HA resource constraints. Scripting, Automation & Tools

* Develop and maintain automation scripts using Shell/Bash, Python, and Ansible.

* Automate routine tasks such as patching, configuration deployment, monitoring, and health audits.

* Work with configuration management and orchestration tools (Ansible, Puppet, SaltStack preferred). Networking & Security

* Manage Linux network configurations including bonding, VLANs, routing, DNS configurations, and firewall rules (firewalld/iptables).

* Implement OS-level security best practices, SELinux policies (enforcing/permissive), and vulnerability remediation.

* Support authentication integrations with LDAP/AD/Samba/Kerberos. Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Operations

* Monitor system health, performance, logs, and hardware components using tools like Nagios, Zabbix, Prometheus, or Red Hat Insights.

* Handle L2/L3 escalations for OS performance issues, application failures, kernel panics, filesystem corruption, and networking defects.

* Provide root-cause analysis (RCA), incident resolution, and support planned maintenance activities. Documentation & Collaboration

* Maintain accurate SOPs, topology documentation, server inventories, and configuration guides.

* Collaborate with middleware, database, storage, network, and security teams for cross functional troubleshooting.

* Participate in DR drills, compliance audits, and capacity planning exercises. Required Skills

* Strong hands-on experience with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Ubuntu Server in enterprise environments.

* Expertise in Linux clustering technologies (Pacemaker/Corosync, HAProxy, Keepalived, etc.).

* Proficiency with Shell/Bash scripting, and familiarity with Ansible automation.

• Strong understanding of Linux internals: processes, memory, storage, networking, and kernel-level troubleshooting. • Experience with LVM, filesystems (ext4, XFS), permissions, SELinux, systemd, and performance analysis tools.

* Ability to troubleshoot hardware, OS, networking, and storage-related issues in a multi-tier environment.

  

**Key skills required:**

* Education : Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

* 6+ years of experience in Unix/Linux system administration.

* Hands-on experience with clustering and HA implementations in production.

* Exposure to virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper-V/KVM) and cloud basics is an advantage.

* Familiarity with ITIL practices (Incident, Change, Problem). Good to have

* Certifications such as RHCSA, RHCE, Linux Foundation Certified Engineer (LFCE), or equivalent.

* Experience with containerization (Docker/Podman) and orchestration (Kubernetes) is a plus.

* Experience in managed services or large enterprise IT operations.

We are seeking a **Senior AI Multi Agent Developer** for the MINDR Intelligence Stream project. The Intelligence Stream serves as the Decide and Act layer of MINDR. As a Senior AI Developer, you will not be designing isolated models or building data pipelines. Instead, you will own the agentic reasoning core, designing and implementing a production-grade Multi-Agent Runtime that orchestrates specialized diagnostic agents, performs automated Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and recommends human-in-the-loop (HITL) remediation actions.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Design and Develop the Multi-Agent Runtime:** Build, optimize, and maintain the deployable Python runtime hosting MINDR agents. You will handle agent lifecycle management, instantiation, state persistence, audit trail logging, and termination.
* **Orchestration and Agent Tooling:** Build and scale the Principal Agent that dynamically schedules tasks and aggregates results from downstream child agents (Performance, Topology, Alarm, Ticket, CX, and Event Scout) using Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* **Implement the RCA Inspector:** Program the reasoning engine that consumes multi-source incident context and compares it against structural playbooks (e.g., CDN traffic shift patterns) and historical incidents to produce ranked, explainable root cause hypotheses.
* **Construct Stream-to-Stream API Contracts:** Maintain tight integration and high API hygiene with neighboring streams including Data Stream (reacting to Anodot anomaly streams via Pub/Sub and consuming Silver layer telemetry), Knowledge Stream (issuing semantic queries to the Knowledge Graph for network topology context), and Experience Stream (exposing WebSocket/SSE streams of agent run lifecycle events for real-time operator dashboards).
* **Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Remediation:** Build safe, secure integrations for the Remediation Agent to interface with Tardis-fronted APIs (e.g., triggering reroutes, raising CASM tickets, or partner notifications) under strict human approval gates.

### **Your Profile**

We are seeking a **Senior AI Multi Agent Developer** with deep expertise in building production-grade multi-agent systems, advanced Python development, and cloud-based streaming architectures for the MINDR Intelligence Stream project.

#### **Must Have Skills**

* Advanced Python development with deep expertise in building scalable production-ready backend services
* Hands-on experience developing multi-agent systems
* Experience with complex prompt engineering
* Experience with tool use logic and state management using frameworks or custom runtime loops
* Proven experience designing clean contract-driven APIs (gRPC, REST, WebSockets, or SSE)

* Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ecosystem, specifically Pub/Sub, BigQuery, and Cloud Functions
* Experience with streaming architectures (Kafka, CDI)
* Strong engineering focus on explainability and auditability
* Experience ensuring all agent intermediate steps and decisions are logged and reconstructable

#### **Nice to Have Skills**

* Familiarity with Network Topology
* Familiarity with IP Core Overload Protection
* Familiarity with telecommunications protocols (VoLTE service chains)
* Experience working with time series anomaly detection engines (e.g., Anodot, Prophet)
* Graph database query experience
* Experience with semantic queries
* Experience with graph-based reasoning

title: Analog Design, Principal Engineer
description:
**Date posted** 10/15/2026

### **Category** **Engineering****Hire Type** **Employee****Job ID** **19243****Remote Eligible** **No****Date Posted** **10/15/2026**

### **We Are** Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**

You have spent over a decade designing analog circuits that have to move data at speeds most engineers never touch, and you know that the difference between a SERDES that works in simulation and one that works in silicon is a hundred small decisions about layout, process variation, and timing handoff. You are the kind of engineer who reads a SerDes standard and immediately starts sketching architectures that push beyond what the spec requires because you see where the bottleneck will be two years from now.

You do not wait for someone to tell you the PLL is the problem. You run the jitter budget, trace it back to the oscillator, and propose three solutions before the next design review. Taped-out circuits in FinFET nodes where a few femtofarads of parasitic capacitance can kill your bandwidth have taught you to work with layout engineers who understand that your redline is not optional.

Presenting simulation data to a customer review panel and explaining why your adaptive equalizer architecture will handle their worst-case channel without adding another milliwatt is something you do comfortably. Mentoring matters to you, not because it looks good on a review, but because you remember the senior engineer who taught you how to read an eye diagram and you want to be that person for someone else.

At Synopsys, you will work on Multi-Gbps SERDES IP that goes into chips that power data centers, automotive networks, and AI accelerators. The problems are hard, the process nodes are cutting-edge, and what you design will ship.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Review high-speed SerDes standards (PCIe, Ethernet, USB, CXL) and translate them into transceiver architectures and detailed sub-block specifications for Multi-Gbps NRZ and PAM4 designs
* Architect and design analog/mixed-signal circuits including TX drivers, RX front-ends, adaptive equalizers, PLLs, DLLs, bandgap references, regulators, oscillators, and ADC/DAC blocks for advanced FinFET and gate-all-around process nodes
* Collaborate with digital design teams on analog/digital co-design, calibration loops, adaptation algorithms, and timing handoff to ensure seamless integration and optimal performance
* Work directly with layout engineers to guide physical implementation, minimize parasitics, manage device stress and process variation, and ensure robust post-silicon performance
* Present simulation results, design trade-offs, and architectural decisions in internal reviews, customer meetings, and industry panel discussions
* Document design features, simulation methodologies, test plans, and characterization results, and support post-silicon bring-up and debug with electrical analysis and design iteration proposals
* Analyze customer silicon data and field performance to identify improvement opportunities and drive post-silicon design updates for next-generation IP releases

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Define the architectural direction for Synopsys SERDES IP, influencing product roadmaps and enabling next-generation connectivity standards across automotive, data center, and AI markets
* Deliver power, performance, and area improvements that directly affect the competitiveness of Synopsys IP in advanced process nodes and high-speed communication applications
* Solve post-silicon challenges that unblock customer tape-outs and ensure successful deployment of Synopsys IP in high-volume production chips
* Mentor analog designers across the team, raising the technical bar for circuit design, simulation methodology, and design-for-reliability practices
* Strengthen Synopsys leadership in Multi-Gbps SERDES by contributing to industry standards bodies, customer engagements, and technical publications
* Enable faster time-to-market for customers by streamlining design and verification flows and reducing silicon respins through robust pre-silicon validation
* Shape the future of high-speed analog design at Synopsys by driving innovation in adaptive equalization, low-power PLLs, and signal integrity for next-generation process technologies

### **What You'll Need**

* MTech/MS with 8+ years or BTech/BS with 10+ years of hands-on analog IC design experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* Proven track record of CMOS tape-outs in FinFET technologies with demonstrable experience in Multi-Gbps high-speed designs using NRZ and PAM4 modulation
* Deep expertise in SERDES sub-circuit design including TX drivers, RX front-ends, adaptive equalizers, PLLs, DLLs, bandgap references, regulators, oscillators, and data converters
* Strong understanding of analog/digital co-design, calibration and adaptation algorithms, and timing handoff between analog and digital domains
* Proficiency with schematic entry, physical layout collaboration, design verification tools, and SPICE simulators (Spectre, HSPICE, or similar)
* Experience with scripting languages such as TCL, PERL, or MATLAB for post-processing simulation data and automating design tasks
* Solid grounding in system-level budgeting for jitter, amplitude, and noise, and familiarity with signal integrity challenges including packaging parasitics, crosstalk, and channel loss. Experience with ESD protection, custom digital design, and design-for-reliability considerations (electromigration, IR drop, aging, self-heating) is a plus. Prior experience with high-speed interleaved SAR ADCs is a strong plus.

### **Who You Are**

* You can walk into a design review, look at a jitter waterfall plot, and pinpoint the architectural bottleneck in under five minutes without needing a slide deck
* You push back when a specification does not make sense or when a layout decision will compromise performance, and you do it with data and a proposed alternative
* You are the engineer others come to when a circuit is not behaving and simulation does not match silicon, because you know how to debug across domains and find the real root cause
* You write clear, thorough documentation because you know that six months from now, someone else will need to understand your design choices and you want them to succeed
* You stay current with emerging process technologies, circuit techniques, and industry standards because you know that what works in 7nm will not necessarily work in 3nm
* You value collaboration and knowledge-sharing, and you take the time to explain a complex trade-off to a junior engineer or a non-technical stakeholder without losing the nuance

**Job Description**

You will define and implement the end-to-end security architecture for Databricks on a major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This is a hands-on role responsible for the access, governance, and data-protection model across the platform. You have designed and implemented enterprise security controls for Databricks environments, and you will act as a cross-account authority on security guardrails, access governance, and compliance.

What You Will Do

**Own end-to-end security architecture.** Define and implement the security architecture for Databricks across the platform, from identity through data protection.

**Manage identity and access.** Own SSO/MFA integration and RBAC/ABAC access models, and establish access governance processes across accounts and workspaces.

**Secure Unity Catalog.** Design and enforce Unity Catalog security, data classification, and fine-grained access controls (row, column, and attribute level).

**Secure Delta Sharing and open sharing.** Ensure only approved data is exposed across cross-account and open sharing, with reliable, measurable revocation.

**Design least privilege and blast-radius containment.** Establish the lowest practical access boundary, preventing access to adjacent business-unit data and storage.

**Control privileged access and configuration drift.** Govern privileged elevation and break-glass access, and detect unauthorized changes with monitored alert latency and remediation.

**Protect data and secrets.** Establish controls for encryption, secrets management, and network security aligned to relevant regulatory compliance requirements.

**Build guardrails and auditability.** Set up security guardrails, auditability, and access governance so the platform stays compliant and controllable as it scales.

**Provide cross-account technical leadership.** Act as a go-to security reviewer across multiple accounts, contributing to design reviews and resolving access and governance issues that individual delivery teams cannot.

What You Bring (Required)

Hands-on experience designing and implementing security for enterprise Databricks environments.

Deep Unity Catalog security experience: RBAC/ABAC, fine-grained (row/column/attribute) access, data classification, and Delta Sharing / open sharing controls.

Least-privilege and blast-radius design across business units, containing access to adjacent data and storage.

Privileged access management experience: controlled elevation, break-glass, configuration-drift detection, and remediation.

Strong identity and access management background: SSO/MFA integration and access governance.

Expertise in encryption, secrets management, and network security on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements relevant to data platforms.

Ability to design and run proof-of-control tests and quantify outcomes (e.g., revocation time, data exposure, drift-detection and alert latency), not just implement.

Databricks Cloud Platform Architect accreditation (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or Databricks Platform Administrator.

Recognized cloud security certification (e.g., AWS or Azure security specialty, or CISSP). Note that Databricks has no standalone security certification, so security credentials come from the cloud provider or an industry body.

Multi-cloud experience across two or more of AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Regulated-industry experience (financial services, healthcare, or similar).

What This Role Is Not

This is a Databricks-native security and access architect role. It is not a general enterprise or datacenter security role. The right candidate has genuinely designed and implemented access, governance, and data-protection controls inside Databricks environments, distinct from a generalist security engineer without hands-on Databricks depth.

title: L2 Managed Service Engineer
description:
Role Summary

The Level 2 Managed Service Engineer for the End-to-End Observability team is responsible for advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, Datadog configuration, incident escalation, and continual service improvement across the observability stack. This role serves as the primary escalation point for L1 engineers and is expected to independently resolve, or drive resolution of, moderately complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, APM, Synthetics, logs, and RUM data across both 3-tier and cloud-native environments.

Key Responsibilities

· Act as the first escalation point for incidents triaged by L1 engineers that require deeper investigation.

· Perform root cause analysis (RCA) by correlating APM traces, infrastructure metrics, network telemetry, logs, Synthetics results, and RUM data.

· Configure and fine-tune advanced Datadog capabilities: custom metrics, log pipelines, monitors with composite/anomaly detection, SLOs, and dashboards aligned to service ownership.

· Guide and review Datadog APM instrumentation coverage across services; identify monitoring gaps and recommend improvements.

· Independently identify whether an issue originates in the application tier, infrastructure, network, or a third-party dependency, in both 3-tier and cloud-native (microservices/containerized) environments.

· Lead or actively participate in major incident bridge calls, providing observability data to speed up resolution.

· Own problem management: identify recurring incidents, drive permanent fixes, and track them to closure.

· Mentor and coach L1 engineers on triage techniques, Datadog usage, and escalation quality.

· Contribute to automation of routine monitoring tasks (alert enrichment, auto-remediation triggers, ticket auto-creation).

· Support capacity and performance trend analysis using historical Datadog data.

· Review and refine monitors to reduce noise and false positives (alert tuning).

· Ensure adherence to SLAs/OLAs and maintain quality of incident documentation and RCA reports.

· Participate in client/stakeholder calls to explain incidents, trends, and improvement plans.

Required Skills and Experience

Observability Platform Skills

· 3 to 6 years of experience in Managed Services, NOC, SRE, or application/infrastructure support roles, with at least 1-2 years working hands-on with Datadog.

· Strong working knowledge of Datadog across monitoring, dashboards, alerting, APM, Synthetics, RUM, logs, metrics, SLOs, and service-level troubleshooting.

· Advanced monitor configuration (anomaly detection, forecast, composite monitors, SLOs).

· APM: distributed tracing, service maps, trace analytics, and identifying instrumentation gaps.

· Synthetics: designing multi-step API and browser tests, analyzing failure trends.

· RUM: correlating front-end performance and errors with backend traces.

· Log Management: building log pipelines, parsing rules, and log-based metrics.

· Solid understanding of infrastructure concepts: compute, storage, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes basics), and cloud resource scaling.

· Solid understanding of networking fundamentals: DNS, load balancing, latency/packet loss analysis, firewall and connectivity troubleshooting.

· Strong analytical ability to read application logs, stack traces, and error patterns to isolate the failing component, without needing to be an expert in the underlying code.

· Experience with ITSM tools for incident, problem, and change management.

· Working knowledge of ITIL processes, especially incident and problem management.

Application and Architecture Understanding

· Solid understanding of 3-tier application architecture and how load, latency, or failure at one tier cascades to others.

· Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture: microservices, containers, API gateways, service meshes, and inter-service communication patterns.

· Ability to correlate application-level symptoms (errors, latency, timeouts) with underlying infrastructure or network causes using observability data alone.

· Understanding of common resiliency patterns (retries, circuit breakers, caching, load balancing) and how their failure shows up in monitoring data.

Good to Have

· Datadog certification (APM, Infrastructure, or Log Management specialization).

· Scripting experience (Python, Shell, PowerShell) for automation and custom integrations.

· Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) for managing Datadog configuration as code.

· Experience with CI/CD pipelines and how deployments correlate with monitoring anomalies.

· Exposure to other observability or APM tools (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus).

Soft Skills

· Strong ownership and accountability for incident resolution.

· Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to both technical teams and stakeholders.

· Mentoring ability and patience when guiding L1 engineers.

· Comfortable leading discussions during high-pressure major incidents.

· Structured approach to documentation and knowledge sharing.

Education

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Work Details

· **Level:** L2 (Mid-level, Managed Services)

· **Shift:** 24x7 rotational shifts, with on-call/escalation coverage as needed

· **Reporting To:** L3 Engineer / Observability Team Lead

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Assoc. Dir. DDIT ISC CSOC Engineering - Cloud
description:
### **Summary**

We are seeking a hands-on Cloud Detection Engineer to help shape the future of cloud security monitoring at Novartis. You will design, build, validate and continuously improve detection capabilities across Azure, AWS and other strategic cloud platforms while being a key partner with incident response and cloud security architect teams. An engineering role that combines cloud telemetry, custom detections, threat research, automation and AI-assisted investigation to create high-signal, scalable outcomes for Cyber Defense.
  
  
Role purpose:
  
  
Build a robust, AI-native cloud detection pipeline that improves correlation and investigation efficiency across multi-cloud environments. Engineer fragmented cloud telemetry into clear, actionable security outcomes with AI embedded throughout the detection engineering lifecycle. A multidimensional engineering role at the intersection of automation, cloud architecture, threat behavior analysis, detection engineering supporting analyst investigation workflows.

### **About the Role**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and operate an AI-native cloud detection pipeline that aggregates, correlates, enriches, deduplicates and prioritizes signals before analyst investigation
* Build and tune high-fidelity detections that improve coverage across cloud control-plane, data plane and management-plane activity, identity and access, network, container and Kubernetes and security posture.
* Use lower-fidelity and behavioral signals as investigation context, while ensuring known high-confidence detections are consistently escalated for security investigation
* Integrate and correlate telemetry from WIZ, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, AWS GuardDuty, Microsoft Sentinel and other cloud-native or CNAPP sources . Apply hands-on Wiz experience to interpret posture findings, attack paths, identity and exposure context, cloud events, runtime findings and threat detections and improve detection workflows
* Develop behavioral baselines and entity-centric analytics across users, IP addresses, identities and cloud resources . Create reusable dashboards, dynamic lookups and enrichment patterns enabling rapid pivots / drilldowns from an alert to related resource, identity, inventory and historical data
* Own the detection lifecycle from threat hypothesis and telemetry assessment through development, peer review, testing, deployment, tuning, documentation and retirement
* Embed AI across the detection lifecycle to accelerate detection creation and tuning, while ensuring engineering controls and human judgment govern the outcomes
* Finetune detections using historical data, controlled simulations, purple-team exercises, attack emulation and lessons learned from incidents and threat hunts
* Use detection-as-code practices, Git, CI/CD and automated testing to deliver controlled, repeatable and auditable content changes . Partner with Threat Hunting and Response, CSOC analysts, cloud platform teams, data onboarding, threat intelligence and automation teams to close visibility gaps and operationalize detections
Automate enrichment and triage using Python, APIs, SOAR workflows and AI-assisted approaches, with appropriate human oversight for security decisions . Measure and improve detection coverage, precision, false-positive rate, investigation volume, alert latency, data quality and analyst effort  

**Required Qualifications**

  
  

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in cloud security, detection engineering, security analytics, threat hunting, incident response or security platform engineering
* Working knowledge of Azure and AWS security architectures, respective cloud domains and workloads
* Understanding of cloud telemetry and logging sources such as Azure Activity and Diagnostic logs, Entra ID logs, AWS CloudTrail, AWS CloudWatch and GuardDuty findings
* Experience in working with CNAPP bundles or developing and tuning detections in Wiz, Vega or cloud-native security platforms

title: Software Development Manager , Amazon Supply Chain Services
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Merchants should be able to use Amazon’s fulfillment capabilities wherever they sell. Making that possible requires software that connects sales channels with fulfillment services, simplifies complex supply chain workflows, and gives merchants visibility into what happens after an order is placed.  
Amazon’s Multi-Channel Commerce and Fulfillment team is looking for a Software Development Manager in Hyderabad to lead an engineering team building these capabilities. Our work helps merchants access Amazon’s supply chain services beyond the Amazon marketplace and manage their businesses through connected, intuitive experiences.  
In this role, you will own the technical direction and delivery of a  
product and services portfolio, from merchant-facing workflows to the distributed systems behind them. You will partner with product managers and engineering teams across Amazon to translate customer problems into a focused roadmap, make architectural decisions, and deliver reliable software. The technical challenges include coordinating workflows across independently owned services, maintaining consistent order and shipment state, and making complex integrations easier for merchants to use.  
We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can develop engineers, bring clarity to ambiguous problems, and balance delivery speed with long-term system health. You will have end-to-end accountability for your team’s software and its customer outcomes, including architecture, execution and production operations.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Set technical direction: Own your team’s architecture and engineering roadmap, making explicit tradeoffs across customer value, reliability, delivery timelines and operational cost.  
Deliver customer outcomes: Partner with product and program leaders to turn merchant needs into well-scoped initiatives with measurable success criteria.  
Build dependable systems: Lead the design and delivery of distributed services and customer experiences that integrate with Amazon’s fulfillment and supply chain platforms.  
Develop the team: Hire and coach engineers, provide actionable feedback, and create opportunities for technical growth and increasing ownership.  
Own operational performance: Establish metrics for service health and customer experience, strengthen testing and observability, and address recurring defects at their source.  
Lead across team boundaries: Align partner teams on interfaces and dependencies, resolve technical disagreements, and communicate decisions and risks clearly to leadership.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 7+ years of engineering experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled
**Senior Network Security Engineer**
with strong expertise in
**Fortinet Security Solutions**
to join our growing Cyber Security team.

**FortiGate Firewalls, SD-WAN, VPN Technologies, and Security Operations**

* Deploy, configure, and manage FortiGate Firewalls across enterprise environments.

* Configure and manage Security Policies, NAT, IPS, Application Control, Web Filtering, and Threat Protection services.

* Configure and support High Availability (HA) and clustering solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex network and security issues and perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA).

SD-WAN & VPN Management

* Design, implement, and manage Fortinet SD-WAN solutions.
* Configure and troubleshoot IPsec VPN, SSL VPN, and ADVPN deployments.
* Optimize WAN connectivity, application performance, and traffic steering policies.
* Implement secure remote access solutions and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) frameworks.

Network Security Operations

* Monitor security events, alerts, and network performance metrics.
* Perform incident response, threat investigation, and security troubleshooting activities.
* Ensure compliance with security best practices, policies, and organizational standards.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams to maintain a secure and resilient environment.

Routing & Switching

* Configure and troubleshoot dynamic routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
* Support enterprise LAN/WAN environments and network segmentation initiatives.
* Maintain and update technical documentation including HLDs, LLDs, SOPs, and operational procedures.

Documentation & Governance

* Prepare implementation plans, technical documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Maintain asset inventory, configuration records, and change management documentation.
* Support internal and external audits and compliance initiatives.

* 6–10 years of experience in Network Security Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with FortiGate Firewalls.
* Expertise in FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer administration.
* Hands-on experience with Fortinet SD-WAN deployments and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of VPN technologies including IPsec VPN, SSL VPN, and ADVPN.
* Experience with High Availability (HA) and clustering solutions.
* Knowledge of routing protocols including BGP and OSPF.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Preferred Technical Skills

* Experience with FortiAuthenticator, FortiSwitch, and Fortinet Security Fabric solutions.
* Exposure to Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco ASA/FTD, or other enterprise security platforms.
* Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud security technologies.
* Familiarity with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), SASE, and cloud security architectures.
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale security environments.

Mandatory Certification

* **Fortinet NSE 5,6 & 7 / FCSS – Network Security**

title: Data Center Technician
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Experience with Linux Administration.
* Experience with network infrastructure.
* Experience in hardware and operating systems.

Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You install, configure, test and troubleshoot hardware (servers and components) and server software. You also manually move and install racks and servers.
  
  
The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

description:
**About Millennium**
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.
  
  
Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.
  
  
**Meet the Team**
Core to the health and growth of our business, Millennium’s Information Technology organization supports a flexible, scalable technology environment and advanced proprietary systems across the firm. Within that organization, the global Network & Datacentre team manages critical datacentre and office technology infrastructure that underpins regional growth, operational resilience, and connectivity across Millennium’s platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the day-to-day physical operation of Millennium’s India datacentre facility and associated office technology rooms, including power, cooling, space, cabling, and security.
* Perform hands-on datacentre work including racking and stacking, structured copper and fibre cabling, labelling, patching, and maintaining strong cable hygiene standards.
* Manage hardware lifecycle activities across servers, storage, and network equipment, including installations, upgrades, moves, adds, changes, and decommissioning.
* Coordinate and execute hardware replacements and RMAs with local and international vendors, while helping maintain service continuity.
* Monitor infrastructure and environmental alerts, respond to incidents, perform first-line troubleshooting, and support a 24x7 operating environment through maintenance windows and extended-hours work as needed.
* Work within established ITIL and ITSM processes for incidents, requests, and changes, while maintaining accurate asset, location, and connectivity records in platforms including ServiceNow and Nlyte.
* Support network device deployment and basic configuration under the direction of Network Engineering, including physical connectivity, VLAN validation, link checks, and basic Layer 2 and Layer 3 troubleshooting.
* Contribute to tooling, automation, and integration efforts across DCIM, monitoring, logging, CMDB, and capacity platforms, while improving runbooks, SOPs, and recurring operational processes.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in a datacentre or large-scale infrastructure environment, ideally within financial services or another mission-critical setting.
* Proven hands-on experience managing racks, cabling, hardware installations, and decommissioning across multi-cabinet environments.
* Experience supporting office technology rooms or comms rooms, including IDF and MDF environments, in addition to core datacentres.
* Strong working knowledge of datacentre power and cooling concepts, including PDUs, UPS, dual feeds, capacity management, and hot aisle or cold aisle design.
* Solid CCNA-level networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, VLANs, trunking, subnetting, basic routing, and access control concepts, with the ability to perform CLI-based troubleshooting on enterprise network devices.
* Experience working with remote management and operational tooling, including technologies such as IPMI, iDRAC, iLO, console servers, ServiceNow, Jira, and DCIM or CMDB platforms.
* Basic scripting capability in Python, PowerShell, or Bash to support task automation, reporting, and data handling.
* Strong documentation, communication, and coordination skills, with a high level of ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively with local facilities teams, vendors, and global stakeholders across time zones.

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Vendor Personnel
description:
**Job Description**
**Shift – 24\*7 (Rotational)**
**Critical Infrastructure Engineer – Reliability & Infrastructure Analytics – For backlog and proactive gap fixing (L2/L3)**
**Role Purpose**
The Critical Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing and improving the reliability of critical infrastructure supporting telecom and data centre operations. The role focuses on ensuring high availability of power, cooling and environmental systems while proactively identifying infrastructure risks, recurring alarms and opportunities for permanent corrective action. The engineer is expected to move beyond reactive incident handling by driving backlog reduction, equipment refresh planning and long-term infrastructure reliability improvements. This aligns with the current CI direction of moving from repeat break-fix to asset-led preventive management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage a team of Critical Infrastructure Engineers/Technicians, ensuring effective shift coverage, operational governance, coaching, workload balancing and adherence to operational standards.
* Analyze infrastructure trends and proactively identify recurring alarms, noisy sites, aging infrastructure and operational gaps impacting service reliability.
* Drive Top Talker analysis, identify recurring failure patterns and develop permanent corrective action plans to eliminate repeat alarms and unnecessary dispatches.
* Review historical incidents, alarm trends and backlog tickets to identify systemic issues and recommend engineering improvements.
* Prepare and present analytical reports, dashboards and executive summaries highlighting recurring issues, infrastructure risks, equipment performance and operational improvements.
* Identify End-of-Life (EOL) / End-of-Support (EOS) equipment, evaluate operational risk and prepare structured equipment refresh and replacement plans for management review.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Vendors and Field teams to drive permanent remediation, equipment replacement and closure of long-pending infrastructure issues.
* Maintain ownership of backlog reduction initiatives and ensure ageing tickets are continuously reviewed, tracked and driven to closure.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities for automation, operational efficiencies and proactive monitoring enhancements. This aligns with the CI objective of moving from repeat break-fix to asset-led preventive management.

**Additional Required Skills**

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret operational data, identify trends and convert findings into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to identify recurring alarms, noisy sites and infrastructure risks using data analysis and operational reporting.
* Strong leadership and people-management skills with experience managing technical teams, conducting coaching sessions and driving operational governance.
* Excellent documentation skills with the ability to create and maintain detailed operational records, RCA reports, equipment history, maintenance documentation and knowledge articles that can be used for future troubleshooting, audits and continuous improvement.
* Ability to prepare executive-level reports and present infrastructure risks, backlog analysis, EOL/EOS recommendations and permanent-fix roadmaps to management.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills with the ability to coordinate effectively across Operations, Engineering, Vendors, OEMs and Field teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Must have prior experience leading technical teams in a Telecom, Data Center or Critical Infrastructure environment.
* Experience preparing SOPs, MOPs, RCA documentation, equipment history records, maintenance logs and audit documentation.
* Experience working with BMS/DCIM/EMS platforms and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Exposure to asset lifecycle management, equipment refresh programs and preventive maintenance planning.
* Experience analyzing recurring infrastructure incidents and implementing permanent corrective actions.

**Key Deliverables**

* Reduction in recurring alarms and noisy sites through permanent corrective actions.
* Proactive identification and reporting of infrastructure risks, ageing assets and EOL/EOS equipment.
* Improved infrastructure reliability through analytical trend monitoring and preventive maintenance.
* Reduction in backlog and ageing infrastructure tickets.
* Comprehensive documentation and knowledge repositories that improve future troubleshooting, onboarding and operational continuity.
* Strong team performance, governance and continuous coaching to improve operational maturity.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.

We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.

Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.

As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.

**What the team owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform

* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models

Your Key Responsibilities:

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.

* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.
* Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities.

Required

* Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, or developer productivity initiatives.

title: WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager
description:
WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager

**We offer:**
=============

The WAN & Network Service Delivery Manager combines two equally important responsibilities within KION's Enterprise Network service. Approximately 50% of the role governs the global WAN managed service, and approximately 50% coordinates service delivery and BAU operations across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI.

For WAN governance, the role monitors supplier delivery, contractual performance, service levels, lifecycle, risks, costs and improvement actions. The role prepares analysis, forecasts, recommendations and decision proposals for the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Budget accountability, cost-centre responsibility, contract ownership and final commercial decisions remain with the Enterprise Network Service Owner. Day-to-day operational coordination with the WAN managed service provider is performed by a designated WAN Operations Coordinator under the functional guidance of this role; overall WAN governance responsibility remains with this position.

For network service delivery, the role coordinates the shared operating model, queues, incidents, service requests, changes, problems, operational readiness and performance reporting. The role has no disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility for network engineers. Engineering capacity and line management remain with the responsible managers, while this role provides process coordination, prioritisation transparency and cross-domain escalation.

The role works closely with the Enterprise Network Service Owner, Lead Network Architect, network engineers, IT Service Management, regional IT teams, Procurement, Finance and external network providers.

**Tasks and Qualifications:**
=============================

  

**1. WAN governance, roadmap and lifecycle - 15%**

* Prepare and maintain the proposed WAN service roadmap in alignment with the Enterprise Network Service Owner and Lead Network Architect.

* Identify lifecycle, resilience, capacity, sourcing and technical-debt risks and prepare recommendations for accountable decision makers.

* Track approved governance decisions and improvement actions to completion.

**2. WAN supplier and contractual-performance governance - 15%**

* Act as the primary operational governance interface for the WAN managed service provider, carriers and access providers.

* Monitor SLAs, KPIs, contractual obligations, potential service credits, risks and supplier commitments.

* Prepare evidence and recommendations for contract, renewal and commercial decisions owned by the Enterprise Network Service Owner.

* Lead supplier service reviews and escalate recurring underperformance, weak corrective actions and unresolved risks.

**3. WAN cost transparency, demand and transition assurance - 10%**

* Prepare cost, consumption and forecast transparency for review and approval by the Enterprise Network Service Owner; the role has no budget or cost-centre accountability.

* Assess the WAN service, supplier, commercial and operational implications of approved demands.

* Coordinate provider estimates, service acceptance and transition requirements with the demand owner, Lead Network Architect and Enterprise Network Service Owner.

* Ensure operational acceptance covers documentation, monitoring, testing, support routes, supplier acceptance and handover.

**4. WAN performance, data and continual improvement - 10%**

* Maintain WAN scorecards covering availability, incidents, capacity, resilience, change quality, supplier performance and cost transparency.

* Coordinate supplier follow-up after significant interruptions, including RCA quality and preventive actions.

* Maintain accurate governance artefacts and promote consistent data across ITSM, CMDB, monitoring, inventory and source-of-truth capabilities.

* Identify opportunities for automation, observability, data-quality improvement and reduced manual coordination.

**5. Enterprise Network operations coordination - 20%**

* Coordinate the BAU operating model across Campus LAN, Wi-Fi, WAN and DDI without assuming disciplinary or matrix people-management responsibility.

* Run queue reviews, service-health reviews and handover checkpoints; make ageing, blocked work and coverage gaps transparent.

* Coordinate operational priorities with line managers and engineering leads and escalate unresolved capacity conflicts to the Service Owner.

* Provide functional guidance to the designated WAN Operations Coordinator responsible for daily KION-provider coordination.

**6. Incident and service-request coordination - 15%**

* Coordinate triage, ownership, progression and documentation for incidents and service requests in the shared Enterprise Network queue.

* Coordinate cross-domain and high-priority incidents, bringing together network, security, application, infrastructure and supplier teams.

* Ensure clear ownership, timely escalation, stakeholder communication and disciplined technical handovers; specialist teams retain technical resolution responsibility.

* Monitor ticket ageing, reassignments and documentation quality and drive corrective action where required.

**7. Change, problem and operational-readiness governance - 10%**

* Coordinate operational risk reviews for significant or high-risk network changes, including production dependencies and rollback readiness.

* Drive follow-up of recurring problems, RCAs, known errors and preventive actions.

* Confirm that new or changed services enter BAU with monitoring, documentation, runbooks, support ownership, access and escalation routes in place.

**8. Operational performance and service improvement - 5%**

* Report queue health, response and restoration performance, recurring incidents, backlog, monitoring coverage and handover quality.

* Maintain and improve SOPs, runbooks, escalation contacts, service maps and operational knowledge.

Use operational trends to recommend improvements to resilience, automation, standards and training  

  

Interfaces

Internal:

* Secure Connectivity platform leadership, functional and team leads, and rotating operations engineers

* Enterprise and Network architecture; Cybersecurity and Information Security

* IT Service Management, e.g. Service Desk, (Major) Incident, Problem and Change

* Procurement, Legal, Finance/Controlling and Vendor Management

* Regional and onsite IT, business partners, programme and project managers

* Cloud, datacentre, workplace, decentralised infrastructure and application teams

External:

* Telecommunications carriers and local access providers

* Managed network and security service providers

* Network technology vendors, integrators and professional-services partners

* Auditors and specialist advisers where required

Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realise their greatest potential.  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  
  
Overview  
The Mastercard Payment Networks team is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead high-performing teams building scalable and reliable backend systems.  
As an Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for driving technical delivery, ensuring engineering excellence, and building strong teams delivering complex distributed systems. This role requires a balance of technical depth, ownership, and strong execution focus.  
You will lead teams working on systems that handle high-volume transaction data, provide secure and efficient access to backend services, and operate at global scale.  

* Are you passionate about low latency, high volume, and highly available (5 9s) systems?

* Ensure systems are designed for high throughput, data processing, and reliable data access

Delivery Ownership & Execution  

* Own end-to-end delivery from planning through production deployment
* Ensure strong engineering readiness (requirements, design, dependencies)
* Drive predictable execution with clear milestones and timelines
* Proactively manage risks, blockers, and cross-team dependencies

  
Operational Excellence  

* Ensure systems meet expectations for reliability, scalability, and performance
* Drive adoption of monitoring, observability, and incident management practices
* Support teams in resolving production issues and improving system stability
* Continuously improve engineering processes, tools, and quality standards

  
People Leadership & Team Development  

* Build, mentor, and retain high-performing engineering teams
* Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Provide coaching, feedback, and career development support
* Hire and grow strong engineering talent

  
Required Skills & Qualifications  

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering with leadership experience

* Hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, and REST-based services
* Experience in microservices and event-driven architectures

description:
**About Dataction:**

Dataction is a new age services firm that offers best in class information technology, analytics, and consulting services to renowned international companies.
