Our engagement models provide the perfect blend of quality, control, and cost for our customers.

To know more about Dataction, please visit https://dataction.co

**Job Purpose:**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Citrix XenServer & VDI Engineer to build the target Citrix XenServer platform and migrate our client's VDI estate off VMware safely and on schedule. The client's VMware licences expire in November 2026, so this is a time-critical, hands-on delivery role. The successful candidate will act as the senior technical authority for the VDI migration across 10 HPE ProLiant hosts: ~400 VDI desktops moving from VMware vSphere 8.0 to Citrix XenServer. He/She will plan and run a rolling host-by-host migration, protect the end-user experience throughout, work closely with the client's Citrix team and the Hyper-V workstream, and leave behind documentation the client's operations team can run with.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Citrix XenServer Platform Build & Management**
  + Build and configure Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor hosts and resource pools on HPE ProLiant hardware (10 hosts), including iLO, firmware/SPP, and hardware compatibility compliance.
  + Configure storage repositories (iSCSI/FC/NFS with multipathing), NIC bonding, networks/VLANs, and pool HA to match the existing VMware design.
  + Manage the estate via XenCenter and the xe CLI, including pool master design, Active Directory integration, role-based access, and host update/hotfix lifecycle.
  + Size and tune pool capacity (CPU, memory, storage IOPS, read caching) for ~400 concurrent desktops.
  + Integrate the new hosts with Active Directory, DNS, monitoring, and patching tooling.
* **Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops Integration**
  + Work with the client's Citrix team to create hosting connections and resources from the Delivery Controllers to the new XenServer pools.
  + Prepare and optimise golden images for XenServer (XenServer VM Tools, Citrix VDA, Citrix Optimizer) and rebuild machine catalogs using MCS/PVS.
  + Validate machine catalog and delivery group configuration, power management, and provisioning behaviour after each stage.
  + Validate VDI performance, user logon experience, profile management (FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management), and capacity after each stage of the migration.
* **VDI Migration Planning & Execution (VMware Exit)**
  + Assess the VMware vSphere 8.0 VDI estate (hosts, catalogs, golden images, persistent vs non-persistent desktops, networks, datastores) and produce the migration plan and schedule against the 11 November 2026 deadline.
  + Run a rolling migration: evacuate a host, rebuild it as XenServer, move desktop capacity in phases by delivery group/user population, and repeat, avoiding disruption to users.
  + Rebuild non-persistent catalogs from new XenServer golden images and convert persistent desktops using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or other V2V tooling, including VMware Tools removal and XenServer VM Tools installation.
  + Define pilot, UAT, validation, and rollback procedures for each stage, and coordinate change windows, out-of-hours activity, and user communications with the client.
  + Decommission VMware hosts once desktops are verified and signed off.
* **Security, Automation & Handover**
  + Apply security hardening to XenServer hosts and golden images aligned to CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Security Baselines, and vendor guidance.
  + Establish patching and lifecycle processes for XenServer hosts, VDAs, and golden images.
  + Automate repetitive build, image, and migration tasks using PowerShell (Citrix PowerShell SDK, XenServer SDK) and the xe CLI.
  + Produce build documentation, runbooks, and operational handover for the client's infrastructure and Citrix teams, and brief them on day-to-day management.
  + Coordinate with the Hyper-V server workstream on shared hardware, networks, storage, and the overall migration schedule.

**Qualification, Skills and Experience:**

* **10+ years** of relevant experience in virtualisation and end-user computing / VDI infrastructure, with deep hands-on expertise in Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor.
* **Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science**, Information Technology or Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor, including host builds, resource pools, storage repositories, multipathing, NIC bonding, pool HA, XenCenter, and the xe CLI.
* Strong experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, including Delivery Controllers, hosting connections, machine catalogs, delivery groups, and MCS/PVS.
* Proven experience running VDI at scale (400+ desktops), including golden image build, optimisation, and VDA lifecycle management.
* Proven experience migrating VDI workloads between hypervisors with minimal user disruption, using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or image-rebuild approaches.
* Good understanding of VMware vSphere/ESXi 7.x/8.x, including vCenter, VMware Tools removal, and host decommissioning.
* Hands-on experience with HPE ProLiant servers, including iLO, firmware/SPP compliance, and Smart Array configuration.
* Good understanding of storage and SAN technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, and multipathing, and storage performance/IOPS sizing for VDI.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, LACP/NIC bonding, switching, firewalls, and Citrix HDX/ICA traffic.
* Strong experience with Windows 10/11 desktop and Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy management.
* Experience with user profile management (FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management) and VDI performance and logon troubleshooting using Citrix Director or similar tools.
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting (including the Citrix PowerShell SDK) for automation, administration, and migration tasks.
* Experience implementing security baselines and hardening standards for hosts and golden images, and managing patching across hypervisors and desktops.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across XenServer, Citrix, Windows, networking, storage, and other infrastructure layers.
* Experience producing migration runbooks, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and working within change management processes.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical solutions, operational procedures, and handover material.
* Exposure to Microsoft Hyper-V or Citrix DaaS / Citrix Cloud is desirable.
* Prior VMware exit / hypervisor replatforming project experience is desirable.
* Relevant certifications are desirable: Citrix (CCA-V / CCP-V) or VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV).

**Why should you join Dataction?**

Fairness, meritocracy, empowerment, and opportunity are pillars of our work culture. In addition to a competitive salary, you can look forward to:

* Great work-life balance through hybrid work arrangement.
* Company funded skill enhancement and training.
* Exciting reward and recognition programme.
* Opportunity to bond with colleagues through exciting employee engagement initiatives.
* Great on the job learning opportunity through involvement in new product/ ideation teams.

**What experience you need**

* 8+ years of professional experience, with at least 4+ years as a Platform/Technical Product Manager operating within a global cross-functional setup.

**What could set you apart**

* Exceptional stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to influence global engineering leaders and corporate executives to prioritize regional initiatives without having direct reporting authority over them.
* Ability to articulate complex, localized Indian financial market nuances (e.g., the Account Aggregator network, UPI volumes, localized bureau data formatting) into generalized technical concepts that global teams can easily grasp.
* Experience working with Scaled Agile Frameworks (SAFe) or managing complex dependencies across multiple global Jira backlogs and CI/CD deployment release cycles.
* Clear understanding of Indian data residency, localization mandates, and data privacy principles governed by the DPDP Act.

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
The
**Lead Forward Deployed Engineer**
operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Onboarding & Data Integration
  
  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end-to-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.
* Pipeline & API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e.g., S3-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC).
* Data Modeling & Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.
* Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.

Data Quality & Validation
  
  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.

Dashboards, Remediation & Workflows
  
  

* Analytics & Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.

Product & Engineering Feedback Loop
  
  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action.

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain & Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

description:
**Company Description**
At the Syngenta Group, our 56,000 people across more than 90 countries strive every day to transform agriculture through tailor-made solutions for the benefit of farmers, society and our planet – making us the world's most local agricultural technology and innovation partner.
  
  
Website address - https://www.syngentagroup.com/

**Job Description**
The Zscaler Technical Engineer will be responsible for the administration, and support of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platforms. The role focuses on securing internet and private application access for users through Zero Trust architecture, ensuring high availability, security compliance, and optimal performance.
  
  
**Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA)**

* Manage ZIA security policies including URL filtering, SSL inspection, sandboxing, firewall policies, and data loss prevention (DLP).
* Manage and troubleshoot Zscaler Client Connector for endpoint traffic forwarding.
* Integrate ZIA with identity providers (Azure AD, Okta, etc.) for user authentication and policy enforcement.
* Implement and manage PAC files, GRE/IPsec tunnels, and proxy configurations.
* Monitor internet traffic using ZIA dashboards, logs, and analytics.
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues related to DNS, proxy, SSL inspection, and application access.

**Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)**

* Manage and administrate Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) using ZPA.
* Manage App Connectors, Service Edges, and Application Segments.
* Define access policies based on user identity, device posture, and application context.
* Integrate ZPA with Identity Providers (SSO) and endpoint posture solutions.
* Manage private application onboarding and segmentation.
* Troubleshoot application access issues and optimize connectivity.
* Maintain high availability and scalability of ZPA infrastructure.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience with Zscaler ZIA and ZPA platforms.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust Architecture and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE).
* Experience with DNS, TCP/IP, VPN, Proxy, SSL/TLS, and network security concepts.
* Experience with identity integrations (Azure AD, SAML, OAuth).
* Good understanding on Z-Identity.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

**Good to have Certifications**

* Zscaler Certified Cloud Professional (ZCCP)
* Zscaler Certified Specialist (ZCS)
* Zscaler Certified Expert (ZCE)

**Qualifications**
5+ years of experience in network / cloud security Including Zscaler Technologies

description:

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. We are looking for a Network Security Engineer with deep Zscaler expertise and a well rounded background in cloud and enterprise networking. This role centers on the deployment, administration, and optimization of Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), while also supporting broader network security initiatives, including Cisco Meraki infrastructure and AWS cloud networking. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer with strong security instincts, a problem solving mindset, and experience managing both on-prem and cloud-based networking environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the design, deployment, and optimization of Zscaler ZIA and ZPA across the enterprise.
* Manage Zscaler policies, including SSL inspection, URL filtering, access control, and zero trust configuration.

* Architect and manage AWS networking, including VPC design, Transit Gateway, NACLs, Security Groups, and routing.
* Develop and implement network segmentation and secure access strategies using both cloud and on-prem tools.

* Monitor, analyze, and respond to network threats, alerts, and performance issues.

* Strong experience configuring and managing Cisco Meraki networking devices in a distributed enterprise environment.
* Solid understanding of AWS networking principles and services (e.g., VPCs, Route 53, Direct Connect).
* Proficiency in network security concepts, including VPN, DNS security, zero trust, and endpoint integration.
* Experience working with firewall policies, network segmentation, and cloud security architectures.
* Familiarity with network troubleshooting tools (e.g., Wireshark, packet capture, logging platforms).

* Plan infrastructure upgrades, installations, maintenance, and capacity; maintain documentation, asset inventories, and configuration records.

2. Server and Data Center Operations

* Manage physical/virtual servers, Windows and Linux environments, and virtualization platforms such as Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Monitor server performance, storage, hardware health, operating systems, and critical services; maintain UPS, power backup, cooling, physical access, and equipment safety.
* Plan server upgrades, migrations, preventive maintenance, and infrastructure improvements.

3. Network and IT Security

* Manage LAN/WAN, internet leased lines, routers, switches, firewalls, Wi-Fi, VPNs, and inter-site connectivity.
* Configure firewall policies, network access controls, secure remote access, and segmentation; manage endpoint security, antivirus/EDR, patching, access permissions, and system logs.
* Resolve network/security issues and implement appropriate security controls.

4. Backup, Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity

* Maintain backup policies for servers, virtual machines, applications, and business data; monitor jobs, retention, offsite copies, and recovery procedures.
* Conduct restoration tests and disaster recovery drills; maintain recovery plans to ensure continuity and minimize downtime.

5. IT Operations and Monitoring

* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, system logs, and critical services; manage OS updates, software installations, patching, and preventive maintenance.
* Troubleshoot issues, perform root-cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and maintain incident, problem, change, and service-request processes.

6. Cloud Services and Enterprise Applications

* Administer Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, cloud storage, user accounts, access permissions, MFA, email, collaboration tools, and subscription renewals.
* Support cloud migration and hybrid infrastructure; monitor service availability, security configurations, and license utilization.

7. IT Asset, License and Compliance Management

* Maintain records of IT assets, software licenses, subscriptions, warranties, support contracts, installations, allocations, renewals, and compliance.
* Coordinate procurement, vendor support, maintenance contracts, and upgrades; maintain IT policies, SOPs, and audit documentation.

8. IT Service Delivery and Team Management

* Lead the IT support team, assign responsibilities, monitor task completion, and ensure timely incident and service-request resolution.
* Coordinate with departments, vendors, and service providers; prepare IT budgets, infrastructure proposals, operational reports, and project updates.
* Identify opportunities to improve IT service quality, security, reliability, and cost efficiency.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* 10–15 years of relevant experience
* Windows Server, Linux fundamentals, virtualization and server hardware; networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, switching and firewall administration; backup/disaster recovery, infrastructure monitoring and endpoint security; Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID and cloud administration; IT asset management, software licensing, vendor management and IT documentation.
* Experience managing enterprise IT infrastructure in a manufacturing or multi-location organization. Relevant certifications in Microsoft technologies, networking, cybersecurity, virtualization, or IT service management.

title: NCX Senior Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is hiring an NCX Senior Engineer who is passionate about NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) infrastructure operations to join our DSX team. This role involves working closely with strategic NVIDIA Cloud Partners to build and improve the operational capabilities essential for running large-scale NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure reliably in production.
  
  
Your role involves guiding partners beyond the initial cluster deployment and validation phase into advanced Day 2 operations. These operations cover ongoing infrastructure health, observability, lifecycle management, quick remediation, performance validation, and operational readiness. You will engage directly with partner engineering and operations teams to develop consistent approaches that support NVIDIA workloads and the broader external customer environments of the partners. This is a highly technical, hands-on role at the intersection of NVIDIA accelerated computing, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and production operations.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead NCP Day 2 operational readiness efforts. Collaborate directly with NVIDIA Cloud Partners to set up the systems, procedures, automation, and operational methods necessary to consistently manage NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure following initial deployment and activation.
* Build continuous infrastructure validation. Develop and implement methods to continuously validate GPU, CPU, storage, and network health. Do this across large-scale AI clusters to identify degraded infrastructure before it impacts critical training or inference workloads.
* Establish observability and operational telemetry. Help NCPs implement comprehensive telemetry, monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and operational signals across compute, GPU, InfiniBand/RoCE networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI workloads.
* Develop automated detection and remediation. Build workflows to detect, isolate, drain, repair, validate, and return unhealthy infrastructure to service while minimizing disruption to customer workloads.
* Refine fleet lifecycle administration. Implement scalable strategies for managing sizable GPU fleets, including NVIDIA driver and firmware lifecycle administration, Kubernetes node maintenance, OS patching, configuration management, upgrades, and configuration drift identification.
* Operationalize NVIDIA reference architectures. Translate NVIDIA NCP requirements and reference architectures into production operating practices, validation criteria, runbooks, automation, and measurable operational standards.
* Define operational health and readiness. Develop health signals, SLOs, important metrics, acceptance criteria, and ongoing validation mechanisms that provide NVIDIA and NCPs with clear insight into infrastructure reliability and service readiness.
* Build reusable operational frameworks. Develop tooling, automation, implementation guides, runbooks, operational playbooks, and reference implementations that can be applied consistently across multiple NCP environments.

**What We Need To See**

* BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in infrastructure engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, cloud platform engineering, systems engineering, or similar roles supporting large-scale production environments.
* Strong experience operating Linux-based distributed systems and cloud infrastructure in production.
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, containers, cluster scheduling, and the operational lifecycle of large multi-node environments.
* Strong understanding of production observability, including metrics, logging, alerting, dashboards, health checks, and operations guided by service level agreements.
* Experience crafting automation for infrastructure lifecycle management, failure detection, remediation, upgrades, and configuration management.
* Strong networking fundamentals and experience troubleshooting complex distributed systems across compute, network, and storage layers.
* Programming and automation experience using Python, Go, shell scripting, or similar languages.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience managing extensive GPU or accelerated computing infrastructure that supports AI training and inference workloads.
* Experience with NVIDIA technologies including DGX/HGX systems, CUDA, NVLink/NVSwitch, NVIDIA networking, InfiniBand, RoCE, GPU Operator, Network Operator, or related NVIDIA infrastructure software.
* Proven experience collaborating with NVIDIA Cloud Partners, hyperscale cloud providers, managed AI clouds, or extensive service-provider infrastructure and operating SLOs for large-scale compute infrastructure and using operational data to improve availability, performance, and fleet efficiency.
* Extensive knowledge of infrastructure observability tools including Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Alertmanager, and scalable telemetry pipelines and translating reference architectures or infrastructure requirements into repeatable production operating models across multiple customer or partner environments.
* Knowledge of failure modes related to large distributed AI workloads and the infrastructure features necessary to consistently support extended training and production inference.

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for phenomenal people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and dedicated people in the world working for us.

title: Senior Hyper-V Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About Dataction**
Dataction is a new age services firm that offers best in class information technology, analytics, and consulting services to renowned international companies. Dataction was established in 2010 and has grown rapidly over the last decade. Dataction has built a reputation for providing differentiated and reliable services to a wide range of customers across multiple sectors.
  
  
At Dataction we connect every dot and reimagine every business process. Our lean, agile, and analytical approach towards problem solving and execution, helps our client achieve sustainable growth and secure a profitable business, while safeguarding a viable future. Our people are committed, courageous, and unafraid of pushing boundaries. They help our clients make decisions that deliver immediate and measurable benefits, justifying investments. Our engagement models provide the perfect blend of quality, control, and cost for our customers.
  
  
To know more about Dataction, please visit https://dataction.co
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Hyper-V Infrastructure Engineer to build the target Microsoft Hyper-V platform and migrate our client's server workloads off VMware safely and on schedule. The client's VMware licences expire in November 2026, so this is a time-critical, hands-on delivery role. The successful candidate will act as the senior technical authority for the server workload migration on HPE ProLiant hosts: ~100 production server VMs (TAG cluster) and a single-host backup recovery cluster moving from VMware vSphere 8.0 to Microsoft Hyper-V. He/She will plan and run a rolling host-by-host migration, protect service continuity throughout, work closely with the VDI/XenServer workstream, and leave behind documentation the client's operations team can run with.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Microsoft Hyper-V Platform Build & Hardening

+ Build, configure, and harden Hyper-V hosts (Windows Server 2019/2022 Datacenter) on HPE ProLiant hardware, including iLO, firmware/SPP, and driver compliance.
+ Design and deploy Hyper-V Failover Clusters: Cluster Shared Volumes, quorum/witness, live migration, and Switch Embedded Teaming.
+ Configure virtual networking (Hyper-V virtual switches, VLANs, SET/NIC teaming) and SAN storage connectivity (iSCSI/FC, MPIO) to match the existing VMware design.
+ Deploy and configure management tooling (SCVMM and/or Windows Admin Center), including host groups, logical networks, VM templates, and role-based access.
+ Stand up the Hyper-V environment for ~100 production server VMs (TAG cluster) and the single-host recovery environment.
+ Integrate the new hosts with Active Directory, DNS, monitoring, and patching tooling.

* Server Workload Migration (VMware Exit)

+ Assess the VMware vSphere 8.0 server estate (clusters, VM inventory, application dependencies, networks, datastores) and produce the migration plan and cutover schedule against the 11 November 2026 deadline.
+ Run a rolling migration: evacuate a host, rebuild it as Hyper-V, migrate workloads, and repeat, using spare cluster capacity to avoid disruption.
+ Convert and migrate VMs using appropriate V2V tooling (e.g. SCVMM, Windows Admin Center VM Conversion, Veeam restore to Hyper-V), including VMware Tools removal, Integration Services, Generation 1/2 decisions, and network/IP re-mapping.
+ Plan and execute a safe approach for the single-host recovery cluster, where no spare capacity exists.
+ Define test, validation, and rollback procedures for each cutover, and coordinate change windows, out-of-hours activity, and application owner sign-off with the client.
+ Decommission VMware hosts once workloads are verified and signed off.

* Backup, Resilience & Security

+ Rebuild and migrate the Veeam backup server and backup proxy onto Hyper-V; reconfigure backup jobs for Hyper-V and confirm repositories and restore tests work on the new platform.
+ Configure high availability, VM placement and anti-affinity rules, and checkpoint policies for production workloads.
+ Apply security hardening aligned to CIS Benchmarks and Microsoft Security Baselines on all new hosts.
+ Establish patching and lifecycle processes for the new hosts (e.g. WSUS / SCCM / MECM / Cluster-Aware Updating).

* Automation, Documentation & Handover

+ Automate repetitive build, configuration, and migration tasks using PowerShell (Hyper-V and FailoverClusters modules).
+ Produce build documentation, runbooks, and operational handover for the client's infrastructure team, and brief them on day-to-day management.
+ Coordinate with the Citrix XenServer / VDI workstream on shared hardware, networks, storage, and the overall migration schedule.

**Qualification, Skills And Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in virtualisation and Wintel infrastructure, with deep hands-on expertise in Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience building and managing Microsoft Hyper-V hosts and Failover Clusters (Cluster Shared Volumes, live migration, quorum, Switch Embedded Teaming) in production.
* Strong experience with System Center Virtual Machine Manager and/or Windows Admin Center for managing Hyper-V at scale.
* Proven experience migrating 100+ server VMs from VMware to Hyper-V with minimal downtime, using V2V tooling such as SCVMM, Windows Admin Center VM Conversion, or Veeam.
* Good understanding of VMware vSphere/ESXi 7.x/8.x, including vCenter, VM export (OVF/VMDK), VMware Tools removal, and host decommissioning.
* Hands-on experience with HPE ProLiant servers, including iLO, firmware/SPP compliance, and Smart Array configuration.
* Good understanding of storage and SAN technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, and MPIO, and their use with Hyper-V Cluster Shared Volumes.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, LACP/NIC teaming, switching, and firewalls.
* Good understanding of backup and disaster recovery technologies, especially Veeam Backup & Replication in Hyper-V environments (backup server/proxy rebuilds, repositories, restore testing).
* Strong experience in Windows Server administration (2016/2019/2022/2025), including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy management.
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting (including the Hyper-V and FailoverClusters modules) for infrastructure automation, administration, and migration tasks.
* Experience implementing security baselines and hardening standards, including CIS Benchmarks and Microsoft Security Baselines, and managing patching (WSUS / SCCM / MECM / Cluster-Aware Updating).
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across Hyper-V, Failover Clustering, Windows, networking, storage, and other infrastructure layers.
* Experience producing migration runbooks, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and working within change management processes.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical solutions, operational procedures, and handover material.
* Exposure to Citrix XenServer or Azure Stack HCI / Azure Local is desirable.
* Prior VMware exit / hypervisor replatforming project experience is desirable.
* Relevant certifications are desirable: Microsoft (Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate / Azure Stack HCI) or VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV).

**Why should you join Dataction?**
Fairness, Meritocracy, Empowerment, And Opportunity Are Pillars Of Our Work Culture. In Addition To a Competitive Salary, You Can Look Forward To
  
  

* Great work-life balance through hybrid work arrangement.
* Company funded skill enhancement and training.
* Exciting reward and recognition programme.
* Opportunity to bond with colleagues through exciting employee engagement initiatives.
* Great on the job learning opportunity through involvement in new product/ ideation teams.

The successful candidate will act as the senior technical authority for the VDI migration across 10 HPE ProLiant hosts: ~400 VDI desktops moving from VMware vSphere 8.0 to Citrix XenServer. He/She will plan and run a rolling host-by-host migration, protect the end-user experience throughout, work closely with the client's Citrix team and the Hyper-V workstream, and leave behind documentation the client's operations team can run with.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Citrix XenServer Platform Build & Management

+ Build and configure Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor hosts and resource pools on HPE ProLiant hardware (10 hosts), including iLO, firmware/SPP, and hardware compatibility compliance.
+ Configure storage repositories (iSCSI/FC/NFS with multipathing), NIC bonding, networks/VLANs, and pool HA to match the existing VMware design.
+ Manage the estate via XenCenter and the xe CLI, including pool master design, Active Directory integration, role-based access, and host update/hotfix lifecycle.
+ Size and tune pool capacity (CPU, memory, storage IOPS, read caching) for ~400 concurrent desktops.
+ Integrate the new hosts with Active Directory, DNS, monitoring, and patching tooling.

* Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops Integration

+ Work with the client's Citrix team to create hosting connections and resources from the Delivery Controllers to the new XenServer pools.
+ Prepare and optimise golden images for XenServer (XenServer VM Tools, Citrix VDA, Citrix Optimizer) and rebuild machine catalogs using MCS/PVS.
+ Validate machine catalog and delivery group configuration, power management, and provisioning behaviour after each stage.
+ Validate VDI performance, user logon experience, profile management (FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management), and capacity after each stage of the migration.

* VDI Migration Planning & Execution (VMware Exit)

+ Assess the VMware vSphere 8.0 VDI estate (hosts, catalogs, golden images, persistent vs non-persistent desktops, networks, datastores) and produce the migration plan and schedule against the 11 November 2026 deadline.
+ Run a rolling migration: evacuate a host, rebuild it as XenServer, move desktop capacity in phases by delivery group/user population, and repeat, avoiding disruption to users.
+ Rebuild non-persistent catalogs from new XenServer golden images and convert persistent desktops using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or other V2V tooling, including VMware Tools removal and XenServer VM Tools installation.
+ Define pilot, UAT, validation, and rollback procedures for each stage, and coordinate change windows, out-of-hours activity, and user communications with the client.
+ Decommission VMware hosts once desktops are verified and signed off.

* Security, Automation & Handover

+ Apply security hardening to XenServer hosts and golden images aligned to CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Security Baselines, and vendor guidance.
+ Establish patching and lifecycle processes for XenServer hosts, VDAs, and golden images.
+ Automate repetitive build, image, and migration tasks using PowerShell (Citrix PowerShell SDK, XenServer SDK) and the xe CLI.
+ Produce build documentation, runbooks, and operational handover for the client's infrastructure and Citrix teams, and brief them on day-to-day management.
+ Coordinate with the Hyper-V server workstream on shared hardware, networks, storage, and the overall migration schedule.

**Qualification, Skills And Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in virtualisation and end-user computing / VDI infrastructure, with deep hands-on expertise in Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or Engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Citrix XenServer / Citrix Hypervisor, including host builds, resource pools, storage repositories, multipathing, NIC bonding, pool HA, XenCenter, and the xe CLI.
* Strong experience with Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, including Delivery Controllers, hosting connections, machine catalogs, delivery groups, and MCS/PVS.
* Proven experience running VDI at scale (400+ desktops), including golden image build, optimisation, and VDA lifecycle management.
* Proven experience migrating VDI workloads between hypervisors with minimal user disruption, using Citrix XenServer Conversion Manager or image-rebuild approaches.
* Good understanding of VMware vSphere/ESXi 7.x/8.x, including vCenter, VMware Tools removal, and host decommissioning.
* Hands-on experience with HPE ProLiant servers, including iLO, firmware/SPP compliance, and Smart Array configuration.
* Good understanding of storage and SAN technologies, including Fibre Channel, iSCSI, NFS, and multipathing, and storage performance/IOPS sizing for VDI.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, VLANs, LACP/NIC bonding, switching, firewalls, and Citrix HDX/ICA traffic.
* Strong experience with Windows 10/11 desktop and Windows Server administration, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy management.
* Experience with user profile management (FSLogix / Citrix Profile Management) and VDI performance and logon troubleshooting using Citrix Director or similar tools.
* Hands-on experience with PowerShell scripting (including the Citrix PowerShell SDK) for automation, administration, and migration tasks.
* Experience implementing security baselines and hardening standards for hosts and golden images, and managing patching across hypervisors and desktops.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across XenServer, Citrix, Windows, networking, storage, and other infrastructure layers.
* Experience producing migration runbooks, cutover plans, rollback procedures, and working within change management processes.
* Excellent documentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly document technical solutions, operational procedures, and handover material.
* Exposure to Microsoft Hyper-V or Citrix DaaS / Citrix Cloud is desirable.

title: MARINE ELECTRICAL ENGINEER
description:
A **Marine Electrical Engineer** is responsible for designing, installing, testing, and maintaining the electrical, electronic, and power generation systems aboard ships, offshore platforms, and marine structures. They ensure that all electrical equipment complies with international maritime standards, operates efficiently, and maintains safety at sea.

Key Responsibilities

* **System Design & Installation:** Design and oversee the installation of marine electrical systems, including power generation (generators, alternators), distribution switchboards, lighting, propulsion control, and navigation systems.
* **Maintenance & Troubleshooting:** Conduct routine inspections, diagnostic tests, and preventive/corrective maintenance on electrical machinery and automation systems to minimize downtime.
* **Compliance & Safety:** Ensure all electrical systems comply with regulations set by classification societies (e.g., DNV, Lloyd's Register) and international maritime bodies (e.g., IMO, SOLAS, IEEE).
* **Automation & Control:** Work with programmable logic controllers (PLCs), instrumentation, alarm monitoring systems, and dynamic positioning (DP) systems.
* **Project Management:** Collaborate with naval architects, marine engineers, and shipyard personnel during dry-docking, retrofits, and new-build construction projects.
* **Documentation:** Maintain accurate technical logs, electrical schematics, inventory records, and safety reports.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Marine Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **Certifications:** Relevant STCW certifications (for seagoing roles), such as Electro-Technical Officer (ETO) certification or High Voltage certification, depending on vessel type.
* **Experience:** 2+ years of experience working in shipyards, maritime operations, or offshore energy sectors.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Deep understanding of AC/DC power systems, high-voltage networks, motor controls, switchboards, and marine automation/navigational equipment.

Preferred Skills & Competencies

* **Problem-Solving:** Ability to troubleshoot complex electrical faults under high-pressure conditions at sea.
* **Communication:** Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills to coordinate with multi-national crew members and shore-based management.
* **Physical Fitness:** Ability to pass required marine medical examinations and work in confined or hazardous environments.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

**A PURPOSE DRIVEN COMPANY – 150 YEARS**

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.

Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.

**What you will do:**

As a Lead, Business Systems Analyst on the Financial Risk Technology (Summit/Calypso) team, you will report to the Lead, Software Engineer (Financial Risk Technology) and partner with product owners, tech leads, designers, engineers and delivery professionals to drive quality assurance (QA) testing. You will act as the primary interface between Technology and specific business areas, identifying business requirements, creating project and process specifications, and coordinating with project teams. You will ensure projects stay on schedule and within budget while helping solve complex business problems and deliver innovative products, services, and experiences to delight our customers!

**What you can expect:**
------------------------

* Support the Lead, Software Engineer setting ambitious and clear product vision, and communicating ‘the story’ effectively to key stakeholders and the rest of the team; begin to identify opportunities to provide input to the team and coach others with occasional guidance
* Collaborate with product owners in understanding needs and defining feature stories, tech leads in defining technical design and other team members to understand the system end-to-end and deliver robust solutions that bring about business impact
* Work on extremely complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an evaluation of often complex variables related to technology and/or data; exercise independent judgment in developing methods, techniques and evaluation criteria for obtaining results.
* Own the end-to-end product strategy from inception and determine business value once solution enters production
* Ensure alignment of product features and stories (i.e., review, give feedback, and prioritize user stories in line with product vision)
* Understand the vision and own aspects of product management / roadmap activities
* Use programming languages including but not limited to SQL, Oracle SQL, Test Management Tools, Agile, SDLC, Git and GitHub, Jira (Basics), and Microsoft Tools

**The skills and expertise you will bring:**
--------------------------------------------

* Bachelor of Computer Science or Engineering; Analytics or experience in related fields
* 5-7 years of experience in Calypso Application testing in critical modules including Collateral, Pricing Difference, UFT, VBScript, and API testing (SOAP & REST); experience in Functional and Regression testing with hands-on experience in the QFrame automation framework
* Experience with agile development methodologies and Test-Driven Development (TDD)
* Knowledge of business concepts, tools and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business
* Ability to learn new skills and knowledge on an on-going basis through self-initiative and tackling challenges
* Excellent problem solving, communication and collaboration skills
* Applied experience and/or expertise with several of the following:

o **Project/Product Management**: Planning, Progress Monitoring and Status Reporting, including visualization of works; Scaling Agile – Organizing, synchronizing multiple teams setup Estimations, ROI, project lifecycle

o **Effective Communication**: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Ability to facilitate dialogue at the right level of detail for all members of the Agile team

o **Decision-Making & Critical Thinking**: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment

o **Business Acumen**: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations

o **Interpersonal Relationships**: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner. Ability to work seamlessly with business partners and software developers alike in a liaison role

o **Financial Acumen**: Knowledge of financial concepts, tools and processes and how financial metrics are used to monitor and drive outcomes. Includes understanding of company accounts/metrics (ex: balance sheet, profit/loss, cash flow, budget & forecast)

o **Analytical** Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems

* **PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

**Skills:** SQL , Agile Methodologies , Business Analysis

title: Senior Analyst - Data Integration
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Role purposeThe Senior Data Analyst owns the integration, quality and analysis of energy, utility and smart-building data across JLL's JouLLe platform and connected systems. The role turns large, complex datasets into reliable reporting, tariff and budget insight, and process improvements that support our clients' energy and sustainability performance. It combines hands-on data work with project delivery, vendor collaboration and stakeholder engagement, and sits at the intersection of data, technology and sustainability within the JBS business.
  
  
Key responsibilitiesIntegrate smart-building and IoT solutions, API connectors and data feeds into JLL's energy management and sustainability platform (JouLLe), ensuring reliable, timely data flows.
  
Own data quality end to end - data cleansing, migration, integration, QA checks and validation across structured and unstructured energy and utility datasets.
  
Manage organizational structures within the JouLLe platform, including buildings (blocks), floors, tenants, and meter assignments across different client sites.
  
Produce utility consumption analysis and reporting for internal teams and clients, translating raw data into clear, decision-ready insight.
  
Conduct analytical reviews of energy data patterns to support optimization recommendations and identify anomalies.
  
Manage utility budget reporting and develop tariff optimisation strategies that reduce cost and improve energy performance.
  
Lead requirements gathering, process mapping and system implementation — including platform enhancements and interfaces to finance, accounting and CRM systems.
  
Manage and collaborate with platform and smart-building solution vendors on scoping, delivery and ongoing improvements.
  
Deliver data and platform projects end to end, on time and to specification.
  
Generate and manage client dashboard access via secure links, and provide platform training and reporting to clients and internal stakeholders on a regular basis.
  
Support compliance and quality audits, and drive process streamlining, automation and efficiency initiatives.
  
  
Essential skills & experienceSignificant experience (typically 3-5 years) in data analysis, integration and migration - ideally across energy, sustainability, utilities, property or finance.
  
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data patterns
  
Advanced Microsoft Excel, including Power Query, for handling large structured and unstructured datasets.
  
Experience with system implementation, administration and analysis.
  
Ticketing system or issue tracking tool experience (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, or similar) for managing workflows and contractor coordination.
  
Strong stakeholder and vendor management, with clear written and verbal communication.
  
Project management capability, from requirements through to delivery.
  
Methodical, proactive and independently motivated, with high standards for data quality and accuracy.
  
  
Desirable skills & experienceExperience with energy management, utility billing or consumption platforms.
  
Experience with API based data flows, edge devices, IoT systems or building management systems (BMS)
  
Smart building / IoT data / API Connector experience.
  
Working knowledge of tariffs, utility budgeting and energy procurement.
  
ERP experience (e.g. Yardi Voyager or a comparable property ERP).
  
Exposure to CRM (Salesforce).
  
Relevant certifications in data analytics.
  
A proven track record of process improvement, automation and efficiency gains.
  
  
Technical toolset (familiarity valued)MS Office 365
  
Excel & Power Query
  
Energy management & utility billing platforms
  
Smart-building / IoT data
  
Ticketing/Issue-tracking systems
  
Salesforce
  
SharePoint / Teams
  
  
QualificationsDegree in a relevant discipline (Data / IT, engineering, finance or sustainability), or equivalent practical experience.
  
Data analytics or data-foundations certification desirable.
  
  
Personal attributesMethodical, proactive and detail-oriented, with a quality-first mindset.
  
Curious and a continuous learner - comfortable exploring new tools and solutions.
  
A collaborative team player who values transparent communication.
  
Comfortable working across multiple teams, systems and, where relevant, jurisdictions.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Technology Consulting**
**Title: Application Engineer - III**
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.
* Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Microsoft - F And O Technical - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics F&SCM Commerce Technical Senior :**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce Technical Senior at EY GDS, you will contribute to the success of enterprise-scale D365 F&O implementations, primarily in the Retail and commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to work with a growing team and play a key role in delivering financial transformation solutions, process improvements, and ERP implementations to global clients, helping build a better working world.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain strong client relationships through value-driven consulting, technical leadership, and proactive engagement.
* Lead the technical design and development of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce solutions, with a focus on POS systems (MPOS/CPOS) & B2C /B2B Website.
* Configure and extend Store Commerce, Hardware Station, and integrate peripherals such as printers, scanners, cash drawers, and payment devices.
* Configure and extend B2C & B2B website, Site builder.
* Develop custom POS functionalities using Commerce SDK, Online SDK , TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, and .NET Core.
* Implement integrations between POS and backend systems: ERP (F&O), payment gateways, fiscal printers, loyalty programs, and eCommerce platforms.
* Design and maintain offline-first POS architecture, ensuring performance, fault tolerance, and scalability across store networks.
* Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business needs into detailed technical designs and functional design documents (FDDs).
* Utilize Azure DevOps and Lifecycle Services (LCS) for source control, CI/CD pipelines, and environment management.
* Support system testing, performance tuning, deployment, and go-live activities.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce best development practices, and maintain thorough technical documentation.
* Provide Level 3 support post-go-live to resolve POS-related issues and ensure smooth store operations.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Familiarity with Power Platform, especially Power Apps and Power BI, is a plus.
* Ability to conceptualize and design future-state business processes.
* Experience in conducting GAP analysis, solution testing, and user training.
* Good understanding of security roles, data management, Azure DevOps, and LCS environments.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Knowledge of integration with other Microsoft technologies such as Azure, Power Platform.
* Familiarity with industry-specific retail practices and compliance requirements.
* Experience working in multi-country and multi-legal entity environments.
* Strong documentation, stakeholder communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Proven ability to lead discovery workshops, manage offshore teams, and mentor junior consultants.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global, fast-paced environment.

**What We Look For**

* 5–10 years of experience in D365 Commerce technical.
* Minimum 3 full-cycle D365 F&O implementations in Commerce domains.
* Strong domain knowledge of Retail & eCommerce
* Strong domain knowledge of D365 Site builder tool
* Strong analytical and debugging skills with a focus on performance and reliability.
* Experience with Microsoft SureStep, Agile, or hybrid implementation methodologies.
* Proficiency in working with globally distributed teams and stakeholders.
* Microsoft certifications such as MB-340, MB-900 are preferred.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
Responsible for addressing and improve product and equipment -specific issues. Collaborating with other Equipment Engineering teams to implement new products and monitor existing products. Serve as the primary point of contact for product-specific engineering issues and acts as a liaison with outside departments including Manufacturing, Process, TSE, PE, QA and Planning. Liaised with QA group for quality improvement by introducing efficient working method, safety working environment, line audit, equipment health check and process and equipment improvement.
  
  
Responsibilities and Tasks
  
  
Evaluate and Improve Assigned Assembly Manufacturing Processes, Materials, and/or Equipment
  
  

* Maintain General process knowledge
* Maintain Equipment knowledge as it relates to the process
* Maintain Materials knowledge as it relates to the process

* Apply DOE techniques
* Perform containment of process and equipment deviations
* Determine root cause
* Implement corrective action
* Maintain knowledge of equipment and materials and how they interact
* Monitor Assembly process SPC and implement working procedures, process specification , FMEA and OCAP for line personnel

Evaluate Future Process, Equipment and/or Material Technologies
  
  

* Evaluate pertinent technology and engineering advancements relating to equipment, materials and processes
* Locate and research technical information on equipment, materials, and/or processes in journals, literature, web, etc
* Build and maintain effective relationships with suppliers
* Identify supplier’s materials or equipment design and production processes
* Create decision matrix for equipment and material selection

Coordinate Equipment and/or Material Procurement
  
  

* Maintain knowledge of process, equipment, and material requirements
* Follow equipment safety requirements
* Define quality and performance requirements
* Maintain Kknowledge of procurement document requirements and format
* Follow Micron Capital Equipment Procedures (MICAP)

* Maintain knowledge SAP MATREQ (Materials Requisition) program to look up and order spare parts
* Maintain knowledge of equipment tracking programs: ETI (Equipment Tracking Interface), ETReports, ETMaint.

Develop Process of Record (POR)
  
  

* Define process variables
* Determine major contributing factors or variables and their interactions using DOE techniques
* Define process edges and center the process (CPK)
* Assembly in-line process control and working towards assembly yield continuous improvement

Qualify New Process, Equipment and/or Material
  
  

* Define and implement quality systems
* Maintain knowledge of Assembly’s qualification procedures
* Maintain knowledge of Quality and Reliability Assurance (QRA).
* Cost reduction project by working closely with other team member such development group, material and equipment supplier

Implement New Process, Equipment and/or Material
  
  

* Define and maintain operation, maintenance, and energy isolation procedures
* Review current procedures on an on-going basis
* Maintain knowledge of Assembly On-Line Document System (AODS)
* Maintain knowledge of change communication procedures: ECN (Engineering Change Notice), Inbox, emails
* Maintain knowledge of material attributes (shelf life, storage requirements, etc.)
* Ensure materials compatibility with equipment and parameters
* Maintain knowledge of supplier’s constraints
* Maintain knowledge of new chemical/material approval process and MICIS (Micron Chemical Information Systems)

Coordinate Training Requirements and Conduct Training
  
  

* Develop, or coordinate development of, training materials for existing equipment
* Coordinate and conduct technical training with Engineering and Equipment Support (EES) group
* Conduct training for production trainers
* Train and mentor others

Contribute to a Safe and Compliant Work Environment
  
  

* Identify and promptly report hazards
* Follow safety procedures and area work rules (including use of proper PPE, energy isolation, and chemical safety)

Use of Artificial Intelligence in few projects
  
  

* Operate and maintain equipment and tools within manufacturer and company guidelines
* Use proper lifting techniques and work in an ergonomically correct manner

title: Embedded Engineer

Gandhinagar
