title: AI-Powered Software Testing & Quality Engineering Intern
description:
### **Combine AI with Software Testing | Automate Test Processes | Deliver Quality Software**

### **Job Description**

Wahy Lab Solutions is seeking analytical and technology-driven candidates for the position of AI-Powered Software Testing & Quality Engineering Intern. The role focuses on validating software quality using traditional testing methodologies, test automation techniques, and AI-assisted testing tools. Interns will gain practical exposure to intelligent test generation, defect analysis, test optimisation, and AI-driven quality assurance through industry-oriented software projects.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse software requirements and develop test scenarios, test cases, and test plans.
* Execute manual and AI-assisted software testing activities.
* Identify, document, track, and report software defects and inconsistencies.
* Perform functional, regression, integration, usability, and compatibility testing.
* Explore AI-powered tools for test case generation, test data creation, and test result analysis.
* Assist in developing and maintaining automated test scripts.
* Use AI tools to support test coverage analysis and identify potential edge cases.
* Perform API testing and validate application responses and data accuracy.
* Evaluate AI-generated test cases for accuracy, relevance, and completeness.
* Collaborate with developers and QA engineers to investigate and resolve software defects.
* Maintain test documentation, defect reports, and quality assurance records.
* Participate in live projects involving AI-assisted testing and modern quality engineering practices.

### **Required Skills**

* Basic understanding of Software Testing, Quality Assurance (QA), and testing methodologies.
* Knowledge of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Familiarity with manual testing, test case design, and defect life cycle management.
* Basic understanding of test automation concepts and scripting fundamentals.
* Familiarity with AI tools and Generative AI applications is preferred.
* Awareness of Selenium, Playwright, or similar automation frameworks is an advantage.
* Basic knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman is beneficial.
* Understanding of prompt engineering for AI-assisted testing is an added advantage.
* Strong analytical thinking, logical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication, documentation, and teamwork abilities.
* Interest in AI-driven software quality engineering and emerging testing technologies.

### **Qualification**

* Any Degree / Diploma / PG / ITI.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates interested in Software Testing, Artificial Intelligence, Test Automation, and Quality Engineering are encouraged to apply.

### **Job Details**

* Job Title: AI-Powered Software Testing & Quality Engineering Intern
* Job Type: Full-Time / Part-Time
* Work Mode: Work from Office (WFO) / Work from Home (WFH) / Hybrid
* Location: Kakkanad, Kochi, Kerala

### **Career Opportunities**

This internship can help candidates prepare for future roles such as:

* AI Test Engineer
* Software QA Engineer
* Test Automation Engineer
* Quality Engineering Analyst
* AI Testing Specialist
* Software Test Analyst

### **Why Join Us?**

* Next-Gen QA Stack: Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge AI testing tools, prompt engineering
for test automation, and Generative AI test generation.* Modern Quality Engineering: Learn how to combine traditional STLC fundamentals with AI-driven edge case discovery and automated regression testing.
* Real Project Workflows: Work alongside software developers and QA teams on production applications to streamline testing cycles.
* Future-Proof Career: Position yourself at the forefront of the software industry by mastering AI-driven quality engineering techniques early in your career.

### **Apply Now and Build Your Future in AI-Driven Software Testing!**

Interested candidates may apply by mailing their resume on hr@wahylab.com

description:

The

*move fast, speak up, decide and own, drive change, and exceed customer needs*

**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview**
Global Markets Technology provides end-to-end technology solutions for Global Markets businesses including Equities, Prime Brokerage, Interest Rates, Currencies, Commodities, Derivatives and Structured Products. Across all these products, solutions include architecture, design, development, change management, implementation and support using various enterprise technologies. In addition, GMT provides Sales, Electronic Trading, Trade Work Flow, Pricing, and Market Risk, Middle office, Collateral Management, Credit Risk, Post-trade confirmation, Settlement and Client service processes for Trading, Capital Markets, and Wealth Management businesses.
  
  
FX electronic trading technology contains a suite of applications, with a complex eco system, architecture, multiple business flows, upstream and downstream dependencies. This is a critical institutional front office trading application supported 24 by 5 supporting all global locations for FX business.
  
  
**Job Description:**
The successful candidate will join the India development team of FX electronic trading technology.
  
  
Individual contributor role; is responsible for defining and leading the engineering approach for solutions at the program or portfolio level to deliver significant business outcomes. Key responsibilities include design/delivery of critical strategic complex business projects along with the India team. Continuously improving the design, quality, and reuse of the solution and delivering technology enablers that improve development efficiencies for the solution. They are experts in at least one area of engineering and acts as a "go-to-” reference across the organization. As experts, they play a role in improving technical competency in their area through recruitment and development activities.

* Creates ideas on designing complex technology and solution development approaches - e.g., boundary condition coverage for complex technology issues.
* Help validate the economic impact of design decisions.
* Leads technical oversight for teams in solution development including design reviews and code within own domain.
* Supports/mentors/coaches’ team(s) on design and best practices for high code performance e.g., pairing, code reviews
* Accountable for defining the technology tool stack for the solution within range of internally approved and supported technologies.

As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**
This role provides advanced-level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases under general direction, and leads backend optimization, data integration, documentation, and secure, scalable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.
* Translates technical specifications into code for complex new or enhancement projects for internal clients. Writes programs, develops code, tests artifacts, and produces reports. Employs software development techniques to ensure tests are implemented in a way that support automation.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.
* Elevates code into the development, test, and production environments on schedule. Provides follow up production support. Submits change control requests and documents.
* Thoroughly understands software development methodology. Thoroughly understands development architecture standards. Trains and mentors staff with less experience. Resolves elevated issues.
* Participates in design, code, and test inspections throughout the life cycle to identify issues. Explains technical considerations at related meetings, including those with internal clients. Performs systems analysis activities.
* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.
* Interfaces with cross functional team members, and communicates systems issues at the appropriate technical level for each audience.
* Thoroughly understands and complies with Information Technology and Information Security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead backend system optimization efforts, ensuring high performance, scalability, and responsiveness under varying workloads.
* Spearhead the integration of multiple data sources, APIs, and services, streamlining data flow and improving overall system efficiency.
* Oversee the creation and upkeep of detailed backend documentation, helping cross-functional teams understand architecture and logic.
* Advocate and implement best practices for security, data protection, and backend resilience, aligning with enterprise-grade standards.
* Collaborate with front-end teams to design backend interfaces that support seamless and intuitive user experiences.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* Must Have skills : AWS Full stack Java required.
* Typescript

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, system integration, database design, and back-end architecture.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in relevant fields such as Computer Science, or a Master’s degree/Diploma in Computer Science.
* Expertise in server-side development, system integration, and API management; strong knowledge of database design, optimization, debugging, and performance tuning.
* Must-have skills: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Node JS, AWS, CloudFormation, ECS, Fargate, DynamoDB, S3, Lambda, IAM, SQL queries, GitHub, Bitbucket, Bamboo, CI/CD, TDD/BDD, Splunk, Honeycomb, Python.
* Knowledge of Agile, Confluence, JIRA; aptitude for continuous process improvement for process flows/workflows.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills to work with cross-functional teams.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong verbal and written communication, facilitation, relationship-building, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Be highly flexible, adaptable, and creative.
* Comfortable interacting with senior executives (within the firm and at the client)

**What We Look For**

* Strong teamwork, work ethic, product mindset, client centricity and a relentless commitment to EY values.

**What Working At EY Offers**
We offer a competitive remuneration package where you’ll be rewarded for your individual and team performance. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Helping careers take flight. Reshaping an industry. Enable your career to be Made on Duck Creek.**

Our market-leading solutions are available on a standalone basis or as a full suite, and all are available via Duck Creek OnDemand. We empower our employees with the choice to work from an office, from home, or on a hybrid schedule. Our flexible-first environment fosters productivity, inclusion, collaboration, and ensures a consistent employee experience regardless of location.
  
  
  
  
If working in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving company that is transforming one of the world’s oldest and largest industries sounds exciting, let us know. We are excited you are considering Duck Creek as a future employer and hope you decide to join “The Flock”!
  
  
  
  
To learn more about us, visit www.duckcreek.com and follow us on our social channels for the latest information – LinkedIn and Twitter.
  
  
  
  
**TITLE: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Application**
**Location: This position must be in the Bay Area, CA or Bengaluru, India and required to be in the office 2 to 3 times a week.**
**What You’ll Do**
The Senior Product Manager, Agentic Application owns the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for an agentic AI application that automates insurance product configuration for Duck Creek carriers. This role defines how AI agents read, understand, and translate complex carrier product documents into structured, validated Duck Creek product configuration compressing work that takes analysts from weeks to hours.
  
  
This role converts complex carrier workflow needs, AI accuracy requirements, document understanding challenges, and multi-line-of-business scalability goals into clear product priorities, requirements, and measurable outcomes. It requires deep comfort operating at the intersection of agentic AI, insurance product domain knowledge, and enterprise software delivery.
  
  
This role exercises independent judgment and partners across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, AI Platform, Customer Success, Professional Services, and carrier stakeholders to deliver governed, accurate, and scalable agentic configuration capabilities.
  
  

* Define and maintain the product strategy and roadmap for an agentic AI application that automates insurance product configuration, including document ingestion, structured data extraction, knowledge graph development, configuration generation, output validation, and human review workflow design.
* Translate carrier product configuration needs, document change workflows, accuracy requirements, and line-of-business expansion goals into clearly defined epics, features, use cases, requirements, user stories, and measurable product outcomes.
* Partner with Engineering and Architecture to define scalable, reliable, and maintainable agent pipeline patterns, including agent orchestration design, event-driven communication, durable state management, and cloud infrastructure requirements.
* Define product capabilities for a knowledge graph that represents relationships between insurance product elements, enabling intelligent change impact detection, cross-element dependency tracking, and semantic abstraction over raw product document structure.
* Drive an eval-first product culture: define accuracy targets by capability, establish a continuous evaluation methodology using AI observability tooling, and ensure no feature ships without a measurable accuracy signal.
* Partner with AI Platform, Semantic Insurance Data, Data Orchestration, Security, and Governance teams to support trusted context, responsible AI controls, and reliable execution across carrier document types and product lines.
* Define carrier-facing product capabilities, including configuration request intake, pipeline status visibility, reviewer experience, extraction result review, and output approval workflows.
* Evaluate trade-offs across extraction accuracy, pipeline reliability, reviewer burden, scalability, carrier data privacy, infrastructure cost, and time-to-market when shaping product priorities and requirements.
* Define adoption, accuracy, reliability, and business impact measures — including extraction accuracy, configuration validity rates, human review approval rates, pipeline throughput, LOB onboarding velocity, and carrier time-to-configuration.
* Support release planning, readiness, and communication by clarifying scope, dependencies, risks, acceptance criteria, and expected accuracy outcomes.
* Maintain awareness of emerging agentic AI frameworks, LLM evaluation methodologies, knowledge graph technologies, document understanding models, and insurance product configuration patterns to inform product direction.

**WHAT YOU’VE DONE:**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Insurance, Product Management, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in technical product management, AI product management, platform services, software engineering, or related roles.
* Experience owning complex AI, data, platform, or document-processing product capabilities.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineering, architecture, data science, customer-facing teams, and business stakeholders.
* Experience translating ambiguous business and technical problems into product strategy, roadmap priorities, requirements, release plans, and measurable outcomes.

**Preferred**

* Master's degree or equivalent advanced experience in a relevant field.
* Experience with AI agent frameworks, LLM evaluation, knowledge graphs, document understanding, structured data extraction, or agentic AI pipeline design.
* Experience in property and casualty insurance, InsurTech, financial services, or another complex regulated industry, particularly in product configuration, underwriting, policy administration, or manuscript management.
* Familiarity with event-driven architectures, cloud-native platforms, LangGraph or similar agent orchestration frameworks, and human-in-the-loop system design.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**
**Knowledge**

* Technical product management practices for complex AI, data pipeline, or document processing capabilities.
* AI agent design, including LLM-based extraction, deterministic agent patterns, orchestration frameworks, and multi-stage pipeline architecture.
* Extraction accuracy concepts, including eval harness design, scoring methodology, baseline comparison, and prompt iteration.
* Knowledge graph concepts, including entity relationship modeling, semantic abstraction, dependency graph traversal, and change impact analysis.
* Human-in-the-loop design patterns, including review gate placement, correction capture, audit logging, and reviewer experience.
* Document understanding across complex insurance documents, including rate manuals, carrier filing documents, underwriting guidelines, and product manuscripts.
* Event-driven system design, including versioned event contracts, Pub/Sub patterns, durable state management, and agent checkpointing.
* Responsible AI practices, including hallucination detection, deterministic output validation, schema-enforced output gates, and accuracy-gated deployment.
* Cloud-native platforms, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, and enterprise security patterns relevant to carrier data handling.

**Skills**

* Translating ambiguous carrier configuration needs and AI accuracy requirements into structured product requirements, clear priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Evaluating trade-offs across extraction accuracy, reviewer burden, LOB scalability, infrastructure cost, carrier data privacy, and time-to-market.
* Analyzing accuracy, reliability, pipeline performance, and business impact metrics to inform product decisions and prioritization.

**Abilities**

* Ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority across a broad cross-functional organization, including Product, Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, Customer Success, Professional Services, and carrier customers.
* Ability to explain complex AI extraction, knowledge graph, and validation decisions in clear business and carrier terms.
* Ability to use AI-enabled tools to support product discovery, analysis, prototyping, documentation, and iterative product development.

**Other Requirements**

* Travel: 10%
* Work Authorization: Legally authorized to work in the country of the job location.
* Work location: Bay Area, CA Or Bengaluru, India

**WHAT WE STAND FOR:**
  
  
Our global company celebrates & leverages the differences each employee brings to the table. Our success is a direct result of an inclusive culture where opportunities to learn from one another occur regardless of title, seniority, or background. This collaborative and team-oriented approach is at the core of how we operate and continuously improve our products, services, and systems. As such, Duck Creek is committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants – to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital, military, or any other protected status.
  
  
  
  
We strive to be an example to the world of inclusion, diversity, and equity in all things – where employees are free to be their authentic selves in the workplace and in the communities in which we live. We believe in leading by example and are proud of the diversity of our team and our shared commitment to our Core Values: We Prioritize Respect; We Listen; We Care; We Add Value; and We Lead.
  
  
  
  
To learn more about our inclusive company culture, values, DE&I initiatives, and people, please visit: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/.
  
  
  
  
Please let us know if you encounter accessibility barriers with our web content by sending an email to accessibility@duckcreek.com.
  
  
**Privacy Notice:**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with our Privacy Notice and applicable data protection laws.
  
  
**Duck Creek Technologies does not accept, nor will we pay a fee for any hires resulting from unsolicited headhunter or agency resumes.**
  
  
Actual compensation for this role is determined based on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, internal equity, and geographic location, where permitted by law.
  
  
For reference, the expected salary range for this position is generally positioned as follows based on candidate location:
  
  

* 164,600 – 235,200: Candidates living in the Boston, New York City–Newark, Los Angeles, San Francisco/Bay Area, Seattle, or Washington, DC metropolitan areas

This position is also eligible for annual bonus compensation, subject to plan terms and individual eligibility.
  
  
Final compensation will be determined based on the factors outlined above and in accordance with applicable law.
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies believes in the safe, ethical, and responsible use of artificial intelligence. We may use AI-assisted tools to support parts of the recruitment process, such as reviewing applications, identifying relevant skills, and organizing candidate information.
  
  
AI tools are used to assist—not replace—human judgment. All AI-assisted outputs are reviewed by a Duck Creek team member, and final hiring decisions are always made by people. Candidates should be comfortable working in environments where AI is used responsibly to enhance business processes.
  
  
Duck Creek Technologies offers a comprehensive benefits package, which includes:

title: Sr Product Development Mgr I
description:
**Job Requirements**
Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.
  
  
The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.
  
  
**Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here:**

* Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.
* Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.
* Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

**Commerce, Data & Identity**
Commerce, Data & Identity provides the core product management functions for areas crucial to Disney’s media businesses. These include initiatives and products that power digital commerce, identity, and growth, as well as those that reach uniquely across The Walt Disney Company enterprise, such as messaging and privacy, among others. Additionally, it is responsible for the data engineering, science, and products for Disney Entertainment & ESPN, along with their interconnection with other parts of The Walt Disney Company.
  
  
Disney’s Product Management team is seeking a Sr. Product Manager I, Content Data Products who will be an exceptional addition to our Content Data Products team. This team is responsible for ideating, developing, and managing Data products focused on maximizing the value of Disney’s content asset portfolio across all our distribution channels, including subscription & ad supported streaming, cable and broadcast.
  
  
In this role, you will partner with a wide cross section of stakeholders groups who are interested in developing content performance insights - including data engineers, data analysts, data scientists and content programming executives. Content data from these data products are used in decision making across brands like Disney+, Hulu, ESPN+, Marvel Studios, ABC News, etc.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have deep familiarity with the data warehousing solutions, data processing pipelines, analytics platforms and BI Tooling approaches from a product management perspective. The candidate will be required to then layer on deep business domain knowledge required to develop strong partnerships with Analysts and Business teams that use the Content data insights on a daily basis. This role requires the ability to work in an incredibly fast-paced and constantly changing environment.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Duties Of The Role**

* Act as a data strategist and subject matter expert for content data sets and seamlessly navigate every layer of the data stack to identify opportunities where data can be leveraged for insights.
* Develop and manage regulatory and contractual data feeds to internal and external organizations and ensure stakeholder alignment across content operations, partner managers, engineering and disney leadership.
* Build strong relationships with technology and business teams across the organization and get a solid grasp of these stakeholder's pain points and business outlook.
* Partner with a whole range of teams within the Data organization (analytics, data science, data engineering, data architecture, data quality & governance, program management) to deliver high impact, cost effective data solutions.
* Lead and drive teams on all business readiness activities, including Business case development, product planning, sequencing, testing, user education, rollout, iteration, and support
* Manage day-to-day Product Management activities related to multiple scrum teams, including backlog refinement, prioritization of short term/long term business needs, product/feature launch communications, user onboarding and training.
* Ability to identify risks, resolve key blockers, and establish appropriate resolution paths

title: Venture Fellow - Internship
description:
Aadi Labs is a venture creation studio. We help founders turn promising ideas into working products, first customers and the foundations of real companies, and we build some of those companies ourselves, with Venture Fellows leading the work.

You will own a real function inside an early-stage venture for six months: real users, real numbers, real consequences if something does not work.

**What you will actually do**

Depending on the venture and the function you choose, that could mean running growth experiments and watching the numbers move, shipping product decisions that get tested by real users within days, writing and deploying code that goes live the same week, or designing the first experience a customer ever sees of something that did not exist a month ago. You will not be handed a six-month roadmap on day one. You will be handed a problem and the room to go solve it.

**Who this is for**

AI is already part of how you work daily. You use it to get more done than your headcount would suggest, not as a novelty you dabble in occasionally. You want responsibility earlier than a conventional internship gives you, and you are comfortable with a role that is not fully defined yet.

Prior experience in a function helps, but a real track record of building or shipping something, anywhere, counts for more than a résumé line.

**Pick your track**
— Venture Fellows lead one of five functions. You choose which one you are applying for on our site.

* **Growth**
   — positioning, acquisition and retention, with AI handling the busywork so your judgment goes toward what to test next.
* **Product**
   — the customer, the first use case, the smallest version worth shipping, prototyped with AI to move at founder speed.
* **Engineering**
   — production code, using AI coding tools to multiply your own output.
* **Design**
   — the end-to-end experience, from UX to the first impression a user gets.
* **Other**
   — sales, operations, customer success, or a function that doesn't fit neatly above.

**Logistics**
: 6 months · Remote or hybrid (Whitefield, Bangalore)

· Direct exposure to zero-to-one building, mentorship, real equity via ESOP, and a credible path to full-time or founding your own venture after.

**About the Position**
As an
**Associate**
**Product Manager – Discover**

You will work on some of Sense’s most strategic problem spaces, including:

* Drive higher application rates for open jobs by connecting job seekers with the most relevant jobs across Email, SMS, Voice, and Chat surfaces.

* LLM-powered Recommendation and Decisioning Engines which drive above outcomes
* Reliable Feedback Loop - AI Quality, Observability & Data Quality monitoring to ensure reliable and explainable outcomes for recruiters and customers

This role sits at the intersection of AI, workflow orchestration, automation infrastructure, and recruiter productivity. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, AI/ML teams, Customer Success, and GTM teams to conceptualize, build, and scale products that automate recruiting workflows and empower recruiters with AI-driven assistance.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for a high-potential Product Manager who enjoys solving complex platform and systems problems, thrives in ambiguity, and wants to grow into a larger product leadership role over time.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Discovery**
  
  

* Identify opportunities where AI and automation can meaningfully improve recruiter productivity, operational efficiency, and candidate experience.
* Work closely with Product Leadership to define and evolve the vision for Sense’s Discover roadmap. More specifically, contribute to the roadmap for:

+ Candidate Matching
+ Job Matching
+ AI Decisioning & Actions
+ AI Observability

* Stay current with advancements in Agentic AI, LLM ecosystems, workflow orchestration, and enterprise automation trends.
* Conduct structured discovery sessions with enterprise customers, recruiters, implementation, customer success, sales and leadership teams to understand and document feedback, pain points and user flow inefficiencies clearly.

**Execution - Design, Development and Delivery**

* Translate ambiguous business and customer problems into clearly defined user flow diagrams, user stories, and acceptance criteria within a PRD - explaining aha! moments, self-serve features, guided onboarding, activation experience and instrumentation to track post launch activation and repeat usage metrics.
* Contribute to the implementation of intelligent orchestration capabilities across recruiting workflows and user journeys.
* Partner with user experience and design teams to ship consumer-grade, highly flexible yet scalable and delightful user experiences. Help define interaction patterns and experiences for features owned by your EPD triad across Voice, Chat, Recruiter Hub, Workflows, Sequences and other surfaces.
* Partner with engineering, platform and ML teams to deliver scalable, reliable and maintainable solutions across ingestion pipelines, document processing, feature extraction, data transformations & indexing, vector storage & embeddings, structured and low latency retrieval and amongst other product and platform capabilities.
* Ensure product, design and engineering decisions are documented, and shared with stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Drive feature prioritization, sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release coordination by maintaining a groomed / ungroomed backlog / project plan in Asana or Jira.
* Work closely with QA teams and perform hands-on UAT to ensure comprehensive test coverage and delivered features meet customer and usability expectations.
* Ensure customer reported issues are resolved under pre-defined SLA windows and are escalated proactively to the appropriate leadership to ensure timely resolution.
* Contribute towards shipping internal tools for engineering and customer support to easily track and debug issues.

**Enablement and GTM**

* Run a structured post launch program to ensure awareness, activation and adoption of key features
* Analyse past usage, revenue and churn risk signals to identify customer segments where a feature is launched and will be useful to drive targeted adoption
* Work closely with product marketing and knowledge base team to create and update the customer facing how-tos and other useful artifacts
* Create internal and customer facing announcement artifacts and adoption playbooks for customer success and implementation teams
* Run structured training sessions for new capabilities, office hours and workshops

**Product Adoption and AI Observability**
  
  

* Define, review and present adoption and AI Observability metrics to stakeholders on a bi-weekly basis

+ Customer Satisfaction & Feedback Synthesis
+ AI Quality / Reliability / Faithfulness -

- Feature extraction accuracy
- Hit Rates, Miss Rates, Relevant Results Density
- Faithfulness of AI explanation on a sample dataset

+ Indexing and Retrieval Reliability - Latency, Failure Rates, Zero Result Rates
+ Conversion Funnel Analysis

* Personally inspect AI Quality - LLM outputs, traces, retrieval results, source-ingestion failures, irrelevant results, failed actions, and downstream customer outcomes.
* Analyse customer reported issues via bugs and support tickets and identify improvement opportunities
* Partner with Product Analytics and Data teams to ensure timely and evolving instrumentation, derive actionable insights and identify optimization opportunities on a bi-weekly basis.

**Professional Qualifications**

* BE/B.Tech or M.B.A with at least 1-3 years of experience in product management role with deep familiarity with software development lifecycle.
* You need to be a highly analytical problem solver to succeed in this role.
* [Must Have] - You bring hands-on experience with data analysis using SQL and present your findings in a structured way. Experience with tools like Mixpanel, Heap or Amplitude is preferred.
* [Highly Preferred] Previous experience in working closely with engineering and ML on retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, evaluations and observability. Familiarity with AI Observability tools like Arize, Braintrust etc is highly desired.
* Familiarity with project management tools like Asana or Jira.
* Proficient in English, with good written and oral communication and presentation skills
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, ability to prioritize and balance multiple tasks
* Ability to process and apply feedback constructively without ego
* Ability to “do what it takes to get the job done” - no job is small for you.

As entrepreneurs, have we considered solving their problems and making them more productive?
  
  
Zinier is a company on a mission to empower frontline workers - and the people supporting them - to achieve greater things for themselves and the world around them. With the majority of workers worldwide being deskless, Zinier recognizes the need for Technology Equity to improve the lives and productivity of these workers who keep the world up and running.
  
  
We have global team headquartered in Silicon Valley, with a hybrid workforce across the United States, Canada, Europe, Latin America, Singapore, and Bangalore, India, with leading investors that include Accel, ICONIQ Capital, Founders Fund, Newfund Capital, NGP Capital, Tiger Global Management, and Qualcomm Ventures LLC.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
Zinier is searching for a deeply technical, execution-obsessed Product Lead to shape our data and AI strategy. You'll own the roadmap for how Zinier captures, structures, and activates data to power agentic, AI-driven field service products — and you'll be equally comfortable writing epics and stories with engineering as you are challenging architecture decisions on data pipelines and LLM interfaces.
  
  
This is a hands-on, technical PM role. You'll define what data is needed and translate it into clear requirements for the teams building our solutions, own the lifecycle of data and AI initiatives from intent recognition through execution, and partner across Platform, Data Platform, Product Engineering, Design, Security, and Legal to build a scalable, compliant, and highly intuitive solutions.

* Shape the data & AI strategy: Define and execute the roadmap — plan, execute, self-correct, and learn.
* Treat data as the fuel: Define what data is needed and translate that into clear requirements for the teams building the solutions.
* Own projects end to end: Define, execute, measure, and iterate — owning the full lifecycle from initial intent recognition and planning frameworks through execution and coordination.
* Lead cross-functionally: Partner with cross functional teams like Platform , Data Platform, Product Engineering, Product Designers, Security, and Legal to build a scalable, compliant, and highly intuitive solutions.
* Write epics and stories: Translate strategy into engineering-ready epics and stories, working in Scrum with clear acceptance criteria.
* Define and own data products: Set up and define data products, including data warehouse and data lake requirements.

**Must-have**
**What you'll bring to the role**

* Strong B2B experience.

* Technical fluency — able to credibly challenge engineering teams on architecture, data models, and trade-offs.

**Shape the data. Power the agents. Own the strategy.**

title: Cloud & Hosting - Senior Product Owner - Observability
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Product Owner, Observability owns the backlog and roadmap for the Observability platform, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.
  
  
The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Director, Modern Engineering Platform Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.
* Link every backlog item explicitly to GSK D&T strategy and domain OKRs and measure the outcome with a named metric.
* Translate consumer needs and business outcomes into clear requirements and user stories that engineering can act on without further interpretation.
* Work daily with the engineering team through refinement, planning and review, and accept completed increments against agreed criteria.
* Balance new capability against the reliability bar, agreeing SLOs and error budget impact with Reliability Engineering before committing to work.
* Use AI tooling to accelerate discovery, backlog refinement and requirement drafting, and record where AI-assisted output has been reviewed before acceptance.
* Measure product adoption, self-service uptake and value delivered and iterate the roadmap on that evidence rather than on stakeholder volume.
* Steer delivery with flow metrics such as throughput, cycle time and work in progress, and act on them rather than reporting them.
* Manage consumer demand and stakeholder expectations, saying no with a reason where an item does not compete on value.
* Manage supplier-delivered components within the product, holding partners to the same acceptance criteria and reliability standards as internal work.
* Contribute the product view into the domain roadmap held by the Platform Manager and the portfolio view held by the Domain Portfolio Manager.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Manager on platform strategy, the Platform Architect on technical design and standards, and Reliability Engineering on the reliability bar.

**Minimum Level Of Job-Related Experience Required**

* 5+ years in technology, years in product ownership or product management, including at least two years owning a backlog in a platform or infrastructure context.
* Practical experience of lean or agile backlog management, including prioritisation by value and risk rather than by request order.
* Track record of translating business needs into requirements that engineering teams could deliver without repeated clarification.
* Experience working to OKRs and measuring adoption or value delivered rather than features shipped.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and acting on delivery predictability data.
* Experience managing stakeholders and declining requests with a defensible reason.
* Exposure to AI tooling used for discovery, backlog refinement or requirement drafting.
* Hands-on expertise with modern observability tooling such as Grafana and Google Cloud Observability.
* Proven observability expertise across metrics, logs and traces, telemetry pipelines, dashboards and alerting, with accountability for reliability and cost.
* Experience delivering AI-driven or automated operations on observability data (desirable).
* Experience in a pharma, regulated or comparably complex enterprise environment (desirable).

**Skills/Background**

* Decisiveness on backlog order, including the confidence to sequence against value rather than seniority of the requester.
* Clear written communication, since requirements and acceptance criteria are the role's primary output.
* Enough technical literacy to challenge engineering estimates and understand reliability trade-offs.
* Comfort with data as the basis for roadmap change rather than stakeholder pressure.
* Collaborative habit with architecture and reliability colleagues who can veto on standard ground.

**Skills**
AI Observability, API Management, Automation Technology, Backlog Prioritization, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Grafana, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Product Management, Product Ownership, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. description:
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com.
  
  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.
  
  
**Job Function**
Data Analytics & Computational Sciences
  
  
**Job Sub Function**
Business Intelligence
  
  
**Job Category**
Professional
  
  
**All Job Posting Locations:**
Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead is an experienced role bridging business needs and digital solutions while leading and developing a team of professionals.
  
  
The Digital Product Management Business Lead translates business needs into clear, actionable requirements that enable successful delivery and adoption of digital, analytics, automation, data science, and AI products. The role works across business, product, design, data, engineering, quality, and technology partners to identify business needs, define requirements and future-state capabilities, shape product priorities, and guide digital solutions from discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.
  
  
This role collaborates closely with Product Managers, and is responsible for leading and developing a team, setting priorities, managing performance, and strengthening business analysis and product management capabilities
  
  
Business Analysis & Problem Definition
  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders, product teams and business analysts to ensure strategic priorities, business processes, pain points, opportunities, risks, and desired outcomes are effectively understood and documented.
* Guide and mentor business analysts in planning and facilitating discovery sessions through stakeholder interviews, workshops, process analysis, data analysis and user research.
* Provide oversight and direction on process and systems assessments, business requirements documentation, epics, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria ensuring solutions align with business objectives and product management best practices.
* Review and coach analysts on developing structured recommendations and business cases that support informed decision-making and investment prioritization.

Digital Product Management
  
  

* Lead and develop business analysts, providing guidance on product management practices, prioritization, and execution.
* Support adherence to product management frameworks, governance processes, and ways of working to ensure consistency across products and teams.
* Oversee product vision, roadmaps, backlogs and establish clear priorities for delivery teams.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, data, UX/design, and other teams throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to leverage digital technologies, data, automation, analytics, and AI to improve business outcomes, assessing whether AI is the appropriate solution based on value, user need, data readiness, feasibility, risk, and required oversight.

**Product Performance & Business Value**

* Review and coach analysts on defining measurable product outcomes, KPIs, adoption metrics, and value measures, including relevant measures for AI-enabled capabilities such as reliability, output quality, user trust, exception rates, and productivity improvement.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for optimization and enhancement, using AI-assisted analysis to detect patterns, adoption barriers, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Track expected and realized value from digital investments, using AI to synthesize performance, financials, adoption, and user data.
* Recommend whether products or capabilities should be enhanced, scaled, consolidated, or retired based on value, performance, adoption, risks, and strategic fit.

Stakeholder & Cross-functional Leadership
  
  

* Serve as a key connection point between SCE Product Managers and Business Analyst using AI-assisted synthesis to improve shared understanding of needs, decisions, requirements, and delivery implications.
* Build alignment across stakeholders with differing priorities and perspectives, using AI to organize inputs, compare options, clarify areas of agreement, conflict, and unresolved risks.
* Facilitate decisions on requirements, priorities, scope, trade-offs, and delivery, using AI-supported analysis to present options and implications while ensuring accountable stakeholders make final decisions.
* Communicate product roadmaps, progress, risks, dependencies, and outcomes to leadership, using approved AI tools to accelerate concise, audience-appropriate updates that are reviewed for accuracy and context.
* Translate technical and AI concepts, capabilities, limitations, risks, and trade-offs into clear business language, and translate business needs into actionable direction for technology teams.

People Management & Team Development
  
  

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of business analysts, product professionals, and related roles, including building their ability to use approved AI tools responsibly to improve work quality, speed, and business impact.
* Establish clear objectives, priorities, roles, and performance expectations, including expectations for appropriate AI use, verification of outputs, data protection, and accountability for final work products.
* Provide ongoing feedback, coaching, performance management, and career development, using AI-assisted preparation where appropriate while retaining personal judgment and accountability for employee decisions.
* Allocate work and resources based on priorities, capacity, skills, and development opportunities, using AI-supported workload and scenario analysis to inform—not determine—management decisions.
* Mentor team members in business analysis, product management, stakeholder engagement, Agile ways of working, and responsible application of AI to research, synthesis, requirements, testing, and communication.
* Establish consistent standards and best practices for requirements, product documentation, prioritization, delivery, and AI-assisted ways of working, including validation, traceability, privacy, security, and governance expectations.
* Identify capability gaps and create development plans to strengthen team effectiveness, including AI literacy, prompt and context design, critical evaluation of outputs, data fluency, and value measurement.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing team culture that encourages responsible experimentation, shared learning, and scaling of proven AI-enabled practices.

**Other Duties**
Cultivate and Sustain Collaboration: Collaborate across teams to build trust, open communication, and shared ownership of project goals.
  
  

* Champion J&J Values: Model J&J C.E.O. Leadership Behaviors and values to reinforce a healthy and motivating workplace culture.
* Support Team Cohesion: Plan and participate in team-building activities, knowledge-sharing sessions, and feedback loops that foster trust, collaboration, and team cohesion.
* Encourage Growth: Support mentorship, and continuous learning within the team.

**Required Minimum Education**
: Bachelor’s Degree (with 7+ years of experience) and/or Master’s Degree (with 5+ years of experience)
  
  
**Required Years Of Related Experience**

* 5+ years of relevant experience

**Required Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Bachelor's degree and/or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering or Supply Chain.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, product management, digital transformation, technology delivery, or related disciplines in highly regulated business environments.
* Demonstrated people management experience, including coaching, performance management, prioritization, and employee development.
* Digital acumen and strong business analysis experience, including process analysis, requirements definition, future-state design, and stakeholder facilitation.
* Experience managing digital products or technology-enabled capabilities through multiple stages of the product lifecycle.
* Experience developing product roadmaps, managing backlogs, writing requirements/user stories, and prioritizing features.
* Strong understanding of Agile product development and cross-functional delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with business, engineering, architecture, data, and other technology teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, and decision-making skills.

Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to engage senior leaders

**Preferred Skills:**

title: Data & AI Portfolio, Adoption & Service Excellence
description:
**Job Summary**
The Data & AI Lead is responsible for identifying, shaping, and delivering AI-enabled products that improve risk and compliance processes and deliver measurable business value.
  
  
The role sits within the AI Centre of Excellence (CoE) and acts as the bridge between business, data, AI engineering, and governance teams, ensuring AI solutions are aligned to strategic priorities, deliver tangible outcomes, and are successfully adopted by business users.
  
  
In addition to product ownership, the role drives process excellence and value realisation, ensuring AI initiatives generate measurable productivity, risk reduction, and operational efficiency improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Define and maintain the Data & AI capability strategy and product roadmap for Risk & Compliance, ensuring AI initiatives are aligned to business priorities, enterprise AI direction and measurable value outcomes.
* Own the AI use case portfolio across assisted, enabled, generative and agentic automation, ensuring a coherent path from ideation to prioritisation, design, delivery, adoption, scale and retirement.
* Partner closely with respective Product Owners, Business Owners and Process Owners to review the full product and process journey, identifying where AI, data, automation and analytics can materially improve productivity, risk outcomes, user experience and decision quality.
* Lead structured opportunity discovery across products and processes to identify areas where process engineering through AI and data tools can deliver substantial qualitative and quantitative benefits, including cycle-time reduction, effort elimination, quality improvement, control uplift and improved decision support.
* Continuously challenge existing ways of working and push the boundaries of imagination with business stakeholders by bringing practical ideas on GenAI, agentic AI, workflow automation, data intelligence and reusable AI capability patterns.
* Support strategic buy, build, reuse or partner decisions for AI capabilities, ensuring investment is directed towards scalable, reusable and value-accretive solutions.
* Maintain a centralised AI backlog and product pipeline that balances business value, feasibility, risk, complexity, user adoption, delivery capacity and strategic relevance.

**Business**

* Act as the primary business-facing lead for AI capability development, building trusted relationships with Product Owners, Business Owners, SMEs and senior stakeholders to identify, shape and deliver AI-enabled business transformation.
* Work with product and business owners to assess the entire product journey, including upstream inputs, workflow steps, decision points, controls, handoffs, pain points, downstream outputs and user experience.
* Translate business challenges into clear, outcome-led AI opportunities, ensuring each use case has a defined problem statement, target user group, expected benefit, success measure and adoption pathway.
* Lead process and value analysis to determine where AI and data tools can generate measurable business impact, including productivity gains, cost avoidance, improved quality, better risk detection, reduced manual intervention and enhanced decision-making.
* Quantify expected benefits before implementation and track realised benefits after deployment, covering both quantitative measures such as time saved, volume processed, cost avoided and cycle-time reduction, and qualitative outcomes such as improved user confidence, better insights, stronger controls and improved service experience.
* Enable product and business owners to reimagine how work can be performed using AI, including GenAI assistants, copilots, agentic workflows, intelligent triage, automated summarisation, insight generation and decision-support tools.
* Ensure AI products are business-relevant, user-centred, measurable, scalable and designed to deliver sustained adoption rather than isolated experimentation.

**Processes**

* Establish and operate a structured AI product lifecycle covering intake, opportunity discovery, journey review, prioritisation, requirements definition, design, development oversight, deployment readiness, adoption, value tracking and continuous improvement.
* Facilitate end-to-end product journey and process engineering reviews with Product Owners and Business Owners to identify friction, duplication, manual effort, control gaps, rework, delays and decision bottlenecks that can be improved through AI and data-enabled solutions.
* Convert business and process opportunities into well-defined product artefacts, including product requirement documents, user journeys, process maps, feature definitions, prioritisation criteria, value hypotheses and delivery roadmaps.
* Work closely with AI engineering, data and analytics teams, GenAI prompt specialists, governance teams and business SMEs to ensure AI solutions are designed and delivered against clearly defined business outcomes.
* Oversee use case delivery from ideation through deployment, ensuring delivery progress, dependencies, risks, milestones, design decisions, readiness activities and business adoption plans are actively managed.
* Define and maintain value measurement approaches, including baseline metrics, benefit assumptions, productivity scorecards, adoption dashboards, value realisation tracking and portfolio performance reporting.
* Use feedback from users, adoption metrics, operational outcomes, process performance and governance inputs to continuously improve AI products, backlog priorities and product journey design.

**People & Talent**

* Build and own strong working relationships with Product Owners, Business Owners, Process Owners, Technology, Data, Risk, Compliance and AI Governance teams to create a shared agenda for AI-enabled transformation.
* Act as a trusted advisor to business teams by helping them understand what is possible with AI, GenAI, agentic AI, data products and automation, while translating ambition into practical, deliverable and governed use cases.
* Facilitate ideation sessions, product clinics, journey walkthroughs and design workshops that encourage stakeholders to rethink how processes, controls and decisions could be redesigned using AI and data.
* Build confidence and adoption across business teams by partnering with learning, engagement and change teams to deliver training, demos, playbooks, engagement plans and user enablement activities.
* Promote a product and value-led mindset across AI delivery teams, ensuring teams remain focused on user outcomes, measurable impact, adoption, continuous improvement and responsible innovation.
* Encourage a culture of curiosity, experimentation and disciplined execution, where teams are empowered to challenge legacy processes and explore ambitious but controlled uses of AI.
* Support the development of AI fluency across business stakeholders by sharing reusable examples, emerging use cases, lessons learned and practical patterns for applying AI to real business problems.

**Risk Management**

* Ensure AI use cases are shaped and delivered in line with enterprise AI governance, responsible AI, data, risk, compliance, security and regulatory expectations.
* Work with Product Owners and Business Owners to identify risks across the full product journey, including process risks, control gaps, data risks, adoption risks, operational risks, model risks and inappropriate automation risks.
* Partner with AI Governance, Risk, Compliance and assurance teams to ensure appropriate validation, explainability, bias assessment, control requirements, monitoring inputs and approval evidence are built into product delivery.
* Ensure AI-enabled process engineering does not compromise control effectiveness, accountability, data integrity, customer outcomes, regulatory expectations or operational resilience.
* Identify and manage delivery risks, dependency risks, value realisation risks, user adoption risks and operational readiness risks across the AI portfolio, escalating material issues where required.
* Ensure AI products are implemented with appropriate human oversight, usage boundaries, business readiness, control documentation, monitoring inputs and feedback mechanisms to support sustainable and controlled use.
* Use qualitative and quantitative performance insights to identify where deployed AI products may require refinement, additional controls, retraining, user education, redesign or retirement.

**Governance**

* Maintain transparent governance over the AI product portfolio, including roadmap status, prioritisation decisions, product journey reviews, delivery progress, adoption performance, value realisation and key risks.
* Ensure each AI use case has clear ownership across Product Owner, Business Owner, delivery team and governance stakeholders, with defined accountability for business outcomes, adoption, controls and value tracking.
* Provide regular reporting to senior stakeholders and governance forums through AI portfolio dashboards, value dashboards, ROI tracking reports, adoption metrics and portfolio performance updates.
* Support governance forums with evidence-based recommendations on prioritisation, investment, scaling, remediation, redesign or retirement of AI products.
* Maintain disciplined portfolio controls so AI initiatives are traceable, measurable, outcome-led and aligned to business priorities, responsible AI expectations and enterprise governance standards.
* Ensure product journey reviews, benefit cases, design decisions, user impacts, adoption evidence and value realisation outcomes are appropriately documented and available for management review.
* Create a continuous improvement governance loop where feedback from Product Owners, Business Owners, users, delivery teams and governance stakeholders is used to refresh the roadmap, backlog, adoption approach and value strategy.

**Key Deliverables**

* AI product roadmap & portfolio backlog (including generative & agentic AI initiatives) aligned to Risk & Compliance strategic priorities.
* End-to-end process re-engineering blueprint co-created with product/business owners (leveraging generative & agentic AI) to transform key Risk & Compliance processes.
* Central AI use case intake & prioritization framework ensuring value-driven selection and disciplined stage-gate development of AI solutions.
* AI adoption strategy & integration plan (with clear adoption KPIs) to drive and measure widespread usage of new AI and data tools across Risk & Compliance teams.
* Business enablement playbook & training modules to build R&C team proficiency and trust in advanced AI tools (e.g., generative & agentic AI solutions).
* AI value measurement framework & dashboards tracking qualitative and quantitative benefits (productivity, risk reduction, ROI) delivered by deployed AI initiatives.
* AI governance compliance documentation and requisite risk & compliance approvals for each AI product, evidencing Responsible AI and regulatory adherence.
* Executive portfolio performance reports for R&C leadership highlighting AI-driven value creation, adoption progress, and future advanced AI opportunities.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key Stake Holders**

* AI Engineering Solution development
* Data & Analytics Data products and datasets
* GenAI Specialists Prompt design and context engineering
* AI Assurance Model validation and governance
* AI Operations Monitoring and lifecycle management
* Business Units AI adoption and value realisation

**Skills And Experience**

* Experience in product management, data analytics, or digital transformation
* Strong knowledge of risk, compliance, or financial services operations
* Ability to operate at the intersection of business, data, and technology
* Strong stakeholder engagement and strategic thinking capabilities

**About Standard Chartered**
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
  
  
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
  
  
**Together We**

* Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
* Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
* Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

**What We Offer**
**In line with our Fair Pay Charter,**
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  
  

* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: HRIS Product Owner (Time & Absence Mgmt)
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
The Workday Product Owner for a part of the Workday capabilities, with the objective of providing optimal technology support for our HR strategy, driving employee experience and improving HR efficiency and effectiveness.
  
  
In working closely with the HR function, the transformation office and external partners, the role is responsible to understand, challenge and translate Time Mgmt business requirements into effective solutions, by combining technology capabilities with smart process design, clear roles, responsibilities and data definitions. This straddles the whole life cycle, from strategy and architecture work, proactively bringing in ideas and planning out a roadmap, over focused delivery of projects, to ensuring a proper handover to production, periodic monitoring of effective usage and compliance, as well as supporting the ongoing maintenance and evolution.

* Translate HR business requirements into scalable and sustainable technology solutions within Workday Time Off, Leave of Absence and Time Tracking.
* Lead the analysis, design, configuration, and documentation of Workday Time Mgmt solutions, ensuring compliance with internal policies and best practices.
* Facilitate design and discovery workshops with stakeholders to define optimal solutions while considering platform capabilities, architectural standards, and long-term maintainability.
* Independently configure and maintain Workday functionality across the relevant domains, including supporting testing activities.
* Collaborate with internal IT teams and external vendors to deliver enhancements and issue resolution.
* Continuously monitor new Workday features and releases, proactively identifying opportunities to enhance HR processes and deliver additional value to the organization.
* Define and maintain the product roadmap for the respective Workday domain, prioritizing enhancements and initiatives using agile delivery methodologies.
* Establish and enforce governance and design standards to maintain the integrity, scalability, and security of the overall Workday platform, in close collaboration with other HRIS product owners.
* Enable operational excellence by supporting the creation of training materials and knowledge articles, ensuring first-level support teams are equipped to handle common inquiries and routine maintenance tasks.
* Act as the second-level functional and technical support for the assigned Workday domains, investigating complex issues and coordinating escalations with Workday or external partners when necessary.
* Manage periodic reconciliations and maintenance activities related to Time Mgmt.

Qualifications: Education, Experience
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Information Technology, alternatively a strong background in Workday Time Off, Leave of Absence and Time Tracking
* Proven experience (> 3 years) in Workday Time Mgmt solutions; certification is a plus
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business requirements into system configurations
* Excellent project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across various teams

If you are a strategic thinker with a passion for leveraging technology to drive HR excellence, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity. Join us in shaping the future of our HRIS landscape and making a meaningful impact on our organization's success.
  
  
Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.
