**Who are we?**
RZR Global is an AI-driven company specializing in mobile advertising solutions designed to fuel revenue growth. We leverage AI to discover audiences in a privacy-first environment through trillions of contextual bidding signals and proprietary behavioral models. Our audience engagement platform includes creative strategy and execution. We handle 5 million mobile ad requests per second from over 10 billion devices, driving performance for both publishers and brands. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA, with a global presence across the United States, EMEA, and APAC.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Director/Senior Director of Product Management to lead the strategy and execution for our DSP Platform,Connected TV (CTV) product line and new initiative . This role owns the foundations that make the DSP scalable and self-serve (campaign workflows, bidding/pacing primitives, reporting/measurement surfaces, APIs, experimentation), while also driving CTV-specific capabilities (supply integrations, deal mechanics, creative standards, measurement, brand safety, and performance).
  
  
You will operate at the intersection of engineering, data/ML, ad operations, supply partnerships, and revenue teams, translating market needs into platform bets and shipping roadmaps that improve scale, performance, reliability, and margin. The ideal candidate has deep programmatic advertising experience (especially CTV), strong platform product instincts, and a track record of building and leading high-performing PM teams.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Product Strategy & Roadmap (Platform + CTV)
  
  

* Define and communicate a 12-24 month product vision for DSP Platform and CTV aligned with company OKRs (revenue growth, margin, scale, retention).
* Own the roadmap and prioritization across platform investments and CTV-specific capabilities (supply, deals, measurement, creative, policy).
* Build business cases for major initiatives and decide build vs buy vs partner.

**Sprint Planning & Delivery Monitoring**

* Lead sprint planning and backlog grooming for Platform and CTV squads: define sprint goals, prioritize work, clarify scope, confirm capacity, and manage cross-team dependencies.
* Ensure stories are execution-ready with clear acceptance criteria, instrumentation requirements, rollout plans, and a shared Definition of Ready/Done.
* Monitor sprint delivery health using lightweight metrics (commit vs complete, velocity trends, cycle time, blocked work) and drive corrective actions (re-prioritization, scope management, escalation of blockers).
* Facilitate sprint reviews and retrospectives to improve predictability, quality, and team health; convert learnings into backlog actions and process improvements.

DSP Platform Ownership (Foundational Capabilities)
  
  

* Drive improvements in campaign creation & management (self-serve UX, bulk tools, validations, rules).
* Own bidding & decisioning primitives (targeting, frequency, pacing, budget control, bid modifiers).
* Improve experimentation & measurement surfaces (A/B testing, lift frameworks, reporting truth sources).
* Evolve reporting & insights (near-real-time performance, diagnostics, alerting, finance reconciliation).
* Own APIs & integrations (advertiser/agency workflows, trafficking, data onboarding).
* Partner with engineering to set and maintain reliability, latency, and throughput SLOs for platform-critical systems.

CTV Product Leadership (Demand + Supply + Measurement)
  
  

* Own end-to-end CTV buying experience: inventory access, deal support (PMP/PG), targeting, creative QA, brand safety, and measurement integrations.
* Partner with Supply/Partnerships and AdOps to expand CTV reach while protecting quality (fraud mitigation, allow/block controls, supply-path insights).
* Ensure compatibility and operational excellence across industry standards

Cross-Functional Leadership & GTM
  
  

* Align Sales, CS, Solutions, and Marketing on packaging, positioning, and enablement for CTV and platform capabilities.
* Build a feedback loop with top customers/agency trading desks and use it to guide roadmap choices.
* Establish a strong operating cadence: roadmap reviews, launch readiness, post-launch adoption tracking, QBRs.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Manage and mentor PMs (or build the team), ensuring clear ownership boundaries, high-quality PRDs, and success metrics.
* Raise the bar on product craft: discovery, validation, experimentation, metrics, and decision memos.

**What are we looking for?**

* 8+ years of product management experience, including 3+ years leading PMs (or equivalent leadership scope).
* Proven track record building platform products (APIs, core services, workflow systems) with measurable adoption and reliability outcomes.
* Strong programmatic advertising domain knowledge: DSP mechanics (auctions, pacing, frequency, targeting, optimization, reporting, measurement) and CTV specifics (supply dynamics, deal types, creative constraints, brand safety, fraud patterns).
* Ability to work deeply with engineering/data teams; comfort with event-driven systems, data pipelines, experimentation design, and performance metrics.
* Strong executive communication: crisp narratives, tradeoffs, stakeholder alignment, and decision making under ambiguity.
* Experience owning product outcomes tied to business goals (revenue, margin, retention, platform cost).

**RZR is an equal opportunity employer**
RZR is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. title: Founder's Office
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
  
  
  

* Role type: Full time
* Location: Remote
* Working with: CEO and Cofounder

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
  
  
**About The Role**
You’ll work closely with the founders on some of the most important problems at the company.
  
  
There isn’t a fixed lane for this role. What you work on will depend on what the company needs at the time. That could mean figuring out why a product isn’t growing, launching a new product or market, improving an internal process, working with customers, researching a new opportunity, or taking on a project that simply doesn’t have an obvious owner yet.
  
  
This is a hands-on role. We’re not looking for someone whose job ends at analysing a problem and making a recommendation. You should be comfortable getting into the details and doing the work yourself.
  
  
As the company grows, the problems you work on will change. We expect the role to change with them.
  
  
What you’ll work on
  
  
Depending on the week, you might:
  
  
  

* Take a new idea from a rough hypothesis to something we can actually test
* Dig into a part of the business that isn’t working well, understand why, and fix it
* Work on growth for an existing product, including talking to customers, improving positioning, running experiments, or helping close important deals
* Research a new market, product, partnership, or business opportunity and decide whether it is worth pursuing
* Build a process or internal tool where none exists today
* Work with product and engineering to turn customer or business problems into product changes
* Take ownership of projects that cut across teams and would otherwise fall between the cracks
* Help the founders make decisions by getting to the underlying facts quickly

Some projects will last a few days. Others may become something you own for months.
  
  
What we’re looking for
  
  
  

* You’re good at figuring things out. You can take a vaguely defined problem, ask the right questions, and get to a useful answer without needing a detailed brief
* You’re comfortable doing the work yourself. If something requires talking to customers, going through data, writing copy, building a spreadsheet, or putting together a quick script, you’ll do it
* You have good business judgement. You can distinguish between something that is interesting and something that actually matters
* You’re comfortable with numbers and technology. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be able to work with data and use technology to make yourself more effective
* You communicate clearly. You can write well, explain what you’ve learned, and say when something isn’t working
* You take ownership. Once you take something on, the founders shouldn’t have to keep checking whether it is moving
* You care about details. A lot of this job involves noticing things other people miss and following through on them
* You’re comfortable with ambiguity. Priorities will change and you won’t always have a playbook to follow

We care less about whether you’ve had a “Founder’s Office” title before. You could come from startups, consulting, product, growth, operations, investing, or something else entirely. What matters is whether you can learn quickly and get useful things done.
  
  
What you get
  
  
You’ll work directly with the founders and get exposure to most parts of the company.
  
  
You’ll see how decisions get made, work on problems before they have dedicated teams around them, and have a lot of room to take ownership. If something you start becomes important enough, there’s a good chance you’ll continue to own it.
  
  
This role is a good fit for someone who eventually wants to build a company, run a business or product line, or become a generalist operator at an early-stage company.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director Product Management
description:
**About Target**
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.
  
  
Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.
  
  
Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.
  
  
**About Team & Role**
Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.
  
  
Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.
  
  
As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.
  
  
The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.
  
  
Further the role will be responsible for
  
  

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data-driven decision-making leveraging Digital-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

**Detailed Job Description**
Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.
  
  
You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution-related barriers.
  
  
You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.
  
  
You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.
  
  
Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.
  
  
**About You**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

title: Senior Category Manager
description:
**About AppsForBharat**

At AppsForBharat, we are building Sri Mandir, a platform that helps millions of devotees connect with their faith through technology. Our vision is to make religious and spiritual experiences more accessible by combining deep cultural understanding with innovative digital experiences.

We are looking for a
**Senior Category Manager–South Business**
to build and scale our South-focused puja business. This is an entrepreneurial role for someone who can own business outcomes end-to-end, make sharp commercial decisions, and build a differentiated category by understanding customer needs, rituals, product assortment, and pricing.

**The Role**

As the Senior Category Manager, you will own the South business P&L and drive its growth by building a relevant product catalog, defining pricing strategies, identifying new business opportunities, and improving app orders and customer conversion.

You will work closely with the puja calendar owner, marketing, creative, product, and retention teams, to translate regional rituals, festivals, and customer insights into commercially successful offerings.

This role offers the opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up, with significant ownership and the ability to shape category strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business & P&L Ownership**

* Own the end-to-end P&L for the South business, driving revenue growth, profitability, and sustainable business performance.
* Define business goals, key performance indicators, and category-level growth plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins, increase average order value (AOV), and drive repeat purchases.
* Track business performance, identify gaps, and take data-backed decisions to improve outcomes.

**2. Category Strategy & Catalog Development**

* Build and scale a differentiated South-focused puja catalog based on regional customer needs, rituals, and preferences.
* Define product assortment, SKUs, bundles, and offerings for key rituals, festivals, and everyday devotional needs.
* Identify underserved customer segments and new category opportunities.
* Work with relevant teams to evaluate product feasibility, availability, and operational readiness before launching new offerings.
* Continuously refine the catalog based on customer demand, sales performance, and emerging opportunities.

**3. Pricing & Commercial Strategy**

* Define pricing strategies for new and existing offerings, balancing customer value, competitiveness, and profitability.
* Run pricing experiments to understand customer willingness to pay and improve conversion.
* Evaluate product-level economics, margins, discounts, and promotional effectiveness.
* Develop strategies for bundling, upselling, and cross-selling to improve revenue per order.

**4. Growth & App Order Expansion**

* Drive growth in South business orders through relevant category initiatives and customer-focused offerings.
* Identify opportunities across app discovery, merchandising, conversion funnels, and customer journeys.
* Partner with product and growth teams to improve category visibility, conversion, and repeat engagement.
* Analyse customer behaviour and business data to identify growth levers and prioritise high-impact initiatives.

**5. Festival, Ritual & Consumer Insights**

* Partner closely with the puja calendar owner to understand upcoming festivals, regional rituals, and high-intent purchase occasions.
* Translate festival calendars and ritual insights into relevant products, bundles, campaigns, and launch plans.
* Develop a deep understanding of South Indian devotional practices and differences in customer preferences across regions.
* Use customer feedback, market research, and sales trends to continuously improve the category proposition.

**6. Cross-functional Execution**

* Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns, product communication, and festival-led initiatives.
* Work with product, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure smooth execution of category launches and business initiatives.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders and ensure timely execution of priorities.
* Take ownership of outcomes while operating with limited hand-holding in a fast-paced environment.

**What We're Looking For**

* **Category management experience:**
  Experience managing a category or business with clear ownership of commercial outcomes, revenue, or P&L.
* **Strong commercial acumen:**
  Ability to make sound decisions on pricing, assortment, margins, promotions, and business growth.
* **Entrepreneurial mindset:**
  Comfortable building from the ground up, navigating ambiguity, and taking end-to-end ownership.
* **Analytical thinking:**
  Ability to interpret business metrics, identify opportunities, and convert insights into actionable growth plans.
* **Customer-centricity:**
  Strong understanding of consumer behaviour and the ability to build offerings around customer needs.
* **Execution excellence:**
  Ability to work cross-functionally, manage multiple priorities, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* **Learning agility:**
  Curiosity to understand South Indian rituals, regional nuances, and devotional customer needs, even without prior domain expertise.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C, online marketplaces, or other consumer internet businesses.
* Experience managing a category or business with revenue and profitability targets.
* Exposure to assortment planning, pricing experiments, promotions, merchandising, and conversion optimization.
* Familiarity with South Indian markets, regional consumer behaviour, or devotional categories is an advantage, but not mandatory.

**Why Join Us?**

* Own and build a business with direct accountability for P&L and growth.
* Work at the intersection of consumer internet, commerce, and India's rich devotional ecosystem.
* Build differentiated offerings for a large and diverse customer base.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams and influence business strategy.
* Take on an entrepreneurial role with the opportunity to create meaningful, measurable impact.

* Full-time MBA or equivalent postgraduate management qualification from a leading global or Indian institution. Exceptional candidates with comparable experience are also encouraged to apply.
* Strong analytical ability, commercial judgment and comfort working with ambiguous business problems.
* Excellent executive communication and advanced PowerPoint skills, with the ability to turn complex information into clear, compelling leadership presentations.

* Intellectual honesty and the confidence to challenge assumptions constructively.

* Are intellectually curious, ambitious and eager to learn the business end to end.
* Bring structure to ambiguity and focus discussions on decisions and outcomes.
* Can challenge senior stakeholders respectfully, using evidence and sound business judgment.
* Are equally comfortable with data, executive communication and execution detail.
* Take ownership, handle sensitive information with discretion and deliver at pace.

title: Manager - AI GTM and Market Intelligence
description:
**About GoKwik**
GoKwik is a growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, enabling checkout optimization, RTO reduction, payments, retention, and post-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik powers 15,000+ merchants globally, processes ~$2 billion in GMV, and continues to strengthen its AI-powered infrastructure across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Most GTM teams wait for demand to declare itself. This role builds the systems that find it first. As Manager — AI GTM and Market Intelligence, you will own the engine that identifies high-fit D2C merchants before they raise a hand, the internal tools Marketing and Sales rely on daily to see what our spend is actually producing, and the proprietary data stories that establish GoKwik’s authority in the market. This is a builder’s role rather than an analyst’s: the output is working software and published research other teams depend on, not reports. You will use AI as your primary build leverage, partner closely with Demand Generation, Sales, Brand and PR, and own each system end to end — from the idea to the thing running in production.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* AI Outbound & Signal Pipeline - Own GoKwik’s outbound motion end to end: build the ICP from proprietary merchant data and third-party market sources, detect intent signals such as checkout migrations, funding rounds and founder activity, and convert them into AI-personalised outreach that reaches high-fit D2C brands before they enter the market.
* Marketing Intelligence Platform - Own the internal tools Marketing, Sales and CS run on: the funnel from lead to go-live, ad spend joined to closed deals for true cost-per-outcome, competitive share of voice, and self-serve AI reporting that removes the dependency on manual data pulls. Each tool ships with a user guide and must be actively used by the team it was built for.
* Data-Led Thought Leadership - Turn GoKwik’s proprietary transaction data into publishable industry research no competitor can replicate. Own the data and the narrative from first principles to final draft, in partnership with Brand and PR.
* Attribution & Funnel Integrity - Own how marketing performance is measured: canonical definitions for lead, MQL, SQL and go-live, campaign taxonomy and UTM governance, and distinct attribution for outbound and signal-sourced pipeline in Salesforce. Hold these definitions steady across Marketing, Sales and Finance when numbers are contested.
* Automation & Reliability - Run these systems as production software, not side projects. Own the scheduled jobs, monitoring and alerting that keep them trustworthy, and design alerts that stay quiet until something genuinely needs attention.
* Enablement & Documentation - Build for handover from day one. Every tool, dashboard and automated workflow carries written documentation, a named owner and a walkthrough session, so no system depends on one person’s context to keep running.

**Who You Are**

* 4–6 years of experience across growth, demand generation, marketing analytics, revenue operations or product, with a track record of building tools rather than only reporting on them.
* Demonstrable experience building working internal tools, automations or data products using AI as the primary build leverage. You should be able to walk us through something you shipped that other people depended on, and what broke along the way.
* Strong SQL and comfort interrogating a number to its source before it is acted on. Hands-on experience with Salesforce or a comparable CRM, and with a data warehouse.
* Commercial fluency in D2C, eCommerce, payments or B2B SaaS go-to-market. You understand what a lead, an MQL and a go-live mean, and why the definitions get argued about.
* Proven experience running outbound or lifecycle campaigns, including prospect research, segmentation, sequencing and reply handling.
* Excellent written communication. A large part of this role is explaining a number to a senior stakeholder who will act on it, and writing research that stands up to external scrutiny.
* Comfortable owning systems in production: when a scheduled job fails, you investigate rather than escalate.
* Hands-on experience with ad platforms and campaign measurement across Google, Meta or emerging AI ad surfaces is a strong plus.
* A computer science degree or a background as a software engineer is not required. What matters is the judgment to know what is worth building and the ability to direct AI tooling to build it correctly.

**Why GoKwik**
At GoKwik, you work at the intersection of go-to-market, product and data. This role sits on a foundation that already exists: a live platform of internal GTM products, an outbound engine with a scored universe of more than 16,000 D2C brands, and first-party transaction data across 15,000+ merchants that no competitor can replicate. You are not starting from a blank page, and you are not inheriting a backlog of requests — you are taking custody of systems people already use and deciding where they go next.
  
  
You get unusual autonomy and unusually direct exposure: the freedom to choose what gets built, a short line to senior stakeholders, and work that is visible externally through published research as well as internally through the tools leadership reviews. For someone who wants to build rather than brief, in a performance-driven team with real ownership from week one, there are few roles in Indian eCommerce with this much surface area.
  
  
**Required Skills**
AI stakeholder management Problem-solving marketing automation analytics Business growth

title: Creative Content Writer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking an imaginative and strategic Creative Content Writer / Copywriter who knows how to turn ideas into words that resonate and stick. At Zoodle Kid, we believe in storytelling that connects emotionally, communicates clearly, and drives engagement without sounding like a formulaic ad.

In this role, you will be the core voice behind our customer journeys crafting captivating ad hooks, high performing performance marketing copy, engaging organic social storytelling, and dynamic video scripts in both English and Kannada. You will work closely with our creative production, marketing, and pedagogy teams to articulate our mission of early childhood development to parents and educators.

Key Responsibilities

1. Performance Marketing & Ad Copywriting

* Write high-converting ad copy, attention-grabbing hooks, and actionable CTAs for digital campaigns across Meta (Facebook & Instagram), Google, YouTube, and display channels.
* A/B test varied communication angles, parent triggers, and pain points to systematically optimize click-through and conversion metrics.
* Develop persuasive copy for landing pages, promotional micro-campaigns, and product launches.

**2. Video Concepting & Scriptwriting**

* Ideate creative concepts and craft structured scripts for short-form video ads, reels, pedagogical explainers, parent testimonials, and brand films.
* Collaborate closely with the Video Production Manager and creative crew to align visual cues, presenter delivery, pacing, and on-screen graphics.
* Develop narrative treatments, voiceover scripts, and storyboard copy that communicate complex child development concepts simply and warmly.

3. Social Media & Organic Brand Storytelling

* Drive brand storytelling across social channels including Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube Community.
* Author relatable, educational, and share-worthy carousel copies, captions, and infographics tailored to modern parents.
* Maintain brand voice integrity, warmth, and consistency across all public communication touchpoints.

**4. Bilingual Content Adaptation (English & Kannada)**

* Write and adapt nuanced, culturally relevant copy fluently in both English and Kannada.
* Transcreate campaigns rather than translating literally, ensuring local cultural resonance, relatable colloquialisms, and emotional depth in Kannada communication.

**5. Collateral, Outreach & Email Copy**

* Draft engaging content for parent newsletters, email drip workflows, WhatsApp broadcast sequences, and community engagement initiatives.
* Write clear, intuitive copy for offline brochures, experiential event kits, and pedagogical literature.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Exceptional command over creative writing, storytelling, and conceptualization.
* Demonstrated ability to write punchy ad hooks, headlines, and conversion-focused copy.
* Strong understanding of video formats, pacing, visual transitions, and scripting structure.
* Native or professional working proficiency in both English and Kannada (verbal and written).
* Deep audience empathy—ability to speak authentically to parents and early childhood educators.

Strong time management and agility to handle simultaneous campaigns in a fast-paced environment.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Experience: 3+ years of professional copywriting, creative content writing, or digital advertising experience.
* Language Requirement: Professional proficiency in both English and Kannada is mandatory.
* Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating published campaign copy, social media traction, and produced video scripts is required.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mass Communication, Journalism, English, Advertising, Marketing, or related fields (proven writing track record prioritized over specific degrees).

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Performance Ad Metrics: Hook retention rate, click-through rates (CTR), and conversion performance of written ad sets.
* Organic Growth & Engagement: Engagement rates, shares, and audience retention on organic social posts and video content.
* Delivery & Turnaround: On-time delivery of scripts and campaign assets against the production calendar.
* Language & Brand Quality: Accuracy, tone consistency, and cultural resonance across both English and Kannada deliverables.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Content connects genuinely with parents and builds strong trust without feeling transactional.
* Ad copy and video scripts systematically produce top-performing creative hooks across digital channels.
* Video scripts translate seamlessly onto camera with minimal structural friction or rewrites.
* Kannada and English messaging resonate equally well with their respective target demographics.

Interested candidate can share their CV at meekha.gogoi@zoodlekid.com

Domain & Solutioning Leadership

Pre-Sales & Bid Support

Alliance & Partnership Management

title: Solutions Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

* Demonstrates intellectual curiosity, learning agility, and a growth mindset.

title: Manager, Program Management, Brand Protection
description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about protecting the world's most recognized brands and ensuring customers can shop with confidence on Amazon? Join the Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team — the central hub for addressing complex brand protection challenges across Amazon's global marketplace.
  
  
The IPP team designs and builds high-performance systems leveraging machine learning and cross-functional collaboration to identify, prevent, and remediate intellectual property abuse on behalf of rights owners worldwide. As the single-threaded owner for end-to-end brand protection solutions, IPP ingests and prioritizes critical brand pain points, conducts comprehensive root cause analysis, develops sustainable mechanisms, and drives continuous improvement across Amazon's brand protection ecosystem.
  
  
We are seeking a strategic, experienced Manager, Program Management to lead a team of program managers responsible for the strategy, execution, and cross-organizational integration of Brand Protection programs. This is a hybrid people-leadership and program-delivery role and you will own the performance, growth, and delivery output of your team while individually driving high-impact programs that turn reactive enforcement into proactive, scalable prevention, directly reducing brand abuse for rights owners globally.
  
  
This role operates in ambiguous, cross-functional environments where problem definition and strategy are not always predetermined. You will shape the direction of your team's work, define what success looks like, and build the organizational capability to deliver with senior leadership visibility.
  
  
This is a global role requiring effective communication and understanding of the diverse needs of international brands, operational teams, and stakeholders across countries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and develop a team of program managers, setting clear expectations, providing direct and constructive feedback, and coaching each team member to operate at the top of their level.
* Build a high-performing team culture centered on ownership, bias for action, and customer obsession fostering an environment where PgMs can tackle ambiguous, high-stakes problems independently.
* Establish team-level mechanisms (e.g., weekly business reviews, program health checks, retrospectives) that drive operational rigor and continuous improvement.
* Develop and execute comprehensive strategies to address complex, high-ambiguity brand protection challenges, owning the most critical and cross-cutting programs.
* Analyze defect trends, abuse patterns, policy gaps, and process inefficiencies to design scalable mechanisms that support evolving business needs and strengthen Amazon's enforcement posture.
* Establish key mechanisms, dashboards, and self-service tooling that eliminate manual dependencies and enhance Amazon's brand protection capabilities at scale.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning Product, Engineering, Operations, Science, and Policy teams across multiple geographies, operating as a thought leader in the IP protection space.
* Influence roadmap prioritization across multiple organizations making trade-off recommendations, surfacing the right inputs for leadership decisions, and ensuring your team's programs are integrated into the broader Brand Protection strategy.
* Author and present program updates to senior leadership, translating complex cross-org dependencies into crisp narratives and actionable decision points.
* Build and maintain deep team-level expertise in brand abuse and enforcement strategy, ensuring the team can conduct rigorous deep dives to derive insights about emerging abuse vectors across Amazon's worldwide stores.

**About The Team**
The vision of Intellectual Property Protections (IPP) team is to ensure every Brand’s catalog (ASINs and offers) is clean with no IP infringements while minimizing friction for the Sellers. We do this by proactively identifying infringing content on ASINs and offers through various signals including Brand provided data, Seller behavior, Brand licensee relationships, Brand/Seller appeals, etc. We build highly transparent systems that communicate the impact of our protections clearly and unambiguously to the Brand Owner and earn their trust.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience managing teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* Master's degree
* Knowledge of SQL

In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship-building skills, intrinsic problem-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time-to-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed-price, milestone-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI-DLC (AI-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes-based governance frameworks for AI-native builds, and steering multi-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

**About The Team**

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Engineering Director, Firmware, Software and Digital Systems, Residential Fire
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
**Title:**
**Engineering Director, Firmware, Software and Digital Systems**
**, Residential Fire**
**Location:**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Employment Type**
: Fulltime
  
  
**Position Summary**
Kidde Global Solutions is seeking an Engineering Director to lead its Firmware, Software, Digital, and Quality Engineering teams in Hyderabad, India. This leader will build and develop multidisciplinary teams responsible for embedded firmware, connected products, cloud services, mobile applications, and software quality for Kidde's consumer residential fire and life safety portfolio.
  
  
The Engineering Director will define technology roadmaps, establish scalable platforms and engineering practices, and partner with global Engineering, Product Management, and Program Management leaders to deliver innovative, safe, reliable, and connected products. The role is accountable for organizational capability development, technical excellence, resource planning, and engineering execution across global design centers, while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technology & Product Development**

* Define technology strategies, roadmaps, and platform architectures supporting Kidde's residential fire and life safety product portfolio.
* Partner with Product Management, Program Management, Systems Engineering, and Architecture teams to translate business objectives into executable technical solutions.
* Drive the development and delivery of connected products, cloud services, mobile applications, and digital solutions through global cross-functional collaboration.
* Evaluate and apply emerging technologies, including AI and advanced analytics, to improve products, customer experiences, and engineering productivity

**Engineering Excellence & Governance**

* Establish common platforms, reusable architectures, engineering processes, development tools, and verification practices across global design centers.
* Drive technical excellence through architecture governance, design reviews, modern development practices, and engineering automation.
* Ensure products meet performance, quality, reliability, safety, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead software quality and secure development initiatives, including validation, reliability engineering, and cybersecurity best practices. Quality, Cybersecurity & Compliance.

**Site & Organizational Leadership**

* Serve as the Residential Fire Business Unit Site Leader for Hyderabad, providing leadership for local engineering operations, employee engagement, organizational growth, and talent development.
* Lead and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary organization of 45+ engineers, managers, and technical professionals spanning firmware, software, cloud, mobile, digital technologies, and quality assurance.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, quality, safety, and integrity.
* Partner with global engineering leaders to establish Hyderabad as a strategic engineering center and center of excellence for digital engineering disciplines.

**Business & Operational Leadership**

* Develop annual operating plans, resource strategies, budgets, and organizational growth plans aligned with business objectives.
* Establish engineering metrics, operating reviews, and accountability mechanisms to drive execution, predictability, and continuous improvement.
* Manage strategic partnerships with external development organizations, technology providers, and key suppliers.
* Drive cross-functional alignment across Engineering, Product Management, Program Management, Operations, and Quality to deliver business objectives and product roadmaps.

**Required Qualifications**
**Education**

* BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

**Experience & Leadership**

* 15+ years of progressive engineering experience, including senior leadership roles within embedded, connected, cloud-enabled, or industrial product development organizations.
* Proven success leading large, multidisciplinary engineering organizations, including firmware, software, cloud, mobile, quality, and systems engineering teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing globally distributed engineering organizations and collaborating effectively across cultures, regions, and time zones.
* Strong people leadership capabilities, including organizational development, coaching, succession planning, talent management, and building high-performing teams.
* Proven track record delivering complex products and technology platforms from concept through commercialization and lifecycle support.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep expertise in embedded firmware and software development for connected products, including IoT architectures, cloud-enabled systems, and end-to-end product delivery.
* Strong knowledge of wireless and connected technologies, including Wi-Fi, BLE, Matter/Zigbee, cloud connectivity, serial communications, and device-to-device networking architectures.
* Hands-on experience with embedded software technologies, including C/C++, RTOS, Embedded Linux, distributed systems, and scalable cloud-connected applications.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle processes, engineering governance, quality systems, cybersecurity practices, and secure product development methodologies.
* Experience establishing platform architectures, reusable frameworks, and engineering standards that enable scalable product development across multiple teams and geographies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Technology Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Experience in life safety, safety-critical, regulated, or high-reliability industries.
* Experience leading cloud, mobile, digital platform, software quality, cybersecurity, or digital engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing modern engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps, AI/ML-enabled development tools, or advanced analytics within products and engineering processes.

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

title: Senior Technical Consultant: Salesforce(Automotive Experience)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**Executive Summary & Organizational Context**
Within Salesforce Professional Services, the Senior Technical Consultant — Automotive Cloud role occupies a vital strategic position at the bleeding edge of AI CRM and automotive industry digital transformation. As automotive enterprises navigate sweeping market disruptions—from electric vehicle transitions and direct-to-consumer sales models to connected vehicle telemetry and autonomous fleets—this role serves as the bridge between pioneering platform capabilities and real-world enterprise execution.
  
  
Salesforce stands as the #1 AI CRM, defining an ecosystem where humans with agents drive customer success together. It is an organizational environment where ambition meets action, technology meets trust, and innovation functions as an operating principle. As Salesforce leads global workforce transformation in the agentic era, the practice actively seeks Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through artificial intelligence, driving rapid innovation, and keeping core values like trust at the center of every client commitment. Operating in a paradigm where Agentforce represents the future of autonomous and assisted AI interactions, incoming talent directly shapes the trajectory of Salesforce by translating cutting-edge platform capabilities into measurable enterprise value.
  
  
The Senior Technical Consultant operates as a hands-on advisor positioned directly at the intersection of Salesforce platform architecture and deep automotive domain knowledge. Covering an enterprise scope that spans Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers, the consultant acts as the trusted technical voice for client leadership navigating complex digital transformations. In this capacity, the consultant leads critical work streams within enterprise engagements by architecting solutions, guiding technical implementation teams, presenting and defending technical designs before client governing bodies, evaluating complex solution trade-offs, proactively mitigating architectural risk, and seeing issues through to complete resolution.
  
  
Building upon this organizational mission, the following section outlines the specific technical responsibilities, domain implementations, and high-impact work streams that define daily execution in this role.
  
  

* Strategic Impact & Core Responsibilities The Senior Technical Consultant accelerates time-to-value, mitigates architecture-level risk, and drives sustained enterprise value across high-stakes customer engagements. By combining hands-on technical design with strategic risk management, the role ensures that automotive clients successfully translate complex platform capabilities into resilient, scalable operational outcomes. Technical Architecture & Work Stream Leadership
* Lead the end-to-end technical design and delivery of dedicated work streams within the automotive domain, maximizing the capabilities of Salesforce Automotive Cloud and adjacent platform components.
* Author and govern application and technical design documents (ADD/TDD) that strictly adhere to Salesforce architecture best practices while seamlessly aligning with the client's broader enterprise ecosystem—including legacy Dealer Management Systems (DMS), vehicle telemetry data pipelines, and connected vehicle cloud infrastructure.
* Establish and enforce robust technical standards across the full Salesforce stack, guiding project teams on optimal integration patterns (REST, SOAP, and event-driven architectures), environment management frameworks, deployment pipelines, and automated testing strategies.

**Core Automotive Domain Implementation**
Architect and deploy tailored, enterprise-grade capabilities across primary functional automotive work streams:
  
  

* Vehicle Lifecycle Management: Implement end-to-end tracking of vehicle assets from manufacturing assembly through inventory pipeline, retail sale, warranty period, and secondary market disposition—integrating telematics data to create a living, single source of truth for every VIN.
* Dealer Network Operations: Streamline OEM-to-dealer interactions by unifying lead distribution, co-op sales programs, inventory sharing, and warranty claim processing, ensuring consistent brand standards and transparent operational visibility across distributed retail networks.
* Fleet Management: Construct scalable multi-vehicle management frameworks that support commercial fleet accounts, enabling centralized tracking of preventative maintenance schedules, driver assignments, telematics alerts, and contract lifecycles.
* Service Scheduling & Retention: Connect vehicle telematics and diagnostic trouble codes (DTCs) directly into intelligent dealer service scheduling workflows, driving proactive maintenance outreach, reducing customer friction, and maximizing dealer workshop utilization.
* Customer Journey Orchestration: Unify siloed customer data across OEM marketing, dealership sales, and aftersales service channels to execute personalized, multi-channel customer journeys that enhance lifetime customer value and brand loyalty.

**AI-Native Delivery & Future-Proofing**

* Drive continuous up-skilling in AI Fluency and AI-native delivery practices, leveraging Agentforce capabilities to power domain-specific automotive use cases such as intelligent dealer assist, connected vehicle conversational agents, and predictive service recommendations.
* Operationalize advanced AI developer tools and assistants—specifically Agentforce Vibes, Cursor, and Claude—into daily delivery workflows to streamline complex APEX code generation, automate unit test creation, accelerate technical design drafting, and maintain superior delivery velocity and code quality.

**Advisory, Risk Management & Mentorship**

* Provide hands-on advisory leadership during critical project inflection points, rapidly troubleshooting complex technical issues, performing root-cause analyses, and driving technical impediments through to full resolution.
* Manage high-stakes client expectations by negotiating complex technical solutions and architecture trade-offs across executive client leadership, OEM technology groups, and third-party systems integrators.
* Actively mentor junior consultants and technical architects, instilling technical rigor and sharing domain assets to grow and scale the broader Automotive Services Practice.

Executing these technical responsibilities and high-impact work streams requires a proven foundation of enterprise architecture experience, platform mastery, and specialized automotive domain acumen.
  
  

* Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience To maintain high standards of technical delivery and domain credibility, candidates must demonstrate a rigorous combination of enterprise architecture depth, hands-on implementation experience, and specialized automotive sector intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Industry Cloud Delivery: 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce delivery experience with Automotive Cloud or a directly adjacent industry cloud (Manufacturing Cloud or Consumer Goods Cloud), backed by demonstrated automotive domain delivery artifacts.
* Architecture & Delivery Experience: 7+ years of total experience as a Lead Developer or Solution Architect, with a proven track record of delivering complex software solutions within mid-to-large-scale enterprise organizations.
* Automotive Domain Acumen: Deep domain knowledge of core automotive business processes, including vehicle sales and financing, aftersales service operations, dealer network management, commercial fleet operations, or connected vehicle data platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture Mastery: Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise integration patterns (REST/SOAP web services, asynchronous event-driven architectures), Single Sign-On (SSO) federations, Master Data Management (MDM) strategies, and Data Lake/CDP connections.
* Specialized Systems Integration: Proven expertise integrating Salesforce with specialized automotive applications, including Dealer Management System (DMS) platforms (e.g., CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion), telematics ingestion platforms, and proprietary OEM back-end systems.
* Methodology & Process Design: Demonstrated proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies, supported by a track record of analyzing, designing, and optimizing complex business processes through technology.
* Executive Communication & Engagement: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate, present, and defend complex technical architectures before developer teams, business steering committees, and C-suite executives.
* Autonomy & Leadership: Ability to operate independently, navigate high levels of organizational ambiguity, and drive project outcomes as a self-starter.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Business, or a related technical field.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct engagement experience on Salesforce Automotive Cloud implementations, with deep operational mastery of the Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, or Fleet Management modules.
* Hands-on experience with connected vehicle platforms, IoT edge device integrations, or real-time telematics data ingestion into the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Advanced experience leveraging Salesforce Data Cloud (CDP) to build real-time, unified customer and vehicle data profiles that power personalized experiences.
* Practical exposure to cutting-edge Agentforce implementations within automotive contexts, such as AI-driven service advisors, dealer-facing conversational chatbots, and predictive maintenance agents.
* Direct experience consulting with OEMs, Tier-1 automotive suppliers, or dealership groups at enterprise scale.
* Existing Salesforce Industry Cloud accreditations or certifications in Manufacturing Cloud, Automotive Cloud, or adjacent vertical solutions.

While these baseline and preferred qualifications establish a candidate's operational readiness, long-term success in the practice requires continuous technical credentialing and structured platform upskilling.
  
  

* Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning Maintaining technical mastery within the rapidly evolving Agentforce ecosystem requires an unyielding commitment to continuous learning and formal platform credentialing. Salesforce Professional Services invests heavily in continuous talent development to ensure consultants remain ahead of platform innovation curves.

**Target Certification Requirements**
Candidates are expected to formally achieve the following five Salesforce certifications within their first 3 months in the role:
  
  

* Certified Platform App Builder
* Certified Platform Developer I
* Certified Agentforce Specialist
* Certified Sharing & Visibility Designer
* Certified Integration Architect

*Note: Holding any of the above Salesforce credentials prior to onboarding is considered highly beneficial and serves as a primary key differentiator during the candidate evaluation and selection process.*
Beyond technical certifications and architectural expertise, sustained consulting excellence in high-stakes enterprise environments depends on core leadership behaviors and alignment with corporate values.
  
  

* Leadership Qualities & Core Values To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Senior Technical Consultant must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust. Core Leadership Pillars
* PASSION: Demonstrates an unyielding commitment to Customer Success. The consultant exhibits deep personal investment in seeing automotive clients succeed, transforming complex technology implementations into tangible market wins and measurable business outcomes for OEM stakeholders and dealer networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Maintains a continuous learning mindset. The consultant approaches every complex enterprise engagement, client interaction, and architectural challenge with humbleness, curiosity, and openness—actively dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in automotive technology and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives amidst high levels of uncertainty and rapid industry transformation. Recognizing that structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption are permanent constants in the automotive sector, the consultant remains poised, agile, and decisive when navigating ambiguous project environments.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*

title: Project Manager / Project Director – Regulatory Reporting
description:
**Highlight of the engagement opportunity**

* Nature of role: Full time
* Number of years of experience expected: o Project Manager: 8–12 years, including at least 5 years in regulatory reporting / RegTech delivery. o Project Director: 12–18+ years, including at least 7 years in regulatory reporting / RegTech delivery, with proven ownership of delivery, revenue, and client relationships. o Candidates without direct regulatory reporting delivery experience will not be shortlisted, regardless of general project management pedigree.

**A. Delivery and project leadership**

* • Play a key role in delivering complex change projects in the financial and regulatory reporting space, and/or demonstrate a track record of delivering continuous process improvements through technology and non-technology solutions.
* Independently lead and manage implementation engagements with leading banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, and insurance companies, covering automation of regulatory and risk reporting.

**B. Product leadership**

* Lead product and project delivery in parallel across Acies regulatory reporting products and client implementations.
* Translate regulatory requirements and client needs into product configuration, functional specifications, and delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure reporting outputs are audit-ready, with clear data lineage, controls, reconciliation, and traceability.
* Work with product, engineering, and domain teams to prioritize enhancements and reduce time-to-implementation.

**C. Practice, people, and business (Project Director emphasis)**

* Lead and be responsible for team mentoring, project management, and client delivery.
* Own project revenue, margin, and resource utilization for assigned engagements.
* Generate business from existing clients and support pre-sales, proposals, and solutioning for new clients.
* Build and scale the regulatory reporting delivery practice, including hiring, capability building, and reusable accelerators.
* Represent Acies in client leadership forums and industry discussions on regulatory reporting.

* **Period of engagement:**
  Full time
* **Probation period:**
  6 months
* **Compensation:**
  Compensation varies depending on the skill, fitment and role played by the person. Compensation discussions will take place post the selection process.
* **Performance incentives:**
  Typically, all roles at Acies have a performance incentive. Specific aspects will be discussed during the compensation discussion
* **Leave:**
  22 working days a year. Additional leaves for national holidays, sick leaves, maternity and paternity, bereavement and studies vary based on the city and country of engagement.
* **Other benefits:**
  Other employment benefits including medical insurance will be informed during the compensation discussion.
* **Career growth for full-time roles:**

* **Career opportunities for part-time roles:**
  Conversion of part-time roles to full-time roles depends on both performance of the individual and business needs. You are encouraged to ask about the prospects as you interact with Acies personnel during the selection process.
* **Global mobility:**
  Acies encourages mobility across our offices. Such mobility is, however, subject to business needs and regulations governing immigration and employment in various countries.

**Selection process:**

We seek to be transparent during the selection process. While the actual process may vary from the process indicated below, the key steps involved are as follows:

1. Domain and delivery interview: Assessment of regulatory reporting delivery experience, regulators covered, platforms implemented, and scale of projects led.
2. Case study / problem-solving round: Regulatory reporting implementation scenario covering planning, data management, computation, reporting outputs, risks, and stakeholder management.
3. Client and leadership fit interview: Ownership, client relationship skills, team leadership, and commercial acumen.
4. Final discussion on career and compensation: Post final selection, a separate discussion will be set up to discuss compensation and career growth. The number of interview rounds may increase depending on the criticality and seniority of the role involved.

**Preparation required:**

It is recommended that you prepare on the following aspects before the selection process:

* Understanding of products and exposures in the financial services industry (Banks / NBFC / Insurance).
* Understanding of the product development and implementation lifecycle.
* Understanding of RBI, IRDAI, and SEBI reporting requirements.
* Understanding of Middle East regulatory reporting requirements (CBUAE, SAMA, CBB, QCB, CBO, CBK / CMA Kuwait).
* Familiarity with regulatory reporting platforms such as AxiomSL, OneSumX, Vermeg, SAS, OFSAA, or Moody's.
* Regulatory frameworks including Basel III/IV, IFRS 9, LCR, NSFR, ALM, capital adequacy, NPA / asset classification, and insurance reporting.

For any additional queries you may have, you can send a LinkedIn InMail to us, connect with us at https://www.acies.consulting/careers-apply.html or e-mail us at careers@acies.holdings.

**How to reach us:**

Should you wish to apply for this job, please reach out to us directly through LinkedIn or apply on our website career page - https://www.acies.consulting/careers-apply.html

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

Experience: 5+ years

Work mode- Work from office (Hybrid)

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to run day-to-day delivery across one or more engineering pods. This is an execution-first role: you own sprint health, team coordination, stakeholder communication, and issue resolution — keeping pods moving without needing to be pulled by a Delivery Head on routine matters. You have enough of a technical background to read a sprint board intelligently, ask the right questions in a stand-up, and catch when an estimate doesn't add up. What sets you apart is the ability to communicate with clarity upward to clients and account leads, and inward to engineers and BAs, translating between both worlds without distortion.

Sprint management: Own sprint planning, daily stand-ups,sprint reviews, and retrospectives for one or more agile pods;track commitments, surface blockers early, and maintain a clean backlog with the BA and tech lead.

Delivery coordination: Coordinate work across engineers, QA,BAs, and external dependencies; manage task assignment and priority shifts within the sprint without waiting for escalation.

Stakeholder communication: Prepare and deliver clear, concise,sprint status updates for internal delivery heads and client-facing reports; translate technical progress into business-readable language and flag risks before they become issues.

Risk and issue tracking: Maintain an active risk and issue log;own the resolution path for blockers within your pod and escalate cross-pod or client-level issues with context and a proposed course of action.

Technical liaison: Work closely with tech leads to understand development dependencies, estimate accuracy, and release readiness; challenge assumptions grounded in delivery data, not just instinct.

Metrics and reporting: Track sprint velocity, bug open/close rates, release frequency, and scope change; produce concise delivery dashboards for internal and client review on a regular cadence.

Scope and change management: Identify and document scope changes as they arise; assess impact on timeline and budget before committing the pod to additional work.

Onboarding and team continuity: Support onboarding of new pod members; maintain runbooks, sprint artefacts, and process documentation so delivery continuity is not person-dependent.

Client coordination: Manage day-to-day client touchpoints clarifying requirements, confirming acceptance criteria,scheduling demos, following up on open decisions — with minimal supervision.
