description:
**Job Description:**
**About us\***
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Quantitative Finance (QF) is part of the Corporate Treasury function, which is a part of the Chief Financial Officer organization. The QF team develops analytical solutions using complex quantitative and financial methodologies to measure value and risk. These analytics are executed on a high-performance, computational environment utilizing over 23,000 cores and executing 115,000 jobs per day. The team provides end-to-end analytics support from quantitative research and development to model implementation and platform execution. The role interacts closely with Treasury partners (BSM, GLM, ECM, etc.), Corporate Investments (CIO), Global Risk Analytics (GRA) and other stakeholders to develop analytical solutions, drive platform modernization, strengthen data governance, and support production operations.
  
  
**Job Description\***
This role requires strong critical thinking skills to address complex challenges facing the company and financial services industry, with an emphasis on attention to detail, collaboration, and effective communication.
  
  
Treasury provides an opportunity to gain broad knowledge about the company and its many businesses. Your day-to-day experience will be varied and challenging and provide hands-on responsibilities and opportunities to expand your expertise across multiple disciplines within Treasury and Quantitative Finance.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
* Good organizational and time-management abilities, with attention to detail and the capacity to handle multiple projects.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or a related field is preferred.

title: Senior Engineering Manager – Technical & Projects
description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**
**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**
**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
Senior Manager – Technical & Projects
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai, India
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced electrical engineering professional to lead complex power system consulting and engineering projects for clients across the globe.
  
  
As
**Senior Manager – Technical & Projects**
, you will provide technical leadership across power system studies, electromagnetic transient analysis, and EMI/EMC studies. You will be responsible for leading project execution, reviewing technical deliverables, providing engineering recommendations, managing client relationships, and ensuring projects are delivered to a high standard, on time and within budgeted effort.
  
  
The role requires strong expertise in power system analysis, hands-on experience with engineering simulation software such as
**ETAP, PSCAD, CDEGS, or equivalent tools**
, and the ability to translate complex technical analysis into practical recommendations for clients.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Engineering
  
  

* Lead and execute complex engineering studies across one or more of the following areas:

+ Power System Studies: Load flow, short circuit, motor starting, transient stability, relay coordination, arc flash, harmonic analysis, and renewable energy systems including solar, wind, and battery energy storage.
+ Electromagnetic Transient Studies: Insulation coordination, lightning surge analysis, GIS switching studies, and related switching transient analysis.
+ EMI/EMC Studies: Electromagnetic interference and compatibility assessments for complex electrical environments, including oil & gas facilities, railways, and other industrial applications.

* Utilize engineering simulation tools such as ETAP, PSCAD, CDEGS, or equivalent software to perform detailed analysis and develop technically sound solutions.
* Review electrical power systems, distribution networks, industrial control systems, and renewable energy installations for technical integrity and compliance with applicable IEC, IEEE, and client standards.
* Develop engineering recommendations for system design, operation, protection, optimization, and troubleshooting based on study results.
* Provide technical leadership in the investigation and resolution of electrical system issues, including system trips, equipment failures, and site incidents.
* Review technical reports, calculations, models, and other engineering deliverables to ensure quality, accuracy, and consistency.

Project & Client Management
  
  

* Own project execution from scope definition through completion, ensuring deliverables meet agreed scope, schedule, quality, and budget/man-hour requirements.
* Plan and manage project resources, priorities, risks, and technical deliverables.
* Monitor project progress and proactively address technical, schedule, or resource-related issues.
* Serve as a senior technical point of contact for clients and respond to technical queries with clear, accurate, and timely guidance.
* Present technical findings and recommendations to clients through reports, presentations, workshops, and technical meetings.
* Support business development activities, including technical discussions, proposals, estimates, and client presentations as required.

Team Leadership & Development
  
  

* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and project team members.
* Review and support the development of engineering methodologies, tools, templates, and best practices.
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, knowledge sharing, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Support capability development and knowledge transfer across the engineering team.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Significant professional experience in power system studies and electrical engineering consulting, preferably within industrial, utility, oil & gas, renewable energy, rail, or similar environments.
* Strong hands-on experience with ETAP and/or PSCAD; experience with CDEGS or equivalent engineering software is highly desirable.
* Strong understanding of electrical power systems, protection, system studies, and applicable IEC/IEEE standards.
* Demonstrated experience leading technically complex projects and managing project scope, schedules, and deliverables.
* Experience interacting directly with international clients and presenting technical findings and recommendations.
* Prior experience providing technical leadership or mentoring engineers.

**Desired Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex electrical system issues.
* Excellent technical report writing and presentation skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Effective project planning and organizational skills.
* Proactive approach to project and client management.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining quality and deadlines.
* Strong proficiency in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively within a global, multidisciplinary team.
* Willingness to travel internationally, as required for client meetings, workshops, and site assignments.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* High-quality engineering studies and deliverables delivered on time and within planned project effort.
* Strong technical credibility with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Effective resolution of complex power system and electrical engineering challenges.
* Successful development and mentoring of engineering talent.

title: Project Controller
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  

* Familiarization with the process of project control procedures
* Understanding Contract vis-à-vis project scope of work
* Developing Cost WBS structure and control budget for the project based on the approved estimate.
* Proactively monitor and communicate budget, actual status, and forecast costs/labor hours for projects monthly.
* Consolidate performance data to support performance measurement, data analysis, and cost forecasting.
* Assist in the development of project work plans and schedules.
* Create client and internal status reports that effectively communicate schedule status and identify critical path.
* Provide technical guidance to other project controls staff in project financial status
* Ensuring all financials are in order, preparing spreadsheets and a wide variety of routine cost analyses, cash flow, and other cost related evaluations.
* Set-up, monitor & report earned value progress measurement systems for projects, including analysis based on input from project leads
* Identify business acumen by identifying for us potential project problems early, report issues and problems to operations leadership, and work with project teams to address and implement recovery plans.
* Review of expenditure details, identifying incorrect charges, and commencement of the charge correction process will ensure our financials are accurate. To review, process, and track sub consultant invoices on various projects.
* Prepare and update project schedules and cost/resource loading them.
* Identify and drive optimizations in planning and execution of projects
* Advise Project Controls Lead and Project Leadership Team of any potential schedule issues and when necessary, provide guidance on corrective action and measures to mitigate any adverse trends.
* Develop and review schedule corrective actions and recovery plans and verify needed actions plans are implemented.
* Review project changes to evaluate detail schedule impact; responsible for quantifying and incorporating the effect and impact of approved changes in the overall schedule stewardship and reporting.
* Monitor and report on schedule implications of changes
* Support project team with ongoing project progress measurement and schedule analysis, reporting, and forecasting activities.
* Develop change management and maintaining change log.
* Support in monitoring of cost developments of engineering/vendors/contractors and develop the cost reports.
* Look for ways to reduce project costs and for ways to improve our work processes.
* Perform price estimation and price budgeting from contract commitment to fit the baseline program
* Provide planning / scheduling, and cost controlling mechanism for all projects which includes variation reporting, monitoring of milestone progress to the preparation of customer billing processes, etc.
* Ensure effective project implementation and utilize productive reports from the creation of WBS with the use of project management system to monitor the status of the project.
* Perform project costing related reporting to the team and management’s review monthly to ensure that expenditures are kept within the project budget.
* Performing and/or managing the analysis of cost and risks for projects with a focus on support of project management.
* Accountable for investment of project cost, and schedule and reports to the Project Manager of one or more projects during the planning and execution phase.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Graduate / Advanced degree in Engineering or other technical disciplines
* Experience in the infrastructure sector or in construction industry is highly preferable, with exposure in site engineering, project management, project planning, project costing, project scheduling, coordination, procurement and construction workflows.
* Knowledge in cost control tools and technics to drive /contribute project financial health, knowledge in Estimation, Project / Cost Controlling, Project Tracking, Project Scheduling
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of interdependency of underlying cost and schedule drivers.
* Demonstrate excellent understanding of the entire system of the business, relationship between productivity vs profitability
* Minimum of 7 years post qualification experience (PQE) in project control / planning or relevant sectors

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: Data Collection Transformation - Senior Associate
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
  
  
MSCI Sustainability & Climate Data collection team is involved in acquisition of Sustainability & Climate data at scale and QA of the collected data and responsible for establishing and maintaining highest level of data quality and standards across all datasets feeding our ESG products. As an Data Collection Transformation Associate, you will be responsible for delivering on initiatives as part of the S&C transformation agenda. The role focuses on large-scale collection setup & execution and as a Senior Associate, individual is expected to take ownership & drive the collection transformation project working in collaboration with collection team and internal stakeholders.
  
  
Your Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Insightful Research: Proactively source, analyze, and process global company disclosures, leveraging generative AI to extract meaningful insights across diverse data domains and models.
* Unlock the Power of Information: Work with a vast array of data sources—including annual reports, company websites, quantitative data feeds, web crawlers, and news articles—to transform unstructured information into actionable intelligence.
* Revolutionize Data Collection with AI: Design and implement AI-assisted, scalable models that streamline data sourcing from multiple channels, ensuring comprehensive coverage of issuers.
* Automate & Scale Data Methodologies: Develop innovative, automation-friendly data collection methodologies that convert unstructured data into structured insights through advanced AI-driven “electronification.”
* Engineer Next-Gen AI Models: Build and refine generative AI-powered data extraction models, ensuring continuous improvement in accuracy, efficiency, and performance.
* Lead & Optimize AI Agents: Manage, guide, and enhance AI agents, serving as a validation layer to improve outputs and refine AI-generated insights through expert feedback.
* Shape the Future of Data Operations: Partner with technology and transformation teams to design, optimize, and engineer cutting-edge data workflows and operational processes.
* Enhance Data Quality & Efficiency: Drive automation initiatives that improve data quality diagnostics, reducing manual intervention and increasing operational efficiency
* Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with internal stakeholders and downstream teams to understand data needs, define quality control frameworks, and ensure seamless data delivery.
* Engage with Companies & Clients: Review and process company feedback, address client queries, and contribute to a transparent, data-driven ecosystem that powers critical decision-making.

**Your Skills And Experience That Will Help You Excel**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Environmental Science, Data Science, or related interdisciplinary fields.
* 7–12 years of experience in large‑scale data collection, research, data operations, or supply‑chain analysis; climate or sustainability domain experience is an advantage.
* Experience of leading the projects to completion and working with stakeholders and team members
* Experience applying GenAI/LLMs for data extraction, summarization, classification, or workflow automation; ability to build prompt‑based workflows and evaluate model output.
* Familiarity with AI agents, retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG), or ML‑assisted quality is required.
* Hands‑on experience with Python for automation, web scraping, API integration, data cleaning, and high‑volume processing.
* Working knowledge of SQL and comfort handling large datasets.
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to interpret complex corporate disclosures and extract meaningful supply‑chain insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple time zones and collaborate with cross‑functional partners

**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
  
  
MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.

It is the policy of the firm to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy (including unlawful discrimination on the basis of a legally protected parental leave), veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Strategy Leader
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As a Strategy Leader within Grid Technologies and a key member of the Strategy & Sustainability team, you will shape the direction of one of the world’s most critical energy businesses. You will drive high-impact strategic projects across our global GT portfolio, working closely with business leaders and operational units to translate business needs into actionable initiatives.
  
  
Your day is a mix of solving complex problems, working with cross-functional teams, engaging senior stakeholders, and challenging how we operate today to build what the grid needs tomorrow. You will bring analytical rigor, energy-sector insight, and strategic creativity to define solutions and push our business forward. This role offers an exceptional springboard for a global career within Siemens Energy after +2 years in the Strategy team.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Lead high-value strategic initiatives that directly shape the future of Siemens Energy and the global Energy Transition.
* Identify growth opportunities, portfolio moves, and business-critical themes, translating them into executable plans with business leaders.
* Drive preparation for Executive Board decisions through management reviews, strategy updates, and external presentations.
* Support special strategic initiatives and one-off projects requiring fast problem solving and senior stakeholder engagement.
* Engage with cross-functional teams and lead workstreams within complex projects, building a strong internal network across Grid Technologies and the wider Siemens Energy organization.
* Analyze complex problems and develop creative, actionable solutions together with highly skilled colleagues.
* Leverage deep energy industry knowledge to challenge the status quo and spark new ideas, business models, and innovations.
* Develop continuously through on-the-job learning, coaching from senior colleagues, and dedicated trainings and job-shadowing programs.

**What You Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in Strategy, with a strong track record in strategic initiatives, market analysis, and end-to-end project management.
* At least 2 years experience in the Energy sector, ideally within Grid Technologies or adjacent segments, with strong understanding of industry dynamics and current trends.
* Ability to work effectively across functions and organizational layers, mobilizing resources and driving alignment in complex environments.
* Strong analytical and structured thinking skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and build compelling, data-driven recommendations.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* High-performance orientation—you consistently meet or exceed objectives and thrive under tight deadlines.
* Solution-driven mindset with a willingness to “go the extra mile” and deliver results with ownership and autonomy.
* A collaborative team spirit, enjoying the opportunity to work with highly motivated colleagues and possessing strong interpersonal and leadership skills.

**About The Team**
Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
  
  
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* Opportunity to work on challenging projects in an exciting environment
* Opportunity for remote/flexible work
* Professional support and strong collaboration with colleagues around the world
* Professional development opportunities within the company

title: Design Manager - Water/Wastewater Treatment
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
As a Design Manager – Treatment, you will lead the multidisciplinary design delivery of complex water treatment, wastewater treatment, and desalination projects. You will be responsible for driving design integration, technical excellence, programme certainty, and quality compliance across all stages of project delivery. This includes overseeing process, civil, mechanical, chemical, electrical, and I&C interfaces, ensuring alignment across all design disciplines.
  
  
You will work closely with Project Managers, Discipline Leads, and Sector/Regional leadership to plan, coordinate, and assure the technical execution of treatment projects while also mentoring and strengthening the capability of the broader design team.
  
  
Key duties include
  
  

* Development and implementation of multidisciplinary design strategies for water/wastewater treatment and desalination projects, ensuring design integration and coherent execution.
* Lead and manage the preparation, coordination, and delivery of design packages for water treatment plants, wastewater treatment plants, desalination facilities, and associated process systems.
* Evaluate, compare, and select appropriate treatment technologies and processes for project-specific needs.
* Provide leadership in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB) models—ensuring constructability, staging, risk mitigation, and alignment with contractor expectations.
* Lead or support HAZOP/HAZID studies, interpret findings, and implement appropriate mitigation measures across treatment process designs.
* Own and manage core design management documents Project Responsibility Matrix, Project Organisation Chart, Design Programme, Basis of Design, and Schedule of Deliverables.
* Identify and manage inputs from external specialists, JV partners, and sub‑consultants, ensuring their deliverables are fully integrated.
* Lead client engagement activities, including workshops, presentations, design reviews, and technical discussions.
* Facilitate multidisciplinary coordination meetings and proactively manage resolution of design issues to maintain schedule and quality commitments.
* Ensure all design outputs comply with quality standards, codes, legislation, and HSE principles, promoting safe design practices.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering Design Build water infrastructure projects**
.**
Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Key software tools**

* Planning & Coordination Primavera P6 / MS Project
* Collaboration ACC, ProjectWise, SharePoint, MS Teams
* GIS ArcGIS Pro / QGIS
* Treatment Modelling (exposure advantageous) RO/ion balance tools, process simulators
* BIM (exposure advantageous) Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, Revizto

**Key Behaviours**

* Builds positive, collaborative relationships across diverse teams.
* Strong client‑facing presence; personable, approachable, and confident.
* Leads through coordination, communication, and engagement.
* Drives integrated, high‑quality design solutions across disciplines.
* Organised, proactive, and able to resolve complex issues promptly.
* Creative, flexible, dependable; champions safety and quality culture.

**Work Experience**

* 20+ years of experience in design management within an engineering consultancy or EPC/Design‑Build environment.
* Proven experience managing multidisciplinary design teams delivering complex treatment facilities.
* Demonstrated capability in delivering Water Treatment/ Wastewater Treatment/ Desalination across preliminary, detailed, and construction design stages.
* Strong understanding of PFDs, mass balance development, hydraulic profiles, P&IDs, and preparation of process input documents.
* Strong experience in Design for Design‑Build (D for DB), including early contractor engagement, constructability review, and technical risk mitigation.
* Experience leading design delivery in BIM‑enabled environments.
* Demonstrated interest in digital delivery and innovation, including automation, data‑driven workflows, and continuous improvement.
* Strong communication, coordination, leadership, and organisational skills.
* Experience in client presentations, tender submissions, and stakeholder management.
* Experience in change management, including assessment of design changes, impact analysis, and stakeholder communication.
* Working understanding of MTO/BoQ development and coordination with discipline teams for quantity validation.
* Ability to develop Level‑of‑Effort (LOE) estimates and support bids, proposals, and design execution plans.
* Understanding of project financials, including forecasting, progress tracking, milestone monitoring, and invoicing.
* Experience with alternate delivery methods such as Design–Build, EPC, CMAR, or PPP/P3 is an asset.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, Environmental Engineering (or related discipline)
* Master’s degree in relevant field
* Professional Engineer (PE) / Chartered Engineer (CEng) is highly desirable

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience delivering large multidisciplinary treatment programmes (water, wastewater, or desalination).
* Exposure to complex staging, commissioning planning, or brownfield facility expansions.
* Experience or understanding of PFAS treatment technologies (e.g., GAC, IX, RO) is an added advantage.
* Awareness of sustainability, circularity, and low‑carbon treatment solutions.
* Ability to operate effectively in fast‑paced, contractor‑integrated environments.

**Hybrid Work Expectation**
Average office presence of 3 days per week or as per Company Policy, with travel for client/site meetings and occasional team meetings.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

Job Description:

**Sr. Product Manager – Master Data Management**

Ingram Micro is looking for an experienced Sr. Product Manager to drive the roadmap and execution of key master data initiatives that shape the foundation of how our business operates. This is an important role in Ingram Micro's company-wide master data transformation journey — helping build the data structures, governance frameworks, and product experiences that power trusted, consistent, and scalable data across the enterprise.

The successful candidate will demonstrate the ability to shape and deliver a product roadmap for their domain, prioritize initiatives informed by data, and drive execution in partnership with data engineering, enterprise architecture, and business operations stakeholders.

**You Have:**

* 5–8 years of experience in product management, with a strong preference for experience in data, platform, or enterprise product domains.
* 3+ years of experience building products or platforms for B2B environments, ideally with exposure to data management, ERP systems, or enterprise data platforms.
* Experience working with cross-functional go-to-market and operations teams to drive adoption of internal data products and capabilities across business units.
* Familiarity with master data management (MDM) concepts, data governance frameworks, and data quality principles strongly preferred.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive meaningful insights from complex data sets and translate them into actionable product decisions.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to influence stakeholders across technical and business teams.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

The DevOps Platform Engineering team builds and runs the tooling, platforms and workflows that every engineering team at MSCI uses to deliver software. We operate as a software engineering team whose customers are other engineers — we build internal products, APIs, automation and integrations, and we run them as products with roadmaps, users and service commitments.

We own and maintain several Developer tools in MSCI's developer toolchain end to end. That covers the tools engineers work in every day, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube and Cursor, as well as the platforms we build and run ourselves such as our Backstage-based internal developer portal. Ownership here means we select, integrate, secure, operate and continuously improve these services, and we are accountable for their availability,and adoption across the firm.

Alongside the tools, we enable standardisation across the software development lifecycle. We define the golden paths, reusable CI/CD workflows, platform abstractions, engineering standards and governance models that product and engineering teams adopt so they can move quickly without re-solving the same problems.

As part of the MSCI Core DevOps Engineering team, you will help shape where software delivery and developer enablement go next across the organisation.

**What the team owns**

* Developer tooling: GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Docker, Cursor
* Internal developer platforms: Backstage-based developer portal and our in-house developer productivity platform
* CI/CD platforms, reusable pipelines and release automation
* SDLC standards, golden paths and governance models
* Self-service capabilities, internal APIs and integrations that remove manual toil from engineering teams
* Developer experience measurement, adoption and the services we provide to engineering teams across MSCI

Your Key Responsibilities:

* Build and maintain reusable CI/CD frameworks, GitHub Actions workflows, templates, and platform abstractions that make the golden paths the fastest way to ship software at MSCI — simple enough to adopt quickly, flexible enough for diverse engineering use cases.
* Develop and support internal platform capabilities, APIs, automation services, and integrations across the developer toolchain, including GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, SonarQube, Cursor, Backstage, and our in-house developer productivity platform.
* Run the developer tooling estate as a product: monitor health and usage, resolve issues, manage upgrades and configuration, and improve the reliability of services engineers depend on daily.
* Apply proactive problem solving to developer pain points — find friction in engineering workflows before it is escalated, trace issues to root cause, and deliver durable fixes rather than workarounds.
* Bring intellectual curiosity and a critical thinking mindset to platform decisions: evaluate new tools, patterns, and approaches on their merits, and make evidence-based recommendations that raise the quality of what we deliver to our developers.
* Contribute to SDLC standardization initiatives and engineering best practices, translating agreed standards into working automation, templates, and controls.
* Partner with Security, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure, Risk, and Application Engineering teams to embed governance, compliance, and operational controls directly into engineering workflows and platform capabilities.
* Treat engineering teams as customers: gather feedback, document and support what you build.

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
* Hands on Programming experience in Go or Java.
* Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps Engineering, or related software engineering roles.
* Software engineering mindset, with hands-on experience building automation, APIs, internal tooling, or reusable workflows that other engineers depend on.
* Solid working experience with SCM and CI/CD tooling such as GitHub (preferred), Azure DevOps, and/or GitLab, including repositories, pipelines, reusable workflows and templates, permissions, and integrations.
* Good understanding of the SDLC and software delivery workflows, including source control governance, branching strategies, release processes, and developer enablement practices.
* Experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks.
* Strong collaboration and communication skills
* Operational mindset, with experience supporting tooling or services that other teams rely on in production.
* Intellectual curiosity and critical thinking — willingness to dig into unfamiliar problems, question how things work today, and evidence a better way.

Nice to Have

* Exposure to an internal developer platform or portal (Backstage or equivalent).
* Experience building self-service engineering workflows or developer enablement tooling.
* Experience with platform observability, engineering metrics, or developer productivity initiatives.
* Exposure to GitOps frameworks.
* Experience in GitHub Enterprise Platform & Services
* Familiarity with frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript for platform UI and tooling development.
* Agentic SDLC experience and AI-native development.

About MSCI:

**What we offer you**

* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.

At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.

MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. description:
**About Us**
**HEAD OF PRODUCT BUSINESS UNIT**
Anchanto | Pune, India | Reports to the Chief Executive Officer | Unit of 12 to 45 people
  
  
**About Anchanto**
Anchanto is an e-commerce and supply chain technology company headquartered in Singapore, with offices in twelve countries across Asia Pacific, the Middle East and Europe and its largest engineering center in Pune. Brands, retailers and logistics service providers use our purpose built SaaS products to run and scale their e-commerce and omnichannel operations: Order Management, Warehouse Management, Anchanto Grid with more than 200 ready integrations to marketplaces, carriers and enterprise systems, Parcel Tracking, Control Tower and Operations Experience, with Vantage AI as the data and insights layer across all of them. Our AI enabled agentic services, launching soon, help customers run their commerce operations with less manual work and faster decisions. More than 360 enterprise customers, including L'OrÃ©al, Panasonic, EstÃ©e Lauder, DKSH, Toll and Bosch, process over 200 million orders a year through Anchanto across more than 700 warehouses. Anchanto is an Asendia portfolio company.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
A Product Business Unit (PBU) is Product Management and Engineering for one product, brought together as a single threaded organization with one head, one backlog and one set of priorities. The head owns the product's market position, strategy, roadmap, engineering, quality, reliability and business results, and leads the engineers who build it. This is how the leading software companies are organized today: Amazon's single threaded leaders and two pizza teams, the autonomous product units at Spotify and Atlassian, the product clouds at Salesforce and Adobe each run as a business. It removes the handoffs, competing priorities and diffused accountability of separate product and engineering functions, and puts one leader in charge who decides and answers for the result.
  
  
This is not a pure product management role. You lead the engineering team as well as the product team, you own the technical quality of what ships, and you are measured on outcomes, not activities. It is the role of building a product business that leads its category: you set where the product goes, build it with your own engineering team, put it in front of the market with the revenue teams, and answer for what it earns and how customers experience it.
  
  
**WHAT YOU OWN: PRODUCT STRATEGY, ROADMAP, ENGINEERING, DECISIONS AND RESULTS**

* Product strategy. You know your market and competitors better than anyone in the company, set the product strategy and the positioning ambition with the industry research leaders, keep the product's gaps against the Gartner, Forrester and IDC criteria on your roadmap with dates, and give the CROs your input on pricing and packaging.
* Roadmap and priorities. One backlog covering the roadmap, customer commitments, innovation and tech debt, with the trade offs made by you within the portfolio allocation the CEO sets. Customer priorities and asks come to you from the Delivery team, your internal customer; you deliver against them and do not overwrite them.
* Decisions. What gets built, in what order and how; technical design within the architecture and security standards the CTO sets; release decisions; and whether your product can meet a scope and a date. No scope or date is committed on your product without your confirmation, and once committed you deliver it.
* The way we build. Specs based, AI assisted engineering is the standard way of working in every unit. You own the spec standard for your product and the readiness gate that stops work starting before decisions, credentials and test windows are in place. Quality is owned by the people who build.
* Results. Product P&L, growth, margin and contribution; reliability, incident response and customer satisfaction for your product; and the people: unit structure, hiring, promotions and a standing innovation and AI sub pod that explores adjacent capabilities.
* Ecosystem. Alignment with the other PBUs on the shared roadmap, the blueprint and joint commitments, and working in step with Product Marketing.

**COMMERCIAL INVOLVEMENT**
This is not a sales role and carries no quota. The CROs set market priorities, the go to market and what and how your product is sold; the revenue teams (existing customers, Global Strategic Accounts, Key Account Management) own the customer connect. You help them sell: you step into strategic, complex or at risk deals when asked, and you are the final word on what your product can commit to and when. You do not override or bypass them to reach customers directly.
  
  
**How You Manage Your People**

* Every person in the unit has written objectives and two or three KPIs for the quarter, reviewed monthly; nobody is without them thirty days after joining.
* Feedback is direct, factual and given within the week, in writing when it matters.
* You represent the company to your team, not the team to the company. Management debt, wrong decisions, undelivered feedback and unaddressed interpersonal issues, is fixed within thirty days of knowing about it.
* Performance is measured against objectives, not effort or tenure. An underperformer gets a written plan and a date; if it passes you take the decision yourself, including exit. Interns are confirmed and people are promoted only after a documented assessment and a direct conversation.
* The unit reports in numbers, weekly in writing and monthly in the outcome review.
* You talk to your N-1, your N-2 and every individual contributor, with skip level one to ones at least quarterly; you do the final interview of every person joining the unit; and the unit runs on a written meeting cadence you publish in your first thirty days and keep.

**OWNING CUSTOMER ESCALATIONS**
An escalation on your product is yours from the moment it is raised until the customer confirms it is closed. You do not trivialize it, and you do not expect the CEO or the CROs to lead it. You own the fix and the communication: first written update within the hour, a fixed written cadence until closed, root cause and corrective action within five working days after. You put proactive monitoring in place so the unit knows before the customer does.
  
  
**Who Decides What**

* Decision: Roadmap, prioritization, trade offs, what gets built and how, technical design within architecture guardrails, release decisions within standards.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Whether your product can meet a scope and a date; unit structure, hiring and promotions within policy; spend within the approved budget.

Decides: You
  
  

* Decision: Customer priority, customer asks, revenue delivery and the external customer commitment and timeline.

Decides: Delivery, with your confirmation on scope and date
  
  

* Decision: Pricing and packaging; market priorities; go to market; what and how your product is sold; customer connect.

Decides: CROs and revenue teams, with your input on pricing
  
  

* Decision: Portfolio allocation, the blueprint, headcount and total investment, cross PBU priority collisions.

Decides: CEO
  
  

* Decision: Technology standards, security and compliance, architecture guardrails, CICD, infrastructure, data and AI platform.

Decides: CTO
  
  
**How You Are Measured**
You own outcomes, not activities. Story points, releases and features shipped are not on this scorecard. You are judged on the outputs below, and you run the unit on five to eight controllable input metrics that you propose, prove move the outputs, and review every week. Numbers are baselined in your first month and verified by Finance.
  
  

* Product led revenue enablement

What we look at: Adoption and usage depth of the modules we sell, share of customers on the current version, deals unblocked or lost on product capability, referenceable customers, time to go live
  
  

* Retention and unit margin

What we look at: Net revenue retention for your product, churn and its reasons, and the unit's contribution margin after people, infrastructure and delivery cost
  
  

* Reliability and customer satisfaction

What we look at: Availability, incidents and time to resolve, escaped defects, escalations by count, root cause and time to close, NPS or CSAT, and whether the unit found the problem before the customer did
  
  

* Planned versus actual

What we look at: Execution against the quarterly plan and the annual plan: objectives met, committed deliveries on date, say to do ratio, and variances explained in writing
  
  

* Market position

What we look at: Where the product stands against the Forrester Wave, Gartner Magic Quadrant and IDC MarketScape criteria for its category, gaps closed each quarter, and analyst recognition over time
  
  

* AI leverage and AI first approach

What we look at: Share of work built specs based and AI assisted, automation percentage by activity, cost and cycle time per delivered item falling every quarter, new work designed AI first
  
  

* Team EPS and health

What we look at: Team EPS score, attrition and regretted attrition, skills coverage, and whether the unit runs without you in the room
  
  
**PLANNING AND CADENCE**
You write the multi year product plan, the annual plan each October as a six page narrative with targets and resource scenarios, and, four weeks before each quarter, a ninety day plan derived from both, presented to and aligned with the leadership team; execution is measured against it. Weekly unit review on the inputs in writing, monthly outcome review with the CEO, quarterly review on the two or three CEO goals for your unit.
  
  
**Skills And Prior Experience**
Must haves for every candidate. Candidates without all of these will not be shortlisted.
  
  

* At least fifteen years of industry experience, with at least five of them running a product, product line, business unit or operation with accountability for its results.
* Global experience. Has worked in, and built or run operations outside India, with customers or teams in more than one country. India only experience does not qualify.
* Education. Engineering from IIT or NIT, or an MBA from IIM or a top ranked global business school.
* Domain. Commerce, logistics, supply chain or marketplace software, or the operations they serve, with enterprise customers.
* Decides and manages directly. Makes the call quickly, takes the trade off and answers for the outcome. Has set objectives for every person, given hard feedback in time, taken exit decisions personally and owned the communication in a customer crisis. Comfortable making AI assisted, specs driven engineering the default way of working.

Career paths we are open to. The role needs product, technology and business skills together; nobody arrives with all three at the same depth, so we hire from four paths and test for the second skill in each.
  
  

* Technology leader with product skills. Director of Engineering, CTO, CIO or equivalent, with deep experience in building, releasing and commercializing software systems, who has also owned a roadmap, met the market and made product trade offs, not only delivered what product handed over.
* Product management leader with technology depth. Head of Product Management or commercial product management in B2B SaaS, with technology skills to a good extent: has led or closely directed engineering teams, can hold an architecture review, and has shipped and commercialized what they defined.
* Operations practitioner from a large 3PL, retailer or brand. Has run e-commerce, fulfilment or supply chain operations as a business at scale, with deep domain knowledge of how the work is actually done, and has specified, bought or built the systems behind it well enough to direct a product team.
* Consultant or transformation leader. Head of consulting, transformation or a consulting practice in commerce or supply chain, with deep consulting and domain expertise, who has delivered systems and operating models for clients end to end rather than advised from the side.

In every path the second skill must be shown with specific examples. This role is not a Head of Engineering with a product manager reporting in, a delivery manager promoted up, a product leader who hands execution to someone else, a second sales channel to the customer, or a union leader for the team. Compensation: fixed salary, variable pay tied to the scorecard, and long term incentives; details shared with shortlisted candidates.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global Exposure: Work with diverse teams, customers and stakeholders across international markets and gain experience in a global B2B SaaS environment.
* Learning & Development: We invest in our people through sponsored learning, certifications and development opportunities aligned with your professional growth.
* International & Onsite Opportunities: Client-facing roles may offer opportunities to travel and work onsite with customers across our global markets.
* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive medical insurance coverage to support to you and your family health and well-being.
* Comprehensive Leave Benefits: Maternity, Paternity, Marriage and Bereavement leave, along with Comp Off and flexibility to support important personal commitments.
* Recognition for Long-Term Contribution: Tenured employees are eligible for additional monetary benefits, extra paid leave and company-sponsored paid vacations as part of our commitment to recognising long-term contribution.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: A supportive and flexible work environment that enables employees to manage professional responsibilities alongside personal priorities.
* Meaningful Career Growth: Take ownership of challenging, high-impact work and contribute to products and solutions that serve global brands, retailers and logistics businesses.

title: VP - BA Client Journey Execution
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as a VP – BA Client Journey Execution, where you will support the organisation in delivering its strategic objectives through the identification, definition, and delivery of business requirements and solutions that address complex business problems and opportunities.
  
  
In this role, you will work in close partnership with Product Owners and Technology teams to shape and deliver market‑leading digital products and client journeys, ensuring solutions are customer‑centric, scalable, and aligned to regulatory, operational, and strategic priorities. You will play a key role in driving the end‑to‑end onboarding and KYC journey, ensuring efficient execution, strong stakeholder alignment, and pace of delivery across complex change initiatives.
  
  
**Key Critical Skills Include**

* Proven experience as a Business Analyst, ideally within financial services or regulated environments.
* Demonstrated experience working closely with Product Owners within Agile delivery models to implement market‑leading digital products and client journeys.
* Strong understanding of end‑to‑end client onboarding journeys, with KYC knowledge considered highly desirable.
* Formal change methodology qualifications, such as Agile Practitioner, Lean, and/or Six Sigma.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively across business, product, operations, compliance, and technology teams.
* A proven track record of delivering complex programmes at pace, managing ambiguity while maintaining delivery discipline and high-quality outcomes.

You may be assessed on key essential skills relevant to succeed in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Identification and analysis of business problems and client requirements that require change within the organisation.
* Development of business requirements that will address business problems and opportunities.
* Collaboration with stakeholders to ensure that proposed solutions meet their needs and expectations.
* Support the creation of business cases that justify investment in proposed solutions.
* Conduct feasibility studies to determine the viability of proposed solutions.
* Support the creation of reports on project progress to ensure proposed solutions are delivered on time and within budget.
* Creation of operational design and process design to ensure that proposed solutions are delivered within the agreed scope.
* Support to change management activities, including development of a traceability matrix to ensure proposed solutions are successfully implemented and embedded in the organisation.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Business Consultant COE
description:
**Job Description**
The Business Consultant will be part of the Honeywell AutonomyX Center of Excellence (CoE) based in Pune, India, and will play an active role in developing and executing business consulting activities for Middle East, Turkey, and Central Asia (META) region opportunities, with flexibility to engage other regions depending on workload. This role will combine selective front-office ownership of qualified customer opportunities with back-office business development, analysis, proposal, and value-storyline execution in partnership with the Middle East business consulting team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Business development and selective opportunity leadership for META digital transformation programs for operating companies:
* Co-lead opportunity development for Honeywell AutonomyX and related transformation programs across META, working closely with the Middle East business consulting lead and regional sales teams, including

+ Research customer operating models, business priorities, performance improvement levers, and digital/autonomy transformation opportunities
+ Translate customer challenges into structured consulting problem statements linked to Honeywell and AutonomyX solutions
+ Own preparation of executive engagement materials, value hypotheses, customer narratives, and account-specific storylines for selected pursuits
+ Lead or actively participate in selected customer-facing discussions and workshops, including preparation, facilitation, documentation, and follow-up from Pune or on site when required
+ Own customer-ready material including value propositions, executive summaries, business cases, case studies, and sales enablement content for assigned opportunities

* Consulting workshops, studies and execution ownership
* Lead or co-lead scoping of customer diagnostic exercises, workshops, value assessments, and consulting studies for selected META opportunities

* Coordinate and drive inputs from technical, sales, and solution teams to produce structured consulting deliverables
* Own the development of diagnostic reports, gap analyses, business cases, value roadmaps, maturity assessments, and adoption plans for assigned workstreams
* Drive follow-up actions, maintain opportunity documentation, and lead handover from consulting discovery into sales execution where assigned
* CoE capability building and organizational enablement
* Build and continuously improve repeatable AutonomyX consulting assets, templates, value frameworks, and proposal content within the Pune CoE
* Lead selected internal enablement activities for value-based selling and consulting-led opportunity development across META
* Share best practices, case studies, and reusable methods with regional sales, consulting, and solution teams

**Qualifications**
**Skills and qualifications**

* Prior consulting experience with a leading consulting firm at Associate level or equivalent, including strategy, operations, transformation, digital, or value-creation work. Alternatively MBA from a leading business school
* Prior experience in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, refining, petrochemicals, or other process industries preferred
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical engineering discipline preferred; Chemical Engineering is desirable, although other relevant engineering disciplines will be considered
* Preferred experience in running or contributing to operational transformation programs, performance improvement initiatives, digital transformation programs, or operating model improvement efforts
* Demonstrated ability to lead defined consulting workstreams, customer workshops, or opportunity development activities with senior stakeholder exposure
* Strong written communication and executive-presentation preparation skills, with ability to create clear customer-facing narratives and C-suite-ready materials
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to structure ambiguous business problems, identify customer value levers, and translate analysis into actionable recommendations
* Strong quantitative skills, including business case development, financial modelling, scenario planning, benchmarking, and value analysis
* Ability to work effectively from Pune with META stakeholders across time zones, balancing independent ownership, remote collaboration, and selected customer-facing engagement
* Ability to travel to Middle East selectively for high-value customer workshops, internal alignment sessions, and strategic pursuits as required

**Value proposition of role**

* Opportunity to help shape the AutonomyX CoE in Pune while taking ownership of selected strategic growth opportunities in the META region
* Blend of customer-facing consulting leadership and high-impact strategy, proposal, analysis, and execution ownership
* High visibility to regional business consulting, sales, and leadership teams through direct contribution to priority transformation pursuits
* Exposure to globally leading operating companies in the Middle East that are at the forefront of technology transformation, autonomy, and next-generation industrial operations
* Strong platform to develop expertise in autonomy, digital transformation, industrial operations, and value-based selling
* Role offers a broad problem-solving, business case, and opportunity-leadership remit across multiple industries and customer situations
* Selective travel intensity compared with pure front-office consulting, while retaining meaningful ownership of strategic customer engagements

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Senior Requirement Engineer, AVP
description:

**Senior Requirement Engineer, AVP**

**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
