description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary — The Why Now**
As Avalara scales its Go Live function to support New Product Introductions (NPI) and enterprise-level customer growth, we need Senior Analysts who do more than execute — they lead, design, and elevate. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) operates at the intersection of complex enterprise implementation delivery, cross-functional product collaboration, and practice development.
  
  
Where the I3 Analyst owns individual customer implementation success, the I3 Senior Analyst owns the quality and scalability of how implementations are delivered — for the most complex customers, across new and evolving products, and in close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  
  
This role exists to accelerate Avalara's ability to onboard enterprise customers at scale, introduce new products effectively, and continuously raise the implementation standard across the Go Live team. The I3 is a force multiplier: their impact is felt not just in their own portfolio, but in the capability and quality of the broader team.
  
  
How This Role Elevates Avalara
  
  

* For customers: Enterprise and multi-product customers receive expert implementation guidance, proactive risk management, and deep technical partnership — resulting in faster time-to-value and stronger long-term adoption.
* For the team: The Senior Analyst sets the implementation quality standard — authoring playbooks, mentoring I3 analysts, and identifying process improvements that raise team-wide performance.
* For the business: Directly supports ARR growth by enabling complex enterprise wins, supporting the sales cycle with pre-sales expertise, and accelerating NPI readiness across implementation teams.
* For our AI-first strategy: Designs and deploys AI-driven implementation workflows at a team level — moving beyond personal productivity to scalable automation that benefits the entire Go Live function.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Enterprise & Multi-Product Implementation Leadership**

* Lead customer implementations involving multiple Avalara products and enterprise-level platforms including complex ERP, POS, and ecommerce environments (e.g., NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce, SAP).
* Act as the primary implementation authority for high-complexity, high-stakes customer engagements — setting strategy, managing scope, and driving outcomes from kickoff to Go Live.
* Clearly define, articulate, and manage scope of work for client-initiated implementation and data service projects, including change management when scope evolves.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Enablement**

* Partner with Avalara Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop implementation approach documentation, onboarding frameworks, and training materials for new product launches.
* Serve as a subject matter expert during NPI cycles — identifying implementation risks, documenting configuration requirements, and ensuring Go Live readiness before product release.
* Identify bugs, integration gaps, or UX friction during NPI implementations and partner with Engineering to track and resolve them.

**Practice Development & Quality Elevation**

* Own and evolve Go Live practice standards — documenting business processes, designing implementation playbooks, and proposing best practices for sales and use tax automation onboarding.
* Develop and document business requirements related to implementation workflows, data transformation, and cross-system reporting.
* Lead testing plan design and execution for complex implementations, ensuring customers go live on validated, stable configurations.
* Mentor and provide structured guidance to I2 Analysts — reviewing implementation quality, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of junior team members.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support pre-sales activities — including scoping, solution design input, and customer-facing technical presentations.
* Engage cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance to resolve systemic implementation blockers and drive process improvements at scale.
* Represent the Go Live team's perspective in strategic planning discussions, NPI readiness reviews, and cross-departmental initiatives.

**Customer Success & Risk Management**

* Monitor project health across assigned accounts — proactively identifying risk factors, intervening early, and resolving escalations with speed and precision.
* Provide strategic guidance to customers on best practices and use cases across a range of business models and tax compliance needs.
* Support customers in developing and executing testing plans, ensuring technical readiness before Go Live.

**AI-Driven Practice Scaling**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows at a team level — building reusable Glean AI agents, prompt libraries, and automation tools that improve implementation quality and speed across the Go Live function.
* Share AI innovations, document their impact, and drive adoption across I2 and I3 peers.

**12-Month Success Signals**
A successful Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) at the end of 12 months will have:
  
  

* Led multiple enterprise or multi-product implementations to successful Go Live with measurably shorter cycle times and low escalation rates, demonstrating ownership at a higher complexity tier than I2.
* Delivered at least two NPI readiness contributions — documented implementation playbooks, training materials, or bug reports — that were formally adopted by the Go Live or Product teams.
* Authored or significantly improved at least two Go Live practice standards or playbooks, with measurable adoption and quality impact across the team.
* Mentored at least two I2 Analysts with demonstrable improvement in their implementation quality metrics or time-to-competency.
* Built and deployed at least one AI-powered workflow (e.g., a Glean agent, automation script, or prompt framework) that generated measurable time savings or quality improvements at a team level — not just personally.
* Supported at least one pre-sales engagement in partnership with the Sales or Account Management team, contributing to a customer expansion or new business outcome.

AI Expectations
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first company. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) is expected to operate as an AI Bar Raiser — not just embedding AI into their own work, but actively raising AI capability across the Go Live team.
  
  
**Specific Expectations Include**

* Design and build reusable AI tools — including Glean AI agents, automated documentation workflows, and AI-assisted risk detection models — that are shared and adopted across the team.
* Use AI to analyze implementation portfolio data at scale, identifying patterns in at-risk implementations, NPI friction points, or recurring ERP configuration issues, and translating insights into proactive action.
* Deploy AI to accelerate NPI documentation, training material generation, and business requirements capture — dramatically compressing the time from product release to team readiness.
* Use AI to support customer communication at scale — generating implementation status summaries, tailored onboarding guidance, and escalation documentation with speed and precision.
* Coach I2 Analysts on applied AI usage, sharing effective practices and helping peers move from casual familiarity to embedded, outcome-driven AI workflows.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, in full compliance with Avalara's data governance and AI ethics policies.

Candidates must demonstrate specific, quantified examples of AI usage that improved team-level outcomes — not just personal efficiency. Senior Analysts who cannot clearly articulate their AI impact across a team or function do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard for this level.
  
  
What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Required**
Bachelor’s in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline (BCA, MCA, B.Tech from an accredited institution). Open to hire from Commerce background given strong technical acumen or expertise of implementation.
  
  

* 4–7 years of software implementation or delivery experience, preferably within the B2B SaaS sector, with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity.
* Proven ability to lead complex, enterprise-level software implementations across multiple products and ERP/ecommerce environments.
* Strong ability to articulate process logic and technical architecture — including design and delivery of functional and technical presentations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of accounting and tax processes, including sales and use tax compliance automation concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional conversations and drive alignment.
* Experience contributing to practice improvement — documenting business processes, designing best practices, or owning team-level standards.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset — takes initiative at a team level, holds peers accountable with coaching (not criticism), and drives outcomes without requiring direction.
* Embodies Avalara's Success Traits: Ownership, Simplicity, Curiosity, Adaptability, Urgency, Optimism, and Humility.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience configuring or integrating enterprise ERPs such as NetSuite, Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce Commerce, Sage, or WooCommerce.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Jira, or equivalent CRM and project tracking platforms.
* Prior exposure to tax automation software implementation or tax-related roles.
* Experience in NPI or product launch support — working alongside Product Management or Engineering to prepare implementation teams for new releases.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and integration architecture concepts.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or developing junior team members.

**Bar Raiser Expectation**
At Avalara, We Hire Only Those Who Raise The Bar — Not Those Who Merely Meet It. A Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) Who Is a Bar Raiser
  
  

* Improves the average performance of the team simply by being present — through coaching, example, and a consistent commitment to quality.
* Brings data, structure, and strategic thinking to conversations about risk, prioritization, process design, and escalation.
* Challenges assumptions respectfully and proposes better approaches — even when it's uncomfortable.
* Leaves every customer engagement, process, team interaction, and system in a measurably stronger state than they found it.
* Continuously develops technical, functional, and AI capabilities — and actively helps peers do the same.
* Demonstrates strong judgment in tradeoff decisions, especially when they affect customers, timelines, or team capacity.

Being a Bar Raiser at the I3 level means raising the entire team's execution quality — not just excelling individually.
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Senior Manager - Quick Commerce
description:
**Department:**
Sales / E-commerce

**Location:**
Pune (Narhe)

**Experience:**
6–12 Years (D2C/FMCG/Beauty & Personal Care preferred)

**About the Role:**

We are looking for an experienced and growth-driven Head – Quick Commerce to lead and scale our business across quick commerce platforms such as Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, BB Now, Flipkart Minutes, and other emerging channels. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, optimizing product visibility, managing platform relationships, ensuring inventory availability, and executing high-impact commercial and marketing initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Business Growth & Strategy

* Develop and execute the overall Quick Commerce growth strategy aligned with business objectives.
* Drive revenue, profitability, and market share across all Quick Commerce platforms.
* Identify new opportunities, cities, categories, and platform partnerships for expansion.
* Own the Quick Commerce P&L and deliver sustainable business growth.

Platform Account Management

* Manage relationships with key account managers across Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, BB Now, Flipkart Minutes, and other platforms.
* Lead commercial negotiations, annual business plans, joint business planning (JBP), and promotional calendars.
* Ensure timely onboarding of new SKUs and categories.

Sales & Commercial Excellence

* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* Drive assortment expansion, pricing strategy, visibility, and category rankings.
* Optimize promotions, platform campaigns, and performance marketing investments.
* Monitor ROAS, margins, contribution, and profitability.

Inventory & Supply Chain

* Collaborate with Supply Chain and Demand Planning teams to maintain healthy inventory levels.
* Minimize stock-outs while optimizing inventory turnover.
* Forecast demand based on seasonal trends, campaigns, and platform insights.

Marketing & Visibility

* Work closely with Brand and Performance Marketing teams to improve search visibility and discoverability.
* Execute platform marketing campaigns, banner placements, sponsored listings, and exclusive launches.
* Improve product ratings, reviews, and conversion rates.

Data & Performance Analytics

* Analyze platform dashboards, sales trends, customer behavior, and category performance.
* Generate actionable insights to improve sales, assortment, and operational efficiency.
* Present business reviews and performance updates to leadership.

Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with Brand, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations, Customer Support, and Product teams.
* Lead and mentor the Quick Commerce team to achieve business objectives.

**Key Skills:**

* Strong understanding of Quick Commerce business models.
* Experience managing Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, BB Now, Flipkart Minutes, and similar platforms.
* Excellent negotiation and key account management skills.
* Strong analytical and commercial acumen.
* Expertise in P&L management and business planning.
* Advanced Excel and data analysis skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and leadership abilities.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field.
* MBA is preferred.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 7–12 years of experience in E-commerce, Modern Trade, Key Account Management, or Quick Commerce.
* Prior experience in FMCG, D2C, Beauty & Personal Care, Consumer Goods, or Retail.
* Proven track record of scaling Quick Commerce sales and managing high-value platform relationships.

title: Automation Excellence Lead
description:
**Maersk Position Description**

* Business Title : Automation Excellence Lead
* Job level : JL4
* Department or Business Unit: Automation Excellence
* Supervisory Responsibilities: No
* Reports to: Head of Automation Excellence

**About The Role**
The Automation Excellence Lead is responsible for driving the design, development, and deployment of next-generation AI-enabled solutions that transform how business processes operate across GSC. The role combines expertise in Automation, Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, Workflow Automation, and Process Transformation to create scalable, intelligent, and autonomous business capabilities.
  
  
The role serves as a technical leader, solution architect, and innovation catalyst, partnering with business stakeholders, Product Owners, technology teams and SMEs to translate business challenges into AI-powered enterprise solutions. The position is expected to lead complex automation and AI initiatives while mentoring teams and establishing best practices for enterprise AI adoption.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**AI & Intelligent Automation Strategy**

* Drive adoption of AI, Generative AI, and Agentic AI capabilities across business processes.
* Identify opportunities to transform manual and rule-based activities into intelligent autonomous workflows.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend enterprise adoption strategies.
* Contribute to the AI and automation roadmap aligned with business priorities.
* Partner with stakeholders to define high-value AI use cases and business transformation opportunities.

**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect enterprise-grade automation and AI solutions using Power Platform, Python, Azure AI Services, Copilot Studio, OpenAI, and related technologies.
* Design scalable AI architectures including RAG, multi-agent systems, autonomous AI workflows, intelligent document processing, conversational AI, and process intelligence solutions.
* Define integration strategies across enterprise applications, APIs, databases, knowledge platforms, and workflow systems.
* Create reusable solution patterns, frameworks, components, and technical blueprints to accelerate delivery.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI Development**

* Design and develop enterprise GenAI solutions leveraging LLMs and foundation models.
* Build intelligent AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, orchestrating, and executing business activities.
* Develop multi-agent ecosystems supporting end-to-end business processes.
* Create AI copilots and digital assistants for operations, customer support, productivity, decision intelligence, and employee self-service.
* Establish reusable agent frameworks, prompt libraries, connectors, and orchestration patterns.

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex automation and AI initiatives from discovery to production adoption.
* Provide technical guidance, solution architecture oversight, and design review across projects.
* Establish coding standards, AI development standards, reusable frameworks, and quality engineering practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, solution governance assessments, and technical risk evaluations.
* Mentor developers and AI engineers on emerging technologies, technical design, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices.

**Innovation & Capability Building**

* Drive experimentation with emerging AI technologies through proofs of concept, pilots, and rapid prototypes.
* Promote AI awareness, adoption, and practical use case identification across business functions.
* Contribute to AI community of practice, Automation Excellence standards, and Center of Excellence initiatives.
* Support capability-building programs for AI, automation, prompt engineering, agentic design, and responsible AI.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business SMEs, and Technology Teams
* Translate business problems into scalable AI and automation solutions with clear business outcomes.
* Present solution recommendations, roadmaps, technical options, risks, and value realization outcomes to leadership.
* Drive alignment between business priorities, technology investments, delivery capacity, and adoption readiness.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Automation, Software Engineering, AI Engineering, or Digital Transformation.
* 7+ years of experience delivering AI, ML, GenAI, or intelligent automation solutions.
* Proven experience leading enterprise-scale automation and AI initiatives.
* Experience working with global stakeholders, cross-functional teams, and business transformation programs.

**Technical Skills**
**Skill Area**
**Expected Capabilities**
**AI & GenAI**
Azure OpenAI, LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, model evaluation, AI agent design patterns, hallucination mitigation, model monitoring, and governance.
  
  
**AI Platforms**
Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Services, AI Builder, knowledge platforms, vector databases, and enterprise search patterns.
  
  
**Agentic AI**
Design of autonomous agents, multi-agent orchestration, tool use, planning, reasoning, workflow execution, human-in-the-loop controls, and agent monitoring.
  
  
**Programming**
Python, SQL, .NET / C#, cloud-based development, reusable libraries, and automation frameworks.
  
  
**Architecture & Engineering**
Solution architecture, integration architecture, event-driven design, enterprise application integration, data engineering foundations, security, and observability.
  
  
**Soft Skills**
:
  
  

* Ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Committed to guiding junior team members and fostering professional growth.
* Experience with Agile methodologies is a plus.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Customer-focused mindset with a passion for delivering high-quality data solutions.
* Curiosity and a growth mindset, eagerness to stay current with rapidly evolving AI/ML technologies and apply them to real-world business problems

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
  
  
We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

title: Specialist, Implementation
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Specialist, Implementation
  
  
**Overview**

* In a customer-facing environment, lead and train a cross-functional processing implementation project team of technical and non-technical electronic payment processing experts from both Mastercard and our customer
* Deliver standard through complex implementation activities ensuring quality and reliability of the implementations.
* Are you motivated to be a part of driving a world beyond cash?
* Have good knowledge about electronic payment and related processes such as authorization, clearing and settlement?
* Are you able to cope with a fast changing and ambiguous environment?
* Ability to bring new creative thoughts, ideas and solutions to make payments easier and more efficient for our customers

Role
  
  

* Act as central point of contact for customers and/ or Mastercard customer representatives throughout processing implementation project end-to-end execution.
* Assess and document customer needs and according implementation impacts on customers’ and Mastercard’s core and non-core processing systems and platforms.
* Handle multiple customer processing implementation projects in parallel

**All About You**

* Experience in “Information Technology” system knowledge, with good understanding of network technology, applications, and project management
* Knowledge of payment transaction processing and industry business knowledge
* Good understanding of Mastercard’s payment processing systems, formats and associated customer host interface testing services and principles
* Ability to interact well with the customer
* Good verbal and written communication skills
* Desire to learn independently
* Ability to work in a matrixed organizations and cross functional teams
* Ability to manage change in a technical work environment
* Open to work for Night Shift – CST Timings (Non Negotiable)

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Paid Media Manager
description:
Job Description: Paid Ads Manager / Performance Marketing Manager

**Company:** Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** Paid Ads Manager / Performance Marketing Manager  
**Department:** Performance Marketing  
**Location:** Kharadi, Pune – Head Office  
**Experience Required:** 4+ years preferred  
**Salary:** As per experience and expertise  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM

About Osumare Marketing Solutions

Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a full-service branding and digital marketing agency specializing in performance marketing, SEO, social media management, branding, website development, creative strategy, and digital growth solutions.

We manage digital marketing campaigns for clients across multiple industries, helping businesses generate qualified leads, acquire customers, increase sales, and achieve measurable growth through data-driven marketing strategies.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced, analytical, and result-oriented Paid Ads Manager who can independently plan, execute, manage, optimize, and scale paid advertising campaigns across multiple platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the complete performance marketing lifecycle, from understanding client business objectives and developing media plans to campaign setup, audience targeting, budget allocation, conversion tracking, optimization, reporting, and performance improvement.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on expertise in Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads, along with experience in e-commerce advertising, Google Shopping campaigns, remarketing, lead generation, and conversion-focused campaigns.

The candidate should be capable of managing multiple client accounts, handling advertising budgets responsibly, identifying performance improvement opportunities, and delivering measurable results while maintaining campaign profitability and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities1. Paid Advertising Strategy & Planning

* Develop comprehensive paid advertising strategies aligned with client objectives, target audiences, and business goals.
* Understand client products, services, target markets, sales processes, and customer acquisition requirements.
* Prepare media plans, advertising budgets, channel allocations, campaign structures, and performance forecasts.
* Identify the most suitable advertising platforms based on campaign objectives, audience behaviour, and industry requirements.
* Develop strategies for lead generation, e-commerce sales, website traffic, brand awareness, app promotion, and customer acquisition.
* Establish campaign KPIs such as cost per lead (CPL), cost per acquisition (CPA), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rate, and customer acquisition cost (CAC).
* Conduct competitor research, keyword research, audience research, and advertising opportunity analysis.

2. Google Ads Management

* Independently plan, set up, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.
* Manage Search, Display, Performance Max, Shopping, YouTube, and remarketing campaigns as applicable.
* Conduct keyword research, search intent analysis, negative keyword management, and search term optimization.
* Develop effective campaign structures, ad groups, bidding strategies, and conversion-focused ad copy.
* Optimize Quality Score, click-through rate (CTR), cost per click (CPC), conversion rates, and cost per acquisition.
* Manage Google Merchant Center feeds and product advertising for relevant e-commerce accounts.
* Analyze search terms, impression share, auction insights, and campaign-level performance.
* Identify wasted advertising spend and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency.
* Stay updated on Google Ads features, automation capabilities, policies, and campaign best practices.

3. Meta Ads Management

* Plan, execute, and optimize campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
* Manage lead generation, website conversion, sales, remarketing, engagement, and awareness campaigns.
* Develop audience strategies using interest targeting, custom audiences, lookalike audiences, and retargeting where appropriate.
* Set up campaign structures, placements, budgets, bidding strategies, and conversion objectives.
* Collaborate with creative teams to develop effective ad concepts, messaging, formats, hooks, and calls to action.
* Monitor campaign fatigue, frequency, CTR, CPM, CPL, CPA, and conversion rates.
* Conduct A/B tests for creatives, audiences, copy, landing pages, and campaign settings.
* Optimize lead quality and conversion performance rather than focusing only on lead volume.
* Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns while controlling acquisition costs.

4. LinkedIn Ads Management

* Plan and manage LinkedIn advertising campaigns for B2B clients.
* Develop targeting strategies based on industry, company size, job title, seniority, function, and relevant professional audiences.
* Manage Lead Gen Forms, website conversion campaigns, sponsored content, and other suitable campaign formats.
* Support B2B lead generation, account-based marketing initiatives, and high-value customer acquisition.
* Monitor lead quality, cost per lead, engagement, and conversion performance.
* Coordinate with client sales teams to understand lead quality and improve campaign targeting.
* Optimize campaigns based on business outcomes and the quality of leads generated.

5. E-commerce & Shopping Ads

* Plan and manage paid campaigns focused on online sales and revenue growth.
* Manage Google Shopping and Performance Max campaigns for eligible e-commerce businesses.
* Coordinate product feed optimization, Merchant Center diagnostics, product categorization, and product-level performance analysis.
* Develop product segmentation and budget allocation strategies based on margins, demand, inventory, and sales performance.
* Monitor ROAS, CPA, average order value, conversion rate, and revenue contribution.
* Identify high-performing products and campaigns for scaling.
* Coordinate with website and e-commerce teams to improve landing pages, checkout experiences, and conversion rates.

6. Conversion Tracking & Analytics

* Set up and validate conversion tracking using Google Ads, Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, and Google Tag Manager.
* Work with developers to implement tracking for forms, purchases, calls, WhatsApp enquiries, and other relevant conversion actions.
* Understand and troubleshoot tracking discrepancies, attribution issues, and conversion measurement errors.
* Monitor campaign performance using GA4, advertising platform dashboards, and reporting tools.
* Use available CRM and sales data to evaluate lead quality, qualified leads, sales conversion, and revenue attribution.
* Ensure that campaign decisions are based on reliable data and properly configured conversion events.
* Understand attribution models, conversion windows, consent requirements, and privacy-conscious measurement practices.

7. Campaign Optimization & Scaling

* Monitor campaign performance regularly and implement data-driven optimization strategies.
* Identify underperforming keywords, audiences, ad sets, placements, creatives, and landing pages.
* Conduct structured experiments to improve campaign efficiency and conversion performance.
* Optimize budgets, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and creative combinations.
* Scale successful campaigns while maintaining target CPL, CPA, ROAS, or other agreed KPIs.
* Diagnose performance fluctuations and recommend corrective measures.
* Identify opportunities to reduce wasted spend and improve advertising account efficiency.
* Maintain a systematic testing and optimization process across client accounts.

8. Landing Page & Conversion Rate Optimization

* Evaluate landing pages for relevance, user experience, messaging consistency, and conversion potential.
* Collaborate with design, content, and web development teams to improve landing page performance.
* Recommend improvements to headlines, forms, calls to action, page structure, loading speed, and mobile experience.
* Analyze conversion funnels and identify drop-off points.
* Support landing page A/B testing and conversion rate optimization initiatives.
* Ensure consistency between advertisements, landing pages, and the client's actual offerings.

9. Budget Management & Financial Accountability

* Manage advertising budgets responsibly across multiple platforms and client accounts.
* Allocate budgets according to campaign performance, business priorities, and growth opportunities.
* Monitor daily and monthly spending to avoid overspending and budget wastage.
* Maintain accurate campaign budget forecasts and expenditure reports.

10. Reporting & Client Communication

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly campaign performance reports.

* Explain campaign performance, challenges, and corrective actions clearly to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Track campaign KPIs against agreed targets and identify gaps.
* Coordinate with account managers and client servicing teams for updates and approvals.
* Maintain documentation of campaign structures, budgets, experiments, and optimization activities.

* Provide clear creative briefs based on audience insights, campaign objectives, and performance data.
* Ensure advertising creatives and landing pages are aligned with campaign requirements.
* Manage multiple client accounts and campaigns simultaneously.
* Take complete ownership of assigned accounts, from strategy and setup to optimization and reporting.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in paid advertising or performance marketing preferred.
* Strong practical expertise in Google Ads and Meta Ads.
* Working experience in LinkedIn Ads and B2B lead generation.
* Knowledge of Google Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube Ads, and e-commerce advertising.
* Experience managing multiple campaigns, advertising accounts, and budgets.
* Strong understanding of keyword research, audience targeting, bidding strategies, remarketing, and campaign optimization.
* Practical knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads conversion tracking, and Meta Pixel.
* Ability to analyze advertising data and make performance-driven decisions.
* Understanding of CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, ROAS, CAC, and conversion rate.
* Experience with lead generation funnels, landing pages, and conversion rate optimization.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and reporting skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and meet deadlines.

Preferred Skills

* Experience with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify or WooCommerce.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and offline conversion tracking.
* Experience with B2B marketing, real estate lead generation, or high-ticket services.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Advertising or other relevant advertising platforms.
* Familiarity with Looker Studio and performance reporting dashboards.
* Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications.
* Experience working in a digital marketing agency and managing multiple clients across industries.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on relevant client objectives and agreed targets, including:

* Achievement of target CPL, CPA, ROAS, and conversion goals.
* Quality and business relevance of leads generated.
* Campaign efficiency and responsible budget utilization.
* Improvement in conversion rates and advertising performance.
* Accuracy of tracking, analytics, and reporting.
* Timeliness of campaign launches, optimizations, and deliverables.
* Quality of strategic recommendations and experimentation.
* Client satisfaction, account retention, and proactive communication.
* Ownership, accountability, and consistency in execution.

*KPIs will be defined according to each client's industry, budget, conversion funnel, and business objectives. Results depend on market conditions, offer competitiveness, website performance, and other factors beyond advertising execution.*

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a professional who:

* Can independently handle end-to-end paid advertising campaigns without constant supervision.
* Has strong practical knowledge of multiple advertising platforms.
* Understands the difference between generating leads and generating qualified, revenue-producing leads.
* Can make strategic decisions using campaign data rather than assumptions.
* Is proactive in identifying problems and implementing solutions.
* Takes complete ownership of assigned accounts and budgets.
* Can coordinate effectively with internal teams and clients.
* Is committed to continuous learning and keeping up with changes in advertising platforms.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should share their updated resume along with details of their paid advertising experience, platforms managed, approximate advertising budgets handled, industries served, and measurable campaign results.

Candidates with relevant case studies demonstrating improvements in CPL, ROAS, conversion rates, lead quality, or customer acquisition performance will be preferred.

**We are looking for a hands-on performance marketing professional who can take complete ownership of paid advertising campaigns, manage budgets responsibly, and consistently work toward measurable business outcomes.**

title: Senior Brand Manager
description:
Job Description: Senior Brand Manager

**Company:** Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** Senior Brand Manager  
**Department:** Branding & Marketing Strategy  
**Location:** Kharadi, Pune – Head Office  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 4+ Years  
**Salary:** ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 per month, depending on skills and experience  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent  
**Work Mode:** Work From Office  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM

About Osumare Marketing Solutions

Osumare Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a full-service branding and digital marketing agency offering integrated solutions across brand strategy, brand identity, creative communication, website development, performance marketing, social media management, SEO, and digital growth.

We work with brands across multiple industries to build distinctive brand identities, strengthen market positioning, improve customer engagement, and drive business growth through strategic and creative marketing solutions.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, and creative **Senior Brand Manager** who can independently handle end-to-end brand strategy, brand positioning, communication planning, campaign conceptualization, and brand development for the agency's clients.

The candidate will be responsible for understanding client businesses, researching target audiences and competitors, developing brand strategies, defining brand communication, and ensuring consistent brand execution across digital and offline touchpoints.

The ideal candidate should combine strategic thinking, creative excellence, strong communication skills, and practical execution capabilities. The candidate must be comfortable coordinating with internal creative, content, social media, web development, and performance marketing teams to translate brand strategies into effective marketing campaigns.

Key Responsibilities1. Brand Strategy & Positioning

* Develop comprehensive brand strategies aligned with client business objectives, target audiences, and market opportunities.
* Define brand positioning, value propositions, brand purpose, brand personality, and key differentiators.
* Conduct brand discovery and audits to understand existing brand perception, strengths, weaknesses, and opportunities.
* Identify target audience segments, customer personas, purchase motivations, and consumer behaviour.
* Develop brand positioning frameworks and strategic recommendations to establish a distinctive market presence.
* Ensure brand strategies are commercially relevant, differentiated, and consistent with long-term business goals.

2. Brand Identity & Development

* Lead the development and refinement of brand identities for new and existing clients.
* Work with creative teams on brand names, logos, colour palettes, typography, visual language, and supporting brand assets.
* Develop brand guidelines, visual identity systems, and brand usage standards.
* Define tone of voice, messaging frameworks, communication styles, and brand personality.
* Ensure consistency across websites, social media, advertising creatives, presentations, brochures, and other marketing materials.
* Review creative deliverables to ensure alignment with approved brand strategy and identity guidelines.

3. Brand Communication & Messaging

* Develop brand messaging frameworks, key communication pillars, taglines, and value propositions.
* Create communication strategies for product launches, service launches, brand campaigns, and market expansion.
* Guide copywriters and creative teams in developing impactful and consistent brand communication.
* Ensure that brand messaging reflects the target audience's needs, business objectives, and competitive positioning.
* Review campaign copy, promotional messaging, website content, and advertising communication for brand consistency.
* Translate complex business offerings into clear, compelling, and differentiated brand narratives.

4. Integrated Marketing Campaigns

* Conceptualize and plan integrated branding campaigns across digital and offline channels.
* Develop campaign briefs, creative directions, communication themes, and execution plans.
* Coordinate with social media, performance marketing, SEO, content, design, and web development teams.
* Ensure campaigns communicate a consistent brand message across all relevant customer touchpoints.
* Support campaign planning for product launches, seasonal promotions, brand awareness, lead generation, and customer engagement.
* Monitor campaign performance with relevant teams and recommend improvements to strengthen brand impact.

5. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Conduct industry research, competitor benchmarking, and brand landscape analysis.
* Identify market trends, consumer insights, emerging opportunities, and competitive gaps.
* Evaluate competitor positioning, messaging, visual identity, marketing strategies, and customer communication.
* Use research findings to develop differentiated brand strategies and creative campaign concepts.
* Prepare brand audit reports, competitor analysis documents, and strategic recommendations for clients.

6. Client Management & Strategic Consulting

* Understand client business models, products, services, objectives, and growth challenges.
* Participate in client meetings, discovery sessions, and strategic planning discussions.
* Present brand strategies, campaign concepts, creative directions, and recommendations to clients.
* Translate client requirements into clear briefs for creative and marketing teams.
* Manage client feedback, expectations, approvals, and revisions professionally.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve client branding and recommend additional strategic initiatives.
* Build strong client relationships through strategic thinking, accountability, and quality delivery.

7. Creative Direction & Quality Control

* Provide strategic creative direction to graphic designers, copywriters, video editors, and other creative professionals.
* Evaluate creative concepts based on brand relevance, originality, clarity, and target audience appeal.
* Ensure all deliverables meet established brand standards and project requirements.
* Review creative outputs before client presentation or final delivery.
* Maintain consistency in brand communication across all campaign assets.
* Encourage creative innovation while ensuring alignment with business objectives and brand guidelines.

8. Project Planning & Execution

* Develop brand project plans, timelines, deliverables, and execution roadmaps.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth execution of branding projects.
* Manage multiple client accounts and branding assignments simultaneously.
* Monitor project progress, identify bottlenecks, and ensure timely completion.
* Maintain documentation of brand strategies, approved guidelines, communication frameworks, and client feedback.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned projects, from initial research and strategy through execution and final delivery.

9. Brand Performance & Reporting

* Establish appropriate brand KPIs based on campaign objectives and client requirements.
* Collaborate with digital marketing teams to evaluate brand awareness, engagement, audience response, and campaign effectiveness.
* Interpret available campaign data and consumer insights to identify areas for improvement.
* Prepare brand performance summaries, campaign reviews, and strategic recommendations.
* Use insights from campaign performance and market feedback to refine future brand strategies.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Mass Communication, Advertising, Branding, or a related field.
* Minimum **4+ years of relevant experience** in brand management, brand strategy, integrated marketing, advertising, or a branding agency.
* Strong understanding of brand positioning, brand identity, brand architecture, brand communication, and marketing strategy.
* Experience in developing brand strategies, communication frameworks, and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Excellent market research, competitor analysis, and consumer insight capabilities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to develop creative briefs and provide effective direction to design and content teams.
* Strong presentation, client management, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Excellent project management, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and deliver within deadlines.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Google Slides, Excel, Google Sheets, and documentation tools.

Preferred Experience

* Previous experience working in a digital marketing, advertising, creative, or branding agency.
* Experience handling multiple client brands across different industries.
* Experience in brand launches, rebranding, brand identity development, and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Familiarity with digital marketing channels, social media, performance advertising, SEO, and website communication.
* Experience preparing brand strategy presentations, pitch decks, brand guidelines, and campaign proposals.
* A portfolio or case studies demonstrating successful branding projects and strategic contributions.

Key Competencies

* Strategic and analytical thinking
* Strong creative judgment and conceptualization
* Brand storytelling and communication
* Client relationship management
* Cross-functional team coordination
* Attention to detail and quality consciousness
* Decision-making and problem-solving
* Time management and task prioritization
* Accountability and end-to-end ownership

Performance Expectations

The Senior Brand Manager will be expected to:

* Independently develop and execute brand strategies based on client business objectives.
* Deliver clear, actionable, and differentiated brand positioning recommendations.
* Maintain high standards of brand consistency across all client deliverables.
* Ensure timely execution of assigned branding projects.
* Provide clear strategic briefs and constructive creative direction to internal teams.
* Manage client communication and approvals efficiently.
* Identify opportunities for brand growth, differentiation, and improved communication.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of brand initiatives.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on diverse brands and industries.
* Exposure to end-to-end branding and integrated digital marketing projects.
* A collaborative environment involving strategy, creative, content, and performance marketing teams.
* Opportunities to develop strategic thinking, client consulting, and leadership capabilities.
* A role with meaningful ownership of branding projects and client deliverables.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resume along with a portfolio or case studies highlighting their experience in brand strategy, positioning, identity development, integrated campaigns, or brand communication.

**We are looking for a strategic thinker who can turn business objectives into strong brand strategies and translate those strategies into effective, consistent, and impactful brand experiences.**

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Pune, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Branding: 4 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
D2C Growth & Performance Marketing Executive

**Location:** Pune (Hadapsar)

**Salary:** ₹5–10 LPA

**Experience:** 2+ years

**Work Mode:** Onsite

**Work Timings:** 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM | Alternate Saturdays off

About FarmDidi

FarmDidi is a funded foodtech startup on a mission to empower 1 million+ rural women while bringing high-quality, authentic food products to Indian households.

We are building India's next Amul — rooted in purpose, driven by data, and built with relentless execution.

* #1 Pickle Brand on Amazon India
* Featured on Shark Tank India
* Backed by Samved VC, LetsVenture, Indigram Labs and IIM Calcutta
* Recognised by UNDP, NITI Aayog, Wharton Economic Forum, Maharashtra Government and MEITY

We are a small, ambitious team where every person has real ownership and directly contributes to building the company.

About the Role

We are looking for a **D2C Growth & Performance Marketing Executive** who can own the complete P&L of our D2C business.

This is not just a performance marketing role.

You will own the commercial performance of the D2C business — including revenue, Meta and Google advertising spends, customer acquisition, CAC, ROAS, AOV, conversion rate, contribution margin and profitability.

You should be someone who genuinely gets excited by **Meta Ads, Google Ads, numbers and analysis**.

You should enjoy looking at campaign data and asking:

* Why did CAC increase?
* Why did ROAS change?
* Which creative is actually driving conversions?
* Which audience is working?
* Where are customers dropping off?
* What changed from last week?
* What should we test next?
* Where is the next meaningful growth opportunity?

We are looking for someone who does not simply report numbers, but understands the story behind the numbers and converts analysis into action.

What You Will Own:

**1. D2C P&L Ownership**

Own the overall performance and profitability of the D2C business, including:

* D2C revenue
* Customer acquisition
* Marketing spends
* CAC
* ROAS
* AOV
* Conversion rate
* Repeat purchases
* Contribution margin
* Overall D2C profitability

You will work closely with the Founders to set monthly and quarterly revenue and profitability targets.

You will not just report numbers.

You will own the numbers.

**2. Meta and Google Ads**

You will be the primary owner of FarmDidi's Meta and Google advertising engine.

Responsibilities include:

* Own Meta and Google advertising budgets
* Plan and allocate monthly and weekly spends
* Build, manage and optimize campaigns
* Scale winning campaigns
* Identify and fix underperforming campaigns
* Manage CAC and ROAS
* Test audiences, creatives, keywords, placements and campaign structures
* Monitor CPM, CPC, CTR, CVR, CAC and ROAS
* Forecast advertising spends and revenue
* Build performance dashboards and reports
* Identify new opportunities for growth
* Continuously experiment with new campaign formats, tools and strategies

**Hands-on experience managing Meta and Google Ads spends is mandatory.**

We are not looking for someone who has only executed campaigns under supervision. We want someone who has genuinely owned budgets and performance.

3. Analytics and Growth

We are looking for someone who is **highly analytical and genuinely enjoys analysis.**

You should enjoy spending time with campaign, customer and business data to identify patterns, problems and opportunities.

You should naturally ask:

* Why did CAC increase?
* Why did ROAS drop?
* Which creative is winning and why?
* Which audience is converting?
* Which products are driving profitable growth?
* Where are customers dropping off?
* What changed compared to last week or last month?
* What does the data tell us that we are currently missing?
* What should we test next?

Your role is not simply to present data.

Your role is to turn:

**Data → Insight → Hypothesis → Experiment → Learning → Scale**

4. Content and Creative Strategy

Work closely with the content, creative and brand teams to build content that drives business outcomes.

You will:

* Analyse creative performance
* Identify winning creative themes
* Identify winning hooks and messaging
* Develop creative briefs
* Build a continuous creative testing pipeline
* Identify content opportunities based on customer and campaign data
* Translate performance insights into actionable content requirements
* Work with designers, content creators and video teams

You should be able to look at performance data and tell the content team:

**"This is what is working. This is what is not working. Let's create and test multiple variations."**

5. SEO and Organic Growth

Work closely with the SEO and content teams to build sustainable organic acquisition.

You will:

* Identify high-intent search opportunities
* Use Google Ads search data to inform SEO strategy
* Identify content gaps and opportunities
* Improve organic acquisition
* Analyse paid vs organic acquisition
* Identify opportunities to reduce long-term dependency on paid acquisition

6. Shopify and CRO

Work closely with our Shopify developers to improve the D2C funnel.

You will identify and prioritize:

* Landing page improvements
* Product page improvements
* Checkout improvements
* Conversion tracking issues
* Pixel and analytics issues
* Page speed improvements
* Funnel drop-offs
* CRO opportunities
* A/B testing opportunities

You don't need to be a developer.

But you should be able to clearly communicate:

**What is the problem? Why does it matter commercially? What should we fix or test?**

7. Team Management

You will work with and eventually manage members of the growth and performance marketing team.

You should be comfortable with:

* Setting goals
* Delegating responsibilities
* Reviewing performance
* Coaching team members
* Building SOPs
* Creating accountability
* Hiring and training talent
* Building a culture of experimentation and performance

Prior experience managing or mentoring a team is strongly preferred.

What We Are Looking ForMust Have

* 2+ years of experience in Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing or D2C
* Strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads
* Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads
* Experience managing meaningful advertising budgets
* Experience in D2C, e-commerce, FMCG, consumer brands or startups
* Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, CPM, CPC, CTR, CVR, AOV, LTV and contribution margin
* Highly analytical mindset
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
* Experience with GA4 and conversion tracking
* Experience working with Shopify or another e-commerce platform
* Experience managing or mentoring a team
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Good to Have

* Experience owning a D2C P&L
* Experience managing ₹10L+ monthly advertising spends
* Experience scaling a consumer brand
* Experience in FMCG, food or consumer products
* SEO / organic growth experience
* CRO and landing page optimization experience
* Experience working closely with content and creative teams
* Experience with Amazon Ads or other digital advertising platforms

The Person We Are Looking For

You should be:

**Highly analytical**

Numbers should excite you. You enjoy digging into dashboards, spreadsheets and campaign data to find patterns, anomalies and opportunities.

**Curious**

You don't simply accept that performance changed. You want to understand why.

**Commercially minded**

You understand that revenue without healthy contribution margins is not sustainable growth.

**Hands-on**

You are comfortable getting into Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads yourself.

**Experiment-driven**

You form hypotheses, test quickly, analyse the results and scale what works.

**Detail-oriented**

You notice when a metric moves unexpectedly and investigate it.

**Ownership-driven**

You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do. You identify problems and take responsibility for solving them.

**Fast-moving**

You believe insights should quickly become experiments and experiments should quickly generate learning.

**Collaborative**

You can work effectively with Founders, content, creative, SEO, Shopify developers and other teams.

**A team leader**

You can manage, coach and develop people while maintaining high standards.

**Always learning**

You actively follow the latest developments in Meta, Google, AI, D2C, CRO and performance marketing.

Most importantly, you should genuinely **enjoy Meta Ads, Google Ads, numbers and analysis.**

If finding a new creative angle, identifying why CAC moved, improving ROAS or discovering a new growth lever genuinely excites you, you will enjoy this role.

How We Will Measure Success

Your success will be measured by business outcomes, not by the number of campaigns launched.

You will be accountable for:

* D2C Revenue Growth
* CAC
* ROAS
* Contribution Margin
* New Customer Acquisition
* AOV
* Conversion Rate
* Repeat Purchase Rate
* Organic Revenue Growth
* D2C Profitability

The goal is to build a scalable and increasingly profitable D2C growth engine for FarmDidi.

Why Join FarmDidi?

* Work directly with the Founders
* Real ownership from Day 1
* Own a meaningful business P&L
* Build the growth engine of a rapidly growing consumer brand
* Work across Performance Marketing, Content, SEO, Shopify, CRO and Business Strategy
* 6-month appraisals
* ESOP opportunity
* High autonomy and fast decision-making
* Build a business that creates livelihoods for rural women

You won't just be running ads.

**You will be building a business.**

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: NPI Project Manager
description:
**Join our Team**
**About This Opportunity**
The NPI Project Manager EAS at EMS is responsible for driving and coordinating the successful industrialization and introduction of new products at External Manufacturing Services (EMS) partners.
  
  
The role ensures manufacturing and supply-related requirements, deliverables and readiness criteria are fulfilled throughout the NPI lifecycle, from early manufacturing preparation through Pre-PVT, Production Verification Test (PVT), ramp-up and transition into stable serial production.
  
  
Acting as the primary on-site NPI interface at the EMS partner, the role ensures effective cross-functional coordination, proactive risk management, timely issue resolution and transparent reporting to secure product quality, cost competitiveness, manufacturing readiness and agreed project milestones.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Coordinate and manage New Product Introduction (NPI) activities at EMS partners, ensuring successful transition of new antenna products from development into manufacturing, including PVT, ramp-up and serial production.
* Develop and maintain NPI project plans, ensuring manufacturing and supply-related activities, milestones and deliverables are completed on time.
* Act as the main interface between the EAS project organization and EMS partner, ensuring effective communication, coordination and alignment of priorities.
* Lead regular NPI project meetings, track progress and open actions, and drive timely resolution or escalation of critical issues.
* Coordinate manufacturing fit-gap assessments and technical enablement activities with R&D Launch Management and EMS partners to ensure production capabilities, equipment, tooling and processes meet requirements.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across R&D, Supply Chain, Quality, Project Sourcing and EMS Sourcing to ensure manufacturing, material and component readiness.
* Support on-site PVT builds, production line qualification and ramp-up to achieve Production Readiness Approval (PRA) and Start of Production (SOP).
* Monitor manufacturing and quality performance, including production yields, scrap rates, cycle times and process capability, and drive resolution of deviations.
* Identify and manage project risks, dependencies and manufacturing readiness gaps, ensuring corrective actions and timely escalation.
* Collaborate with EMS Sourcing, Cost Estimating and engineering teams on manufacturing costs, resources, production efficiency and investment requirements.
* Track EMS partner performance against project milestones, quality requirements, KPIs and NPI readiness criteria.
* Prepare regular project status reports covering progress, risks, financial implications and required management decisions.
* Ensure smooth transition from NPI to stable serial production, including issue closure, handover and lessons learned.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain or Operations.
* Program/Project Management certification such as PMP or PgMP/PjMP.
* Minimum 10 years of overall experience, including at least 5 years leading large infrastructure programs/projects.
* Strong experience in managing external suppliers, EMS partners and cross-functional teams.
* Experience in Supply Chain Management and multi-site/global manufacturing or supply chain environments.
* Proven ability to identify and manage risks and drive mitigation plans with clear ownership.
* Experience in escalation management and governance of large infrastructure programs/projects.
* Excellent communication skills with experience managing senior stakeholders.
* Manufacturing experience will be an added advantage.

description:
**Employment Type:**
Project, Full Time
  
  
**Title:**
Project Director, Preconception Nutrition & Care, India
  
  
**Location:**
New Delhi, India
  
  
**Deadline for submission:**
October 31, 2025 (Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the position may be closed once a suitable candidate is identified.)
  
  
**About Us**
Nutrition International (NI) is a global organization dedicated to delivering proven nutrition interventions to those who need them most. Working in partnership with countries, donors, and implementers, our experts conduct cutting-edge nutrition research, support critical policy formulation, and integrate nutrition into a broader development agenda. For more than 30 years now, we have focused on delivering low-cost, high-impact, nutrition interventions to people in need, driven by our mission to achieve a world where everyone, everywhere, is free from malnutrition and able to reach their full potential. Our work is guided by a dedicated and talented team of experts working globally, regionally and within countries to end malnutrition worldwide.
  
  
If you are a motivated and passionate individual who shares our conviction that a better world is possible through improved nutrition, wants to leave the world a little better than they found it, and is looking to be part of a team with a clear vision, we want to hear from you. Please consider applying for the position below which is being advertised for an anticipated project.
  
  
**About The Project**
The Preconception Nutrition and Care project is an exciting new initiative in India. It aims to change how families begin: by reaching couples of reproductive ages with nutrition, health interventions and counselling before pregnancy, so that women enter pregnancy healthier and better nourished. Healthier beginnings lead to better maternal and birth outcomes. The project takes a systems-based approach. It brings together service delivery, evidence generation, learning and government partnership, so that preconception care becomes integrated into overall health system delivery. At the heart of the project is a commitment to putting the nutritional needs of women and couples at the center of design and implementation. The project aims to generate evidence and learning from implementation, and to use it to shape national dialogue on preconception nutrition and care.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Project Director will lead this work from New Delhi. You will head a small, focused team, guide a range of implementing partners and engage with state and national government. You will also be the primary voice of the project with the donor, government, research bodies and the private sector. You will work closely with Nutrition International's Maternal Newborn Health and Nutrition and Health Economics and Nutrition Financing portfolios, as well as colleagues in the Asia Regional Office and headquarters in Ottawa.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to lead a high-visibility project, with full accountability for results, partnerships and resources. You will help set the direction for how India, and the wider region, approaches nutrition and care before pregnancy.
**In this role you**
**will be responsible to:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for donor/s, national government representatives and strategic partners to lead evidence-based negotiations on project priorities, scope, and deliverables
* Facilitate shared understanding of project scope, goals and deliverables and among project staff, partners and stakeholders
* Guide the implementation of project activities and ensure project staff and partners are executing the project according to the approved project plan
* Manage relations with partners, service providers and consultants of the project, according to Nutrition International's policies. This includes the development of terms of reference, service provided and consultant/firm selection, contracting, monitoring and end of contract processes
* Oversee and work closely with government stakeholders and partners to develop detailed annual workplans that clearly define the strategies, activities and resources (time, budget and equipment etc.) required for effective implementation of the project; and update workplans regularly to ensure the timely completion of activities and achievement of the deliverables
* Cultivate and manage strong, collaborative relationships with implementing partners, government authorities, donors and other key stakeholders. Ensure open communication channels and a shared understanding of the project's goals, responsibilities, and timelines
* Identify and engage with potential new partners that align with the project's objectives, ensuring their capacities complement the project's needs and strategies
* Ensure monitoring and learning strategies and systems are applied within the project in collaboration with the Monitoring, Data and Learning sub-unit
* Ensure a monitoring plan is developed and followed by the project team and partners. Ensure monitoring data is analyzed and used for course correction as needed
* Ensure that the project has a comprehensive staffing strategy with the appropriate composition of team members to ensure adequate oversight and quality assurance of all work within the project
* Manage project staff contracts and consultants in a timely manner and according to local legislation and Nutrition International policies
* Provide financial oversight for the full scope of the project. Maintain oversight on all sub-grants within the project and their associated budget(s) and ensure that partners establish appropriate financial procedures and tools required to be in alignment with Nutrition International requirements and standards
* Develop regular cash flow projections and monitor expenditure and review variance analysis to ensure the project operates within its budget parameters
* Ensure all project funds are managed according to established accounting policies, procedures and donor regulations
* Ensure donor stewardship with our committed donors to sustain relationships. Build and strengthen relationships with key project stakeholders and partners to ensure the project is harmonized with other donors funded project/programs and facilitates government leadership and ownership
* Establish mechanisms for regular communication within the project team, Country leadership and across partners and with Nutrition International leadership to maximize opportunities for program integration and to elevate issues or risks

title: Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert, GxD hub
description:
**Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert, GxD hub**

**Engagement Type:**

Consultancy

**Location: New Delhi**

**LEAD’s**
**Gender x Digital (GxD) hub**
**is seeking a Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert to support a large-scale government programme focused on digital skilling and AI capability building. The role combines inclusion strategy, data systems, and stakeholder coordination, with a focus on developing and operationalising frameworks, establishing inclusion metrics and monitoring systems, and building a coherent evidence base on programme inclusion.**
**About LEAD at Krea University**

LEAD
is an action-oriented research centre of IFMR Society (a not-for-profit society registered under the Societies Act), leverages the power of research, innovation and co-creation to solve complex and pressing challenges in development. LEAD specialises in developing in-depth granular understanding of socio-economic contexts and harnessing actionable insights that have a wide range of applications in industry, policy, and academia. LEAD is a collaborative hub that brings experts from diverse disciplines and sectors together to develop innovative solutions by harnessing innovation, technology and analytics.

**About GxD hub**

The
Gender x Digital hub (GxD hub)
is a cross-disciplinary platform dedicated to advancing meaningful digital connectivity among women and girls in India. GxD hub is an initiative of LEAD at Krea University (IFMR). Our mission is to address critical intersections between gender and digital through rigorous research, impactful engagement with stakeholders, and ecosystem development. Our work is rooted in a deep commitment to develop gender intentional and overall inclusive digital platforms in the country.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Consultant – Inclusion and Data Expert to support a large-scale government programme focused on digital skilling and AI capability building. The candidate will sit at the intersection of inclusion strategy, data systems, and stakeholder co-ordination, contributing to the development and operationalisation of frameworks that ensure equitable participation across beneficiary cohorts, with a particular focus on women and underserved groups.

This role combines inclusion expertise with strong data capabilities. The candidate will be responsible for tracking and synthesising progress against inclusion targets, while building the systems and evidence base needed to document and communicate the programme’s equity outcomes across states and implementing partners.

This is a stakeholder-facing role for someone who can navigate government and field contexts while bringing analytical rigour to their work. The ideal candidate is an inclusion practitioner with strong data and research skills, who can synthesise evidence, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and translate programme insights into clear, actionable outputs. The candidate will be placed within the Ministry that GxD hub is closely working with.

**Key Responsibilities**



**Inclusion Strategy and Implementation**

●     Develop and operationalise an inclusion strategy to ensure equitable participation across beneficiary cohorts, with attention to gender, geography, and socioeconomic status

●     Advise on accessibility standards for training content, digital platforms, and learning delivery mechanisms

●     Conduct periodic reviews and recommend interventions to address participation gaps across regions and demographics

**Monitoring, Data, and Evidence**

●     Establish inclusion metrics, monitoring frameworks, and reporting mechanisms for states and implementing partners

●     Ensure inclusion-related data is systematically collated, structured, and narrated consistently — building a coherent evidence base from the programme's earliest stages

●     Track and monitor progress on women's participation and other inclusion targets, and synthesise findings into regular reports and briefs for internal and external audiences

●     Support secondary data analysis and evidence synthesis to contextualise programme data within the broader landscape of digital inclusion in India

**Government and Stakeholder Coordination**

●     Coordinate with ministries, state governments, NGOs, and community organisations to improve outreach among underserved groups

**Minimum Qualifications**

●     Master's degree in Social Sciences, Gender Studies, Public Policy, Development Studies, Education, or a related field

●     Minimum 8 years of experience in inclusion, gender, accessibility, social development, or large-scale government or development programmes

●     Demonstrated experience working directly with central or state government counterparts in India — including in advisory, coordination, or embedded roles

●     Strong track record in data synthesis, evidence collation, and translating programme data into structured narratives for policy and funder audiences

●     Experience designing or operationalising inclusion monitoring frameworks, with hands-on familiarity with indicator development and reporting systems

**Strongly Desired**

●     Prior experience embedded in or advising large-scale government skilling, digital access.

●     Familiarity with India's digital ecosystem, including digital public infrastructure, and the policy landscape around AI and digital skilling

●     Experience working with government-commissioned research, and multi-stakeholder coordination across central and state bodies

●     Comfort with both qualitative and quantitative research methods, including primary data collection, field assessments, and mixed-method approaches

**Application Instructions**

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

**To apply, please email the below documents as a single PDF to**
**hr-lead@ifmr.ac.in**
**:**

●     Curriculum vitae

●     Cover letter (no more than two pages) explaining your interest in the role and writing sample

***Note:***
*Due to the large volume of applications we receive, we are unable to contact each candidate individually regarding the status of their application. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purposes.*
