title: Art Director
description:
**About Fraganote**

Fraganote is a VC-backed Indian fragrance house redefining how modern India experiences perfume.

We are deeply obsessed with blends, stories, and the emotional architecture of fragrance. Here, perfume isn't just a product—it's identity, memory, mood, and cultural commentary.

Conversations in our office range from olfactory construction to consumer psychology to whether a vanilla note should feel smoky, creamy, or quietly powerful.

We move fast. We think long-term. And we're building one of India's most iconic fragrance brands.

**Job Summary**

As the
**Art Director**
at Fraganote, you will define and elevate the creative vision of the brand across every consumer touchpoint. You'll lead the visual language of campaigns, product launches, content, packaging, and digital experiences while ensuring every piece of communication reflects the sophistication and emotional depth of the brand.

This role goes beyond execution—you'll be responsible for conceptual thinking, creative direction, mentoring the design team, and collaborating closely with marketing, content, photography, product, and founders to create work that is culturally relevant, visually distinctive, and commercially impactful.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve Fraganote's creative and visual identity across digital, print, packaging, retail, and social platforms.
* Conceptualize and lead end-to-end creative campaigns for product launches, seasonal drops, and brand initiatives.
* Direct the overall visual storytelling of the brand across performance marketing, organic content, website, email, and offline experiences.
* Lead, mentor, and inspire the design team while maintaining exceptional creative standards.
* Collaborate with photographers, videographers, stylists, content creators, and marketing teams during creative planning and production.
* Review and approve all creative assets before publication to ensure consistency, quality, and brand alignment.
* Drive innovation by exploring new design trends, visual styles, AI-assisted creative workflows, and emerging cultural aesthetics.
* Build scalable design systems and creative processes that improve efficiency without compromising quality.
* Balance strong artistic vision with business objectives, ensuring creative work contributes to brand growth and performance.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, or a related field.
* **8-10 years**
  of experience in creative design, with at least
  **3–4 years leading creative projects or teams**
  .
* Strong portfolio showcasing expertise in branding, campaign design, packaging, digital marketing creatives, and visual storytelling.
* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Figma, and creative workflow tools. Motion design experience is a plus.
* Deep understanding of typography, composition, colour theory, luxury aesthetics, and brand systems.
* Experience working in D2C, beauty, fashion, luxury, lifestyle.
* Strong leadership, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional creative taste with an eye for detail and a passion for building iconic brands.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for someone who doesn't just design beautiful assets—they create worlds that people want to be a part of.

You understand how luxury brands communicate, how culture influences design, and how great creative can drive both emotion and business results. If you're excited about building one of India's most loved fragrance brands through bold ideas and exceptional craft, we'd love to meet you

**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO South-East Asia Regional Office (SEARO) seeks to establish a roster of qualified consultants to provide technical support to Member States in the development, implementation, costing, monitoring, evaluation, review, and strengthening of National Action Plans (NAPs) on Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR).
  
  
Selected consultants may be engaged to support regional and country-level activities aligned with the Global Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance, the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, and the One Health approach.
  
  
**Background**
Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) remains a major threat to public health, food security, economic development, and health system resilience. Countries in the WHO South-East Asia Region have developed and are implementing National Action Plans on AMR; however, varying levels of capacity, financing, governance, monitoring systems, and multisectoral coordination continue to challenge effective implementation.
  
  
To support Member States in strengthening AMR national programmes and advancing implementation of the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025-2030, WHO requires a roster of technical experts capable of providing specialized support across strategic planning, costing, resource mobilization, monitoring and evaluation, programme review, governance strengthening, and One Health coordination.
  
  
The roster will enable WHO to rapidly mobilize qualified experts to support national and regional priorities as needs arise.
  
  
**Deliverables**

**Deliverable 1: National Action Plan Development and Revision**

* Conduct situational and strategic analyses.
* Facilitate stakeholder consultations and multisectoral engagement.
* Develop or update AMR National Action Plans.
* Prepare implementation frameworks and operational plans.
* Support national validation and endorsement processes.

**Deliverable 2: Costing, Budgeting and Financing**

* Develop costed implementation plans.
* Conduct budget and financing analyses.
* Estimate resource requirements and investment needs.
* Develop financing scenarios and sustainability plans.
* Prepare resource mobilization strategies and investment cases.
* Assess cost-saving potential, cost-effectiveness and return on investment for AMR interventions and implementation options.

**Deliverable 3: Monitoring, Evaluation and Accountability Frameworks**

* Develop theories of change and results frameworks.
* Design logical frameworks and performance indicators.
* Establish monitoring and reporting mechanisms.
* Develop accountability and learning frameworks.
* Design data collection and review tools

**Deliverable 4: Mid-Term and End-Term Reviews**

* Develop review methodologies and assessment tools.
* Conduct programme performance reviews.
* Facilitate stakeholder consultations and review workshops.
* Analyse implementation progress and bottlenecks.
* Produce review reports and recommendations.

**Deliverable 5: Capacity Development**

* Develop training materials and guidance documents.
* Deliver workshops and technical training sessions.
* Provide mentoring and coaching to national teams.
* Strengthen national capacity in planning, costing, monitoring and evaluation.

**Deliverable 6: Reporting and Policy Products**

* Prepare technical reports and progress reports.
* Develop policy briefs and evidence summaries.
* Produce national and regional assessment reports.
* Develop strategic planning and investment documents.

**Qualifications, experience, skills and languages**

AMR continues to threaten public health and health system resilience across the WHO South-East Asia Region. Despite progress in implementing national action plans, countries continue to face challenges in responsible antimicrobial use, equitable access to quality-assured antimicrobials, stewardship capacity, AMU surveillance, regulatory oversight and pharmaceutical governance. Strengthening AWaRe implementation, stewardship programmes, surveillance systems and One Health collaboration remains a regional priority under the WHO SEARO Regional Roadmap on AMR 2025–2030. Establish or strengthen AMU surveillance systems, including methods, protocols, data collection, analysis, reporting, dashboards, multisectoral integration, and technical recommendations.
  
  
**Deliverable 2: Antimicrobial Stewardship Programme Development and Implementation**
Develop and implement AMS strategies, programmes, tools and quality-improvement measures, including AWaRe implementation and interventions to improve prescribing practices.

**Deliverable 4: Regulatory Systems and Pharmaceutical Governance**
Review antimicrobial regulatory and policy frameworks, assess prescribing, dispensing, sales and marketing practices, and support stronger regulations, quality assurance, licensing, prescription-only policies and implementation recommendations.
  
  
**Deliverable 5: One Health Antimicrobial Use Optimization**
Support One Health approaches to optimize antimicrobial use across human, animal, food production and environmental sectors, including multisectoral coordination, integrated monitoring, consultations, and implementation of responsible-use strategies and action plans.

Develop and deliver AMS/AMU training, mentoring, awareness and behaviour-change activities, and strengthen institutional capacity for stewardship, surveillance, regulation and access programmes.

Monitor and evaluate AMS, AMU, access and governance programmes, including indicators, reporting systems, performance reviews, lessons learned and recommendations for strengthening and sustainability.

We are looking for a Senior Director to join our Delay - Expert Services team. In this role you’ll provide advisory services to Clients seeking to enhance their commercial performance and corporate governance including the introduction and improvement of project controls and risk management.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform Delay Analysis for large Construction & Infrastructure projects in international arbitration and litigation.
* Drafting and reviewing concise but detailed expert reports based on the analysis findings.
* Reviewing documents on varied project types in a broad range of industries, for example infrastructure, oil & gas, energy or renewables.
* Drafting notes, presentations and external communications to assist with the overall project scope and individual work streams.
* Presenting and participating in client meetings
* Provide assistance in managing the workload and tasks of the project team and arrange and organize the documentation filing process for the project.
* Supporting Clients and their consultants engaged in Alternative Dispute Resolution and the delivery of complex and challenging major projects and programmes of work
* Providing advisory services to Clients seeking to enhance their commercial performance and corporate governance including the introduction and improvement of project controls and risk management.
* Regularly attending marketing events – client events, seminars and lectures to build relationships in the field.

**Requirements**

* Degree level education in a construction related field (Civil Engineering, Industrial Engineering and/or Construction Management).
* Relevant MSc in Engineering and/or Construction law would be an advantage.
* Ideally 10+ years of construction/industrial experience. Ideally with international exposure to large projects and experience as a site planner or tendering manager. A strong understanding of most common construction contract schemes (NEC, FIDIC…) would be an advantage.
* Ideally 3+ years’ experience of performing detailed delay forensic analysis and with a deep understanding of the delay analysis practice and standards (SCL, AACE, etc.)
* Proficient with Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project. Excellent understanding of planning concepts such as criticality, float, lag, concurrency and planning and resource allocation.
* Microsoft Excel and Office and comfortable with large sets of data and documentation.
* Excellent analytical skills, an attention to detail and exceptional report writing skills.
* Confident and impactful presenter.
* Ability to work well under pressure.

**About Kroll**
In a world of disruption and increasingly complex business challenges, our professionals bring truth into focus with the Kroll Lens. Our sharp analytical skills, paired with the latest technology, allow us to give our clients clarity—not just answers—in all areas of business. We embrace diverse backgrounds and global perspectives, and we cultivate diversity by respecting, including, and valuing one another. As part of One team, One Kroll, you’ll contribute to a supportive and collaborative work environment that empowers you to excel.
  
  
In courts and international tribunals worldwide, Kroll's experts help businesses, investors and legal advisers establish facts, determine values and settle critical questions. We provide credible analysis, robust valuations and familiarity with all legal and arbitration procedures and venues. Our professionals bring expertise from a wide range of industries, including construction and infrastructure; energy and mining; financial services; healthcare; retail; and technology, telecoms and media. We also help businesses anticipate project problems, protect their IP, prevent fraud, handle investigations, maintain compliance and deliver the world’s most challenging projects.
  
  
At Kroll, your work will help deliver clarity to our clients’ most complex governance, risk, and transparency challenges. Apply now to join One team, One Kroll.
  
  
In order to be considered for a position, you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Description**

NikahForever is India’s leading Community Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. We have proudly facilitated 5 million+ members. By leveraging AI-based algorithms, we streamline the process of searching and connecting with compatible profiles. Our platform redefines how people perceive and approach marriage, ensuring an easy and efficient experience.

**Build the Team. Own the Architecture. Ship the Product. Solve the Hardest Problems.**

**Experience:**
Proven engineering leadership experience required

**Preferred background:**
Strong product-based technology companies

**Role:**
Hands-on Engineering Manager / Individual Contributor

**Expectation:**
High ownership, high execution velocity, zero dependency on constant supervision

The Role

We are looking for an engineering leader who can do both:
**build a high-performing engineering team and personally solve difficult engineering problems.**

You are not someone who stopped coding after becoming a manager. You can review a system architecture, understand an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a production outage, write a critical service, build an AI agent, and still know how to hire, coach, challenge, and manage engineers effectively.

You can take an ambiguous business objective, translate it into an engineering strategy, break it into executable work, assign ownership, remove bottlenecks, and drive it to production.

When the team is moving fast, you multiply its output. When a critical technical problem is blocking delivery, you can get into the details and help solve it yourself.

You are technology-agnostic, obsessed with execution, comfortable with complexity, and actively exploring how AI and autonomous agents can change the way software is built.

**We are not looking for a manager who needs a team to do the engineering for them but for an engineer who has developed the ability to make an entire team more effective without losing the ability to build themselves.**

**What You Will Own**

1. Engineering execution and delivery

* Take complete ownership of engineering delivery, from understanding business priorities to shipping reliable production systems.
* Convert ambiguous business objectives into clear technical plans, milestones, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive execution across multiple projects without allowing dependencies, indecision, or coordination overhead to become excuses for delays.
* Identify bottlenecks early, make trade-offs decisively, and unblock the team without waiting for escalations.
* Maintain high execution velocity without accumulating reckless technical debt or compromising security and reliability.
* Ensure the team ships working software, not just completed tickets, merged pull requests, or impressive-looking roadmaps.
* Take direct ownership of critical deliverables when timelines or technical complexity demand hands-on intervention.

2. Hands-on engineering and technical leadership

* Remain technically credible through active coding, code reviews, debugging, system design, and production ownership.
* Design and build backend services, APIs, integrations, data pipelines, automations, and AI-powered systems as required.
* Navigate unfamiliar repositories and technology stacks without treating unfamiliarity as a blocker.
* Make sound architecture decisions based on business needs, scalability, reliability, maintainability, cost, and time to market.
* Diagnose complex production failures, performance bottlenecks, data inconsistencies, and difficult integration issues.
* Establish engineering standards for code quality, testing, security, observability, deployment, and operational readiness.
* Know when to delegate, when to coach, and when to personally take the keyboard.

3. Team leadership and people management

* Build and manage a team of high-performing engineers with clear expectations, accountability, and ownership.
* Hire engineers who demonstrate exceptional problem-solving ability, technical depth, learning speed, and execution.
* Set a high engineering bar and address persistent performance issues directly and fairly.
* Coach engineers through difficult technical decisions instead of becoming the team's permanent debugging service.
* Develop engineers who can independently own systems, make decisions, and deliver outcomes.
* Create a culture where engineers challenge assumptions, surface problems early, take responsibility, and continuously improve.
* Balance delegation with hands-on involvement without becoming either a micromanager or an absent manager.
* Provide clear feedback, manage performance, resolve conflicts, and make difficult people decisions when necessary.

4. AI-native and agentic engineering

We expect you to be an active practitioner of modern AI-assisted engineering, not someone who merely encourages the team to experiment with ChatGPT.

* Use AI coding agents to accelerate code exploration, implementation, debugging, testing, and refactoring.
* Build or integrate agentic workflows involving planning, tool calling, multi-step execution, external APIs, and verification.
* Identify engineering and business processes that can be automated using LLMs, agents, and conventional software.
* Establish practical workflows that increase engineering throughput without sacrificing correctness or security.
* Evaluate new AI tools based on measurable improvements in delivery speed, quality, and cost.
* Teach the team how to use AI effectively, review AI-generated code critically, and validate agent-driven changes.
* Personally prototype and ship AI-powered solutions rather than limiting your involvement to strategy and vendor selection.

**We want a leader who uses AI to increase the output of the entire engineering organization, including their own.**

5. Cross-domain problem solving

You should be comfortable moving between fundamentally different technical challenges.

Depending on the problem, this may involve:

* Backend architecture, APIs, databases, caching, and distributed systems.
* Mobile, web, and end-to-end product workflows.
* Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, performance, and incident management.
* Payment gateways, third-party integrations, asynchronous workflows, and data consistency.
* AI applications, LLM integrations, agentic systems, and automation.
* Security, reliability, cost optimization, and scaling systems under real-world constraints.

6. Business ownership

* Understand the business metrics behind the engineering roadmap.
* Prioritize work based on customer impact, revenue, risk, and engineering effort.
* Challenge unnecessary complexity, low-value projects and choices that don't solve a meaningful problem.
* Make informed build-versus-buy decisions.
* Optimize infrastructure and engineering costs without creating fragile systems.
* Communicate technical risks, delivery trade-offs, and progress clearly to business stakeholders.

You are expected to understand not just whether something can be built, but whether it should be built, why it matters, and how quickly it needs to deliver value.

The Non-Negotiable Bar

**Technical credibility:**
You have personally built and shipped production software and can still reason deeply about code and architecture.

**Independent execution:**
You do not need your manager to tell you what to prioritize, how to solve a problem, or how to unblock your team.

**Leadership without hiding behind delegation:**
You can manage through others while remaining capable of direct technical contribution.

**Breadth of experience:**
You have dealt with different classes of engineering problems and can adapt beyond your primary specialization.

**AI-native thinking:**
You actively use AI and agentic workflows to improve individual and team productivity.

**Accountability:**
When a project fails, you investigate the causes, own your part, correct the course, and prevent avoidable recurrence.

**People leadership:**
You can attract, develop, challenge, and retain strong engineers while addressing underperformance directly.

What We Do Not Want

* A people manager who has lost the ability to understand or contribute to the code.
* A project manager whose primary output is meetings, status reports, and Jira updates.
* An architect who produces diagrams but cannot validate implementation details.
* A hands-off manager who delegates every difficult technical problem.
* A micromanager who becomes the approval bottleneck for every decision.

What Success Looks Like

* The team consistently ships high-quality software with predictable execution.
* Engineers operate with greater independence and take meaningful ownership.
* Architectural and technical decisions improve the product rather than create unnecessary complexity.
* Critical production issues are diagnosed and resolved systematically.
* AI and automation measurably improve engineering throughput.
* Engineering resources are allocated to the highest-impact problems.
* You can step into the hardest technical problems without becoming a permanent bottleneck.

Interview Process

* **Technical deep dive:**
  Walk us through complex systems you have personally designed, built, shipped, or operated.
* **Live problem solving:**
  Debug an unfamiliar codebase, investigate a failure, or solve a practical engineering problem.
* **System design:**
  Design a production system and defend your choices around reliability, scale, security, cost, and delivery speed.
* **AI-agent exercise:**
  Use an AI coding agent to solve a bounded engineering task and demonstrate how you verify its work.
* **Engineering management scenarios:**
  Handle missed commitments, underperformance, technical disagreements, competing priorities, and team bottlenecks.
* **Execution review:**
  Explain a difficult project you owned, the decisions you made, what went wrong, and the measurable result.
* **Ownership verification:**
  Distinguish what you personally contributed from what the team delivered.

We will evaluate the reasoning behind your decisions, not just the final answers.

**The expectation is simple: lead the team, own the outcome, understand the technology, and be ready to build when it matters.**

title: CAMPUS AMBASSADOR PROGRAM MANAGER
description:
Tejaki — by Blowtrumpet Technologies
  
  

* South Delhi

**ABOUT Tejaki**
Tejaki is Blowtrumpet’s publisher-facing supply-side platform (SSP), built for content creators who want transparent monetisation. Tejaki runs on offers — not blind bids — so creators know what they are earning and why. It supports multiple content formats and fair revenue distribution. Tejaki is a product under Blowtrumpet Technologies.
  
  
THE ROLE
  
  
Drive Tejaki’s campus community — reaching content creators, publishers, and SSP-curious students through campus ambassadors who understand the supply-side of advertising and fair monetisation.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and execute the campus ambassador programme across target colleges in India
* Identify, recruit, and onboard campus ambassadors — training them on company values, products, and community standards
* Build relationships with college placement cells, TPOs, student bodies, and faculty sponsors
* Plan and coordinate campus events — tech talks, workshops, hackathons, and industry connect sessions
* Manage the campus ambassador community on HFW — facilitating engagement, resolving issues, and celebrating wins
* Lead skill development initiatives — coding challenges, design sprints, research paper workshops — tailored to each campus
* Connect students with internship and early-career placement opportunities across all Blowtrumpet products
* Track programme metrics — ambassador activity, event attendance, application conversions, and community growth
* Collaborate with HR and hiring managers to create seamless pathways from campus to career

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong understanding of the Indian college ecosystem — IITs, NITs, IIIT, DTU, BITS, IGDTUW, and similar institutions
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills — you can connect with a 20-year-old student and a college dean in the same day
* Event planning and project management skills

* Familiarity with Discord, WhatsApp, and community management tools
* Willingness to travel to campuses as needed

EARLY CAREER & CAMPUS TALENT

**early-career graduates**
and
**final-year interns**
to consider long-term opportunities in innovation and establish stable careers with us in one of the most promising industry segments. If you are looking to create a ding in the universe, this may be your chance.
  
  
Blowtrumpet is not just offering a job — we are offering a seat at the table where the future of advertising technology is being designed. You will work with small, focused teams, learn from practitioners, ship real products, and grow into a career that compounds.
  
  
STATEMENT OF PURPOSE
  
  
Along with your application, please include a
**Statement of Purpose**
that covers:

* Your 3–5 year career vision — where do you see yourself, what kind of work excites you, and what impact do you want to make?

WORKING AT BLOWTRUMPET
  
  
We function like a startup — and we are proud of it. That means you will wear multiple hats, take ownership beyond your title, and grow faster than you would in a larger organisation. We are looking for people who thrive on that kind of pace.
  
  
**A Few Things To Know Upfront**

* Excellence is non-negotiable. We have no room for mediocrity. We would rather ship fewer things brilliantly than many things passably.
* Growth-oriented. We invest in training, mentorship, and giving you real responsibility early. Your growth is the company’s growth.
* Early starts, disciplined days. We are based in South Delhi and our working day begins at 8 AM. We believe discipline creates freedom — starting early lets us work with focus, finish with intention, and keep stress low.
* Low stress, high standards. We keep the environment calm and supportive. People here help each other, cover for each other, and win together. The pressure comes from the pursuit of great work, not from mismanagement.

title: Head - Policy, Systems & Program Architecture
description:
**Competency**
: Policy analysis, systems thinking, program architecture, government process literacy, documentation.

**Job Mode:**
Onsite

**Reports To:**
Founder & CEO / Board of Directors

**Location:**
New Delhi (HQ) · Multi-state travel

**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk's core identity is as a policy-to-outcomes institution builder. This role is the intellectual and architectural engine of that identity. The Head – Policy, Systems & Program Architecture owns the 'R' and 'I' of the RIGHT model: Redesign (policy co-shaping) and Institutionalize (systems design). Everything that becomes RightWalk standard must pass through this function. This role ensures that what works in one state becomes codified, transferable, and replicable — not tribal knowledge locked in people's heads.

This role owns the institutional architecture of RightWalk’s work: policy reform logic, system design, program models, SOPs, quality thresholds, PMU blueprints, exit criteria and codification of what works across states. It protects the organisation’s identity as a systems-change institution.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Policy reform logic and standards**

* Own the policy reform logic across RightWalk's domains — Education (RTE), Livelihood (Apprenticeship), and Health — including policy interpretation, rights-based reasoning, and advocacy positioning.
* Define non-negotiable standards for program design and implementation fidelity.
* Support government-facing policy/process improvements through evidence and design.
* Set non-negotiable program standards: define quality thresholds, entry/exit criteria, and program fidelity benchmarks across all states.
* Lead policy domain heads (Education, Livelihood, Health) and guide specialist analysts.
* Engage with government counterparts, NITI Aayog, and central ministries on policy refinement.

**2. Systems and process architecture**

* Design institutional systems: SOPs, process flows, governance structures, government-technology interface specifications, and central-state system alignment.
* Translate policy intent into implementable system designs.
* Develop templates for process mapping, bottleneck analysis and system redesign.
* Work with technology and data teams to ensure digital tools reflect real administrative workflows.

**3. Program architecture and playbooks**

* Own the codification of 'what works' — convert state-level learning into replicable playbooks, training curricula, and toolkits.
* Translate policy intent into executable program architecture — the bridge between reform logic and PMU operations.
* Define what must be standardised centrally and what can be adapted by states.
* Develop exit and transition criteria for government ownership.
* Ensure each program has clear logic from policy intent to beneficiary outcome.

**4. Codification and replication**

* Capture state innovations and convert them into RightWalk standards.
* Sign off on any new program design or modification before state rollout — the 'fidelity gate' for all RightWalk programs.
* Build knowledge products that support scale, training, donor communication and government adoption.

**5. Cross-functional alignment**

* Partner with the Data/M&E function on KPI definitions, indicator frameworks, and learning loops.
* Work with Programs to test architecture in real state contexts.
* Work with Tech/Product to translate workflows into digital requirements.
* Work with Communications to ensure public narrative reflects real systems work.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — SIX MONTHS**

* RightWalk has a clear, documented policy and program architecture for each of its three domains — living documents that are used, not just filed.
* Every PMU in every state is working from a consistent playbook — not inventing their own approach.
* SOP and playbook structure created for major programs.
* The 'RightWalk Standard' exists — a codified set of quality thresholds and fidelity benchmarks that any state PMU can be assessed against.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Running state execution or managing PMU field teams.
* Owning donor relationships or fundraising proposals.
* Communications and media strategy.
* Data collection or field M&E.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Experience:**
  12–18 years. Prior experience at the intersection of policy and systems — could be government, a policy think-tank, a development consulting firm, or a senior implementation NGO role.
* **Domain:**
  Deep familiarity with at least one of RightWalk's domains: education (RTE), labour/apprenticeship, or public health systems.
* **Government literacy:**
  Ability to work with government drafting — GOs, policy circulars, SOP design — not just analysis.
* **Writing:**
  Exceptional writing and documentation discipline — can produce policy briefs, system blueprints, and playbooks independently.
* **Mindset:**
  Architecture mindset: thinks in systems, process flows, and standards — not just programmes.
* **Backbone:**
  Comfortable holding the line on quality and fidelity even under pressure from execution teams.



**Success traits**
: Architecture mindset, clarity, strong writing, humility to learn from the field, courage to define standards, ability to hold complexity without drowning everyone in it.

title: Senior Analyst, PPK Operations
description:
**Company Overview**
Bain & Company is the management consulting firm that the world's business leaders come to when they want results. Bain advises clients on strategy, operations, information technology, organization, private equity, digital transformation and strategy, and mergers and acquisitions, developing practical insights that clients act on and transferring skills that make change stick. The firm aligns its incentives with clients by linking its fees to their results. Bain clients have outperformed the stock market 4 to 1. Founded in 1973, Bain has 58 offices in 37 countries, and its deep expertise and client roster cross every industry and economic sector.
  
  
**Department Overview**
Bain's Product, Practice & Knowledge (PPK) department has played a vital role in harnessing the best of our consulting staffs' individual and collective expertise for over 20 years. Within PPK, each practice supports teams across the globe with deep expertise and knowledge. Our practices play a critical role in Bain's commercial success and are a key strategic priority.
  
  
PPK is continually focused on creating a stronger, more scalable, efficient and effective PPK organization. The PPK Operations team will help achieve this by developing and improving processes, tools, and communications to better support our PPK teams.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Senior Analyst is a technical builder on the PPK Operations team. Where the Analyst supports defined analytical workstreams and the Operations Manager owns the simplification agenda end to end, this role sits between the two: it takes ownership of complete solutions from problem definition through build and adoption, working with limited supervision, and is expected to bring the technical depth that makes automation and AI-enabled delivery real.
  
  
The distinguishing expectation of this role is speed of build. We are looking for someone who uses AI tools and low-code platforms to deliver dashboards, automations and analyses in a fraction of the time traditional approaches require, and who can explain and defend the logic behind what they build.
  
  
**Automation and AI-enabled solution build (~40%)**

* Designs and builds automated solutions that remove manual effort from recurring PPK processes, using Power Automate, SharePoint, Excel and scripting as appropriate
* Uses AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT as a core part of the build workflow to accelerate development, generate and debug code and formulas, structure unfamiliar data, and prototype solutions quickly
* Prototypes and deploys AI agents and assistants for defined PPK use cases; identifies where an agentic approach outperforms a conventional one

* Shares reusable assets, templates and best practices across PPK so solutions built once are used many times

**About You**

**Technical skills: preferred**

**Experience And Mindset**

* 4 to 6 years of experience in a professional services, consulting, analytics, knowledge management or operations environment

* A self-learner with a genuine desire to figure it out; you pick up new tools quickly and without being taught
* A passion for changing how work gets done by adopting new approaches and new technology, paired with the judgement to know when the traditional approach is still the right one

* The maturity and integrity to handle confidential information and to use technology, including AI, responsibly
* Ability to operate independently, comfortable with a remote supervisor and wider team, managing competing priorities with minimal supervision

title: Head - Data M&E & Institutional Intelligence
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk operates on the principle that 'what gets measured, gets governed.' This role owns the data spine of the organisation — the independent control room that tells every layer of RightWalk whether systems are working, outcomes are real, and learning is being captured. Critically, this function must be independent of the program teams whose performance it measures. Data inflation and incentive-driven reporting are existential threats to RightWalk's credibility. The Head – Data, M&E & Institutional Intelligence is the institutional conscience of the organisation's evidence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Data and indicator architecture**

* Design and own the end-to-end data architecture: from field input to impact indicators — definitions, collection protocols, validation logic, and storage.
* Build common data dictionaries across programs and states.
* Ensure indicator definitions are clear, auditable and usable by teams.
* Align program indicators with donor reporting, government dashboards and internal learning needs.

**2. Dashboards and institutional intelligence**

* Build and maintain real-time dashboards and standard report packs for the CEO, state teams, and donors.
* Drive institutional intelligence: cross-state comparisons, learning loops, and evidence synthesis for policy refinement.
* Convert data into actionable intelligence for policy, program and product decisions.
* Manage the Knowledge Management function — evidence library, document repositories, and institutional memory.

**3. M&E systems and quality assurance**

* Lead the M&E framework: indicator design, sampling methodology, periodic evaluation cycles, and external evaluation partnerships.
* Own data governance — data quality audits, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag dashboards, and anomaly detection.
* Lead and develop State M&E Leads (embedded in states, functionally reporting to this role).
* Conduct periodic verification, mystery beneficiary calls, red-flag reviews and quality audits.
* Maintain strict independence from Program and State teams — this role's credibility depends on it.

**4. Learning loops and evidence building**

* Ensure field learning feeds into policy redesign, process improvement and product updates.
* Support impact evaluation readiness and external evaluation partnerships.
* Produce public-good outputs — impact reports, evidence briefs, and external publications that build RightWalk's credibility.

**5. Data governance and ethics**

* Define data access, privacy, anonymisation and data security protocols with Tech and People teams.
* Ensure responsible handling of beneficiary, field and government data.
* Create data discipline without making teams feel they are entering a tax raid.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — SIX MONTHS**

* Organisation-wide M&E and data architecture drafted and adopted.
* A live dashboard exists that the CEO, State Directors, and donors can access — real-time, reliable, and action-oriented.
* Data quality audits are conducted every quarter; anomalies are surfaced, not suppressed.
* The organisation makes at least two key program design changes in direct response to M&E evidence.
* RightWalk publishes at least one credible external evidence brief that strengthens its policy positioning.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Setting programmatic targets — that is the program team's domain.
* Managing field delivery or GDN operations.
* Policy authorship or advocacy strategy.
* Tech platform development (though close collaboration with Tech is essential).
* Sit under state programs whose performance it must assess.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* **Experience:**
  10–16 years in M&E, data systems, evaluation, or research — ideally within development sector, government advisory, or research institutions.
* **Methods:**
  Strong quantitative and qualitative research skills — comfortable with both survey-based M&E and systems-level data architecture.
* **Tools:**
  Experience with MIS/dashboard design and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* **Independence:**
  Track record of building independent M&E functions that are trusted by leadership and donors alike.
* **Orientation:**
  Governance mindset - more interested in data integrity than in making numbers look good.
* **Sector:**
  Exposure to government data systems, HMIS, DISE, or similar public data infrastructure

title: Senior Manager, Incident & Change Management (ITIL Expertise + Experience in Network, Infra, Data Centre & Application-Support is a Must)
description:
**Overview**
WELCOME TO SITA
  
  
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
**About The Role & Team**
As Senior Manager, Incident & Change Management within Digital Customer Operations (DCO), you will lead a global team of Incident and Change Managers responsible for protecting service continuity, governing operational change, and restoring critical services with speed and control. You will combine advanced, hands-on ITIL expertise with strong operational leadership across network, infrastructure, data centre and application-support environments. The role is a senior escalation point for complex regional and global services, engaging executives, customers and technical leaders during high-impact incidents and major changes. You will drive continuous improvement and digitalization, strengthen customer outcomes, and build a high-performing team aligned with DCO priorities.
  
  

* As per SITA Career Framework the title will be Senior Manager, Service Operations

**What You’ll Do**
Incident Management
  
  

* Lead and govern the end-to-end Incident Management process, ensuring the rapid restoration of critical services while minimizing business and customer impact.
* Act as the senior escalation point for high-severity incidents, coordinating technical, operational, and business teams to drive timely resolution.
* Lead crisis management activities during service disruptions, providing clear communication and regular updates to executives, customers, and key stakeholders.
* Drive incident response governance, ensuring adherence to ITIL best practices, escalation procedures, and operational controls.
* Monitor and improve incident management KPIs, including service availability, resolution times, service restoration metrics, and customer impact.
* Lead post-incident reviews and root cause analysis to identify corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
* Collaborate with Network, Infrastructure, Data Center, Application Support, and Service Operations teams to strengthen service resilience and operational stability.
* Provide leadership during executive-level escalations, effectively managing communications with senior management and strategic customers.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance incident response effectiveness, operational performance, and customer experience.

**Change Management**

* Lead and govern the end-to-end Change Management process, ensuring all infrastructure, network, application, and service changes are implemented in a controlled and risk-managed manner.
* Establish and maintain Change Management policies, standards, and governance frameworks in alignment with ITIL best practices.
* Chair Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings, evaluating change risks, business impacts, dependencies, and implementation readiness.
* Ensure changes are assessed, approved, tested, and deployed with minimal disruption to business operations and customer services.
* Monitor change effectiveness through KPIs and reporting, including change success rates, failed changes, emergency changes, and change-related incidents.
* Partner with operational, engineering, and business teams to balance service stability, operational resilience, and business agility.
* Act as the senior escalation point for high-risk or business-critical changes, providing clear communication and decision-making support to senior stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance change governance, reduce operational risk, and improve service reliability across complex enterprise environments.
* Lead post-implementation reviews and ensure lessons learned are incorporated into future change planning and execution.

**Qualifications**
**ABOUT YOUR SKILLS**

* Continuous Improvement & Digitalization: Demonstrated ability to use incident, change, SLA and KPI insights to simplify workflows, strengthen controls, automate repeatable activities and improve operational performance.
* Customer-Centric Thinking: Proven ability to make service decisions based on customer impact, business criticality and transparent communication, while balancing restoration speed, risk and long-term service quality.
* Self & Business Leadership: Strong executive presence, judgement and accountability, with the ability to remain composed during crises, set direction, influence decisions and lead teams through ambiguity and operational pressure.
* Advanced hands-on expertise in ITIL Service Management, with deep experience across Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, and Service Operations governance.
* Extensive experience leading large-scale operational environments, ensuring service stability, resilience, and continuous operational excellence.
* Strong leadership, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to drive alignment and decision-making across cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
* Proven capability in Major Incident and Crisis Management, including leading the response to critical service disruptions and coordinating recovery efforts within complex enterprise environments.
* Demonstrated experience defining, monitoring, and improving Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) to drive operational performance and customer satisfaction.
* Broad technical understanding of enterprise IT environments, including Network Operations, Infrastructure Services, Data Center Operations, and Application Support, enabling effective decision-making during service-impacting events.
* Experience acting as the senior escalation point for high-priority service issues, effectively managing communications and resolutions involving executive leadership, strategic customers, and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to assess operational risks, identify improvement opportunities, and drive sustainable service enhancements.
* Proven track record of leading service management teams and fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Experience managing major incidents and enterprise change across large customer accounts, third-party suppliers and geographically distributed operations.
* This role requires approximately 20% travel to support regional operations, strategic customers, and key service-management activities.
* At least 10 years of experience in incident management, change management experience, escalation manager and crisis management, or a related discipline.
* Bachelor's degree in, IT, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever.

We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs.

At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From

title: VP, APAC Operations
description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
CoreWeave's Data Center Operations organization runs the physical infrastructure behind one of the world's leading AI cloud platforms: the GPU clusters that frontier AI labs and enterprises use to train and serve their models. As CoreWeave expands into Asia-Pacific, we're building a regional operations organization from the ground up. It will own uptime, safety, and operational excellence across every CoreWeave data center in the region, and set the standard for how we run at scale outside North America and Europe.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Vice President, Data Center Operations – APAC is the senior operations leader for CoreWeave's Asia-Pacific data center portfolio, reporting directly to the SVP of Data Center Operations. You will own day-to-day operations across [Singapore, Korea, and future APAC sites]. This is a hands-on role: you'll be present in the data centers with your teams, not directing work from a distance. You'll build the regional team, put global standards and processes in place, and hold colocation partners, contractors, and vendors accountable to CoreWeave's performance bar. You'll work closely with global Operations, Fleet Operations, Engineering, Construction, Networking, and Supply Chain, as well as with executive leadership.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own operational performance for all APAC data centers (uptime, MTTR, safety, and audit readiness) and make the region a reliable, scalable part of CoreWeave's global fleet
* Build and lead the APAC operations organization (Regional/Area Managers, Data Center Managers, and Technicians), including hiring plans, leadership bench, and on-call coverage
* Adapt global SOPs, KPIs, and tooling for APAC, so that standards are followed consistently on site across countries and are not just documented
* Manage colocation partners, contractors, and vendors directly: drive schedule and SLA performance, escalate firmly, and decide when to course-correct or exit
* Lead new-site readiness and turn-up in partnership with Construction and Deployment, taking capacity from handoff to production on time
* Navigate local labor, regulatory, safety, and compliance requirements across multiple APAC jurisdictions
* Lead the response to critical (SEV-1) incidents in the region and represent APAC operations in executive reviews and global operating cadences

**Who You Are**

* 15+ years in data center operations or critical infrastructure, including 5+ years leading multi-site operations at Senior Director/VP scope
* Proven ownership of live, production data center operations in APAC (operating sites, not only construction or project delivery) across more than one country
* Experience at a hyperscaler, large cloud provider, or major colocation/data center operator running high-density or mission-critical environments
* Track record of building and scaling operations teams of [XX+] people across multiple sites, including hiring and developing managers
* Hands-on experience managing colocation, facilities, and contractor relationships against SLAs, including performance management and commercial escalation
* Working knowledge of APAC labor law, regulatory, and EHS requirements across multiple jurisdictions (e.g., Singapore, India, Korea, Japan, Australia)
* Based in or willing to relocate to [Singapore or India], with frequent travel across the APAC region

**Preferred**

* Experience running GPU/HPC or AI infrastructure at high rack density, including liquid cooling
* Experience standing up a new regional operations organization or market entry for a cloud or data center operator
* Familiarity with the Korean and/or Japanese data center markets
* Exposure to global operations standardization: SOP frameworks, KPI programs, and ticketing/DCIM tooling

**Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.**

* You'd rather be on the data center floor with your team than run the region from a slide deck
* You bring structure to fast-moving environments and know when to move fast and when to slow down for rigor
* You're direct and steady with partners and vendors, and you hold the line on commitments without burning bridges
* You're energized by building something new in a region where CoreWeave is just getting started

**Why CoreWeave?**
**About**
At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:
  
  

* Be Curious at Your Core
* Act Like an Owner
* Empower Employees
* Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
* Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!
  
  
The base pay and target total cash for this position range from INR 14,500,000.00 to INR 14,500,000.0. Pay is based on a number of factors, including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This position includes a discretionary bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

title: Roster of International consultant – Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance and/or laboratory strengthening for AMR
description:
**Contractual Arrangement**
External consultant
  
  
**Job Posting**
Oct 16, 2026, 2:40:59 PM
  
  
**Closing Date**
Nov 14, 2026, 3:59:00 AM
  
  
**Primary Location**
India-New Delhi
  
  
**Organization**
SE/HSD Department of Health Systems Development
  
  
**Schedule**
Full-time
**IMPORTANT NOTICE:**
Please note that the deadline for receipt of applications indicated above reflects your personal device's system settings.
  
  
**Area of expertise**
Roster of International consultant – Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) surveillance and/or laboratory strengthening for AMR
  
  
**Purpose of consultancy**
The WHO Regional Office for South-East Asia is establishing a roster of qualified consultants who may be engaged for specific assignments to strengthen national and regional AMR surveillance, clinical microbiology services and laboratory systems. Assignments may cover surveillance design and assessment; implementation and reporting through the Global Antimicrobial Resistance and Use Surveillance System (GLASS); bacteriology and mycology capacity; diagnostic stewardship; laboratory networks and quality systems; data quality, analysis, interpretation and visualization; One Health and genomic surveillance; capacity development; operational research; and translation of surveillance evidence into policy and programme action.
  
  
Depending on the individual Terms of Reference, consultants will provide technical assistance for planning, implementation, analysis and reporting using WHO tools, standards and recommendations. They may also contribute to evidence-based technical guidance, protocols, standard operating procedures, training packages and implementation tools.
  
  
**Background**
Antimicrobial resistance is a major public health and development challenge in the WHO South-East Asia Region. Member States need timely, representative and quality-assured data on resistance patterns and antimicrobial use to guide national action plans, clinical and public health interventions, laboratory strategies, stewardship, infection prevention and control, and resource allocation.
  
  
Reliable laboratory systems are essential for effective AMR surveillance, including accurate bacterial and fungal identification, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, diagnostic stewardship, specimen referral, quality management and standardized data flows. WHO supports Member States, country offices and partners to strengthen sustainable surveillance and laboratory systems aligned with WHO standards and GLASS. This roster will help WHO SEARO identify specialists for time-bound regional or country assignments based on emerging needs.
  
  
**Deliverables**
Under The Overall Guidance Of WHO Technical Unit, Consultants May Be Requested To Perform One Or More Of The Following Assignments (a More Specific Terms Of Reference (TORs), Including The Exact Deliverables, Duration Of Assignment And Place Of Assignment Will Be Shared With The Selected Candidate At The Time Of Hiring For a Specific Assignment):
  
  
****Deliverable 1: Surveillance and laboratory assessment.****
Conduct desk or country assessment of AMR surveillance systems, data flows, governance arrangements, indicators, data quality, bacteriology and mycology capacity, laboratory networks, diagnostic stewardship and reporting processes, with prioritized and feasible recommendations
  
  
****Deliverable 2: Technical products and implementation tools.****
Design assignment-specific protocols, standard operating procedures, data dictionaries, validation checklists, surveillance tools, indicator frameworks, laboratory-strengthening plans, survey materials, diagnostic-stewardship tools, guidance documents or One Health implementation products
  
  
****Deliverable 3: Data and analytical outputs.****
Develop cleaned or validated datasets; statistical, microbiological or genomic analyses; reproducible code or pipelines; tables, figures, maps, dashboards or visualization specifications; interpretation notes; and quality documentation, as applicable
  
  
****Deliverable 4: Laboratory and diagnostic products.****
Adapt guidance documents, training packages and tools for clinical bacteriology and mycology; laboratory quality management; antimicrobial susceptibility testing; external quality assurance; specimen referral; laboratory networks; and diagnostic stewardship.
  
  
****Deliverable 5: Capacity-development package.****
Develop training needs findings, curricula, presentations, exercises, job aids, workshop or webinar facilitation, mentoring records and a brief evaluation of learning and follow-up needs.
  
  
****Deliverable 6: Reporting and knowledge products.****
Prepare GLASS submission-related outputs, national or regional surveillance reports, laboratory-capacity reports, policy briefs, technical reports, manuscripts, systematic reviews, presentations or other communication products.
  
  
****Educational Qualifications****
**Qualifications, experience, skills and languages**
**Essential:**
**Band level B:**
A first university degree or medical degree in epidemiology, public health, medicine, clinical microbiology, laboratory sciences, biostatistics, statistics, mathematical modelling, health informatics, data science, computer science, bioinformatics, veterinary public health, environmental health, pharmacy, health economics or another field relevant to the assignment.
  
  
**Band level C:**
An advanced university degree or medical degree with postgraduate specialization in one of the fields listed above or another field relevant to the assignment.
  
  
Desirable: Additional postgraduate training, specialization or professional certification relevant to the technical profile, such as clinical microbiology, bacteriology, mycology, field epidemiology, laboratory quality management, diagnostic stewardship, data analytics, geographic information systems, genomic epidemiology, health information systems, monitoring and evaluation, or adult learning.
  
  
****Experience****
Essential
  
  
Band level B: At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the technical profiles advertised.
  
  
**Band Level C:**

* At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in one or more of the advertised technical profiles.
* Demonstrated experience producing high-quality, assignment-relevant outputs such as surveillance assessments, protocols, analytical products, laboratory tools, technical reports, training packages, dashboards, scientific publications or policy products.
* For laboratory-focused assignments, essential experience may include one or more of the following:
* Implementation of recognized antimicrobial susceptibility testing standards, such as CLSI or EUCAST.
* Microbiological proficiency testing or external quality-assurance programmes.
* Bacteriology or mycology laboratory assessments and laboratory-system strengthening.
* Mycological diagnosis, diagnostic stewardship or laboratory quality management.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience with AMR surveillance and GLASS-related methods, tools or reporting.
* Experience working with ministries of health, national AMR programmes, public health institutes, reference laboratories, academic institutions or One Health coordination mechanisms.
* Experience in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in the WHO South-East Asia Region.
* Experience with WHO, another United Nations entity or an international public health organization.
* Experience facilitating multidisciplinary or multisectoral work and transferring skills to national teams.
* Experience implementing infectious-disease surveys or clinical research studies in accordance with good clinical and data-management practices.
* A publication record in peer-reviewed journals or authorship of technical guidance, national reports, research proposals, systematic reviews or evidence-synthesis products.
* Experience developing and applying bioinformatics pipelines, where relevant to the assignment.

**Essential**
**Skills and knowledge**

* Advanced knowledge and competence in at least one advertised technical profile, with a sound understanding of public health surveillance or laboratory-system principles relevant to the assignment.
* Ability to apply relevant WHO standards, methods and tools to national or regional contexts.
* Ability to analyse complex information, assure data or laboratory quality, interpret findings and formulate practical recommendations.
* Excellent technical writing, presentation and communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and policy audiences.
* Ability to work effectively in multicultural and multidisciplinary settings and to deliver quality outputs within agreed timelines.
* For laboratory-focused assignments, essential competencies may include quality-assured microbiological testing, assessment of bacteriology or mycology laboratories, and design or implementation of external quality-assurance programmes.

Desirable
  
  

* Knowledge of GLASS, national AMR surveillance systems, One Health surveillance and relevant laboratory standards.
* Knowledge of laboratory networks and specimen-referral systems in resource-limited settings and associated challenges.
* Proficiency in one or more relevant platforms or languages, such as R, R Markdown, R Shiny, Python, SQL, Power BI, DHIS2, geographic information systems, statistical software, laboratory information systems, web technologies or bioinformatics tools.
* Knowledge of data governance, privacy, security, interoperability and reproducible analytical practices.
* Knowledge of adult learning, training design, facilitation and mentoring approaches.

****Languages And Level Required****
Essential: Expert knowledge of English.
  
  
Desirable: Intermediate or expert knowledge of another official United Nations language or a language used in a WHO South-East Asia Region Member State, where relevant to the assignment.
  
  
**Location**
Consultancies may be: Home-based, Country-based, Regional Office-based, or a combination of remote and in-country support. The duty arrangement for each consultancy will be specified in the individual Terms of Reference.
  
  
**Travel**
The consultant may be expected to travel to one or more WHO South-East Asia Region Member States for country assessments, laboratory assessments, technical consultations, training or other assignment-related activities. Travel dates, locations and purpose will be specified in the individual Terms of Reference and arranged in accordance with applicable WHO policies.
  
  
**Remuneration and budget (travel costs are excluded)**
**Remuneration:**
Band level B and/or Band level C, as applicable to the assignment. The daily or monthly rate will be established in accordance with the applicable WHO consultant remuneration guidance and stated in the individual Terms of Reference.
  
  
**Living expenses:**
Not applicable for home-based work. When an assignment requires on-site presence or travel, applicable travel and subsistence arrangements will be specified separately in accordance with WHO policies.
  
  
**Expected duration of contract**
: Roster assignments may range from short inputs to several months, up to a maximum of 11 months per calendar year. Each individual Terms of Reference will specify the contract duration, number of working days and, for part-time assignments, the expected percentage or level of effort.
  
  
****Additional Information****

The list can be accessed through the link: http://www.whed.net/. Some professional certificates may not appear in the WHED and will require individual review.

title: Head - NPL
description:
**Job Description**
**JoJob Description / Area of Responsibility**

* Lead the end-to-end Operations workstream for the development and flawless launch of advanced, safety-critical automotive mechatronic systems across two focus factories. Integrate mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software disciplines; align worldwide stakeholders, customers and suppliers; and deliver industrialization, quality, cost, timing, capacity and ramp-up targets. Provide decisive, hands-on leadership in a highly dynamic environment and coach launch teams.
* Support quotations and business cases with operations feasibility, industrial concepts, footprint and capacity scenarios, investment estimates, launch timing and risk assessment for complex mechatronic products. Ensure assumptions cover both focus factories and the required revenue-growth roadmap.
* Define Operations targets for safety, quality, cost, timing, scope, capacity and launch maturity across both focus factories. Establish project governance, decision rights, integrated master plan, gate deliverables, cadence, documentation and escalation paths.
* Build and lead the global launch team; secure resources and ownership with line management. Drive early risk management, manufacturing concept selection, make-or-buy inputs and work-package definition.
* Align factory readiness and industrialization strategy with the growth path from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue. Lead operations delivery for the complete mechatronic system, integrating mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces.
* Translate product requirements into robust manufacturing, assembly, testing, traceability and end-of-line concepts. Drive DfM/DfA, design reviews, process validation, equipment implementation, supplier readiness and capacity installation.
* Staff, direct and coach the two-factory launch team; resolve cross-functional dependencies and resource conflicts. Ensure all deliverables meet customer, regulatory, safety, cost, quality and timing requirements. Control the integrated plan and recover deviations through clear owners, countermeasures and escalation.
* Manage capital expenditure, tooling, launch costs, labor, ramp-up cost and obsolete-material exposure against approvals. Lead APQP, FMEA, control-plan, capability, test-coverage, traceability, line-release, PPAP and safe-launch readiness.
* Coordinate equipment, process, component, logistics and software-release maturity across both factories. Run risk-based launch reviews and drive rapid problem solving to achieve a stable, flawless ramp-up.
* Maintain one transparent, fact-based status for both factories covering milestones, budget, quality, capacity, resources, risks and decisions. Report gate maturity and forecast to Project Management, Operations leadership, plant management and executive steering committees.
* Escalate product, process, supplier, customer or safety-critical issues early, with impact, containment, recovery plan and required decision. Track actions to closure and ensure disciplined change control.
* Capture lessons learned and standardize reusable launch methods, equipment concepts, controls and best practices across both factories. Drive continuous improvement in yield, cycle time, scrap, reliability, test coverage and launch efficiency. Support warranty, 0-km, field and supplier-quality containment and root-cause resolution. Optimize capacity and requalification throughout the product lifecycle.
* Represent Operations and both focus factories on project, customer, supplier and executive meetings worldwide. Build alignment among diverse stakeholders and communicate complex issues clearly, directly and early. Lead feasibility, change and problem-resolution discussions using timing, cost, quality, safety and risk evidence. Maintain a strong customer focus while protecting operational readiness and launch integrity.
* Own the transition from launch through stable serial production and formal handover at both factories. Monitor ramp-up performance, capacity, yield, quality, delivery and cost until agreed exit criteria are achieved.
* Coordinate product maintenance, engineering changes, non-conformance resolution and requalification. Lead capacity adaptations and phase-out preparation in line with business and customer requirements.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, electronics, mechatronics, manufacturing, industrial engineering or a related technical field. At least 15 plus years of progressive experience in automotive or another safety-critical, high-volume industry, including complex mechatronic product development, manufacturing industrialization and launch. Experience across multiple functions or factories is required.
  
  
Demonstrated successful delivery of at least three new-product launches, including a complex multi-site or safety-critical mechatronic program. Strong competence in APQP/PPAP, industrialization, launch planning, risk management, budget control, capacity planning, supplier readiness and structured problem solving.
  
  
At least 5 years as a Launch Manager, Operations Project Manager or comparable cross-functional leader. Proven ability to lead international matrix teams, steer two factories, make timely decisions, escalate effectively and deliver under high pressure.
  
  
Proven leadership of worldwide, multicultural stakeholders across functions, factories, customers and suppliers. Fluent business English is required; additional languages are advantageous. Strong intercultural sensitivity, executive communication and willingness to travel are expected.
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Global Customer, Business Unit and Operations Governance: Expert knowledge of matrix decision-making, escalation paths and stakeholder management across factories and functions. Ability to establish clear governance, accountability and communication in a worldwide project environment
* New Product Launch and Product Lifecycle Management: Expert application of NPL processes, gate reviews, industrialization planning, launch readiness and serial-life handover. Strong command of multi-site launch governance and operational deliverables
* Safety-Critical Quality in Launches: APQP, PPAP, safe launch, line release, control plans, process capability, test coverage and end-to-end traceability. FMEA-based risk prevention and awareness of functional-safety implications for manufacturing and validation
* Operations Program Control and Reporting: Integrated planning, milestone and gate control, resource steering, risk and opportunity management, change control and executive reporting. Rapid problem resolution, disciplined escalation and recovery planning across two factories.
* Manufacturing and Launch Financials: Business-case understanding and management of Capex, tooling, launch cost, labor, ramp-up cost, capacity and obsolete-material exposure. Ability to align industrial investment with growth from approximately €250M to €600M annual revenue.
* Advanced Mechatronic Product and Manufacturing Knowledge: Strong system-level understanding of mechanical, electronics, electric motor and embedded software interfaces. Manufacturing, assembly, testing, calibration, traceability, software-release and configuration-control concepts
* Customer and Supplier Management: Customer-specific milestones, audits, PPAP, capability and drawing requirements. Executive-level communication, negotiation, expectation management and recovery alignment with customers and suppliers
* Matrix Team Leadership: Lead, motivate and coach international cross-functional teams without relying solely on direct authority. Delegate outcomes, resolve conflict, manage performance input and create ownership across both focus factories
* Change Management and Complex Problem Resolution: Evaluate changes across system interfaces and quantify impact on safety, quality, timing, cost, capacity and industrial readiness. Drive fast, structured decisions and implementation while keeping worldwide stakeholders aligned.
* Front Loading and Industrial Strategy: Lead early feasibility, manufacturing concept, footprint, capacity, investment and timing assessments for large, complex programs. Challenge assumptions early and convert lessons learned into robust launch concepts

title: Senior Manager
description:

* Identify and implement automation opportunities using Power Automate, Power Platform, workflow tools, and AI-enabled reporting capabilities.
* Apply predictive analytics, advanced dashboards, and digital workflows to improve efficiency, data quality, and project outcomes.
* Support development of scalable digital solutions aligned with project controls, PMO, and Future of Construction objectives.
* Define and deliver enterprise AI solutions using Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agents, and action agents to support project management use cases such as schedule and cost intelligence, risk monitoring, progress tracking, document workflows, decision support, and automated follow-up actions.

* Define data standards, validation checks, access controls, and information management protocols across project systems.
* Improve data integrity, reporting accuracy, audit readiness, and consistency across platforms and dashboards.
* Translate business and project requirements into practical digital, reporting, and data management solutions.

* 13+ years of experience in Project Controls, PMIS, Reporting, Analytics, and Digital Delivery.
* Proven experience leading large-scale PMIS implementations and reporting transformation programmes.
* Experience supporting major infrastructure, transportation, buildings, energy, utilities, or data centre projects.
* Strong background in project mobilisation, governance, PMO, and performance reporting.
* Experience managing geographically dispersed and offshore delivery teams.
* Track record of driving automation and digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience implementing Microsoft Fabric reporting platforms and Fabric Apps, enterprise AI and agentic solutions, and integrated project or construction management technology stacks; experience with Octave tools is desirable.

*Technical Skills*

* Oracle Unifier
* Power BI and other Business Intelligence tool
* Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse/Warehouse, Data Factory pipelines, semantic models, governance, and Fabric Apps
* AI solution implementation: Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agents, action agents, orchestration, responsible-AI controls, and project-management use cases
* Octave project and construction management technology stack implementation and integration
* Microsoft Power Platforms
* Smartsheet
* Advanced Excel
* PMIS Administration
* Project Controls + Earned Value Management (EVM)
* SQL / Data Modelling (preferred)

*Leadership Skills*

* Stakeholder Management
* Team Development
* Digital Transformation
* Change Management
* Client Relationship Management
* Innovation & Continuous Improvement

* Postgraduate qualification preferred (NICMAR / Project Management / MBA).
