title: Founders’ Office ( Growth & Strategy )
description:
**Founder's Office | Growth Valley Community**

Gurugram (in-office) | Full-time | 1-5 years experience | Reports directly to the Founder

Tier One IIT/IIM Preferred.

Do not apply if you are looking for structured job with work life balance. Apply if you are mentally young, want to prove to yourself, want to grow and behave like growth. A
**consistent**
growth story will be awarded.

**We are looking forward to growth focussed team members, who just are obsessed about making things bigger and better for themselves and people around them. And that MUST reflect in their past journey. You will thoroughly fail in our environment if you are looking for a generic job/work life balance/ multi focus life.**

**We are fanatic about what we do. What we are building. It takes intent and energy. It takes time. It takes focus. If you are one already, it could be one of the best place to work together and building something big and beautiful for the world.**

**About GVC.**

Growth Valley Community is a global entrepreneurship programme where teenagers build real ventures: real inventory, real customers, real profit and loss. Our students run live businesses through TecTeenShop and are mentored by professionals and alumni from Harvard, MIT, Stanford and Columbia, supported by IITians. Today we stand at 1000+ students across 12 countries with roughly 95% retention, which is among the hardest numbers to earn in education.

Product-market fit is proven. Parents renew, students stay, and the transformation is visible in the room. What we have not yet built at scale is distribution: the systems, partnerships and engines that take this from X students to 100X. That is the frontier, and that is exactly where this role operates.

**The role.**

You sit beside the founder and function as a force multiplier. Not an assistant, not an analyst producing decks for other people to act on. You take a mandate, own it end to end, and leave behind a running system. You will be in rooms most people wait years to enter: pricing calls, investor material reviews, partnership negotiations, hiring decisions. The compensation for that access is simple: everything you touch must move.

This is the highest-leverage seat in the company for someone who wants to compress five years of operator learning into one.

**What you will actually own. These are live mandates, not hypotheticals:**

* **Enrollment engine.**
  Our enrollment function is being rebuilt from the ground up as a system: one shared pipeline, a daily operating cadence, written playbooks, zero dependence on any single person. You will build and run it, starting with the fastest lever we own, a referral programme into our 100s of existing families.

* **Admissions product.**
  We have designed a full admission journey (application, staged review, live status tracking, WhatsApp and email automation on an Airtable backbone). You will take it from tested prototype to daily operations.

* **AI Founder Programme, Cohort 1.**
  A new one-year product where teens ship their own live AI product and present it at a Demo Day. You will run the launch: offer page, Founders Session event, application funnel, squad operations.

* **Partnerships.**
  Scout and open school and institutional relationships that compound, so demand stops being bought lead by lead.

* **The numbers.**
  Own the dashboards the founder runs the company on, and help prepare the materials investors see.

**How we will measure you.**

Your first 90 days are pass or fail on outcomes, not activity. Concretely: a pipeline running that did not exist, a referral programme live, an admissions system operating on SLAs, a cohort launch executed. You will know exactly what winning looks like from week one, because we will write it down together.

**Who fits.**

* Tier-1 institute background (IIT, IIM, BITS, top DU or equivalent), or proof of building so undeniable that pedigree is irrelevant.
* 1-3 years in a startup operating role, or in consulting/banking with a genuine itch to build rather than advise.
* Bias to action. You default to shipping a rough version today over presenting a perfect plan next week.
* Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities shift, playbooks do not exist yet, and you find that energising rather than stressful.
* High integrity. We sell trust to parents of teenagers. There is no version of this company where cut corners survive.
* Skill gaps we can fix. Will gaps we cannot.

**Who should not apply.**

If you want a defined lane, a structured mentorship ramp, a large team around you, or advisory distance from the actual work, this role will genuinely frustrate you, and you will frustrate us. We are building 1 to 10 in a company where speed matters. It is intense and demanding. The honest trade: the learning curve is the compensation multiplier, and the people who thrive here would be bored anywhere else.

**Compensation.**

fixed, plus performance upside, plus founder proximity that no salary line captures. We are honest about this: cash is competitive for our stage, not FAANG-level.

**Growth path.**

This seat is designed to outgrow itself. Prove the mandates and the natural next step is leading a function as we scale: growth, programmes, or operations. The people who join founder's offices at this stage of a company and deliver tend to end up running significant pieces of it. That is the plan here too.

**How to apply.**

Send two things to sam@growthvalleycommunity.com

1. A short story (300 words maximum) about a time you took initiative on a hard problem, what you actually did, and what it produced. Numbers welcome.
2. Your CV.

Subject line: FO | Your Name | College. The story matters more than the CV; it is your first evaluation. We respond to every application within 72 hours and move fast from there.

description:
### **Description**

**About the Program**

The Eptura Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide recent graduates and early-career professionals with meaningful, hands-on experience within a global SaaS organization. Throughout this 12-month program, apprentices will receive mentoring, structured learning opportunities, and exposure to commercial operations and sales processes.

**Eligibility**

To be considered for this apprenticeship, candidates must:

* Have completed a Bachelor's degree within the past two years, OR
* Be in the final year of their degree program and eligible for apprenticeship participation
* Have no more than two years of professional work experience
* Be legally eligible to participate in an apprenticeship program in India

**Shape the Future of Work with Eptura**

At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe.

**Role Overview**

As a Product Associate, you will work directly within our Gurugram engineering team, helping to shepherd product enhancements and customer-reported issues through Eptura's AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC). You'll connect product priorities and engineering execution, keeping work organized, clearly specified, and moving forward on our Jira kanban boards.

This is a role for someone who is curious, organized, and eager to learn how great software products are built. You don't need prior experience in product management. You do need strong attention to detail, clear communication, demonstrated capabilities in using AI, and a genuine interest in how technology solves real-world problems.

### **Responsibilities**

  

* Manage and maintain the Jira kanban board: keeping tickets well-organized, clearly described, and appropriately prioritized in collaboration with engineering leads.
* Help triage incoming product enhancement requests and customer-reported defects, gathering the context engineers need to act on them.
* Work with AI to write clear, structured user stories and acceptance criteria that translate business needs into actionable engineering tasks.
* Coordinate with engineers to track progress, surface blockers, and ensure items move efficiently through the AIDLC stages.
* Participate in requirement-gathering conversations with product managers and stakeholders, capturing key decisions and open questions.
* Assist in drafting functional specifications and supporting documentation for new or enhanced product features, also working with AI.
* Support basic testing activities: reviewing completed work against acceptance criteria and flagging discrepancies.
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of our AIDLC processes and team ways of working.

  

### **About You**

We're looking for a motivated self-starter who is keen to build a career in product or technology. The following will set you up for success in this role:

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English: you'll be writing tickets, specs, and summaries that engineers and stakeholders rely on.
* High attention to detail and a methodical approach to organizing information.
* Comfort working in a structured, process-driven environment: you like things to be clear, tracked, and accounted for.
* Curiosity about how software products are built and a willingness to ask questions.
* Familiarity with project or task management tools (Jira experience is a plus).
* A proactive mindset: you spot gaps, follow up, and take ownership of your work.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess AI outputs, identify limitations or risks, and recommend improvements to enhance product value.
* AI-related experience:
* Understanding of AI fundamentals, including large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, automation workflows, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience using AI tools to improve productivity: research, data analysis, content creation, or workflow automation, either through academic, personal, or professional projects. Ability to build and demonstrate an AI agent.
* Ability to evaluate Ai-driven product opportunities, gathering feedback and translating it into feature recommendations.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to agile or kanban workflows (even in an academic or personal project context).
* Basic understanding of software development concepts: you don't need to code, but knowing what engineers do helps.
* Prior internship, project, or coursework related to business analysis, product management, or software delivery.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Monthly stipend
* Health Insurance fully paid – Self
* 13 Public Holidays
* Hyrid working policy
* Exposure to the latest trends and technologies in the SaaS industry.
* Mentorship from global experienced professionals in the sales, renewals and customer success fields.
* Potential for career advancement based on performance and dedication.

**Eptura Information:**

* Follow us on Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook | YouTube
* At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

Joining Eptura means becoming part of a forward-thinking, dynamic team that's on a mission to shape a better, more connected future. We're seeking passionate, driven individuals who want to make a real impact and be at the forefront of workplace innovation.

description:

**Flexteam360 | Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India | On-site**

**Compensation: ₹35–55 LPA, depending on experience and role fit**

Flexteam360 is hiring for the Operations Product team of a leading German e-commerce company,
**Westwing (Westwing.com)**
, operating across 25+ European markets.

ABSOLUTE MUSTS - do not apply if you don't have these.

* Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise OMS platform, preferably
  **Manhattan OMS / Active Omni, IBM Sterling OMS, and/or Fluent Commerce**
  .
* 5+ years of relevant experience in enterprise OMS implementation, configuration, techno-functional consulting, application support, or product ownership.

You will work closely with the Director of Product, based in Germany, to own and improve the Order Management System (OMS) powering the company's international e-commerce operations.

We are looking for an experienced
**OMS specialist with strong techno-functional expertise**
who understands enterprise order management platforms, can translate business requirements into functional solutions, and can drive system configuration, implementation, production stability, and continuous improvement.

You may currently be working as an OMS Product Manager, SME, Consultant, Technical Specialist, Functional Lead, Application Support Lead, or Techno-Functional Team Lead.

What you will do

* **OMS ownership:**
  Drive improvements to order orchestration, sourcing and allocation, inventory availability, fulfilment routing, split shipments, order consolidation, and returns.
* **Configuration and functional design:**
  Translate business requirements into functional specifications, configuration changes, and system enhancements.
* **Production stability:**

* **Monitoring and optimisation:**

* **Implementations and deployments:**
  Coordinate configuration changes, releases, testing, UAT, go-lives, and post-deployment support with vendors and engineering teams.
* **System integrations:**
  Ensure reliable data flows between OMS, WMS, ERP, e-commerce platforms, and supplier systems.
* **Business collaboration:**
  Work with Logistics, Warehouse Operations, Sourcing, Engineering, and Product teams to identify operational challenges and deliver scalable solutions.
* **Continuous improvement:**
  Use operational data and automation opportunities to improve fulfilment performance and system reliability.

What we are looking for

**Essential requirements**

* Strong understanding of order lifecycle management, order orchestration, sourcing and allocation, fulfilment workflows, inventory availability, and exception handling.
* Experience translating business requirements into functional specifications, configurations, or system enhancements.
* Practical experience in production support, incident management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and SLA-driven environments.
* Experience coordinating with engineering teams, vendors, or implementation partners on fixes, enhancements, and deployments.
* Understanding of OMS integrations with WMS, ERP, e-commerce platforms, and supplier systems.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with excellent English proficiency.

* Experience across multiple OMS platforms, particularly Manhattan, IBM Sterling, and Fluent Commerce.
* Hands-on DOM configuration, including allocation rules, sourcing logic, fulfilment nodes, routing rules, and service levels.
* OMS platform certifications.
* Experience in fashion, retail, e-commerce, or omnichannel fulfilment.
* Familiarity with APIs, SQL, databases, application logs, Jira, ServiceNow, or Postman.
* Experience leading teams, coordinating offshore-onshore delivery, and managing implementations or SaaS vendors.

Who should apply?

We welcome candidates working as:

* OMS Subject Matter Experts or Consultants
* Manhattan OMS / Active Omni Specialists
* IBM Sterling OMS or Fluent Commerce Specialists
* OMS Techno-Functional or Functional Leads
* OMS Application Support / Production Support Leads

We are particularly interested in professionals who have worked hands-on with enterprise OMS platforms and can combine deep system knowledge with business-facing ownership.

Why join?

title: Product Manager
description:
**Product Manager – Hardware & UAV Systems**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a results-driven
**Product Manager**
to lead the lifecycle of our next-generation drone platforms and hardware offerings. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex hardware engineering, firmware/software integration, and market demand. You will work closely with cross-functional teams—spanning electrical, mechanical, and embedded systems engineering-to translate market needs into scalable, high-performing physical products.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Define and execute the product roadmap for hardware and drone systems in alignment with overall company vision and growth targets.
* Conduct continuous market research, competitive analysis, and teardowns to evaluate emerging trends in electronics, component availability, and UAV technology.
* Translate customer pain points and market opportunities into clear product requirement documents (PRDs), system specifications, and feature prioritization.

**Product Development & Lifecycle Management**

* Partner directly with cross-functional teams—including Electronics/PCB Design, Mechanical, Embedded Firmware, Systems Engineering, and Operations—to drive hardware from concept to mass production.
* Oversee the full hardware lifecycle: concept design, prototyping, EVT/DVT/PVT stages, testing, manufacturing handoff, and post-launch iterations.
* Balance technical trade-offs regarding component selection, Bill of Materials (BOM) cost, power envelope, weight, reliability, and manufacturability (DFM/DFA).

**Customer & Go-To-Market Execution**

* Engage directly with enterprise customers and end-users to gather actionable feedback and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with Supply Chain, Quality, and Operations teams to ensure component sourcing resilience and smooth transition to production.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing to craft product positioning, pricing models, technical documentation, and go-to-market strategies.

**Metrics & Quality Control**

* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across product adoption, unit economics, field reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Utilize field telemetry and RMA/quality data to drive continuous hardware and firmware improvements.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline (MBA or MS preferred).
* **Experience:**
  Minimum
  **5+ years**
  of proven product management experience delivering hardware, embedded systems, electronics, or UAV/aerospace products.
* **Electronics & Hardware Domain:**
  Strong technical foundation in electronic systems, PCB assembly (PCBA) design cycles, sensor integration, microcontrollers, or power electronics.
* **Drone/UAV Knowledge:**
  Working familiarity with UAV architectures, flight controllers, telemetry, propulsion systems, or sensor payloads.
* **Execution:**
  Demonstrated track record of taking complex hardware/electronics products from initial schematic/concept stage through manufacturing and market launch.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on background in hardware engineering, embedded software design, or systems integration prior to transitioning into Product Management.
* Direct experience managing
  **BOM cost optimization**
  , supply chain dynamics, and component obsolescence strategies.
* Familiarity with global hardware certifications and regulatory frameworks (e.g., FCC, CE, RoHS, FAA, DGCA, EASA).
* Experience working in fast-paced startup or rapid-hardware-prototyping environments.

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:

Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.

title: Senior Principal, AI Delivery & Governance Lead
description:
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US**
We are seeking a Senior Principal, AI Delivery & Governance Lead to drive the delivery and governance of the SMBS AI programme. SMBS is building a live AI ecosystem — agents in production, workflows redesigned, outcomes measured. This is not a strategy exercise — we are building the next generation of our operational engine. This role does not build AI solutions directly — it ensures the conditions are in place for the build team to deliver effectively and for what is built to land with real operational impact.
  
  
This role owns the AI backlog and solution delivery assurance — governing what gets built and when, translating use case inputs from Ops Intelligence Analysts and Delivery Excellence teams into structured backlog items, and ensuring the build team works on the highest-impact opportunities. This is transformational delivery: systematically replacing manual, judgement-heavy processes with intelligent, scalable AI solutions. With typically 7+ years of experience in programme delivery or technology transformation, this is a role for someone experienced in moving from proof of concept to operational reality.
  
  
SMBS AI does not operate in isolation. This role coordinates across the full SimCorp AI ecosystem — Product AI, Platform and Infrastructure, AI Search and Knowledge, and Compliance and Legal — aligning standards, resolving dependencies, and leveraging what is being built across SimCorp. It also shapes how SMBS transitions into this next stage, influencing the AI guidelines, governance principles, and ways of working across DMS, IOS, and IAS.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
In your daily work, you will:
  
  

* Manage the interface between the SMBS AI team and all other SimCorp AI teams, ensuring alignment on standards, dependencies, and shared roadmaps.
* Maintain the Integration Dependency Register as the single source of truth for cross-team dependencies, blockers, and agreements.
* Represent the SMBS AI team in cross-company AI governance forums and steering committees.
* Facilitate the resolution of scope boundaries and overlapping use cases with the Product AI team.
* Own the AI use case backlog, ensuring use cases are consistently structured, scored, and prioritized using the established evaluation framework.
* Receive and structure use case inputs from service unit Ops Intelligence Analysts and Delivery Excellence teams.
* Coordinate sprint planning and release sequencing with the build team.
* Manage the intake of change requests for agents in production and prioritize them against new development.
* Prepare board and executive materials related to the AI initiative, including progress reporting, investment tracking, and impact measurement.
* Manage stakeholder expectations across service units, ensuring transparency on timelines, priorities, and delivery capacity.
* Drive the compliance and legal whitelisting process for AI tools and models, ensuring tooling is approved before the build team requires it.
* Ensure the AI initiative remains anchored in the service scalability strategy and does not drift into technology-for-technology’s-sake initiatives.

**What We Value**

* 7+ years of experience in program management, operational transformation, or service delivery leadership within financial services.
* Deep understanding of investment operations across Data Management, Investment Operations, and Investment Accounting.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate across multiple teams with competing priorities and without direct authority.
* Experience managing structured backlogs and prioritization frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation capabilities at senior and executive levels.
* You can hold a substantive conversation with AI engineers about agent design, model selection, and deployment trade-offs and translate those conversations into decisions and priorities that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
* You are a clear and confident communicator who can represent complex AI initiatives to executive audiences.
* You thrive in ambiguous environments and bring structure and clarity where others see complexity.
* You have good English skills and are comfortable working in an international, cross-functional environment.
* You have effective collaboration skills and a bias for organizational alignment over individual delivery.

You operate as a senior individual contributor who influences outcomes through structure, clarity, and credibility — not through hierarchy. Your value is in making the system around you work better, not in being the one who executes.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy — We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose, you can work remotely the other days. Of course you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Growth and innovation — Every 6th sprint is reserved for planning and innovation. So, with regular intervals you have a chance to explore and learn new skills or improve something that you believe will be beneficial to you, your team, or the organization.
* Self-Direction — High degree of self-organization. Each team member has a high degree of freedom to plan, organize, and design their work.
* Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance — We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment — We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**Who We Are**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law.
  
  
We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302348
description:
**Description**
**About the Role & Team**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience**
**Must-Have Attributes**
– Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery.
  
  
– SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
  
  
– Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
  
  
– Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
  
  
– Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
– Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader).
  
  
– AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
  
  
– Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
  
  
  

* Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

– Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
  
  
– Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
**Company:**

Marsh

**Description:**
----------------

We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.

Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI

**Role Overview**

The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.

As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.

You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.

**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.
  

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentalsis desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Client Partner Manager
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.  
  
**Description**  
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Gurgaon team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.  
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.  
Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Minimum 10 years of experience managing a sales team  
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.  
Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.

The role is the primary commercial interface between Glanbia and key customers, ensuring excellence in assortment, availability, visibility, promotions, inventory management, service, and customer profitability. The KAM will work closely with Marketing, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Finance, and Customer Service to deliver sustainable growth and strengthen Glanbia’s position across priority offline channel

**Account Management & Business Growth**

  

* Own end-to-end business delivery for assigned key accounts, including revenue, volume, NSV, gross profit, and market share objectives.
* Develop annual and quarterly account plans aligned with company and customer priorities.
* Identify growth opportunities through assortment expansion, improved distribution, new product launches, premiumization, and customer-specific programs.

* Lead annual Joint Business Planning discussions and translate agreed priorities into clear initiatives, targets, owners, and timelines.
* Track delivery against the JBP and initiate corrective actions where performance is off plan.
  

**Commercial Negotiation & Trade Investment**

  

* Lead negotiations on annual trade terms, pricing, margins, promotions, listings, visibility, and commercial agreements.
* Manage customer trade investment within approved budgets and improve return on investment.
  

**Sales Performance & Analytics**

  

* Monitor sell-in, sell-out, inventory, distribution, assortment, and promotional performance by customer and SKU.
* Use customer and market data to identify gaps, risks, and growth opportunities, and convert insights into actions.
* Maintain accurate account forecasts and provide customer inputs for business planning and S&OP reviews.
* Track competitor pricing, promotions, assortment, and in-store execution.
  

**Demand, Supply & Service Management**

  

* Partner with Demand Planning, Supply Chain, and Customer Service to ensure product availability and healthy inventory.
* Minimize stock-outs, excess inventory, aged stock, short supplies, and order fulfilment issues.
* Coordinate timely order processing and drive improvement in customer service levels and OTIF.
  

**Execution Excellence**

  

* Ensure agreed assortment, availability, visibility, pricing, planograms, and promotional plans are executed across customer outlets.
* Drive high-quality launch execution for new products and track post-launch performance.
* Undertake periodic market visits to assess execution standards, shopper experience, and competitor activity.
  

**KPIs & Success Metrics**

  

* Annual Business Revenue, Margins, and market share delivery

* JBP achievement and growth initiative delivery
* Sell-out growth, distribution, assortment, availability, and visibility
* Forecast accuracy, inventory health, service level, and OTIF

OriginBluy is running a Customer Care Gold Standard program for a large utility that serves more than 23 lakh households through 60+ walk-in service centres and an inbound call centre.

The consultant is our person on the ground: they diagnose how service works today, help define the Gold Standard, and stay through training and monitoring until the client’s own managers can hold the standard.

They report to the Principal Coach and work directly with the client’s customer care leadership, centre managers and call centre teams.

What you’ll do

**Diagnose**

* Run mystery shopping at walk-in centres: brief and calibrate the shoppers, score visits and consolidate the findings
* Select and listen to recorded calls with a focus on outliers (best, worst, repeat and escalated calls) and find the root cause of each: behaviour, process, system or policy
* Interview centre managers, call centre team leads and functional heads
* Pull together existing SOPs, scripts, QA formats and MIS into one baseline

**Define**

* Map the end-to-end customer journey for the top contact reasons, both walk-in and call
* Draft the Gold Standard: interaction standards, scripts, SOPs, escalation paths and the scorecard
* Build the cost-benefit case with client Finance: contact volumes, repeat rates, cost per contact
* Run dry runs of the new standard with a pilot group and refine it

**Deliver and sustain**

* Co-deliver CSE and manager workshops with the trainer
* Administer the Ready-for-floor certification test
* Run post-training mystery shopping and call audits, produce centre-wise scores and prepare packs for leadership reviews
* Coach centre managers and TLs to observe, score and coach against the standard

What you bring

**Must have**

* **10–15 years in customer service operations**
  , including all three of the following:
* **Inbound call centre:**
   managed or ran operations or quality for an inbound voice operation, ideally 50+ seats. Hands-on with call quality monitoring, AHT, first-contact resolution, CSAT and repeat-call analysis.
* **Walk-in service centres:**
   managed a network of customer service centres or branches. Knows queue and token management, counter processes, document-heavy service requests and how to manage a multi-location network.
* **Transformation projects:**
   led at least two service transformation or process improvement projects end to end. This could be SOP standardisation, a service redesign, a contact-centre turnaround, or harmonising processes after a merger, with results you can show.
* Comfortable with data: builds analyses in Excel, works with call logs and MIS, and can turn numbers into a business case
* Can run a good interview and a good workshop. Credible with a functional head and comfortable with a frontline executive.
* **Fluent in Gujarati, Hindi and English**
   (spoken; written Gujarati preferred)
* Willing to travel extensively within Gujarat

**Good to have**

* Experience in utilities, city gas distribution, power distribution, telecom, banking or insurance, meaning large regulated consumer bases with high volumes of service requests
* Familiarity with regulator-defined service standards and complaint timelines (e.g., PNGRB, state electricity regulatory commission norms)
* Lean, Six Sigma (Green Belt or above) or COPC exposure
* Experience with outsourced or agency staffing models in contact centres
* Training delivery or facilitation experience

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* A credible baseline from mystery shopping and call audits that the client’s leadership accepts
* A Gold Standard draft built from the client’s own best interactions, signed off by the client owner
* A cost-benefit case that the client’s Finance team has validated
* Strong working relationships with centre managers and call centre TLs, so that they see the program as support rather than an audit

Personal attributes

* Good at reading and getting on with people on the shop floor; earns trust quickly with frontline teams
* Rigorous with evidence: separates what they saw from what they were told
* Discreet with client data and with individual performance information
* Self-directed and able to run the program on the ground without close supervision

About Elimai.ai

Elimai.ai is an AI-native enterprise technology company building intelligent AI agents for the fashion and apparel industry.

Our platform helps apparel manufacturers and exporters streamline product development, sampling, costing, pre-production approvals, and merchandising workflows. By automating email processing, technical document interpretation, approval tracking, and manual Excel updates, we help teams improve productivity, reduce errors, and gain real-time operational visibility.

We are now expanding our solutions to support fashion brands, buying offices, and sourcing organizations, enabling seamless collaboration across the fashion supply chain.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Apparel Product Development & Merchandising Domain Specialist**
with strong knowledge of garment product development, sourcing, technical merchandising, and brand-side operations.

This is a domain expertise and product development role, not a conventional merchandising execution position. The selected candidate will work closely with our product, AI, and engineering teams to translate real-world apparel industry workflows into intelligent software solutions.

We are looking for someone who understands not only
**what merchandisers do, but why they do it, how decisions are made, and where existing processes can be improved.**

Why Join Elimai.ai?

* Contribute directly to AI products built specifically for the apparel industry.
* Work closely with product leaders and AI engineering teams.
* Apply real-world merchandising experience to solve industry-wide operational challenges.
* Help shape technology for fashion brands, sourcing offices, and manufacturers.
* Play a meaningful role in transforming traditional fashion supply chain workflows through AI.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Apparel Industry Domain Expertise**

* Provide practical domain knowledge across product development, merchandising, sourcing, sampling, costing, and pre-production activities.
* Explain end-to-end workflows followed by fashion brands, buying offices, and apparel manufacturers.
* Identify differences between brand-side and manufacturer-side merchandising operations.
* Document industry terminology, business processes, approval requirements, and operational challenges.

**2. Brand-Side Sourcing & Merchandising Workflows**

* Map how fashion brands manage seasonal collections, product development calendars, style development, and sourcing activities.
* Explain vendor selection, quotation comparison, target costing, and supplier coordination processes.
* Understand how brands coordinate with multiple factories and track product development progress.
* Identify operational challenges in brand-to-manufacturer communication, sample management, and approval tracking.

**3. AI Product Development & Workflow Automation**

* Collaborate with AI engineers and product teams to convert merchandising processes into software requirements.
* **Identify repetitive manual activities suitable for AI-driven automation.**
* Help design AI agents for sampling, costing, technical document processing, approvals, and workflow tracking.
* Validate AI-generated information against actual apparel industry practices.
* Define business rules, workflow exceptions, and scenarios requiring human intervention.
* Provide practical feedback to improve product accuracy, usability, and industry relevance.

**4. Product Testing & Validation**

* Develop realistic merchandising scenarios using tech packs, email conversations, costing sheets, approval documents, and WIP trackers.
* Test AI product features from the perspective of merchandisers, sourcing professionals, and product development teams.
* Identify incorrect interpretations, missing information, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

**5. Customer & Product Collaboration**

* Participate in product discussions, demonstrations, and feedback sessions with apparel manufacturers, buying offices, and brands.
* Understand customer workflows and translate operational requirements into actionable product improvements.
* Work with internal teams to prioritize features based on business value and user needs.
* Support the development of relevant industry use cases and product demonstrations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **Strong practical experience in apparel product development, technical merchandising, sourcing, or buying-office operations.**
* **Good understanding of end-to-end garment development, from initial design brief to bulk production approval.**
* Ability to read and interpret tech packs, BOMs, measurement charts, specifications, and technical comments.
* **Familiarity with brand-to-vendor communication, development calendars, and production handoff processes.**
* Experience working with merchandising trackers, Excel-based WIP reports, and product development documentation.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate complex garment industry processes clearly to non-fashion professionals, including software engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience with a fashion brand, buying office, sourcing organization, or global apparel exporter.
* Experience coordinating product development across multiple factories or suppliers.
* Familiarity with PLM, ERP, or other apparel industry software platforms.
* Experience creating SOPs, process maps, training materials, or workflow documentation.
* Prior involvement in software implementation, process digitization, or automation projects is an advantage.

*Prior AI or software development experience is not mandatory. Strong apparel industry knowledge and the ability to explain business workflows are more important.*

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

* Help Elimai.ai develop a comprehensive understanding of brand-side and manufacturer-side merchandising workflows.
* Translate real-world apparel processes into clear, actionable requirements for AI product development.
* Improve the accuracy and practicality of Elimai's AI-powered merchandising solutions.
* Identify high-value opportunities to automate repetitive work while retaining essential human decision-making.
* Help build products that apparel brands, buying offices, and manufacturers can confidently use in their daily operations.

Essentials for Financials, Profit & Loss statements as well as People Flash reporting are the primary reporting tools within this product line. The main responsibility is to increase the usage and adoption of the tools, understand changing business needs and feed them into continuous improvement process of the solution, supporting improvements and spreading a positive message while interacting with the different stakeholders.
  
  
The Reporting and Data Analytics sub-function is a leading-edge organization providing powerful analytical solutions to evolve our ability to provide insights to the business. title: Sr. Manager - Operations
description:
**Overview**
**Overview:**
**Sr Manager – Operations**
Serves as a strategic leader responsible for optimizing organizational performance, driving operational excellence, and leading cross-functional teams to achieve business objectives. This role combines advanced operational expertise with executive leadership skills to transform processes, systems, and team performance across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Environment, Health and Safety (EHS)**

* Drive a Safety First mindset, ensuring 100% compliance with Process Safety Management (PSM), OSHA, and local environmental control boards (such as the State Pollution Control Board and DISH).
* To maintain safe, pollution free working environment & housekeeping for eliminate/minimize work time lost due to accidents by implementing recommendations of Internal safety audits, EHS round, safety committee meeting, HAZOP study, & Occupational Health Risk Assessment etc.
* Oversee Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) and Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) operations and ensure strict adherence to hazardous waste management protocols.
* Lead incident investigations, root cause analyses (RCA), and implement corrective actions for any safety near-misses in the work place.

**Production & Operational Excellence**

* Direct day-to-day manufacturing operations to maximize equipment utilization, plant uptime, and overall output yield.
* Monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) relating to safety, quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
* Own plant performance across production, maintenance, quality, food safety, stores and factory administration, in close coordination with cross functional team.
* Improve OEE, capacity utilisation, throughput, labour productivity, yields and equipment reliability while reducing conversion cost, wastage, rework and downtime.
* Deliver production plans aligned with sales forecast demand, customer service levels and inventory norms.
* Implement Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement frameworks to minimize operational bottlenecks and reduce cycle times.

**Maintenance Management**

* Oversee preventive and breakdown maintenance programs to minimize downtime and costs.
* Achieve optimal Energy Units per KG targets by optimizing production processes and equipment conditions for reduced energy consumption.
* Generate Maintenance Reports, including Machine Health Cards, and manage Maintenance Costs effectively.
* Lead new project planning, including layout, process reengineering, and equipment execution for enhanced efficiency in coordination with the project team.
* Ensure critical plant & machinery uptime to prevent production shutdowns.
* Maintain high uptime rates by ensuring optimal conditions of equipment across all production lines.
* Prepare the Annual Operational Plan (AOP) for Plant Maintenance.
* Implement safety programs and eliminate accidents through regular inspection and repair of safety devices.
* Ensure fire hydrant, ETP & STP systems, and other critical infrastructure are in proper working condition.
* Analyze all the breakdown failures and implement corrective and preventive actions through proper lean tool.
* Liaise with EB and PCB officials for compliance and operational needs.
* Supervise and motivate the maintenance team, ensuring discipline and efficiency.
* Implement 5S practices in the maintenance section.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Provide direction and motivation to team members, emphasizing safety, quality, efficiency, productivity, cost reduction, and morale.
* Responsible for managing and appraising team member job performance and recommending corrective action.
* Develop and maintains positive team member relations centered on mutual trust, dignity, respect, fairness, consistency, two-way communication, teamwork, and harmony.
* Plan and coordinate hiring and placement of team members. Monitors and track staf fing conditions, work hours and overtime, job rotation, and absenteeism.
* Direct floor activities through consistent application of company’s practices to ensure all aspects of manufacturing are ef fective and correct sub-standard situations.

**Qualifications**

* Must be a BE / BTech in Chemical, Mechanical or Industrial Engineering with around with 15 + years’ experience in chemical process manufacturing/operations, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of production planning, maintenance systems, quality assurance, and safety standards.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive operational efficiency.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to manage diverse teams.

title: Project Leader
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose -- moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Project Leader to join our team in a Remote capacity. As a Project Leader, you will lead Parexel and client teams by combining deep clinical research expertise with strategic insight to develop innovative solutions that drive clinical trial success. This position plays a key role in study execution, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and client satisfaction. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, leverage industry-standard processes, and drive study outcomes from planning through closeout.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic project leadership and advancing new treatments for patients. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Project Leader can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research and project management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage medium to high complexity clinical trials or low complexity clinical trial programs with full accountability for project deliverables, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans with key milestones, budgets, and resources assigned to specific tasks and outcomes; define metrics for reporting performance against plan.
* Own the client relationship at the study level, establishing effective communication channels and standards that ensure high client satisfaction and timely delivery of solutions.
* Manage project profitability through budget oversight, revenue recognition, forecasting, resource management, and change in scope management in collaboration with cross-functional partners.
* Identify and mitigate project risks, implement contingency plans, and keep clients informed of risks and mitigation strategies.
* Establish quality standards that drive individual and team commitment to quality; monitor deliverables and implement corrective and preventative actions as needed.
* Lead cross-functional project teams to achieve successful study completion; establish team goals, inspire ownership, and maintain accountability through regular project reviews.
* Represent Project Leadership in external client meetings, bid pursuits, investigator meetings, and professional conferences.
* Act as a role model and mentor for Project Leaders and junior staff; support program management responsibilities as needed.

**You'll thrive in this role if you bring**

* Advanced project management and strategic thinking skills with the ability to create urgency and develop solutions-based approaches.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills with strong conflict management abilities.
* 10+ years of experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or in a regulated environment with proven success managing complex projects.
* The ability to work independently with minimal oversight, analyze complex situations, and develop nonstandard solutions.
* A patient-focused mindset, high accountability, and strong attention to detail in all deliverables.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), project planning software, and standard clinical research systems (CTMS, EDC, IXRS, TMF).
* Ability to thrive in a matrix environment, value teamwork, and embrace Parexel's High-Performance Culture principles.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in a science or medical-related field.
* Proven advanced project management experience in healthcare, clinical research, or contract research organization.
* Proven track record of developing and managing client relationships at the project level.
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (Master's or higher) in a related field.
* PMP or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience managing different trial phases and program-level responsibilities.

Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
  
  
Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
  
  
"
  
  
**Job Description**
Job Summary
  
  
This role is for a Continuous Improvement (CI) Manager responsible for driving site-wide operational excellence through structured problem-solving, Lean methodologies, and cultural transformation. The position requires a hands-on leader with expertise in Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and performance analytics. As a key driver of productivity and efficiency, this role will establish a multi-year CI roadmap, lead high-impact improvement projects, and support cross-functional teams in identifying and resolving systemic issues.
  
  

* Responsibilities:

+ Ensure compliance with cGMP, EHS, data integrity, and all regulatory requirements.
+ Implement company policies, systems, and procedures effectively while ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and strategic goals.
+ Maintain discipline, safety standards, and adherence to SOPs on the shop floor.
+ Lead OE diagnostic session to identify ideas to improve OPEX, TVC.
+ Facilitate LMS (Lean Management System) idea generation, evaluation, implementation, and sustainability.
+ Conduct plant capacity analysis and develop improvement plans to maintain a minimum 1.3X flexible manufacturing capacity.
+ Monitor Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), identify major losses, and drive improvement projects to enhance equipment performance.
+ Monitor and optimize Productivity metrics & improve it to reach TD.
+ Establish annual SDP KPI baselines, set targets, and drive action plans to achieve business objectives.
+ Track Requirement vs Capacity vs Actual (R vs C vs A) performance, analyze gaps, and implement corrective actions to improve manufacturing efficiency.
+ Identify process bottlenecks and implement solutions to reduce Door-to-Ship (D2S) lead time for critical products.
+ Drive Value Stream Mapping (VSM), Kaizen, Lean projects, and continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing operations.
+ Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Quality, Warehouse, Planning, and Supply Chain teams to achieve plant performance objectives.
+ Lead automation, digitalization, and process improvement projects to enhance operational efficiency and reliability.
+ Support production planning and prioritization to maximize throughput and minimize delays.
+ Lead TPM deployment across manufacturing and engineering functions in alignment with corporate TPM roadmap.
+ Implement and sustain Autonomous Maintenance (Jishu Hozen) pillars, driving progression through TPM maturity levels and achieving targeted JH steps.
+ Strengthen Planned Maintenance systems through preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance practices.
+ Drive initiatives to achieve Zero Breakdown, Zero Defect, Zero Accident, and Zero Waste objectives.
+ Develop and monitor equipment health indicators, maintenance KPIs, and asset robustness metrics.
+ Facilitate Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, CAPA, and reliability improvement programs for critical equipment.
+ Build operator and maintenance team capability through TPM training, coaching, and competency development programs.

"
  
  
**Qualifications**
Educational Qualification
  
  
Graduation in Mechanical, Industrial, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy or related field is mandatory.
  
  
Certification in Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt) and Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt) is preferred.
  
  
JIPM certification is preferred.
  
  
**Minimum Work Experience**
10+ years of experience
  
  
Skills & Attributes Functional Skills
  
  

* Best Practice Implementation
* Failure Mode And Effects Analysis
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness
* Process Analysis
* Process Mapping
* Project Management
* Statistics

Resident Skills
  
  

* Continuous Improvement Process
* Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPs)
* Lean Methodologies
* Operational Excellence

Behavioural Skills
  
  

* Proactive Leadership – Takes initiative to identify improvement areas and mobilize cross-functional teams toward impactful solutions.
* Collaboration & Coaching – Builds trust and engagement across teams by mentoring, facilitating workshops, and encouraging shared ownership of outcomes.
* Results Orientation – Maintains a sharp focus on measurable outcomes, driving projects with discipline and accountability to deliver operational excellence.

Critical Exposures
  
  

* Experience in Lean Six Sigma project execution, process audits and compliance with operational and quality standards is desired.
* Exposure to data analysis and reporting in transformation projects to track process performance, quality improvements, and change management is preferred.
* Experience in FMEA and Root Cause Analysis to optimize costs and productivity is desired.
* Exposure to Lean tools such as Kaizen, VSM, or SMED for throughput improvement, changeover time reduction, and labour/material optimization is preferred.

"
  
  
**Additional Information**
Benefits Offered
  
  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
  
  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
  
  
" Our Work Culture
  
  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
  
  
For more details, please visit our career website at https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/"
