title: Project Manager - HVAC (MEP Projects)
company: APEE Infratech India Pvt Ltd ( Formerly AP Electricals and Engineers )
description:
**Position – Project Manager – HVAC /MEP Projects**

**Department - Projects / Mechanical**

**Reporting To - H O D**

**Location - Project Site / Hyderabad**

**Job Purpose**

To Execute the projects HVAC services with R&D, Pharma project and oversee the complete mechanical MEP project activities, ensuring timely execution, technical compliance, quality, safety, cost control and successful project completion as per approved drawings, specifications, contract requirements and client expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Planning & Execution**

* Plan, coordinate and supervise mechanical MEP project activities from mobilization to completion and handover.
* Prepare project execution plans, work schedules, manpower requirements, and material requirements.
* Monitor project progress against approved schedules and ensure timely completion of activities.
* Coordinate with civil, electrical, architectural, structural, and other MEP teams to avoid interface issues.
* Identify project risks, delays, and constraints and implement corrective measures.
* MIR & Joint measurement sheet approval for Billing.

**2. Technical Coordination**

* Review shop drawings, coordinated drawings, material submittals, technical submissions, and method statements.
* Coordinate with consultants, clients, architects, vendors, and subcontractors for technical approvals and clarifications.
* Identify design discrepancies and prepare RFIs/technical queries wherever required.
* Ensure all works are executed according to approved drawings and project specifications.
* Provide technical guidance and solutions to site engineers and supervisors.

**4. Manpower & Subcontractor Management**

* Plan and allocate manpower according to project requirements.
* Monitor the performance of mechanical engineers, supervisors, technicians, and subcontractors.
* Coordinate with subcontractors regarding work fronts, productivity, quality, and project schedules.
* Conduct regular site meetings and progress reviews.
* Ensure adequate resources are available for uninterrupted project execution.

**5. Material & Procurement Coordination**

* Prepare and review material requirements based on project schedules and BOQ.
* Coordinate with procurement and stores teams for timely availability of materials.
* Review material specifications and ensure materials conform to approved submittals.
* Monitor material consumption and minimize wastage.
* Coordinate with vendors for equipment delivery, installation, testing, and commissioning.

**6. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure all mechanical works are carried out in accordance with project HSE requirements.
* Coordinate with the EHS team to implement safe working practices.
* Ensure compliance with permit-to-work systems, PPE requirements, work-at-height procedures, hot-work controls, and other applicable safety requirements.
* Stop unsafe work practices and ensure corrective action is taken.

**7. Documentation & Reporting**

* Prepare and review daily, weekly, and monthly project progress reports.
* Maintain records of drawings, approvals, inspections, testing, material submittals, and project correspondence.
* Monitor as-built drawings and ensure they are updated based on actual site installation.
* Coordinate preparation of operation and maintenance manuals, warranties, test certificates, and handover documents.

**8. Client & Consultant Coordination**

* Attend project meetings with clients, consultants, contractors, and other stakeholders.
* Present mechanical project progress, technical issues, and planned activities.
* Resolve site issues through effective coordination and communication.
* Maintain professional relationships with clients and project stakeholders.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in **Mechanical Engineering**.
* Additional qualifications in HVAC, MEP, Project Management, or related fields will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* Typically, **8–10 years of relevant experience** in HVAC/ MEP Projects, preferably in commercial buildings, industrial projects, data centres, hospitals, hotels, or large-scale construction projects.
* Experience in managing mechanical site execution, subcontractors, testing & commissioning, and client/consultant coordination.

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: HR Technology & Automation Manager
description:
**Main Purpose**
The HR Technology & Automation Manager is responsible for leading the global HR technology function, encompassing the strategic ownership, configuration, governance, continuous improvement, and roadmap evolution of Workday and the broader HR technology landscape. The role also drives HR process automation and digitalization across the organization — identifying, redesigning, and implementing automation solutions that reduce manual effort, improve data quality, and enhance the employee experience.
  
  
Acting as both a strategic and technical leader, this role bridges HR, IT, HRIS, and technology vendors. It manages day-to-day HRIS operations, leads a team of HRIS analysts, and champions the adoption of workflow automation, AI, and digital tools across HR processes.
  
  
**Primary Job Responsibilities**
**HR Technology & Workday**

* Lead the design, development, configuration, and continuous improvement of Workday and all HRIS functionalities across the organization, including modules, integrations, security, reporting, and enhancements.
* Manage the full lifecycle of HRIS projects: requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, and post-launch support for implementations, upgrades, and system integrations.
* Develop, maintain, and migrate integration solutions between Workday and internal/external systems (Payroll, Finance, Benefits, etc.) using Studio, Cloud Connect, REST/SOAP Web Services, XML, and XSLT.
* Define and enforce HRIS governance frameworks, data standards, access controls, and security configurations to ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor system performance and proactively recommend improvements to optimize the reliability, scalability, and efficiency of HR systems.
* Manage the HRIS budget including planning, vendor cost management, and tracking execution against approved budgets aligned with business priorities.
* Stay current on Workday releases, community updates, and the broader HR technology market; assess the impact of new features and lead their adoption where relevant.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for all HRIS configurations, integrations, and processes.
* Provide expert guidance and training to team members and HR stakeholders on HRIS and Workday best practices.
* Serve as the key integrator between functional HR requirements and technical HRIS delivery; partner closely with HR, Payroll, IT, Finance, and external vendors globally.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and company policies related to HR data security and privacy.

**HR Automation & Process Digitalization**

* Own the HR automation agenda: systematically identify repetitive, manual, high-volume, or error-prone HR processes across the function as candidates for automation or digitalization.
* Partner with HR stakeholders to map, redesign, and streamline processes before automating — ensuring automation reinforces best-practice workflows, not inefficient ones.
* Evaluate, recommend, and implement automation solutions including workflow automation tools, RPA, AI-powered capabilities, system integrations, and digital self-service enhancements.
* Leverage AI and intelligent automation tools where appropriate to improve HR data quality, accelerate processing, reduce manual intervention, and enable predictive insights.
* Establish governance standards, prioritization frameworks, and documentation practices for all HR automation initiatives across the organization.
* Define and track impact metrics for automation efforts: efficiency gains, reduction in manual effort, data quality improvements, error reduction, and enhanced employee and manager experience.
* Act as the bridge between HR, IT, HRIS, and technology vendors to ensure alignment on automation strategy, tooling, data security, and architecture.
* Build awareness and capability across the HR team for automated tools and self-service solutions, driving adoption and reducing dependency on manual processing.
* Continuously scan the HR technology landscape for emerging platforms, AI-enabled capabilities, and automation tools that can advance HR digitalization goals.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Human Resources, or a related field of study.
* Minimum 8 years of HRIS/HR technology experience, with at least 5 years of hands-on Workday expertise including module configuration, integrations, and security (Studio, Cloud Connect, REST/SOAP, XML, XSLT).
* Proven track record leading HRIS teams and delivering global HR technology initiatives in a complex, multi-country environment.
* Demonstrated experience in HR automation, process digitalization, or the implementation of workflow/RPA/AI-enabled solutions within HR.
* Strong understanding of HR processes and data across domains such as Recruiting, Onboarding, Compensation, Payroll, Benefits, and Learning.
* Experience with Workday tenant security configuration, integration architecture design patterns, and ERP integration best practices.
* Excellent analytical thinking, attention to detail, and organizational skills; comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced, agile environment.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to translate technical topics clearly for non-technical HR stakeholders and present confidently at senior levels.
* Experience with software development lifecycle and project management; agile methodology experience is a plus.
* Shows initiative, works independently with minimal supervision, and approaches complex problems creatively with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Exposure to AI tools, process mining, intelligent automation platforms, or digital transformation programs is a strong plus.

title: Subcontracts Engineer - Heavy Fabrication & EPC Projects
description:
**About Zeeco**
Zeeco is a global leader in designing and manufacturing advanced combustion and environmental solutions for the petroleum, chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, LNG, power, and industrial process sectors. Our product portfolio includes ultra-low emission burners, vapor recovery units (VRUs), flare systems, thermal oxidizers, hazardous waste incinerators, fired heaters, and other engineered process equipment.
  
  
Headquartered near Tulsa, Oklahoma (USA), Zeeco operates one of the world's largest combustion research and testing facilities alongside a state-of-the-art manufacturing campus. With engineering, manufacturing, and service operations across the globe, Zeeco delivers innovative, reliable, and sustainable solutions to customers worldwide.
  
  
At Zeeco, we foster innovation, technical excellence, and continuous professional growth. Employees are given opportunities to work on challenging global projects while collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering and project teams.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Zeeco is seeking an experienced
**Contracts Engineer**
to manage end-to-end procurement and contract administration activities for fabrication and allied industrial services supporting project execution.
  
  
The role requires strong techno-commercial expertise in procurement, contract management, vendor development, and commercial negotiations. The successful candidate will be responsible for sourcing qualified service providers, administering contracts, ensuring timely execution of services, and supporting cost-effective project delivery while maintaining compliance with company standards and contractual obligations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Procurement & Contract Management:**
  
  

* Manage the complete procurement lifecycle for fabrication and industrial service contracts, including:

+ Fabrication services
+ Blasting and painting services
+ Packaging and logistics
+ Equipment rental (cranes, rolling, forming, bending, and other specialized machinery)
+ Transportation and logistics services
+ Industrial manpower supply contracts

* Prepare, review, negotiate, and administer service contracts in accordance with project specifications, company procedures, and commercial requirements.
* Ensure contractual compliance with technical specifications, commercial terms, statutory regulations, and internal procurement policies.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Planning, Projects, Manufacturing, QA/QC, and Finance teams throughout the procurement cycle.
* Monitor contract execution to ensure adherence to agreed scope, timelines, commercial terms, and quality expectations.

**Vendor Development & Supplier Management**
  
  

* Identify, evaluate, qualify, and develop local and regional vendors to strengthen the approved supplier base.
* Conduct vendor capability assessments covering:

+ Technical competency
+ Manufacturing capability
+ Financial stability
+ Quality systems
+ Infrastructure and resource availability
+ Delivery performance

* Maintain and continuously update the Approved Vendor List (AVL).
* Monitor vendor performance through key performance indicators including quality, delivery, cost competitiveness, responsiveness, safety, and contractual compliance.
* Drive continuous vendor performance improvement initiatives and establish long-term strategic supplier relationships.

**RFQ & Tendering Process**

* Review Purchase Requisitions (PRs) and service requirements received from Project, Planning, Engineering, and Manufacturing teams.
* Clarify technical scope, commercial requirements, and execution methodology with internal stakeholders before floating enquiries.
* Prepare and issue Requests for Quotation (RFQs) to qualified vendors.
* Obtain competitive quotations while ensuring complete compliance with technical and commercial requirements.
* Perform comprehensive techno-commercial evaluations of vendor quotations.
* Prepare detailed comparative statements and recommendation reports.
* Analyze cost structures, pricing trends, and procurement opportunities to achieve cost optimization without compromising quality or delivery commitments.

**Commercial Negotiation & Order Finalization**
  
  

* Lead commercial negotiations with vendors covering:

+ Pricing
+ Payment terms
+ Delivery schedules
+ Liquidated Damages (LD) clauses
+ Warranty obligations
+ Taxes and duties
+ Commercial risks
+ Contractual obligations

* Finalize contract terms in alignment with company objectives, project schedules, and risk mitigation requirements.
* Prepare and issue Purchase Orders (POs), Service Orders, and Work Orders after obtaining all required internal approvals.
* Ensure contractual documentation is complete, accurate, and aligned with organizational procurement standards.

**Order Execution, Expediting & Contract Administration**

* Monitor vendor progress to ensure timely execution of contracted services in accordance with project schedules.
* Coordinate with QA/QC, Projects, Planning, Manufacturing, Stores, and Engineering teams to resolve execution-related issues.
* Track service completion milestones and ensure compliance with contractual deliverables.
* Manage contract variations, deviations, change orders, claims, and commercial correspondence throughout project execution.
* Support timely resolution of contractual disputes while protecting company interests.

**Documentation, Compliance & Cost Control**

* Maintain complete procurement documentation, contract records, commercial correspondence, and historical cost databases.
* Develop and maintain vendor performance records for future procurement decisions.
* Maintain cost benchmarking data to support strategic sourcing initiatives and commercial negotiations.
* Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, contractual obligations, statutory regulations, and audit requirements.
* Support internal and external audits by providing complete procurement and contract documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* 5 to 12 years of relevant experience in procurement and contract management within the Oil & Gas, Fired Equipment, Process Equipment, EPC, Heavy Engineering, or Manufacturing sectors.
* Strong understanding of fabrication processes, welding, machining, surface preparation, coating systems, heavy equipment handling, and industrial service procurement.
* Proven experience in managing high-value service contracts and project-based procurement activities.
* Hands-on experience in vendor sourcing, qualification, development, and performance management.
* Strong knowledge of contract drafting, interpretation, and contract administration.
* Thorough understanding of commercial terms and conditions, including Incoterms, payment terms, Liquidated Damages (LD) clauses, warranty clauses, retention provisions, and contractual risk management.
* Experience in techno-commercial evaluation, cost analysis, and commercial benchmarking.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities with exceptional attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize multiple procurement activities and work effectively under project-driven schedules.
* Proficiency in ERP systems and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, for procurement reporting and commercial analysis.

title: Project Engineer
description:
**Company Name:** Thermistance Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** Project Engineer  
**Department:** Project Management / Engineering  
**Industry:** Advanced Thermal Management & Manufacturing  
**Reporting To:** Project Manager / HOD – Engineering  
**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**1. Job Summary**

The Project Engineer will be responsible for planning, coordinating, executing, and monitoring engineering and manufacturing projects from initiation to completion. The role involves coordinating with design, production, purchase, quality, maintenance, and sales teams to ensure timely project delivery, technical accuracy, quality compliance, and cost-effective execution.

The candidate should have a strong understanding of engineering drawings, manufacturing processes, project scheduling, material planning, and cross-functional coordination, preferably in a mechanical engineering or manufacturing environment.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Project Planning and Execution**

* Develop project plans, schedules, milestones, and execution strategies.
* Monitor project progress against timelines, budgets, and deliverables.
* Coordinate project activities from design and material procurement through manufacturing, testing, and dispatch.
* Identify project risks, delays, and bottlenecks and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure timely completion of projects in accordance with customer requirements.

**B. Engineering and Technical Coordination**

* Review engineering drawings, BOMs, technical specifications, and project requirements.
* Coordinate with the design team for drawing approvals, design changes, and technical clarifications.
* Ensure effective communication of engineering requirements to production and quality teams.
* Support prototype development, product validation, testing, and troubleshooting.
* Maintain technical documentation, revision records, and project-related engineering data.

**C. Manufacturing and Production Coordination**

* Coordinate with production for job card creation, operation-wise planning, and machine-wise tracking.
* Monitor production progress and ensure adherence to project schedules.
* Track work-in-progress (WIP), material availability, machine utilization, and production constraints.
* Coordinate with the purchase and stores teams to ensure timely availability of materials and components.
* Follow up on pending operations, rework, and production delays.

**D. Quality and Process Compliance**

* Coordinate with the quality team for in-process inspections, final inspections, and testing.
* Ensure project deliverables meet approved specifications and quality standards.
* Track non-conformities, corrective actions, and preventive measures.
* Maintain inspection reports, test reports, and project quality records.
* Support continuous improvement in manufacturing and project execution processes.

**E. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Act as the coordination point between design, production, purchase, quality, maintenance, and other relevant departments.
* Conduct regular project review meetings and communicate progress, risks, and pending actions.
* Coordinate with maintenance to resolve machine breakdowns affecting project delivery.
* Escalate critical issues to the Project Manager or HOD.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders to ensure closure of assigned actions.

**F. ERP and Project Documentation**

* Update project status, milestones, material requirements, and progress in the ERP system.
* Monitor project-wise job cards, BOMs, production status, and material movement.
* Prepare project progress reports, trackers, dashboards, and delay analysis.
* Maintain project schedules, meeting minutes, action logs, change records, and closure reports.
* Ensure accurate and timely data entry for project monitoring and management review.

**G. Customer and Project Closure Support**

* Support customer technical discussions and project status updates, as required.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to meet customer delivery commitments.
* Ensure completion of testing, documentation, dispatch readiness, and handover activities.
* Record lessons learned and recommend improvements for future projects.

**3. Educational Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Diploma in Mechanical Engineering may be considered based on relevant experience and technical capability.

**4. Experience**

* Typically 2–5 years of experience in project engineering, manufacturing, production coordination, or engineering operations.
* Experience in a manufacturing or mechanical engineering organization is preferred.
* Fresh engineering graduates may be considered for a Graduate Engineer Trainee role.

**5. Required Technical Skills**

* Understanding of mechanical engineering drawings, BOMs, and technical specifications.
* Knowledge of manufacturing processes, production planning, and material flow.
* Working knowledge of project planning, scheduling, and progress monitoring.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and project tracking tools.
* Experience with ERP/MRP systems for job cards, inventory, production, and project tracking.
* Knowledge of quality inspection, root cause analysis, and corrective action processes.
* Familiarity with CAD tools such as SolidWorks or AutoCAD is an advantage.

**6. Required Competencies**

* Strong planning, coordination, and organizational skills.
* Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Proactive follow-up and timely escalation of issues.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Ownership, accountability, and a results-oriented approach.

**7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**The Project Engineer's performance will be evaluated based on:**

* **On-time project completion:** Percentage of projects delivered within approved timelines.
* **Schedule adherence:** Achievement of planned project milestones.
* **Job card tracking:** Timely updates and closure of operation-wise and machine-wise job cards.
* **Material readiness:** Timely identification and follow-up of project material requirements.
* **Project documentation:** Accuracy and timely completion of project records and ERP updates.
* **Issue resolution:** Timely closure of technical, production, and coordination issues.
* **Quality performance:** Reduction in rework and project-related non-conformities.
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Effective follow-up and closure of interdepartmental action items.
* **Cost and resource control:** Monitoring of project expenses, material usage, and resource utilization.
* **Customer delivery performance:** Achievement of agreed delivery and technical requirements.

**8. Working Conditions**

* Full-time role based at the company's office and manufacturing facility.
* Regular interaction with engineering, production, quality, purchase, stores, and maintenance teams.
* Occasional shop-floor visits and participation in project review meetings.
* Ability to work in a manufacturing environment and manage time-sensitive deliverables.

**9. Desired Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be technically sound, systematic, and proactive, with the ability to convert project requirements into actionable plans and coordinate their execution across departments. Experience in manufacturing project tracking, ERP-based production monitoring, and machine-wise job card management will be an added advantage.

**Objective of the Role:** To ensure smooth project execution through effective planning, technical coordination, manufacturing follow-up, ERP-based tracking, and timely delivery of quality products to customers.

title: Senior Manager - Regional Logistics
description:
**About the Job:**
We are looking for a dynamic Regional Logistics Manager to lead secondary distribution operations within the assigned branch territory. The role is responsible for ensuring best-in-class service levels at optimum cost, while staying fully compliant on storage, transportation, sustainability, safety and security standards.
  
  
This is a high-impact role that combines strategic network design with hands-on execution, working closely with Sales, O2C, Finance, Factories, HO Logistics, 3PL partners, transporters and Carrying & Forwarding Agents (CFAs) to deliver a seamless end-to-end distribution experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Distribution & Transportation Management**

* Manage Cost of Distribution (COD) by optimizing inbound and outbound delivery (E2E) to control Total Delivered Cost (FDC / VDC / % COD).
* Drive Distribution Network Redesign, Logistics Excellence and related projects across delivery transportation and downstream warehouse operations.
* Prepare the Transport strategy along with T-Hub, onboard new carriers for downstream operations, and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Complete formalities and ensure recovery of accident/loss claims for primary and secondary movements.

**Warehouse & DC Operations**

* Lead DC improvement projects – manpower productivity, MHE utilization, DIDO/GIGO improvement, warehouse utilization – ensuring minimal business disruption.
* Prepare warehouse strategy and manage new infrastructure transitions in line with business volume progression (OPL/MBS).
* Ensure 100% cycle count and inventory accuracy along with adherence to internal & external compliance guidelines.

**Service Levels & Customer Fulfilment**

* Maintain COF / OTIF / ZATP, reduce CD OOS and secondary OTRs.
* Resolve CD complaints related to shortages/damages and drive corrective actions.
* Coordinate with the Sales team and O2C team to onboard new customers post CSP alignment and ensure full supply.

**Compliance & Quality**

* Ensure cool chain compliance in downstream storage and transportation (DC to Distributor).
* Drive batch traceability, reefer service and chilled service strategies.
* Adhere to the company charter on supply and distribution of Infant Milk Substitutes and Infant Foods.

**Transformation & Automation**

* Identify and deploy advanced process improvement tools in warehousing (WMS, Dock Management, RF Implementation).
* Implement digital solutions in transportation – Transporeon, In-Transit Visibility, Digital Hygiene Checklist, LCOP, ERC, OVT.
* Roll out all Distribution-related HO projects (LER, CLER, Trainings, LVS) at the unit level.

**Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage vendors and ensure formal execution of agreements with DC owners, CFAs and Carriers.
* Trigger transport events on a real-time basis and ensure timely issuance of detention certificates.
* Maintain strong P2P process compliance.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* MBA / PGDM from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institution (full-time).
* 2 – 5 years of relevant post-MBA experience in Logistics, Warehousing, Transportation or Distribution within FMCG / Consumer / Supply Chain-intensive industries.
* Mandatory experience in managing Warehousing Operations and Transportation Management.
* Strong experience in team management, stakeholder engagement, coordination with Sales and Order-to-Cash (O2C) teams, and end-to-end execution ownership.
* Exposure to transformation and automation projects in supply chain / logistics.
* Working knowledge of SAP, WMS, TMS and digital logistics tools (e.g., Transporeon, In-Transit Visibility).
* Understanding of the FMCG value chain, freight market trends, and transport costing (fixed vs. variable)
* Knowledge of the local language of the region is an added advantage.

title: Senior Associate - Organizational Change Management
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a Senior Associate - Organizational Change Management, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize their organizational structures and processes to enhance efficiency and effectiveness. Within our Management Consulting practice, you will focus on aligning organizational structures with strategic goals, driving long-term success for our clients. As a Senior Associate, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems, mentor junior team members, and maintain professional standards. You will build meaningful client relationships and develop a deeper understanding of the business context, navigating complex situations to grow your personal brand and deepen your technical skills.
  
  
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will deliver tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth. You will collaborate with subject matter experts to deliver training needs analysis, curriculum design, and blended training solutions, using industry-standard tools to create engaging learning assets. Your ability to adapt to changing priorities and work across time zones will validate seamless project execution and client satisfaction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Designing and implementing learning solutions to support client transformation initiatives
* Collaborating with Subject Matter Experts to conduct Training Needs Analysis and develop curriculum
* Utilizing instructional design frameworks such as ADDIE and SAM to create engaging learning experiences
* Developing role-based learning plans and blended training solutions tailored to client needs
* Leveraging industry-standard authoring tools like Articulate Storyline and Adobe Captivate to create multimedia learning assets
* Publishing and managing content on Learning Management Systems, confirming accessibility standards are met
* Evaluating learning program effectiveness using Kirkpatrick Levels 1-3 and refining based on feedback
* Supporting engagement delivery through phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation
* Facilitating workshops and presentations using various collaboration tools
* Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members to enhance their development
* Staying informed on the latest trends in learning and development to contribute to internal initiatives
* Developing and presenting innovative ideas and solutions to clients and stakeholders
* Building and maintaining client relationships to support organizational change management efforts
* Analyzing business operations and ERP solutions to align learning strategies with organizational goals

What You Must Have
  
  

* 4-8 years of prior relevant experience in consulting
* Master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Education (M.Ed.), Communications, HR, Organizational Development or Psychology.
* Certification in Instructional Design or Learning Experience Design (e.g., ATD/CPTD, Articulate, or an equivalent recognized ID credential) is required, while PROSCI or other Change Management certifications are preferred and considered an added advantage.
* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.
* Will to work in a fast-paced environment with sometimes unpredictable circumstances or changes, comfortable working in ambiguity.
* Demonstrating proficiency in AI tools for workforce solutions
* Utilizing analytical thinking to assess training effectiveness
* Collaborating with engagement managers to address client needs
* Exhibiting ability to work independently and in teams
* Supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring juniors
* Leveraging AI-human collaboration for enhanced productivity

title: SAP FI-Manager
description:

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

EY Consulting is a fast-moving, high-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency - Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk & Assurance. * Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators.
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the manager/lead

* You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements independently (Mandatory skill)

* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
* Follow up on the action items from the workshops
* Experience on FIORI APPS, BO-DS, BW, HANA and other reporting tools.
* Prior client facing consulting experience.
* SAP Finance/Controlling Certification is a plus

**What We Look For**

* Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / ICMA/ MBA Finance in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience with 7 to 10 years in SAP FI.
* Experience of having worked in an onsite- offshore delivery model
* Experience with leading business blueprint, gathering and documenting business requirements and designing SAP enabled solutions
* Development of project documentation including business process flows, training materials, requirements gathering and project management methodology experience required
* Experience should be in End-to-end Implementation, Rollout, Support, upgrade, enhancements in the below areas.

+ SAP Finance – FI- Organization structure, New General Ledger, FI-Accounts Payable, FI-Accounts Receivable, FI-Bank accounting and FI-Asset Accounting.
+ SAP Finance – Taxation and Withholding Taxes.
+ SAP Finance – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions & Reporting.
+ Controlling- CO-Cost Center Accounting, CO-Profit Center Accounting and CO-Internal Orders.
+ Knowledge and Hands on experience in CO-Profitability Analysis & Product Costing (Planning and cost object controlling) and Material Ledger Actual Costing.
+ FI integration with MM, SD, PP & PS.
+ Excellent business communication skills

title: Creative / Design Head
description:

Kass • Full-Time Opportunity • Kolkata

**Role :**
Creative / Design Head

**Location :**
Kolkata (Work From Office)

**Experience & Availability :**
2–3+ Years • Immediate to 30 Days

**About Kass**

Kass is a premium D2C skincare brand built around
**Bio-Intelligent Skincare -**
thoughtfully formulated solutions designed to address skin concerns at their foundation and support long-term skin health.Building a premium brand goes far beyond creating pretty graphics. It requires a distinctive visual language, a cohesive brand ecosystem, and high-velocity operational pipelines that consistently deliver theatrical-grade assets. We are looking for a
**Creative/Design Head**
who understands how modern, premium D2C brands operate, commands the production floor, and knows how to lead a multidisciplinary creative department to drive tangible brand scale.

**The Role**

As the
**Creative/Design Head**
, you will own Kass’s entire visual and creative direction across all touchpoints - digital performance campaigns, brand films, 3D simulations, physical packaging, and retail presence.You will lead, mentor, and direct a high-output multidisciplinary team (video editors, 3D motion artists and graphic designers), acting as the ultimate strategic and aesthetic filter for the brand. Beyond creative leadership, you will build and optimize the operational pipelines and automations that allow the team to scale output without sacrificing a premium, "million-dollar" brand finish.

**Key Responsibilities1. Creative Direction & Brand Architecture**

* **Define, protect, and evolve**
  Kass’s overall visual identity and brand guidelines across digital, physical packaging, e-commerce, and offline touchpoints.
* **Translate complex, clinical, and bio-intelligent formulations**
  into sophisticated, scroll-stopping narratives and high-converting visual assets.
* Ensure every frame, static, and render meets an uncompromising, premium aesthetic standard.

**2. Multidisciplinary Team Leadership**

* **Direct, mentor, and maintain rigorous quality control**
  over a high-output creative floor comprising Video Editors, Graphic Designers and 3D Motion Artists.
* **Act as the primary strategic filter**
  for all campaigns—reviewing daily cuts, static creatives, narrative hooks, and 3D explainers to eliminate friction before deployment.
* **Plan, delegate, and manage project workflows**
  based on priorities, launch timelines, and individual strengths, fostering a culture of ownership and execution speed.

**3. Production & On-Set Command**

* **Bridge practical filmmaking with digital post-production**
  —lead on-set shoots, direct macro camera setups and lighting, and establish a rich, organic visual vocabulary for new product drops.
* **Supervise high-fidelity post-production**
  , including dynamic motion tracking, kinetic typography, and seamless 3D/CGI product integration.
* **Lead the production**
  of both top-of-funnel cinematic brand films and rapid-iteration performance creatives (Reels, Meta ads, short-form video).

**4. Pipeline Architecture & Workflow Optimization**

* **Build, maintain, and streamline**
  the department’s operational backbone, designing organizational systems and workflows that eliminate creative bottlenecks.
* **Integrate modern automation tools**
  , node-based workflows, and emerging AI technologies into daily production to exponentially scale asset variations and multiply team efficiency.
* **Collaborate closely**
  with Marketing, Performance, Product, and Operations to translate commercial goals into actionable creative solutions with minimal turnaround time.

* **Proven Leadership:**
  Demonstrated track record leading, managing, and mentoring a multidisciplinary creative or design team in a high-velocity environment (D2C, agency, or high-growth consumer brand).
* **Aesthetic & Technical Mastery:**
  Advanced proficiency across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator) with strong working knowledge of 3D workflows, motion graphics, and emerging AI creative tools.

  Solid understanding of cinematography, lighting, framing, and macro product shooting.
* **Systems Thinker:**
  Someone who doesn’t just design, but builds scalable pipelines, templates, and automated workflows to elevate the entire department’s output.

  Deep intuition for modern consumer psychology, thumb-stopping hooks, retention pacing, and conversion-focused design.
* **Education:**

At Kass, creative production is not an afterthought—it is the central engine of our brand equity and customer acquisition. If you have the vision to shape a rapidly scaling skincare brand and the operational muscle to lead a high-performing creative floor, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Manager Purchase
description:

* Own the complete equipment build cycle: source individual parts, sub-assemblies, and heavy components from a global and domestic supplier base, coordinate inbound logistics, and support in-house assembly and trial runs.

* Ensure full compliance with corporate sourcing policies, internal approval workflows, ISO standards, and corporate procurement audits.

title: Partnerships & Activations Lead
description:
**Job Title: Partnerships & Activations Lead**

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, work from office, with local travel

**Preferred Experience:**
3–5 years in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, brand activations or business development

**About Sevora**

Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery in eligible locations. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a relationship-driven professional to build partnerships and deliver community activations that generate qualified leads, shopping appointments and sales.

You will develop a network across Kolkata’s residential communities, clubs, private social groups and complementary businesses. Working closely with Sales and the Personal Shopper, you will own partner acquisition, activation planning, execution, lead quality and cost efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partnerships & Community Development**

* Build relationships with community hosts, residential associations, premium clubs, women’s groups and event organisers.
* Establish referral partnerships with salons, beauty studios, wedding planners, makeup artists and complementary lifestyle businesses.
* Develop partnership proposals and negotiate participation fees, promotional support, collaboration terms and referral arrangements.
* Maintain an active partner pipeline and monthly activation calendar.
* Develop productive partnerships into recurring shopping events and referral opportunities.

**2. Lead Generation & Appointment Booking**

* Deliver monthly targets for qualified customer leads and shopping appointments.
* Generate enquiries through kitty parties, private gatherings, residential communities, clubs, curated exhibitions, professional networks and referrals.
* Prepare channel plans with target audiences, activities, budgets and expected outcomes.
* Capture shopping preferences, budget, occasion, buying timeline and location to support lead qualification.
* Develop customer and community-host referral programmes with approved incentives and clear tracking.

**3. Activations & Event Execution**

* Plan and execute private shopping sessions, styling events, collection previews, pop-ups and community activations.
* Evaluate opportunities based on audience fit, purchase intent, participation costs and sales potential.
* Own event logistics, including permissions, venue arrangements, setup, displays, staffing coordination and partner communication.
* Coordinate invitations, lookbooks, QR codes, registration forms and promotional materials with Marketing and Creative teams.
* Coordinate assortment, stock availability, product movement and reconciliation with Merchandising and Operations.
* Work with Sales and the Personal Shopper to deliver shopping assistance and introduce eligible customers to Try at Home.
* Manage approved budgets and maintain records of expenses and partner commitments.

**4. Lead Handover & Sales Coordination**

* Capture accurate customer details and permission for follow-up.
* Record lead source, preferences, interest level and next action in the CRM.
* Hand over leads promptly to Sales with clear ownership and follow-up expectations.
* Review appointment attendance, follow-up progress, purchases and reasons for lost sales.
* Coordinate post-event follow-ups with Sales and retention campaigns with CRM.
* Use customer and sales feedback to improve future activations.

**5. Performance & Reporting**

* Report weekly on partner outreach, confirmed activities, qualified leads, appointments, costs and attributable sales.
* Track performance by partner, event and referral source using CRM tags, QR links or referral codes.
* Monitor cost per qualified lead, cost per purchasing customer and sales after cancellations and returns.
* Assess activation profitability with Finance using product margins and relevant costs.
* Recommend which partnerships and activities to expand, improve or discontinue.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Relevant experience in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, activations or business development.
* Strong networking, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills.
* Experience generating customer leads and delivering measurable commercial outcomes.
* Ability to manage activities independently, from outreach and planning to execution and reporting.
* Understanding of budgets, lead qualification, conversion and customer acquisition costs.
* Clear communication in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, presentations, WhatsApp Business and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled evening or weekend events.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in fashion, premium retail, beauty, hospitality or lifestyle services. Existing relationships with Kolkata communities, clubs, residential associations and relevant businesses will be an advantage.

10+ Years

Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) from a recognized university.
  
  
**Location:**
Railway Project Site
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Senior QS & Billing Expert will be responsible for quantity surveying, measurement, billing, cost monitoring, contract administration, and commercial management of railway civil infrastructure works, ensuring accurate billing and compliance with contract conditions, specifications, and project requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Review and verify contractor measurements, RA bills, final bills, and supporting documents.
* Prepare and check detailed quantities, BOQs, rate analysis, and cost estimates for civil and railway infrastructure works.
* Monitor quantities executed at site and reconcile them with approved drawings, BOQ, and contract provisions.
* Conduct joint measurements with contractors and site teams and maintain accurate measurement records.
* Review variation claims, extra items, deviation statements, and rate analysis for additional works.
* Monitor project costs, quantities, and expenditure against the approved budget and contract value.
* Assist in contract administration, including interpretation of BOQ, specifications, payment terms, and contractual provisions.
* Review contractor submissions related to claims, extensions of time, escalation, and other commercial matters.
* Coordinate with engineering, planning, construction, and project management teams for timely resolution of billing and quantity-related issues.
* Maintain records of measurements, bills, variations, quantities, and commercial correspondence.
* Prepare monthly commercial reports, cost statements, quantity reconciliation, and billing status reports.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, contract conditions, Indian Railways/RDSO requirements, and applicable standards.
* Support the Project Manager in commercial and contractual matters related to railway civil works.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Quantity Surveying, billing, measurement, BOQ, rate analysis, and cost control.
* Good understanding of civil construction contracts and contract administration.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, AutoCAD, and quantity/billing software.
* Ability to independently verify contractor bills and assess quantities at site.
* Strong analytical, numerical, documentation, and reporting skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills with contractors and project stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary project environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in Quantity Surveying, Billing, Cost Control, or Commercial Management.
* Experience in railway/metro infrastructure projects will be preferred.
* Experience in civil works such as railway formation, earthwork, bridges, culverts, stations, drainage, and other infrastructure works.
* Experience in EPC/Item Rate/Construction Contracts, contractor billing, variations, claims, and final account settlement.
* Knowledge of Indian Railways, RDSO, Metro Rail standards, SOR/DSR, and railway contract procedures will be an advantage.

Key Deliverables
  
  

* Accurate and timely verification of contractor bills and measurements.
* Effective monitoring and reconciliation of quantities and project costs.
* Proper assessment and documentation of variations, claims, and additional works.
* Timely commercial and billing reports for project management.
* Compliance with contractual, technical, and financial requirements.
* Effective support to project management in QS, billing, and contract administration matters.

title: Operations Specialist (Deployment)
description:
**Operations Specialist (Deployment)**

**Location:**
Gandhinagar, Gujarat

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and highly organized
**Operations Specialist (Deployment)**
to lead end-to-end deployment operations across client locations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for planning and executing deployments, coordinating with malls and commercial properties, managing operational documentation, ensuring SOP compliance, and resolving on-ground challenges.

This role requires an individual who can take ownership of field operations, make quick decisions under pressure, and effectively coordinate with internal teams, logistics partners, clients, and mall authorities to ensure smooth and timely deployments.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Deployment Planning & Execution**

* Plan, coordinate, and execute deployments across multiple client locations.
* Ensure timely movement, installation, commissioning, and handover of robots/equipment.
* Coordinate with internal teams, logistics partners, and site representatives to meet deployment timelines.
* Monitor deployment progress and proactively address execution challenges.

**2. Documentation & Compliance**

* Prepare, verify, and maintain all deployment-related documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of deployed assets, inventory movement, and deployment status.
* Ensure all documentation is complete, compliant, and audit ready.

**3. Mall & Client Coordination**

* Act as the primary point of contact for malls and commercial properties during deployment.
* Coordinate with mall management for:
* Work permits
* Access permissions
* Vendor registrations
* Safety documentation
* Deployment scheduling
* Follow up with stakeholders to ensure all approvals are received before deployment.
* Maintain professional relationships with clients, facility teams, and mall authorities.

**4. SOP & Operational Excellence**

* Execute deployments strictly in accordance with company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and operational standards.
* Identify opportunities to improve deployment efficiency and operational processes.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by documenting best practices and lessons learned.

**5. Problem Solving & Decision Making**

* Identify deployment bottlenecks and operational risks before they impact execution.
* Make timely and effective decisions during critical on-site situations.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve logistics, technical, or documentation issues.
* Escalate critical concerns with clear analysis and practical recommendations.

**6. Reporting & Operational Tracking**

* Maintain daily deployment reports, deployment trackers, and status updates.
* Track inventory movement, deployment milestones, and pending activities.
* Prepare deployment summaries and post-deployment reports for management review.
* Ensure timely communication of project status, risks, and completion of updates to stakeholders.

**7. Travel & Field Operations**

* Travel extensively across India for deployment, commissioning, maintenance support, and operational activities.
* Represent the company professionally at client sites and commercial locations.
* Ensure smooth coordination between headquarters and on-site teams.

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline (
  **Mandatory**
  )
* MBA in Operations or Supply Chain Management (
  **Preferred**
  )

**Experience**

* 2–3 years of experience in:
* Operations
* Deployment
* Field Execution
* Logistics
* Project Coordination
* Supply Chain Operations

**Required Skills**

**Technical & Operational**

* Strong understanding of deployment operations and field execution.
* Experience with operational documentation (E-Way Bills, Challans, Delivery Notes, Asset Transfers, etc.).
* Inventory tracking and asset management.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, and reporting tools.
* Experience with ERP or inventory management systems is an added advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Strong coordination and multitasking abilities.
* Exceptional problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to work independently with a high sense of ownership.
* Strong planning, organizational, and time management skills.
* Ability to perform effectively under tight deadlines and changing priorities.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who:

* Takes complete ownership of deployment activities from planning to completion.
* Is comfortable travelling frequently across India.
* Can manage multiple deployment projects simultaneously.
* Maintains high standards of documentation and operational discipline.
* Demonstrates strong leadership during on-ground execution.
* Builds positive relationships with clients, vendors, and mall authorities.
* Is proactive, adaptable, and solution oriented.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge robotics deployments across India.
* High ownership role with significant decision-making responsibility.
* Exposure of large-scale commercial projects and premium retail environments.
* Fast-paced work environment with opportunities for professional growth.
* Collaborative and innovation-driven culture.

title: Manager - Process Excellence & Cost Optimization
description:
**Job Purpose**
This role controls plant cost and material loss and improves workforce productivity. It does this through standard measurement systems (BOM, cost per sq ft, manpower matrices) and shop-floor automation such as production scanning, smart scheduling and live dashboards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cost and Financial Control**

* Track monthly plant cost per sq ft against budget, and analyse and explain variances.
* Reconcile BB and COV material consumption and wastage against BOM, keeping variance within 1%.
* Build and maintain a BOM-based tracking system for general consumables, with cost variance within 5%.
* Reconcile and approve job-worker bills within the agreed billing cycle, with no delays.

**Automation and Digital Tracking**

* Implement operator-wise and team-wise production scanning (barcode for COV, QR code for BB) to measure throughput and reduce manpower cost by 10% YoY.
* Drive smart production scheduling and order-kit allocation to improve direct-worker efficiency by 20%.
* Develop an AI / Power BI tracker for media-wise material inflow versus wastage, with full traceability and variance under 1%.
* Maintain daily plant and department dashboards comparing budget and actual cost trends.

**Waste Management and Manpower Productivity**

* Develop at least two alternate or backup buyers for each saleable scrap item or category, targeting a 15% impact on sale value.
* Optimise waste disposal, including balers for cardboard, plastic and fabric, to cut waste volume by 30%.
* Build a manpower performance measurement matrix for non-sq-ft production and non-production departments.
* Support the skill matrix and skill-based operator allocation, and train supervisors and operators in method and productivity improvement (10 people per department).

**General Duties**

* Conduct time and motion studies, set standard times, and balance lines.
* Prepare monthly MIS and variance reports for management.
* Coordinate with production, stores, finance, IT and vendors.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen and 5S initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering. An MBA or PGDIE is preferred.
* 8–12 years in manufacturing industrial engineering, costing or productivity, including at least 3 years leading projects or a team.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong in BOM and inventory reconciliation, cost analysis, time study and production scheduling.
* Skilled in advanced Excel and Power BI, with exposure to ERP/MES and barcode or QR systems. AI or analytics knowledge is a plus.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable presenting data to senior management.
* Able to work across departments and train shop-floor teams.

title: Manager / Sr. Manager – Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**

RightWalk's work in Gujarat depends on how well we are trusted by the government system, industry, donors, NGOs and communities on the ground. This role owns that trust. The Manager – Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships is the person who ensures RightWalk's PMU is seen by government counterparts, establishments, industry and civil society as a credible, dependable, high-integrity partner — not just a project vendor.

This is a high-ownership role, not a coordination or liaison function. The person is fully accountable for the stakeholder ecosystem that determines whether RightWalk's programs in Gujarat land with government buy-in, industry participation, and community trust — expected to originate strategy, make independent judgment calls on engagement, and drive outcomes rather than simply execute instructions. Reporting to the PMU Head – Gujarat, this role owns the connective layer between the PMU's program delivery and the external ecosystem it depends on.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Stakeholder Relationship Ownership**

* Own and build strong working relationships with government departments, establishments & industry, donors, NGOs, and community groups across Gujarat.
* Own all external stakeholder communication on behalf of the PMU — timely, professional, and consistent, without needing to be directed.
* Represent RightWalk at government meetings, industry forums, and community events, building and personally standing behind the organisation's credibility.
* Independently identify, pursue and close opportunities for collaboration and strategic partnerships that strengthen program impact.

**2. Engagement Strategy, Planning & Execution**

* Own the design, implementation and monitoring of the Gujarat stakeholder engagement strategy, aligned with the PMU's program priorities.
* Own and maintain a live stakeholder map and engagement tracker — who matters, why, and what the relationship status is — as a single source of truth for the PMU.
* Take end-to-end ownership of workshops, roundtables and forums — agenda setting, logistics, and follow-through — ensuring each engagement delivers a clear outcome.
* Ensure engagement is inclusive and sustained, not transactional — built for long-term trust rather than one-off wins.

**3. Advisory & Internal Collaboration**

* Advise the PMU Head – Gujarat, Project Managers, and the Steering Committee on engagement strategy, and take the lead on flagging stakeholder risks early.
* Own the briefing of internal teams ahead of stakeholder meetings, translating stakeholder context into actionable guidance.
* Anticipate stakeholder concerns and potential friction points, and take the initiative to resolve them before they become the PMU's problem.

**4. Reporting & Documentation**

* Own the inputs for weekly and monthly reports to the Project Board, government counterparts, establishments/industry, and donors.
* Maintain a clear, auditable record of all stakeholder interactions, and be personally accountable for its accuracy.
* Define and own engagement effectiveness metrics, and use them to sharpen the approach over time.
* Own the preparation of reports, decks and briefing material for stakeholders and leadership.

**5. Partnership Development & Resource Mobilisation**

* Own the identification and cultivation of new partnerships with donors, industry, NGOs and government programs in Gujarat, driving them from first conversation to agreement.
* Take the lead on resource mobilisation efforts that strengthen the PMU's delivery capacity, working the relationship rather than waiting to be asked.
* Co-create programs and initiatives with partners in line with RightWalk's organisational goals.
* Continuously and independently scout for opportunities that expand RightWalk's visibility and credibility in the state.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE — YEAR 1**

* A live, accurate stakeholder map exists for Gujarat, covering government, industry, donor and NGO relationships, with clear ownership and engagement status.
* RightWalk is a known, trusted name among key government counterparts and industry stakeholders relevant to the PMU's mandate.
* At least one new partnership or resource-mobilisation opportunity is identified and progressed with a donor, industry or government body.
* Stakeholder engagement plans are running on a predictable cadence — not ad hoc — with documented outcomes from each major forum or workshop.

**WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT DO**

* Program design or delivery — this role enables delivery through relationships, it does not run the program itself.
* Strategic communications, media relations or public narrative — that sits with the Strategic Communications function.
* Overall donor strategy or fundraising targets — this role owns partnership cultivation and resource-mobilisation opportunities in Gujarat, not the organisation's fundraising strategy.

**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Experience: 4–7 years in stakeholder engagement, partnerships, or institutional relations within the development sector.
* Results-driven and proactive, comfortable managing multiple stakeholders and workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong interpersonal, networking and people-management skills, with the ability to engage credibly across government, industry and community groups.
* Confident working independently, able to anticipate challenges, and deliver quality work under tight timelines.
* Professional or working proficiency in Gujarati is required for effective engagement with state-level stakeholders and communities.
* Motivated by social justice, equity and systemic change, and energised by fast-paced, impact-driven environments.

**Core Values We Expect You to Embody**

* Integrity & Ethics: Do what's right, always.
* Ownership & Excellence: Take full charge, no excuses.
* Resilience & Audacity: Be fearless, even when it's hard.
* Empathy & End-User First: Listen, understand, and design what matters most.
* Helicopter Mindset: Zoom out to think big, zoom in to deliver relentlessly.

About Elimai.ai

Elimai.ai is an AI-native enterprise technology company building intelligent AI agents for the fashion and apparel industry.

Our platform helps apparel manufacturers and exporters streamline product development, sampling, costing, pre-production approvals, and merchandising workflows. By automating email processing, technical document interpretation, approval tracking, and manual Excel updates, we help teams improve productivity, reduce errors, and gain real-time operational visibility.

We are now expanding our solutions to support fashion brands, buying offices, and sourcing organizations, enabling seamless collaboration across the fashion supply chain.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Apparel Product Development & Merchandising Domain Specialist**
with strong knowledge of garment product development, sourcing, technical merchandising, and brand-side operations.

This is a domain expertise and product development role, not a conventional merchandising execution position. The selected candidate will work closely with our product, AI, and engineering teams to translate real-world apparel industry workflows into intelligent software solutions.

We are looking for someone who understands not only
**what merchandisers do, but why they do it, how decisions are made, and where existing processes can be improved.**

Why Join Elimai.ai?

* Contribute directly to AI products built specifically for the apparel industry.
* Work closely with product leaders and AI engineering teams.
* Apply real-world merchandising experience to solve industry-wide operational challenges.
* Help shape technology for fashion brands, sourcing offices, and manufacturers.
* Play a meaningful role in transforming traditional fashion supply chain workflows through AI.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Apparel Industry Domain Expertise**

* Provide practical domain knowledge across product development, merchandising, sourcing, sampling, costing, and pre-production activities.
* Explain end-to-end workflows followed by fashion brands, buying offices, and apparel manufacturers.

* Document industry terminology, business processes, approval requirements, and operational challenges.

**2. Brand-Side Sourcing & Merchandising Workflows**

* Participate in product discussions, demonstrations, and feedback sessions with apparel manufacturers, buying offices, and brands.

* Work with internal teams to prioritize features based on business value and user needs.
* Support the development of relevant industry use cases and product demonstrations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **Strong practical experience in apparel product development, technical merchandising, sourcing, or buying-office operations.**
* **Good understanding of end-to-end garment development, from initial design brief to bulk production approval.**
* Ability to read and interpret tech packs, BOMs, measurement charts, specifications, and technical comments.
* **Familiarity with brand-to-vendor communication, development calendars, and production handoff processes.**
* Experience working with merchandising trackers, Excel-based WIP reports, and product development documentation.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate complex garment industry processes clearly to non-fashion professionals, including software engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience with a fashion brand, buying office, sourcing organization, or global apparel exporter.
* Experience coordinating product development across multiple factories or suppliers.
* Familiarity with PLM, ERP, or other apparel industry software platforms.
* Experience creating SOPs, process maps, training materials, or workflow documentation.
* Prior involvement in software implementation, process digitization, or automation projects is an advantage.

*Prior AI or software development experience is not mandatory. Strong apparel industry knowledge and the ability to explain business workflows are more important.*

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

* Help Elimai.ai develop a comprehensive understanding of brand-side and manufacturer-side merchandising workflows.
* Translate real-world apparel processes into clear, actionable requirements for AI product development.
* Improve the accuracy and practicality of Elimai's AI-powered merchandising solutions.
* Identify high-value opportunities to automate repetitive work while retaining essential human decision-making.
* Help build products that apparel brands, buying offices, and manufacturers can confidently use in their daily operations.

title: Manager - Tax – Internal Tax Operations
description:
**Position Profile**
Weaver is looking for talented tax manager to join our growing firm! The Internal Tax Operations team supports the tax-related activity of Weaver and its partners. This includes the firm’s partnership return, state and international tax compliance, and individual partner tax returns.
  
  
The tax manager will primarily support the tax compliance process for Weaver partners, including oversight of return preparation, technical review, and workflow management. This role will also assist with firm-level tax compliance activities and collaborate closely with U.S.-based tax professionals to ensure timely delivery and high-quality service.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  

* Partner Tax Compliance Leadership

+ Manage end-to-end tax compliance process for Weaver partner individual tax returns.
+ Supervise, mentor, and develop associates and senior associates supporting the partner tax compliance process
+ Coordinate workflow between US teams and India-based tax professionals.
+ Monitor project status, budgets, workloads and deadlines to ensure timely delivery during busy season.

* Technical Review

+ Perform first-level technical review of complex federal and state individual income tax returns prepared by associates and senior associates.
+ Identify technical issues and provide guidance to team members regarding federal and state tax matters.

* Internal Tax Operations Support

+ Review reports, schedules, and supporting workpapers for the firm’s partnership, state, and other tax filings.
+ Assist with special projects and process improvement initiatives related to Internal Tax Operations.

* Seasonal Client Service Support

+ During non-peak partner compliance periods, assist the Private Client Services teams serving high-net-worth individual clients.

**To be successful in this role, the following qualifications are required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting or related field
* CPA with 5+ years of experience in federal tax compliance, planning and consulting at a public accounting firm with a focus on high-net-worth individuals, partnerships, and closely held businesses
* Experience reviewing complex Forms 1040 returns, partnership and flow-through reporting, and supervising tax compliance workflows within a public accounting environment
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across global teams

**Additionally, The Following Qualifications Are Preferred**

* Master’s degree in accounting or related field
* Experience with multi-state tax compliance
* Proven ability to manage, mentor and develop staff
* Experience working with US-based public accounting firms in a global delivery environment

title: Principal Engineer Software
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Job Summary
  
  
As a Principal Engineer in our Identity Security division, you will be the ultimate technical authority and go-to expert for our core Single Sign-On (SSO) and Federation capabilities. You will own the architectural integrity, security posture, and scalability of our SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect (OIDC) implementations. In this role, you will balance deep technical execution with organizational leadership—driving best practices across microservices, mentoring engineering teams, representing our identity expertise externally, and pioneering the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to advance our identity security capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Write clean, highly secure, and performance-optimized code for critical authentication paths and build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) to evaluate new architectures.
* Architect resilient, low-latency microservices capable of handling millions of token validations, federation requests, and authentication flows globally.
* Drive engineering modernizations, including upgrading backend frameworks, implementing secure CI/CD pipelines, and integrating advanced security analysis tools.
* Lead root-cause analysis and resolution of critical bugs involving multi-tenant SSO setups, token encryption/signing, and token lifecycles.
* Partner with data science teams to integrate AI/ML models into authentication flows for real-time risk scoring and anomalous token behavior detection.
* Advocate for and embed generative AI development tools into the team's daily workflows to safely accelerate delivery and improve code quality.
* Lead large-scale features, protocol refactors, and microservice optimizations, ensuring alignment with the company’s Tech Radar and security baselines.
* Identify architectural gaps in SSO services, advocate for improvements, and implement robust solutions.
* Conduct rigorous reviews of complex protocol implementations and cryptographic designs to ensure strict adherence to RFC standards.
* Proactively identify and resolve cross-team technical dependencies for seamless integration.
* Teach, guide, and upskill developers, fostering a culture of deep identity security awareness.
* Represent the company in the cybersecurity industry by speaking at tech conferences, writing technical blogs, or contributing to open-source identity standards.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record in a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer role.
* The candidate should have experience in at least one of the following programming languages: C#/.NET OR Java OR Python .The candidate should be willing to work with the C#/.NET technology stack.
* Exposure or strong interest in applying AI/ML technologies within cybersecurity contexts.
* Strong background in modern cloud-native architectures, distributed microservices, and secure-by-design engineering principles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven experience in public speaking, technical writing (blogs/whitepapers), or mentoring engineering communities.
* Broad understanding of the business context, connecting technical decisions to customer value.
* Ability to translate highly complex technical concepts for both engineering and business stakeholders.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with Identity and Access Management (IAM) architectures, specifically building and securing SAML 2.0 Identity/Service Providers and OAuth 2.0/OIDC Authorization Servers.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Sr. Engagement Manager, Professional Services, AWSI
description:
