AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise-level customers.
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re-designing software development processes to become AI-native end-to-end (“AI-DLC”). This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands-on transformation leadership.

We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities

Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Enterprise Automation
description:
As a Senior Engineering Manager in the Revenue Platform Automation division, you’ll lead the engineering efforts driving our Sales, Customer Success (CS), and Finance technology stack. You’ll ensure seamless integration and optimal performance across these platforms, with a strong focus on backend and data-driven solutions. Collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, you’ll play a critical role in ensuring our systems are robust, integrated, and aligned with the company's strategic objectives. This role offers a unique opportunity to blend technical expertise with leadership skills, driving impactful change in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  
  
You will build and lead a team of talented engineers responsible for developing and maintaining automation solutions for our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technologies. You’ll train and mentor team members, identify and resolve impediments, oversee the integrity of software estimations, and ensure that code and tests meet high standards while keeping scalability, reliability, and maintainability in mind.
  
  
This is a backend-focused role, leveraging your strong background in Java, Python, workflow automation solutions (Workato), web services (REST/OpenAPI), messaging frameworks (Kafka), data platforms (Snowflake), cloud technologies (AWS/GCP), and containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) to build innovative solutions. You’ll use your strong knowledge of Sales, Customer Success, and Finance business domains and tools to build complete solutions in sales automation (Salesforce, Service Cloud), finance automation (ERP/billing/CPQ/payment), and customer insights (Catalyst/Gainsight). You’ll ensure your team masters their discrete business domains, maintaining ownership, and accountability for their deliverables. You will oversee the development of strong test automation suites, aligning with automated build & CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native delivery.
  
  
Your ability to collaborate with product management, provide leadership across multiple locations, set high standards for the team, and hire, train, and retain exceptional talent is foundational to your success. You’ll solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, inspire creative thinking, and help foster a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose.
  
  
Your responsibilities span across the Sales & Customer Success Platform and Finance Platform teams, each of which are cross-functional teams consisting of product management, product ownership, and engineers who are responsible for our core Revenue Technology stack. The Senior Engineering Manager oversees the engineers/testers on the teams, identifying and overseeing the solutions that meet internal customers’ needs.
  
  
**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and inspire a team of skilled engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability. Provide guidance and support to ensure team growth and success, empowering them with autonomy and ownership
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of automation solutions for our revenue platforms. Ensure the highest quality code with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Your back-end expertise allows you to dive into the codebase when needed, ensuring alignment with best practices
* Ensure that our Sales, Customer Success, and Finance systems, particularly those centered around Salesforce and its ecosystem, are robust, optimized, and seamlessly integrated
* Lead efforts to enhance system performance, drive innovation, and implement scalable solutions that align with the company’s strategic objectives
* Leverage your strong background in Java, Python, data platforms, workflow automation, software architecture, messaging frameworks, and cloud technologies to drive the technical direction of our revenue platforms. Ensure the adoption of best practices in automation, web services, test automation, and cloud-native delivery
* Work closely with Product Management, Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams to align engineering efforts with business goals. Translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies to drive impactful change
* Oversee the integrity of software estimations and ensure high standards of performance, reliability, and security in the systems developed by your team. Vigilantly identify and resolve impediments, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope
* Drive innovation within the revenue technology stack. Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes, tools, and systems, ensuring our technology remains at the cutting edge
* Play a key role in hiring, training, and retaining top engineering talent. Set a high bar for performance, create opportunities for professional growth, and cultivate an environment where team members feel valued and motivated
* Establish and drive a culture rooted in belonging, psychological safety, candor, connection, cooperation, and fun. Solicit feedback, engage with empathy, and build strong relationships across the organization to foster an environment where innovative ideas can thrive
* Apply Agile, Lean, and principles of fast flow to enhance team efficiency and productivity
* Model and encourage desired behaviors to support the company’s vision and values. Participate in various company initiatives and projects as requested

**Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering with deep experience in software integration and workflow automation, particularly in Sales, Customer Success, and Finance technology stacks
* 7+ years in an Engineering leadership role with direct management responsibilities of at least 3 people
* 7+ years of experience in hands-on coding and delivering services that are provided “as a service” to other teams as part of a large-scale distributed microservices architecture
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing and mentoring engineering teams
* Expert-level skills in Java, Python, and SQL
* Deep understanding of sales automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and related technologies, including ERP tools, payment automation, billing automation, and CPQ
* Experience with containerization technologies, including Kubernetes and Docker, and an understanding of how to build cloud-scale delivery, including scalability, resiliency, and recoverability
* Solid understanding of software development methodologies, Agile practices, and DevOps principles
* Excellent problem-solving skills with a focus on innovation, efficiency, and scalability
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage with stakeholders at all levels of the organization
* Experience in the financial industry or B2B platforms is a plus

**Working Conditions**
The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.
  
  
Morningstar is an equal opportunity employer
  
  
Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. title: Software Testing Engineer, Portfolio Management Group, Analyst
description:
**About This Role**
**About Global Fixed Income Team**
BlackRock’s active fixed income portfolio strategies stretch across a range of investment styles and segments of the fixed income universe. The breadth and depth of our platform puts us in a strong position to potentially deliver attractive returns in various market environments. With a focus on alpha generation and risk management, the team uses a top-down view from lead portfolio managers and bottom-up expertise from our sector specialists
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Software Testing Analyst to help deliver reliable web applications, APIs, data integrations, and AI-powered features. You will work closely with developers, business analysts, and stakeholders to define quality criteria, identify risks early, and assess whether features are ready for release.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Review requirements and define acceptance criteria, test plans, and regression scenarios.
* Assess AI-generated responses for relevance, factual support, consistency, and correct use of supporting sources.
* Validate data across application screens, APIs, databases, and generated outputs.
* Cover edge cases and failure scenarios, including invalid inputs, timeouts, interrupted requests, and access restrictions.
* Own defects from discovery through resolution: investigate issues, communicate their impact, and verify fixes.
* Build and maintain automated checks, reusable test data, and quality documentation.
* Communicate quality risks and provide clear recommendations on release readiness.

**Must know**

* Test-case design, manual testing, regression testing, and defect management.
* Programming in Python, Java, or a similar language, with the ability to write validation scripts.
* API testing, including HTTP, JSON, and response validation.
* SQL for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Test automation using a framework such as pytest, Selenium, or Playwright.
* SDLC, STLC, Git, and collaborative delivery practices.
* Structured problem-solving and clear communication.

**Good to know**

* Quality evaluation for AI applications, including prompt variations, unsupported claims, source grounding, and response quality.
* Large language model and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) concepts.
* CI/CD pipelines, application logs, and browser developer tools.
* Accessibility, performance, and security testing.

Relevant experience may come from professional work, internships, or substantial projects. We value someone who takes initiative and can drive quality from requirements through release.
  
  
**Education & Qualifications**

* 1-3 years of relevant work experience

**Problem-Solving**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

title: D&T Manager – Sites & Services
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
This senior role is a strategic engineering leader within the BTFE team, responsible for architecting, building, and overseeing scalable, secure, and maintainable digital products and services. The individual will lead delivery across the predominantly .NET-based BTFE technology ecosystem, while governing mobile application delivery through vendor partners and strengthening the team’s future cross-platform engineering capabilities.
  
  
With advanced expertise across multiple technologies, they will guide full lifecycle development—from technical planning and design to implementation, deployment, and ongoing optimization. They will mentor developers, lead design discussions, manage technical risks and debt, and collaborate cross-functionally to align solutions with business objectives. The role also includes ownership of production stability, vendor engineering quality, troubleshooting, performance tuning, security, and sustained technical excellence across web, API, backend, and mobile-integrated platforms.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Delivery Leadership & Execution**

* Leading delivery of complex BTFE products, platforms, and modules across internal teams and vendor partners with end-to-end accountability for scope, quality, release readiness, and delivery outcomes
* Owning production support strategy across BTFE platforms, including incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, service reliability, and continuous improvement for critical issues
* Driving stakeholder alignment through active participation in product discovery, requirement gathering, scope definition, technical planning, dependency management, and release planning
* Providing high-confidence estimates for large-scale efforts, advising on resourcing and partner capacity, and establishing delivery plans that balance near-term outcomes with long-term technical health

**Learning, Development & Mentoring**

* Championing a culture of continuous learning, introducing relevant emerging technologies, cross-platform frameworks, engineering practices, and AI-enabled ways of working
* Providing deep mentorship and technical guidance to mid- and junior-level engineers, while building capability across .NET, web/API, cloud, integration, and mobile engineering fundamentals
* Leading internal initiatives such as architecture reviews, engineering talks, vendor knowledge exchanges, and capability development programs
* Demonstrating strong leadership presence, strengthening team culture and practices, and creating an environment where people can do their best work and grow

**Technical Consulting & Strategy**

* Creating and validating high-level estimations, technology roadmaps, modernization plans, and investment cases for large, cross-functional BTFE efforts
* Designing and owning complex, scalable, secure, and resilient end-to-end solutions across .NET, APIs, cloud services, data stores, third-party integrations, and mobile experiences
* Serving as an advisor across BTFE product, business, operations, security, architecture, and vendor communities, aligning solutions with strategic goals and user needs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Independently defines and manages work plans for complex projects, driving alignment across teams and contributing to strategic project planning
* Has led multiple medium-to-large projects or delivered key enterprise-level components with full accountability for scope, quality, delivery outcomes, and production readiness
* Shapes and enforces IT technical standards, driving adoption of best practices and fostering engineering excellence across teams, vendors, and initiatives
* Possesses expert-level knowledge of enterprise architecture, system design patterns, distributed systems, and technical toolsets, applying them to architect resilient, scalable solutions
* Advanced experience with .NET Core, C#, ASP.NET Core/Web API, API integration, relational and NoSQL databases, cloud platforms, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and production support
* Credible cross-platform development experience with exposure to mobile application engineering, including mobile architecture, API integration, security, performance, telemetry, release lifecycle, and app-store delivery; hands-on experience with React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, .NET MAUI, or equivalent is expected.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Demonstrates the General Mills leadership behaviors required for success: energizes and inspires others; grows by deepening and sharing expertise; challenges with strategic courage; delivers impactful results across teams; and connects and aligns cross-functional efforts
  
  

* Experience with .NET MAUI, React Native, Flutter, Xamarin, or comparable cross-platform frameworks, with working knowledge of native iOS and/or Android engineering ecosystems
* Energizes and inspires others
* Grows by deepening and sharing expertise
* Challenges with strategic courage
* Delivers impactful results across teams
* Connects and aligns cross-functional efforts

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**About us:**

At PadCare, we’re on a mission to make hygiene sustainable. Founded in 2018, we have developed India’s first patented sanitary napkin recycling technology—PadCareX.

But we’re not just solving a waste problem, we’re building a circular economy that champions environmental resilience and social equity. Our service model closes the loop starting from collection, recycling, and transforming single-use sanitary napkins into sustainable materials, while also creating dignified jobs for marginalized waste workers, especially women, across the country.

With 100+ changemakers across 25+ cities, PadCare is driving real impact—for people and the planet. Recognized by Forbes, the World Economic Forum, and more, we believe business can be a force for good. If you do too, PadCare is where your purpose finds a home.

Oh, and you must have seen us on an episode of Shark Tank India, Season 2 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q0cmPtpJRo

To learn more about the work that PadCare is doing, check out the website: www.padcarelabs.com

**Role overview & Key Responsibilities:**

We are hiring a full-time Product Analyst to own modules of our internal Order-to-Cash platform, end to end, working directly with the Product Lead. The core of the role is building requirements: understanding the business process, identifying its gaps, and structuring it into a complete system module that accounts for every case, validation and dependency. You will also test what gets built and make sure the delivered solution matches what was defined.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Requirement building (core)

• Understand business workflows across Sales, Onboarding, Operations and Finance, and identify

process gaps and inefficiencies

• Structure each process into a system module with clear flows and flow charts

• Cover every scenario the module must handle (standard, exception and edge cases) before it

goes to development

• Define fields and data structures, validation rules, dependencies and conditions

• Own and maintain the functional specification for each assigned module

2. Testing and quality assurance

• Write and execute functional test cases for every release

• Run end-to-end workflow testing and user acceptance testing (UAT)

• Log, prioritise and re-test bugs through the periodic bug-fix cycles

3. Development partner coordination

• Work with the external development team on assigned modules

• Track tasks, follow-ups and requirement clarifications

• Ensure the delivered solution matches the defined requirement

4. Data checks for owned modules

• Validate data for the modules you own, including post-go-live accuracy checks

• Work alongside the data management team where module data is involved

**What we're looking for:**

**Must-have**

• 1–3 years in a product, business analyst or functional/QA role on software or ERP projects

• Hands-on experience writing functional specs or BRDs and test cases

• Experience working with development teams through build, testing and release

• Strong analytical and logical thinking; able to structure problems into clear workflows

• Basic understanding of APIs and system design: data flow, validations, logic layers

• Attention to detail and execution focus

• Clear communication across business and tech teams

**Good-to-have**

• Exposure to ERP tools, especially Zoho Books

• Familiarity with Order-to-Cash or billing processes

• Basic SQL

• Exposure to AI or automation use cases (document processing, workflow automation)

Tools you will use

• HTML (basic UI understanding)

• AI tools for productivity and documentation

• Excel and basic analytics tools

**Culture Fit:**
Must align with PadCare’s values – Integrity, Entrepreneurship, Collaboration, Customer-First, Innovation.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time; based in Pune.

**Why join us:**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive salary in line with industry standards.
* **Growth Path:**
  Opportunity to scale into Head of Research and beyond as PadCare expands globally.
* **Purpose With Impact:**
  Join a mission-driven team transforming menstrual hygiene through sustainable solutions that uplift women’s health, the environment, and sanitation workers' dignity.
* **Eco-Warrior in Action:**
  Help recycle millions of sanitary pads and actively reduce landfill waste and carbon emissions—real impact, not just buzzwords.
* **Innovation Meets Heart:**
  Be part of a team that blends empathy with patented 5D recycling tech to build the future of circular economy.
* **Grow With Us:**
  We’re a fast-gowing, venture-backed startup offering real opportunities to scale your career as we scale our impact.
* **A Culture That Cares:**
  Work in a space where collaboration, inclusivity, and purpose aren’t just values—they’re how we roll every day.

* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.

* Apex Development

* Salesforce Field Service

As part of our team, you'll help shape the future of enterprise data platforms, enable advanced analytics and AI innovation, and contribute to business-critical capabilities that impact millions of customers. If you're ready to bring your expertise, leadership, and passion for innovation to a team redefining entertainment technology, we'd love to have you join us on this journey.

title: Sr. Analyst, Implementation
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
**Role Summary — The Why Now**
As Avalara scales its Go Live function to support New Product Introductions (NPI) and enterprise-level customer growth, we need Senior Analysts who do more than execute — they lead, design, and elevate. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) operates at the intersection of complex enterprise implementation delivery, cross-functional product collaboration, and practice development.
  
  
Where the I3 Analyst owns individual customer implementation success, the I3 Senior Analyst owns the quality and scalability of how implementations are delivered — for the most complex customers, across new and evolving products, and in close partnership with Product Management, Sales, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  
  
This role exists to accelerate Avalara's ability to onboard enterprise customers at scale, introduce new products effectively, and continuously raise the implementation standard across the Go Live team. The I3 is a force multiplier: their impact is felt not just in their own portfolio, but in the capability and quality of the broader team.
  
  
How This Role Elevates Avalara
  
  

* For customers: Enterprise and multi-product customers receive expert implementation guidance, proactive risk management, and deep technical partnership — resulting in faster time-to-value and stronger long-term adoption.
* For the team: The Senior Analyst sets the implementation quality standard — authoring playbooks, mentoring I3 analysts, and identifying process improvements that raise team-wide performance.
* For the business: Directly supports ARR growth by enabling complex enterprise wins, supporting the sales cycle with pre-sales expertise, and accelerating NPI readiness across implementation teams.
* For our AI-first strategy: Designs and deploys AI-driven implementation workflows at a team level — moving beyond personal productivity to scalable automation that benefits the entire Go Live function.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**Enterprise & Multi-Product Implementation Leadership**

* Lead customer implementations involving multiple Avalara products and enterprise-level platforms including complex ERP, POS, and ecommerce environments (e.g., NetSuite, Dynamics 365, Salesforce Commerce, SAP).
* Act as the primary implementation authority for high-complexity, high-stakes customer engagements — setting strategy, managing scope, and driving outcomes from kickoff to Go Live.
* Clearly define, articulate, and manage scope of work for client-initiated implementation and data service projects, including change management when scope evolves.

**New Product Introduction (NPI) Enablement**

* Partner with Avalara Product Management, Sales, and Customer Success teams to develop implementation approach documentation, onboarding frameworks, and training materials for new product launches.
* Serve as a subject matter expert during NPI cycles — identifying implementation risks, documenting configuration requirements, and ensuring Go Live readiness before product release.
* Identify bugs, integration gaps, or UX friction during NPI implementations and partner with Engineering to track and resolve them.

**Practice Development & Quality Elevation**

* Own and evolve Go Live practice standards — documenting business processes, designing implementation playbooks, and proposing best practices for sales and use tax automation onboarding.
* Develop and document business requirements related to implementation workflows, data transformation, and cross-system reporting.
* Lead testing plan design and execution for complex implementations, ensuring customers go live on validated, stable configurations.
* Mentor and provide structured guidance to I2 Analysts — reviewing implementation quality, sharing expertise, and accelerating the development of junior team members.

**Cross-Functional Stakeholder Partnership**

* Collaborate with Sales and Account Management to support pre-sales activities — including scoping, solution design input, and customer-facing technical presentations.
* Engage cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Support, and Finance to resolve systemic implementation blockers and drive process improvements at scale.
* Represent the Go Live team's perspective in strategic planning discussions, NPI readiness reviews, and cross-departmental initiatives.

**Customer Success & Risk Management**

* Monitor project health across assigned accounts — proactively identifying risk factors, intervening early, and resolving escalations with speed and precision.
* Provide strategic guidance to customers on best practices and use cases across a range of business models and tax compliance needs.
* Support customers in developing and executing testing plans, ensuring technical readiness before Go Live.

**AI-Driven Practice Scaling**

* Design and deploy AI-powered workflows at a team level — building reusable Glean AI agents, prompt libraries, and automation tools that improve implementation quality and speed across the Go Live function.
* Share AI innovations, document their impact, and drive adoption across I2 and I3 peers.

**12-Month Success Signals**
A successful Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) at the end of 12 months will have:
  
  

* Led multiple enterprise or multi-product implementations to successful Go Live with measurably shorter cycle times and low escalation rates, demonstrating ownership at a higher complexity tier than I2.
* Delivered at least two NPI readiness contributions — documented implementation playbooks, training materials, or bug reports — that were formally adopted by the Go Live or Product teams.
* Authored or significantly improved at least two Go Live practice standards or playbooks, with measurable adoption and quality impact across the team.
* Mentored at least two I2 Analysts with demonstrable improvement in their implementation quality metrics or time-to-competency.
* Built and deployed at least one AI-powered workflow (e.g., a Glean agent, automation script, or prompt framework) that generated measurable time savings or quality improvements at a team level — not just personally.
* Supported at least one pre-sales engagement in partnership with the Sales or Account Management team, contributing to a customer expansion or new business outcome.

AI Expectations
  
  
Avalara is an AI-first company. The Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) is expected to operate as an AI Bar Raiser — not just embedding AI into their own work, but actively raising AI capability across the Go Live team.
  
  
**Specific Expectations Include**

* Design and build reusable AI tools — including Glean AI agents, automated documentation workflows, and AI-assisted risk detection models — that are shared and adopted across the team.
* Use AI to analyze implementation portfolio data at scale, identifying patterns in at-risk implementations, NPI friction points, or recurring ERP configuration issues, and translating insights into proactive action.
* Deploy AI to accelerate NPI documentation, training material generation, and business requirements capture — dramatically compressing the time from product release to team readiness.
* Use AI to support customer communication at scale — generating implementation status summaries, tailored onboarding guidance, and escalation documentation with speed and precision.
* Coach I2 Analysts on applied AI usage, sharing effective practices and helping peers move from casual familiarity to embedded, outcome-driven AI workflows.
* Apply AI responsibly and securely, in full compliance with Avalara's data governance and AI ethics policies.

Candidates must demonstrate specific, quantified examples of AI usage that improved team-level outcomes — not just personal efficiency. Senior Analysts who cannot clearly articulate their AI impact across a team or function do not meet Avalara's AI Bar Raiser standard for this level.
  
  
What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Required**
Bachelor’s in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline (BCA, MCA, B.Tech from an accredited institution). Open to hire from Commerce background given strong technical acumen or expertise of implementation.
  
  

* 4–7 years of software implementation or delivery experience, preferably within the B2B SaaS sector, with demonstrated progression in scope and complexity.
* Proven ability to lead complex, enterprise-level software implementations across multiple products and ERP/ecommerce environments.
* Strong ability to articulate process logic and technical architecture — including design and delivery of functional and technical presentations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of accounting and tax processes, including sales and use tax compliance automation concepts.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional conversations and drive alignment.
* Experience contributing to practice improvement — documenting business processes, designing best practices, or owning team-level standards.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset — takes initiative at a team level, holds peers accountable with coaching (not criticism), and drives outcomes without requiring direction.
* Embodies Avalara's Success Traits: Ownership, Simplicity, Curiosity, Adaptability, Urgency, Optimism, and Humility.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience configuring or integrating enterprise ERPs such as NetSuite, Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce Commerce, Sage, or WooCommerce.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Jira, or equivalent CRM and project tracking platforms.
* Prior exposure to tax automation software implementation or tax-related roles.
* Experience in NPI or product launch support — working alongside Product Management or Engineering to prepare implementation teams for new releases.
* Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and integration architecture concepts.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring or developing junior team members.

**Bar Raiser Expectation**
At Avalara, We Hire Only Those Who Raise The Bar — Not Those Who Merely Meet It. A Go Live Senior Analyst (I3) Who Is a Bar Raiser
  
  

* Improves the average performance of the team simply by being present — through coaching, example, and a consistent commitment to quality.
* Brings data, structure, and strategic thinking to conversations about risk, prioritization, process design, and escalation.
* Challenges assumptions respectfully and proposes better approaches — even when it's uncomfortable.
* Leaves every customer engagement, process, team interaction, and system in a measurably stronger state than they found it.
* Continuously develops technical, functional, and AI capabilities — and actively helps peers do the same.

* 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
* 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.

**About The Job**
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.
  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.
  
  
The AI and Infrastructure team works on the world’s toughest problems, redefining what’s possible and the possible easy. We empower Google customers by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Googler Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide. We’re at the center of amazing work at Google by being the “flywheel” that enables our advanced AI models, delivers computing power across global services, and offers platforms that developers use to build services.
  
  
In AI and Infrastructure, we shape the future of hyperscale computing by inventing and creating world-leading future technology, and drive global impact by contributing to Google infrastructure, from software to hardware (including building Vertex AI for Google Cloud). We work on complex technologies at a global scale with key players in the AI and systems space. Join a team of talented individuals who not only work together to keep data centers operating efficiently but also create a legacy of driving innovation by building some of the most complex systems technologies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams.
* Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching.
* Develop the mid-term technical vision and roadmap within the scope of your (often multiple) team(s). Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs.
* Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems.
* Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

title: UX ENGINEER
description:
Tejaki — by Blowtrumpet Technologies
  
  

* South Delhi
* Full-time / Intern / Early Career

**ABOUT Tejaki**
Tejaki is Blowtrumpet’s publisher-facing supply-side platform (SSP), built for content creators who want transparent monetisation. Tejaki runs on offers — not blind bids — so creators know what they are earning and why. It supports multiple content formats and fair revenue distribution. Tejaki is a product under Blowtrumpet Technologies.
  
  
THE ROLE
  
  
Build creator-first experiences — onboarding flows, earnings transparency, content upload pipelines, and monetisation controls that feel fair and empowering to publishers of every size.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Lead UX research — user interviews, usability testing, task analysis, and journey mapping
* Design user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes
* Build and iterate on front-end implementations based on usability data
* Define information architecture and navigation patterns across product surfaces
* Set up analytics and event tracking to measure user behaviour and task completion
* Advocate for the user in architecture and product decisions

**What We Are Looking For**

* Background in HCI, interaction design, or UX engineering
* Proficiency in React/Next.js — you prototype in code, not just in Figma
* Experience running usability studies and translating findings into design changes
* Understanding of accessibility, cognitive load, and information hierarchy
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable with analytics tools and A/B testing
* Portfolio showing UX-driven engineering work, not just visual design

EARLY CAREER & CAMPUS TALENT
  
  
We are actively inviting
**early-career graduates**
and
**final-year interns**
to consider long-term opportunities in innovation and establish stable careers with us in one of the most promising industry segments. If you are looking to create a ding in the universe, this may be your chance.
  
  
Blowtrumpet is not just offering a job — we are offering a seat at the table where the future of advertising technology is being designed. You will work with small, focused teams, learn from practitioners, ship real products, and grow into a career that compounds.
  
  
STATEMENT OF PURPOSE
  
  
Along with your application, please include a
**Statement of Purpose**
that covers:
  
  

* What interests you in advertising and technology — what drew you to this space?

WORKING AT BLOWTRUMPET
  
  
We function like a startup — and we are proud of it. That means you will wear multiple hats, take ownership beyond your title, and grow faster than you would in a larger organisation. We are looking for people who thrive on that kind of pace.
  
  
**A Few Things To Know Upfront**

* Multi-functional by design. Everyone here contributes across boundaries. If you see a gap, you fill it. If you can learn it, you own it.

title: Product Engineer - Software Reliability
description:
**Overview**
Esri is the world leader in geographic information systems (GIS) and developer of ArcGIS, the leading mapping and analytics software used in 75 percent of Fortune 500 companies. At Esri, we believe in helping our customers take on challenging geospatial problems and making a difference in the world. Join our team of talented and passionate engineers and help us build the next generation of ArcGIS Enterprise, a suite of products delivering state-of-the-art geospatial capability to thousands of our customers and millions of users worldwide. Our team builds cutting-edge, highly scalable, and reliable distributed software for on-premises and the cloud. We make maps, geographic information, and analyses available on any device, anywhere, at any time.
  
  
Software Reliability Engineers are responsible for ensuring that the ArcGIS Enterprise product is reliable, highly available, and has powerful disaster recovery features. They do this by gathering user requirements, defining them for the team, evaluating the product, and guiding users through documentation, videos, and presentations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support Esri's strong user-focus by gathering software reliability and availability requirements
* Collect requirements directly from users and indirectly from Esri staff in Support and Professional Services
* Collaborate and influence decisions within and across teams because reliability features and requirements cut across all functionalities
* Prioritize and guarantee software quality by creating test plans, automating those tests, evaluating the results, and ensuring that defects are acted upon
* Communicate effectively with our users through written documentation as well as presentations

**Requirements**

* 2-6 years in a position with operational responsibilities, such as monitoring, maintaining, and deploying enterprise software
* Experience in software testing
* Fundamental understanding of web services, such as REST
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills in a complex backend-server stack
* Effective communication skills and ability to work with cross-functional teams
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science and applications, math, GIS, geography, or related field
* Existing work authorization for India

**Recommended Qualifications**

* Master's degree in engineering, computer science and applications, math, GIS, geography, or related field
* Experience administering ArcGIS Enterprise
* Experience working directly on a software development team

**The Company**
At Esri, diversity is more than just a word on a map. When employees of different experiences, perspectives, backgrounds, and cultures come together, we are more innovative and ultimately a better place to work. We believe in having a diverse workforce that is unified under our mission of creating positive global change. We understand that diversity, equity, and inclusion is not a destination but an ongoing process. We are committed to the continuation of learning, growing, and changing our workplace so every employee can contribute to their life’s best work. Our commitment to these principles extends to the global communities we serve by creating positive change with GIS technology. title: Product Associate - Apprentice
description:
**Department:**
Product Management
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Apprentice
  
  
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Description**
**About the Program**
The Eptura Apprenticeship Program is designed to provide recent graduates and early-career professionals with meaningful, hands-on experience within a global SaaS organization. Throughout this 12-month program, apprentices will receive mentoring, structured learning opportunities, and exposure to commercial operations and sales processes.
  
  
**Eligibility**
**To Be Considered For This Apprenticeship, Candidates Must**

* Have completed a Bachelor's degree within the past two years, OR
* Be in the final year of their degree program and eligible for apprenticeship participation
* Have no more than two years of professional work experience
* Be legally eligible to participate in an apprenticeship program in India

**Shape the Future of Work with Eptura**
At Eptura, we're not just another tech company—we're a global leader transforming the way people, workplaces, and assets connect. Our innovative worktech solutions empower 25 million users across 115 countries to thrive in a digitally connected world. Trusted by 45% of Fortune 500 companies, we're redefining workplace innovation and driving success for organizations around the globe.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Product Associate, you will work directly within our Gurugram engineering team, helping to shepherd product enhancements and customer-reported issues through Eptura's AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC). You'll connect product priorities and engineering execution, keeping work organized, clearly specified, and moving forward on our Jira kanban boards.
  
  
This is a role for someone who is curious, organized, and eager to learn how great software products are built. You don't need prior experience in product management. You do need strong attention to detail, clear communication, demonstrated capabilities in using AI, and a genuine interest in how technology solves real-world problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage and maintain the Jira kanban board: keeping tickets well-organized, clearly described, and appropriately prioritized in collaboration with engineering leads.
* Help triage incoming product enhancement requests and customer-reported defects, gathering the context engineers need to act on them.
* Work with AI to write clear, structured user stories and acceptance criteria that translate business needs into actionable engineering tasks.
* Coordinate with engineers to track progress, surface blockers, and ensure items move efficiently through the AIDLC stages.
* Participate in requirement-gathering conversations with product managers and stakeholders, capturing key decisions and open questions.
* Assist in drafting functional specifications and supporting documentation for new or enhanced product features, also working with AI.
* Support basic testing activities: reviewing completed work against acceptance criteria and flagging discrepancies.
* Contribute to ongoing improvement of our AIDLC processes and team ways of working.

**About You**
We're looking for a motivated self-starter who is keen to build a career in product or technology. The following will set you up for success in this role:
  
  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English: you'll be writing tickets, specs, and summaries that engineers and stakeholders rely on.
* High attention to detail and a methodical approach to organizing information.
* Comfort working in a structured, process-driven environment: you like things to be clear, tracked, and accounted for.
* Curiosity about how software products are built and a willingness to ask questions.
* Familiarity with project or task management tools (Jira experience is a plus).
* A proactive mindset: you spot gaps, follow up, and take ownership of your work.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess AI outputs, identify limitations or risks, and recommend improvements to enhance product value.
* AI-related experience:
* Understanding of AI fundamentals, including large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, automation workflows, and responsible AI principles.
* Experience using AI tools to improve productivity: research, data analysis, content creation, or workflow automation, either through academic, personal, or professional projects. Ability to build and demonstrate an AI agent.
* Ability to evaluate Ai-driven product opportunities, gathering feedback and translating it into feature recommendations.

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to agile or kanban workflows (even in an academic or personal project context).
* Basic understanding of software development concepts: you don't need to code, but knowing what engineers do helps.
* Prior internship, project, or coursework related to business analysis, product management, or software delivery.

**Benefits**

* Monthly stipend
* Health Insurance fully paid – Self
* 13 Public Holidays
* Hyrid working policy
* Exposure to the latest trends and technologies in the SaaS industry.
* Mentorship from global experienced professionals in the sales, renewals and customer success fields.
* Potential for career advancement based on performance and dedication.

**Eptura Information**

* Follow us on Twitter | LinkedIn | Facebook | YouTube
* At Eptura, we believe strong teams are built through collaboration, flexibility, and a range of perspectives grounded in skill and experience. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work, contribute meaningfully, and grow alongside our business.

title: Senior QE Engineer
description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100,000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. **Position Description**
Senior QE Engineer
  
  
We’re looking for a
**Senior QE Engineer**
with deep expertise in automation and performance testing to help us deliver high-quality software at scale. In this role, you’ll serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on quality practices, design robust test strategies, and contribute to building scalable and reliable systems. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams in a CI/CD environment to drive automation, performance testing, and quality initiatives across the platform.
  
  
**Position Location**
Jaipur/Gurugram
  
  
**Reports To**
Manager QE
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* Own performance testing using JMeter or similar tools, identifying system bottlenecks and collaborating with engineering teams to optimize.
* Develop and maintain robust, scalable automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, Rest Assured).
* Contribute to test strategy, planning, execution, and reporting.
* Ensure E2E test coverage across UI, API and backend systems.
* Work closely with development teams to identify root causes and provide performance tuning suggestions.
* Identifies opportunities to adopt innovative testing technologies and techniques.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging testing tools and frameworks to improve test efficiency.

**With a Side Of (additional Skills)**

* Exposure to Big Data or AI/ML products.
* Understanding of security testing concepts (OWASP, DAST, SAST) is a plus.

**Unleash your potential: What you will be doing and owning:**

* 8+ years in quality engineering with strong focus on automation and performance testing.
* Strong knowledge of performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling).
* Experience with monitoring and profiling tools for performance monitoring.
* Strong in Java/Python/JavaScript based automation frameworks.
* Hands-on experience in CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
* Solid experience in test, functional testing, system integration testing, regression testing, GUI testing, API/web service testing, and browser compatibility testing
* Familiarity with test management tools like Zephyr
* Deep understanding of software quality best practices, shift-left testing, and test pyramid principles.

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

* Project/Product Management: Planning, Progress Monitoring and Status Reporting, including visualization of works; Scaling Agile – Organizing, synchronizing multiple teams setup Estimations, ROI, project lifecycle

Ability to facilitate dialogue at the right level of detail for all members of the Agile team

title: UX Design Architect
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
We are looking for an experienced Senior UX/UI Designer who combines exceptional hands-on design expertise with solid leadership capabilities. You will lead complex design initiatives while actively contributing to research, user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity interfaces, prototypes, and scalable design systems.
  
  
The ideal candidate has a proven track record of creating intuitive, engaging member experiences and transforming complex, large-scale data into clear, actionable interfaces. You will help shape product direction, raise design quality, mentor designers, and collaborate closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver measurable user and business outcomes.
  
  
This role also requires a forward-looking designer who responsibly applies AI-powered tools, automated workflows, and AI agents to accelerate design and delivery-while maintaining human judgment, data privacy, accessibility, and quality
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Hands-On Design Ownership: Lead end-to-end UX/UI design for complex digital products, from discovery and concept development through detailed interaction design, visual design, prototyping, and implementation review
* Design Leadership & Quality: Set a high standard for usability, visual craft, consistency, and accessibility. Lead design critiques, communicate actionable feedback, and ensure solutions meet user needs and business objectives
* Dashboard & Data Visualization Design: Create intuitive, data-rich dashboards and analytics experiences that help users interpret complex information, identify insights, and take action
* Member Experience: Design cohesive end-to-end journeys, personalized portals, and engagement features that build trust, simplify interactions, and support member retention
* Product Discovery & Strategy: Lead stakeholder workshops, research synthesis, journey mapping, and concept exploration to define problems, prioritize opportunities, and influence product roadmaps
* Figma & Design Systems: Lead the creation and evolution of scalable design systems, including reusable components, design tokens, responsive patterns, documentation, and developer-ready specifications
* AI-Enabled Workflows: Evaluate and apply AI tools and automation to support research synthesis, ideation, wireframing, prototyping, and documentation. Validate outputs and follow organizational privacy and security requirements
* Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, Architects, and business stakeholders across time zones to align priorities, resolve trade-offs, and support efficient delivery
* User-Centered & Accessible Design: Champion research-informed decisions, inclusive design, and WCAG-aligned accessibility throughout the product lifecycle
* Mentorship & Team Development: Mentor designers through hands-on guidance, thoughtful feedback, and knowledge sharing to strengthen individual capabilities and overall team quality
* Design Validation & Outcomes: Use usability testing, product analytics, and user feedback to evaluate solutions and improve adoption, task success, engagement, and satisfaction
* Implementation Quality: Collaborate closely with engineering during development, conduct design QA, and ensure delivered experiences reflect the intended interaction and visual quality
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in design or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of professional UX/UI or product design experience, with a solid portfolio demonstrating hands-on execution, leadership of complex initiatives, and measurable outcomes
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled design tools and automated workflows, with the judgment to assess output quality, recognize limitations, and protect sensitive information
* Solid hands-on UX/UI expertise across information architecture, user journeys, interaction design, visual design, responsive layouts, prototyping, and usability testing
* Solid experience designing enterprise, SaaS, or other complex web-based products, balancing user needs, business priorities, and technical constraints
* Experience designing complex data dashboards, analytics platforms, and member- or subscriber-based digital experiences
* Experience working in Agile or product-led environments with multidisciplinary teams and distributed stakeholders
* Design system experience, including building, maintaining, and driving adoption of scalable components, design tokens, and reusable UI patterns
* Accessibility knowledge, including practical application of WCAG-aligned design principles and collaboration with engineering to support accessible implementation
* Expert-level Figma proficiency, including advanced prototyping, variables, reusable components, shared libraries, design system architecture, documentation, and Dev Mode handoff
* Data visualization expertise, with the ability to translate complex metrics and workflows into clear, accessible, and actionable experiences
* Demonstrated design leadership, including owning major projects, guiding design decisions, facilitating critiques, mentoring designers, and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain design rationale, build alignment, and navigate ambiguity

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience designing healthcare, pharmacy, or other regulated-industry products, with an understanding of privacy, compliance, and complex user needs
* Experience designing AI-powered, conversational, or enterprise search experiences
* Experience leading design across multiple products, workstreams, or distributed teams
* Experience establishing design governance, critique practices, and quality standards
* Experience using experimentation and product analytics to connect design improvements to measurable user and business outcomes
* Familiarity with front-end development concepts and technical constraints to support effective design-engineering collaboration

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Founder's Office - AI Implementation
description:
**Company Description**

NextDimension AI is building the operating system for specialty medicine. We deploy autonomous AI agents that handle the full scope of patient operations — scheduling, care coordination, billing, and more — so practices can run leaner and patients get a better experience.Our team comes from Google, Amazon, Nvidia, Adobe and Visa.We are rapidly growing and looking for builders who want to do the best work of their careers on problems that actually matter: Patient journey, Healthcare systems optimization, and a new AI-native Operating System for Health Systems.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram, working closely with the founders to drive product delivery across key customer implementations.

You’ll own what happens after a customer signs — getting them live, keeping them healthy, and helping them grow.

**Run the implementations**

* Own the plan and timeline for every account you’re assigned — who’s doing what, by when, and what’s blocking it
* Juggle several implementations at once and always know where each one stands
* Chase down client-side blockers and unblock

**Onboard new customers with Quality**

* Run onboarding start to finish — kickoff, setup, configuration with the engineers, testing, and go-live
* Be the customer’s main point of contact the whole way through
* Make sure every deployment is actually set up right before it goes live — quality, not just hitting the date

**Keep accounts healthy and growing**

* Watch the numbers that matter once a customer is live — adoption, resolution rate, AI-booked appointments, prior-auth automation, patient satisfaction
* Run regular check-ins and act as the early warning system the moment an account goes quiet
* Spot the opening to expand when an account is doing well and hand a warm, well-prepped expansion roadmap to customers

**Build the playbook**

* Turn what works into reusable SOPs, templates, and checklists as you go, organized by customer type
* Make each new customer an activation, not a project you start from scratch
* Set it up so all teams involved know what is next, and time to delivery keeps going down

**Who You Are**

You’ve done this before — carried customers from signed to live to growing, and you’ve done it for more than one at a time without losing the thread.

**You’ll need:**

* 3 to 6 years in hands-on, customer-facing delivery — implementation, onboarding, customer success, professional services, technical account management, or project management — ideally in B2B SaaS, AI, or healthtech
* A real track record running several implementations or accounts in parallel, on a timeline, and driving people to go-live
* Proof you’ve owned a deployment end to end yourself, from kickoff to adoption — not managing a relationship while someone else did the work
* Finisher energy — you go after the boring blocker and close the loop, every time
* Comfort with US-overlap hours for customer calls

**Strong plus:**

* You know US healthcare workflows or EHR/PMS systems or you’ve worked in RCM or practice operations
* You’re AI-native — you already use AI tools to automate your own work and you get what agentic systems can and can’t do

**What to expect**

* Location: Gurugram, India — 5 days in-office, 1 day work from home.
* Enterprise products shipped at startup speed.
* Salary + Bonus + Equity

Ready to build in the next dimension? We're not looking for someone to maintain a project. We're looking for someone to define the future of patient & practice experiences. Apply to join our mission!

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

* Identify, troubleshoot, report and track software defects and issues.

* Report test results and defects to the development team and other stakeholders and work on the resolution.

* Good understanding of SDLC and STLC.

**Senior Finance Test Analyst**

with

.

* Consolidate offshore progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers.
