EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
  
  
Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**EY Technology:**
Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
  
  
**EY Technology supports our technology needs through three business units:**
Client Technology (CT) - focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
  
  
Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit-for-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
  
  
Information Security (Info Sec) - Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.
  
  
**The opportunity**

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Provides senior level system analysis, design, development, and implementation of applications and databases. Integrates third party products.

* Thoroughly understands client business functions and technology needs. Has a broad understanding of Vanguard's technologies, tools, and applications, including those that interface with business area and systems.

title: Fashion Merchandiser
description:
**Industry:**
AI / Fashion Technology / Apparel Manufacturing

**Department:**
Product & AI Solutions

**Years of Experience:**
3+ years

**Salary:**
40k/month take home, 5 LPA CTC

**Job Location:**
Coimbatore

**Work Mode (WFO / WFH / Hybrid):**
Hybrid

*This is a contracted role for 6 months, post which contract will be extended upon evaluating performance*

About Elimai.ai

Elimai.ai is an AI-native enterprise technology company building intelligent AI agents for the fashion and apparel industry.

Our platform helps apparel manufacturers and exporters streamline product development, sampling, costing, pre-production approvals, and merchandising workflows. By automating email processing, technical document interpretation, approval tracking, and manual Excel updates, we help teams improve productivity, reduce errors, and gain real-time operational visibility.

We are now expanding our solutions to support fashion brands, buying offices, and sourcing organizations, enabling seamless collaboration across the fashion supply chain.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Apparel Product Development & Merchandising Domain Specialist**
with strong knowledge of garment product development, sourcing, technical merchandising, and brand-side operations.

This is a domain expertise and product development role, not a conventional merchandising execution position. The selected candidate will work closely with our product, AI, and engineering teams to translate real-world apparel industry workflows into intelligent software solutions.

We are looking for someone who understands not only
**what merchandisers do, but why they do it, how decisions are made, and where existing processes can be improved.**

Why Join Elimai.ai?

* Contribute directly to AI products built specifically for the apparel industry.
* Work closely with product leaders and AI engineering teams.
* Apply real-world merchandising experience to solve industry-wide operational challenges.
* Help shape technology for fashion brands, sourcing offices, and manufacturers.
* Play a meaningful role in transforming traditional fashion supply chain workflows through AI.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Apparel Industry Domain Expertise**

* Provide practical domain knowledge across product development, merchandising, sourcing, sampling, costing, and pre-production activities.
* Explain end-to-end workflows followed by fashion brands, buying offices, and apparel manufacturers.
* Identify differences between brand-side and manufacturer-side merchandising operations.
* Document industry terminology, business processes, approval requirements, and operational challenges.

**2. Brand-Side Sourcing & Merchandising Workflows**

* Map how fashion brands manage seasonal collections, product development calendars, style development, and sourcing activities.
* Explain vendor selection, quotation comparison, target costing, and supplier coordination processes.
* Understand how brands coordinate with multiple factories and track product development progress.
* Identify operational challenges in brand-to-manufacturer communication, sample management, and approval tracking.

**3. AI Product Development & Workflow Automation**

* Collaborate with AI engineers and product teams to convert merchandising processes into software requirements.
* **Identify repetitive manual activities suitable for AI-driven automation.**
* Help design AI agents for sampling, costing, technical document processing, approvals, and workflow tracking.
* Validate AI-generated information against actual apparel industry practices.
* Define business rules, workflow exceptions, and scenarios requiring human intervention.
* Provide practical feedback to improve product accuracy, usability, and industry relevance.

**4. Product Testing & Validation**

* Develop realistic merchandising scenarios using tech packs, email conversations, costing sheets, approval documents, and WIP trackers.
* Test AI product features from the perspective of merchandisers, sourcing professionals, and product development teams.
* Identify incorrect interpretations, missing information, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement.

**5. Customer & Product Collaboration**

* Participate in product discussions, demonstrations, and feedback sessions with apparel manufacturers, buying offices, and brands.
* Understand customer workflows and translate operational requirements into actionable product improvements.
* Work with internal teams to prioritize features based on business value and user needs.
* Support the development of relevant industry use cases and product demonstrations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **Strong practical experience in apparel product development, technical merchandising, sourcing, or buying-office operations.**
* **Good understanding of end-to-end garment development, from initial design brief to bulk production approval.**
* Ability to read and interpret tech packs, BOMs, measurement charts, specifications, and technical comments.
* **Familiarity with brand-to-vendor communication, development calendars, and production handoff processes.**
* Experience working with merchandising trackers, Excel-based WIP reports, and product development documentation.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate complex garment industry processes clearly to non-fashion professionals, including software engineers.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience with a fashion brand, buying office, sourcing organization, or global apparel exporter.
* Experience coordinating product development across multiple factories or suppliers.
* Familiarity with PLM, ERP, or other apparel industry software platforms.
* Experience creating SOPs, process maps, training materials, or workflow documentation.
* Prior involvement in software implementation, process digitization, or automation projects is an advantage.

*Prior AI or software development experience is not mandatory. Strong apparel industry knowledge and the ability to explain business workflows are more important.*

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

* Help Elimai.ai develop a comprehensive understanding of brand-side and manufacturer-side merchandising workflows.
* Translate real-world apparel processes into clear, actionable requirements for AI product development.
* Improve the accuracy and practicality of Elimai's AI-powered merchandising solutions.
* Identify high-value opportunities to automate repetitive work while retaining essential human decision-making.
* Help build products that apparel brands, buying offices, and manufacturers can confidently use in their daily operations.

title: Content Researcher
description:
**Content Researcher**

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Experience:**
Prior experience in content research, writing or a related field preferred, but not mandatory

**Type:**
Full-time

**Read This Before You Apply**

At ARL, we value curiosity, initiative, clear thinking and the ability to turn research into useful content.

We're looking for someone who pays attention to what is happening in the market, asks thoughtful questions, spots patterns and understands what an audience needs to know. You should enjoy going beyond surface-level trends to understand why a topic matters — and then turn those insights into clear, engaging written content.

Prior experience as a content researcher is a plus, but it isn't a requirement. We care more about your research instincts, analytical ability, writing, and willingness to learn.

**Who We Are & Why ARL**

At AgResearch Labs (ARL), we're building technology and infrastructure for cleaner, more climate-resilient food production.

Over more than a decade of R&D, ARL has developed indigenous aeroponics and farm-automation technologies that power Growize Farms, our commercial platform for building and operating high-performance farms at scale.

Recognised among India's Top 100 deep-tech startups by NASSCOM, ARL is entering its next phase of growth — scaling our business, teams and operating systems.

This creates an opportunity to help shape how we explain our work, engage our audiences and contribute to conversations around agriculture, food production, technology and the markets we operate in.

**The Role**

As a Content Researcher, you will identify relevant topics, investigate what audiences and markets care about, and turn your findings into thoughtful, well-written content.

You'll explore market needs, industry developments, audience questions, emerging conversations and content trends to understand what is worth saying, who it is for and how best to communicate it.

The role is not limited to writing from a brief. We want someone who can help identify the brief in the first place: someone who can research independently, connect ideas, analyse what works across different channels and develop content that is useful, relevant and engaging.

**What You'll Own**

**Market, Audience & Topic Research**

* Stay curious about developments in the market, industry news, customer needs, audience conversations and emerging trends relevant to ARL.
* Research topics using credible sources, reports, articles, interviews, social platforms, search trends and other relevant inputs.
* Identify the questions, challenges, misconceptions and interests that matter to our audiences.
* Separate meaningful signals from passing trends, and explain why a topic is relevant to ARL and its audience.
* Build a pipeline of researched topics, angles and content opportunities.

**Content Ideation & Writing**

* Turn research and insights into clear, engaging written content across formats such as educational explainers, articles, thought pieces, anecdotes, social posts, newsletters and website content.
* Develop strong angles, hooks and narratives rather than simply summarising information.
* Adapt the depth, tone, structure and format of content to the intended audience and channel.
* Translate technical or complex ideas into accessible content without losing accuracy or nuance.
* Work with internal subject-matter experts to validate information and uncover useful stories, examples and perspectives.

**Content Analysis & Performance Learning**

* Study content from relevant brands, creators, publications and competitors to understand what earns attention, builds trust and drives engagement.
* Analyse available performance signals — such as reach, engagement, saves, shares, clicks, search visibility or reader feedback — to understand what is working and why.
* Use evidence and audience response to refine topics, formats, distribution choices and future content ideas.
* Develop hypotheses, test different angles and document learnings rather than relying only on intuition.
* Understand that different channels and audiences need different approaches; content that works in one place may not work in another.

**Research Quality & Collaboration**

* Verify facts, check sources and maintain a clear distinction between evidence, interpretation and opinion.
* Keep research organised, with source links, key findings and useful context that others can review.
* Collaborate with the marketing, business and technical teams to align content with business priorities and audience needs.
* Manage multiple topics and deadlines while maintaining accuracy and writing quality.
* Use AI and research tools thoughtfully to improve efficiency, while independently verifying claims and adding original judgment.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong curiosity about markets, people, industries and why certain ideas or stories resonate.
* Good research and analytical instincts — the ability to find credible information, connect dots, spot patterns and draw useful conclusions.
* Clear, engaging writing with the ability to explain ideas simply and adapt to different formats.
* An understanding that effective content starts with audience needs and a clear purpose, not just a trending topic.
* The ability to assess what content works, for whom, on which platform and why — using both qualitative judgment and available data.
* Initiative to suggest topics and angles, ask questions and develop ideas without waiting for a fully defined brief.
* Attention to detail, factual accuracy and a willingness to revise work based on feedback and evidence.
* Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where content priorities and business needs can evolve.

Prior experience as a content researcher, content writer, journalist, editorial researcher, market researcher or in a related role is good to have, but not mandatory. Strong writing samples, research projects, personal publications or other evidence of your ability to think and communicate well are welcome.

**Good to have:**
Experience with digital content, SEO, social media analytics, audience research, industry publications or content planning; familiarity with agriculture, food systems, sustainability, climate, technology or deep-tech topics; comfort using spreadsheets, analytics dashboards and AI-assisted research tools.

**What Success Looks Like**

* You consistently identify relevant topics and angles grounded in audience needs and market developments.
* Your content is accurate, clear, engaging and appropriate for its intended audience and channel.
* Research leads to useful insights and original angles, rather than surface-level summaries.
* Content ideas become a consistent pipeline of work that supports ARL's communication and business priorities.
* You learn from performance data and feedback, and use those learnings to improve future content.
* Internal teams can rely on your research, source quality and written output.

**Why This Role**

This is an opportunity to help shape how a growing deep-tech and AgTech business communicates with the world. You'll have room to explore ideas, understand an evolving market, learn from subject-matter experts and turn complex topics into content that informs, engages and builds understanding.

If you're curious about why people pay attention to certain ideas, enjoy getting to the bottom of a topic and can turn what you learn into compelling writing, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Senior Applications Engineer (Functional Verification)
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.
  
  
You Are
  
  
You have spent enough time in digital design or verification to know that the real work starts when something breaks in a way the documentation never mentioned. Debugging is not just a skill for you, it is how you think. You follow the signal, trace the logic, and figure out what actually happened versus what should have happened, and you can explain the difference to someone who was not there when it broke.
  
  
Working with customers does not intimidate you. You have learned that the best support is not about having every answer immediately, it is about asking the right questions, reproducing the issue, and staying with it until it makes sense. You know your way around Verilog or VHDL well enough to read someone else's RTL and spot where the problem might be hiding.
  
  
You are comfortable working across time zones with engineers in different locations, and you understand that being remote does not mean working in a vacuum. At Synopsys, you will be part of a global team supporting EDA tools that matter, and the work you do will directly affect how customers deploy and trust the products we build.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Drive customer deployments of VCS/Verdi simulation/debug technology, working closely with product teams and R&D to ensure successful adoption and integration.
* Diagnose and troubleshoot complex technical issues in verification flows, utilizing good product knowledge and analytical skills.
* Collaborate with global domain experts to gather requirements and contribute to the development of a robust product roadmap.
* Drive competitive engagements by demonstrating Synopsys VCS/Verdi advantages and supporting customers in benchmarking scenarios.
* Interface directly with customers, product validation, and R&D teams to propose solutions and suggest improvements in implementation and validation processes.
* Develop and optimize scripts (Perl, TCL, Shell, Make,Python) to enhance productivity and workflow automation.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Enable customers to accelerate their verification cycles and achieve first-pass silicon success through expert support and deployment of VCS simulation technology.
* Drive innovation in verification methodologies by integrating advanced features and AI-driven productivity tools.
* Enhance Synopsys’ product offerings by providing actionable feedback from customer engagements and competitive benchmarking.
* Facilitate seamless collaboration across global teams, ensuring consistent delivery of high-quality solutions.
* Support the continuous improvement of VCS/Verdi and related technologies through proactive problem-solving and technical expertise.
* Contribute to the growth of Synopsys’ leadership in EDA by empowering customers to leverage the full capabilities of verification platforms.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electronics with 4+ years or Master’s degree in Electronics with 2+ years of experience.
* Proficiency in verification technologies, including simulation, UVM, SVA, and LRM.
* Strong expertise in HDL languages (Verilog, VHDL, SystemVerilog) and digital design fundamentals.
* Proven experience in debugging simulation mismatches and verification flows.
* Advanced scripting skills (Perl, TCL, Make, Shell, Python) and working knowledge of UNIX environments.
* Exposure to Synopsys EDA tools such as SpyGlass, VC SpyGlass, Verdi is a plus.
* Exposure to GenAI technologies is a plus

**Who You Are:**

* Excellent written and oral communication skills, comfortable interfacing with global teams and customers.
* Collaborative team player with a proactive and innovative mindset.
* Detail-oriented and organized, able to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Motivated self-starter with strong problem-solving abilities.
* Adaptable and open to travel, eager to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment.

The Team You'll Be Part Of
  
  
You will be working as part of the Colombo-based team supporting Synopsys EDA tools for customers globally. The team collaborates closely with remote engineering and support teams across different continents, and your role will involve both reactive support and proactive engagement to improve product deployment and customer satisfaction.
  
  
Rewards and Benefits
  
  
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: Venture Fellow - Internship
description:
Aadi Labs is a venture creation studio. We help founders turn promising ideas into working products, first customers and the foundations of real companies, and we build some of those companies ourselves, with Venture Fellows leading the work.

You will own a real function inside an early-stage venture for six months: real users, real numbers, real consequences if something does not work.

**What you will actually do**

Depending on the venture and the function you choose, that could mean running growth experiments and watching the numbers move, shipping product decisions that get tested by real users within days, writing and deploying code that goes live the same week, or designing the first experience a customer ever sees of something that did not exist a month ago. You will not be handed a six-month roadmap on day one. You will be handed a problem and the room to go solve it.

**Who this is for**

AI is already part of how you work daily. You use it to get more done than your headcount would suggest, not as a novelty you dabble in occasionally. You want responsibility earlier than a conventional internship gives you, and you are comfortable with a role that is not fully defined yet.

Prior experience in a function helps, but a real track record of building or shipping something, anywhere, counts for more than a résumé line.

**Pick your track**
— Venture Fellows lead one of five functions. You choose which one you are applying for on our site.

* **Growth**
   — positioning, acquisition and retention, with AI handling the busywork so your judgment goes toward what to test next.
* **Product**
   — the customer, the first use case, the smallest version worth shipping, prototyped with AI to move at founder speed.
* **Engineering**
   — production code, using AI coding tools to multiply your own output.
* **Design**
   — the end-to-end experience, from UX to the first impression a user gets.
* **Other**
   — sales, operations, customer success, or a function that doesn't fit neatly above.

**Logistics**
: 6 months · Remote or hybrid (Whitefield, Bangalore)

· Direct exposure to zero-to-one building, mentorship, real equity via ESOP, and a credible path to full-time or founding your own venture after.

description:

**Job Description**
**Lab Automation Specialist**
At bp, we provide an excellent working environment and employee benefits such as an open and inclusive culture, a great work-life balance, tremendous learning and development opportunities to craft your career path, life and health insurance, medical care package and many others.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Lab Automation Specialist supports the identification, definition, and deployment of laboratory automation solutions across bp's R&D laboratories, but with particular focus on setting up the new Bengaluru Technology Centre for Day 1 operations. Working as part of the Lab Automation, LIMS & Data Management team, the role acts as a key interface between laboratory stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring automation solutions are aligned with business objectives, laboratory operations, safety requirements, and user expectations.
  
  
Working closely with scientists, laboratory teams, automation specialists, digital teams, and external partners, the role is responsible for gathering and documenting business requirements, analysing laboratory workflows, and translating user needs into clear requirements that support automation delivery.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Facilitate requirements gathering activities through workshops, interviews, process mapping, and stakeholder engagement.
* Engage with scientists, laboratory personnel, and subject matter experts (SMEs) to understand current processes, challenges, and automation opportunities.
* Support the definition of project scope, objectives, requirements, and success criteria for laboratory automation initiatives.
* Document business, process, functional, and data requirements using agreed standards and methodologies.
* Develop and maintain current-state and future-state process maps.
* Analyse laboratory workflows to find opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, quality, data integrity, and user experience through automation.
* Work with wider team, Robotics specialists, Digital Security, Digital delivery, system integrators, and suppliers to translate requirements into solution specifications.
* Support solution evaluations, testing, validation, deployment, and operational handover activities.
* Maintain traceability of requirements, actions, risks, assumptions, and decisions throughout project delivery.
* Promote continuous improvement and the adoption of standardised automation practices across laboratory operations.

**Essential Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree as a minimum in science, engineering or a related discipline plus 7 years relevant experience.
* Experience in business analysis, process & workflow improvement, laboratory operations, automation, manufacturing, or another technical environment.
* Experience gathering, documenting, and handling business and user requirements.
* Project management experience
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process mapping skills.
* Experience working with stakeholders and facilitating discussions across multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Desirable Education & Experience**

* Knowledge of laboratory automation, robotics, laboratory workflows, or scientific operations.
* Knowledge of Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS), lab data capture and equipment integration.
* Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery approaches.
* Experience working with technology suppliers, vendors, or system integrators.

**Leadership Expectations**

* Lives the bp values of Safety, Respect, Excellence, Courage, and One Team.
* Builds effective relationships and collaborates across disciplines and geographies.
* Demonstrates curiosity, learning agility, and a continuous improvement attitude.
* Delivers high-quality outcomes with strong attention to detail and customer focus.
* Supports safe, efficient, and value-driven delivery of automation initiatives.

**Travel Requirement:**
Occasional domestic and international travel to bp sites and supplier facilities may be required.
  
  
**About Bp**
Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner!

title: Consultant
description:
**Are you ready to trade your job for a journey? Become a FlyMate!**
Passion, excitement & global collaboration are all core to what it means to be a FlyMate. At Flywire, we’re on a mission to deliver the world’s most important and complex payments. We use our Flywire Advantage - the combination of our next-gen payments platform, proprietary payment network and vertical specific software, to help our clients get paid, and help their customers pay with ease - no matter where they are in the world.
  
  
What more do we need to truly be unstoppable? Perhaps, that is you!
  
  
**Who We Are**
Flywire is a global payments enablement and software company, founded more than a decade ago to solve high-stakes, high-value payments. We’ve scaled into new regions and industry verticals and expanded our product offerings to deliver meaningful value to our clients around the world.
  
  
Today we support more than 5,100 clients across the global education, healthcare, travel & B2B industries, with diverse payment methods across 240 countries & territories and more than 140 currencies.
  
  
With over 1,400+ global FlyMates, representing more than 40 nationalities, and in 15 offices world-wide, we’re looking for FlyMates to join the next stage of our journey as we continue to grow.
  
  
As a Consultant at Flywire, you will play a pivotal role in guiding our clients through the successful implementation and optimization of Flywire's payment solutions. You will leverage your expertise to understand client needs, translate them into actionable strategies, and ensure a seamless integration experience, ultimately contributing to their financial success and Flywire's growth.
  
  
Responsibilities:\*\*
  
  

* Lead and manage the end-to-end implementation lifecycle for new clients, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, and go-live.
* Conduct in-depth analysis of client business processes and payment workflows to identify opportunities for efficiency and optimization through Flywire's offerings.
* Develop and deliver tailored solution presentations, workshops, and training sessions to client stakeholders at various levels.
* Act as a primary point of contact for clients during the implementation phase, providing expert guidance, resolving issues, and managing expectations.
* Collaborate closely with internal Flywire teams, including Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support, to ensure client success and product enhancements.
* Document client requirements, solution designs, and implementation plans comprehensively.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with project delivery and client satisfaction.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Flywire's implementation methodologies and best practices.
* Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and Flywire's product roadmap.

Qualifications:\*\*
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in a consulting, implementation, or technical account management role, preferably within the fintech, payments, or SaaS industry.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex projects and multiple client engagements simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen eye for detail.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, capable of building rapport with diverse stakeholders.
* Proficiency in understanding and explaining technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience with payment systems, financial processes, or enterprise software implementations is highly desirable.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to travel occasionally to client sites as required.

**What We Offer**
Competitive compensation
  
  
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  
  
Competitive time off
  
  
Work with brilliant people globally Learn more about their journeys by checking out #InsideFlywire on social media
  
  
Wellbeing Programs (Mental Health, Wellness, Yoga/Pilates/HIIT Classes) with Global FlyMates
  
  
Be a meaningful part in our success - every FlyMate makes an impact
  
  
Great Talent & Development Programs (Managers Taking Flight – for new or aspiring managers, OneFlywire Career Mobility)
  
  
**Submit today and get started!**
We are excited to get to know you! Throughout our process you can expect to meet with different FlyMates including the Hiring Manager, Peers on the team, the VP of the department, and a skills assessment. Your Talent Acquisition Partner will walk you through the steps and be your “go-to” person for any questions.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Excellent client service skills.
* Good attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize.

* Knowledge of HIPAA regulations as they relate to benefits enrollment data and PHI handling.

RA & QM functionality sits overall within the SQR (Systems, Quality & Regulatory) business function.
  
  
This role provides deep functional and process expertise and serves as the primary regional/global or functional authority supporting the Global Process Owner (GPO). The incumbent ensures global process standards are effectively deployed and adhered to locally, while leading high-priority, cross-functional simplification and transformation initiatives.

* RA: Product Regulatory Affairs

description:

As a member of our team, you will play a vital role in introducing our groundbreaking GPU products to various deployments, from data centers to edge computing. If you have a strong passion for system design and a successful history of engaging with customers on a technical level, this is an excellent opportunity for you to make a substantial contribution.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Lead the product through its entire lifecycle, from the design-in phase to end-of-life, ensuring flawless execution until system Goes-live..
* Offer in-depth technical assistance to OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, and design houses, ensuring ease of qualification and assisting in issues.

* Perform detailed technical analysis, including circuit/board troubleshooting and FAR issue resolution, to ensure products meet customer criteria
* Actively work towards achieving the Design Wins with Manufacturers

* Provide onsite support to solve hardware and software problems.
* Be a technical specialist on NVIDIA Datacenter products
* Establish strong communication channels and collaborative relationships with internal teams to ensure a positive end customer experience.

**What We Need To See**

* BS or MS in Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Computer Science (or equivalent experience).
* 8+ years of work-related experience in the high-tech electronics industry, particularly in system design or FAE support roles.
* Hands-on experience with hardware bring-up, board-level validation, or system qualification. Understanding of L1-L10 server test levels and how each stage maps to OEM qualification milestones
* Knowledge of PCIe and other high-speed communication interfaces. Familiarity with BMC/IPMI, BIOS/UEFI, or system firmware debugging
* Understanding of thermal design fundamentals and how component placement drives system temperatures
* Exposure to AI or data centre infrastructure: understanding how GPUs fit into a rack, how cooling and power are provisioned, and how workloads are deployed, Capable of excelling in a dynamic, constantly evolving environment.
* Remarkable talent for effectively managing multiple initiatives and priorities. Strong time-management and organizational skills for coordinating complex projects.

description:

* Provide technical and clinical leadership during the sales process by demonstrating the full range of Ultrasound products, including potential uses, product capabilities, and customer benefits.
* Coordinate, schedule, and execute objective-based system training for customers and channel partners; monitor and report on training outcomes.

* Serve as the focal point for the modality/team by identifying customer satisfaction issues, assisting with escalations, resolving problems, and addressing specialty training requests.
* Advocate for and support the adoption of hybrid training delivery models for customers.
* Maintain well-documented pre- and post-training records in alignment with global guidelines.
* Responsible for pre- and post-sales support of ultrasound systems. Responsibilities include conducting clinical activities such as workshops, CMEs, webinars, and hands-on training.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree/ Diploma with 5+ years of experience in MNC as Ultrasound applications is required.
* Experience in Fetal Medicine, General Imaging, OB/GYN, Vascular Sonography, and Cardiology applications is essential

* Excellent interpersonal, oral and written communication skills.

title: MES Engineer: Pharmaceutical & Biotech Manufacturing
description:
12 of the top 15 pharma generic companies in the world trust Leucine to manufacture the drugs that reach millions of patients every day.

Pharma manufacturing is one of the last large industries still running on paper, Excel, and tribal knowledge. A single missed step in a batch record can mean a recall, a regulatory warning, or a drug that should never have left the plant.

Leucine is the AI platform replacing all of it. Series A, backed by top-tier global investors, 60+ pharma enterprises in production, and the team that's going to define this category.

**About The Role**

We're hiring an MES (Manufacturing Execution System) Engineer to help pharmaceutical and biotech manufacturers move from paper to digital batch execution.

You'll implement, configure and improve MES solutions for our clients, and every project has to meet strict GMP and data integrity standards. You'll report to a Lead or Senior Engineer, and you'll own work packages as your experience grows.

**What You'll Do**

**Delivery & Implementation**

* Work on MES projects from start to finish: requirements gathering, design, configuration, testing, deployment and Hypercare.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and turn them into MES functional and technical requirements, workflows and configurations.
* Configure MES solutions to fit each client's operations, including electronic batch records (EBR), recipes, production workflows and master data.
* Design and deliver integrations with enterprise systems such as ERP (for example SAP), LIMS, WMS and QMS, and with shop-floor (L2) equipment and automation systems.
* Find and fix system issues quickly to keep production downtime low.

**Compliance & Validation**

* Apply GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity (ALCOA+), EU Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11 to all MES work.
* Prepare validation deliverables and help execute them, including specifications, IQ/OQ/PQ test scripts and traceability matrices. Follow computerized system validation (CSV) and computer software assurance (CSA) principles.
* Help with deviations, root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

**Requirements**

* 2+ years of MES implementation or consulting experience in pharmaceutical, biotech or life sciences.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major MES platform, such as Leucine MES, Körber PAS-X, Emerson Syncade, Siemens Opcenter, FactoryTalk PharmaSuite or GE Proficy.
* A solid understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, electronic batch records, recipes and production execution.
* Practical experience with MES configuration, documentation, testing and validation support.
* Knowledge of system integration, including ERP-MES interfaces, L3-L2 integration and APIs.
* The ability to turn requirements into MES documentation, workflows, configurations and test cases
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder management.
* Comfortable working on your own or as part of a team

**Mandatory**

* Working knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5, data integrity, EU Annex 11 and 21 CFR Part 11, applied in MES work.
* Hands-on experience with batch processes in pharmaceutical or biotech manufacturing.
* Proven experience with MES platforms, electronic batch records, testing and validation.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with digital transformation or Industry 4.0 initiatives.
* Experience with cloud-based or SaaS MES solutions.
* Certification in an MES platform or related technology.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server or Oracle databases.
* Hands-on SAP integration experience, for example PP-PI, MM and QM

**Benefits**

* Be part of a fast-growing SaaS company transforming the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing through cutting-edge technology
* Collaborate with a passionate, high-performing team building innovative AI-powered digital solutions
* Take ownership of impactful client implementations from day one, with ample opportunities for learning, career growth, and professional development
* Enjoy a competitive compensation package designed to reward your contributions
* Comprehensive Health Insurance with industry-leading coverage for your peace of mind
* Complimentary Meals & Refreshments: Stay energized with unlimited breakfast, lunch, snacks, and dinner provided at the office
* Family-Friendly Leave Policies, including Paternity Leave and Compassionate Leave, to support you through life's important moments

title: Aerospace FMS. System Testing Engineer
description:
We are hiring!

**Aerospace (FMS) System Testing Engineer**

**Location**
: Bangalore, Karnataka (onsite)

**Experience**
: 3-5 Years

Are you passionate about aviation safety and mission-critical systems?

Qubist Solutions is expanding our engineering team, and we are looking for a rigorous and detail-oriented Aerospace System Testing Engineer. In this role, you will bridge system design, software, and hardware to ensure our airborne products meet the highest levels of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

**What You Will Do:**

* Design, develop, and execute system-level test plans and procedures for complex avionics architectures.
* Ensure bi-directional requirements traceability from aircraft-level safety objectives down to implementation artifacts.
* Configure and manage Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), System Integration Labs (SIL), and automated test environments.
* Partner with cross-functional engineering teams to resolve defects and root-cause anomalies during integration.
* Generate objective evidence and traceability matrices to support SOI (Stage of Involvement) audits and FAA/EASA certification.

**The Standards You Will Drive:**

You will directly apply the core ecosystem of aerospace certification guidelines to our testing lifecycle:

* ARP4754A: Validating system architectures and requirement allocations.
* ARP4761: Utilizing FHA, PSSA, and SSA outputs to drive safety-critical failure-mode testing.
* DO-178C: Executing high-level/system-level software integration tests.
* DO-254: Verifying complex electronic hardware behavior at the system and LRU levels.
* DO-330: Defining Tool Operational Requirements and validating automated verification toolchains.
* DO-356A: Testing system vulnerabilities and verifying airworthiness cybersecurity architectures.

**What You Bring to the Table:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Aerospace, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or related fields.
* 3+ years of hands-on avionics testing and integration experience in a certified program.
* Proficiency in Requirements Management tools (DOORS, Jama, Polarion).
* Experience with test automation scripting (Python, C/C++) and aviation data buses (ARINC 429, AFDX, MIL-STD-1553B).
* A proven track record of generating certification artifacts for regulatory audits.

**How to Apply:**

Ready to build the future of flight? Click "Apply" on this post or send your resume directly to
**communications@qubistsolutions.com**
with the subject line "Aerospace Testing Engineer - [Your Name]".

visit: www.trimble.com

title: vehicle diagnostics
description:
A typical
**Vehicle Diagnostics Engineer**
role at
**Renault Nissan Technology & Business Centre India (RNTBCI)**
focuses on developing and validating vehicle diagnostic functions compliant with automotive standards.
  
  
Job Title
  
  
**Vehicle Diagnostics Engineer**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop and maintain vehicle diagnostic specifications for ECUs.
* Define and validate diagnostic functions based on UDS (ISO 14229) and OBD-II requirements.
* Configure and test Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), Diagnostic Identifiers (DIDs), and Routine Control services.
* Analyze CAN/LIN communication and troubleshoot diagnostic issues.
* Work with software, calibration, validation, and ECU suppliers to resolve diagnostic defects.
* Perform diagnostic validation using tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, or DDT2000.
* Support software integration, vehicle testing, and issue analysis.
* Ensure compliance with Renault-Nissan diagnostic standards and regulatory requirements.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, diagnostic specifications, and test reports.
* Participate in defect tracking and root cause analysis.

Required Skills
  
  

* Knowledge of automotive communication protocols:

+ CAN
+ LIN
+ Ethernet (preferred)

* Understanding of:

+ UDS (ISO 14229)
+ OBD-II
+ ISO 15765 (CAN Transport Protocol)

* Experience with tools such as:

+ Vector CANoe
+ CANalyzer
+ DDT2000
+ INCA (preferred)

* Understanding of ECU architecture and embedded systems.
* Familiarity with diagnostics over CAN and vehicle networks.
* Basic scripting knowledge (CAPL or Python) is an advantage.
* Strong debugging and analytical skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Automobile, or related disciplines.
* Typically 2–6 years of experience in automotive diagnostics, ECU validation, or embedded systems.

Common Interview Topics
  
  

* UDS services (0x10, 0x11, 0x19, 0x22, 0x27, 0x2E, 0x31, 0x34, 0x36, 0x37).
* DTC lifecycle and fault memory.
* OBD-II requirements and emission-related diagnostics.
* CAN protocol, CAN frames, arbitration, and message IDs.
* Diagnostic session control and security access.
* Flash programming and bootloader concepts.
* CAPL scripting basics.
* ECU communication and diagnostic troubleshooting.
* Difference between functional and physical addressing.
* Positive and negative response codes in UDS.

This role is suited to engineers with backgrounds in
**automotive electronics, ECU diagnostics, embedded systems, or vehicle network validation**
, rather than mechanical design.

title: Team Member - Green Steel
description:
**As a strategic step towards Sustainability:**
JSW Steel has established a Steel Recycling Business to cater the growing scrap demand. As part of this initiative, the state-of-the-art Scrap Processing Facility of ~0.5 MTPA is planned in the vicinity of Chennai. This plant encompassing shredding & baling operations to ensure high-quality scrap supply to the plant in the vicinity of Chennai.
  
  
**Strengthening the Scrap Supply Chain:**
To further secure and enhance scrap availability, it is imperative to establish collection and processing centres across strategic locations.
  
  
**Role Scope & Key Deliverables**

* The role covers the entire value chain - from conducting comprehensive market studies and building the business case to securing requisite approvals, driving plant setup, and managing operations thereafter.

This includes in-depth market analysis, strong technical knowledge, project management skills, and coordination with vendors, contractors, and internal stake holders.
  
  
**Key Result Areas (Key Performance Indicators)**

* Analyze market for scrap types, supply-demand dynamics, pricing trends, and regulatory changes in the Domestic & International Market
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard partners (yards, aggregators, dismantlers, OEMs, logistics) for obsolete and prompt scrap.
* Identifying required technologies & infrastructure, Prepare capex, business case, board notes, and evaluate land/locations for setting up scrap processing centres.
* Plan and execute projects according to approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards.
* Supervise installation, testing, and commissioning activities.
* Identify project risks, delays, and technical problems and implement corrective actions.

**Critical Tasks**

* Developing Business Framework for setting up Scrap Collection & Processing Centres.
* Identifying the required technology & infrastructure for the processing units such as equipment, land & plant infra, etc
* Ensure equipment selection and design comply with project specifications and applicable engineering standards
* Prepare technical specifications, RFQs, BOQs, and equipment datasheets
* Prepare technical evaluation of mechanical equipment and vendor offers
* Ensure execution is in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, method statements, and quality requirements.
* Coordinate day-to-day site activities with civil, electrical, instrumentation, and other disciplines
* Carryout commissioning, trial runs, and performance testing of mechanical systems
* Monitor project progress and identify delays, technical risks, and interface issues and initiate corrective actions
* Take over the plant for operation post commissioning

**Educational Background And Work Experience**

* Bachelor’s in Mechanical Engineering
* 5+ years of working in Project Execution and Supply chain

**Competencies**

* Experience in business development, sales, or supply chain roles within the steel, scrap, recycling, or waste management industry
* Knowledge of local and international scrap market regulations and compliance.
* Project planning and execution
* Site supervision
* Vendor/contractor management
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, SAP etc

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Effy (Rayles and Roobie Technologies Pvt. Ltd.) is a Chennai-based custom software development company and Freshworks Premium System Integration Partner, building integrations, middleware/APIs, and marketplace apps for clients across fintech, retail, media, and legal sectors. This role owns quality assurance across all client integrations and Freshworks marketplace apps and also acts as the technical point of contact for support requests raised by clients, customers, and partners making this a hybrid QA and technical support/customer success role.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a customer-focused and technically inclined Technical Support Engineer to join our team. This role is ideal for freshers and candidates with up to 2 years of experience who have good communication skills, an interest in troubleshooting technical issues, and a willingness to learn.

You will be responsible for handling customer support tickets, participating in customer calls, performing initial debugging, and providing timely responses to customer queries. As we work with customers across the UK and US, strong English communication skills are essential.

Knowledge transfer and guidance will be provided to help you understand our applications and handle customer issues independently.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Handle customer support tickets, investigate reported issues, and provide timely responses and updates.
* Attend customer calls and communicate professionally with customers across the UK and US.
* Perform L1 troubleshooting and initial debugging of application-related issues.
* Test APIs using tools such as Postman and validate API requests and responses.
* Use Browser Developer Tools to inspect network requests, analyze console errors, and troubleshoot application issues.
* Explain technical issues and troubleshooting steps clearly to both technical and non-technical customers.
* Document investigation findings, error messages, logs, and troubleshooting steps in support tickets.
* Escalate complex issues to the development team with relevant technical details.
* Follow up on open tickets and coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Learn our products and applications through internal knowledge-transfer sessions and apply the knowledge to customer support activities.

**Required Skills:**

* Good verbal and written English communication skills.
* Confidence in communicating with international customers.
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, status codes, and JSON.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman.
* Basic knowledge of Browser Developer Tools, especially Console and Network tabs.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand technical problems and explain them in simple terms.
* Good documentation, ticket management, and follow-up skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of JavaScript or any scripting knowledge.
* Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and web applications.
* Understanding of client-server architecture and API integrations.
* Internship, academic project, or prior experience in technical support or application support is an added advantage.

**Additional Preferred Skills - AI Tools**

* Basic familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT (GPT), Claude or Cursor etc.
* Ability to use AI tools to assist with technical troubleshooting, error analysis, understanding API responses, and identifying potential solutions.
* Willingness to learn and leverage AI-powered tools to improve productivity and problem-solving efficiency.
* Basic understanding of how to use AI tools to analyze code snippets, browser console errors, and technical documentation.



**Who Can Apply?**

* Freshers and candidates with
  **0–2 years of experience**
  .
* Candidates interested in technical support, application troubleshooting, and API testing.
* Individuals with strong communication skills and a willingness to learn new technologies.

If you enjoy solving problems, helping customers, and working with technology, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Solutions Manager
description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

* Define content models, taxonomy, metadata, workflow, governance and lifecycle patterns, and design multisite, multibrand, multilingual, authoring, publishing, search, SEO and accessibility approaches along with DAM, PIM, creative tooling and channel integrations.
* Lead platform-specific inventory, dependency, migration and modernisation assessments, defining extraction, transformation, loading, validation, reconciliation, redirect and cutover approaches with realistic estimates, assumptions and risks.

* Create reusable reference architectures, playbooks, assessment frameworks and accelerators, guide delivery teams on complex configuration and migration decisions, and identify practical generative AI and agentic opportunities with appropriate security, privacy, governance and human oversight.

At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

title: AI Content Marketer
description:
**About CultureMonkey**

CultureMonkey is building HR tech for companies that take people seriously.

We help organisations listen to their people better through employee engagement surveys, lifecycle surveys, pulse surveys, action planning, and people analytics. But the real thing we are building is not just software...

We are helping companies build workplaces where people feel heard, understood, and valued.

We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS company working with mid-market and enterprise customers across geographies. Over a million employees in 150+ countries trust us with something important: the honest voice of how they feel at work.

And the way people find us is changing fast. They do not just Google us anymore. They ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. That shift is exactly where this role comes in.

**About the Role**

* We are looking for an AI Content Marketer who can make CultureMonkey the answer... on Google, and inside every AI engine people now ask first.
* This role sits right between content, SEO, product, and distribution.
* You will write content that HR leaders actually finish. You will make sure it ranks, gets cited, and keeps earning attention long after you hit publish.
* This is not a "write a blog and move on" role.
* This is a role about being remembered.
* You will own how a fast-growing brand gets found, read, and trusted in a search world that AI is rewriting in real time.

**What You Will Do**

* Write content people actually finish. Blogs, case studies, and playbooks that are clear, human, and genuinely useful.
* Write for the answer, not just the algorithm. Content built to rank on Google and get cited by AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.
* Use AI as a real part of your workflow, for research, drafting, and scaling, then edit hard so every piece stays accurate, original, and human.
* Run keyword and prompt research in Ahrefs and Search Console to publish content that ranks and holds its place.
* Refresh and re-optimize existing content so top pages keep their rankings as search intent and SERPs shift. Content decay is where organic traffic quietly leaks.
* Build domain authority through internal linking and structured outreach: guest posts, backlinks, and partnerships.
* Distribute with intent across newsletters, LinkedIn, Reddit, and product communities. Right message, right channel, right timing.
* Partner across teams on landing pages, sales and marketing emails, and ad copy, all research-backed.
* Track what matters, from CTR and organic traffic to keyword rankings and visibility in AI answers, and let the data shape the next draft.
* Most importantly... do not just write content that fills a calendar. Write the content that people, and AI, actually trust.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 1 to 2 years in content marketing, content writing, SEO, or a similar role where your writing had to perform, not just publish.
* Someone who writes clearly because they think clearly. Practical, useful, no filler.
* Someone who treats SEO and AI search as strategy, not jargon.
* Someone who uses AI fluently but never blindly. You can tell a sharp draft from generic filler, and you fix the difference.
* Comfort with data. Rankings, CTR, and traffic should tell you what to write next, not intimidate you.
* Strong follow-through. You track open items, hit publish dates, and keep multiple pieces moving without being chased.
* A curious, proactive streak. You would rather test an idea than wait for permission.
* Someone who takes feedback without ego and turns it into sharper work.
* Bonus points if you have played with keyword tools, AI writing tools, or have a portfolio you are proud to show.

**You Will Love This Role If**

* You like writing that actually gets read, not just filed away.
* You enjoy turning a messy topic into a clean, useful piece.
* You get a quiet thrill from watching a page climb the rankings.
* You want to crack how to get cited by ChatGPT and Perplexity, not just Google.
* You like data pointing you to your next move.
* You want your work to have visible impact quickly.
* You enjoy working with people who move fast, care deeply, and still know how to have fun.

**Why Join CultureMonkey**

* You will work on content that genuinely matters to the people reading it.
* You will help companies listen to their employees better, not just push another dashboard.
* You will join a content practice that is still being shaped, so your ideas on process, tooling, and how we win AI search will actually matter.
* You will work directly with a fast-moving team that values sharp thinking, ownership, and honesty over hierarchy.
* You will be part of a team that believes people grow when they are trusted, heard, and given room to contribute.
* We practice what we build for customers: people-first experiences, high ownership, empathy, flexible work, learning, fun, and a real sense of belonging.
* Things move fast here. Decisions happen in days, not quarters. Good ideas travel quickly. And when you do good work, you will see its impact almost immediately.

**The Kind of Person We Are Hoping To Meet**

* Someone who is curious about how AI is changing search, and wants to be early to it.
* Someone who can turn a blank page into something people actually want to read.
* Someone who cares about the reader on the other side of the screen, not just the keyword.
* Someone who wants to build a content engine, not just hit publish.
* Someone who believes great content is not about volume, it is about being the answer people trust.

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

description:

title: Senior Engineer - HVDC System Design
description:
**Job Description Summary**
This role is designed to interpret the customer’s technical enquiry and to design the most cost-effective overall solution for an HVDC installation utilizing the power electronics solutions, aiming to minimize the total cost, and to specify the main (high-value) items of bought-out equipment for HVDC Projects. The successful candidate will also be involved in the development and industrialization of tools and processes and will have technical knowledge and experience in the field of power system engineering (academic and professional).
  
  
The successful candidate will be part of an established team of experienced power systems engineer which will provide them with various opportunities to develop their skills in the field of high voltage AC and DC power system design via mentoring by Systems Expert, on-the-job training, classroom training (such as the HVDC university training modules), placement in other engineering departments etc.
  
  
As part of the role, the candidate will be required to represent GE in front of external stakeholders such as clients, third party suppliers, professional bodies (IEC, Cigré, etc).
  
  
**Job Description**
**Essential responsibilities:**
The Successful Candidate Will Be Involved In Any Of The Following Areas And Is Expected To Have Experience In a Number Of These Areas
  
  

* Main Circuit Design
* Develop an integrated scheme design that meets the Customer’s needs, by developing requirements on the ratings and functionalities of the different HVDC system’s subsystems, in an optimized and cost-effective manner.
* Insulation Coordination Studies
* Determine the temporary and transient overvoltage stresses on HV equipment and provide the protective level requirements for the surge arresters.
* Manage the lifecycle of high economic value High Voltage equipment such as power transformers, instrument transformers, reactors, capacitors, and surge arresters, covering the development of its requirements, specification, supplier management and the validation and verification (testing) of design, manufacturing and commissioning.
* Reliability, Availability and Maintainability Studies and Management
* Create, verify, and validate the reliability, availability and maintainability models for HVDC systems and subsystems, providing insight to customers and leaders and managing the risks, issues and opportunities that affect the systems throughout their lifecycle.
* Create, verify, and validate the electrical power losses models for HVDC systems and subsystems, providing insight to customers and leaders and managing the risks, issues and opportunities that affect the systems throughout their lifecycle.
* Report or resolve any non-conformances in a timely manner.
* Identify and evaluate EHS risks in own area and implement practical measures.
* Actively participate in defining corrective actions when work is unsafe or when an uncontrolled risk is observed.

**Desired Additional Skills**

* Transient Studies
* Determination (by simulation) of temporary and transient overvoltage stresses on equipment and surge arrester energy ratings.
* Harmonic Analysis and Power Quality
* Conducting AC and DC harmonic performance and harmonic stability studies for HVDC converter stations for VSC and LCC HVDC schemes. Radio Frequency Interference studies and Electromagnetic Compatibility studies. Power Line Carrier Interference studies and filters. Design of AC, DC, and High Frequency harmonic filters and screening. Calculations of filter performance and rating. Creation of project-specific equipment specifications for filter reactors/capacitors/resistors.

**Tools**
PSCAD, PSS/E, DigSilent, Python and MATLAB.
  
  
**Desired Candidate Profile**
**Qualifications And Experience**
Preferably educated with a Master in Power Systems Engineering from an accredited institution (or equivalent knowledge) and proven professional experience and technical expertise in the field of Power Systems Engineering and preferably in HVDC System Design/Studies.
  
  
**Technical Domain Competencies**
**At least AWARE of the following areas, and PROFICIENT in some of them:**

* Power System Design
* Circuit analysis
* Power control
* Reactive power design
* HVAC domain knowledge
* HVDC domain knowledge
* High voltage equipment specification, design, and testing (E.g., power transformers, reactors, capacitors, switchgear, instrumentation transformers and transducers, surge arresters, bushings and insulators)
* Reliability, availability, and maintainability (RAM) assessment and management
* Electrical power systems modelling and analysis
* Insulation co-ordination
* Audible noise assessment and mitigation

**AWARE Of**

* Network Studies
* Harmonic Analysis and Power Quality
* EMC assessment and mitigation
* HVDC valves and their control systems

**Engineering Management Competencies**

* Planning: Ability to plan and manage own work.
* Risk and Opportunity Management: Proactively identifies and manages risks, issues, and opportunities.
* Acquisition and Supply: Generation of work products associated with acquiring or providing products or services.

* Curious, resilient, and willing to learn.

* Technical skills: Strong analytical skills to translate clinical and economic information and messages into payer evidence strategies; Understands reimbursement decisions to determine value drivers and how evidence is used in decision making and how it impacts various payers (e.g., providers, patients, health systems); Knowledge of methods and principles of health economics, health technology assessment (HTA) reviews

title: Operations Management Intern
description:
Company Description: IHM Connect delivers smart, adaptable ERP solutions that help organizations streamline operations and drive growth across multiple industries. The company’s flagship product, Campus Connect, supports schools with integrated finance, HR, attendance, and result management to improve efficiency and student-focused outcomes. Beyond education, IHM Connect serves sectors such as real estate and manufacturing with tailored systems that address specific operational challenges. Its ERP solutions integrate with existing processes to provide real-time data and actionable insights for better decision-making. As the company expands into new markets, it remains committed to user-friendly technology that enhances productivity and reduces inefficiencies.

Role Description: The Operations Management is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This position focuses on supporting client onboarding, understanding client requirements, and ensuring smooth adoption of IHM Connect ERP solutions. Day-to-day responsibilities include engaging with clients to address queries, tracking client satisfaction, coordinating with internal technical and sales teams, and maintaining updated records of client interactions. The intern will assist in preparing presentations, reports, and follow-up communication, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve client experience. This role offers exposure to ERP implementation, customer success processes, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment.

Qualifications

* Strong customer-focused mindset, with skills in Customer Satisfaction and Account Management to build and maintain long-term client relationships.
* Effective Communication skills (verbal and written) to interact with diverse stakeholders and present information clearly.
* Interest or foundational skills in Sales and Consulting to support solution positioning, client needs assessment, and upsell opportunities.
* Basic understanding of ERP or software solutions, and the ability to learn product features quickly.
* Good organizational and time-management abilities, with attention to detail in documentation and follow-ups.
* Ability to work collaboratively on-site in Hyderabad with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business, Management, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Onboarding & Implementation**

* Manage end-to-end onboarding process for schools and business clients
* Coordinate data collection, system setup, and implementation timelines
* Ensure smooth migration of operational data to the IHM Connect platform
* Conduct onboarding sessions and training for client teams

Operational Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned clients
* Monitor platform adoption and ensure proper usage of modules (HR, Finance, CRM, WhatsApp Automation, etc.)
* Identify operational gaps and proactively suggest improvements
* Ensure SLA adherence and timely resolution of client issues

Relationship & Retention Management

* Maintain regular communication with school management and business owners
* Support renewals and contract negotiations in coordination with the sales team
* Address escalations and ensure long-term client satisfaction
* Work on improving retention and reducing churn

Strategic Operations & Process Optimization

* Build and improve SOPs for onboarding and client management
* Analyze operational data to identify bottlenecks
* Coordinate cross-functionally to improve internal workflows
* Assist in pricing discussions, service scope alignment, and operational feasibility
