title: Senior Structured Data Access Control Process Analyst
description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for
*all*
.**
Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
  
  
The
**Senior Structured Data Access Control Process Analyst**
will play an important role in supporting Micron's Structured Data Access Control (sDAC) program and related data governance initiatives. This role analyzes business processes, identifies opportunities for automation and efficiency, develops reporting and dashboard solutions, supports operational workloads, and contributes to projects that strengthen secure and compliant access to enterprise structured data.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong analytical thinking with process improvement, stakeholder engagement, reporting, and project execution skills. Working closely with technical and business teams, they will transform complex governance processes into actionable insights and help drive continuous improvements across access management and governance workflows.
  
  
This position supports both day-to-day operations and strategic initiatives, helping advance governance modernization, workflow automation, and user experience improvements across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain a deep understanding of Structured Data Access Control (SDAC) process and related governance workflows along with the knowledge of Role Based Access Control (RBAC) and data security management for integration.
* Define, document and improve business processes, requirements, workflows, operating procedures, governance standards, user guidance, training material and communications.
* Identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and efficiency improvements.
* Leveraging AI powered tools and other technologies to improve analysis, research, and productivity.
* Serve as a project contributor, feature owner, or workstream lead for governance initiatives. Includes tracking and communicating project status, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and key milestones.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions to understand business needs, gather requirements, and address process challenges.
* Facilitate partnerships with developers to define business requirements and acceptance criteria. Participate in requirements gathering, planning, testing, deployment, change management, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and validation activities.
* Collaborate with BISOs, architects, DBAs, developers, governance teams, and business stakeholders.
* Support user adoption efforts and partner with governance and security teams on RBAC-related initiatives.
* Perform deep data analysis to detect patterns and drive to results. Along with developing data-driven recommendations to improve service quality, cycle time, operational effectiveness, and user experience. Monitor service levels and operational health.
* Design, develop, and maintain Power BI, ServiceNow, and governance reporting solutions, dashboards, and operational metrics.
* Analyze trends, bottlenecks, Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance, and operational health metrics to provide actionable insights, create executive-ready reporting and present to leadership and stakeholder on governance recommendation.
* Support operational ticket queues, governance workflows, and triage and resolution of access request review along with assisting users and stakeholders with governance-related inquiries.
* Support audit, certification, and compliance activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Information Systems, Business Data Analytics, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of work experience in business analysis, governance, operations, analytics, or process improvement.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements, developing reports, dashboards, and metrics using Power BI, ServiceNow and the Microsoft 365 suites.
* Self-motivated, organized, and highly capable of carrying out detailed plans with limited direction.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and effective written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative and inclusive with a positive attitude, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams across geographical and organizational cultures and to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting data governance, access management, and IAM governance programs, with familiarity in RBAC concepts.
* Knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server (MSSQL) or Oracle Database role and direct access permissions.
* Knowledge of SDLC, Agile, Scrum, or Kanban methodologies. PMP, Scrum, Agile, or Business Analysis certifications are a plus.
* Experience with ServiceNow workflow design and automation, Microsoft 365 collaboration tools (SharePoint, Planner, Power Automate), and Power BI data modeling and advanced visualization techniques.

**About Micron Technology, Inc.**

*for all*
. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

The role drives coordination of projects, tools, and processes that support market development to drive customer engagement, support internal and external communications, and enhance visibility into program activities against key success metrics. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

* Recognize and escalate issues that potentially require upper management awareness and input
* Secure services as needed from other departmental, divisional, and organizational groups
* Help with special projects upon request
* Perform other responsibilities as assigned

**Who is USP Looking For?**
**Required Skills And Qualifications**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree
* Minimum of five years of relevant professional experience with a combination of relevant project management skills and/or scientific background.
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work across teams in a matrixed environment
* Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and efficiently manage multiple projects
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Advanced computer competence (MS Office, MS Teams, MS Project, Sharepoint, Copilot, etc.)
* Experience with business, sales and marketing platforms (e.g. Tableau) and CRM platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Marketo)

* Demonstrated initiative and resourcefulness with good judgement about what can work and when additional support is needed

**Title: Senior Consultant, IOT Product Security**

Support clients in improving cybersecurity across OT, ICS, and industrial environments. The role will involve solution design and deployment, client engagement, project delivery, proposal support, and team coordination.

* Assess OT cybersecurity risks across manufacturing, industrial, utilities, energy, or similar environments.

* Knowledge of OT devices and OT network architectures.

+ OT asset management
+ OT network segmentation
+ Secure remote access
+ OT monitoring or IDS
+ OT Automation solutions
+ OT incident response
+ IoT security
+ SCADA/ICS security

* Experience with OT cybersecurity platforms such as Claroty, Nozomi, Dragos, or equivalent.
* Familiarity with ISA/IEC 62443, NIST - 800-82, NISTIR – 8183, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and OT cyber risk management.
* Skilled in developing, reviewing, and refining technical deliverables and documentation.

* Ability to use GenAI and agentic AI tools to accelerate OT cybersecurity assessments, documentation, threat analysis, solution design, and delivery workflows, while applying appropriate governance, validation, and human oversight.

* Ability to work with AI copilots or agents for repeatable delivery tasks, while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and compliance.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and project execution skills.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or related field; Master's degree (MBA, M.Tech, or MS in Cybersecurity) is a plus.

Do you love writing in a compelling and creative way? Does it excite you to be able to run an end-to-end sales cycle leading and coaching a pursuit team to success? **About us**

Grama Group is a fast-growing political and governance consulting firm working at the intersection of public policy, politics, data, and implementation.

Our teams have been closely involved in landmark electoral campaigns, governance initiatives, and large-scale public programs across India. We work directly with political leadership, governments, and senior decision-makers to solve complex governance challenges, strengthen institutional capacity, and support high-impact public initiatives.

Our work spans policy design, governance strategy, implementation support, data-driven decision-making, public systems, political communication, and organisational capability building.

* Develop policy notes, presentations, dashboards, analytical reports, and strategic briefs for senior stakeholders
* Work with datasets, MIS systems, and field inputs to support data-driven decision-making
* Contribute to governance and political strategy through structured research, issue analysis, and policy inputs
* Maintain structured documentation and institutional knowledge repositories for ongoing initiatives

* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving ability
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to synthesise complex information into actionable insights
* Curiosity about politics, governance, and public systems
* Comfort working in high-intensity and fast-moving environments
* Ability to independently drive projects and manage multiple workstreams
* High professionalism, discretion, and stakeholder management capability
* Strong ownership mindset and willingness to work on-ground when required

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a reputed institution, preferably in Political Science, Economics, Public Policy, Law, Social Sciences, Engineering, or related disciplines
* 0 to 4 years of experience in consulting, public policy, governance, research, analytics, political consulting, development sector, or related fields
* Experience with quantitative analysis, policy evaluation, impact assessment, or dashboarding tools would be beneficial but is not mandatory

* Opportunity to work on high-impact governance and political initiatives
* Direct exposure to senior political and administrative leadership
* Fast learning environment with significant responsibility and ownership
* Opportunity to work across policy, politics, data, and implementation
* Exposure to large-scale public systems and real-world governance challenges
* Young, driven, and multidisciplinary team environment
* Chance to contribute meaningfully to governance and public impact at scale

title: Engineer - Controls Platform NPI
description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

* Identifie, développe, évalue, introduit et gère des solutions d'ingénierie répondant aux besoins technologiques en matière de contrôle de produits et de systèmes de contrôle. Applique la théorie du contrôle et la modélisation mathématique à la conception et au contrôle de systèmes avec les comportements souhaités. CFO is a risk-based program to identify & confirm data gaps in various high risk financial regulatory reports filed by the bank like FR- Y-9C, FR- Y-15, FFIEC 031/041, FFIEC 009, FFIEC 101, COREP, FINREP & AnaCredit & Liquidity Reports. Executing assessments to review and validate source documents, data source elements and logic adheres to specified business and/or data regulatory requirements

* Examination of financial information and data attributes for assessment of alignment with instructions, i.e. fit for use and/or BRD (Business Requirements Document) validation activities.
* Assist in issue evaluation and remediation efforts including identification, remediation, monitoring and escalation activities particular to identified conformance or transaction related non-adherence issues and observations.
* Manage relationships across Finance, Data Management, or other line of business support teams.

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
CA/CPA, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance
  
  
**Experience Range\***
3 - 5 years experience
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Exposure to US regulatory reports such as FRY-9C, FRY-14Q/M, FFIEC031, FRY-15, FFIEC 009 or EMEA regulatory reports like COREP, FINREP & AnaCredit.
* Experience in analyzing SQL code through either writing the code to match business requirements or validation of code to ensure it executes the business requirements.
* Advanced tool skills in working with large data sets to identify anomalies in the data, in addition to standard knowledge of Microsoft software (Excel, Word, Power Point) including advanced excel functions such as pivot tables, V-lookup, etc.
* Strong communication skills to support partnership across multiple line of business, finance and technology teams.

**Desired Skills**

* Prior experience in Audit, Financial Reporting or Finance Data Management Organizations
* Ideal candidate should have a general comprehension of both GAAP and Regulatory Reporting for large banks.

**Work Timings\***
11:30 am to 8:30 pm
  
  
**Job Location\***
MUM/HYD/CHN

title: Senior Manager, AIN Documentation, Content Create and Automation (DCCA)
description:
Location: India | Scope: Global service supporting Amgen sites
  
  
Under minimal direction, the Senior Manager, DCCA leads a DS, DP or FDP team based in India that creates and revises controlled GMP documentation for Amgen sites globally. The role owns the service-delivery model that enables reliable, compliant, and accurate documentation support - delivering to agreed service-level agreements while driving right-first-time quality, predictable turnaround, and continuous improvement. Hours for this role may vary based on global time zones, which could include hybrid hours, on call requirements, and flexible working hours.
  
  
Role Responsibilities
  
  
**Global Service Delivery and SLA Management**

* Lead the daily operation of the global GMP documentation service for DS, DP, or FDP, ensuring requests are received, clarified, prioritized, assigned, completed, and handed off in accordance with defined service-level agreements.
* Establish transparent intake, triage, prioritization, and escalation practices that balance site criticality, compliance risk, business impact, and available capacity.
* Develop and maintain capacity plans, workload forecasts, staffing models, and recovery plans that enable the team to meet commitments across supported sites and time zones.
* Own performance management routines and dashboards for on-time delivery, right-first-time quality, cycle time, queue aging, rework, customer feedback, and resource utilization.
* Identify service risks early, communicate impacts and options clearly, and escalate constraints with proposed mitigation and recovery actions.

**GMP Documentation Quality and Compliance**

* Ensure document creation and revision activities comply with applicable global and local GMP requirements, good documentation practices, data-integrity expectations, controlled-document procedures, and approved change-control processes.
* Set and maintain standards for document structure, technical writing, accuracy, traceability, version control, formatting, and review readiness to prevent defects before delivery.
* Oversee authoring and revision of controlled GMP documents, such as SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing and laboratory records, technical reports, and associated attachments, based on approved site inputs and change requirements.
* Oversee the content creation of training materials used in the manufacturing areas including instructional design.
* Implement appropriate peer review, quality checks, training, and escalation mechanisms to improve right-first-time acceptance and reduce avoidable rework.
* Support inspection and audit readiness; ensure service records, training, and performance evidence are complete, traceable, and review-ready.
* Oversee investigational support within the specific manufacturing domain.

**Global Partnership and Governance**

* Serve as the senior-manager-level liaison between the India documentation team and global site stakeholders, including Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, QC, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and other technical functions.
* Create effective governance forums with supported sites to review demand, priorities, service performance, quality trends, capacity needs, and improvement opportunities.
* Clarify and maintain accountability between the service team and site owners: the service team provides disciplined document development and revision support; site functions retain ownership of technical content, approvals, local requirements, and implementation decisions.
* Resolve complex cross-functional issues that could affect document quality, approval readiness, delivery timing, or compliance, using a risk-based approach.

**People Leadership and Organizational Capability**

* Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing team of GMP documentation professionals, technical writers, and/or documentation specialists.
* Establish role clarity, training curricula, performance expectations, career paths, and succession plans that build sustainable technical and leadership capability in India.
* Promote a culture of quality, ownership, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous learning while maintaining an inclusive, respectful, and accountable work environment.
* Partner with Human Resources and functional leaders to maintain an adaptable organization that can respond to changing global demand and business priorities.

**Operational Excellence and Strategic Improvement**

* Standardize and continuously improve documentation workflows, templates, authoring practices, quality controls, and digital ways of working across the service.
* Lead cross-site projects and improvement initiatives that increase speed, accuracy, scalability, and customer experience without compromising compliance.
* Manage departmental headcount, training, technology, and operating budgets; optimize resources against the long-range demand plan.
* Represent the documentation service on global teams, task forces, and quality-system initiatives as needed.

Service Performance and Quality Measures
  
  
The leader establishes goals and management routines that keep customer commitments, documentation quality, and compliance visible and balanced.
  
  
**Measure**
**Leadership expectation**
**On-time delivery**
Meet committed site service-level agreements through active planning, workload balancing, and early escalation of risks.
  
  
**Right-first-time quality**
Increase documents accepted without material rework by applying defined authoring standards, peer review, and quality checks before handoff.
  
  
**Cycle time and queue health**
Monitor turnaround time, aging, backlog, and prioritization to maintain a predictable global service.
  
  
**Compliance performance**
Maintain adherence to controlled-document, change-control, data-integrity, training, and audit-readiness requirements.
  
  
**Customer partnership and capacity**
Use site feedback, demand forecasts, and workload data to improve service reliability and plan resource needs.
  
  
*Service-level targets and acceptance criteria are defined in collaboration with the supported sites and governing quality processes.*
**Basic Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree and 12 to 17 years of experience
  
  
2 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs, or directing the allocation of resources.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, engineering, technical communications, business, or a related field.
* 7+ years of directly related experience in a biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical-device, or other regulated GMP environment, including 4+ years leading people, technical writers, documentation specialists, projects, or programs.
* Demonstrated experience developing and revising controlled GMP documents, including SOPs, work instructions, forms, manufacturing or laboratory records, and related technical documentation.
* Experience operating a shared service or customer-facing function across multiple sites, cultures, and time zones, with accountability for service-level agreements and delivery metrics.
* Experience with electronic document-management and quality-management systems, document lifecycles, change control, and inspection or audit support.
* Lean, continuous-improvement, project-management, or operational-excellence experience is preferred.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Strong people leadership, coaching, talent development, and capability building for a diverse technical team.
* Expert technical writing, editing, and review skills; sound judgment to distinguish content clarity, document quality, and compliance risk.
* In-depth knowledge of cGMP, good documentation practices, data integrity principles, controlled-document requirements, and change-management processes.
* Service-management discipline: intake, prioritization, workload planning, capacity modeling, performance dashboards, and timely risk escalation.
* Ability to influence global stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, communicate clearly in writing and verbally, and operate effectively across time zones.

description:
**About Us**

The Senior Change Management Analyst is an experienced individual contributor responsible for supporting ITIL-aligned IT change management. Reporting to the Change Manager, the role reviews and coordinates Requests for Change (RFCs), prepares CAB materials, maintains the change calendar, validates implementation readiness, supports stakeholder communications, monitors outcomes, and recommends continual improvements. The role does not own enterprise change policy, manage people, or serve as final approver for high-risk changes unless formally delegated.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Support consistent, ITIL-aligned execution of the change process under direction of the Change Manager.
* Review RFCs for completeness, risk, impact, approvals, testing evidence, implementation steps, validation criteria, communications, and rollback planning.
* Coordinate with change owners, technical teams, service owners, release teams, incident management, vendors.
* Maintain accurate change records, calendar entries, meeting notes, decision logs, and audit-ready evidence. Escalate scheduling conflicts, readiness gaps, policy exceptions, high-risk changes, and change-related incidents.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Change Governance and RFC Quality**

* Apply approved change policies, procedures, templates, workflows, risk models, and approval paths in daily change activities.
* Review RFCs for business justification, scope, affected services, dependencies, outage needs, approvals, implementation, validation, and backout plans.
* Return incomplete or unclear records to change owners and document required corrections according to process guidelines.
* Verify correct classification and routing for standard, normal, emergency, expedited, major, minor, vendor release-related, infrastructure, application, cloud, security, and vendor-driven changes.

**CAB and Change Meeting Support**

* Prepare CAB agendas, change summaries, risk highlights, schedule views, meeting materials, and decision documentation.
* Assist the Change Manager with facilitation, timekeeping, risk callouts, notes, follow-up tracking, deferrals, approvals, and action items.
* Escalate high-risk, high-impact, conflicting, business-critical, or poorly documented changes before CAB review.

**Risk, Impact, and Readiness Assessment**

* Evaluate readiness based on service impact, technical complexity, outage duration, customer impact, security exposure, data sensitivity, dependencies, and rollback feasibility.
* Constructively challenge weak implementation plans, inadequate testing evidence, incomplete dependency analysis, missing communications, or unrealistic rollback steps.
* Escalate unresolved concerns, policy exceptions, and changes requiring additional review by service owners, cybersecurity, compliance, release management, or business stakeholders.

**Calendar, Scheduling, and Communications**

* Maintain the enterprise change calendar and monitor maintenance windows, blackout periods, and resource constraints.
* Identify collisions, overlapping outages, resource conflicts, and competing implementation windows; coordinate schedule alignment with release, project, application, infrastructure, cloud, security, vendor, and operations teams.
* Draft and distribute approved communications; ensure service desk and support teams understand outage windows, expected symptoms, business impact, workarounds, and escalation contacts.

**Emergency Change, PIR, Metrics, and Tooling**

* Support emergency changes by verifying urgency, risk, approvals, implementation details, validation, communications, and after-the-fact documentation.
* Support post-implementation reviews for failed, backed-out, emergency, high-risk, major, or incident-causing changes; document lessons learned, corrective actions, owners, due dates, and follow-up status.
* Prepare dashboards, trend summaries, audit evidence, and KPI reporting for success rate, failed changes, emergency volume, unauthorized changes, change-related incidents, approval cycle time, standard adoption, and CAB action closure.
* Use ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar ITSM tools to review, route, schedule, document, report, and audit changes; recommend workflow, notification, dashboard, template, and automation improvements.

**YOUR PROFILE**
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5 or more years in IT service management, IT operations, infrastructure support, application support, release management, project coordination, or production support.
* 3 or more years of hands-on experience supporting an enterprise IT change management process.
* Current ITIL certification required, preferably ITIL 4 Foundation or higher.
* Experience reviewing RFCs, maintaining change calendars, preparing CAB materials, supporting emergency changes, and documenting post-implementation review outcomes.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or comparable ITSM platforms.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices, including change enablement, incident, problem, service request, configuration, release, service level, and continual improvement.
* Ability to translate technical information into business impact, risk, operational readiness, and stakeholder communication requirements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for meeting notes, status updates, process documentation, and stakeholder communications.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL 4 Practitioner: Change Enablement.
* Experience in regulated or audit-driven environments such as Financial Services.
* Experience supporting cloud, hybrid infrastructure, cybersecurity, network, application, database, endpoint, and enterprise platform changes.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release automation, infrastructure as code, automated testing, and automated change approval models.
* Working knowledge of ISO 27001, SOC1, SOC 2, GDPR, or similar control frameworks.
* Experience creating dashboards and analytics using ServiceNow Performance Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, Excel, or similar tools.
* Experience supporting standard change models, risk scoring frameworks, process training materials, and stakeholder communication templates.

**Required Technical Skills And Core Competencies**

* ITSM and Change: ITIL-aligned workflows, RFC quality, classifications, approvals, calendars, risk assessment, and closure.
* Risk Judgment: Identifies service, business, technical, security, compliance, and scheduling risks before implementation.
* Service Tools: Use ITSM tools to review, route, schedule, document, report, and audit change records.
* Process Discipline: Applies governance consistently while keeping the process practical and understandable.
* Technology Ops: Working knowledge of infrastructure, applications, networks, databases, cloud, cybersecurity, endpoints, and production support.
* Accountability: Follows up, maintains accurate records, meets deadlines, and escalates unresolved risks properly.
* Reporting: Create and interpret dashboards, KPI summaries, trend reports, data quality checks, and audit evidence.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Builds effective relationships across technical teams, service owners, vendors, audit, and business stakeholders.
* Documentation: Create clear meeting notes, change summaries, process guidance, work instructions, and communications.
* Communication: Explains technical change activity clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Collaboration Tools:Microsoft Office, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, Visio, or equivalent tools.
* Continuous Improvement: Simplifies workflows, standardizes repeatable work, improves templates, and reduces rework.

**What We Offer**
We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
  
  
Our industry-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
  
  
**Our Global Benefits Also Include**

* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location

title: Quality, Health, Safety and Environment (QHSE) Officer/Safety Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose:**

To establish, implement, maintain and continually improve Sara Interiors Pvt. Ltd.’s integrated Quality, Health, Safety and Environment (QHSE) arrangements across interior fit-out, refurbishment, office and bank rollouts, MEP coordination and turnkey projects. The role supports consistent quality delivery, prevention of injuries and occupational ill health, prevention of pollution, compliance with applicable requirements, effective contractor control and reliable project handover.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**> Quality assurance and quality control:**

·  Develop, implement and maintain project quality plans, inspection and test plans (ITPs), checklists, method statements and quality records in coordination with Project Managers and site teams.

·  Review contract requirements, approved drawings, specifications, finish schedules, samples, mock-ups and acceptance criteria before work begins.

·  Coordinate material submittals and approvals; verify deliveries against approved specifications, purchase orders, certificates and condition requirements.

·  Plan and conduct site quality inspections for relevant fit-out activities, including partitions, ceilings, flooring, joinery, painting, glazing, fixtures and MEP interfaces.

·  Ensure hold points and witness points are identified and released before work is concealed or proceeds to the next stage.

·  Raise and track nonconformance reports (NCRs), defects and snags; coordinate root-cause analysis, corrective action, reinspection and closure.

·  Monitor rework, repeat defects, inspection acceptance and material damage; recommend preventive actions and lessons learned.

·  Maintain traceable quality records, test results, approved submittals, as-built information, operation and maintenance documents, warranties and handover evidence.

>
**Health and safety management:**

·  Maintain project HSE plans, hazard identification and risk assessments (HIRA), job safety analyses (JSA), safe work methods and permit-to-work arrangements.

·  Identify and control risks associated with work at height, electrical activities, hot work, power tools, lifting and manual handling, dust, chemicals, concealed services and work in occupied premises.

·  Verify that contractors and subcontractors provide competent personnel, appropriate training, inspected equipment, suitable PPE, task risk assessments and method statements.

·  Coordinate inductions, toolbox talks, safety briefings, worker consultation and communication of changing site conditions.

·  Conduct site inspections and audits; record findings, assign corrective actions and verify closure.

·  Coordinate emergency preparedness, first-aid and fire arrangements, evacuation routes, emergency contacts and drills in line with client/building procedures.

·  Ensure incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions and occupational health concerns are reported, investigated and followed by corrective action.

·  Exercise stop-work authority or escalate immediately when serious risk, missing critical controls or unsafe conditions are identified.

**> Environmental management:**

·  Maintain project environmental aspects-and-impacts registers and environmental management plans.

·  Implement controls for waste segregation, reuse and recycling, authorised waste handling, dust, noise, odour, spills, chemical storage and drain protection.

·  Promote efficient use of materials, water and energy and reduction of packaging, damage and avoidable rework.

·  Verify that waste and special/hazardous waste streams are handled through appropriate approved or authorised routes where required; retain collection and transfer records.

·  Respond to environmental incidents and complaints, coordinate containment and clean-up, investigate causes and track corrective actions.

**> Integrated management system and compliance:**

·  Support development, implementation and maintenance of the Integrated Management System (IMS) aligned with ISO 9001 (Quality), ISO 14001 (Environment) and ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety), where adopted by the company.

·  Maintain controlled policies, procedures, registers, forms, records and revision history; ensure current approved documents are available to relevant users.

·  Identify applicable legal, statutory, regulatory, client, landlord and contractual requirements with competent internal or external support; maintain compliance evidence.

·  Plan and coordinate internal audits, site inspections, management reviews and follow-up actions.

·  Monitor objectives and KPIs, analyse trends, report significant risks and performance to management, and recommend improvement actions.

·  Coordinate certification readiness and external audit logistics when directed; ensure the certification body remains independent and that no certification status is claimed before it is granted.

**> Project and contractor coordination:**

·  Integrate quality and HSE requirements into project mobilisation, procurement, work sequencing, coordination meetings and project close-out.

·  Review contractor work plans and coordinate interfaces between trades, especially ceiling closure, service penetrations, electrical energisation, hot work, deliveries and occupied-area work.

·  Coordinate with clients, project management consultants, designers, building management and subcontractors on inspections, permits, access, shutdowns and acceptance requirements.

·  Ensure lessons learned from defects, incidents, complaints and audits are communicated and reflected in updated controls and training.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

·  Degree or diploma in engineering, construction, quality, occupational safety, environmental management or a related discipline; relevant statutory safety qualification where required for the assigned role.

·  Relevant experience in construction, interior fit-out, commercial projects, facilities or MEP coordination; seniority to reflect company-wide versus site-only responsibility.

·  Working knowledge of quality planning, inspection/testing, NCR and corrective action, contractor management, risk assessment, permit-to-work and environmental controls.

·  Familiarity with ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 requirements and integrated management system documentation.

·  Experience conducting site inspections, audits, incident investigations, toolbox talks, KPI reporting and client/contractor coordination.

·  Ability to read drawings/specifications, maintain records, prepare reports and communicate clearly with office and site personnel.

**Skills & Competencies we look for:**

·  Practical risk-based decision-making and visible site leadership.

·  Strong documentation, inspection, audit and follow-up discipline.

·  Clear communication, worker engagement and contractor coordination.

·  Problem-solving, root-cause analysis and corrective-action verification.

·  Ability to balance quality, safety, environmental controls and programme requirements without bypassing critical controls.

·  Professional integrity, impartial reporting and commitment to continual improvement.

**Documented records and maintained or coordinated:**

·  Project quality plan, ITPs, inspection requests, checklists, test records, material submittals and approvals.

·  NCR, snag, concession/deviation and corrective-action registers.

·  HIRA/JSA, method statements, permit records, induction, training, toolbox talks and equipment inspection records.

·  Environmental aspects register, waste records, SDS, spill/incident reports, complaint log and environmental inspection records.

·  Legal/client compliance register, audit reports, management review actions and KPI dashboards.

·  Project handover index, test/commissioning records, as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties and acceptance records.

* 2–5 years of experience in data governance, data management, analytics, or a related field.

description:

MSCI Sustainability & Climate Data collection team is involved in acquisition of Sustainability & Climate data at scale and QA of the collected data and responsible for establishing and maintaining highest level of data quality and standards across all datasets feeding our ESG products. As an Data Collection Transformation Associate, you will be responsible for delivering on initiatives as part of the S&C transformation agenda. * Revolutionize Data Collection with AI: Design and implement AI-assisted, scalable models that streamline data sourcing from multiple channels, ensuring comprehensive coverage of issuers.
* Automate & Scale Data Methodologies: Develop innovative, automation-friendly data collection methodologies that convert unstructured data into structured insights through advanced AI-driven “electronification.”
* Engineer Next-Gen AI Models: Build and refine generative AI-powered data extraction models, ensuring continuous improvement in accuracy, efficiency, and performance.
* Lead & Optimize AI Agents: Manage, guide, and enhance AI agents, serving as a validation layer to improve outputs and refine AI-generated insights through expert feedback.
* Shape the Future of Data Operations: Partner with technology and transformation teams to design, optimize, and engineer cutting-edge data workflows and operational processes.
* Enhance Data Quality & Efficiency: Drive automation initiatives that improve data quality diagnostics, reducing manual intervention and increasing operational efficiency
* Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with internal stakeholders and downstream teams to understand data needs, define quality control frameworks, and ensure seamless data delivery.
* Engage with Companies & Clients: Review and process company feedback, address client queries, and contribute to a transparent, data-driven ecosystem that powers critical decision-making.

* Experience of leading the projects to completion and working with stakeholders and team members
* Experience applying GenAI/LLMs for data extraction, summarization, classification, or workflow automation; ability to build prompt‑based workflows and evaluate model output.

* Hands‑on experience with Python for automation, web scraping, API integration, data cleaning, and high‑volume processing.
* Working knowledge of SQL and comfort handling large datasets.
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to interpret complex corporate disclosures and extract meaningful supply‑chain insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple time zones and collaborate with cross‑functional partners

title: Expert Writer, Medical Content Development
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!
  
  
Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.
  
  
**Job Description**
**THE POSITION:**
At EVERSANA, our integrated life sciences compliance team is taking a leading role in helping some of the most scientifically advanced Biopharma and research companies around the world to innovate novel therapies for rare, ultra-rare and a range of critical therapeutic areas including Oncology, Neurology, Immuno-oncology, Immunology etc. This role is within the EVERSANA Compliance team reporting directly to the Manager, Medical Content Development. This person will also collaborate very closely with other team members with in the EVERSANA Compliance Business Unit (Medical Information, Medical Affairs, Pharmacovigilance, Regulatory and Quality).
  
  
The position will support various types of clients including pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, digital therapeutics, and over-the-counter companies. This includes companies of various sizes and, in particular, small and emerging companies. Position is responsible for content development-related client engagements.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:
  
  

* Plays an essential role supporting Manager, Medical Content Development on content development-related engagements for integrated and complete commercialization deals as well as for clients who require medical information or medical affairs consulting services outside of EVERSANA’s complete commercialization partnerships.
* Writes and creates medical and scientific content related to Medical Affairs, Medical Information and Medical Communications including, but not limited to, Scientific Response Documents (SRD), Frequently Asked Question (FAQ) documents, Slide Sets, Abstracts, Posters, Education and Training materials, and others for potential clients.
* Drives the client document development process from gathering materials and developing scientifically rigorous content to facilitating document review and discussions at medical, legal, regulatory (MLR) review meetings.
* Works with EVERSANA and/or client-provided document management technology platforms (i.e., Veeva PromoMats / MedComms, etc.) as content owner when appropriate, uploading documents, providing reference anchoring and annotations as required.
* May be called up to perform scientific data fact checking for documents in support of medical reviewers participating in MLR teams.
* Collaborates with Manager, Medical Content Development and contributes to discussions on strategy, tactical execution and communication approaches for assigned projects.
* Participates in key client meetings as assigned.
* Supports preparation of thought leadership articles, newsletter, publications, congress presentations, slides, and blogs related to the medical content services and practices.
* Supports creating/updating the SOPs, checklists, templates, style guides, and guidance documents as necessary.
* Mentoring and coaching team members. Support hiring and onboarding as necessary.
* Stays knowledgeable of industry best practices and supports leadership team in evaluating and implementing new technologies and procedures to improve operational efficiency and quality of materials developed.
* Works collaboratively with other medical writers and creative teams across EVERSANA.
* All other duties as assigned

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.*
**Expectations Of The Job**

* Responsible to deliver CLIENT DELIGHT
* Responsible to identify, deploy, oversees, mentor direct reports and consultants supporting various clients
* Responsible to work collaboratively with EVERSANA medical information and medical affairs team and take direction and feedback from management and clients
* Responsible to ensure management and compliance with industry standards and codes of practice
* Able to work independently to develop high-quality, scientifically accurate, strategically aligned, ethical, and compliant medical content
* Responsible to proactively flag and manage any quality issues, and ensure timely corrective and preventive actions
* Travel – Up to 10% (only post COVID).
* Hours – Average 40+ hours/week.

**Qualifications**
**MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**
The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.
  
  

* PharmD (or M. Pharm. or M.S. Pharm), PhD, or MD with medical writing and content development experience
* Minimum of 4 years of experience within the life science and/or pharmaceutical industry with extensive medical writing and content development experience
* Direct Medical Information / Medical Communications / Scientific Communications experience
* Exceptional communication skills including, written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills including the ability to independently interpret and summarize complex results.
* Ability to effectively interface with all levels of management and staff and to succeed in a matrix team setting while meeting or exceeding timelines.
* Familiarity with AMA Style guide as well as an understanding of clinical research principles and applied statistics. Familiarity with International Committee of Medical Journal Editors (ICMJE), Good Publication Practices (GPP), and other medical publishing guidelines (e.g., Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA), Strengthening the Reporting of Observational Studies in Epidemiology (STROBE), Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials (CONSORT), etc.
* Proficient editing skills along with expertise in Microsoft Office, Acrobat and other applications.
* Experience conducting literature searches and working with tools such as PubMed, Ovid, Embase, etc.
* Experience working with reference management and citation software (e.g., EndNote, Mendeley, Citavi, etc.)
* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and best practices in relationship to Medical Information, Medical Affairs and promotional and non-promotional materials review
* Excellent project management skills and proven track record of being results driven; ability to manage
* Ability to conceptualize, design and deliver best in class solutions
* Highly Principled - Proves to be a professional of unquestionable integrity, credibility and character who demonstrates high moral and ethical behavior
* Collaboration – Ability to work cross functionality across EVERSANA business units and with various clients, including leadership and various departments and functions of our clients
* Agile learning – Ability to support and learn about multiple disease states and therapeutic areas.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing medical content, especially Medical Information materials, for new product launch
* Experience publishing abstracts, posters, manuscripts
* Experience working across multiple therapeutic areas
* Experience working with Veeva Vault MedComms / Promomats

**Additional Information**
**OUR CULTURAL BELIEFS:**
**Patient Minded**
I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.
  
  
**Client Delight**
I own every client experience and its impact on results.
  
  
**Take Action**
I am empowered and empower others to act now.
  
  
**Grow Talent**
I own my development and invest in the development of others.
  
  
**Win Together**
I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.
  
  
**Communication Matters**
I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.
  
  
**Embrace Diversity**
I create an environment of awareness and respect.
  
  
**Always Innovate**
I am bold and creative in everything I do.
  
  
Our team is aware of recent fraudulent job offers in the market, misrepresenting EVERSANA. Recruitment fraud is a sophisticated scam commonly perpetrated through online services using fake websites, unsolicited e-mails, or even text messages claiming to be a legitimate company. Some of these scams request personal information and even payment for training or job application fees. Please know EVERSANA would never require personal information nor payment of any kind during the employment process. We respect the personal rights of all candidates looking to explore careers at EVERSANA.
  
  
From EVERSANA’s inception, Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds who share a passion for improving the lives of patients and leading innovation within the healthcare industry. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion, and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees’ points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

description:

At PadCare, we’re on a mission to make hygiene sustainable. Founded in 2018, we have developed India’s first patented sanitary napkin recycling technology—PadCareX.

But we’re not just solving a waste problem, we’re building a circular economy that champions environmental resilience and social equity. Our service model closes the loop starting from collection, recycling, and transforming single-use sanitary napkins into sustainable materials, while also creating dignified jobs for marginalized waste workers, especially women, across the country.

With 100+ changemakers across 25+ cities, PadCare is driving real impact—for people and the planet. Recognized by Forbes, the World Economic Forum, and more, we believe business can be a force for good. If you do too, PadCare is where your purpose finds a home.

Oh, and you must have seen us on an episode of Shark Tank India, Season 2 - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q0cmPtpJRo

To learn more about the work that PadCare is doing, check out the website: www.padcarelabs.com

**Role overview & Key Responsibilities:**

We are hiring a full-time Product Analyst to own modules of our internal Order-to-Cash platform, end to end, working directly with the Product Lead. The core of the role is building requirements: understanding the business process, identifying its gaps, and structuring it into a complete system module that accounts for every case, validation and dependency. You will also test what gets built and make sure the delivered solution matches what was defined.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Requirement building (core)

• Understand business workflows across Sales, Onboarding, Operations and Finance, and identify

process gaps and inefficiencies

• Structure each process into a system module with clear flows and flow charts

• Cover every scenario the module must handle (standard, exception and edge cases) before it

goes to development

• Define fields and data structures, validation rules, dependencies and conditions

• Own and maintain the functional specification for each assigned module

2. Testing and quality assurance

• Write and execute functional test cases for every release

• Run end-to-end workflow testing and user acceptance testing (UAT)

• Log, prioritise and re-test bugs through the periodic bug-fix cycles

3. Development partner coordination

• Work with the external development team on assigned modules

• Track tasks, follow-ups and requirement clarifications

• Ensure the delivered solution matches the defined requirement

4. Data checks for owned modules

• Validate data for the modules you own, including post-go-live accuracy checks

• Work alongside the data management team where module data is involved

**What we're looking for:**

**Must-have**

• 1–3 years in a product, business analyst or functional/QA role on software or ERP projects

• Hands-on experience writing functional specs or BRDs and test cases

• Experience working with development teams through build, testing and release

• Strong analytical and logical thinking; able to structure problems into clear workflows

• Basic understanding of APIs and system design: data flow, validations, logic layers

• Attention to detail and execution focus

• Clear communication across business and tech teams

**Good-to-have**

• Exposure to ERP tools, especially Zoho Books

• Familiarity with Order-to-Cash or billing processes

• Basic SQL

• Exposure to AI or automation use cases (document processing, workflow automation)

Tools you will use

• HTML (basic UI understanding)

• AI tools for productivity and documentation

• Excel and basic analytics tools

**Culture Fit:**
Must align with PadCare’s values – Integrity, Entrepreneurship, Collaboration, Customer-First, Innovation.

**Work Mode:**
Full-time; based in Pune.

**Why join us:**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive salary in line with industry standards.
* **Growth Path:**
  Opportunity to scale into Head of Research and beyond as PadCare expands globally.
* **Purpose With Impact:**
  Join a mission-driven team transforming menstrual hygiene through sustainable solutions that uplift women’s health, the environment, and sanitation workers' dignity.
* **Eco-Warrior in Action:**
  Help recycle millions of sanitary pads and actively reduce landfill waste and carbon emissions—real impact, not just buzzwords.
* **Innovation Meets Heart:**
  Be part of a team that blends empathy with patented 5D recycling tech to build the future of circular economy.
* **Grow With Us:**
  We’re a fast-gowing, venture-backed startup offering real opportunities to scale your career as we scale our impact.

title: Senior Application Engineer: Mobility Systems and Integration
description:
**Who We Are:**

Gamma Technologies (GT), the global leader in multi-physics system simulation software, develops a suite of integrated solutions designed to guide and accelerate the engineering transformation of today’s products. Fusing advanced physics with AI algorithms, our platform, GT-SUITE, is used to simulate a broad range of systems from early-stage development to digital twin applications across multiple industries including transportation and mobility, marine, aerospace and defense, power and energy, data centers and HVACR.

At GT, our people are the driving force behind our success. We are looking for a Senior Application Engineer: Mobility Systems and Integration, who shares our passion for authentic innovation, trusted partnerships, bold decisions and a relentless focus on customer success.

**What You Will Do**

You will join our Applications Team to help our customers get the most out of our solutions and to leverage the knowledge learned from these interactions to continuously improve our software GT-SUITE, a sophisticated desktop software package for simulating almost any kind of engineering multi-physics system. As part of our mobility systems and integration team, you will focus on solutions for vehicle systems and their integration with multiple domains such as drivetrain, thermal management, and controls. This is an opportunity to contribute to the automotive and other transportation industry and more specifically the development of electrified powertrains by means of simulation.

* Assist customers in their use of GT-SUITE software to simulate mobility systems, such as ground vehicles, off-highway, marine, rail systems, and aviation
* Use customer feedback and interaction to design and test new GT-SUITE product features related to simulation methodologies, specifically related to mobility systems, energy management, and multi-physics integration
* Opportunity to develop solutions to assist customers in advancing their simulation capability and thereby reduce reliance on physical testing
* Opportunity to research, design, prototype, and test software features to improve GT-SUITE model deployment workflows
* Demonstrate cutting edge software solutions for vehicle performance, energy management and systems integration to prospective customers
* Interact with established and emerging automotive companies through software evaluations, training classes, conferences, and marketing events
* Help evangelize the critical role Gamma Technologies plays in helping the industry on the Road to Zero Carbon



**What You Will Bring**

* Master’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent is required
* 5+ years of professional, post-graduate-level experience in mobility systems development or 1D modeling for model, software, or hardware in the loop applications
* Proficiency in GT-SUITE for system or component simulation
* Hands-on experience with GenAI based concepts and prompt engineering is a plus
* Knowledge of Machine Learning techniques is a plus
* Previous working experience with cloud and distributed computing technologies is a plus

**What We Can Offer You**

* Dynamic, supportive and highly talented team of experts
* The opportunity to bring in your own ideas, implement them and make them accessible to a large customer base
* The opportunity to build a professional network in various branches of industry
* The primary work location will be our Pune, India office. We’ve adopted a hybrid work policy asking employees to report to the office 3 days per work week
* An attractive salary and additional company benefits
* A friendly, collaborative, and supportive work culture that is truly unique within the industry

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer, dedicated to creating an inclusive workplace for all.

title: Business Consultant COE
description:
**Job Description**
The Business Consultant will be part of the Honeywell AutonomyX Center of Excellence (CoE) based in Pune, India, and will play an active role in developing and executing business consulting activities for Middle East, Turkey, and Central Asia (META) region opportunities, with flexibility to engage other regions depending on workload. This role will combine selective front-office ownership of qualified customer opportunities with back-office business development, analysis, proposal, and value-storyline execution in partnership with the Middle East business consulting team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Business development and selective opportunity leadership for META digital transformation programs for operating companies:
* Co-lead opportunity development for Honeywell AutonomyX and related transformation programs across META, working closely with the Middle East business consulting lead and regional sales teams, including

+ Research customer operating models, business priorities, performance improvement levers, and digital/autonomy transformation opportunities
+ Translate customer challenges into structured consulting problem statements linked to Honeywell and AutonomyX solutions
+ Own preparation of executive engagement materials, value hypotheses, customer narratives, and account-specific storylines for selected pursuits
+ Lead or actively participate in selected customer-facing discussions and workshops, including preparation, facilitation, documentation, and follow-up from Pune or on site when required
+ Own customer-ready material including value propositions, executive summaries, business cases, case studies, and sales enablement content for assigned opportunities
+ Lead preparation and follow-through for selected regional demonstrations, conferences, campaigns, and strategic pursuits

* Drive go-to-market planning inputs, account prioritization, white-space analysis, customer segmentation for Honeywell AutonomyX and Process Automation
* Consulting workshops, studies and execution ownership
* Lead or co-lead scoping of customer diagnostic exercises, workshops, value assessments, and consulting studies for selected META opportunities
* Develop consulting proposals, workshop agendas, data request lists, workplans, interview guides, and analysis frameworks with appropriate regional input
* Coordinate and drive inputs from technical, sales, and solution teams to produce structured consulting deliverables
* Own the development of diagnostic reports, gap analyses, business cases, value roadmaps, maturity assessments, and adoption plans for assigned workstreams
* Drive follow-up actions, maintain opportunity documentation, and lead handover from consulting discovery into sales execution where assigned
* CoE capability building and organizational enablement
* Build and continuously improve repeatable AutonomyX consulting assets, templates, value frameworks, and proposal content within the Pune CoE
* Lead selected internal enablement activities for value-based selling and consulting-led opportunity development across META
* Share best practices, case studies, and reusable methods with regional sales, consulting, and solution teams

**Qualifications**
**Skills and qualifications**

* Prior consulting experience with a leading consulting firm at Associate level or equivalent, including strategy, operations, transformation, digital, or value-creation work. Alternatively MBA from a leading business school
* Prior experience in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, refining, petrochemicals, or other process industries preferred
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical engineering discipline preferred; Chemical Engineering is desirable, although other relevant engineering disciplines will be considered
* Preferred experience in running or contributing to operational transformation programs, performance improvement initiatives, digital transformation programs, or operating model improvement efforts
* Demonstrated ability to lead defined consulting workstreams, customer workshops, or opportunity development activities with senior stakeholder exposure
* Strong written communication and executive-presentation preparation skills, with ability to create clear customer-facing narratives and C-suite-ready materials
* Strong analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to structure ambiguous business problems, identify customer value levers, and translate analysis into actionable recommendations
* Strong quantitative skills, including business case development, financial modelling, scenario planning, benchmarking, and value analysis
* Ability to work effectively from Pune with META stakeholders across time zones, balancing independent ownership, remote collaboration, and selected customer-facing engagement
* Ability to travel to Middle East selectively for high-value customer workshops, internal alignment sessions, and strategic pursuits as required

**Value proposition of role**

* Opportunity to help shape the AutonomyX CoE in Pune while taking ownership of selected strategic growth opportunities in the META region
* Blend of customer-facing consulting leadership and high-impact strategy, proposal, analysis, and execution ownership
* High visibility to regional business consulting, sales, and leadership teams through direct contribution to priority transformation pursuits
* Exposure to globally leading operating companies in the Middle East that are at the forefront of technology transformation, autonomy, and next-generation industrial operations
* Strong platform to develop expertise in autonomy, digital transformation, industrial operations, and value-based selling
* Role offers a broad problem-solving, business case, and opportunity-leadership remit across multiple industries and customer situations
* Selective travel intensity compared with pure front-office consulting, while retaining meaningful ownership of strategic customer engagements

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.
