title: Specialist - Commercial Standards Claims & Contract
description:
**Job Description**
**Specialist — Commercial Standards, Claims & Contracts is a Business Analyst and SME on the Customer Operations Transformation programme.**
The outcome is a clear, governed set of commercial policies — credit, claims, pricing and trade terms — and customer agreements that are standard, compliant and correctly executed in the systems; fewer and cleaner customer claims; lower invalid deductions and trade-spend leakage; and <1 Day Resolution wherever the process allows: fewer claims arising in the first place, and faster, controlled settlement for those that remain. Everything this role does serves that outcome.
  
  
The scope spans Commercial Standards, Claims and Contracts end to end — formulation and governance of credit, claims, pricing and trade-terms policies, policy exceptions and delegation of authority, the customer agreement and contract lifecycle (drafting, approval, activation, amendment and renewal), pricing, rebate, discount and promotion setup, accruals, claims intake, validation and settlement, proof of performance, and the controls that link agreed terms to what is invoiced and paid. The role designs across this scope as one process rather than as separate contract, promotion and claims solutions. It works with market Commercial, Revenue Growth Management, Sales Finance, Credit, Legal, Internal Control, Customer Service and Collections teams, GBO, D&T, the SAP and Control Tower (Claims and Deduction platform) teams and third-party vendors.
  
  
The role combines 5 capabilities in one person. As an SME, they formulate, document the global commercial policies — credit policy (credit limits, payment terms, risk categories, blocks and releases), claims policy (eligibility, evidence, time limits, approval and write-off thresholds), and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount and rebate guardrails, price-change control) — and the standards and controls that make them work in practice. As a business analyst, they interrogate contract, trade-terms, accrual, claims and deduction data, document current and target process, and write requirements to standard. As a subject matter expert, they bring the functional depth to act as design authority for the fragment and to challenge solutions that would not work in the markets. As a sprint or project owner, they take a scope fragment through design, test and deployment on a two to four week value drop cadence. As a process and technology expert, they translate commercial policy, contract terms and controls into working design on SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, Control Tower claims and deduction capability, and the contract and trade promotion management toolset.
  
  
**The defining discipline of this role is designing claims out at source, not processing them faster.**
A quicker claim approval is a smaller prize than a contract term clear enough never to be disputed; a faster settlement is a smaller prize than a promotion set up correctly in the system so the customer never needs to claim. The postholder is expected to use the data to find where in the commercial process claims are created — an ambiguous contract clause, a non-standard trade term, a late or incorrect pricing or promotion setup, an accrual gap, a weak approval control — and design the fix upstream into commercial policy, standards, contract templates, deal approval and master data, as well as into the claims and settlement design.
  
  
**Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role.**
A claim usually starts life as a commercial negotiation; a contract term becomes a pricing condition, an accrual, an invoice and, if anything is misaligned, a deduction in Collections. The postholder is expected to know what happens on either side of their own process — from deal negotiation through to cash and the P&L — and to design accordingly.
  
  
**This is a transformation design and delivery role, not an operational one.**
The postholder does not negotiate customer deals, draft or approve individual contracts, validate or settle individual claims, or manage customer relationships; that stays with market Commercial, Legal, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done — including the commercial policies, standards, contract templates, reason codes, analytics and controls that let run teams find and remove causes in BAU. The role formulates and recommends policy; final approval sits with the relevant policy owners and governance forums.
  
  
The role works independently within an agreed frame set by the workstream lead, gathers its own data, forms its own view and brings recommendations rather than questions. Where a Senior Specialist is assigned on the same fragment, it works under their design direction. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS.
  
  
**Analyse commercial terms, contracts and claims performance and baseline the problem — 25%.**
Document current-state credit, claims and pricing policies, commercial standards, contract lifecycle and claims processes across markets and identify variation from the global standard. Build the process, trade-terms and claim-type taxonomy and interrogate the data directly at portfolio level — customer agreements and terms, pricing and promotion conditions, accruals versus actuals, claims volume, value, ageing and rejection rates, invalid deductions, write-offs and trade-spend leakage — to baseline the problem per market and size the opportunity. Perform gap analysis between current process, commercial policy, contract terms, platform capability, controls and the target operating model, separating structural design issues from operational backlog. Support business-rule validation, master-data requirements and policy analysis. Aim for validated current-state documentation and a defensible baseline that will stand up to audit.
  
  
**Formulate commercial policies and standards, and design claims out at source — 25%.**
Support future-state design aligned to the global standard, always designing for the cause rather than the symptom. Formulate, document and maintain the global commercial policies the design depends on — credit policy (credit limits and risk categorisation, payment terms, credit blocks and release authority), claims policy (claim eligibility, evidence and proof-of-performance requirements, submission time limits, validation, approval and write-off thresholds) and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount, rebate and promotion guardrails, price-change control and margin protection) — with a clear policy-exception and delegation-of-authority framework, and take them through the governance forums for approval. Translate policy into the standards that operationalise it: standard trade-terms structures, contract and agreement templates, clause libraries, deal approval and delegation-of-authority rules, and the minimum data a contract must carry to be executed correctly in the systems. Use the baseline to show where claims are created — contract ambiguity, non-standard terms, pricing and promotion setup, accruals, proof of performance, master data — and design the fix upstream. Design the interventions: standard contract-to-condition setup, automated accruals and settlement, validated claim intake, reason-code frameworks and claims workflow. Prepare business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, business rules and user stories. Facilitate design workshops and document outcomes and decisions. Assess process, policy, financial and control impacts, and define how policy compliance will be monitored.
  
  
Deliver the outcome: standard contracts, fewer claims and <1 Day Resolution — 20%. Design for, and evidence, policy adoption and compliance across markets, an increase in contracts on standard terms and templates, fewer policy exceptions, a reduction in claims volume, aged claims, invalid deductions and trade-spend leakage, and movement toward <1 Day Resolution for appropriate claims and queries. Shape the build-out of SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, Control Tower claims and deduction functionality, and contract and trade promotion management tooling as the primary levers on the outcome. Define the measures with the business owner, monitor post-go-live performance against the baseline, and recommend and, where owned, implement continuous improvements to the design. This is the accountability every other accountability serves.
  
  
**Own testing, deployment and adoption through the value drops — 20%.**
Translate requirements into working design on SAP, Control Tower and the contract and trade promotion management toolset with D&T, system integrators and vendors. Define and review test scenarios, support SIT and UAT, and manage defect resolution with business users. Break the work into fragments that can be delivered on the value drop cadence, and own the backlog, dependencies and risks for the fragment. Support deployment, hypercare and business readiness, and hand over up-to-date commercial standards, contract templates, process documentation, SOPs, controls and training materials to the run teams. Aim for SIT and UAT completed with minimal post-go-live defects and a clean handover into run.
  
  
**Manage delivery discipline and enable across the programme — 10%.**
Track requirements, risks, assumptions, dependencies and decisions throughout the lifecycle, and escalate early and precisely when the frame is wrong. Act as a trusted partner to market Commercial, Revenue Growth Management, Sales Finance, Credit, Legal, Internal Control, Customer Service, GBO, D&T and vendors, and coach business users through testing, deployment and adoption. Enable the adjacent workstreams — Order-to-Invoice, Collections, Claims & Receivables, Customer Service and Supply — by surfacing cross-boundary impact before it becomes a deployment defect, and by handing design-level root causes to the workstream that owns them.
  
  

* Commercial Standards, Claims & Contracts domain depth and business analysis, on a broad Customer Operations base. Real SME depth in commercial policy and customer contracts — credit policy and credit risk, claims policy, pricing governance, trade-terms structures, rebates, discounts and promotions, contract lifecycle management, accruals, and claims validation and settlement — sufficient to act as design authority and to write policy that is clear, enforceable and auditable, combined with strong business-analysis craft: process mapping, requirements gathering, gap analysis, functional-specification writing, user stories and workshop facilitation. Understands how claims and deductions are created across the commercial and Order to Cash process, and how contract wording, deal approval, pricing and promotion setup, master data and accruals drive them. Built on a general understanding of Customer Operations end-to-end (Order to Cash, Commercial and Supply) and of how markets actually work, including upstream and downstream impact. Knows Consumer Products industry standards and the realities of Beer, Wine & Spirits — distributor and wholesaler concentration, complex customer agreements, promotional and trade-spend claims, and route-to-market and regulatory constraints on trade terms. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards.
* Data, technology and delivery discipline. Comfortable interrogating contract, trade-terms, accrual, claims and deduction data directly, and translating requirements into working design on SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, the Control Tower claims and deduction platform, and the supporting contract and trade promotion management toolset. Understands the platform, the data model, the business rules, workflow and approval logic, and the operating model — retained, GBO and BPO — beneath the process. Strong on test planning and defect management (SIT / UAT), business readiness and hypercare, and on risk, issue and dependency management. Data-driven by instinct — baselines the problem, quantifies the opportunity and lets the evidence settle the argument. Able to prioritise across concurrent workstreams and deadlines.
* Design-for-prevention rigour, stakeholder influence and adaptability. Relentless about cause over symptom in design — not satisfied with automating a workaround when the claim could be designed out through a clearer standard, contract or setup. Strong stakeholder management and influencing across a global and local matrix, including senior Commercial, Finance and Legal stakeholders and policy governance forums, and consultative by default: frames the problem before prescribing and drives stakeholders toward aligned design decisions. Clear communicator, and able to manage conflict to a resolution rather than let it stall a decision. Comfortable being redeployed: arrives in an unfamiliar market or process, orients fast, and adds value quickly. Resilient, collaborative, and a visible role model for Diageo’s values.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Business, Commercial, Law, Operations, IT or a related discipline.
* Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards. Business-analysis, Agile / Scrum or Lean Six Sigma credentials are an advantage; familiarity with SAP pricing, condition contracts or settlement management, Control Tower or similar claims and deduction platforms, or contract lifecycle or trade promotion management tools is a plus.

**Experience — Essential**

* Overall. 10+ years spanning transformation, business analysis and consultative experience, with a strong core of business analysis and SME design work in large-scale process transformation.
* Subject matter expertise. Deep functional understanding of credit, claims and pricing policy, commercial terms, customer contracts and agreements, trade promotions and claims within a Commercial and Order-to-Cash environment — someone who knows how claims and deductions are created by contract terms and commercial setup, and how standards and process should be designed to prevent them, not only the tooling. Operational exposure is useful context; the requirement is designing the process, not running it.
* Transformation. Experience in business process transformation, including current-state assessment and future-state operating model design, across the full lifecycle from design through testing, deployment and post-go-live stabilisation. Evidence of reducing claims, deductions, trade-spend leakage, cycle time or manual effort against a defensible baseline.
* Consultative. A track record of acting as a trusted business partner — framing the real problem, facilitating design decisions, aligning global and local stakeholders — and being measured on whether the business changed, not only on whether the deliverable shipped.
* Technology. Experience translating business requirements into functional specifications and solution design with D&T, system integrators and vendors, including test planning and defect management (SIT / UAT). SAP pricing, condition contracts or settlement management, Control Tower, or comparable contract, trade promotion or claims platform exposure is an advantage.

title: Product Stewardship & Regulatory System Specialist
description:
**Reports To:**
Product Stewardship and Regulatory Supervisor
  
  
**Department:**
Product Stewardship and Regulatory Affairs
  
  
**Location:**
Gurugram, India
  
  
General Description
  
  
The Product Stewardship & Regulatory Affairs (PSRA) Specialist supports the company's compliance with global, regional, and local chemical control, product safety, and environmental regulations applicable to paints, coatings, and related raw materials. This role is responsible for the day-to-day execution of PSRA work assignments related to customer service, regulatory operations, data governance, and system administration activities, following established procedures and work instructions in a timely manner. The specialist is responsible for maintaining regulatory and product information within designated PSRA systems, processing requests related to raw material regulatory data, reviewing vendor SDSs and raw material information changes, supporting customer compliance inquiries, and ensuring data accuracy across regulatory databases and enterprise systems. The position plays a key role in promoting product safety, regulatory compliance, responsible product stewardship, and continuous improvement of PSRA digital processes while supporting business objectives and innovation initiatives. In addition, the specialist serves as a subject matter resource for PSRA-related information systems, including Sphera Intelligent Authoring (IA), SAP, LPI, web-based SDS authoring and distribution platforms, and associated regulatory databases, helping to ensure data integrity, system effectiveness, and process efficiency.
  
  
PSRA Systems and Data Management 6Support
  
  

* Maintain and update regulatory, product, substance, and raw material information within PSRA-related information systems, including Sphera Intelligent Authoring (IA), SAP, LPI, web-based SDS management systems, and other designated databases.
* Support SDS authoring, revision, publishing, and distribution activities utilizing Sphera IA and other approved SDS authoring platforms.
* Ensure data consistency and integrity across interconnected systems through routine reviews, validation checks, and adherence to established governance procedures.
* Investigate and resolve system-related data issues impacting product stewardship, regulatory compliance, SDS generation, customer requests, and reporting activities.
* Collaborate with IT, Digital, Master Data, Supply Chain, and PSRA teams to support system enhancements, process improvements, and implementation of new regulatory tools.
* Participate in system upgrades, validation activities, and data migration projects related to PSRA systems.
* Develop and maintain system documentation, training materials, work instructions, and standard operating procedures related to regulatory data management processes.
* Support the creation of dashboards, reports, and automated workflows to improve efficiency, visibility, and accuracy of regulatory information.
* Provide end-user support and training on PSRA systems and processes as required.
* Support internal users of Salesforce (SFDC), Sphera IA, SAP, LPI, web-based SDS systems, reporting tools, data workflows, and the implementation of new digital solutions that improve service levels, data quality, compliance, and operational effectiveness.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Regulatory Affairs, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in Product Stewardship, Regulatory Affairs, Chemical Compliance, or related functions, preferably within a multinational organization.
* Practical experience interpreting regulatory requirements for chemical products.
* Knowledge and experience assigning GHS classifications.
* Knowledge and experience in SDS and label authoring/preparation.
* Experience working with regulatory information management systems and enterprise software platforms.
* Working knowledge of Sphera Intelligent Authoring (IA), SAP, LPI, web-based SDS authoring/distribution systems, and Salesforce (SFDC) preferred.
* Experience maintaining product, substance, and raw material regulatory databases and supporting data governance processes.
* Familiarity with system integrations, master data management, workflow automation, and reporting tools is highly desirable.
* Ability to understand complex regulations pertaining to chemical substances.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data management skills.
* Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
* Customer-focused, results-oriented, and able to work under pressure.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Power BI, and related reporting tools.
* Experience collaborating with IT, Digital, and business stakeholders to improve regulatory processes and systems is preferred.

**Our Company**
Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.
  
  
Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals.

title: Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Our Digital Technology team helps employees leverage technology to work more effectively, collaborate better, and deliver greater business value. **Job Purpose**
The Enablement & Copilot Coordinator is responsible for coordinating employee enablement activities that drive awareness, adoption, and effective use of Microsoft Copilot and related digital workplace tools.
  
  
This role serves as a key liaison between technology teams and end users, ensuring employees have access to training, resources, communications, and support needed to successfully embrace new capabilities. The position focuses on execution, coordination, user engagement, and continuous improvement rather than technical development.
  
  
**Key Responsibilites**
**Copilot Adoption & Enablement**

* Support enterprise deployment and adoption initiatives for Microsoft Copilot and other AI-enabled productivity tools.
* Coordinate enablement activities that help employees understand and effectively use new capabilities.
* Assist with rollout planning, readiness activities, and adoption campaigns.

* Escalate improvement recommendations to appropriate technology teams.

* Support awareness of privacy, security, compliance, and governance requirements.

* Increased adoption and usage of Microsoft Copilot and related productivity tools.

* Strong organizational and project coordination abilities.

title: Staff/ Sr Staff DFT Solutions Engineer
description:
We Are
  
  
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.You Are
  
  
You are
  
  
You have spent years deep in the details of digital IC design, and you know that the difference between a chip that works and one that doesn't often comes down to decisions made during DFT planning. You are the engineer who catches those decisions early, who can look at a scan architecture and immediately see where the coverage gaps will show up three months later during silicon bring-up. You have debugged enough ATPG failures and MBIST issues to know that the best solutions start with understanding what the customer is actually trying to build, not just what they think they need.
  
  
You operate at the intersection of deep technical work and customer collaboration. You can spend the morning implementing a complex test access network for a multi-IP SoC and the afternoon explaining to a customer why their current flow is leaving test coverage on the table, and you are equally comfortable in both modes. You do not wait for perfect specs. You ask the right questions, prototype quickly, and iterate based on what you learn.
  
  
At Synopsys, you will work with customers designing some of the most complex chips in automotive, AI, and consumer electronics, and what you deliver will directly determine whether their silicon works on the first spin.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Deliver end-to-end DFT solutions for customer designs, from architecture planning and scan insertion through pattern generation, silicon bring-up, and diagnostics analysis
* Implement and validate test solutions including scan, MBIST, and IEEE 1687 architectures for complex SoCs with multiple IP blocks
* Participate in customer design reviews to understand their flows, identify gaps, and propose specific improvements that reduce test time or increase coverage
* Prototype and validate new DFT methodologies in collaboration with Solution Architects, proving out viability before customer deployment
* Provide technical support and training to customers, including hands-on problem resolution, methodology workshops, and account-level engagement
* Conduct product demonstrations, competitive benchmarking, and evaluations to help win new customers and expand adoption of Synopsys test solutions
* Analyze silicon test data, diagnose failures, and present findings to both internal teams and customer stakeholders with clear recommendations

The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Enable first-time silicon success for customers by delivering robust, validated DFT solutions that catch issues before tapeout
* Accelerate time-to-market for automotive and consumer electronics customers by optimizing their test flows and reducing pattern generation cycles
* Expand Synopsys' footprint in next-generation test technologies by proving out new methodologies that become standard practice across accounts
* Build long-term customer relationships that turn one-time engagements into strategic partnerships, increasing account value and retention
* Raise the technical capability of customer teams through training and knowledge transfer, creating a multiplier effect beyond individual projects
* Shape the direction of Synopsys test products by feeding real-world customer challenges and use cases back to R&D teams
* Contribute to measurable improvements in test coverage, pattern count reduction, and silicon yield across diverse customer programs

What You'll Need
  
  

* Bachelor's degree with 7+ years or Master's degree with 5+ years in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field
* Hands-on experience with RTL coding, DFT insertion, ATPG pattern generation, and silicon bring-up for digital ICs
* Deep knowledge of scan architectures, fault models, test access networks, and IEEE standards including 1149.1, 1500, and 1687
* Proven ability to handle scan implementation and validation for large, multi-IP SoCs with complex hierarchies and multiple clock domains
* Experience with MBIST concepts, architecture planning, and integration in automotive or safety-critical design environments is a strong plus
* Familiarity with industry-standard DFT tools and flows, exposure to Synopsys TetraMAX, DFT Compiler, or MBIST Architect is valuable
* Strong written and verbal communication skills to translate technical concepts for both engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders

Who You Are
  
  

* You can walk into a customer design review, absorb their methodology in real time, and walk out with three specific recommendations they can act on next week
* You are comfortable working independently on complex technical problems while knowing when to pull in a Solution Architect or R&D engineer for a second opinion
* You manage multiple customer engagements at once without dropping threads, keeping track of where each project stands and what needs to happen next
* You prototype quickly and iterate based on feedback, treating customer pushback as useful signal rather than friction
* You explain tradeoffs clearly, whether you are talking to a junior engineer learning DFT or a VP trying to understand why test time matters for their product schedule
* You stay current on emerging test standards and methodologies because you are genuinely curious about where the technology is headed, not just what you need to know today

description:

Senior Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.

title: Control & Protection Application Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
As a Control and protection System Application Engineer, you will report to the Control & Protection System Application Manager. The successful candidate will be part of a highly motivated and dynamic team of engineers working on the design of Control and Protection functions for LCC and VSC HVDC schemes. The development of such Control system is technically challenging and involves a variety of engineering disciplines, contribution through teamwork and an innovative approach.
  
  
As a Control Systems Application Engineer you will be expected to study on the existing designs of specified project and functionalities in MATLAB/Simulink and transfer them to the PSCAD simulation environment across the full delivery process life cycle, including but not limited to plant model design and maintenance, verification model in MATLAB, creating test harness for conversion, writing model guides, and evaluating models in PSCAD.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Support the business’ Tendering, Operations, Contractual and After Sales needs regarding:
* Defining control system requirements.
* HVDC System in electromagnetic transient tools like PSCAD, EMTP-RV etc.
* Plant modelling in various simulation tools (MATLAB, PSCAD etc) and its verification.
* Dynamic Performance Studies (DPS) and other design studies using both offline and online simulation tools
* Control and protection parameters tuning to meet grid stability criteria specified in customer technical specifications.
* Conversion of MATLAB Simulink algorithms to PSCAD models
* Support improvements to existing algorithm/strategies for power fault recovery or instability issues during DPS studies
* Contribute to development of new strategies for control, protection, and sequencing (start-up/shut down sequence) to meet customer technical specifications if required
* Proposing continual improvement activities for improving the effectiveness and efficiency of control application team through the introduction of tools, methods, and process improvements.
* Support a standard product methodology mindset, seek opportunities to re-use solutions, improve quality and reliability whilst reducing the delivery timeline and associated costs

**Qualifications / Essential Requirements**

* Engineering degree or equivalent including power systems and power electronics subjects or proven equivalent knowledge and experience in HVDC business
* Strong sense of urgency and ability to identify and manage technical risks
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, experienced in creating and presenting technical reports and responding to clients’ technical questions
* Ability to understand and communicate customer requirements, ownership of technical discussions with customers and capable of developing client relationships.
* Competent on functional characteristics of power systems and understand the interactions between AC and HVDC systems.
* Knowledge HVDC Control, Protection and Sequencing strategy
* Experience in PSCAD and MATLAB-SIMULINK simulation tools
* Able to work to deadlines under pressure whilst maintaining the safety, quality, and engineering integrity of the solution
* Must be flexible with working hours and willing to travel to support projects globally

**Desired Characteristics**

* Knowledge of Power System analysis, Power system stability
* Experienced user of power system study tools such as Power Factory, PSS/E, ETAP, EMTDC RV. Etc.
* Process improvement or RCA experience or certification
* Experienced in technical leadership
* Experience working in HVDC industry
* Ability to define requirements and ensure they adhere to best practice

In Grid Solutions we help enable the transition for a greener more reliable Grid. GEV Grid Solutions has the most advanced and comprehensive product and solutions portfolio within the energy sector.

At GEV Renewable Energy, our engineers are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. title: App Dev Engr/Scient, Inter
description:
**Overview**
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
**About The Role**
PowerArtist is a leading RTL power analysis and optimization platform widely adopted across top semiconductor and SoC companies for early power estimation and debug. With increasing industry focus on low-power design and faster tape-outs, PowerArtist plays a critical role in enabling early power closure and design efficiency.
  
  
This position offers strong customer visibility, exposure to advanced SoC programs, and the opportunity to work closely with leading semiconductor customers to drive power optimization/estimation success.
  
  
This role focuses on
**product validation**
, feature qualification, and
**Application Engineering (AE) backend support**
. You will work closely with Product Development, Application Engineering, and key semiconductor customers to validate new capabilities, reproduce and analyze customer-reported issues, develop comprehensive validation strategies, and enable rapid issue resolution. The position offers broad exposure to advanced SoC design flows, strong cross-functional collaboration, and the opportunity to directly influence product quality, customer success, and future feature development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Validate new PowerArtist features, enhancements, and bug fixes across diverse design environments and customer use cases.
* Develop and maintain feature validation test plans, design suites.
* Perform functional, performance, and quality verification of RTL power analysis flows.
* Reproduce, analyze, and debug customer-reported issues in collaboration with R&D and AE teams.
* Create testcases to verify bug fixes and ensure no regressions are introduced.
* Validate support for new technologies, libraries, simulators, synthesis tools, and waveform formats.
* Analyze RTL power estimation results and verify accuracy against expected behavior.
* Automate validation workflows, regression execution, and result analysis using scripting.
* Provide backend technical support to AE teams by investigating complex customer issues and identifying root causes.
* Collaborate closely with R&D during feature development cycles to improve product quality and usability.
* Support release qualification activities and ensure timely delivery of high-quality product releases.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills:**

* 3+ years of experience in RTL design, verification, power analysis, or EDA tool validation.
* Strong understanding of RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog) and digital design fundamentals.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including their application in EDA workflows, validation automation, regression analysis, testcase generation, and productivity enhancement.
* Hands-on experience with PowerArtist or RTL power estimation and analysis methodologies.
* Knowledge of switching activity formats (VCD, FSDB, SAIF) and power modeling concepts.
* Familiarity with dynamic power, clock power, and activity-based power estimation techniques.
* Experience debugging RTL power analysis flows, libraries, constraints, and waveform-related issues.
* Knowledge of synthesis tools (Design Compiler, Genus) and simulation environments (VCS, Xcelium, Questa).
* Strong debugging, root-cause analysis, and log investigation skills.
* Proficiency in TCL, Shell, and/or Python scripting for automation and regression development.
* Ability to work effectively with R&D and AE teams in diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on technical documentation.

**Strategic Vision & Leadership:**

* Drive the adoption of cutting-edge testing methodologies, tools, and frameworks to enhance product quality and delivery speed.

* Spearhead initiatives to research, evaluate, and onboard advanced AI/ML tools and techniques to optimize testing processes, predict defects, and improve overall QA efficiency and intelligence.

* Ensure seamless integration of advanced automation into highly mature CI/CD/CT pipelines, driving continuous deployment with confidence.

* Maintain hands-on familiarity with modern automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright) and programming languages (Python, Java, Javascript, Typescript), capable of providing expert guidance and resolving complex technical challenges.

**Organizational Impact & Stakeholder Management:**

* Collaborate extensively with senior leadership across Engineering, Product Management, and Business units to embed quality assurance principles and goals.

* Act as a key liaison for quality-related matters, representing the QA organization in strategic discussions and planning.

* Establish and enforce enterprise-wide quality governance, standards, and metrics, ensuring adherence to regulatory and compliance requirements.

* Communicate complex technical and strategic concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Team & Talent Development:**

* Build, lead, and mentor a distributed team of highly skilled SDETs, QA Engineers, and QA Leads, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on data analysis, feedback loops, and industry benchmarks.

title: Director - Credit Risk
description:
**Role Overview:**

Sirius AI is hiring a director to lead its credit risk practice: setting strategy, designing solutions and overseeing delivery for banks, lenders, NBFCs, card issuers and fintechs. The role combines credit risk expertise, model development, regulatory knowledge, client management and team building.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Practice and growth**

* Own the strategy and roadmap for credit risk offerings, accelerators and reusable model frameworks.
* Own practice growth: build pipeline, win new clients, expand existing accounts and deliver on practice targets.
* Support proposals, solution demonstrations, proofs of concept and client presentations.
* Build, mentor and scale a team of credit risk modelers, data scientists and analysts; set technical standards.
* Produce thought leadership: whitepapers, client workshops and industry forums.

**Delivery oversight**

* Oversee client engagements from discovery and solution design through development, validation, implementation and adoption.
* Guide development of lifecycle models: application, behavioral and collections scorecards; decisioning and limit-setting; early-warning systems; pricing.
* Guide development of PD, LGD and EAD models for CECL and stress testing.
* Set modeling approach across traditional (logistic regression, survival analysis, transition matrices) and ML (gradient boosting, neural networks) techniques, with explainability and fair lending built in.
* Ensure models meet MRM and regulatory expectations (SR 11-7, OCC 2011-12): conceptual soundness, documentation, validation and monitoring.
* Drive use of alternative data and GenAI: bureau data, automated documentation, credit memos, financial statement and unstructured document analysis.
* Guide deployment, decision engines, monitoring and MLOps.
* Translate model outputs into credit strategy with client risk, finance and business teams.

**Requirements:**

* 12+ years in credit risk modeling, risk analytics or quantitative risk.
* Personally built and implemented credit risk models that passed validation and regulatory review and run in production.
* Has built and scaled a practice or team.
* Track record of growing business: pipeline, revenue or practice targets beyond pre-sales support.
* Hands-on PD/LGD/EAD and scorecard development; CECL; stress testing; bureau, open banking or alternative data for new-to-credit customers.
* Fair lending and consumer credit compliance: ECOA/Reg B, FCRA, adverse action explainability, disparate impact, less discriminatory alternatives, UDAAP.
* Knowledge of SR 11-7 and OCC 2011-12, with experience engaging model validation, internal audit and regulators.

**What we are looking for:**

* ICAAP and IFRS 9 familiarity.
* Strong statistics and ML; proficiency in Python, SQL and/or SAS, sufficient to review and challenge teamwork.
* Working knowledge of GenAI/LLMs in regulated environments.
* Consulting or client-facing experience, including solution selling and engagement management.
* Ability to manage stakeholders up to CRO/Head of Credit and explain complex models clearly.
* Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science).
* Good to have publications, white papers or patents in credit risk, quantitative finance or applied AI.
* Experience in US banks, payment, fintechs or other financial services organisations. Exposure to additional markets such as the UK or Europe is an advantage.

title: Research Scientist II, Grocery ECO
description:
**Description**
We are looking for a talented Research Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy machine learning and computer vision models that solve real-world problems at scale in the Amazon grocery domain. You will work closely with engineering, product, and business teams to turn complex technical challenges into production-ready solutions, and own the model development lifecycle from experimentation through deployment. You will bring scientific rigor to every stage — from data analysis and model design to evaluation and iteration. This is a high-impact role where your models will directly improve the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, train, and evaluate computer vision and machine learning models for complex grocery-domain problems including product identification, shelf perception, and in-store scene understanding — iterating rapidly from prototype to production-quality solutions
  
  
Conduct rigorous exploratory data analysis to characterize domain-specific challenges (image variability, catalog gaps, label noise) and translate findings into actionable modeling decisions
  
  
Design and execute offline and online evaluation frameworks — defining metrics that capture both model performance and downstream business impact, and diagnosing failure modes to prioritize improvements
  
  
Build and improve data pipelines and annotation workflows that feed model training, including active learning strategies to maximize label efficiency
  
  
Communicate technical results, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to engineering, product, and business stakeholders — connecting model behavior to customer experience outcomes
  
  
Stay current with state-of-the-art research in computer vision, multimodal learning, and representation learning — evaluating and adapting promising techniques to team-specific problems
  
  
Contribute to a culture of scientific rigor through reproducible experimentation, thorough documentation, peer code and design reviews, and raising the quality bar for the team
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Research Scientist on the GRAISE team, you'll spend your days analyzing model performance from overnight experiments, and prototyping new approaches using multimodal learning with store video and sensor data. You'll present findings to product and business stakeholders, translating technical results into actionable recommendations. Throughout the day, you'll balance rigorous scientific thinking with practical engineering constraints, knowing your work directly improves the shopping experience for millions of customers in Amazon grocery stores.
  
  
**About The Team**
The GRAISE team (Grocery, Retail & In-Store Experience) within World Wide Grocery Store Tech (WWGST) builds foundational AI and machine learning systems that power Amazon's in-store grocery technologies. We develop domain-specific models that solve uniquely complex challenges in grocery — from smart shopping carts and inventory intelligence to personalization and store operations. Our mission is to create technology which makes grocery shopping more convenient, economical, personalized, and enjoyable for customers while empowering retailers with operational efficiency.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* PhD, or Master's degree
* Experience investigating the feasibility of applying scientific principles and concepts to business problems and products
* Experience analyzing both experimental and observational data sets
* 3+ years of building machine learning models for business application experience
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with neural deep learning methods and machine learning

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of R, MATLAB, Python or similar scripting language
* 3+ years of applied research experience
* Knowledge of deep learning, machine learning and statistics
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals

We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.

WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. The
**Associate Director - Cross Channel**
will lead the integration of
**eCommerce, Ad Operations, and Data Governance**
capabilities to deliver high-quality, scalable, and data-driven solutions for clients.
  
  
The role will work closely with regional, client, media, analytics, and technology teams across markets to ensure seamless campaign execution, trusted data, and strong business outcomes. The ideal candidate will combine strong knowledge of the digital and eCommerce ecosystem with operational leadership, data governance, and a passion for process improvement and innovation.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Lead cross-channel operations across eCommerce, retail media, Ad Operations, and Data Governance, ensuring consistent quality and delivery across clients and markets.
* Provide strategic oversight across eCommerce and retail media platforms such as Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, Pacvue, Walmart, SKAI, DV360, CM360, IAS, Google Ads, Meta, and other emerging platforms, along with broader digital media channels.
* Ensure end-to-end campaign and data integrity from campaign setup, trafficking, tagging, and activation through data ingestion, validation, reporting, and reconciliation.
* Build and maintain governance frameworks, quality controls, and standardized processes to ensure accurate, consistent, and trusted client reporting.
* Partner with Media, Client Servicing, Analytics, Technology, and regional teams to translate business requirements into effective operational and data solutions.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex campaign, data, reporting, and technology issues, driving root-cause resolution and clear stakeholder communication.
* Use retail and commercial understanding including promotions, pricing, inventory, margins, and consumer behaviour to inform eCommerce and media decisions.
* Drive process optimization, automation, and technology adoption, including opportunities leveraging AI and emerging marketing technologies.
* Turn campaign and business data into actionable insights, identifying opportunities to improve performance, efficiency, scalability, and client experience.
* Lead and develop high-performing teams, building strong capabilities across Commerce, Ad Operations, and Data Governance.
* Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to client presentations, strategic initiatives, new business opportunities, and capability development.

****Required Skills & Experience****

* 8+ years of experience across eCommerce, retail media, Ad Operations, digital media, data governance, or related areas.
* Strong understanding of the digital and Commerce ecosystem, including Search, Social, Programmatic, Display, eCommerce, Retail Media, Offline, and DOOH.
* Proven experience in leading teams, managing complex client engagements, and working with global stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of eCommerce and retail media platforms such as Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, Pacvue, Walmart, DV360, CM360, IAS, Google Ads, Meta, and similar platforms.
* Strong knowledge of campaign operations, trafficking, tracking, platform integrations, data validation, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Experience with dashboarding and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Datorama, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, standardization, and single-source-of-truth principles.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated experience in process improvement, automation, and building scalable operating models.
* Strong commercial mindset with the ability to connect media, data, and operations to broader business outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global environment with multiple priorities and stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
The
**Lead Forward Deployed Engineer**
operates at the intersection of engineering, data, and customer deployment. In this hands-on, customer-facing role, you will lead complex enterprise onboardings to integrate, transform, and operationalize cybersecurity data into Qualys’ Enterprise TruRisk Management (ETM) platform. You will translate fragmented security environments into a unified risk model while bridging the gap between customer needs and core product engineering.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Customer Onboarding & Data Integration
  
  

* Strategic Execution: Lead end-to-end enterprise onboarding from strategy to production rollout, serving as the system of record for customer assets, findings, and business context.
* Pipeline & API Design: Build REST API, webhook, and scalable ingestion (e.g., S3-based ETL/ELT) pipelines to integrate diverse data sources (VM, EDR/XDR, Cloud, IAM, CMDBs, GRC).
* Data Modeling & Correlation: Design custom mapping, transformation, tagging, and asset criticality scoring; implement de-duplication and correlation logic across heterogeneous security feeds.
* Pipeline Reliability: Ensure continuous full and incremental data ingestion with automated scheduling, monitoring, and error handling.

Data Quality & Validation
  
  

* Data Integrity: Establish scalable validation frameworks to audit and maintain asset/findings accuracy for confident risk decision-making.
* Issue Resolution: Execute controlled reprocessing and configuration adjustments to fix data quality issues without disrupting operational metrics.

Dashboards, Remediation & Workflows
  
  

* Analytics & Modeling: Build customized dashboards, trend visualizations, and risk scoring models, including complex "toxic risk combination" scenarios.
* Workflow Automation: Integrate ETM with ticketing/remediation tools (Jira, ServiceNow) and configure automated alerts, escalations, and ownership mapping.
* Executive Reporting: Develop custom reports/utilities using public APIs for board-level, operational, and regulatory audiences.

Product & Engineering Feedback Loop
  
  

* Roadmap Influence: Translate field deployment challenges and recurring integration gaps into technical requirements for product and core engineering teams.
* Customer Maturity: Guide enterprises from initial risk visibility to automated, remediation-driven action.

Required Qualifications:
  
  

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience: 8–10 years in data engineering, platform engineering, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Technical Stack:
* Strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, or similar languages.
* Deep experience with REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous systems, and scalable ingestion pipelines (ETL/ELT).
* Hands-on knowledge of relational, NoSQL, search, or graph databases.
* Domain & Data Expertise:
* Strong foundation in data modeling, normalization, transformation, and correlation.
* Solid understanding of core cybersecurity domains (VM, Cloud Security, IAM, Risk Frameworks).
* Hands-on application of AI or automation to optimize data pipelines and onboarding workflows.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional client-facing, communication, and technical consultation skills.

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* Background in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Professional Services.
* Familiarity with large-scale, distributed systems and microservices architectures.
* Proven ability to thrive in high-impact, fast-paced, and ambiguous production environments.

description:
**Executive – MD’s Office | Technical Coordination, MIS & AI Operations**

Swid Renewables Limited is seeking a technically capable, highly organised and proactive professional to work closely with the Managing Director and drive coordination, management follow-ups and execution across the business.

The core responsibility is to
**ensure that management decisions and delegated responsibilities translate into timely action and measurable outcomes**

**This is a business execution and management coordination role within the MD’s Office. It does not involve personal assistance or personal errands.**

**Key responsibilities :**

**Management follow-up and execution**

* Track decisions, commitments and responsibilities delegated by the Managing Director.
* Follow up consistently with department heads, managers and relevant teams against agreed deadlines.
* Maintain a central action tracker with clear owners, priorities, due dates, dependencies and status.
* Identify delays and bottlenecks, obtain actionable updates and escalate matters requiring the Managing Director’s intervention.
* Verify completion through relevant records or deliverables before closing action items.

**MIS, analytics and management reporting**

* Own the preparation and accuracy of MIS reports, dashboards and periodic management updates.
* Compile, organise and analyse information across projects, operations, sales, finance and other functions.
* Highlight performance gaps, overdue commitments, emerging risks and matters requiring decisions.
* Use advanced Excel and relevant reporting tools to turn business data into clear, actionable insights.

**AI agents and workflow improvement**

* Use AI agents and AI-enabled tools effectively for research, communication review, meeting summaries, action tracking, reporting and business analysis.
* Build and improve recurring workflows that reduce manual effort and strengthen follow-up.
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and handle confidential business information with discretion.

**Communication and priority management**

* Review and manage authorised business communication channels, including email, WhatsApp and incoming calls.
* Prioritise messages, coordinate timely responses and bring urgent or significant matters to the Managing Director’s attention.
* Keep the Managing Director’s task list, pending decisions and follow-up priorities current and readily available.
* Coordinate meetings and prepare agendas, briefing notes, presentations and minutes.
* Maintain organised records of important communication, decisions and supporting documents.

**Technical and strategic support**

* Understand technical discussions, project updates and operational issues well enough to track commitments and coordinate effectively with relevant teams.
* Support the Managing Director with research, analysis, presentations and strategic initiatives.
* Help translate strategic priorities into practical action plans, milestones and review schedules.

**Daily working approach**

1. **Review communication:**
   Check email, WhatsApp and all designated business communication channels for updates, requests and pending matters.
2. **Handle and prioritise:**
   Attend to calls, messages and correspondence; coordinate responses and flag urgent issues.
3. **Maintain the action list:**
   Keep a consolidated, up-to-date list of tasks, decisions, commitments and priorities ready for the Managing Director.
4. **Follow up and escalate:**
   Review delegated work with responsible managers, record progress, resolve coordination gaps and escalate delays with a clear summary and proposed next steps.
5. **Support strategy:**
   Prepare MIS insights, research and recommendations to support business planning and management decisions.

**What we’re looking for**

* A technical qualification, preferably a degree or diploma in engineering or a related discipline.
* 5 years+ of relevant experience in management coordination, technical operations, project coordination, MIS or an MD’s/CEO’s office.
* **Strong MIS and advanced Excel skills**
  , including data analysis, dashboards and management reporting.
* **Practical proficiency in using AI agents and AI-enabled tools**
  , with the ability to demonstrate useful business workflows.
* A proven ability to follow up with managers, hold action owners accountable to agreed timelines and escalate issues with sound judgement.
* Ability to understand technical information and communicate it clearly to management.
* Excellent written and spoken English; Marathi and Hindi would be an advantage.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook and relevant collaboration tools.
* Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and confidence in coordinating with senior colleagues.
* Dependability, discretion and the ability to manage sensitive information and changing priorities.

**Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate their MIS skills, approach to management follow-up and practical use of AI agents during the selection process.**

:

The Lead Analyst Procurement supports category strategy and sourcing activities across the allocated categories. The role contributes market insight, commercial analysis, and structured supplier support to ensure services are sourced and managed in a way that delivers measurable value, operational efficiency, and long-term performance – not only for the assigned categories. Applying category management best practices, the role supports spend analysis, supply market intelligence, industry benchmarking of pricing and service delivery models, supplier segmentation, and the development of sourcing strategies that balance cost efficiency with service quality and innovation. Working closely with the internal stakeholders, the role translates operational priorities into sourcing approaches and supplier solutions. Operating within a global procurement framework, the role supports consistent application of category strategy, sourcing governance, and supplier management practices, while leveraging digital procurement tools and data-driven insights to improve spend visibility and process efficiency. **Major Responsibilities:**

1. Conduct spend data analysis and generate actionable insights, identifying cost drivers, spending patterns, supplier concentration, and opportunities for savings and improved contract coverage
2. Support the development and execution of category strategies incorporating spend analysis, supply market intelligence, and industry benchmarking of pricing, supplier practices, and service delivery models to inform sourcing direction and stakeholder recommendations

* Growing personal capability, engagement, and effectiveness within the Procurement team

description:
**Company Description**
Skill-Lync is a technology-driven education company focused on helping learners build the technical skillsets needed to launch and grow their careers. The organization partners with industry experts to create high-quality, practical educational content that reflects current market needs. This content is delivered globally through Skill-Lync’s online platform, making advanced technical training accessible and affordable. The company is committed to supporting learners in developing job-ready capabilities and staying competitive in fast-evolving fields such as automotive engineering and artificial intelligence.

**Role Description**
This part-time, on-site Gen AI Automotive Engineer role is based in New Delhi. The individual in this role will develop and refine AI-driven models and tools applicable to automotive engineering workflows, such as design optimization, performance analysis, and predictive maintenance. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with subject matter experts to translate automotive engineering problems into AI solutions, preparing technical content or demonstrations for learners, validating model outputs against real-world engineering scenarios, and documenting methodologies and best practices. * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively on-site in New Delhi.
* Prior experience in technical training, teaching, or content creation for engineering or AI domains is an advantage.
