title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

You might thrive in this role if you
  
  

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
  
  
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
  
  
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

**Manage Enhancement Requests (40%)**

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to synthesize data, user feedback, and operational metrics into clear insights and recommended actions, and exhibit root-cause thinking
* Strong user support and troubleshooting skills; ability to respond to user inquiries, investigate issues, identify root causes, resolve where appropriate, and escalate effectively to technical teams or platform specialists
* Working knowledge of business intelligence and analytics concepts (e.g., dashboards/reporting, data access, user permissions, tool platform concepts, adoption, and common end-user workflows); familiarity with tools such as Power BI or Tableau; experience consuming data from Databricks or an enterprise data platform preferred
* Strong work management and organizational skills; ability to work from a backlog, coordinate multiple workstreams, track actions and dependencies, prioritize work, and communicate dependencies and tradeoff implications
* Ability to translate business needs into actionable requirements, including soliciting use cases, stakeholder requirements, and platform pain points
* Strong stakeholder communication skills; ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, platform administrators, vendors, and product leadership
* Strong written communication and documentation skills, including product documentation, status updates, process materials, user guidance, and executive-ready summaries
* Curiosity and willingness to learn emerging analytics technologies; ability to quickly learn new tools and evaluate capabilities; experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day operations preferred

  

**Experience**

* Experience with product maintenance and testing, including supporting routine updates and enhancements, validating functionality through testing, and assessing whether changes continue to meet user needs

* Experience solving basic issues in software tools and turning findings into actionable next steps
* Experience supporting users or customers with clear and helpful communication.
* Experience with support platforms like ServiceNow is preferred

title: Senior ML & AI Technical Solutions Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Mission
  
  
As a Senior ML and AI Technical Solutions Engineer, you play a critical role by helping customers debug and maintain stable GenAI and ML Workloads with AI agent systems using the Databricks Platform. You will develop product expertise end-to-end by advising a broad set of customers and use cases across the space - including products such as Agent Bricks, Vector Search and Model Serving. TSEs have proven production troubleshooting and optimisation experience to help our customers’ workloads run smoothly and to achieve their strategic objectives with ML/AI technology with Databricks. Additionally, you are an early adopter of GenAI technology to improve your own efficiency and amplify the team's output. Reporting to a TSE manager - you will be part of a world class global support engineering organization for Databricks, known for your technical depth and delivering impeccable customer service.
  
  
The Impact You Will Have
  
  

* Act as senior technical solution expert for complex issues spanning data pipelines, ML pipelines and/or AI applications, applying deep expertise in distributed systems.
* Analyse and troubleshoot production workloads at the code level, optimise for performance, reliability, latency, and cost.
* Diagnose and support Machine Learning and/or Large Language Model deployments, including real-time and batch inference, autoscaling, monitoring, logging, and alerting. Serve as a Subject Matter Expert guiding customers on experiment tracking, model registry, versioning, evaluation, labelling, tracing, and lifecycle observability.
* Provide high-quality support by guiding customers in leveraging Databricks AI to solve generative AI use cases & challenges, leveraging LLMs, MCP, AI Agents, RAG/Agentic RAG, APIs, vector embeddings, semantic search, Vector Search/Lakebase databases, context orchestration, memory management, and prompt engineering.
* Collaborate with internal teams to influence roadmap, product improvements and support business growth.
* Develop expertise in productionizing systems in Databricks and share your knowledge by contributing to wikis and other technical documentation, or by teaching our AI systems new skills, which will be used internally and externally by customers and partners.

What We Look For
  
  
8+ years of experience designing, building, and scaling Data, Machine Learning, and AI systems on-premises and in the cloud using Python, Scala, and Java in production environments, with expertise in Machine Learning and/or generative AI. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP); familiarity with Databricks is a plus. Proficient in data engineering necessary for orchestrating end-to-end machine learning training pipelines, ideally with experience processing large datasets with Apache Spark.
  
  

* SME knowledge in feature engineering, ML frameworks, model training, model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining strategies. Proficient in working with algorithms and deep learning, along with NLP techniques.
* Prior experience building, designing or troubleshooting LLM-based Generative AI applications. Familiarity with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph etc). Expertise in context orchestration, including prompt design, memory management, retrieval systems, vector embeddings, semantic search, and tool integrations.
* Comprehensive Knowledge of MLOps and LLMOps with expertise in model evaluation, scoring, ranking, optimisation, training, validation, and packaging.
* Experience developing agent skills, plugins, and debugging with native AI capabilities is a plus.
* Prior support or customer-facing experience is not required for this role, but the ability and desire to develop excellent customer service skills are.
* Prior experience in Data Scientist, ML Engineer, or AI Engineer roles is highly valued.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Professional certifications are good to have.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. title: Manager, Data Engineering
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  

* The Manager, Data Engineering job sets goals and objectives for the achievement of operational results for the team responsible for designing, building and maintaining robust data systems that enable data analysis and reporting. This job leads implementing the end to end process to ensure that large sets of data are efficiently processed and made accessible for decision making.

Key Accountabilities
  
  

* DATA & ANALYTICAL SOLUTIONS: Oversees the development of data products and solutions using big data and cloud based technologies, ensuring they are designed and built to be scalable, sustainable and robust.
* DATA PIPELINES: Develops and monitors streaming and batch data pipelines that facilitate the seamless ingestion of data from various data sources, transform the data into information and move to data stores like data lake, data warehouse and others.
* DATA SYSTEMS: Reviews existing data systems and architectures to lead identification of areas for improvement and optimization.
* DATA INFRASTRUCTURE: Oversees the preparation of data infrastructure to drive the efficient storage and retrieval of data.
* DATA FORMATS: Reviews and resolves appropriate data formats to improve data usability and accessibility across the organization.
* STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT: Partners collaboratively with multi-functional data and advanced analytic teams to capture requirements and ensure that data solutions meet the functional and non-functional needs of various partners.
* DATA FRAMEWORKS: Builds complex prototypes to test new concepts and provides guidance to implement data engineering frameworks and architectures that improve data processing capabilities and support advanced analytics initiatives.
* AUTOMATED DEPLOYMENT PIPELINES: Oversees the development of automated deployment pipelines improving efficiency of code deployments with fit for purpose governance.
* DATA MODELING: Guides the team to perform data modeling in accordance to the datastore technology to ensure sustainable performance and accessibility.
* TEAM MANAGEMENT: Manages team members to achieve the organization's goals, by ensuring productivity, communicating performance expectations, creating goal alignment, giving and seeking feedback, providing coaching, measuring progress and holding people accountable, supporting employee development, recognizing achievement and lessons learned, and developing enabling conditions for talent to thrive in an inclusive team culture.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum requirement of 12 years of relevant work experience with a Bachelors degree.
* DATA ENGINEERING: Experience with data engineering on corporate finance data is strongly preferred.
* CLOUD ENVIRONMENTS: Familiarity with major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* DATA ARCHITECTURE: Experience with modern data architectures, including data lakes, data lakehouses, and data hubs, along with related capabilities such as ingestion, governance, modeling, and observability.
* DATA INGESTION: Proficiency in data collection, ingestion tools (Kafka, AWS Glue), and storage formats (Iceberg, Parquet).
* DATA STREAMING: Knowledge of streaming architectures and tools (Kafka, Flink).
* DATA MODELING: Strong background in data transformation and modeling using SQL-based frameworks and orchestration tools (dbt, AWS Glue, Airflow). Experience with modeling concepts like SCD and schema evolution.
* DATA TRANSFORMATION: Familiarity with using Spark for data transformation, including streaming, performance tuning, and debugging with Spark UI.
* PROGRAMMING: Proficient with programming in Python, Java, Scala, or similar languages. Expert-level proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and optimization.
* DEVOPS: Demonstrated experience in DevOps practices, including code management, CI/CD, and deployment strategies.
* DATA GOVERNANCE: Understanding of data governance principles, including data quality, privacy, and security considerations for data product development and consumption

description: DescriptionHow does Amazon know whether it is delivering faster than the competition? That question is answered by the Speed Measurement and Analytics team within Customer Experience and Business Trends (CXBT), and as a Business Intelligence Engineer I on this team, you will help build the answer. You will own data pipelines, dashboards, and analytical deep-dives that feed into Pulse, the team's benchmarking product that tracks competitive delivery speed across 10+ geographies worldwide. Your work will directly inform how Amazon invests in speed improvements across Worldwide Stores. If you are curious, analytical, and energized by turning large-scale data into clear, actionable insights, this is a great opportunity to grow your career while shaping decisions that matter.Key job responsibilities Build and maintain data pipelines, ETL jobs, and data models that power competitive delivery-speed benchmarking across your assigned geography or horizontal function, ensuring data freshness, accuracy, and completeness. title: Transformation Data & AI Architect
description:

**Purpose of Role:**
Weir’s global SAP S/4HANA (S4+) transformation represents a once-in-a-generation opportunity to build the core business platforms that will support operational excellence and growth for the next decade. As we modernise our enterprise applications across SAP and complementary systems such as Salesforce, Workday and Coupa, data and AI are fundamental to unlocking the full value of this transformation.
  
  
The Transformation Data & AI Architect is a senior leadership role within the S4+ Programme, responsible for defining, governing and delivering the end-to-end Data & AI architecture. This includes ensuring all data models, flows, governance structures and AI capabilities align with enterprise value streams, S/4 best practice and Weir’s Clean Core approach.
  
  
A key aspect of this role is operating across a multi-partner ecosystem, working directly with our systems integrator, technology partners, internal domain teams and enterprise architecture to ensure architectural consistency, integration alignment and high-quality delivery across all workstreams.
  
  
**Why choose Weir:**
**Be part of a global organization dedicated to building a better future:**
At Weir, the growing world depends on us. It depends on us constantly reinventing, quickly adapting and continually finding better, faster, more sustainable ways to access the resources it needs to thrive. And it depends on each of us doing the best work of our lives. It’s a big challenge – but it is exciting.
  
  
**An opportunity to g**
**row your own way:**
Everything moves fast in the dynamic world of Weir. This creates opportunities for us to take on new challenges, explore new areas, learn, progress and excel. Best of all, there is no set path that our people must take. Instead, everyone is given the support and freedom to tailor-make their own career and do the best work of their lives.

: Weir is a welcoming, inclusive place, where each individual’s contribution is recognized and all employees are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and be themselves. We continually focus on people and their wellbeing. We believe in fairness and choose to be honest, transparent and authentic in everything we do.

* Define ML data contracts and embed models in operational processes (Fiori, SAC).

title: Senior Manager Data Engineering
description:
Candidates for this position are preferred to be based in Bangalore, India and will be expected to comply with their team's hybrid work schedule requirements.

**About Wayfair**

Wayfair is a destination for home, helping millions of customers find the right products for their homes. Our technology and data platforms power digital experiences, analytics and machine

learning capabilities that help customers discover, explore and shop for what they need. Our data engineering organization plays a critical role in enabling personalized customer experiences, intelligent product discovery and data-driven business decisions at scale.

As Senior Engineering Manager, data Engineering you will lead Customer Technology's data engineering organization across Marketing, Storefront, and Search & Recommendations. You will define the strategic direction, build organizational capabilities and drive execution across a portfolio of data platforms and products that connect the end-to-end customer journey—from acquisition and marketing engagement through on-site discovery, shopping and conversion. You will lead through Engineering Managers and partner closely with senior technical leaders and Lead Individual Contributors to establish a cohesive technical vision, build scalable data foundations and deliver high-impact data products. You will drive alignment across domains, ensuring customer signals and data assets are connected, trusted, discoverable and accessible to power analytics, personalization, measurement and machine learning. This role requires a combination of strong organizational leadership, technical judgment and business acumen. You will partner with senior leaders across Product, Data Science, Analytics and Software Engineering to translate business priorities into technology strategy, balance foundational platform investments with product delivery, and build a high-performing organization capable of executing reliably at scale.

**What you’ll do**

**Lead and grow the organization**

* Lead and develop engineering managers, technical leaders and teams across a broad data engineering portfolio.
* Build an effective organization through thoughtful team design, hiring, succession planning and developing future leaders.
* Set clear expectations for leaders and teams, create accountability for outcomes and foster an inclusive culture of collaboration, learning and high standards.
* Coach leaders through complex technical and organizational challenges, helping them make sound decisions and grow their teams’ capabilities.

**Set strategy and deliver outcomes**

* Define the portfolio vision, strategy and multi-quarter roadmap across the teams.
* Connect investment decisions and delivery priorities to customer and business outcomes; make trade-offs explicit and align stakeholders around them.
* Establish operating mechanisms that support predictable delivery, transparent progress, early risk identification and continuous improvement across teams.
* Build strong partnerships with Product, ML Science, Analytics and Software Engineering leaders, translating shared priorities into coordinated plans and measurable results.
* Represent the portfolio in senior technology and business discussions, communicating strategy, performance, risks and investment needs with clarity.

**Lead connected customer data products and platforms**

* Align strategy, roadmaps and data definitions across the teams to advance Customer Technology initiatives and improve the end-to-end customer experience.
* Set technical direction with EM’s , senior engineers and architects across cloud storage, processing, orchestration and serving; ensure teams make sound trade-offs across reliability, performance, cost and speed.
* Guide reusable cross-domain data products that connect marketing engagement, storefront behavior, search and recommendation interactions and conversion outcomes.
* Ensure each domain has reliable, fit-for-purpose data foundations and products, with clear ownership and quality standards.
* Own portfolio-wide outcomes and standards for data freshness, quality, reliability, usability and cost across batch and real-time use cases; strengthen observability, governance, data contracts, lineage and discoverability, and simplify the ecosystem to support evolving analytics and AI/ML needs.
* Ensure teams have effective operating practices for service health, incident response, capacity, cost management and learning from production issues.

**What you’ll need**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of overall experience in data engineering or related technology roles, including at least 5 years leading large engineering teams and 2 years managing multiple Engineering Managers.
* Demonstrated success leading through managers and technical leaders, developing leaders, building effective teams and creating a culture of accountability and inclusion.
* Experience setting strategy and roadmaps for a broad engineering portfolio, aligning investment and execution to measurable business or customer outcomes.
* Strong technical judgment in data architecture and modeling, including dimensional modeling, change data capture, incremental processing and data versioning.
* Experience with cloud data platforms; experience with Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery and Google Cloud Storage is especially relevant.
* Enough hands-on technical depth to challenge designs and guide architecture across SQL/Python/Spark pipelines, data modeling, performance and cost—while enabling teams to own implementation.
* Experience with streaming technologies and services such as Kafka, Pub/Sub or Dataflow.
* Experience operating production data platforms with strong reliability, data quality, observability and service-management practices.
* Ability to build alignment across functions and communicate complex decisions, trade-offs and risks to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Experience in e-commerce or another large-scale consumer product environment, particularly in digital customer experiences.
* Experience leading clickstream, behavioral analytics, event-data or customer interaction data organizations.
* Experience leading platform modernization or migration programs while protecting downstream service and consumer continuity.
* Exposure to NoSQL databases or business intelligence tools such as Looker, Tableau,

**AtScale or Power BI.**

* Experience enabling AI/ML applications through reliable, context-rich data products.

title: Director, Data Systems Software Engineering
description:
DB Fleet Central is an OCI native cloud service for database fleet management and observability. It gives enterprise customers a way to monitor fleet health and availability, understand performance and capacity trends, manage databases, and investigate operational issues across cloud, hybrid, and multicloud environments. Its roadmap includes AI-assisted SQL and AWR insights, diagnostic assistance, fleet-wide anomaly and regression detection, and the AI Agent Observability platform.

As Director, you will set the engineering direction and lead the organization responsible for delivering these customer capabilities as reliable cloud services.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Systems Software Development**

**• Set engineering strategy for DB Fleet Central capabilities that help customers monitor fleet health and availability, understand performance and capacity, and manage database operations.**

**• Establish portfolio standards for data models, APIs, performance budgets, experimentation, and outcome measurement across service areas.**

**• Align multiple teams on roadmap priorities, dependencies, resourcing, quality standards, and customer outcomes.**

**• Lead and develop engineering managers and senior technical contributors; build the organization and technical leadership needed to deliver the service roadmap.**

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization**

**• Direct teams through the full lifecycle of cloud services and data systems: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, release, and production operation.**

**• Set expectations for design and code reviews, automated functional and non-functional testing, performance profiling, API lifecycle, logging, metrics, and observability.**

**• Use product, adoption, performance, and service-health measures to steer delivery and continuous optimization.**

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design**

**• Set the architecture and technical direction for secure, highly available, scalable services that meet enterprise fleet needs.**

**• Lead the strategy and phased delivery of the AI Agent Observability platform as a core DB Fleet Central capability.**

**• Sponsor AI-assisted database performance and capacity insights, SQL and AWR analysis, diagnostic assistance, fleet-wide anomaly and regression detection, and root-cause analysis as these roadmap capabilities mature.**

**• Establish responsible AI standards for data protection, evaluation, traceability, monitoring, and human review of recommendations or actions.**

**• Guide architecture reviews and technology research across connected service areas.**

**Issue and Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support**

**• Direct cross-team response to complex customer issues and service incidents; ensure timely communication, prioritization, and durable resolution.**

**• Use customer feedback and support trends to shape product improvements and issue-handling practices.**

**• Partner with customer-facing leaders to maintain trust and align short-term mitigation with long-term fixes.**

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance**

**• Set and enforce service-wide standards for secure development, tenant isolation, privacy, data governance, and AI use.**

**• Ensure teams follow architecture, API, testing, and operational quality standards.**

**Development Operations - System Maintenance**

**• Own operational plans and outcomes for an always-on cloud service, including availability, capacity, performance, reliability, and customer SLOs and SLAs.**

**• Establish a sustainable on-call and escalation model; ensure teams are prepared for production support and incident leadership.**

**• Direct improvements to automation, deployment safety, monitoring, runbooks, patching, and root-cause follow-through.**

**Core Responsibilities**

**Planning and Execution: Oversee cross-team roadmaps, dependencies, resources, and milestones; adjust plans to maintain strategic outcomes.**

**Collaboration and Partnership: Align product, SRE, security, database, and infrastructure leaders around shared service goals.**

**Problem Solving: Guide teams through complex, ambiguous technical and operational problems and prevent recurrence.**

**Continuous Learning and Improvement: Build organizational expertise in database systems, cloud operations, and AI; use service and customer evidence to improve the roadmap.**

**Performance and Development: Coach managers and senior engineers, grow future leaders, and guide hiring and talent development.**

title: Data Security Engineering Lead
description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas.com

**Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?**

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact.

  

**Purpose and Scope:**

Engineer and run the Microsoft Purview platform that protects Astellas' most sensitive data. As Data Security Engineering Lead, you will turn approved protection requirements into working sensitivity labels, data loss prevention and classification controls, keep them accurate as the business and its use of AI evolve, and lead the Astellas team that takes over day-to-day operations from our implementation partner.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

* Scope: Microsoft Purview data security capabilities across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Windows endpoints, browsers, and Microsoft 365 Copilot and other AI tools, in a single global Microsoft 365 tenant.
* Information Protection: Design, configure and maintain sensitivity labels and label policies, container labels, client-side and service-side auto-labeling, and encryption (Rights Management and Message Encryption), keeping the label scheme simple enough for employees to apply correctly.
* Data Loss Prevention: Build and tune Purview DLP policies across email, collaboration, endpoint (via Defender for Endpoint) and browser channels, and extend protection to Copilot and AI tools using Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) for AI. Configure policy tips, user notifications and business-justification overrides.
* Classification & Detection: Turn crown-jewel and use-case inputs from the Data Protection Policy & Engagement Lead into accurate detection, using custom sensitive information types, exact data match, document fingerprinting and trainable classifiers. Validate coverage with Content Explorer and Activity Explorer, and reduce false positives using feedback from the business and the Insider Risk team.
* Policy Lifecycle & Operations: Run policy change control from simulation to enforcement and rollback; triage and escalate DLP alerts; configure approved exceptions with expiry dates; and monitor user overrides, reporting patterns back to policy owners.
* Integration & Automation: Send Purview alerts and audit data to Microsoft Sentinel and ServiceNow with the Security Operations and platform teams; automate configuration, reporting and testing with Purview PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; and work with the Insider Risk team to share data loss and insider risk signals, align detections and Adaptive Protection, and use joint findings to tune policies.
* Service Ownership: Own service levels, performance metrics and the operations and engineering runbook; lead knowledge transfer from our implementation partner; and become the Astellas operations owner for the platform by mid-2027.
* Platform Leadership: Own the Microsoft Purview data security platform roadmap and provide input to licensing decisions; oversee our implementation partner's engineering delivery and quality; and lead and mentor the Astellas engineers and analysts who take over day-to-day operations.

  

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology or a related field.
* 10+ years in security engineering or operations, including 4+ years hands-on with Microsoft Purview data security (Information Protection, DLP and data classification) in a production Microsoft 365 environment.
* Experience leading cross-functional initiatives with global stakeholders and overseeing external partners or vendors, including leading or mentoring a team.
* Experience building custom sensitive information types and tuning DLP policies to reduce false positives at enterprise scale.
* Hands-on experience with Endpoint DLP and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* PowerShell scripting, with working knowledge of KQL and Microsoft Graph.
* Ability to explain technical behavior clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience with exact data match, document fingerprinting or trainable classifiers.
* Experience protecting Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI tools with DSPM for AI.
* Experience integrating Purview with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR and ServiceNow.
* Experience with Zscaler CASB and Data Security products.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or other regulated industries.
* Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC-401); SC-200 or SC-100 a plus.

**Working Environment:**

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas’ Responsible Flexibility

  

**What awaits you at Astellas?**

* Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.
* Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day.
* Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare.
* A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.
  

**Our Organizational Values and Behaviors**

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

title: AI Operationalization Lead
description:
AI Operationalization Lead

**About Machinify**
-------------------

Machinify builds the AI operating system for healthcare payment intelligence, combining the minds of industry experts with the power of technology. US healthcare wastes billions of dollars a year inside the claims payment workflow, and Machinify has built a platform to fix that, backed by more than 40 years of payment integrity expertise and a product suite spanning the full claims lifecycle from pre-pay through post-pay. Today, 85+ customers rely on us, including 18 of the top 20 US health plans, covering more than 270 million member lives across commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid. We process over 3 petabytes of claims data and return more than $6 billion in savings and recoveries to our customers every year, with 99% customer retention.

We're now opening a new hub in Bengaluru that isn't a satellite office or a support function: it's a genuine extension of one global Machinify, where local leaders run real teams and own real product and outcomes. The problems our teams solve are hard by design, which is exactly why they haven't been solved before, and why the work is worth doing. Joining now means building Machinify's India presence- its people, culture, and way of working- from the ground up, with real influence over what gets built and how.

**About the Role**
------------------

Machinify is building a dedicated AI Operationalization team, and we're looking for a Lead to run it. Across the company, employees are already using AI tools — Claude, custom Slack bots, one-off scripts and apps — to solve real problems on their own initiative. Some of these "citizen developer" creations are genuinely valuable, but they were built to solve one person's problem quickly, not to run reliably at company scale, under the security, compliance, and support standards Machinify's customers and regulators expect.

The AI Operationalization Lead owns the pipeline that takes those grassroots AI products and turns them into tools the company can actually depend on — hardened, monitored, documented, and owned. Just as important, this role builds the platform, tooling, and repeatable process that make that operationalization faster and cheaper every time, so promoting a citizen-built prototype to a supported internal product stops being a bespoke project and becomes a well-worn path.

**What You Will Own**
---------------------

* Build and lead the AI Operationalization team, setting its charter, intake process, and prioritization model for evaluating citizen-developer AI tools.
* Define and run a maturity/promotion pipeline that takes a tool from prototype to production: security review, code and architecture review, testing, documentation, and ownership handoff — with a PHI screen early in the pipeline to flag anything that needs to be handed to the US-based compliance team instead of proceeding locally.
* Design and build the shared platform, templates, and "golden paths" (CI/CD, deployment patterns, reusable components, logging/monitoring hooks) that make it faster to operationalize the next tool than the last one.
* Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal on internal AI governance standards before a tool reaches production. This team does not own HIPAA/HITRUST compliance work: part of the role is recognizing when a citizen-developer tool touches protected health information and routing or escalating that work to Machinify's US-based Security and Compliance teams rather than operationalizing it locally.
* Work directly with citizen developers across the business to understand what they built and why, translate tribal knowledge into supportable systems, and mentor them in engineering practices that make their next build easier to operationalize.
* Establish ongoing ownership: monitoring, incident response, versioning, and a clear support model for each promoted tool, so operationalized tools don't silently degrade or become orphaned.
* Track and report on the health of the citizen-developer-to-production pipeline — what's in the queue, what's been promoted, what's been retired — to IT and business leadership.
* Evaluate and recommend platform, tooling, and vendor choices (internal developer platforms, model routing/gateways, deployment infrastructure) that support the team's mission.
* Stay current on the AI tooling landscape and bring in newer approaches where they meaningfully improve speed, reliability, or governance — with tradeoffs clearly stated to stakeholders.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of software engineering experience, including production ownership of systems built by others (rewrites, hardening, or platformization of existing prototypes).
* Direct experience working with LLM-based tools and frameworks (e.g., Claude, OpenAI, LangChain-style orchestration, MCP-based integrations) at a practical, hands-on level.
* Experience building internal developer platforms, CI/CD pipelines, or self-service tooling that other engineers or non-engineers use to ship work.
* Enough working familiarity with HIPAA/HITRUST-style data regulations to recognize when a piece of work touches protected health information and needs to be flagged or escalated — this role is not expected to own that compliance work directly.
* Experience with generalized process automation beyond LLM tooling — RPA, workflow orchestration, scripting-based automation — since much of what gets operationalized will look more like "automate this repetitive process reliably" than "integrate a language model."
* Track record of leading a small team or function, including setting process, prioritizing intake, and reporting to leadership.
* Strong communication skills — able to work with both non-technical "citizen developer" creators and engineering/security stakeholders, and to explain tradeoffs plainly.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity: this is a new function, and part of the role is defining what "done" looks like.

**Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify**
---------------------------------------------

*Machinify is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without discrimination on any status protected under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruitment process, please let our recruiting team know.*

* Test integrations between Salesforce and external systems, including REST/SOAP API flows.
* Log, track, and retest defects, coordinating with developers and business teams through resolution.
* Support release testing, regression cycles, and production validation.
* Maintain test evidence, execution results, and QA documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve test coverage and automate repeatable test scenarios.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

Must-Have Skills:  

* Hands-on experience in testing Salesforce features and applications.
* Experience in designing and executing test cases for functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Familiarity with Salesforce objects, workflows, Flows, permissions, and business processes.
* Experience with defect tracking and test documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

Good-to-Have Skills:  

* Experience in Salesforce test automation.
* Familiarity with Jira, Zephyr, TestRail, or ALM.
* Experience with Salesforce Clouds such as Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Health Cloud, or Experience Cloud.
* Experience working on healthcare projects.

title: COMPETENCY / CAPABILITY LEADER
description:
Purpose

Build world-class Data, Analytics and AI capability through offerings, reusable assets, architecture standards and industry solutions.

Role Overview

The Competency / Capability Leader runs the practices engine room — the offering factory, the reusable IP portfolio, architecture governance and the talent certification agenda. This leader ensures that every pursuit and delivery engagement is powered by hardened, healthcare-specific assets rather than one-off effort, and that the practice's technical standards keep pace with the Data-for-AI market. The role also anchors platform partnerships and provides senior technical firepower on large pursuits.

Key Responsibilities

•Own the offering factory — from concept through packaging, enablement and field adoption.

•Run the asset-harvesting engine — systematically mine delivery engagements for reusable IP, accelerators and solution patterns.

•Manage architecture governance and technical standards across the practice.

•Build accelerators and reusable IP that raise win rates and delivery productivity.

•Define AI-SDLC estimation models and productivity benchmarks used in pursuits and delivery planning.

•Drive certifications and structured capability development across the talent base.

•Lead platform partner collaboration (Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, AWS, GCP) — joint solution development and co-sell assets.

•Support large pursuits with differentiated solution constructs and assets.

Data-for-AI Skills

Must Have: Data Platform Architecture · AI Platform Architecture · Lakehouse Architecture · Data

Mesh · Data Products · MLOps · GenAI Architecture · Data Governance

Nice to Have: Agentic AI · Graph Databases · GraphRAG · Digital Twins · Healthcare Ontologies · AI

Foundry · Databricks Mosaic AI

Understanding of Healthcare Data, Standards & Compliance

Expected depth: Deep technical mastery — the standards and compliance knowledge must be encoded into offerings, reference architectures and reusable assets.

Healthcare Data Sets: Claims (medical & pharmacy) · Clinical / EHR (Epic Clarity/Caboodle, Cerner Millennium) · Enrollment / eligibility · Labs & imaging · Provider / member MDM domains · Registries & HIE feeds · Device telemetry · SDOH & RWD · OMOP CDM research data

Standards & Terminologies

FHIR R4 / US Core · Bulk FHIR · HL7 v2 / v3 / CDA & C-CDA · X12 EDI · NCPDP · DICOM · SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD-10, CPT / HCPCS terminology services · USCDI · TEFCA · OMOP CDM

Compliance & Regulatory

HIPAA de-identification engineering (Safe Harbor / Expert Determination) · Consent management patterns · 42 CFR Part 2 (behavioral health) · CMS interoperability rules (0057-F, 9115-F) · ONC certification criteria · FDA 21 CFR Part 11 / SaMD data considerations (HMT) · Policy-as-code governance

Guild & Community Contributions

Architecture & Solutions Guild

•Define reference architectures

•Lead review boards

•Publish solution standards

AI Guild

•Publish AI blueprints

•Create AI accelerators

•Build enterprise AI frameworks

Industry Offerings Guild

•Create reusable offerings

•Harvest assets from projects

•Establish reusable frameworks
